While {@condition charmed}, the creature must take the Dash action and move toward the light by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet of the light. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, the creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the {@condition charmed} creature enters the worm's snares, it has disadvantage on the saving throw to avoid being {@condition restrained}.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The blade can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Slippery
entries: Opportunity attacks against the blade are made with disadvantage.

trait.name: Toxiferous
entries: When a creature hits the blade with a melee attack while within 5 feet of them or touches the blade, that creature takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage.

action.name: Machete
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Dart
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Wild Hop
entries: The blade jumps a number of feet up to their walking speed. If the blade uses this bonus action to jump at least 10 feet straight toward a creature, the next Machete attack the blade makes against that creature on the same turn is made with advantage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The needler can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Sniper
entries: If the needler misses with a ranged weapon attack while they are hidden, they remain hidden. Additionally, if the needler makes a ranged weapon attack with advantage and hits, the attack deals an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage.

trait.name: Toxiferous
entries: When a creature hits the needler with a melee attack while within 5 feet of them or touches the needler, that creature takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage.

action.name: Poison Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Blowgun
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 25/100 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the target takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage at the start of each of their turns.

bonus.name: Hop and Hide
entries: The needler jumps a number of feet up to their walking speed, then takes the Hide action.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The seer can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Third Eye
entries: Creatures within 30 feet of the seer can't hide from the seer. Creatures who can't be targeted by divination magic are immune to this effect.

trait.name: Toxiferous
entries: When a creature hits the seer with a melee attack while within 5 feet of them or touches the seer, that creature takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage.

action.name: Acid Grasp
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage. If the target is a creature and they attack the seer before the start of the seer's next turn, the target takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Refulgent Beam
entries: The seer fires two magical beams of radiant energy, each beam targeting a creature the seer can see within 120 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) radiant damage and shed dim light in a 10-foot radius for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While shedding light in this way, attack rolls against the target have advantage, the target can't benefit from being {@condition invisible}, and they can't take the Hide action.

action.name: Noxious Bubble (1/Day)
entries: The seer creates a 5-foot-radius sphere filled with toxic gas in an unoccupied space they can see within 60 feet of them. If undisturbed, this bubble lasts for 1 minute then dissipates harmlessly. If a creature attacks the bubble, touches it, enters its space, or otherwise disturbs it, the bubble bursts, and each creature within 15 feet of it must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 27 ({@damage 6d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Psychedelic Drone (1/Day)
entries: Each enemy within 60 feet of the seer who can hear them must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage and be {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

bonus.name: Hop
entries: The seer jumps a number of feet up to their walking speed.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The slink can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The slink can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Toxiferous
entries: When a creature hits the slink with a melee attack while within 5 feet of them or touches the slink, that creature takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The slink makes one Poison Dagger attack and one Tongue Nab attack.

action.name: Poison Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage, and the target can't take reactions until the start of their next turn.

action.name: Tongue Nab
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. {@h}The slink grabs one Small or Tiny object the slink can see that the target is holding or carrying. The slink can catch the object if they have a free hand, otherwise it lands at the slink's feet.

bonus.name: Hop and Hide
entries: The slink jumps a number of feet up to their walking speed, then takes the Hide action.

trait.name: Acid Burst
entries: When the tadpole is reduced to 0 hit points, their body pops, spraying acid around them. Each creature within 5 feet of the tadpole takes 1 acid damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The tadpole can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the tadpole takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the tadpole takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Noxious Skin
entries: When a creature starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more tadpoles, that creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of their next turn. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 plus the number of tadpoles within 5 feet of the creature.

action.name: Bite (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, one target. {@h}1 piercing damage.

hp.special: Seven times their level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their level)

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The angulotl yegg can breathe air and water.

action.name: Signature Attack (Poison Knife)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d4 plus PB} piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage. Beginning at 7th level, the yegg can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Death from Above! (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the yegg jumps up to their walking speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If they leap over an enemy during this jump, the yegg can make a signature attack with advantage against that enemy. On a hit, this attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 5th Level: Lay Low (3/Day)
entries: When the yegg hits a creature with a signature attack while hidden, the yegg can use their reaction to remain hidden.

action.name: 7th Level: Excoriating Acid (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the yegg throws a flask of acid at a point they can see within 20 feet of them. The flask shatters, and each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage PBd10} acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Promising Threat
entries: The bestial spirit has advantage on Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks if the target has seen it hit a creature with its Chomp attack in the past minute.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Devour
entries: When the bestial spirit reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it consumes some of the creature's essence, regaining {@dice 1d10} hit points.

trait.name: Sludge Form
entries: The animated sludge can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

action.name: Contaminated Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. In addition, a target hit by this attack must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.

action.name: Engulf
entries: Each creature in the animated sludge's space must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature becomes {@condition grappled} by the sludge if it is Large or smaller (escape {@dc 14}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}. If the saving throw is successful, the target is pushed out of the sludge's space.

The sludge can grapple one Large creature or up to two Medium or smaller creatures at one time. At the start of each of the sludge's turns, each target {@condition grappled} by it takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) necrotic damage and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.
A creature within 5 feet of the sludge can attempt to pull a creature or object out of it. This takes an action and requires a successful {@dc 14} Strength check.

trait.name: Invisible in Sludge
entries: The elemental has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition while fully submerged in delerium sludge.

trait.name: Sludge Form
entries: The elemental can enter a {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

action.name: Contaminated Touch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

action.name: Engulf
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 15}, each Large or smaller creature in the elemental's space. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is pushed out of the elemental's space. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. The elemental can grapple one Large creature or two Medium or smaller creatures at a time.

At the start of each of the elemental's turns, the target takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Necrotic damage and is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.
A creature within 5 feet of the elemental can take an action to pull a creature or object out of it with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: If the spirit is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the spirit move or act, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to discern that the spirit isn't an object.

trait.name: New Form (1/Day)
entries: When the spirit is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, it can choose a different object it can see within 10 feet of it and send its consciousness into that object. After it does so, it drops to 1 hit point instead.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Telekinetic Reach
entries: The spirit casts the {@spell Mage Hand} cantrip. When it does so, the spectral hand created by the spell is {@condition invisible}.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The animated slime can use its action to polymorph into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
entries: While the animated slime remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The animated slime has advantage on attack rolls against any creature {@condition grappled} by it.

trait.name: Occasionally Adhesive (Object Form Only)
entries: The animated slime can use a bonus action to become sticky and adhere to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the animated slime is also {@condition grappled} by it (escape {@dc 13}). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage. The animated slime can become non-adhesive at any time.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the slime is in object form, the target is subjected to its Occasionally Adhesive trait (if it is currently active).

name: Ankheg

trait.name: Disoriented Resistance (2/Day)
entries: When the ankheg fails a saving throw, they can succeed instead, and they can't use bonus actions until the end of their next turn.

trait.name: Earth Walk
entries: Difficult terrain composed of earth and stone doesn't cost the ankheg extra movement.

trait.name: Soft Underbelly
entries: When a {@condition prone} creature within 5 feet of the ankheg attacks the ahkheg, the attack is made with advantage instead of disadvantage.

trait.name: Unstable Tunneler
entries: While burrowing, the ankheg leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in their wake. Each section of tunnel collapses 1 minute after the ahkheg leaves that space.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) acid damage. If the target is Large or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and the ankheg can't make a Bite attack against another target.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Acid Spit {@recharge}
entries: The ankheg spits acid in a 30-foot long, 5-foot-wide line. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage and is bathed in acid. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

A creature who is bathed in acid takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage at the start of each of their turns for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). A creature can use their action to wipe the acid off themself or another creature within their reach, ending the effect early.

bonus.name: Earth Eruption
entries: While burrowing within 10 feet of the surface, the ankheg erupts (without spending movement) into a 10-foot square on the ground directly above them. This area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature on the ground in this area must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is pushed 5 feet to an unoccupied space of the ankheg's choice and is {@condition restrained} by rubble. A creature can use their action to free themself or another creature within their reach. On a successful save, a creature is moved 5 feet to an unoccupied space of the creature's choice and is not {@condition restrained}.

reaction.name: Skitter
entries: When a creature attacks the ankheg, the ankheg can move up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendaryHeader: The ankheg has three villain actions. They can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. The ankheg can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Big Bug!
entries: The ankheg stands on their hind legs in an impressive and terrifying display of dominance. Each enemy within 30 feet of the ankheg who can see them must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the ankheg for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

legendary.name: Action 2: Quick Burrow
entries: If the ankheg is {@condition grappled}, the condition ends for them, and they burrow up to twice their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If the ankheg is grappling a Large or smaller creature during this movement, the ankheg's speed is not halved.

legendary.name: Action 3: Acid Bath
entries: Acid sprays from the ankheg's wounds onto each creature within 15 feet of them. Each target must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Deep Earth Dweller
entries: The annelidast doesn't require air.

trait.name: Primordial Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the annelidast must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage. A creature that finishes a long rest within 1,000 feet of the annelidast must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or develop tumors across its body and become {@condition poisoned} until the tumors are removed by the {@spell greater restoration} spell or similar magic.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The annelidast can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The annelidast makes three Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 2d12 + 8}) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from the annelidast. A creature {@condition restrained} by the annelidast automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

action.name: Crush {@recharge 5}
entries: The annelidast launches most of its massive bulk into the air and crashes down on the ground in a 20-foot line that is 10 feet wide. It then retracts itself into a space along that line and can occupy the space of one or more Large or smaller creatures. Each creature in the line must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 45 ({@damage 7d12}) bludgeoning damage, is knocked {@condition prone}, and is {@condition restrained} while it shares a space with the annelidast, as it is pinned beneath the annelidast's body. On a success, a creature takes half the damage, isn't knocked {@condition prone}, and is pushed out of the annelidast's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice within 5 feet of the annelidast. A creature, including the {@condition restrained} creature, can take its action to free the {@condition restrained} creature by succeeding on a {@dc 17} Strength check. If the annelidast burrows along the surface of the earth at least 20 feet before using this action, creatures in the line have disadvantage on the saving throw.

reaction.name: Defensive Recoil
entries: When the annelidast takes damage, it can make one Slam attack against a creature {@condition restrained} by it.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: Annominc has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If Annominc moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, Annominc can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Snail Trail
entries: When the anomollusk moves through a space, it fills the space with contaminated mucus that remains for 10 minutes. A creature that ends its turn in the mucus is covered in goop and subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} 20 ({@damage 8d4}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition. Each time the creature ends its turn with the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition, it gains a {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. A creature within 5 feet can take an action to clean away the goop, ending the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

action.name: Slobber
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}20 ({@damage 8d4}) Acid damage.

action.name: Creep
entries: The anomollusk moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, and can enter the spaces of Large or smaller creatures as it does. Each creature whose space it enters is subjected once to the following effect. {@actSave str} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is pushed 5 feet away from the anomollusk into a space of its choice. If the target chooses not to move, it suffers the effects of a failure. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition and is subjected to Snail Trail.

reaction.name: Shell Reflection
entries: {@actTrigger} The anomollusk takes damage from a spell or magical attack. {@actResponse} The attacker takes Radiant damage equal to the triggering damage and causes an {@table Arcane Anomalies|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: Anthracia has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Anthracia makes three attacks using Stone Touch, Missile Thorn, or both. She can also use Tree Teleport, if available.

action.name: Stone Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (save ends at end of turn) as their limbs become heavy. If this attack reduces a creature to 0 hit points, they become stable and are {@condition petrified} into a withered stone tree featuring their tortured likeness. The petrification lasts until the creature is restored by a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power of 4th order or higher, a {@spell greater restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect.

action.name: Missile Thorn
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, range 90 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Tree Teleport (3/Day; 5th-Level Spell)
entries: Anthracia touches a living tree. She instantly teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of another living tree within 500 feet of the first.
Both trees must be Medium or larger.

action.name: Wall of Poison (1/Day)
entries: Anthracia conjures an opaque wall of poisonous gas centered on a point she can see within 150 feet of her. The wall can be up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall lingers in the air for 1 minute and its area is heavily obscured. Each creature who is in that area when the wall appears or who enters it for the first time on a turn must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 26 ({@damage 4d12}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures who don't need to breathe automatically succeed on this saving throw. A moderate wind (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses the wall after 4 rounds. A strong wind (at least 20 miles per hour) disperses it after 1 round.

reaction.name: Sudden Quake
entries: When an enemy moves within 15 feet of Anthracia, she creates a small tremor in the ground beneath her. Each creature within 15 feet of her must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Elemental Nature
entries: The anubian doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Sand Camouflage
entries: The anubian has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in sandy terrain.

trait.name: Sand Form
entries: The anubian can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Vulnerability to Water
entries: For every 5 feet the anubian moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) cold damage. An anubian completely immersed in water takes 10 ({@damage 4d4}) cold damage at the start of its turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The anubian makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Haboob (1/Day)
entries: A 30-foot-tall cylinder of sand forms in the anubian's space and moves with it for 10 minutes, until the anubian ends the storm as a bonus action, or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). The area within 5 feet of the anubian is heavily obscured. A creature that starts its turn in that area or enters the area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} by the storm. While {@condition restrained}, the creature takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) slashing damage at the start of each of its turns, and moves with the anubian when the anubian moves. A creature, including the {@condition restrained} creature, can use its action to free the {@condition restrained} creature by succeeding on a {@dc 13} Strength check.

bonus.name: Sand Step
entries: The anubian collapses into loose sand and teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, reforming in that space. If the destination space contains sand, the anubian can immediately Hide. The anubian can't use Sand Step while Haboob is active.

trait.name: Diseased Ichor
entries: When the apau perape takes piercing damage or slashing damage, a spray of caustic blood spurts from the wound. Each creature within 5 feet of the apau perape must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or become infected with the Mechuiti's ichor disease and be {@condition poisoned} until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours that elapse, the target must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hp maximum by 5 ({@dice 2d4}) on a failure. The disease is cured on a success. This reduction lasts until the disease is cured. The creature dies if the disease reduces its hp maximum to 0.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The apau perape has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The apau perape makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Fiery Roar {@recharge}
entries: The apau perape releases a terrifying, flame-coated roar in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 31 ({@damage 9d6}) fire damage and is {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The Apex regains 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn. If the Apex takes Necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The Apex dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The Apex's {@variantrule Long Jump|XPHB} is up to 50 feet and its {@variantrule High Jump|XPHB} is up to 30 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Apex makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Lightning Bolt
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}, each creature in a 120-foot long, 5-foot wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Lightning damage, and the target has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Fire Blast
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 10}, range 120 ft. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) Fire damage, and the target and each creature within 10 feet of it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d8} Fire).

bonus.name: Cold Snap
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 18}, one creature the Apex can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 45 ({@damage 10d8}) Cold damage, and the target has the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dc 18}). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Rapid Adaptation
entries: {@actTrigger} The Apex takes damage that isn't Necrotic or Psychic. {@actResponse} The Apex gains {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to that damage type until it is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The witch casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

spellcasting.name: Misty Step (1/day)
headerEntries: The witch casts {@spell Misty Step|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The witch makes two attacks, using Dagger or Eldritch Burst in any combination.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Eldritch Burst
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., or range 120 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Force damage.

reaction.name: Reflexive Hex
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the witch can see within 60 feet makes an ability check, attack roll or saving throw. {@actResponse} The target must roll a {@dice d4} and subtract the number rolled from the triggering roll.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The aqualisk can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The aqualisk has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The aqualisk's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The aqualisk makes two attacks: one with its bite and one to constrict. If it is grappling a creature, it can also use its Fling.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}29 ({@damage 4d10 + 7}) piercing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 4d12 + 7}) bludgeoning damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, that creature is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and the aqualisk can't constrict another target.

action.name: Ethereal Strike (1/Turn)
entries: While on the Ethereal Plane, the aqualisk momentarily shifts to the Material Plane and makes a bite attack against a creature before returning to the Ethereal Plane. Unless the target can see into the Ethereal Plane, the aqualisk has advantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The aqualisk magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane. If a creature is {@condition grappled} by the aqualisk when it uses this action, the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or be pulled into the Ethereal Plane with it. The aqualisk and target remain there as long as the aqualisk maintains {@status concentration} (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). If its {@status concentration} is broken or it chooses to end its {@status concentration}, the aqualisk and the target both return to the Material Plane.

action.name: Fling
entries: One object held or creature {@condition grappled} by the aqualisk is thrown up to 60 feet in a direction it chooses and knocked {@condition prone}. If a thrown creature strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Bite, Pinch, or Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Bubble Lift (1/Day)
entries: The spirit casts the {@spell Bubble Lift|ObojimaTallGrass} spell, using Wisdom as its spellcasting ability

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Aristocratic Disguise
entries: An arachnocrat in a prepared disguise has advantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) checks made to pass as a humanoid aristocrat.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the arachnocrat's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The arachnocrat has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Speak with Spiders
entries: The arachnocrat can communicate with spiders and other arachnids as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The arachnocrat can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The arachnocrat makes two claw attacks. If both claws hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is {@condition restrained} in gilded webbing. As an action, the {@condition restrained} target can make a {@dc 13} Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 12; hp 8; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hp, the target is stable but {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour, even after regaining hp, and is {@condition paralyzed} while {@condition poisoned} in this way. The skin of a creature that dies while {@condition poisoned} takes on a golden hue.

trait.name: Boscage Brachiation
entries: The arboreal grappler doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it climbs out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Mobile Grappler
entries: The arboreal grappler can move at its full speed when dragging a Medium or smaller creature it has {@condition grappled}.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The arboreal grappler can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The arboreal grappler makes one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}. The arboreal grappler has two tentacles, each of which can grapple only one target.

trait.name: Antimagic Lethargy
entries: While in the area of an {@spell antimagic field} spell, the amalgam's speed is halved and they can't use reactions. Additionally, if targeted by the {@spell dispel magic} spell, the amalgam must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or be unable to use reactions for 1 minute.

trait.name: Arcane Tracker
entries: If the amalgam comes within 30 feet of a creature or object affected by magic, the amalgam can unerringly track that target for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Explosive Enhancement
entries: After the amalgam is hit with an attack using a mundane melee weapon, that weapon becomes charged with vibrating energy. For the next minute, the weapon gains a cumulative +1 bonus to damage rolls. If this bonus increases to +3, the weapon explodes and is destroyed, and the creature wielding it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) force damage.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the amalgam remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a puddle of muck.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The amalgam can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the amalgam can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. The amalgam can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The arcane amalgam makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage, or 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage if the amalgam has half their hit points or fewer.

action.name: Wild Surge {@recharge 5}
entries: The unstable compounds that form the amalgam react violently to each other. Each creature within 10 feet of the amalgam must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) damage of a random type (roll a {@dice d6} for each creature): 1, acid; 2, cold; 3, fire; 4, force; 5, necrotic; 6, poison. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

reaction.name: Spell Reflection
entries: When the amalgam takes damage from a spell, they emit a burst of magical energy. Each creature within 10 feet of the amalgam must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) damage of the type dealt to the amalgam by the triggering spell. If the spell dealt more than one type of damage, the amalgam chooses which type this reaction deals.

name: Arcane Guardian
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The arcane guardian casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Disgrace Bound
entries: The arcane guardian is bound to a tomb, castle ruins, or other place related to the disgrace in life that caused it to rise as a arcane guardian in death. If the guardian starts its turn more than 1 mile from its bound location, it loses its Spectral Blade action until it returns to the region. If it remains outside the region, it automatically teleports back to its bound location after 24 hours, regardless of distance.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The arcane guardian can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The arcane guardian doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The arcane guardian makes three Spectral Burst attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Spectral Burst
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) force damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The wraith is an 8th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). The wraith knows the following sorcerer spells:

name: Arcane Wraith

resist.note: from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered

languages: The languages it knew in life

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The arcane wraith casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The arcane wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The arcane wraith makes three Comet Shard attacks.

action.name: Comet Shard
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) Force damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the arcane wraith.

action.name: Nightmare Pattern {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} centered on a point the arcane wraith can see. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition (save ends). While {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition. The effect ends for the target if it takes damage or another creature takes an action to shake it out of its nightmare. When the effect ends, the target takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage.

trait.name: Collective Mind
entries: Ia'Affrat's individual Fiends are connected via a hive mind. He can telepathically communicate with any of his individual Fiends within 50 miles of him, and he can't be surprised. If he is reduced to half his hp or lower, his Intelligence score is reduced to 10, he immediately changes into his shapeless form, and he can't take on a Humanoid form again until he regains hp to be above half his hp or he finishes a long rest.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede Ia'Affrat's darkvision.

trait.name: Grasping Limbs (Humanoid Form Only)
entries: Ia'Affrat can wield weapons and hold, grasp, push, pull, or interact with objects that might otherwise require a more Humanoid form to accomplish.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Ia'Affrat fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Ia'Affrat has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Smoke Shroud
entries: Ia'Affrat emits a cloud of dark smoke within 5 feet of himself. The area is lightly obscured to all except Ia'Affrat, and each non-devil creature that starts its turn in the smoke must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of its turn. At the start of each of his turns, Ia'Affrat chooses whether this shroud is active.

trait.name: Swarm (Shapeless Form Only)
entries: Ia'Affrat can occupy another creature's space and vice versa and can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect, but he can't grapple or be {@condition grappled}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ia'Affrat makes three Bite or Burning Claw attacks, or he makes four Flaming Insect Bolt attacks.

action.name: Bite (Shapeless Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. {@h}21 ({@damage 6d6}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage, or 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage if Ia'Affrat has half of its hp or fewer. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Burning Claw (Humanoid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Flaming Insect Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 11} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) fire damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Inhabit (Shapeless Form Only)
entries: Ia'Affrat crawls into the body of a Humanoid, or a Humanoid corpse that has been dead no more than 7 days, that he can see within 5 feet of him. If the target is unwilling, the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or the target loses control of its body, and Ia'Affrat takes control of the body. Ia'Affrat controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Ia'Affrat can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, and he retains his alignment, his Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, his Hurl Flame action and Teleport and Consume Host legendary actions, and his condition immunities. He otherwise uses the target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. If the target was a Humanoid corpse, he uses the statistics it had before it died.

Ia'Affrat inhabits the target until the target's body is reduced to 0 hp, Ia'Affrat ends it as a bonus action, or Ia'Affrat is forced out by the dispel evil and good or {@spell greater restoration} spell. When the inhabit ends, Ia'Affrat reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target. The target is immune to Ia'Affrat's Inhabit for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the inhabit ends.

bonus.name: Shape Swarm
entries: Ia'Affrat can shape himself into a Large or smaller Humanoid or back into a shapeless mass of Tiny insectoid Fiends. His statistics, other than his size, are the same in each form, and he can't regain hp or gain temporary hp, except for the Consume Host legendary action. He can't take on a Humanoid form if he is occupying the space of another creature.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: Ia'Affrat teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

legendary.name: Vermin Breath (Costs 2 Actions; Humanoid Form Only)
entries: Ia'Affrat exhales {@dice 1d4} swarms of insects in spaces he can see within 30 feet. The swarms take their turns immediately after Ia'Affrat, and they are allies of Ia'Affrat, obeying his telepathic commands. They remain for 1 minute, until Ia'Affrat dies, or until Ia'Affrat dismisses them as a bonus action. Ia'Affrat can have no more than five swarms of insects under his control at a time.

legendary.name: Consume Host (Costs 3 Actions; Shapeless Form Only)
entries: While inhabiting a Humanoid, Ia'Affrat consumes the host from the inside. The host takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage, and Ia'Affrat regains hp equal to that amount.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the flower remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal shrub.

trait.name: Rooted
entries: The flower is unaffected by forced movement and can't be detached while it lives. If the flower is rooted to a wall or ceiling, it doesn't need to make ability checks to maintain its grip.

action.name: Flytrap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}).

action.name: Acid Spit
entries: One creature within 60 feet of the flower that the flower can see must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw. A creature that fails its save takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage and is knocked {@condition prone}. If the creature is climbing, it instead loses its grip and falls. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much acid damage and suffers no other effects.

name: Ardwyn, Elder of Meadowfen
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Ardwyn is a 5th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). Ardwyn has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Ardwyn can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. She lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement, and takes no falling damage. She cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

trait.name: Wing Flap
entries: As a bonus action, Ardwyn can use her powerful feathered arms to propel herself upward a distance equal to half her movement speed. She can use it in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

trait.name: Seedspeech
entries: Ardwyn can communicate simple ideas to living plants, and is able to interpret their responses in simple language.

trait.name: Divine Eminence
entries: As a bonus action, Ardwyn can expend a spell slot to cause her melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) radiant damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If Ardwyn expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by {@damage 1d6} for each level above 1st.

action.name: Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Argan can cast the following spells, using Intelligence as his spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}):

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Argan has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Pervasive Magic
entries: Damage from Argan's spell attacks ignore the target's damage resistances.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Argan makes three Arcane Lance attacks.

action.name: Arcane Lance (Cantrip)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 5d6}) force damage, and Argan moves the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

action.name: Lightning Volley (3rd-Level Spell)
entries: Argan calls down lightning on up to three creatures he can see within 30 feet of him. Each target must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) lightning damage and their speed is halved until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and their speed is not halved.

action.name: Fireball (1/Day; 7th-Level Spell)
entries: Argan sculpts a fiery explosion centered on a point within 90 feet of him. Each creature of his choice in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 ({@damage 12d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Misty Step (2/Day; 2nd-Level Spell)
entries: Argan teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The aridni casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The aridni doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The aridni has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The aridni makes three Shortsword or Pixie Bow attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Pixie Bow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 40/160 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d4 + 5}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Enchanted Arrows
entries: The aridni enchants one arrow with minor magic. The next time it hits a creature with a Pixie Bow attack before the start of its next turn, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or suffer one of the following effects:

items.name: Confusion
entries: The target can't take reactions and acts randomly until the end of its next turn, as if it had failed the saving throw against the {@spell confusion} spell.

items.name: Fear
entries: The target is {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn and must spend its next turn moving away from the aridni by the safest available route.

items.name: Laughter
entries: The target falls {@condition prone} and is {@condition incapacitated} with laughter until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Sleep
entries: The target falls {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute. It wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

trait.name: Strength of Will
entries: Arin has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}, and she gains a bonus to these saving throws equal to her Wisdom modifier.

trait.name: Occupation
entries: Ranger

trait.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Faithful, Fair-spoken

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Arin makes two melee attacks, or one melee attack and one ranged attack.

action.name: Long Sword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage, or 8 ({@dice 1d10 + 3}) if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage, or 7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Arin adds 2 to her AC against one melee attack that would hit her. To do so, she must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

name: Arlowene Lum
languages: can speak with beasts of any size which represent spiders, insects, worms, or other bugs

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Arlowene is a 10th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). Arlowene has the following spells prepared:

action.name: Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 1} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d6 - 1}) bludgeoning damage, or 3 ({@damage 1d8 - 1}) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Curl Up
entries: Arlowene curls up into a spiny ball. When curled up in this way, she can't move, attack, or cast spells with somatic components, and her base armor class becomes 19. Any creature that misses Arlowene with an attack while she is curled up takes 5 {@dice 2d4} points of piercing damage from her sharp quills. If a creature hits Arlowene while she is curled up, however, Arlowene is knocked {@condition prone} in her space. Arlowene may uncurl herself at any point during her turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Aronar can cast the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 19}):

trait.name: Charm Resistant
entries: Aronar has advantage on saving throws he makes to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} condition on himself.

trait.name: Delusions of Grandeur
entries: Whenever Aronar is affected by an effect (such as the {@spell hold person} spell) that allows him to make a saving throw at the end of his turn, he can also repeat that saving throw at the start of his turn. Additionally, whenever Aronar succeeds on a saving throw against an effect, he ends that effect on himself and any ally within 30 feet of him under the same effect.

trait.name: Sun Eater's Grace (3/Day)
entries: When Aronar is within 30 feet of Athmia and casts a spell that restores hit points to another creature, Athmia regains the same number of hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Aronar makes three Divine Mace attacks, or he makes one Divine Mace attack and one God Complex attack.

action.name: Divine Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d6 + 8}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the start of their next turn.

action.name: God Complex (3/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 11} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 8d6}) necrotic damage, and the next attack roll made against this target before the end of Aronar's next turn has advantage.

action.name: Cure Wounds (3/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
entries: Aronar touches a creature and the target regains 21 ({@dice 3d8 + 8}) hit points.

bonus.name: Vainglory (3/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
entries: A creature of Aronar's choice within 60 feet of him regains 15 ({@dice 3d4 + 8}) hit points.

reaction.name: Sun Eater's Soul (3/Day)
entries: When a creature Aronar can see within 30 feet of him is hit with an attack, he can halve the attack's damage dealt to them.

name: Arrevis Fleet
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Arrevis wields a gold-hilted {@item Longsword of Life Stealing||longsword of life-stealing}. Attacks made with this weapon are magical. Arrevis also wears a {@item periapt of wound closure}.

trait.name: Pain Threshold
entries: If Arrevis takes 20 damage or more at once, he is {@condition stunned} until the end of his next turn.

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Arrevis can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. Arrevis lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement and takes no falling damage. Arrevis cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

trait.name: Talons
entries: Arrevis has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface his talons could reasonably grip.

trait.name: Patient
entries: When Arrevis reacts with a {@action Ready||readied action}, he has advantage on the first attack roll, skill check, or ability check he makes as part of that action.

trait.name: Woodland Hunter
entries: Arrevis treats three-quarters cover as half cover and half cover as no cover.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Arrevis makes two attacks with his longsword of life stealing. If Arrevis leaves one hand free, he can also make an attack with his talons.

action.name: Longsword of Life Stealing
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage if used with two hands. Whenever Arrevis scores a critical hit with this attack, his target takes an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage, provided that the target isn't a construct or an undead. Arrevis gains temporary hit points equal to the extra damage dealt.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage. The longbow is not considered a {@itemProperty H||heavy} weapon for Arrevis.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The arx is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The arx has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spiky Hide
entries: A creature that touches the arx or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) piercing damage. This trait also applies to the arx's walls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The arx makes two Claw attacks and one Spear attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) piercing damage, or 14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Wall Smash
entries: If the arx has its wall set up (see Emplace Wall), it can briefly close the panels of the wall in on each other. Each creature other than the arx between the panels in a 10-foot cone from the corner where the panels meet must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 ({@damage 8d6}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Emplace Wall {@recharge 3}
entries: The arx extends its hardened elytra and casts them into the ground, creating a wall. The wall is 3 inches thick and is composed of two 10-foot-by-10-foot panels. The panels must connect perpendicular to each other, forming a corner behind the arx. If the wall falls in a creature's space when the arx places it, the creature must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage, and the arx determines to which side of the wall the creature is pushed. On a success, the creature takes half the damage and decides to which side of the wall it is pushed.

Each 10-foot panel has AC 17 and 50 hp. If a panel is destroyed, the arx can place only one panel of wall with this bonus action. If both panels are destroyed, the arx can't use this bonus action again until it finishes a long rest or until its elytra are restored with a {@spell regenerate} spell or similar magic.
While the arx has at least one wall emplaced, it must remain within 15 feet of at least one of its walls. The arx can retract the walls into its body, ending this effect, as a bonus action.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The asanbosam can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The asanbosam makes one Bite attack and one Claws attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) poison damage and contract a disease. Until the disease ends, the creature is {@condition poisoned}. Every 24 hours that elapse, the infected creature must repeat the saving throw. On a success, the disease ends. On a failure, the creature's hp maximum is reduced by 5 ({@dice 1d10}). This reduction lasts until the disease ends. The target dies if its hp maximum is reduced to 0.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the asanbosam can't use its Claws on another target. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or contract the disease described in the Bite attack.

bonus.name: Arboreal Escape
entries: While in a tree, the asanbosam takes the Disengage or Hide action.

hp.special: 125 (10d10 + 70) plus 125 (10d10 + 70) per player character

trait.name: Aura of Dread
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Vladimir von Drakken takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Daywalker
entries: Vladimir von Drakken doesn't possess any Vampire Weaknesses from the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

trait.name: Reborn Transformation
entries: When he finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, Vladimir von Drakken reverts to his Reborn Vladimir von Drakken form.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Vladimir von Drakken regains 30 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} remaining.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If Vladimir von Drakken is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or dies, he drops to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} instead unless he is killed by a creature with the blood of House von Drakken within them.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: Vladimir von Drakken can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Vladimir von Drakken always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On his turn, Vladimir von Drakken can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Vladimir von Drakken takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Bloodmourne
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 15}, reach 5 ft. {@h}35 ({@damage 6d8 + 8}) Force damage, and the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d4}).

items.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 15}, reach 5 ft. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d8 + 8}) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 23}).

action.name: Bite (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 23}, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, or {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveFail} 70 ({@damage 20d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dc 22} Constitution save ends). Vladimir von Drakken regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Necrotic damage dealt. A Humanoid killed by this damage rises on its next turn as a Vampire Spawn under Vladimir von Drakken's control.

action.name: Soul Rending {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 23}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 54 ({@damage 12d8}) Necrotic damage. Failure by 5 or More: Double damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Terrifying Glare
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 23}, one creature Vladimir von Drakken can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 25 ({@damage 6d6 + 4}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. Failure by 5 or More: While {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Wing Blast (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 23}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from Vladimir von Drakken. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from Vladimir von Drakken and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Before or after using this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, Vladimir von Drakken can move up to half his {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

action.name: Aerial Maneuver (1/Round)
entries: Vladimir von Drakken moves up to his {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: Vladimir von Drakken chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. He can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

reaction.name: Blood Rage (1/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} Vladimir von Drakken becomes {@status Bloodied|XPHB}. He can use this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} even if he has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition or is otherwise unable to take Reactions. {@actResponse} All conditions and spells on Vladimir von Drakken end unless he chooses to be affected by them, and he can move up to his {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action and ignoring {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. Vladimir von Drakken recharges and immediately uses Soul Rending.

trait.name: Firesight
entries: The ash drake can see through areas obscured by fire, smoke, and fog without penalty.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drake makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Ash Cloud {@recharge}
entries: The ash drake beats its wings, filling the area within 10 feet of it with ash for 1 minute. The ash spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. Each creature that isn't an ash drake and that enters the cloud for the first time on its turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn. The ash moves with the drake, remaining centered on it for the duration.

action.name: Ash Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The ash drake spews blistering hot, choking ash in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. A {@condition poisoned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The firetamer is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Flamecharm (Recharges after a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|Short or Long Rest})
entries: The firetamer can cast the {@spell dominate monster} spell (save {@dc 15}) on a {@creature fire elemental} or other elemental fire creature. If the creature has 150 or more hit points, it has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on the {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}.

bonus.name: Flameform (Recharges after a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|Short or Long Rest})
entries: The firetamer can transform into a {@creature fire elemental}. Its game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the elemental, but the firetamer retains its alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, and all of its skill and {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} proficiencies. While in this form, the firetamer can't cast spells. When the firetamer is reduced to 0 hit points, falls {@condition unconscious}, or dies in this form, it reverts to its humanoid form. It can remain in flameform for up to 5 hours or until it reverts to its humanoid form as a bonus action.

bonus.name: Druidic Recovery
entries: If the firetamer is in {@creature fire elemental} form using Flameform, it can expend a spell slot to regain {@dice 1d8} hit points per level of the spell slot expended.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The skydancer is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the skydancer is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} to take only half damage, the skydancer instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The skydancer doesn't provoke an {@action opportunity attack|PHB} when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Skysail
entries: The skydancer flies with a special Ashari magic item called a {@item skysail|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn}. While the {@item skysail|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|skysail's} wings are extended, the skydancer can glide through the air at a speed of 60 feet, but must descend by at least 10 feet at the end of its turn and can't gain altitude.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skydancer makes two {@item skysail|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn} staff attacks.

action.name: Skysail Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the skydancer makes this attack while flying, the target must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Fly (1/Day)
entries: The skydancer uses its {@item skysail|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn} to cast {@spell fly} on itself for up to 1 minute (no {@status concentration} required).

reaction.name: Slow Fall
entries: When the skydancer takes {@quickref falling|XGE|2|0|falling damage}, it can reduce the damage by half.

resist.note: from non-magical attacks, when using skin-to-stone

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The stoneguard is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stoneguard makes three granite maul attacks.

action.name: Granite Maul
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the attack hits, the stoneguard can also immediately cast {@spell thunderwave} as a bonus action. This casting uses a spell slot but requires no components.

reaction.name: Sentinel
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the stoneguard attacks a target other than the stoneguard, the stoneguard can make one attack against that creature.

reaction.name: Skin to Stone
entries: When the stoneguard is attacked, it gains resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks until the end of the attacker's turn

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The waverider is a 7th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

trait.name: Healing Tides
entries: Whenever the waverider casts a spell of 1st level or higher that affects a non-hostile creature, that creature regains 3 hit points (in addition to any healing the spell may provide).

trait.name: Marine Empathy
entries: The waverider can speak with and understand aquatic plants and animals.

action.name: Harpoon
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a Strength contest against the waverider or be pulled up to 20 feet toward the waverider. Attacks with this weapon made while {@quickref Underwater Combat|PHB|3|0|underwater} do not have {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|disadvantage}.

reaction.name: Fishform (Recharges after a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|Short or Long Rest})
entries: The waverider can transform into a {@creature hunter shark} or a {@creature giant octopus}. Its game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the chosen creature, but the waverider retains its alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. It also retains its skill proficiencies, in addition to gaining those of the creature it transforms into. When the waverider is reduced to 0 hit points, falls {@condition unconscious}, or dies in this form, it reverts to its humanoid form. It can remain in fishform for up to 3 hours or until it reverts to its humanoid form as a bonus action.

name: Ashen Hoarder
languages: understands the languages of their creator but can't speak

trait.name: Corpse Carrier
entries: The hoarder carries 6 ({@dice 1d6 + 3}) corpses, which they can use with Corpse Bomb and Create Zombies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hoarder makes two Arm attacks. If both attacks hit the same creature, they can use Impale on the target.

action.name: Arm
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage (hoarder's choice).

action.name: Impale
entries: The hoarder attempts to impale one Larger or smaller creature they can see within 10 feet of them on their spikes. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) piercing damage and be {@condition restrained}. A creature {@condition restrained} in this way takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage at the start of each of their turns, and if this damage reduces them to 0 hit points, they die and become an additional corpse for the hoarder's Corpse Carrier. A creature can use their action to make a {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, and on a success, they free themself or a creature within reach who is {@condition restrained} by the hoarder. If the hoarder is destroyed, each creature {@condition restrained} by them is freed.

action.name: Corpse Bomb
entries: The hoarder hurls a corpse up to 60 feet, destroying it and releasing necrotic energy in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on the corpse. Each creature in this area must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 33 ({@damage 6d10}) necrotic damage and can't regain hit points until the start of the hoarder's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't prevented from regaining hit points.

bonus.name: Create Zombies
entries: The hoarder drops any number of corpses from their Corpse Carrier. Each dropped corpse rises as a zombie in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the hoarder and takes their turn immediately after the hoarder's.

trait.name: Ash Cover
entries: The ashsnake has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made when it is burrowing in ash, as well as a +4 bonus to its armor class.

trait.name: Eruption
entries: When the ashsnake emerges from burrowing, any creature within 5 feet of it that is at least one size smaller than the ashsnake must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Ashsnake can make one bite attack and either one Constrict or Crush attack each round.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). Until the grapple ends the target is {@condition restrained} and the ashsnake cannot constrict or crush another target. The ashsnake can release the target at any time during its turn.

action.name: Crush
