A creature that succeeds on this saving throw by 5 or more is immune to the bereginyas' Foul Form for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bereginyas makes two Claw attacks. If both attacks hit the same target, the bereginyas attaches to the target. While attached, the bereginyas can use only the Smother action, and it moves with the target whenever the target moves, requiring none of the bereginyas' movement. The bereginyas can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. A creature, including the target, can take its action to detach the bereginyas by succeeding on a {@dc 14} Strength check.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) poison damage.

action.name: Smother
entries: While attached to a creature that isn't a Construct or Undead, the bereginyas extends a tendril of poisonous gas down the creature's throat. The creature must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes 22 ({@damage 5d8}) poison damage, immediately runs out of breath, and begins suffocating. On a success, it takes half the damage, doesn't run out of breath, and isn't suffocating. Suffocation ends if the creature dies, if the bereginyas is removed from the creature, or if the bereginyas is killed. A suffocating creature that fails this saving throw reduces its remaining rounds of breath by 1.

name: Bernice Blatherwick
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Bernice can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. She lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement and takes no falling damage. She cannot glide while carrying heavy objects or heavy weapons (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

trait.name: Wing Flap
entries: As a bonus action, Bernice can use her powerful feathered arms to propel herself upward up to half her movement speed. Bernice can use this in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) slashing damage or 6 ({@damage 1d10 + 1}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Inspire
entries: Bernice inspires an ally that can see and hear her. The ally can roll a {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to its next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Bernice adds 2 to her AC against one melee attack that would hit her. To do so, Bernice must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

trait.name: Bloodied Frenzy
entries: While {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, the trollkin has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and saving throws.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The trollkin regains 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn. If the trollkin takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the trollkin's next turn. The trollkin dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The trollkin berserker makes four attacks, using Freezing Bryntroll or Freezing Handaxe in any combination.

action.name: Freezing Bryntroll
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Cold damage. Once per round, if the berserker hits with its bryntroll, it can make a melee attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first, and that is within reach. On a hit, the second creature takes 13 ({@damage 2d12}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Freezing Handaxe
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 feet., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Cold damage.

trait.name: False Presence
entries: The berstuc detects as a Fey when sensed by spells and features, such as the {@spell detect evil and good} spell or a paladin's Divine Sense. However, it is still a Fiend and can be subjected to spells and features that affect Fiends, such as Divine Smite. Beasts and Plants find the berstuc's presence soothing and don't attack the berstuc unless ordered to or provoked.

trait.name: Forest Camouflage
entries: The berstuc has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in forest terrain.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The berstuc has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Twisted Path
entries: While in a nonmagical forest, the berstuc leaves no trail and can't be tracked, except by magical means. Creatures of the berstuc's choice within 30 feet of it that travel with it can't retrace their own trails, and become hopelessly lost after 1 hour of travel with the berstuc. Creatures led astray by the berstuc have disadvantage on ability checks to discern their location or to navigate for 24 hours.

trait.name: Verdant Nature
entries: The berstuc doesn't require food or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The berstuc makes three Slam attacks. If two Slam attacks hit a Medium or smaller creature, the berstuc can use Enclose on it.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}) if it is a Large or smaller creature and the berstuc doesn't have two other creatures {@condition grappled}.

action.name: Enclose
entries: The berstuc encloses a Medium or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by it in a mossy growth on the berstuc's body, and the grapple ends. While enclosed in the berstuc's growth, the target is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} from attacks and other effects outside the berstuc, and it takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) poison damage at the start of each of the berstuc's turns. The berstuc can have only one creature enclosed at a time.

If the berstuc takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside its growth, the berstuc must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or expel the enclosed creature as the growth bursts. The expelled creature falls {@condition prone} in a space within 5 feet of the berstuc. If the berstuc dies, an enclosed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the growth by using 5 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: Bervis's base long jump is 30 feet, and his base high jump is 15 feet with or without a running start.

trait.name: Team Tactics
entries: Bervis can take the {@action Help} action as a bonus action.

action.name: Shortened Spear
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage, or 3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage if used with two hands.

hp.special: 0 + three times your druid level

trait.name: Promising Threat
entries: The bestial spirit has advantage on Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks if the target has seen it hit a creature with its chomp attack in the past minute.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hitYourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Devour
entries: When the bestial spirit reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it consumes some of the creature's essence, regaining {@dice 1d10} hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Big Linda makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 4d12 + 7}) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and Big Linda can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Acid Spew {@recharge 5}
entries: Big Linda spews acid in a 30 foot cone. Each creature in that line of fire must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 49 ({@damage 11d8}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If Big Linda is destroyed and her corpse is left within an area of the Deep Haze for 1 hour, she is revived with all of her {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: When Big Linda starts her turn in an area of the Deep Haze, she regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Big Linda dies only if she starts her turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Big Linda makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. {@h}33 ({@damage 4d12 + 7}) Piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 19}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and Big Linda can't Bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Acid Spew {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 63 ({@damage 14d8}) Acid damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

hp.special: 74 (4d20 + 32) plus 74 (4d20 + 32) per player character

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If Bigger Linda is destroyed and her corpse is left within an area of the Deep Haze for 1 hour, she is revived with all of her {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: When Bigger Linda starts her turn in an area of the Deep Haze, she regains 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Bigger Linda dies only if she starts her turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Haze Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Bigger Linda is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 22}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains a {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: Bigger Linda deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: Bigger Linda has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to any spell or effect that would alter her form.

action.name: Bigger Linda always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On her turn, Bigger Linda can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on her turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Bigger Linda takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 15}, reach 10 ft. {@h}35 ({@damage 4d12 + 9}) Piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 23}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and Bigger Linda can't Bite another target.

items.name: Tail
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 15}, reach 15 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d8 + 9}) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed 20 feet away from Bigger Linda and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Stomp
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 15}, reach 5 ft. {@h}25 ({@damage 3d10 + 9}) Bludgeoning damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 23}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Staggered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

action.name: Breathe Deep
entries: Bigger Linda's Breath Weapon recharges. Bigger Linda can only take this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} as the first {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} she uses this round. After using this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, Bigger Linda can't take her Bite {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} until the start of the next round.

action.name: Breath Weapon (Special Recharge)
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 22}, each creature in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 31 ({@damage 7d8}) Necrotic damage plus 31 ({@damage 7d8}) Force damage, and the target gains a {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Trampling Rampage (Recharges When {@status Bloodied|XPHB})
entries: Bigger Linda moves up to her {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} in a straight line, moving through the space of Large or smaller creatures in her path. She makes one Stomp attack against each creature she moves through.

action.name: Teleport (1/Round)
entries: Bigger Linger teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space she can see within the Deep Haze.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: Bigger Linda chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on her. Bigger Linda can use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

trait.name: Occupation
entries: Retired adventurer, Burglar

trait.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Cunning, Fair-spoken

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the birch siren remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

trait.name: Rustling Copse
entries: If two or more birch sirens use their Haunting Tune ability while within 300 feet of one another, saving throws to resist the effect are rolled with disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The birch siren makes two Slam attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with Psychic Shriek.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Haunting Tune
entries: The birch siren rustles its leaves, creating a haunting chorus. Each humanoid within 300 feet of the birch siren that can hear the song must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition charmed}. The birch siren must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue the chorus. It can stop the chorus at any time. The tune ends if the birch siren is {@condition incapacitated}.

While {@condition charmed} by the birch siren, a creature uses all its movement to move in a random direction. To determine the direction, roll a {@dice d8} and assign a direction to each die face. The creature cannot take actions while {@condition charmed} in this way. Whenever a target takes damage or begins a turn unable to hear the chorus, it can repeat the saving throw. If the saving throw is successful, the effect ends on it.
A target that successfully saves is immune to this birch siren's tune for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Psychic Shriek
entries: The birch siren emits a soundless scream that tears at the minds of its victims. All non-plant creatures within 30 feet of the birch siren must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Exceptional Vision
entries: The bird has a +10 bonus to Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The bird doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they fly out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: High-Speed Dive (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the bird descends at least 30 feet on their turn, they can take the Dash action as a bonus action. When they do, they have advantage on the next attack they make before the end of their turn.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) slashing damage. If the target is a Tiny creature, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). If the target is a Small or larger creature, the bird attaches to them. While attached, the bird's Beak attacks against that target are made with advantage, and the bird can't attack another target. The target or a creature who can reach them can attempt to detach the bird as an action by making a {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a failed check, the attached target takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) slashing damage. On a successful check, the attached target takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) slashing damage and is no longer attached. The bird can detach by spending 5 feet of their movement.

bonus.name: Spot
entries: The bird makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

name: Birdfolk Dockmaster
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, the dockmaster can spend a reaction to fly up to their speed in one direction as they descend. They land in an unoccupied space at the end of their movement, and take no falling damage. They cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though they can drop any held items as part of their reaction).

trait.name: Confidence
entries: The dockmaster adds their Charisma modifier to their initiative rolls.

trait.name: Sneak Attack
entries: Once per turn, the dockmaster deals an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage when they hit a target with a weapon attack and they have advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 ft. of an ally of the dockmaster that isn't {@condition incapacitated} and the dockmaster doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dockmaster makes two saber attacks and one dagger attack.

action.name: Saber
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

name: Birdfolk Farmer
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, the farmer can spend a reaction to fly up to their speed in one direction as they descend. They land in an unoccupied space at the end of their movement, and take no falling damage. They cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though they can drop any held items as part of their reaction).

action.name: Pitchfork
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) slashing damage.

name: Birdfolk Guard
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, the guard can spend a reaction to fly up to their speed in one direction as they descend. They land in an unoccupied space at the end of their movement, and take no falling damage. They cannot glide while carrying heavy objects or heavy weapons, (though they can drop any held items as part of their reaction).

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage, or 5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

name: Birdfolk Militia
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, the militia can spend a reaction to fly up to their speed in one direction as they descend. They land in an unoccupied space at the end of their movement, and take no falling damage. They cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though they can drop any held items as
part of their reaction).

action.name: Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

name: Birdfolk Sailor
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, the sailor can spend a reaction to fly up to their speed in one direction as they descend. They land in an unoccupied space at the end of their movement, and take no falling damage. They cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though they can drop any held items as part of their reaction).

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Talons
entries: The birdfolk skeleton has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface its talons could reasonably grip.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

name: Birdfolk Skirmisher
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, the skirmisher can spend a reaction to fly up to their speed in one direction as they descend. They land in an unoccupied space at the end of their movement, and take no falling damage. They cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though they can drop any held items as part of their reaction).

trait.name: Drop Attack
entries: The skirmisher can make an attack during their glide. If they do so they deal an extra 4 ({@damage 1d8}) points of damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage, or 6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

name: Birdfolk Thug
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, the thug can spend a reaction to fly up to its speed in one direction as it descends. It lands in an unoccupied space at the end of its movement, and takes no falling damage. The thug can't glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though it can drop any held items as part of its reaction).

trait.name: Bandit Fighting
entries: When the thug hits with a melee weapon attack, it can spend a bonus action to either take the {@action Disengage} action or attempt to trip the target of its attack. A creature it attempts to trip must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thug makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 feet, one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d2 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage.

name: Bita, the Council Speaker
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Bita can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. She lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement and takes no falling damage. She cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

trait.name: Wing Flap
entries: As a bonus action, Bita can use her powerful feathered arms to propel herself upward up to half her movement speed. Bita can use it in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Inspiring
entries: Bita targets an ally that can see and hear her. The target can roll a {@dice d4} and add the number rolled to its next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Shocking Grasp
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) Lightning damage and the target can't make {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Fire Bolt
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 120 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d10}) Fire damage.

reaction.name: Shield (1/Rest)
entries: {@actTrigger} The spellsword is hit by an attack roll or targeted by the {@spell Magic Missile|XPHB} spell. {@actResponse} The spellsword casts the {@spell Shield|XPHB} spell. Until the start of their next turn, the spellsword has a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and they take no damage from {@spell Magic Missile|XPHB}.

trait.name: Hateful Presence
entries: Each friendly creature within 10 feet of the black knight commander gains a +2 bonus on weapon damage rolls but can't use the Help action.

trait.name: Locked Saddle
entries: The black knight commander can't be knocked {@condition prone}, dismounted, or moved against its will while mounted.

trait.name: Mounted Charge
entries: If the black knight commander moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature while mounted and then hits it with a Lance attack on the same turn, the commander can use a bonus action to command its mount to make one melee weapon attack against that creature as a reaction.

trait.name: Mounted Warrior
entries: The black knight commander is rarely seen without its warhorse mount. The warhorse wears custom barding that raises is Armor Class to 15, and mounting and dismounting the warhorse costs the commander only 5 feet of movement. While the commander is mounted, its mount can't be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The black knight commander makes one Lance attack and two Mace attacks. If the commander is mounted, its mount can then make one Hooves attack. If both Mace attacks hit one creature, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Lance
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Frightful Charge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: While mounted, the black knight commander lets loose a terrifying cry. It then moves up to 30 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any Large or smaller creature. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. The first time it enters a creature's space during this move, that creature must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) bludgeoning damage and is {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition frightened}. A {@condition frightened} creature can make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Strength Drain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage, and the black stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the black stirge doesn't attack. Instead, the target's Strength score is reduced by {@dice 1d4}. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. The black stirge can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. It does so after it drains 4 points of Strength from the target, or the target dies. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the black stirge. This replaces the stirge's Blood Drain action.

bonus.name: Shadow Blend
entries: While not in sunlight, the black stirge can become {@condition invisible} as a bonus action. It can end this effect as a bonus action.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If Blackjack Mel is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw and only half damage if he fails, provided he doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Knife
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: Blackjack Mel takes the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

reaction.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature Blackjack Mel can see deals damage to him with an attack. {@actResponse} Blackjack Mel halves the damage he takes from that attack.

trait.name: Carnivorous Compulsion
entries: At the start of each of its turns, if the blemmyes can see an {@condition incapacitated} creature, the blemmyes must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or spend its next turn moving toward and attacking that creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The blemmyes makes one Bite attack and two Slam attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) piercing damage. If the target is {@condition incapacitated} and a Medium or smaller creature, the target is swallowed. A swallowed creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside the blemmyes, and it takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the blemmyes' turns. The blemmyes can have only one target swallowed at a time.

If the blemmyes takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the blemmyes must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls {@condition prone} in a space within 5 feet of the blemmyes. If the blemmyes dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

hp.special: twice your druid level

trait.name: Blighted Resilience (10th level or higher)
entries: The creature has immunity to necrotic and poison damage and to the {@condition poisoned} condition.

trait.name: Toxic Demise (10th level or higher)
entries: When the creature is reduced to 0 hit points, it explodes in a burst of toxic mulch or fetid viscera. Each creature within 5 feet of the exploding creature must succeed on a Constitution {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} against your spell save DC or take necrotic damage based on the creature's challenge rating (see the table below). As an action, you can also cause a summoned creature to explode, immediately killing it.

entries.caption: Toxic Demise Damage
rows: {@damage (#$prompt_number:min=1,title=Enter the creature's CR!,default=1$#)d8|A number of  d8s of necrotic damage equal to the creature's challenge rating}
{@damage (PB)d6|A number of d6s of necrotic damage equal to your proficiency bonus}

action.name: Multiattack
entries: When you reach 14th level in this class, the blighted sapling makes two claw attacks.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h} {@damage 2d4 + PB} piercing damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dreg can breathe air and water.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Acid Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 11}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Acid damage and is {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} ({@dice 2d4} Acid).

name: Bloated Gastromorph
languages: All languages known before the curse

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The Bloated Gastromorph regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the Bloated Gastromorph takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the Bloated Gastromorph's next turn. The Bloated Gastromorph dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The Bloated Gastromorph can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Bloated Gastromorph makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a Tongue attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) Slashing damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}) and is moved up to 5 feet toward the Bloated Gastromorph.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) Piercing damage.

If the Bloated Gastromorph takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it regurgitates all swallowed creatures at the end of that turn, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the gastromorph and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. If the Bloated Gastromorph dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Tongue {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. {@h}31 ({@damage 4d12 + 5}) Acid damage. A creature that is hit by this attack is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition and is moved up to 20 feet toward the gastromorph. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

bonus.name: Swallow
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 17}, one Large or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the gastromorph (it can have up to two creatures swallowed at a time). {@actSaveFail} The target is swallowed by the gastromorph, and the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition ends. A swallowed creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects outside the gastromorph, and taks 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Acid damage at the start of each of the gastromorph's turns.

trait.name: Insect Swarm
entries: The bloated hive emits a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of buzzing insects. A creature that starts its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Disrupt the Hive
entries: When the bloated hive dies, it immediately spawns a {@creature Swarm of Contaminated Insects|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} in its space.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Bloated Hive makes two attacks.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Spawn Swarm {@recharge 5}
entries: The bloated hive creates a {@creature Swarm of Contaminated Insects|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, which appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. The swarm takes its turn immediately after the bloated hive.

bonus.name: Distracting Swarm
entries: The bloated hive causes its Insect Swarm to fly in the face of a creature within 5 feet of it. The target can't take Reactions until the end of the bloated hive's turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The blood hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Blood Sense
entries: The blood hag can pinpoint the location of creatures that aren't Constructs or Undead within 60 feet of her and can sense the general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of her.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The blood hag makes three Claw or Blood Bolt attacks and can use Blood-Drinking Hair or Face Peel. She can replace one attack with a use of Sanguine Curse.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) slashing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. The blood hag has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Blood Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature with blood, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Blood-Drinking Hair
entries: The hag drains blood from one creature {@condition grappled} by her. The target must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The blood hag regains hp equal to half the necrotic damage taken.

action.name: Face Peel
entries: The blood hag peels the face off one creature {@condition grappled} by her. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) slashing damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn. The target's hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. While its hp maximum is reduced in this way, the target has disadvantage on all Charisma checks. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

action.name: Sanguine Curse
entries: The blood hag curses one creature she can see or sense within 60 feet of her. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be cursed for 1 minute. A creature automatically succeeds on this saving throw if it doesn't have blood. While cursed, the target is {@condition incapacitated} and takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns as its internal blood vessels rupture. The cursed target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the curse on itself on a success.
The blood hag can have only one target cursed at a time. If it curses another, the effect on the previous target ends.

hp.special: 6 + six times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The hawk has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Signature Attack (Beak)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Distracting Attack (2 Ferocity)
entries: The hawk makes a signature attack. On a hit, the next attack made against the target before the start of the hawk's next turn has advantage.

action.name: 3rd Level: Swooping Attack (5 Ferocity)
entries: The hawk moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. During or after this move, they can make a signature attack against one target. On a hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength saving throw or drop one item they are holding.

action.name: 5th Level: Storm of Talons (8 Ferocity)
entries: The hawk moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then they can dive onto one creature within 5 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage PBd10} slashing damage and is {@condition blinded} until the end of the hawk's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition blinded}.

reaction.name: Swoop In (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: When the hawk's caregiver is hit with an attack while the hawk is within 30 feet of them, the hawk moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If the hawk ends this movement within 5 feet of the caregiver, the hawk becomes the target of the triggering attack instead, and the attack deals half as much damage.

trait.name: Aquatic Camouflage
entries: The leech has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks made to hide in aquatic terrain.

trait.name: Blood Bags
entries: The leech has three blood bags in its body. When encountered, roll {@dice 1d3} to determine how many blood bags are filled with blood. The rest are empty.

action.name: Attach
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 0 ft. {@h}The leech attaches to the target. While attached, the leech doesn't attack, and moves with the target, using none of the leech's movement. The leech can detach itself using 5 feet of movement, and detaches immediately if its blood bags are filled or if the target dies.

A creature within 5 feet can take an action to detach the leech with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) check. {@actSaveFail} The leech is still detached, but the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 2d4}). Failure by 5 or More: The leech isn't detached and the target takes 8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Blood Drain
entries: The leech can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} only when it is attached to a creature. The attached creature loses 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} due to blood loss, and the blood leech fills one of its empty blood bags with some of the target's blood.

bonus.name: Blood Transfusion
entries: The leech can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} only when it is attached to a creature and has at least one filled blood bag. The attached creature regains 10 {@dice 3d6} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and the leech empties one of its filled blood bags.

hp.special: Seven times their level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Blood Curse)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d4 plus PB} necrotic damage, and the target is {@condition poisoned} until the end of the seneschal's next turn. Beginning at 7th level, the seneschal can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Coagulate (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the seneschal empowers the blood of up to PB creatures within 30 feet of them. Each target can expend 1 Hit Die, rolling it and regaining hit points equal to twice the result plus their Constitution modifier.

action.name: 5th Level: Blood Puppet (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the seneschal chooses a creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Wisdom saving throw or move up to their speed in a direction of the seneschal's choice. During this movement, the seneschal can force them to make one attack against a creature of the seneschal's choice (no action required).

action.name: 7th Level: Blood Bondage (1/Day)
entries: As an action, the seneschal arrests the hearts of up to PB creatures within 30 feet of them. Each target must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage PBd6} necrotic damage and is {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition paralyzed}.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the ooze remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from a pool of blood.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead, they must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or the ooze melds into the target's body.
While inside a creature, the ooze has total cover against attacks and other effects originating outside that host.

If the host creature takes 5 damage or more on a single turn from a source other than the ooze, the ooze must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or exit the host, entering the nearest unoccupied space of the ooze's choice. A {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power, {@spell protection from poison} spell, or {@spell lesser restoration} spell cast on the host also forces the ooze out. By spending 5 feet of their movement, the ooze can voluntarily leave the host's body.

action.name: Crimson Feast (Inside Host Only)
entries: The ooze consumes their host creature's bodily fluids. The host must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the host takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) necrotic damage and is {@condition poisoned} until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, the host takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}.

hp.special: 6 + six times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

action.name: Signature Attack (Pseudopod)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} bludgeoning damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Distracting Attack (2 Ferocity)
entries: The ooze makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals its normal effects, and the next attack made against the target before the start of the ooze's next turn has advantage.

action.name: 3rd Level: Clever Goop (5 Ferocity)
entries: The ooze takes the Hide action and makes a signature attack (in either order). If the attack hits a Large or smaller creature, the target is knocked {@condition prone}. While the ooze is hidden in this way, they can approach a creature or move where they're clearly visible without automatically giving away their position.

action.name: 5th Level: Crimson Feast (8 Ferocity)
entries: The ooze attempts to enter the body of a creature they can see within 5 feet of them who isn't a Construct or an Undead. The target must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the ooze melds into the target, who takes {@damage PBd6} necrotic damage, becomes the ooze's host, and is {@condition poisoned} until the ooze exits the host.
While melded, the ooze has total cover against attacks and other effects originating outside the host, and they can't take any action except to exit the host as a bonus action.

At the start of each of the ooze's turns, the host must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the host takes {@damage PBd6} necrotic damage and remains melded. On a successful save, the host takes half as much damage and the ooze exits the host. If the host dies or is subject to a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power, a protection from poison or {@spell lesser restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect, the ooze exits the host.
When the ooze exits the host, they enter an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the host.

bonus.name: Parasitic Symbiosis
entries: If the ooze's caregiver is within 5 feet of them, the ooze moves inside their caregiver. While inside their caregiver, the ooze has total cover against attacks and other effects originating outside the caregiver. The ooze can exit the caregiver by using another bonus action, entering an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the caregiver.

bonus.name: Quick Cure (1/Day)
entries: While inside their caregiver (see Parasitic Symbiosis), the ooze cleanses their caregiver's blood, ending the {@condition paralyzed} and {@condition poisoned} conditions on the caregiver.

name: Blood-Starved Vampire
languages: the languages they knew in life

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the vampire takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the vampire takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Radiant Weakening
entries: The vampire has disadvantage on saving throws against effects that deal radiant damage.

action.name: Feeding Frenzy (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 piercing damage plus 3 necrotic damage. If two or more vampires joined the attack, the target's hit point maximum is reduced by a number equal to the necrotic damage dealt. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest or is targeted by a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power, a {@spell lesser restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect. The target dies if this attack reduces their hit point maximum to 0.

trait.name: Bloody Inspiration
entries: As a bonus action, the bloodbonded can inspire an ally within 30 feet to an enraged state of bloodlust for one minute. These followers gain 5 temporary hp, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and vulnerability to psychic damage. All attacks made by the bloodbonded followers are reckless, gaining advantage to hit enemies but granting enemies advantage on attacks against them.

trait.name: Resolute Followers
entries: Allies of the bloodbonded within 60 feet of it have advantage on Charisma and Wisdom saving throws.

action.name: Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rage Bomb (2/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the bloodbonded can infuse one of its bloodbonded followers who is under the effects of Bloody Inspiration with a fatal fury. This magic causes the follower to foam bloodily at the mouth. If the follower is not slain before the start of the bloodbonded's next turn, the follower dies and explodes in a shower of superheated blood. Creatures within 10 feet must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) fire damage on a failure and taking half damage on a success.

action.name: Blood Boil
entries: The bloodbonded targets a creature it can see within 60 feet and utters words of madness. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage as its blood superheats. The bloodbonded must be able to speak to use this ability.

reaction.name: Loyal Followers
entries: When a bloodbonded would take damage from a melee or ranged attack it can see that targets only the bloodbonded, it can use its reaction to call on one of its followers within 5 feet to take the damage instead.

hp.special: Eight times their level (number of d10 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Halberd)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d10 plus PB} slashing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the bloodletter can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Exsanguinate (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the bloodletter makes a signature attack, then grants an ally they can see within 30 feet of them {@dice PBd6} temporary hit points.

reaction.name: 5th Level: Rubescent Protector (3/Day)
entries: When an ally the bloodletter can see within 10 feet of them is hit with an attack, the bloodletter can use their reaction to redirect the attack to themself, potentially causing the attack to miss. If the attacker is within 10 feet of the bloodletter, the bloodletter can then make a signature attack against the attacker.

reaction.name: 7th Level: Fuilech (3/Day)
entries: When the bloodletter hits a creature with a signature attack, they can use their reaction to siphon the creature's vitality. For 1 minute, the bloodletter empowers up to three creatures they can see within 30 feet of them (potentially including themself), granting those creatures a bonus to saving throws equal to half the bloodletter's PB.

name: Bloodlord Varrox

trait.name: Infernal Ichor
entries: When Varrox dies, his corpse unleashes a spray of burning orange ichor. Each creature within 5 feet of him takes 5 fire damage.

trait.name: Infernal Sacrifice (3/Day)
entries: When Varrox fails a saving throw, he can call on Hell to succeed instead. When he does, each ally within 60 feet of him takes 5 necrotic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Varrox makes three attacks using Soulsword, Death Skulls, or both.

action.name: Soulsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, they can't regain hit points until the start of Varrox's next turn.

action.name: Death Skulls
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage, and Varrox can teleport to an unoccupied space he can see within 5 feet of the target.

bonus.name: Advance and Attack
entries: Varrox barks orders at one ally within 60 feet of him who can hear him. That ally can use their reaction to move up to their speed and make a weapon attack.

reaction.name: An Army from Blood
entries: When a non-minion hobgoblin who Varrox can see within 60 feet of him takes damage, Varrox magically summons three hobgoblin recruits who appear in unoccupied spaces nearest to the damaged hobgoblin.

legendaryHeader: Varrox has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Uncanny Leadership
entries: Varrox chooses up to six non-minion allies within 60 feet of him who can see or hear him. Varrox and each chosen creature gain 10 temporary hit points and can move up to their speed.

legendary.name: Action 2: Hellish Transport
entries: Varrox and each ally within 60 feet of him can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space they can see.

legendary.name: Action 3: I Am Fire and Death
entries: Each enemy within 20 feet of Varrox must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. After the explosion, a shroud of black flame covers Varrox for 1 minute. For the duration, each time another creature hits Varrox with an attack while within 5 feet of him or touches him, that creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Bloodmire Adaptation
entries: The treant is immune to the diseases described in the {@table Bloodmire Diseases|GriffonsSaddlebag2} table.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the treant remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal Bloodmire tree.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The treant deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The treant makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Mudball
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target's speed is halved until the start of the treant's next turn.

action.name: Animate Blood (2/Day)
entries: The treant magically animates a pool of blood it can see within 60 feet of it. The blood congeals into a viscous form and has the statistics of a {@creature gelatinous cube}, except its Ooze Cube, Pseudopod, and Engulf trait and action options deal necrotic damage instead of acid damage, and its Transparent trait doesn't function unless it's in blood or bloodwater.

The animated blood acts as an ally of the treant. The blood remains animate for 8 hours or until it dies; until the treant dies or is more than 120 feet from the blood; or until the treant takes a bonus action to turn it back into an inanimate pool of blood.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the blowbelly pufferfish dies, it bursts. Each creature within 15 feet of it must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The blowbelly pufferfish makes two Chomp attacks.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage. Puff Up (Recharge 5-6). The blowbelly pufferfish inflates its size, becoming Huge and filling its space. Each creature in its space is pushed to an unoccupied space outside the area and must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage and is {@condition Poisoned} for 1 minute as the barbs of the pufferfish poke and prod them. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition Poisoned}. If the creature is pushed into a wall or similar solid surface, it takes an extra 4 ({@dice 1d8}) bludgeoning damage and is {@condition Grappled} (escape {@dc 13}); until this Grapple ends, the creature is also {@condition Restrained}.
The blowbelly pufferfish stays puffed up until the start of its next turn, after which it returns to its normal size. While puffed up, it gains a +2 bonus to its AC.

name: Body Snatcher
languages: all languages known before the curse
and all languages known by its host

trait.name: Electric Invigoration
entries: Whenever a Body Snatcher would take Lightning damage, it absorbs the energy and instead gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half the damage, rounded down. The Body Snatcher also immediately recharges its Electric Torrent ability.

trait.name: Skin Sack
entries: The Body Snatcher is physically indistinguishable from its host and cannot be detected by nonmagical means. If the Body Snatcher is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and it has been inside its current host for less than 24 hours, the host regurgitates it then has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition and 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Body Snatcher makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Invade
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 15}; one Humanoid creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the Body Snatcher. {@actSaveFail} The Body Snatcher departs its current host and moves into the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} creature. It then regains all {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and recharges Electric Torrent. If it had been inside its previous host for less than 24 hours, that creature has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition and 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}. Otherwise, the previous host body becomes a lifeless skin sack.

action.name: Electric Torrent {@recharge 5}
entries: The Body Snatcher unleashes a large electric pulse. {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}, each other creature within 20 feet of the Body Snatcher. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Lightning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

name: Body Snatcher
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Clinging Shadows
entries: A creature in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks to escape the body snatcher's grapple. Each time a creature attempts to escape the body snatcher's grapple while it is in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}, the creature takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage. If this Necrotic damage reduces the target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the target is stabilized but has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition for 1 hour, even if it regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Sunlight Weakness
entries: The body snatcher takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Radiant damage if it ends its turn in sunlight, and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks while in sunlight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The body snatcher makes four Grabbing Hands attacks.

action.name: Grabbing Hands
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends, the body snatcher can't use this hand against another target. The body snatcher has four hands, each of which can grapple one target.

bonus.name: Shadow Teleport
entries: The body snatcher teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space that it can see that is in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}. It can bring any Medium or smaller creature it is grappling, teleporting that creature to an unoccupied space it can see within 5 feet of its destination that is also in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}. An unwilling creature can make a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw to resist being teleported. On a successful save, neither the creature nor the body snatcher {@spell Teleport|XPHB}.

name: Bog Body
languages: understands the languages they knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Acidic Blood
entries: A creature who deals piercing or slashing damage to the bog body while within 5 feet of them takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). Until this grapple ends, the bog body can't make a Slam attack against another target.

action.name: Sling Mud
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Submerge
entries: If the bog body is in swampy terrain, they can submerge themself beneath the water and mud. While submerged, the bog body is heavily obscured.

If the bog body is grappling a target when they submerge, the target submerges with them. While submerged, the target is heavily obscured, {@condition restrained}, and unable to breathe, and takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage at the start of each of their turns.
A bog body can resurface as a bonus action. When they do so, a target they have {@condition grappled} also resurfaces.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The bojack can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the bojack remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal animal corpse.

trait.name: Sudden Death
entries: Creatures that haven't yet taken a turn in combat are {@condition Helpless|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} against attacks made by the bojack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bojack makes two attacks, using Impaling Limbs or Corrosive Mucus in any combination.

action.name: Impaling Limbs
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) Piercing damage and the target is {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} ({@dice 2d6}). While {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} in this way, the target is also {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}.

action.name: Corrosive Mucus
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7} to hit, range 30/60 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d4 + 4}) Acid damage and the target is {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} ({@dice 2d4} Acid). While {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} in this way, the target's AC becomes 10 + its Dexterity modifier.

bonus.name: Predatory Cunning
entries: The bojack takes the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

trait.name: Retribution of Ragnarok
entries: When Bolgrim dies, runes engraved on his chest explode. {@actSave dex} {@dc 12} Each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from Bolgrim. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Bolgrim casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Bolgrim makes three attacks, using Longsword, Handaxe, or Necrotic Ray in any combination.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Slashing damage if the target is marked.

action.name: Handaxe
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Slashing damage if the target is marked.

action.name: Necrotic Ray
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d12 +2}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is spiritually marked with a necrotic rune until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: {@actTrigger} Bolgrim is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. {@actResponse} Bolgrim adds 2 to his {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

swim.condition: (0 ft. swim 60 ft. in vortex form)

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (True Form Only)
headerEntries: The boloti casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 11}):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The boloti can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Water Camouflage
entries: The boloti has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide while at least half of its body is submerged in water.

trait.name: Water Mastery
entries: A boloti has advantage on attack rolls if both it and its target are touching the same body of water. If the target and the boloti are both on dry ground, the boloti has disadvantage on attack rolls.

trait.name: Watery Body (Vortex Form Only)
entries: The boloti can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that starts its turn in the boloti's space must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or take 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage as it is buffeted by the swirl of water.

action.name: Dagger (True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d4 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Whirlpool (Vortex Form Only)
entries: One creature in the boloti's space must make a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage, and if it is Medium or smaller, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and unable to breathe unless it can breathe water. If the saving throw is successful, the target takes half the damage and is pushed out of the boloti's space.

bonus.name: Vortex Form
entries: The boloti magically transforms into a Small vortex of swirling, churning water or back into its true form, which is Fey. The boloti can transform into its vortex form only while at least half of its body is submerged in water, and any creature it is grappling with Whirlpool is freed if the boloti transforms back to its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (3/Day; Humanoid Form Only)
headerEntries: The bone collective casts the {@spell animate dead} spell as an action, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}).

trait.name: Collective Mind
entries: The collective's individual bones are connected via a hive mind. It can telepathically communicate with any of its individual bones within 50 miles of it, and it can't be surprised. If the collective is reduced to half its hp or fewer, its Intelligence score is reduced to 1, it can't cast spells, it immediately changes to its shapeless form, and it can't take on a Humanoid form.

trait.name: Grasping Limbs (Humanoid Form Only)
entries: The bone collective can wield weapons and hold, grasp, push, pull, or interact with objects that might otherwise require a Humanoid form to accomplish.

trait.name: Swarm (Shapeless Form Only)
entries: The bone collective can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny bone.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The bone collective doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Wyrmblood Venom
entries: When the bone collective hits a {@condition poisoned} creature with a Bite or Piercing Bones attack, the target's Charisma score is reduced by {@dice 1d4}. The target is {@condition incapacitated} if this reduces its Charisma to 0. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bone collective makes two Claw attacks, or one Claw attack and one Bite attack.

action.name: Bite (Humanoid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}31 ({@damage 4d12 + 5}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Claw (Humanoid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 3d12 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Piercing Bones (Shapeless Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the collective's space. {@h}52 ({@damage 8d12}) piercing damage, or 26 ({@damage 4d12}) piercing damage if the collective has half its hp or fewer.

bonus.name: Shape Swarm
entries: The bone collective can shape itself into a Small Humanoid or back into a shapeless form of Tiny bones. Its statistics are the same in each form, and it can't regain hp or gain temporary hp. It can't take on a Humanoid form if it is occupying the space of another creature.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The bone crab can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Bone Camouflage
entries: The bone crab has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide among bones.

trait.name: Limited Telepathy
entries: The bone crab can magically communicate simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically with other bone crabs in its pack within 100 feet of it. While within 30 feet of another bone crab, the bone crab can't be surprised and has advantage on initiative rolls.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The bone crab has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the crab's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The bone crab's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: White Ghost Shivers
entries: A creature that eats the meat of the bone crab or that is bitten by a creature infected with the white ghost shivers disease must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or become infected with the disease. An infected creature develops the first symptoms after 24 hours. Symptoms include a mild chill that escalates to a fever and frightful hallucinations that give the disease its name. At the end of each long rest, the infected creature must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of {@condition exhaustion}. The {@condition exhaustion} lasts until the creature finishes a long rest after the disease is cured. A creature that succeeds on two saving throws against the disease recovers from it. Alternatively, the disease can be removed by the {@spell lesser restoration} spell or similar magic.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny human skull. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The bone swarm doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bone swarm makes two Swirling Bones attacks. It can replace one Swirling Bones attack with one Death's Embrace attack, if available.

action.name: Swirling Bones
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. {@h}36 ({@damage 8d8}) bludgeoning, 36 ({@damage 8d8}) piercing, or 36 ({@damage 8d8}) slashing damage (the bone swarm's choice), or 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning, 8 ({@damage 4d8}) piercing, or 8 ({@damage 4d8}) slashing damage (the bone swarm's choice) if the swarm has half of its hp or fewer.

action.name: Death's Embrace {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. {@h}The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the creature is {@condition restrained} and any attack against the bone swarm has a 50 percent chance of hitting the {@condition grappled} creature instead. The bone swarm can have only one creature {@condition grappled} at a time. The {@condition grappled} creature has advantage on ability checks made to escape the grapple when the bone swarm has half of its hp or fewer.

trait.name: Bone Armor (1/Day)
entries: A bone trader in its lair can use a bonus action to summon a temporary suit of bone armor that lasts for ten minutes or until dismissed by the bone trader. While wearing its bone armor, a bone trader has advantage on Wisdom saving throws and Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts
entries: The bone trader can communicate with beasts as if they shared a language.

action.name: Bone Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Skelesuck
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or have one of its bones sucked out, resulting in the piercing damage becoming a reduction in maximum hit points until magical healing is applied.

action.name: Fey Charm
entries: The bone trader targets one humanoid, goblinoid, fey, or beast it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition charmed}. The {@condition charmed} creature regards the bone trader as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the bone trader's control, it takes the bone trader's requests or actions in the most favorable way . Each time the bone trader or its allies do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the bone trader dies, is on a different plane of existence from the target, or ends the effect as a bonus action. If a target's saving throw is successful, the target is immune to the bone trader's fey charm for the next 24 hours.
The bone trader can have no more than one humanoid {@condition charmed} at a time, along with up to three beasts.

name: Boneflayer
languages: Sylvan; understands Common but can't speak it

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The boneflayer doesn't provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Thunderous Ward
entries: When the boneflayer hears a drum or gong, or takes Thunder damage, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The boneflayer makes one Beak attack and one Talons attack.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Slashing damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}) from both talons. While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: Swoop {@recharge 5}
entries: If the boneflayer has a creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the boneflayer flies up to half its {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} and drops that creature.

trait.name: Go for the Throat
entries: The bonemonger deals an extra 21 ({@damage 6d6}) damage when it hits a target with a bite attack and has advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Insightful Telepathy
entries: The bonemonger is constantly under the effects of the {@spell detect thoughts} spell (save {@dc 20}). As a bonus action, it can probe deeper into the mind of any creature it can detect in its lair. If the creature fails its saving throw, the bonemonger has advantage on attack rolls against that creature until the start of the bonemonger's next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the bonemonger fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Osteomancer (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the bonemonger would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 246 hit points, it gains 100 temporary hit points as bones coalesce around it, and it regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, the bonemonger can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 41,000 XP (63,000 XP total) for defeating the bonemonger after its Osteomancer activates.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bonemonger makes one Bite attack and uses Mi.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Mi
entries: The bonemonger proclaims "Mi!" at one creature it can see that can hear it within 90 feet of it. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) thunder damage and 13 ({@damage 3d8}) psychic damage, and become {@condition frightened} of the bonemonger until the end of the bonemonger's next turn.

legendary.name: Grasping Bones
