entries: The bonemonger targets a surface within 60 feet of it, causing a skeletal limb to burst out and grasp at a creature within 5 feet of the surface. The creature must make a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) slashing damage and becoming {@condition restrained} until the end of the bonemonger's next turn on a failure, or taking half as much damage and not being {@condition restrained} on a success.

legendary.name: Springstrike
entries: The bonemonger moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks and then makes one attack with its bite.

legendary.name: Animate Bones (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The bonemonger animates bones it can see with 90 feet of it, creating a {@creature wight} that follows the bonemonger's telepathic commands.

mythic.name: Bare the Throat
entries: The bonemonger uses its Grasping Bones and Springstrike legendary action options.

mythic.name: Bonetide (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: A wave of animated bones ripples out from the bonemonger in either a 90-foot cone or 30-foot-radius sphere (bonemonger's choice). Each other creature in the area must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 52 ({@damage 15d6}) slashing damage and being knocked {@condition prone} on a failure, or taking half as much damage and not being knocked {@condition prone} on a success.

Award a party an additional 1,800 XP (2,900 XP total) for defeating the bonemonger after its Osteomancer activates.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Coalesced Form Only)
headerEntries: The bonepowder ghoul casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

trait.name: Amorphous (Dust Form Only)
entries: The bonepowder ghoul can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Hungry Dead Nature
entries: The ghoul requires no air or sleep.

trait.name: Turning Defiance
entries: The bonepowder ghoul and any ghouls within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn Undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bonepowder ghoul makes two Bite attacks. It can replace one Bite attack with a use of Gravedust or Spellcasting. If both Bite attacks hit the same creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by {@dice 1d4}. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or contract the darakhul fever disease.

action.name: Gravedust
entries: The ghoul projects a 30-foot cone of grave dust. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage. If a creature is a Humanoid, it must also succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or contract the darakhul fever disease.

action.name: Whirlwind (Dust Form Only; Recharge 5-6)
entries: The ghoul creates a whirlwind of bones and teeth in a 20-foot cube originating from it. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) slashing damage, and its Strength score is reduced by {@dice 1d6}. The creature dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and its Strength score isn't reduced.

reaction.name: Coalesce
entries: When a bonepowder ghoul deals necrotic damage with Gravedust to at least one creature that isn't a Construct or Undead, it can magically transform from its dusty form into a coalesced form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except it can speak audibly only in its coalesced form. The coalesced form lasts for a number of minutes equal to the total necrotic damage it dealt with Gravedust to creatures that aren't Constructs or Undead or until the ghoul ends it as a bonus action.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, the bonestalker can cast the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

trait.name: Bones of the Lost
entries: The bonestalker starts with 5 ({@dice 2d4}) skulls, which they can destroy to fuel their actions and reactions.
Choose or roll a {@dice d4} to determine each skull's creature type: 1, Beast; 2, Fey; 3, Humanoid; 4, Monstrosity.

trait.name: Skull Resistance
entries: While the bonestalker possesses at least one skull, they have advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bonestalker makes two Touch of the Felled or two Scream of the Forsaken attacks, and they can use Grief of the Bygone.

action.name: Touch of the Felled
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) necrotic damage. The bonestalker can destroy a Humanoid or Monstrosity skull to deal an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage to the target.

action.name: Scream of the Forsaken
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 8} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) psychic damage.

The bonestalker can destroy a Fey skull to force the target to make a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is {@condition frightened} of the bonestalker until the start of the bonestalker's next turn.

action.name: Grief of the Bygone
entries: The bonestalker destroys two skulls of any type, creating a 15-foot-radius sphere of magical darkness centered on a point they can see within 60 feet of them.
The darkness spreads around corners and lasts for 1 minute.

A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness, and mundane light can't illuminate it. The bonestalker is unaffected by the darkness and has advantage on attack rolls against creatures in the darkness.Any creature who starts their turn in the darkness must make a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Power from the Conquered
entries: When the bonestalker is hit by an attack, they can destroy a Beast skull to become {@condition invisible} until the end of their next turn.

trait.name: Boog Rampage
entries: If Boog sees another Abomination reduced to 0 hit points, Boog rampages for 1 minute. While rampaging, Boog's melee attacks deal an extra 2 damage.

trait.name: Boog Charge
entries: If Boog moves at least 10 feet straight toward a Medium or smaller creature and then hits them with a Gore attack on the same turn, the target is impaled on Boog's horn and is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, the target is {@condition restrained} and takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage at the start of each of their turns, and Boog can't make a Gore attack against another target.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Boog makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage or 12 ({@dice 1d10 + 7}) if rampaging.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage or 10 ({@dice 1d6 + 7}) if rampaging.

action.name: Boog's Ball
entries: Boog throws a 3-inch-radius magic ball at a point they can see within 60 feet of them. If that point is 30 feet or less from Boog, the ball grows to a 5-foot radius. If that point is more than 30 feet from Boog, the ball grows to a 10-foot radius. Each creature in the ball's area when it reaches that point must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage. After the ball reaches that point, it shrinks back to its 3-inch radius and teleports into the hand Boog used to throw it.

name: Boogleswarm
languages: understands Common but can only speak if the swarm has gathered at least one Humanoid tooth

trait.name: Mimicry (Only if the Swarm Can Speak)
entries: The swarm can speak in the voice of a creature whose tooth it has implanted (see the Bite action). Listeners must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) check to discern the mimicry.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny {@creature weasel|XMM}. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Sweet Tooth
entries: If the swarm can see or smell sugar at the start of its turn, it must use all its movement to move closer to the sugar. If it reaches the sugar, the swarm has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn as it consumes the sugar, and this trait doesn't function again until the swarm finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The swarm makes two Bite attacks that must have different targets.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 4d4}) Piercing damage, or 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Piercing damage if the swarm is {@status Bloodied|XPHB}. If the target is a creature that has teeth, it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or lose one of its teeth. The swarm immediately implants the tooth into one of its mouths. A creature that has already lost a tooth to this attack automatically succeeds on the saving throw.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The chosen moves across and climbs icy surfaces without needing to make an Ability Check. Additionally, snow and ice are not {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} for the chosen.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chosen makes two Spear attacks.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Cold damage.

action.name: Breath of the North Wind {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 14} Each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Cold damage, and the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. A creature failing the saving throw by 5 or more has the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition, as it is entombed in ice until the end of its next turn instead. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Freezing Blood
entries: {@actTrigger} The chosen is hit by an attack. {@actResponse} Creatures within 5 feet of the chosen take 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Cold damage.

name: Bouda
senses: magic. the bouda senses magic within 30 feet of it at will. this trait otherwise works like the detect magic spell but isn't itself magical.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bouda makes one Bite attack and one Mephitic Claw attack.

action.name: Bite (Giant Hyena or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Mephitic Claw (Giant Hyena or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Ravenous Gorge
entries: The bouda consumes the organs of a corpse within 5 feet of it that is less than 7 days old. It gains temporary hp equal to twice the dead creature's CR for 1 hour. The bouda can't use Ravenous Gorge on a corpse if it or another bouda has already use Ravenous Gorge on the corpse.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The bouda transforms into a human, a hyena, or back into its true form, which is a hyena-human hybrid. Its statistics, other than its speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies, then crumbles to dust moments later.

bonus.name: Defiling Smear (1/Day)
entries: The bouda secretes a disgusting whitish-yellow substance with the viscosity of tar and smears the substance on an object, unoccupied space, or creature within 5 feet of it. An unwilling creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw to avoid the smear. Each creature, other than a bouda or hyena, that starts its turn within 30 feet of the smeared target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to that source of Defiling Smear for the next 24 hours. The stench of a smear remains potent for 7 days or until removed by the {@spell greater restoration} spell or similar magic.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The boxer makes three attacks, using Grasping Strike or Punch Down in any combination.

action.name: Grasping Strike
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}).

action.name: Punch Down
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: Brace Up
entries: The boxer gains 18 ({@dice 4d8}) {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

bonus.name: Combo
entries: The boxer makes one Grasping Strike or Punch Down attack.

reaction.name: Cross Counter
entries: {@actTrigger} The boxer is hit by a melee attack made by a creature. {@actResponse} The boxer reduces the damage it takes by 18 ({@dice 4d8}) and deals that much Bludgeoning damage to the target if it is within 5 feet.

trait.name: Brainmuncher
entries: The brainmuncher likes to eat the brains of Tiny beasts, like household pets. If left unattended, it will attempt to do so (GM's discretion).

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) psychic damage.

action.name: Levitate
entries: The brainmuncher casts the {@spell levitate} spell on itself.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: The creeper has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has {@status surprised}.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the creeper remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from normal cluster of vines.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The creeper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Thorns
entries: At the start of each of its turns, the creeper deals 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage to any creature grappling it, or that it has {@condition grappled}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The creeper makes two attacks with its strangling bramble. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

action.name: Strangling Bramble
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one Large or smaller target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and at risk of suffocating. If the creeper is grappling a Large creature, or two Medium or smaller creatures, it can't use this attack against another creature.

name: Bredbeddle
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius in true form)

trait.name: Headless (True Form Only)
entries: The bredbeddle can't be {@condition blinded} or {@condition deafened}.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If the bredbeddle dies, they return to life in {@dice 1d6} months with all their hit points. If their body was destroyed, it reforms in an unoccupied space nearest to where they died. Only a {@spell wish} spell or finding and destroying the bredbeddle's true head can prevent this trait from functioning.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bredbeddle makes two Executioner's Axe attacks.

action.name: Executioner's Axe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d10 + 7}) slashing damage.

action.name: Beheading Strike {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft., one Large or smaller Giant or Humanoid with a head. {@h}40 ({@damage 6d10 + 7}) slashing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the bredbeddle cuts off the target's head, which lands at the target's feet. A creature beheaded in this way remains alive unless reduced to 0 hit points, but they are {@condition blinded} and {@condition deafened}, and they can't speak. A creature can use an action to place a beheaded creature's head back on their neck, reattaching the head and ending the effect. A beheaded creature dies if they are separated from their head for more than 24 hours.

bonus.name: Get a Head
entries: The bredbeddle picks up a severed Giant or Humanoid head within 15 feet of them and places it on the bredbeddle's neck. The bredbeddle then polymorphs into that Giant or Humanoid creature. While polymorphed, the bredbeddle's statistics change as follows:

items: They can speak.
They lose their Headless trait.
Their size changes to match the creature whose head they bear.
They can see normally, and they gain any special senses the creature's head had.
Any equipment they are wearing or carrying temporarily changes to match their size, but the equipment's statistics do not change.

entries: The bredbeddle reverts to their true form if they die, if their head is removed, or after 24 hours. When they revert, the head falls off and can't be reattached to the bredbeddle.
A creature who can reach the bredbeddle can use an action to make a {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, removing the head from the bredbeddle on a success.

bonus.name: Toss Head (Polymorphed Form Only)
entries: The bredbeddle removes their head, reverting to their true form, and throws the head at a creature they can see within 60 feet of them.
The head lands in the target's space, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Breggan casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Inspire Loyalty
entries: Allied creatures within 30 feet of Breggan have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions inflicted by any creature other than Breggan.

trait.name: Horned King's Curse
entries: Creatures that are cursed by Breggan (see Pact Saber) have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Charisma saving throws, and Breggan deals an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage whenever she hits a cursed target with an attack.

trait.name: Wandslinger
entries: Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Breggan's ranged attack rolls with Force Blast. In addition, Breggan ignores {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover} and {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Three-Quarters Cover} when making ranged attacks with Force Blast.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Breggan makes one Pact Saber attack and two Force Blast attacks.

action.name: Pact Saber
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Necrotic damage, and the target is cursed by Breggan for 10 minutes (see Horned King's Curse).

action.name: Force Blast
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 120 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Force damage.

action.name: Tyranny of the First
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 15}, up to three creatures of Breggan's choice that can hear her and that have been cursed by her. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the end of Breggan's next turn. A creature {@condition Charmed|XPHB} in this way must immediately use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} (if available) to move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} toward one creature of Breggan's choice, then make a melee attack against the target. This movement doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}. If the attack hits, the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} creature is no longer cursed by Breggan.

reaction.name: Expendable Allies
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature Breggan can see targets her with an attack. {@actResponse} Breggan swaps places with an ally or a creature she currently has {@condition Charmed|XPHB} that she can see within 5 feet of her. The chosen creature becomes the target of the attack instead. This movement doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

trait.name: Brambleskin
entries: A creature that hits the troll with a melee attack while within 5 feet of the troll or ends its turn within 5 feet of the troll takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage from the thorny brambles that cover its skin.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The troll has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The briar troll makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage, and if the target is a creature it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the troll can't bite another target.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Briar Blast {@recharge}
entries: Vicious thorns shoot out of the troll's skin. Each creature within 15 feet of the troll must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 19 ({@damage 3d12}) piercing damage and is {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition stunned}. The area becomes difficult terrain (which the troll ignores) for 1 minute, or until the troll uses this action again.

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that touches the drake or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature other than a brimstone drake that starts its turn within 10 feet of the drake must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of all brimstone drakes for 1 hour.

trait.name: Volcanic Acclimation
entries: Ash, dust, fog, and other particles suspended in the air don't impede the drake's vision, and it can breathe normally in ash and under lava.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drake makes three attacks: one with its bite, one with its claws, and one with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) fire damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Ashen Eruption {@recharge 5}
entries: The drake exhales a cloud of electrically charged ash in a 30-foot cone, creating an area that is heavily obscured until the end of the drake's next turn. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) lightning damage and is {@condition blinded} until the end of the drake's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition blinded}.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The chrysalis can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the chrysalis fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Regenerative State
entries: The chrysalis' hit points reset to its maximum at the start of its turn.

trait.name: Sticky Mucus
entries: When a creature hits the chrysalis with a melee attack, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or become disarmed as its weapon stays stuck to the creature. A creature can use an action to make a {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics|PHB}) check, freeing a stuck weapon within its reach on a success. If the attack requires that the attacker touch the aboleth (GM's discretion), then the attacker becomes grappled (escape {@dc 17}) on a failed save. While it is grappled, it can't use that limb. If the attack is a bite, then the creature can't speak while it is grappled in this way.

trait.name: Transitional State
entries: The chrysalis turns into an aboleth broodmother at the start of its fourth turn after becoming a chrysalis, ending any grapples it is a part of.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chrysalis makes three Sticky Ectoplasm attacks. Each attack must be against a different target.

action.name: Sticky Ectoplasm
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) acid damage and the target's speed is reduced by 15 feet until the target uses an action to remove the ectoplasm. A creature whose speed is reduced to 0 feet by this effect is restrained (escape {@dc 17}).

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The broodiken doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The broodiken is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The broodiken has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Shared Rage
entries: The broodiken can't speak with its creator telepathically, but it can magically receive simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically from its creator while within 100 feet of its creator. The creator can send the broodiken an image of a creature and emotion or simple idea tied to it, such as anger or retrieval, and the broodiken will seek the creature to carry out the emotion or desire. As long as the broodiken is following such an order, it can be more than 100 feet away from its master without wailing.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) piercing damage, and the broodiken attaches to the target. While attached, the broodiken can't attack, and at the start of each of the broodiken's turns, the target takes 9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

The attached broodiken moves with the target whenever the target moves, requiring none of the broodiken's movement. It can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement on its turn. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the broodiken by succeeding on a {@dc 9} Strength check.

name: Broodling
languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The broodling can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Hive Mind
entries: Broodlings' minds connect to other broodlings within 5 feet of them, forming a chain of thought. The broodling gains a +3 bonus to Intelligence checks and saving throws, and to its Entrance save DC for each other broodling in such a chain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The broodling makes two attacks: one with its Bite and one with its Sting.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}1 piercing damage and the creature must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws until the end of the broodling's next turn.

action.name: Entrance (1/Day)
entries: The broodling targets one creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 6} Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the broodling until the broodling dies or until it is on a different plane of existence from the target. The charmed target is under the broodling's control and can't take reactions.

Whenever the charmed target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends. No more than once every 24 hours, the target can also repeat the saving throw when it is at least 30 feet away from the broodling.

name: Brunnmigi
languages: understands Common and the Northern Tongue but cannot speak

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The brunnmigi makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Slashing damage plus 2 Poison damage.

action.name: Befouled Spittle
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Poison damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 11}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition. The target can make a save whenever it completes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} to end this condition.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The bucca doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: The bucca takes 1 radiant damage each minute it is exposed to sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

trait.name: Treasure Sense
entries: The bucca can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious metals and stones, such as coins and gems, within 60 feet of it.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. The {@condition poisoned} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The bucca magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks, or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the bucca wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, the channeler can cast the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Bugbear's Inspiration
entries: Allied Humanoids within 15 feet of the channeler who can see or hear them have advantage on Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The channeler makes two Channeling Staff attacks.

action.name: Channeling Staff
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the channeler can move them up to 10 feet horizontally.

action.name: Vine Eruption (3/Day; 4th-Level Spell)
entries: The channeler attempts to use primal magic to overload a creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw as thorny vines erupt from their body and attempt to envelop them. On a failed save, the target takes 27 ({@damage 5d10}) piercing damage and is {@condition restrained} until the vines are destroyed. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition restrained}. A creature {@condition restrained} in this way takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) piercing damage at the start of each of their turns. The vines have AC 15, 10 hit points, and immunity to psychic damage.

action.name: Ball Lightning (1/Day; 7th-Level Spell; Concentration)
entries: The channeler creates a 20-foot-radius sphere of electricity centered on a point they can see within 120 feet of them. The sphere lasts for 1 minute. When an enemy starts their turn in that area, they must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) lightning damage. As a bonus action, the channeler can move the sphere up to 20 feet.

reaction.name: Shared Shield (2/Day; 2nd-Level Spell)
entries: When a creature the channeler can see within 30 feet of them is hit with an attack, the channeler can create a barrier of magical force around that target. Until the start of the channeler's next turn, the target gains a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack.

trait.name: Commander's Inspiration
entries: Allied Humanoids within 30 feet of the commander who can see or hear them have advantage on Wisdom and Charisma saving throws and gain a +1 bonus to weapon attack and damage rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The commander makes two Greatsword or two Longbow attacks.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage, and one ally within 30 feet of the target who can see the commander has advantage on their next melee attack roll made against the target before the start of the commander's next turn.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Bark Orders {@recharge}
entries: Each ally within 60 feet of the commander who can hear and understand them can use a reaction to move up to their speed and make a weapon attack.

reaction.name: Bolstering Pride
entries: When another creature within 60 feet of the commander who can hear and understand them makes a saving throw, the commander can give that creature advantage on the saving throw.

trait.name: Bugbear's Inspiration
entries: Allied Humanoids within 15 feet of the predator who can see or hear them have advantage on Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

trait.name: Dirty Fighting
entries: When the predator hits a creature with a melee weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The predator makes two Curved Dagger or two Longbow attacks. If both attacks hit the same target, the predator has advantage on their next attack roll made against the target before the end of the predator's next turn.

action.name: Curved Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Go for the Eyes (1/Day)
entries: Each ally within 30 feet of the predator who can hear and understand them gains the predator's Dirty Fighting trait until the start of the predator's next turn.

bonus.name: Guerilla Training
entries: The predator takes the Dash or Hide action.

trait.name: Bodyblock
entries: When a Medium or smaller enemy is within 5 feet of three or more regulars who aren't {@condition prone} or {@condition incapacitated}, that enemy can't see beyond a range of 15 feet.

trait.name: Bugbear's Encouragement
entries: Allied Humanoids within 5 feet of the regular who can see or hear them gain a cumulative +1 bonus to Wisdom saving throws.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the regular takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the regular takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Bullyclub (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Bugbear's Inspiration
entries: Allied Humanoids within 15 feet of the roughneck who can see or hear them have advantage on Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

action.name: Multiattack (Battle Fury Only)
entries: The roughneck makes two Handaxe attacks.

action.name: Handaxe
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Bugbear Battle Cry (1/Day)
entries: Each ally within 15 feet of the roughneck who can hear and understand them gains advantage on attack rolls until the start of the roughneck's next turn.

bonus.name: Battle Fury (1/Day)
entries: The roughneck enters a furious state that lasts for 1 minute. While in this state, the roughneck can take the Multiattack action on their turn, and they have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks.

hp.special: Eight times their level (number of d10 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Spiked Bow)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 2d6 plus PB} piercing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the warden can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Halting Shot (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the warden makes a signature attack. On a hit, the target's speed is reduced to 0 until the end of their next turn.

action.name: 5th Level: Presence of Inspiration (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the warden inspires each ally within 30 feet of them who can hear them, granting them advantage on attack rolls until the start of the warden's next turn.

action.name: 7th Level: Enraged Barrage (1/Day)
entries: As an action, the warden makes a signature attack. Each ally within 30 feet of them who can see them can use a reaction to make a weapon attack, cast a cantrip with a casting time of 1 action, or manifest a 1st-order power with a manifestation time of 1 action.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The bukavac can hold its breath for 20 minutes.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: A bukavac's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bukavac makes one Bite attack, one Gore attack, and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d12 + 5}) slashing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. The bukavac can have no more than two creatures {@condition grappled} at a time.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Croaking Blast {@recharge 5}
entries: A bukavac can emit a howling thunderclap in a 15-foot radius. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 36 ({@damage 8d8}) thunder damage and is {@condition deafened} until cured by the {@spell lesser restoration} spell or similar magic. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition deafened}.

name: Bullybird
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Bullybird can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. Bullybird can't glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

trait.name: Wing Flap
entries: As a bonus action, Bullybird can use his powerful feathered arms to propel himself 15 feet upward. Bullybird can't use this ability while gliding.

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when Bullybird hits with it (included in the attack).

trait.name: Relentless (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If Bullybird would take 14 damage or less that would reduce him to 0 hit points, he is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

trait.name: Seedspeech
entries: Bullybird can communicate simple ideas to living plants, and is able to interpret their responses in simple language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Bullybird makes two melee attacks with his battleaxe.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) slashing damage, or 14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The buraq casts one of the following spells, requiring no components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Angelic Weapons
entries: The buraq's attacks are magical. When the buraq hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 4d8} radiant damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The buraq has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Night Journey
entries: When outdoors at night, the distance of the buraq's vision is not limited by nonmagical darkness. Once per month, the buraq can declare it is on a night journey, and for the next 24 hours, it can Teleport as a bonus action. When on a night journey, the buraq can teleport as often as it wants, and its destination must always be in an area of nonmagical darkness within its line of sight. At any point during the night journey, the buraq can use a bonus action to return itself and its rider to the location where it began the night journey.

trait.name: Powerful Steed
entries: The buraq is considered to be a Large animal for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity and its ability to carry a rider.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The buraq makes two Hooves attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Teleport (1/Day)
entries: The buraq magically teleports itself and its rider, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to a location the buraq is familiar with, up to 1 mile away.

name: Buried Lord Vaettir
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Aura of Authority
entries: While in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the buried lord, the buried lord's allies have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the buried lord doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Grave Goods Sense
entries: The buried lord can pinpoint the location of creatures wearing or carrying one of the vættr's personal items or grave goods within 60 feet of it, and the vættr can sense the general direction of its personal items and grave goods within 1 mile of it.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: A destroyed buried lord vættr gains a new body in 24 hours, regaining all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and becoming active again. The new body forms in a random unoccupied space within 100 feet of where it fell. This trait doesn't function if the vættr is put to rest (typically by returning its remains to its burial mound).

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the buried lord vaettir has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks and attack rolls.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The buried lord vaettir casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

spellcasting.name: Hunter (2/Day)
headerEntries: The buried lord vaettir casts {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The buried lord vaettir makes two Longsword or two Longbow attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4} to hit, range 150/600 feet., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Corpse Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13} Each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Disorienting Gaze
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 13} One creature the buried lord can see within 30 feet of it. {@actSaveFail} For 1 minute, the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and moves in a random direction whenever it moves. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. {@actSaveSuccess} The target has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to this buried lord's Disorienting Gaze for 24 hours.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: {@actTrigger} The buried lord vaettir is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon or shield. {@actResponse} The buried lord vaettir adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

name: Burlywhirl
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Burlywhirl can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. Burlywhirl can't glide while carrying heavy objects, or heavy weapons (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

trait.name: Talons
entries: Burlywhirl rolls advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface his talons could reasonably grip.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Burlywhirl makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, Burlywhirl can spend a bonus action to {@action grapple} them (Escape {@dc 13}) if the attack hits.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 2} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d10}) piercing damage.

action.name: Leadership (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: For 1 minute, Burlywhirl can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that it can see within 30 feet of it makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature can add a {@dice d4} to its roll provided it can hear and understand Burlywhirl. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if Burlywhirl is {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Burrow Awareness
entries: A burrowling has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks if at least one other burrowling within 10 feet of it isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The burrowling has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the burrowling's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The burrowling makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Sling
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: Búrzgul deals an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Búrzgul that isn't incapacitated and Búrzgul doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, Búrzgul has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Búrzgul makes two melee attacks, or one melee attack and one ranged attack.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage, or 7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Yell of Triumph (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: Each creature of Búrzgul's choice that is within 30 feet of it and can hear it gain advantage on attack rolls and Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks until the start of Búrzgul's next turn. Búrzgul can then make one attack as a bonus action.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Búrzgul adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, Búrzgul must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Dray's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 21}, {@hit 13} to hit with spell attacks). Dray can innately cast any cleric cantrip as a 20th-level spellcaster, as well as the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Hungering Frenzy
entries: When Dray scores a critical hit with a weapon attack or reduces a creature to 0 hit points, his spell save DC increases to 23 and he has advantage on all attack rolls until the end of his next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Dray fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Dray has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Dray's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Three Heads
entries: Dray has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks and on Constitution saving throws made to maintain {@status concentration} on spells.

trait.name: Touch of Death
entries: When damage Dray deals reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it automatically suffers one death saving throw failure.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: When one of Dray's heads is asleep, his other heads are awake. In addition, magic can't put him to sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Dray makes two attacks: one with his fist and one with his dagger.

action.name: Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 6d6 + 7}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Ritual Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 6d4 + 7}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Dray regains hit points equal to half that amount. The reduction lasts for 1 hour. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

legendary.name: Cantrip
entries: Dray casts a cantrip.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Dray moves up to half his speed.

legendary.name: Punch
entries: Dray makes one fist attack.

legendary.name: Summon Minions (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Dray magically summons ({@dice 2d4}) orcs or 1 ogre. A summoned creature appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Dray and acts as his ally. It remains for 1 minute, until it or Dray dies, or until Dray dismisses it as an action.

name: c'Naazo
pbNote: +3 Rage of c'Naazo. C'Naazo has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Centipede Singer
entries: At the beginning of each of its turns, c'Naazo summons {@dice 1d4} giant centipedes to aid it in combat. The centipedes appear in unoccupied spaces within 20 feet of c'Naazo.

trait.name: Venom's Succor
entries: Whenever c'Naazo is subjected to poison damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the poison damage dealt.

trait.name: Cracked Shell
entries: The first time c'Naazo takes 10 or more bludgeoning damage at once from any source, its armor class is reduced to 16 until it completes a long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: C'Naazo makes three Segmented Tentacle attacks.

action.name: Segmented Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Poison Spray {@recharge}
entries: C'Naazo sprays poisonous mist in a 15-ft. cone in front of it. Creatures caught within the spray must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Siphon Centipedes
entries: C'Naazo consumes any number of giant centipedes with 10 feet of it, regaining 5 hit points for each giant centipede consumed this way.

trait.name: Resilience
entries: Cackle has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned}.

trait.name: Skulker
entries: Cackle has advantage on {@skill Stealth} checks made in dim light or total darkness.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Cackle makes two attacks with his longsword or two attacks with his shortbow.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Cackle adds 2 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, Cackle must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

hp.special: 54 (4d12 + 28) plus 54 (4d12 + 28) per player character

trait.name: Cacophonous Chorus
entries: The cacophonous chimera creates a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of noise. A creature that starts its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that can hear it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Thunder damage.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The cacophonous chimera has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

action.name: The cacophonous chimera always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the cacophonous chimera can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the cacophonous chimera takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Claws and Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) Slashing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Contaminated Bite (1/Round)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains a {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

action.name: Lamprey Tail
entries: Melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|XPHB}:+11, reach 30 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 2d4}).

action.name: Aerial Maneuver (1/Round)
entries: The cacophonous chimera flies up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

action.name: Cacophony (1/Round)
entries: The cacophonous chimera's three heads sing a discordant song. The effect of the song varies based on which of the chimera's head is taking the lead. Each time the cacophonous chimera uses this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, it can't use the same effect it chose last round.

action.name: Bewildering Chitter (Ratling)
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 300-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the chimera that can hear it. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Bewildered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

action.name: Chilling Howl (Garmyr)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 300-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the cacophonous chimera that can hear it. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Cold damage, and the target has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

action.name: Staggering Screech (Harpy)
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 300-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the cacophonous chimera that can hear it. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Staggered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

action.name: Wing Blast
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 17}, each creature within 15 feet of the cacophonous chimera. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the chimera. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The cacophonous chimera chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The cacophonous chimera can use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

reaction.name: Crescendo of Chaos (1/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} The cacophonous chimera becomes {@status Bloodied|XPHB}. It can take this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} even if it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition or is otherwise unable to take Reactions. {@actResponse} All conditions and spells on the cacophonous chimera immediately end unless it chooses to be affected by them, and it can move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action and ignoring {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}.

It then unleashes a blast of thunderous power. Creatures within 300 feet of it who can hear it are subjected to the following effect. {@actSave wis} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} 17 ({@damage 5d6}) Thunder damage plus 17 ({@damage 5d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition and can't stand until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cactid makes two Tendril attacks and uses Reel.

action.name: Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and if it isn't a Construct or Undead, the cactid begins draining fluid from the target's body. At the start of each of the {@condition grappled} creature's turns, the creature must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, its hp maximum is reduced by 3 ({@dice 1d6}). This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest after drinking at least one gallon of water. The {@condition grappled} creature dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0. The cactid has two tendrils, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Reel
entries: The cactid pulls each creature {@condition grappled} by it up to 10 feet straight toward it.

reaction.name: Hail of Needles (1/Day)
entries: When reduced to below half its hp maximum, the cactid releases a hail of needles. Each creature within 15 feet of the cactid must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Cadwyll Piper
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Cadwyll is a 3rd-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). Cadwyll has the following spells prepared:

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Cadwyll wields a magical longbow. It is a {@item Red-Feather Longbow|HumblewoodCampaignSetting|red-feather bow}{@cite New Humblewood Content|HumblewoodTales|*}.

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Cadwyll can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. Cadwyll can't glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

trait.name: Talons
entries: Cadwyll rolls advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface his talons could reasonably grip.

trait.name: Aerial Defense
entries: Creatures who attack Cadwyll while he is falling, gliding, or jumping have disadvantage on their attack roll.

trait.name: Hunter (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, Cadwyll can deal an extra {@damage 1d10} damage on his next attack made with a shortbow or longbow.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Cadwyll makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

action.name: Red-Feather Bow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, 150/600 feet, one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Forest Defense
entries: When Caithas is in forest terrain and is targeted by a ranged attack by an attacker he can see, the attack has disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Caithas makes three Scimitar or three Scaled Longbow attacks.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) slashing damage.

action.name: Scaled Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 11} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 1d8 + 8}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature who hasn't attacked Caithas since the end of his last turn, he has advantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Manifestation {@recharge 5}
entries: Caithas calls on his connection with Qazyldrath, and the dragon manifests in Caithas's space and exhales dark energy in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, that area is filled with magical darkness for 1 minute. A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness, and supernatural light can't illuminate it. The manifestation of Qazyldrath then disappears.

bonus.name: Gaze of the Decay (1/Day)
entries: Caithas chooses a creature he can see within 60 feet of him, magically marking them for 24 hours. While Caithas and the marked creature are on the same plane of existence, he always knows the distance and direction to them. Additionally, a marked creature can't hide from him, and if the marked creature becomes {@condition invisible}, they gain no benefit from that condition against Caithas.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The cambium casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cambium makes four Needle Fingers or Poison Ray attacks. It can replace two attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Needle Fingers
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Poison Ray
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Damage Ability
entries: The cambium twists the bodily humors of a creature within 30 feet of it that isn't a Construct or Undead and that it hit with Needle Fingers in the past minute. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or its Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score (the cambium's choice) is reduced by {@dice 1d4}. The target falls {@condition unconscious} if this reduces an ability score to 0. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest.

bonus.name: Imbalance Humors
entries: If the cambium has hit a creature that isn't a Construct or Undead with Needle Fingers in the past minute, it can cause a surge in one of the target's bodily humors, causing an imbalance. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or suffer one of the following effects of the cambium's choice. Unless noted otherwise, the target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Sanguine Flux
entries: The target can't regain hp—naturally or magically—until after it finishes a long rest.

items.name: Choleric Flux
entries: The target becomes confused for 1 minute. This effect works as if the target failed a saving throw against the {@spell confusion} spell, except the cambium doesn't have to maintain {@status concentration}.

items.name: Melancholic Flux
entries: The target is {@condition incapacitated} and its speed is halved for 1 minute.

items.name: Phlegmatic Flux
entries: The target is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute.

trait.name: Beast of Burden
entries: The camel is considered to be one size larger for the purpose of determining their carrying capacity.

trait.name: Desert Dweller
entries: The camel ignores difficult terrain created by dirt or sand. They can tolerate temperatures as high as 120° Fahrenheit.

trait.name: Metabolic Reserves
entries: The camel can go without water for up to 7 days, and without food for up to 90 days.

trait.name: Stubborn
entries: The camel has advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, or {@condition prone} condition on themself.

action.name: Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Bilious Spit {@recharge 5}
entries: The camel vomits bile onto a creature they can see within 10 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). If the target fails the save by 5 or more, they are also {@condition blinded} while {@condition poisoned} in this way.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

trait.name: Beast of Burden
entries: The camel is considered to be one size larger for the purpose of determining their carrying capacity.

trait.name: Desert Dweller
entries: The camel ignores difficult terrain created by dirt or sand. They can tolerate temperatures as high as 120° Fahrenheit.

trait.name: Metabolic Reserves
entries: The camel can go without water for up to 7 days, and without food for up to 90 days.

trait.name: Stubborn
entries: The camel has advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, or {@condition prone} condition on themself.

trait.name: Tall and Narrow
entries: If the camel's caregiver is Medium or smaller, the caregiver can occupy the camel's space and vice versa, and it doesn't count as difficult terrain for them.

action.name: Signature Attack (Bite or Kick)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage (Bite) or bludgeoning damage (Kick).

action.name: 1st Level: Bilious Spit (2 Ferocity)
entries: The camel spits at a creature they can see within 10 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of the camel's next turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Punishing Shake (5 Ferocity)
entries: The camel moves up to their speed and makes a signature Bite attack against one target. If the attack hits and the target is Medium or smaller, the camel also shakes and flings them up to 10 feet away horizontally. If the target hits a solid surface, they are knocked {@condition prone} and take an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} bludgeoning damage.

action.name: 5th Level: Trample (8 Ferocity)
entries: The camel moves up to their speed. During this move, they can move through other creature's spaces. Each Large or smaller creature whose space the camel passes through must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage PBd6} bludgeoning damage and is knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Ungulate Urgency
entries: If the camel's caretaker falls {@condition prone} and the camel can see them, the camel moves up to their speed toward their caregiver. If they end this movement in the same space as their caregiver, attacks against the caregiver have disadvantage until either the caregiver is no longer {@condition prone}, the caregiver is no longer in the same space as the camel, or the start of the camel's next turn, whichever comes first.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The daemon's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). The daemon can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

trait.name: Candle Dependence
entries: The daemon remains on the Material Plane only while the candle that summoned it burns.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The daemon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Nether Step
entries: As its movement for its turn, the candlelight daemon can teleport to an unoccupied space within 30 feet of it, provided the space it's teleporting to and from are both in dim light or darkness. The daemon doesn't need to see the destination.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the daemon can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

trait.name: Slayer's Advantage
entries: The candlelight daemon has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't had a turn in combat.

trait.name: Slayer's Attack (1/Turn)
entries: The candlelight daemon deals an extra 35 {@damage 10d6} damage when it hits a target with an attack and has advantage on the attack roll. With the {@spell suffocate|GrimHollowLairsEtharis} spell, the daemon deals this damage as extra bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The daemon makes two claw attacks and one gore attack. It can use hurl fire in place of any of these attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage and 4 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage and 4 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage.

action.name: Hurl Fire
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d8}) fire damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Athenodorus can cast the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When Athenodorus makes an attack, he has advantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Star of Iron
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, they are hexed until the end of their next turn. Whenever a creature hexed in this way makes an attack roll or saving throw, they must roll a {@dice d4} and subtract the number rolled from the attack roll or saving throw.

action.name: Iron Ring (2/Day)
entries: If not in the Cyst, Athenodorus teleports to the Cyst. If in the Cyst, he teleports to a place he has visited.

action.name: Unholy Fire (2/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
entries: Athenodorus calls unholy black flames from the depths at a point he can see within 90 feet of him. Each enemy in a 15-foot-radius, 30-foot-high cylinder centered on that point must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage and is moved up to 15 feet horizontally. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't moved.

bonus.name: Blessing of Ajax (2/Day)
entries: Athenodorus chooses a creature he can see within 30 feet of him. The target regains 14 ({@dice 2d8 + 5}) hit points and Athenodorus can end one of the following conditions affecting the target: {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition poisoned}, or {@condition stunned}.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the caprathorn moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target, and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Implosion
entries: The caprathorn implodes when it dies, leaving behind a sphere of annihilation. Each creature within 60 feet of the caprathorn when this implosion occurs must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be pulled 10 feet toward the sphere.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the caprathorn fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The caprathorn has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The caprathorn's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Thornlamms
entries: A caprathorn typically has three inanimate thornlamms (see that stat block) attached to its horns with vines. Attached thornlamms don't take damage separately, but whenever the caprathorn takes 50 or more damage in a single turn, one of the attached thornlamms dies.

While it has at least one thornlamm attached to its vines, the caprathorn can use a bonus action to consume or detach a thornlamm. If the caprathorn consumes a thornlamm, the caprathorn regains 21 hit points. When the caprathorn detaches a thornlamm, that thornlamm lands in a space within 10 feet of the caprathorn and takes a turn immediately after the caprathorn. The thornlamm obeys the caprathorn's verbal or telepathic commands (no action for the caprathorn). If issued no commands, the thornlamm acts independently, often attacking a creature that isn't its ally. A thornlamm can survive indefinitely detached from a caprathorn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The caprathorn makes three attacks, one with its gore, one with its stomp, and one with its thorns.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Thorns
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) piercing damage. Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't cause the caprathorn to have disadvantage on the ranged attack roll.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The caprathorn makes one attack with its gore, stomp, or thorns.

legendary.name: Detach Thornlamm
entries: The caprathorn detaches a thornlamm as per the Thornlamms trait.

legendary.name: Grow Thornlamm
entries: Provided it has taken no damage from a silvered weapon this round, the caprathorn grows one thornlamm as per the Thornlamms trait. A caprathorn can have up to six attached thornlamms at a time.

legendary.name: Consume Thornlamm (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The caprathorn consumes an attached thornlamm, regaining 21 hit points.

legendary.name: Entomb (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The caprathorn chooses a creature that has 0 hit points that the caprathorn can see within 30 feet of it. The target must make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the target is immune to this effect for 24 hours. If the save fails, the target is entombed deep within the earth in a sphere of magical force that is just large enough to contain the target. Nothing can pass through the sphere, nor can any creature teleport or use planar travel to get into or out of it. A caprathorn can entomb only one target at a time. This effect ends, returning the target to where it was before being entombed, if the target regains any hit points or the caprathorn dies.

legendary.name: Annihilation Field (Costs 3 Actions; Recharges if an Entombed Creature Dies or after a Long Rest)
entries: A sphere of energy ripples out in a 30-foot-radius from the caprathorn. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 38 ({@damage 7d10}) force damage on a failed save, or half a s much damage on a successful one.
