For objects that aren't worn or carried, this emanation destroys Small and smaller ones and damages larger ones. The circle destroys a wall of force or similar structures of force in the area instantly. A creature or object is disintegrated if it drops to 0 hit points due to this magic. A disintegrated creature or object turns to fine ash, and nonmagical objects a disintegrated creature wears or carries disintegrate with it.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the caprisoul dies, it explodes in a burst of soul energy. Each creature within 5 feet of it must make a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw, taking 5 ({@damage 2d4}) psychic damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Soul Drain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}1 piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage. The caprisoul gains temporary hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt. The target must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If Ansom is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails, provided he doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ansom makes four attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of Ansom's next turn.

bonus.name: Flurry of Blades
entries: Ansom makes two Shortsword attacks.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature Ansom can see hits him with an attack. {@actResponse} Ansom adds 3 to his AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss.

name: Cara Stormsinger
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Cara Stormsinger can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. She lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement, and takes no falling damage. She cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

trait.name: Talons
entries: Cara Stormsinger has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface her talons could reasonably grip.

trait.name: Patterned Feathers
entries: Cara Stormsinger has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks when she attempts to hide in a forest.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The beetle makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Acid Spit {@recharge 5}
entries: The carrion beetle spits acid in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 26 ({@damage 4d12}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Cunning Action
entries: On each of its turns, the agent can use a bonus action to take the {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, or {@action Hide} action.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the agent is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the agent instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Expert Cartography
entries: The agent has a +3 bonus to any ability check it makes using {@item cartographer's tools|PHB}, in addition to the ability modifier used for the check.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: The agent deals an extra 21 ({@dice 6d6}) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the agent that isn't {@condition incapacitated} and the agent doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The agent makes two attacks with its dagger.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4+ 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: The agent halves the damage that it takes from an attack that hits it. The agent must be able to see the attacker.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The Cat of Prodigious Size has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Light on Its Feet
entries: When the Cat of Prodigious Size falls and isn't {@condition Incapacitated}, it can subtract up to 200 feet from the fall when calculating falling damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Cat of Prodigious Size makes two attacks: one with its Chomp and one with its Paw.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}32 ({@damage 4d12 + 6}) piercing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is {@condition Grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition Restrained}, and the Cat of Prodigious Size can't bite another target.

action.name: Paw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Leaping Strike
entries: The Cat of Prodigious Size pulls its body low to the ground before leaping vertically 90 feet into the air. While in the air, the Cat of Prodigious Size can make a Paw attack before slamming back down to the ground. Each creature within 20 feet of the Cat of Prodigious Size when it lands must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition Prone}.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The caterpede can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d10}) piercing damage.

variant.name: Toxic Caterpedes
entries: A handful of wild caterpedes can be found in the Wood, and some are toxic. Their meat can be rendered edible through a {@spell purify food and drink} spell or similar effect, or through careful draining of its internal fluids, requiring 24 hours of preparation and a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check to remove its toxins. Toxic caterpedes use the same statistics listed for a caterpede, but with the following additions:

items.name: Damage Immunities
items.entry: The caterpede is immune to poison damage instead of resistant to it.

items.name: Condition Immunities
items.entry: The caterpede is immune to the {@condition poisoned} condition.

entries: The toxic caterpede also has the following trait:

items.name: Bitter Taste
items.entry: If the caterpede takes damage from a bite attack, the attacker takes 7 ({@dice 2d6}) points of poison damage and must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute.

items.name: Bitter Taste
entries: If the caterpede takes damage from a bite attack, the attacker takes 7 ({@dice 2d6}) points of poison damage and must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute.

trait.name: Scowl (2/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, Cathus can attempt to intimidate a creature within 30 feet of him who can see him. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check opposed by Cathus's Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check or become {@condition frightened} of Cathus for up to 1 minute. The target can attempt a new opposed check at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Resilience
entries: Cathus has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned}.

trait.name: Skulker
entries: Cathus has advantage on {@skill Stealth} checks made in dim light or total darkness.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Cathus makes two melee attacks with his barbed shortsword and one with his dagger. Or Cathus can make two ranged attacks with his daggers.

action.name: Barbed Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage. When Cathus scores a critical hit with this weapon, his attack deals an extra 7 piercing damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Straddler
entries: The caustic charger can end its move in the space of a {@condition prone} Large or smaller creature. A creature standing up from {@condition prone} in the same space as the charger can move to a space within 5 feet of the charger as part of standing up.

trait.name: Wastes Walk
entries: Difficult terrain composed of rocks or sand doesn't cost the caustic charger extra movement.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The caustic charger makes two Ram attacks. It can replace one Ram attack with a Tentacles attack.

action.name: Ram
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the charger moved at least 10 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target has disadvantage on the saving throw.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. The {@condition paralyzed} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the caustic charger attacks a target that is not in the charger's space, the target takes half the acid damage and has advantage on the saving throw.

bonus.name: Slurp
entries: The caustic charger feeds on a creature {@condition paralyzed} by its Tentacles attack. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or its hp maximum is reduced by half the amount of acid damage dealt by the Tentacles attack that caused the paralysis, and the charger regains hp equal to that amount. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The Caustic Slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The Caustic Slime can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Caustic
entries: Any creature that touches the slime or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take 2 ({@damage 1d4}) points of acid damage.

action.name: Psuedopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) acid damage.

reaction.name: Split
entries: When a slime that is Medium or larger and has 10 or more hit points is hit with slashing damage, it splits into two new slimes. Each new slime has hit points equal to half the original slime's, rounded down. New slimes are one size smaller than the previous size.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The cavalier is an 8th-level spellcaster that uses Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}; {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). They have the following paladin spells prepared:

trait.name: Bravery
entries: The cavalier has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Light's Fury
entries: The cavalier deals an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage when it hits with a weapon attack.

trait.name: Skilled Rider
entries: While mounted, the cavalier may force an attack targeted at their mount to target them instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cavalier makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Lance
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit (with disadvantage against a target within 5 ft.), reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage.

trait.name: Darkness Shroud
entries: The cave dragon naturally suppresses light near it. Bright light within 15 feet of the dragon becomes dim light, and dim light within 15 feet becomes nonmagical darkness.

trait.name: Magical Tunneler
entries: The cave dragon can burrow through nonmagical unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the dragon can choose whether to leave the material it moves through undisturbed or leave a 5-foot diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Poison Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales a cone of black, poisonous gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}.

trait.name: Hideous Toughness (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the Cave-troll Slinker takes 7 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The Cave-troll Slinker has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Cave-troll Slinker makes two melee attacks: one with its bite and one with its great club.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Great Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Variable Illumination
entries: The cavelight moss sheds bright light in a 5- to 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius. The moss can alter the radius as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cavelight moss makes two Tendrils attacks. If both attacks hit a Large or smaller creature, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and at the start of each of the target's turns, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of {@condition exhaustion}. The cavelight moss then gains 5 temporary hp. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw can't suffer further levels of {@condition exhaustion} from the cavelight moss's grapple for the next 24 hours. The cavelight moss can have only one creature {@condition grappled} at a time.

action.name: Tendrils
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Octopodan Camouflage
entries: Ceemal can attempt to hide even when they are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, or other natural phenomena.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ceemal makes two Fillet Knife or two Acid Spit attacks.

action.name: Fillet Knife
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, another Abomination within 5 feet of the target regains hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

action.name: Acid Spit
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 20/40 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) acid damage, and the target is {@condition poisoned} until the start of Ceemal's next turn.

bonus.name: To Me, Sweetie (3/Day)
entries: Ceemal chooses an ally within 30 feet of them who can hear them. The ally can use their reaction to move up to their speed toward Ceemal without provoking opportunity attacks.

reaction.name: Wail of Loss
entries: When another Abomination who Ceemal can see is reduced to 0 hit points by an enemy within 60 feet of Ceemal, Ceemal releases a psychic wail. The enemy must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the centaur moves at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a pike attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The centaur skeleton makes two attacks: one with its pike and one with its hooves, or two with its longbow.

action.name: Pike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

variant.name: Centaur Skeleton Customization
entries: Some centaur skeletons have the following additional feature at the GM's discretion.

entries.name: Spirit Away
entries: The centaur skeleton and up to three creatures within 5 feet of it magically enter the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. An unwilling creature that succeeds on a {@dc 13} Charisma {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} can resist this effect.

spellcasting.name: Coven Magic
headerEntries: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell's normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability: {@spell Augury|XPHB}, {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB}, {@spell Identify|XPHB}, {@spell Locate Object|XPHB}, {@spell Lucky Charm|CrookedMoon24} (lasts until the hag casts it again, or chooses to end it with no action required), or {@spell Unseen Servant|XPHB}. The hag must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before using this trait to cast that spell again.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Scoured Filth
entries: The hag is burned by soapy water. Treat a bucket or flask of it splashed on the hag as a vial of Acid. If the hag is fully immersed in soapy water at the start of its turn, it takes 20 Acid damage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The hag can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes two Bite attacks or uses Spellcasting to cast {@spell Contagion|XPHB}. It can also use Warping Caress.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of the hag's next turn.

action.name: Warping Caress
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, one creature within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} 19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level. Until the target's {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level is reduced to 0, its body is warped and twisted, and it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks and saving throws that use Strength or Dexterity. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} If a Humanoid dies from this action, the hag can spend 2 days of work to shape its corpse into a {@creature Deepdreck|CrookedMoon24}, or it can combine it with the corpse of a horse to create a {@creature Fleshdobbin|CrookedMoon24}.

trait.name: Three Heads
entries: The cerberus pup has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks and on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, {@condition deafened}, and {@condition stunned}.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: When one of the cerberus pup's heads is asleep, its other heads are awake. In addition, magic can't put it to sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cerberus pup makes three attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hellfire Breath {@recharge}
entries: The cerberus pup exhales debilitating fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw, taking 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

variant.name: Alternative Familiars
entries: Warlocks that have sworn a pact of the chain and align with the chaotic nature of Grihoo and Vaanor can occasionally bind a cerberus pup or analeptic lizard familiar. They typically prefer to bond with those who can provide for their physical and emotional needs—specifically high-enrichment activities like hunting with the pup or providing plenty of bugs for the lizard's diet. A cerberus pup or regenerative lizard serving as a familiar has the following trait.

entries.name: Familiar
entries: At the GM's discretion, warlocks with the Pact of the Chain feature can choose a cerberus pup or regenerative lizard as their familiar, in addition to the forms listed in their class. While the two are bonded, the master can sense what the familiar senses as long as they are within 1 mile of each other. If its master causes it physical harm, the pup or lizard will end its service as a familiar, breaking the telepathic bond.

name: Cerebrograft
languages: telepathy 30 ft. The languages of its creator

trait.name: Dual Minds
entries: The cerebrograft has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, {@condition Stunned|XPHB}, and {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} conditions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cerebrograft makes two Slam attacks and uses Telekinetic Grip.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Telekinetic Grip
entries: The cerebrograft reaches out with its mind to hold one creature or object it can see within 120 feet of it in its psychic grasp. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave str} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target is moved up to 30 feet in any direction and has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the start of the cerebrograft's next turn or until the cerebrograft has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

If the target is an object weighing 300 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is telekinetically moved up to 30 feet in any direction. The cerebrograft can also exert fine control on objects with its telekinesis, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.

action.name: Psychic Crush {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the cerebrograft. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends). Failure by 5 or More: The target instead has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Surge of Vigor (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: If an attack deals over half of the general's current remaining hit points in damage (even if their hit points are reduced to 0 by the attack), they immediately regain 8 ({@dice 1d12 + 2}) hit points.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The general's long jump is 30 feet, and their base high jump is 15 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The general makes three melee attacks, two with their scimitar and one with their dagger. Alternatively, the general can make two ranged attack with their daggers.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The general adds 2 to their AC against one melee attack that would hit them. The general must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The priest is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 12}, +4 to hit with spell attacks). The priest has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Surge of Vigor (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: If the priest is dealt damage equal to half or more of their current remaining hit points (even if their HP is reduced to 0 by the attack), they immediately regain 8 ({@dice 1d12 + 2}) hit points.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the priest moves at least 20 feet in a straight line towards an enemy, their antler attack deals an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) points of piercing damage. If the target of the charge is Large or smaller, they must make a {@dc 11} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from the priest.

action.name: Antlers
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage, or 5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) bludgeoning damage if being held in both hands.

trait.name: Immortal Nature
entries: The chained angel doesn't require food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The chained angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Redemption
entries: When a creature casts the {@spell knock} spell on the chained angel's chains, the chains release a blast of unholy flame. The spellcaster must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 ({@damage 3d10}) fire damage and 16 ({@damage 3d10}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the spellcaster survives, the chained angel must immediately make a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the angel's chains fall away. It is restored to its senses and the form it had before it was chained, typically a deva. On a failure, the chained angel remains chained for 7 days, and during that time, any further attempts to cast {@spell knock} on the angel's chains fail.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chained angel makes two Fiery Greatsword attacks.

action.name: Fiery Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus 16 ({@damage 3d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Fallen Glory {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature the chained angel can see within 50 feet of it must make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 19 ({@damage 3d12}) radiant damage and is knocked {@condition prone}. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Fiendish Cunning
entries: When a creature the chained angel can see within 60 feet of it casts a spell that appears on the cleric or paladin spell list, the chained angel can counter the spell with a successful ability check. This works like the {@spell counterspell} spell with a +5 spellcasting ability check, except the chained angel must make the ability check no matter the level of the spell.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Champion's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma ({@hit 10} to hit with spell attacks, save {@dc 18}). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Assassinate
entries: During his first turn, the Champion has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the Champion scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

trait.name: Aura of Protection
entries: While the Champion is conscious, he and friendly creatures within 10 feet of him have a +3 bonus to {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1} (included above).

trait.name: Eternal Champion
entries: When the Champion is reduced to 0 hit points or dies, his body is destroyed but his spirit returns to the {@deity The Matron of Ravens|Exandria|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Raven Queen's} side, and he gains a new body after {@dice 1d4} days.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the Champion is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}, and only half damage if he fails.

trait.name: Fate-Touched (4/Day)
entries: When the Champion makes an attack roll, ability check, or {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}, he can reroll the {@dice d20} and use either roll. Alternatively, when a creature the Champion can see makes an attack roll against him, or a {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} against one of his spells or features, he can force that creature to reroll the attack or save and use the new roll.

trait.name: Shadow Smite (1/Turn)
entries: The Champion deals an extra 49 ({@damage 14d6}) radiant or necrotic damage (his choice) when he hits a target with a weapon attack and he doesn't have {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|disadvantage} on the attack roll.

trait.name: Unerring Sight
entries: The Champion's ranged weapon attacks ignore {@quickref cover||3||half cover} and {@quickref cover||3||three-quarters cover} and have no range penalty.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: The Champion wears {@item boots of haste|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn} and the {@item Deathwalker's Ward (Exalted)|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Deathwalker's Ward}, and wields {@item Whisper (Exalted)|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Whisper}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Champion makes three attacks with {@item Whisper (Exalted)|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Whisper}.

action.name: Whisper
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d4 + 8}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) psychic damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or be {@condition frightened} of the Champion for 1 minute. On a ranged attack, the Champion can teleport with {@item Whisper (Exalted)|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Whisper}, appearing within 5 feet of the target on a hit, or in a random space within 30 feet of the target on a miss.

action.name: Touch of Life and Death (Recharges after a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|Short or Long Rest})
entries: The Champion touches a creature within 5 feet of him, and chooses to either heal or harm that creature, restoring 55 ({@dice 10d10}) hit points or dealing 55 ({@damage 10d10}) necrotic damage. If the creature is an unwilling target, it can avoid either effect with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: The Champion takes the {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, or {@action Hide} action.

bonus.name: Boots of Haste (1/Day)
entries: The Champion clicks his heels together, casting {@spell haste} on himself. He doesn't suffer from lethargy when the spell ends.

reaction.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: The Champion halves the damage that he takes from an attack that hits him. He must be able to see the attacker.

name: Chantelle Redcliff, Mercantile Guildmaster
languages: plus up to three other languages

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Chantelle is a 14th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 15}). She knows the following bard spells:

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Chantelle wears a {@item dress of many pockets|GriffonsSaddlebag2} and has a {@item book of instant copying|GriffonsSaddlebag2} and {@item wand of gilding|GriffonsSaddlebag2}, which are all described in appendix A.

trait.name: Silver Tongue (Recharges After a Short or Long Rest)
entries: When Chantelle makes a Charisma check or saving throw, she can choose to make the roll with advantage.

trait.name: Wand of Gilding
entries: The wand has 7 charges and regains {@dice 1d6 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. While holding it, Chantelle can use an action to expend 1 of its charges to cast one of the following spells (save {@dc 15}) from it: {@spell alter self}, {@spell charm person} (2nd-level version), {@spell enthrall}, or {@spell hypnotic pattern}.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Magic Coin
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}1 bludgeoning damage plus 19 ({@damage 3d12}) thunder damage.

action.name: Money Talks (4/Day)
entries: Chantelle enchants a coin in her hand with divination magic, which lasts for 10 minutes or until Chantelle ends the effect early (no action required). For the duration, a creature holding the coin that knows at least one language can understand the meaning of any word Chantelle speaks, and when Chantelle speaks, that creature understands what Chantelle says.

Alternatively, Chantelle can use an action to see and hear through the enchanted coin until the start of her next turn, using her own senses as if she were in the coin's space. During this time, Chantelle is {@condition deafened|PHB|deaf} and {@condition blinded|PHB|blind} with regard to her own senses.

reaction.name: Chance {@recharge 4}
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of Chantelle makes an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, Chantelle flips a coin. If it's heads, the creature can roll a {@dice d12} and add the number rolled to the {@dice d20}. If it's tails, one random creature within 60 feet of the merchant gains a {@dice d12}, which it can roll and add to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The chaplain is a 9th-level spellcaster that uses Wisdom as its spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}; {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). They have the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Devotion
entries: The chaplain has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage or 5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) damage when used in two hands to make a melee attack.

name: Chapped Brute
languages: understands one language but can't speak

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The chapped brute has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing. While {@condition deafened}, the brute can't use its blindsight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chapped brute makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Adaptive Hide
entries: After taking damage, the chapped brute abomination gains resistance to that type of damage until it takes another type of damage.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The chapped brute abomination has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell. While {@condition deafened} and unable to smell, the brute can't use its blindsight.

trait.name: Unstable Life
entries: At the start of the chapped brute abomination's turn, roll {@dice 1d20}. The abomination regains hit points equal to any even result and loses hit points equal to any odd result. The abomination can neither exceed its hit point maximum with a gain nor fall below 1 hit point with a loss.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chapped brute abomination makes two tentacle attacks.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the brute can't use the tentacle against another target. The chapped brute abomination has four tentacles.

action.name: Engulf
entries: Each creature {@condition grappled} by the chapped brute abomination must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be pulled into the brute's body. An engulfed target is {@condition blinded}, {@condition restrained}, unable to breathe, and has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} from effects that originate outside the brute. At the start of each of the brute's turns, each engulfed creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage. The brute can hold only one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time.

An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make its choice of a {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check. On a success, the creature escapes and uses 10 feet of movement to enter a space of its choice within 5 feet of the brute.
If the brute dies, an engulfed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement.

If a creature dies inside the brute, the brute doesn't roll for Unstable Life at the start of its next turn and instead regains 20 hit points. The creature's body breaks up inside the brute, and the brute expels anything the creature wore or carried.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The chelicerae casts one of the following spells, requiring no material or verbal components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The chelicerae has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The chelicerae can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chelicerae makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. It can replace the Bite attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the chelicerae doesn't have another creature {@condition grappled}, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). A {@condition poisoned} target is also {@condition unconscious} while {@condition poisoned} in this way. The {@condition poisoned} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the {@condition poisoned} condition on itself on a success.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Magical Discharge (Recharge Special)
entries: The chelicerae releases some of its stored magical energy in a burst. Each creature within 15 feet of the chelicerae must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. After using Magical Discharge, the chelicerae can't do so again until it successfully siphons magic from a creature or until it finishes a long rest.

bonus.name: Nimble Moves
entries: The chelicerae takes the Dash or Disengage action.

bonus.name: Siphon Magic
entries: The chelicerae siphons magic from a spellcaster it is grappling. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or lose one spell slot of the highest level it can cast. The chelicerae then regains an expended use of its Spellcasting.

trait.name: Critical Condition
entries: A creature that rolls a natural 1 on a saving throw against the chemist's attacks or effects takes maximum damage from the attack or effect.

trait.name: Special Immunities
entries: Chemist is immune to the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chemist makes one Caustic Grip attack and uses either Chemical Spray or Explosive Concoction, if available.

action.name: Caustic Grip
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}24 ({@damage 8d4 + 4}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 17}). Until the grapple ends, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and the chemist can't use Caustic Grip against another target. At the end of each of its turns, the target takes 24 ({@damage 8d4 + 4}) Acid damage.

action.name: Chemical Spray
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (the chemist's choice). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Explosive Concoction {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 20-foot radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within 120 feet of the chemist. {@actSaveFail} 45 ({@damage 10d8}) Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (the chemist's choice), and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d6}, same damage type). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Acid Rain (1/Day)
entries: The chemist conjures a storm of acid rain in a 20-foot radius, 20-foot tall {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point it can see within 120 feet. Exposed flames in the area are doused. Chemical pools accumulate in the area and emit thick fumes, rendering it {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} and {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB}. The storm and the pools evaporate after 1 minute.

A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} 30 ({@damage 12d4}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Emergency Dose
entries: The chemist administers a restorative poultice to itself or a creature it can see within 5 feet that isn't a Construct or Undead. The target regains 35 {@dice 10d6} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once a creature benefits from Emergency Dose, it can't do so again until it finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

trait.name: Amorphous Form
entries: The chemystral can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

trait.name: Cold Vulnerability
entries: If the chemystral takes Cold damage, it becomes {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} ({@dc 15}). While it has the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition, it loses its {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immunities} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage and its {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Force damage, and it gains {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Thunder damage. In addition to the normal means, the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ends if the chemystral takes 20 points of Force, Piercing, Thunder, or Slashing damage.

trait.name: Elemental Reaction
entries: If the Chemystral takes Acid, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Necrotic damage, it takes on elemental properties which change the damage type of its Chemical Spray and Engulf actions to match that damage type. In addition, it causes an additional effect when it hits with its Chemical Spray attack:

trait.name: Acid
entries: On a hit, the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d6} Acid).

trait.name: Fire
entries: On a hit, the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d6} Fire).

trait.name: Lightning
entries: On a hit, the target has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Poison
entries: On a hit, the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Necrotic
entries: On a hit, the chemystral regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The chemystral regains 25 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn. If the chemystral takes Cold or Thunder damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The chemystral dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Sonic Neutralization
entries: When the chemystral takes Thunder damage, it loses any active benefit from its Elemental {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} trait.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chemystral makes two Chemical Spray attacks and uses Engulf.

action.name: Chemical Spray
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. {@h}35 ({@damage 10d6}) Acid damage.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The chemystral moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the chemystral enters a creature's space, the creature is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveSuccess} The creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the chemystral. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

{@actSaveFail} The chemystral enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition, and takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Acid damage at the start of each of the chemystral's turns. The engulfed creature has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} from effects outside the chemystral. When the chemystral moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.

The chemystral can hold only one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time. An engulfed creature can take an action to escape with a successful {@dc 17} Strength check, entering a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The chernomoi casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Shriek {@recharge 5}
entries: The chernomoi emits a loud shriek that is audible out to 100 feet. Each creature within 60 feet of the chernomoi and that can hear it must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The chernomoi magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or uses Spellcasting, or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the chernomoi wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

trait.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The chicken can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action.

action.name: Peck
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The child of the briar has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put it to sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The child of the briar makes two Claw attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller creature, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). At the start of each of the {@condition grappled} creature's turns, it takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage. The child of the briar can have only one target {@condition grappled} at a time.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Spitdart Tongue {@recharge 4}
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Entangle
entries: While within 10 feet of at least one other child of the briar, this child can cast the {@spell entangle} spell (spell save {@dc 13}). Each friendly child of the briar within 30 feet of this child can use its reaction to join the casting. For each child beyond the first participating in the casting, the save DC increases by 1, to a maximum of {@dc 17}, and the size increases by 5 feet, to a maximum of a 40-foot square. The entangled area must include at least one of the children involved in the casting. All participating children of the briar are immune to the spell's effects.

name: Chimera
languages: understands any one language but can't speak

trait.name: Volant
entries: When the chimera reduces a creature to 0 hit points, the chimera can move up to their speed toward an enemy they can see.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chimera makes three Bite attacks. They can replace one attack with a Lion's Toss attack or a use of Dragon's Eruption, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Lion's Toss
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be moved up to 20 feet in any direction.

action.name: Dragon's Eruption {@recharge}
entries: The chimera spits a volcanic explosion at a point they can see within 120 feet of them. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 ({@damage 6d8}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Roar
entries: Each enemy who can hear the chimera and is within 60 feet of them must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the chimera for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). If a creature succeeds on a saving throw against this effect or if the effect ends for them, the creature is immune to the chimera's Roar for the next 24 hours.

reaction.name: Ram's Defiance
entries: When a creature within 30 feet of the chimera misses them with an attack, the chimera can move up to half their speed in a straight line toward the creature. If the chimera ends this movement within 5 feet of the creature, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

name: Chimera (Protector Variant)
languages: understands any one language but can't speak

trait.name: Volant
entries: When the chimera reduces a creature to 0 hit points, the chimera can move up to their speed toward an enemy they can see.

trait.name: Protector
entries: The chimera is divinely bound to another creature, who is their charge. When the chimera and their charge are on the same plane, the charge can telepathically communicate with the chimera, and the chimera knows the distance and direction to the charge. If the chimera is within 60 feet of the charge, half of any damage the charge takes (rounded up) is transferred to the chimera.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chimera makes three Bite attacks. They can replace one attack with a Lion's Toss attack or a use of Dragon's Eruption, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Lion's Toss
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be moved up to 20 feet in any direction.

action.name: Dragon's Eruption {@recharge}
entries: The chimera spits a volcanic explosion at a point they can see within 120 feet of them. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 ({@damage 6d8}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Roar
entries: Each enemy who can hear the chimera and is within 60 feet of them must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the chimera for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). If a creature succeeds on a saving throw against this effect or if the effect ends for them, the creature is immune to the chimera's Roar for the next 24 hours.

reaction.name: Ram's Defiance
entries: When a creature within 30 feet of the chimera misses them with an attack, the chimera can move up to half their speed in a straight line toward the creature. If the chimera ends this movement within 5 feet of the creature, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Bite)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Ram's Defense (2 Ferocity)
entries: The chimera makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack imposes disadvantage on the target's next attack roll made before the start of the chimera's next turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Lion's Leap (5 Ferocity)
entries: The chimera moves up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If they end this movement on the ground, each creature within 5 feet of them must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: 5th Level: Volcanic Blow (8 Ferocity)
entries: The chimera spits an explosion of fire at a point they can see within 60 feet of them. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage PBd6} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Protective Absorption (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: When the chimera's caregiver takes damage while within 60 feet of the chimera, half the damage taken (rounded up) is transferred to the chimera.

trait.name: Lethe
entries: While the chimeron's soul count is 0, they have advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and their Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, the chimeron must use their movement on each of their turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature they can sense with their soulsight, and then if they are able, they must use their action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. The chimeron can't act with any other purpose until they add 1 to their soul count.

trait.name: Soul Devourer
entries: When the chimeron reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the chimeron consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to the chimeron's soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

trait.name: Soul Resistance
entries: While the chimeron's soul count is is 2 or higher, they have advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chimeron makes up to three attacks using Powerful Bite, Scorching Bite, Booming Bite, or Chilling Bite. They can't use any attack more than once.

action.name: Powerful Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Scorching Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage, and the target is set on fire until the target or a creature who can reach them uses an action to extinguish the flames. A creature who is on fire at the start of their turn takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage. If a creature who is already on fire is set on fire again on a subsequent turn, the damage isn't cumulative.

action.name: Booming Bite (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) thunder damage, and the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Chilling Bite (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage, the target's speed is halved until the end of their next turn, and they can only make one attack during their next turn.

reaction.name: Pain Absorption (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: When the chimeron takes damage, they reduce the damage taken by 16 ({@damage 3d10}).

trait.name: No Escape
entries: When the dreg hits a creature with an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action, that creature's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 0 until the end of its turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dreg makes two Bone Blade attacks.

action.name: Bone Blade
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) Force damage, and the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against any creature other than the dreg until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Sentinel Strike
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature within 5 feet of the dreg takes the {@action Disengage|XPHB} action or makes a melee attack roll against a target other than the dreg. {@actResponse} The dreg makes an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action against that creature.

trait.name: Running Leap
entries: As long as the chitter has moved 20+ feet this turn, it has a high jump and long jump of 30 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chitter makes two Sharpened Claws attacks and one Acrid Bite attack. It can also use Chitter, if available.

action.name: Acrid Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Sharpened Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Chitter {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 13}, each creature within 120 feet of the chitter that can hear it. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the chitter's next turn.

bonus.name: Aggressive
entries: The chitter moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} toward a {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature it can see. If it ends this movement adjacent to the creature, it gains {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against that creature until the end of its turn.

reaction.name: Slow Fall
entries: {@actTrigger} The chitter takes falling damage and doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. {@actResponse} The triggering damage is reduced to 0.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The chort devil casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the chort devil's darkvision.

trait.name: Hellish Weapons
entries: The chort devil's weapon attacks are magical. When the devil hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 4d6} fire damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The chort devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chort devil makes one Claw attack and two Ranseur attacks, or it makes four Hurl Flame attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d4 + 7}) slashing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws that use Charisma for 1 hour or until cured by a {@spell lesser restoration} spell or similar magic.

action.name: Ranseur
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 1d10 + 7}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Hurl Flame
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) fire damage.

action.name: Teleport
entries: The chort devil magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through an opening large enough for a Small creature. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The swarm makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Psychic Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 4d4 + 3}) Psychic damage.

name: Christophe Laszlo
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Christophe can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. Christophe lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement and takes no falling damage. Christophe cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

trait.name: Wing Flap
entries: As a bonus action, Christophe can use his powerful feathered arms to propel himself 15 feet upward. Christophe can't use this ability while gliding.

trait.name: Seedspeech
entries: Christophe can communicate simple ideas to living plants, and is able to interpret their responses in simple language.

trait.name: Teamaster
entries: Christophe has advantage on Intelligence ({@skill Nature}) checks related to plants that can be used as cooking herbs or to make teas.

action.name: Fisticuffs
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Elemental Nature
entries: The chronalmental doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Temporal Body
entries: When a chronalmental is subjected to a {@spell slow} spell, {@spell haste} spell, or similar effect, it automatically succeeds on any saving throws required by the spell or effect and regains 13 {@dice 3d8} hp.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chronalmental makes three Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Steal Time (1/Day)
entries: The chronalmental steals time from one creature it can see within 30 feet of it, drawing the stolen time into itself. The target must make a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target's speed is halved, and it can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, but not both for 1 minute. Then, the chronalmental's position in the initiative order increases by 10, its speed increases by 30 feet, and when it takes the Multiattack action, it can make one additional Slam attack. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effects on itself and the chronalmental on a success.

action.name: Displace {@recharge 5}
entries: The chronalmental sends one creature it can see within 30 feet of it outside of the flow of time, shunting the creature to a tiny demiplane. The target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition stunned} and magically shunted outside of time for 1 minute. The creature disappears for the duration, returning to the space it previously occupied, or the nearest unoccupied space, when the effect ends. At the end of each of its turns, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reaction.name: Step Between Seconds {@recharge 4}
entries: When a creature the chronalmental can see moves within 5 feet of it, the chronalmental can teleport, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space within 60 feet that it occupied within the past minute.

trait.name: Limited Telepathy
entries: The cikavak can magically communicate simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically with any creature that touches it and that can understand a language.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts
entries: The cikavak can communicate with Beasts as if they shared a language.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Silencing Squawk {@recharge}
entries: The cikavak lets out a magical squawk in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition deafened} and unable to speak for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Searing Presence
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the elemental takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

trait.name: Molten Form
entries: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. In addition, the elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage and must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or be {@condition restrained}. A creature that starts its turn {@condition restrained} in this way takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage. It can repeat the {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} at the end of each of its turns, freeing itself on a success.

trait.name: Water Susceptibility
entries: For every 5 feet the elemental moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 3d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Molten Gaze
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 8} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or have one nonmagical item of the elemental's choice that the target is carrying instantly melt or burn to cinders.

trait.name: Occupation
entries: Emissary, Lore-master

trait.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Lordly, Patient

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the citrullus remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal melon plant.

trait.name: Gush
entries: When the citrullus takes bludgeoning damage, sticky juice splashes out of it. If the attacker is within 30 feet of the citrullus, the attacker must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} by the sticky juice as if it had failed a saving throw against the plant's Bile Spray action.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Bile Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: The citrullus exhales pink bile in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage and is {@condition restrained} by the sticky seed-filled juice for 1 minute. On a success, the creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition restrained}. A creature, including the {@condition restrained} creature, can take its action to free the {@condition restrained} creature by succeeding on a {@dc 13} Strength check.

bonus.name: Creeping Seedlings
entries: The seeds in the sticky juice grow viny tendrils and drag each creature {@condition restrained} by Bile Spray and Gush up to 25 feet straight toward the citrullus.

trait.name: Point Blank Fencer
entries: A rapier deals one extra die of its damage when the city watch captain hits with it (included in the attack). In addition, the captain ignores the loading property of crossbows and doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll with a crossbow from being within 5 feet of a hostile creature. The captain may still have disadvantage on such an attack from other sources.

trait.name: Tactical Insight
entries: The city watch captain has advantage on initiative rolls, and friendly creatures within 30 feet of the captain and under the captain's command can choose to take the captain's initiative instead of their own when combat starts.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The city watch captain can use its Issue Orders. It then makes two Rapier attacks or three Light Crossbow attacks, or it makes one Rapier attack and two Light Crossbow attacks.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the city watch captain can force the target to drop one weapon it is wielding or drop one item it is carrying. If the captain chooses to make the target drop an item, the item can't be wrapped around or firmly attached to the target, such as a shirt or armor. The item lands in a space of the captain's choice within 5 feet of the target.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Issue Orders
entries: The city watch captain shouts orders at up to two friendly creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target can do one of the following as a reaction:

items.name: Attack
entries: The target makes one weapon attack with advantage.

items.name: Defend
entries: The target gains a +2 bonus to its Armor Class until the start of the captain's next turn.

items.name: Reposition
entries: The target moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: The cutthroat deals an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the cutthroat that isn't {@condition incapacitated} and the cutthroat doesn't have {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|disadvantage} on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cutthroat makes two shortsword or dagger attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: The cutthroat can take the {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, or {@action Hide} action.

reaction.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: The cutthroat halves the damage that it takes from an attack that hits it. The cutthroat must be able to see the attacker.

trait.name: Intimidating Presence
entries: Whenever the enforcer hits a creature with a melee attack, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or be {@condition frightened} of the enforcer until the end of the target's next turn. The enforcer and its allies have {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on attack rolls against any creature {@condition frightened} in this way. If a creature's {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the enforcer's Intimidating Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The enforcer makes three warhammer attacks.

action.name: Warhammer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Second Wind (Recharges after a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|Short or Long Rest})
entries: The enforcer regains 12 hit points

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The clawfish can hold their breath for 15 minutes.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage, and if the target is a Small or larger creature, the clawfish can pull themself into the target's space and attach to the target. While attached, the clawfish moves with the target without provoking opportunity attacks, and the clawfish can't make Claw attacks. A creature who can reach the clawfish can use an action to make a {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check. On a success, the clawfish is detached and shunted into an unoccupied space of the clawfish's choice within 5 feet of the target. The clawfish also detaches if they become {@condition grappled}, {@condition incapacitated}, {@condition prone}, or {@condition restrained}, or if they use 5 feet of movement to detach.

action.name: Electrocute {@recharge}
entries: Each creature touching the clawfish takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage. If the clawfish is immersed in water, each other creature within 10 feet of the clawfish who is touching the same body of water must succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The clawfish can hold their breath for 15 minutes.

action.name: Signature Attack (Bite)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Overwhelming Attack (2 Ferocity)
entries: The clawfish makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} lightning damage, and the target can't take reactions until the start of the clawfish's next turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Coiling Claws (5 Ferocity)
entries: The clawfish makes a signature attack against a Medium or smaller creature. On a hit, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and the clawfish can't make a signature attack against another target.

action.name: 5th Level: Lightning Bomb (8 Ferocity)
entries: Each creature within 10 feet of the clawfish must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage PBd8} lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Lightning Retaliation (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: When the clawfish or their caregiver is attacked by a creature the clawfish can see within 5 feet of them, the clawfish shocks the attacker. The attacker must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage PBd6} lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When Cloak makes an attack, she has advantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Cloak makes two Shortsword attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage, and the target is {@condition poisoned} until the start of Cloak's next turn.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature who hasn't moved since the end of Cloak's last turn, the attack deals an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Iron Ring (2/Day)
entries: If not in the Cyst, Cloak teleports to the Cyst. If in the Cyst, she teleports to a place she has visited.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: Cloak takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

reaction.name: You Should've Been Watching Me
entries: If a creature within 5 feet of Cloak hits one of her allies with an attack, Cloak makes a Shortsword attack against the creature. To use this reaction, Cloak must be able to see the ally and the attacker.

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The clockwork abomination doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Explosive Infernal Power Source
entries: When a clockwork abomination is destroyed, its infernal battery explodes. Each creature within 10 feet of the abomination must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The clockwork abomination is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The clockwork abomination has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Unstoppable
entries: Moving through difficult terrain doesn't cost the clockwork abomination extra movement, and its speed can't be reduced.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The clockwork abomination makes one Bite attack and one Slam attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
