It gains an additional level of {@condition exhaustion} for each day until it bonds with another water source or it dies. The crinaea can bond with a new water source and remove its levels of {@condition exhaustion} by finishing a long rest while submerged in the new water source.

trait.name: Watery Form
entries: While fully immersed in water, the crinaea is {@condition invisible} and it can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage.

trait.name: Crooked Thorns
entries: At the start of each of its turns, the effigy deals 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Psychic damage to any creature it is grappling or any creature grappling it.

trait.name: Old Bindings
entries: The effigy takes an extra 10 Force damage if it's hit by an attack roll using {@item Smith's Tools|XPHB} or {@item Tinker's Tools|XPHB} (treat as a {@item Club|XPHB} or {@item Light Hammer|XPHB}).

action.name: Impale
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 13}) from one of two branch arms. Until the grapple ends, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Trackless Step
entries: The crooked hare leaves no tracks, or it leaves the tracks of a Large or smaller creature of its choice. If it doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, it can share the effects of this trait with another creature within 5 feet (no action required).

action.name: Twisting Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 11} Charisma saving throw or become cursed for 24 hours. The cursed creature's limbs sporadically twist and move in unnatural ways, giving the creature {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and on ability checks that rely on Charisma.

spellcasting.name: Confusion (1/Day)
headerEntries: The crooked man casts {@spell Confusion|XPHB}, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}).

trait.name: Aversion to Self-Sacrifice
entries: The crooked man takes 20 Necrotic damage if he can see a creature willingly take damage or gain a condition in place of someone else, or to someone else's benefit.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The crooked man has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crooked man makes two Crooked Claw attacks, and he can replace one attack with a use of Snap Limb. He can also use {@spell Confusion|XPHB} if available.

action.name: Crooked Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Slashing damage plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Psychic damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}) from one of two claws. Until the grapple ends, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Snap Limb
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 19}, one creature the crooked man is grappling, and that has limbs that can break. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Force damage, and the bones (or equivalent) in one of the target's limbs (crooked man's choice) breaks, causing an appropriate effect below. A broken limb heals in 40 days, or when the creature regains any {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} from magic or Regeneration. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Broken Arm
entries: {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls. Can't hold anything or manipulate objects with the limb.

action.name: Broken Leg
entries: {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} halved. If the creature takes the Dash action, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Broken Wing
entries: {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} reduced to 0.

bonus.name: Blinking Teleport
entries: The crooked man has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition for 1 minute and teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet. The condition ends immediately after the crooked man deals any damage.

trait.name: False Crows
entries: The swarm can't enter a space with a drawn or painted image or crafted effigy of a crow. A creature holding such an icon has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws the swarm forces it to make.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny crow. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Wing Bind
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 13}, any creature (other than a Fiend) with a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} that starts its turn in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the swarm. {@actSaveFail} The target's {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} is 0 until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Peck
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Piercing damage, or 7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage if the swarm is {@status Bloodied|XPHB}. If the target is a creature, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls until the start of the swarm's next turn.

action.name: Cacophony {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the swarm. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of the swarm's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Ablaze
entries: The crux sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet, and they can't benefit from being {@condition invisible}. A creature who starts their turn grappling or {@condition grappled} by the crux takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crux makes two Flame Tongue or two Sulfurous Rake attacks.

action.name: Sulfurous Rake
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage, and the target can't take reactions this turn.

action.name: Flame Tongue
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 100 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d12}) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it ignites.

bonus.name: Convocation of Fire (1/Day)
entries: The crux imbues the power of fire in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Flame Bloom.} The Elemental launches a seed of flame at a point they can see within 60 feet of them. A 10-foot radius sphere centered on that point erupts with fire and burns for 1 minute. Each creature who enters that area for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage.

{@b Smoke Screen.} The Elemental exudes an aura of smoke 10 feet in every direction for 1 minute or until dispersed by a moderate or stronger wind. The smoky area is heavily obscured for all creatures who aren't fire elementals.

bonus.name: Flame Jet (1/Day)
entries: The crux gains a flying speed of 30 feet until the end of their turn and can move up to their speed.

name: Crux of Frost
languages: plus the languages known by a creature reflected by Frosted Reflection

trait.name: Scintillating
entries: The crux can't benefit from being {@condition invisible}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crux makes two Rimeglass Touch attacks, and they can use Frosted Reflection or It Stares Back, if available.

action.name: Rimeglass Touch
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) cold damage, and the target can't see or hear creatures other than themself and the crux until the start of the crux's next turn.

action.name: Frosted Reflection
entries: The crux reflects the appearance of a specific Medium or Small creature they've seen within the last week. This appearance is illusory and imperfect, showing a frostbitten version of the creature. The illusion lasts until the crux takes thunder damage, uses this action again, or is {@condition incapacitated}. For the duration, the crux additionally knows any languages that creature knows.

action.name: It Stares Back {@recharge 5}
entries: The crux imposes fragility on a creature within 60 feet of them who is reflected by the crux's Frosted Reflection. If the target can see the crux, the target must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is {@condition frightened} of the crux for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), or until the crux stops reflecting them. While {@condition frightened} in this way, whenever the target takes damage, they take an extra 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage. On a successful save, the target isn't {@condition frightened}, and they are immune to the It Stares Back of all cruxes for 24 hours.

bonus.name: Convocation of Ice (1/Day)
entries: The crux imbues the power of ice in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Frigid Sheen.} The Elemental gains a mirror sheen that reflects damage for 1 minute. When the Elemental is hit with an attack by a creature they can see within 30 feet of them, the Elemental can use a reaction to reflect the attack. The Elemental is unaffected by the attack, and the attacker must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the attack's damage and effects are reflected back at the attacker as if the attack originated from the Elemental, turning the attacker into the target. On a successful save, the attacker takes half as much damage, but suffers no other effect.

{@b Frost Squall.} Frost swirls around the Elemental for 1 minute. For the duration, each non-Elemental creature who starts their turn within 15 feet of the Elemental has their speed reduced to 15 feet unless it is already lower until the end of their turn, and the first time they willingly move before the start of their next turn, they take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage.

hp.special: 76 (9d8 + 36) plus 76 (9d8 + 36) per player character

trait.name: Aura of Dread
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Vladimir von Drakken takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Reborn Transformation
entries: When Vladimir von Drakken consumes the blood of six living creatures of level or challenge rating 10 or higher, he transforms into Reborn Vladimir von Drakken. His {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} doesn't change. If he is destroyed before he can feed sufficiently, he must begin the process again when he rejuvenates.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Vladimir von Drakken regains 30 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} remaining.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If Vladimir von Drakken is destroyed in his crypt-starved form, he crumbles into ash and reforms {@dice 1d10} days later with all of his {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. His new body appears within his crypt in the Brachenwald. Casting Hallow on the druidic shrine prevents his new body from returning so long as the spell remains in effect.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

action.name: Vladimir von Drakken always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On his turn, Vladimir von Drakken can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Vladimir von Drakken takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Bloodmourne
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}26 ({@damage 6d6 + 5}) Force damage, and the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d4}).

items.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 18}).

action.name: Bite (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 18}, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, or {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveFail} 40 ({@damage 10d6 + 5}) Necrotic damage. The target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} Maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and Vladimir von Drakken regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to that amount. A Humanoid killed by this effect and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a Vampire Spawn under Vladimir von Drakken's control.

action.name: Terrifying Glare
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 18}, one creature Vladimir von Drakken can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. Failure by 5 or More: While {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Shadow Step (1/Round)
entries: Vladimir von Drakken teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet that is in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}. He has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the next melee attack he makes before the end of this round.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: Vladimir von Drakken chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. He can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the crystalline devil's darkvision.

trait.name: False Appearance (Gemstone Form Only)
entries: While the devil remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary gemstone.

trait.name: Glittering Temptation (Gemstone Form Only)
entries: The devil sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius. Each creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the devil and that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} for 1 minute. While {@condition charmed}, a creature is {@condition incapacitated} and must move on its turn toward the devil by the safest route, trying to get within 5 feet of the devil to hold it. The {@condition charmed} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. On a success, a creature is also immune to this devil's Glittering Temptation for the next 24 hours. A creature {@condition charmed} by the devil has disadvantage on the saving throw against Crystalline Spray.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The crystalline devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devil makes three Claw attacks.

action.name: Shard Claw (Fiend Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Crystalline Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: The crystalline devil sprays a burst of crystal shards. Each creature within 15 feet of the devil must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 ({@damage 6d8}) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Betraying Carbuncle
entries: The crystalline devil magically transforms into a Small or smaller gemstone or back into its true form, which is a Fiend. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form, except it can't move or speak when in its gemstone form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it. It reverts to its true from if it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dreg makes two Refracted Beam attacks.

action.name: Refracted Beam
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) Radiant damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the start of the dreg's next turn. If this attack deals a different damage type due to Refract Elements, it has additional effects:

action.name: Acid or Fire
entries: The target is also {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} ({@dice 2d6}) of the corresponding damage type.

action.name: Cold
entries: The target has the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} {@variantrule Condition|XPHB} ({@dc 13}).

action.name: Lightning
entries: The target has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} {@variantrule Condition|XPHB} until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Refract Elements
entries: {@actTrigger} The dreg takes Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage. {@actResponse} The dreg gains {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the triggering damage type, including the triggering damage, until the end of its next turn. During its next turn, its Refracted Beam attack deals damage of that damage type instead of Radiant damage.

trait.name: Heat Consumption
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the Cuddle Bug gains 1 Freeze Point, affecting the creature as detailed below. (The effects of Freeze Points stack.)

rows: The creature has a -2 penalty to all attack rolls.
The creature can't add its proficiency bonus to any Dexterity checks or Dexterity saving throws.
The creature suffers one level of Exhaustion. This level of Exhaustion goes away when the creature no longer has any Freeze Points.
The creature's speed is halved, and it can use either an action or a bonus action on each of its turns, not both
At the start of each of the creature's turns while it's not unconscious, it takes 5 cold damages.

entries: A creature can remove all accumulated Freeze Points by taking at least 1 fire damage or finishing a short or long rest.

action.name: Drain Heat
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) cold damage, and the Cuddle Bug regains hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The cursed slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Cursed
entries: Any creature that touches the slime or hits it with a melee attack must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or take 2 ({@damage 1d4}) psychic damage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The slime can climb difficult surfaces, including vertically and upside down, without making an ability check.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) psychic damage.

reaction.name: Slime Curse
entries: The cursed slime splashes a sticky, foul-smelling residue on a creature within 30 feet of it that hits it with an attack. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or become cursed until the end of the slime's next turn. Creatures under this curse have disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hulk makes two Slam attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with its Eye Laser.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Eye Laser
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Force damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} If the target is a creature and this damage reduces it to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it disintegrates into a pile of fine delerium dust.

bonus.name: Wink {@recharge 4}
entries: The hulk vanishes from the Material Plane and is transported to the Space Between Worlds. At the start of its next turn, it returns to an unoccupied space of its choice within 10 feet of the space it vanished from. If no unoccupied space is available within that range, it appears in the nearest unoccupied space (chosen at random if more than one space is equally near).

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The cyclops's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks). The cyclops can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: One-Eyed
entries: The cyclops has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|disadvantage} on any attack roll against a target more than 30 feet away.

trait.name: Storm Wings
entries: While outdoors in stormy conditions, the cyclops has a flying speed of 60 feet.

trait.name: Supernatural Focus
entries: The cyclops has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on Constitution {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1} made to maintain {@status concentration} on spells, and cannot lose {@status concentration} because of turbulent weather.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cyclops makes two ice claw attacks.

action.name: Ice Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) cold damage.

trait.name: Ooze Ancestry
entries: The cyglops doesn't need to breathe. The cyglops doesn't require sleep, gaining the benefits of a long rest after spending 4 hours in a trance-like state. The cyglops has advantage on saving throws against disease.

trait.name: Poor Depth Perception
entries: The cyglops has disadvantage on any attack roll against a target more than 30 feet away.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cyglops makes two pseudopod attacks and uses its eye ray, if recharged. The eye ray can be replaced by its Release Skeletons action.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) acid damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet from the cyglops and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Eye Ray {@recharge 4}
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 8} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 6d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Release Skeletons
entries: The cyglops ejects {@dice 1d3} sets of skeletal remains from inside itself to an unoccupied space it can see within 10 feet of it, losing 4 ({@dice 1d8}) hit points for each one. The remains then animate, each becoming a skeleton loyal to the cyglops. Each skeleton remains for up to 1 hour, or until the cyglops reabsorbs it as an action. All skeletons created this way share one turn in combat, which takes place immediately following the cyglops in initiative.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Dagon can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If Dagon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: One With the Sea
entries: When Dagon drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or would be killed outright, it instead transforms into a swirling body of water. At the start of each of Dagon's turns, it gains one recovery point but otherwise cannot use actions or legendary actions other than Relentless Horror. When it gains its fourth recovery point, its maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} return to normal if they have been reduced and it regains all lost {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. It reforms its physical body in a space of its choice within 10 miles of its location. It then loses all recovery points.

If Dagon is the target of a {@spell Banishment|XPHB} spell cast with a 9th-level spell slot while in this cloud form, it automatically fails its saving throw and is instead sent to the deepest corner of the ocean where it slumbers for {@dice 6d10} years.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: Dagon deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Spectral Waves
entries: Storm-tossed waves formed of magical force swirl around Dagon in a 120-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from him. Creatures without a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} treat this area as Difficult Terrain and take 10 Force damage if they end their turn in this area. Flying creatures that end their turn in this area must make {@dc 24} Strength saving throws, gaining the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition on a failed save.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Dagon makes four Slashing Claw attacks.

action.name: Slashing Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 17}, Reach 20 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 2d10 + 10}) Slashing damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away from Dagon and gains the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Hungry Tide {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 24}, creatures of Dagon's choice within 120 ft. of it; {@actSaveFail 1} The target takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Force damage, and gains the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. {@actSaveFail 2} The target takes {@dice 4d20} (22) Force damage its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced to 0 and cannot be increased until it uses an action to make a successful {@dc 24} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.

legendary.name: Disdainful Swipe
entries: Dagon makes a Slashing Claw attack.

legendary.name: Storm Tossed Seas
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 25}, creatures within 120 ft. of Dagon of its choice; {@actSaveFail} Dagon moves the target up to 30 feet and the target gains the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

legendary.name: Relentless Horror {@recharge 5}
entries: Dagon chooses one of the following options:

items: It teleports up to 200 ft. to an unoccupied space.
It immediately ends one spell or condition affecting it.
It ends one spell or magical effect of its choice within 120 ft. of it.

name: Dancing Lady
languages: understands Druidic and Sylvan but can't speak

trait.name: Dancing Flowers
entries: The dancing lady has three spinning flowers resembling life-sized dancing Humanoids. Each flower has AC 16, 5 hit points, vulnerability to fire damage, and immunity to psychic damage. Attack rolls against these whirling blooms have disadvantage. Destroying a flower deals no damage to the dancing lady, who regrows destroyed flowers at the end of their turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dancing lady makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 3d12 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Blood-Red Waltz
entries: For each flower the dancing lady has, they can choose one creature they can see within 60 feet of them. Each target must make a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw as a dancing flower sweeps toward them. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) psychic damage and is moved to an unoccupied space within 60 feet of the dancing lady. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't moved.

action.name: Disarming Quickstep
entries: For each flower the dancing lady has, they can choose one creature they can see within 60 feet of them. Each target must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw as a dancing flower whirls them into a dance. On a failed save, a creature takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) bludgeoning damage and is {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the start of the dancing lady's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}.

action.name: Ballet of Terror (1/Day)
entries: The dancing lady's flowers pirouette and emit acrid mist. Enemies within 120 feet of the dancing lady who can smell the mist must make a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature becomes {@condition frightened} of the dancing lady for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

reaction.name: Somber Dirge
entries: When a creature the dancing lady can see hits the dancing lady with an attack, the dancing lady causes the attack to hit one of their flowers instead.

trait.name: Hungry Dead Nature
entries: The darakhul requires no air or sleep.

trait.name: Master of Disguise
entries: A darakhul in a prepared disguise has advantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) checks made to pass as a living creature. While using this ability, it loses its Stench.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the darakhul must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the darakhul's Stench for the next 24 hours. A darakhul using this ability can't also benefit from Master of Disguise.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the darakhul has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Turning Defiance
entries: The darakhul and any ghouls within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn Undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The darakhul makes one Bite attack, one Claw attack, and one War Pick attack. If the darakhul is using a shield, it instead makes one Bite attack and one Claw or War Pick attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage, and, if the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or contract the darakhul fever disease.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an Undead, it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. A {@condition paralyzed} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a Humanoid is {@condition paralyzed} for more than 2 rounds, it contracts darakhul fever.

action.name: War Pick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If the darakhul fails a saving throw, they can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Master of Disguise
entries: A darakhul in a prepared disguise has advantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) checks made to pass as a living creature. While using this ability, the darakhul loses their Stench.

trait.name: Necrotic Weapons
entries: The darakhul's weapon attacks are magical. When the darakhul hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 5d6} necrotic damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the darakhul must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the darakhul's Stench for 24 hours.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the darakhul has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Turning Defiance
entries: The darakhul and any ghouls within 60 feet of the darakhul have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The darakhul uses Targeting Directive and makes three weapon attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. If the target is a humanoid, they must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or contract darakhul fever.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature other than an undead, it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a humanoid is {@condition paralyzed} for more than 2 rounds, it contracts darakhul fever.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 17 ({@damage 5d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Tactical Strike {@recharge 5}
entries: The darakhul barks out an order. Up to five allied ghouls within 120 feet that can hear the darakhul can use their reactions to each make one weapon attack.

action.name: Targeting Directive
entries: One of the darakhul's allies within 60 feet that can hear the directive deals an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage to creatures it hits with a weapon attack until the beginning of the darakhul's next turn.

legendary.name: Reposition
entries: The darakhul can take a Dash action.

legendary.name: Attack (Costs 2 actions)
entries: The darakhul makes one weapon attack.

legendary.name: Rejuvenation (Costs 3 actions)
entries: The darakhul drains life energy from one ghoul ally within 60 feet that they can see. The ghoul crumbles to dust and the darakhul regains hit points equal to the target's remaining hit points, plus 1 for each of the target's Hit Dice.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The vampire casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}, +9 to spell attacks):

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The vampire regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes three attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Bite, Unholy Light, or Spellcasting.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Spiritual Maul
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) Force damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the vampire.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, or {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveFail} 12 ({@damage 3d6 + 2}) Necrotic damage, and the vampire regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

action.name: Unholy Light {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 10-foot radius, 40-foot high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point the vampire can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Necrotic damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Staggered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Blood Rebuke
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the vampire can see within 60 feet of it deals damage to it. {@actResponse d}{@actSave con} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d4}). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The dark growth can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) check.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The dark growth regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn. If the Dark Growth takes Fire or Radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the dark growth's next turn. The dark growth dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dark growth makes three attacks: two with its Entangling Vines and one with its Infection Spores.

action.name: Entangling Vines
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 30 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}) and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends.

action.name: Infection Spores
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 60 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} The target is infected with a disease called Dark Decay. Instead of acting normally on its turn, the target must move toward the closest creature that isn't infected with Dark Decay and make one melee attack against it. If the attack hits, the target of that attack must also make a saving throw against Dark Decay. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save. Subsequent Failures: The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. Third Success: The disease ends.

An infected creature that dies or undergoes a Monstrous Transformation becomes a Dark Growth Shambler. A {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB} spell or similar magic that removes diseases ends Dark Decay, as does any magic that removes {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dark growth shambler makes two Claw attacks and one Infectious Bite attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Infectious Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} The target is infected with a disease called Dark Decay. Instead of acting normally on its turn, the target must move toward the closest creature that isn't infected with Dark Decay and make one melee attack against it. If the attack hits, the target of that attack must also make a saving throw against Dark Decay. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save. Subsequent Failures: The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. Third Success: The disease ends.

An infected creature that dies or undergoes a Monstrous Transformation becomes a Dark Growth Shambler. A {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB} spell or similar magic that removes diseases ends Dark Decay, as does any magic that removes {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

reaction.name: Abrupt Decay
entries: {@actTrigger} The dark growth shambler drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and it hasn't taken Fire damage this round. {@actResponse} The dark growth shambler creates a Dark Growth in its space.

trait.name: Dark Devotion
entries: The dark servant has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Darksight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the dark folk's darkvision.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The dark servant has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the dark servant's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the dark servant has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dark servant makes two attacks with its sickle.

action.name: Sickle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. {@hit 3} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The dau casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The dau has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dau makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage, and the dau regains hp equal to the necrotic damage dealt. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage dealt. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The creature dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

reaction.name: Mirror Dodge
entries: When a creature the dau can see within 30 feet of it attacks the dau or targets it with a spell, the dau replaces itself with an illusory duplicate and teleports to any unoccupied space that it can see within 30 feet. The dau isn't affected by the attack or spell, and the illusory duplicate is destroyed.

reaction.name: Tangible Illusion (1/Day)
entries: When the dau casts a spell that creates an illusion of an object, the dau temporarily transforms that illusion into a physical, nonmagical object. The temporary object lasts 10 minutes, after which it reverts to being an illusion (or vanishes, if the duration of the original illusion expires). During that time, the illusion has all the physical properties of the object it represents, but it doesn't have any of the object's magical properties. The dau must touch the illusion to trigger this transformation, and the object can be no larger than 5 cubic feet.

trait.name: Drink Light
entries: The dawndrinker can take a bonus action to drink light within 30 feet of it. If it does so, nonmagical light sources in this area go out, extinguishing any flames that are the source of the light. Provided the light comes from an effect of 3rd level or lower, or a creature of CR 7 or lower, magical bright light becomes dim light, and magical dim light goes out. If a magical effect's light is extinguished, the effect is dispelled. A creature's or object's inherent light returns to normal after 1 minute. The dawndrinker can dim or extinguish stronger effects by succeeding on a Constitution check with a DC of 10 + the effect's level or 5 + the creator's CR, whichever is lower.

trait.name: Light Sense
entries: The dawndrinker can sense any light source within 120 feet of it. This sense penetrates most barriers, but it is blocked by 3 feet of wood or dirt, 1 foot of stone, or 1 inch of metal.

trait.name: Radiant Absorption
entries: Whenever the dawndrinker is subjected to radiant damage, it takes no damage and instead regains hit points equal to the radiant damage dealt.

trait.name: Shadow Cunning
entries: In dim light or darkness, the dawndrinker can take a bonus action to use the Disengage or Hide actions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dawndrinker makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the dawndrinker's next turn.

trait.name: Potent Poison
entries: Undead with resistance or immunity to poison damage or the {@condition poisoned} condition can be affected by the swarm's poison.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

trait.name: Weight of Wings
entries: A creature that starts its turn in the swarm's space has its speed halved and must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or become {@condition blinded}. Both effects end when the creature ends its turn outside the swarm's space. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the blinding effect of Weight of Wings for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Bites
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. {@h}21 ({@damage 6d6}) piercing damage, or 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hp or fewer. The target must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half the damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}.

name: Death Coach

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The death coach's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 20}. The death coach can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The death coach can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. It takes 5 ({@dice 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the death coach fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The death coach has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Silencing Aura
entries: The area within 60 feet of the death coach is under the effects of a {@spell silence} spell. The death coach is immune to this effect.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the death coach moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the death coach can make another attack with its hooves against the target as a bonus action.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) force damage.

action.name: Etherealness (Ghost)
entries: The death coach enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

legendaryHeader: The death coach can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The death coach regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The death coach moves up to its speed.

legendary.name: Dreadful Presence (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature of the death coach's choice that is within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target's speed is also reduced to 0 until this {@condition frightened} effect ends for it. A {@condition frightened} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the {@condition frightened} condition on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the death coach's Dreadful Presence for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The death coach casts a spell.

trait.name: Morbid Curiosity
entries: The death shroud is easily distracted by fresh corpses. Whenever it first detects a corpse that has been dead for less than 1 hour (and that it didn't witness die), it must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or get distracted. While distracted, it spends its movement and actions trying to get close to, and inspect, the corpse for a cause of death. A distracted death shroud in a corpse's space uses its action to make Intelligence ({@skill Medicine|PHB}) checks (DC decided by the GM). On a success, it stops being distracted and becomes immune to the allure of that corpse forever.

trait.name: Turn Immunity
entries: The death shroud is immune to effects that turn undead.

action.name: Slap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Lich Slap
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30 ft., one creature. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage and the target can't regain hit points until the start of the death shroud's next turn.

trait.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: The deathcap takes 10 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myconid can use its Eject Spores. It then makes two Spore-Coated Fist attacks.

action.name: Spore-Coated Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Eject Spores
entries: The myconid ejects one of the following types of spores at one creature it can see within 15 feet of it.

items.name: Deathcap Spores
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. It can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Slumber Spores
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute. The target wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

name: Deathhawk
languages: understands Common but can't speak it

trait.name: Corpse Sense
entries: Within a range of 5 miles, the deathhawk can sense the presence of Undead or corpses that have been dead for less than 90 days; the deathhawk knows the general direction these are in but not their exact locations. In addition, the deathhawk has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks made to find Undead or corpses that have been dead for less than 90 days.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The deathhawk doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they fly out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deathhawk makes one Beak attack and one Wounding Talons attack.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 3d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Wounding Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead, they gain a bleeding wound that lasts until they regain at least 1 hit point. A bleeding creature loses 5 ({@damage 1d10}) hit points for each bleeding wound they have at the start of their turn. Any creature who can reach the target can use an action to stanch all the target's wounds, ending the effect.

bonus.name: Bloodcurdling Shriek {@recharge}
entries: The deathhawk shrieks, and each enemy within 300 feet of the deathhawk who can hear them must make a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw. Creatures who are immune to the {@condition frightened} condition automatically succeed on this saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is horrified for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While horrified, each time the creature makes an attack roll or a saving throw, they must roll a {@damage d4} and subtract the number rolled from the attack roll or saving throw.
If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for them, they are immune to the Bloodcurdling Shriek of all deathhawks for the next 24 hours.

name: Deathwisp

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Flicker
entries: The deathwisp flickers in and out of sight. Ranged weapon attacks against it are made with disadvantage.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The deathwisp can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside a solid object.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the deathwisp has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The deathwisp doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deathwisp makes two Ghostly Pike attacks, or it can make one Ghostly Pike attack and one Life Drain attack.

action.name: Ghostly Pike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) force damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

action.name: Create Specter
entries: The deathwisp targets a Humanoid within 10 feet of it that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute and died violently. The target's spirit rises as a specter in the space of its corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. This specter is under the deathwisp's control. The deathwisp can have no more than twelve specters under its control at one time.

bonus.name: Shadow Traveler (3/Day)
entries: While in shadows, dim light, or darkness, the deathwisp disappears into the darkness and reappears in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. A tendril of inky smoke appears at the origin and destination when it uses this bonus action.

name: Decahedrooze

trait.name: Reactive Mutations
entries: Immediately after the ooze takes damage, it gains resistance to that damage type. The ooze can have up to four resistances from this trait. If the ooze has its maximum number of resistances, the oldest resistance is lost when a new one is gained.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze makes two Pseudopod attacks. It can replace one attack with Engulf.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The ooze moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Small or smaller  creatures' spaces. Whenever the ooze enters a creature's space, the creature must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the ooze. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

On a failed save, the ooze enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is {@condition restrained}, and takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) acid damage at the start of each of the ooze's turns. When the ooze moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a {@dc 16} Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage and the target suffers one of the following random effects (roll a {@dice d10}):
1. The target takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage.
2. The target takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) bludgeoning damage.
3. The target takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) piercing damage.
4. The target takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) slashing damage.
5. The target takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) cold damage.
6. The target takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.
7. The target takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) lightning damage.
8. The target takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) thunder damage.
9. The target takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage.
10. The target takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) radiant damage

legendaryHeader: The ooze can take 2 legendary action, choosing the option below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The ooze regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The ooze makes one Pseudopod attack

hp.special: Seven times their level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Hellfire)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d4} necrotic damage plus {@damage 1d4} fire damage. Both of the spell's damage types increase by {@dice 1d4} when the deceiver reaches 5th level ({@dice 2d4} each), 11th level ({@dice 3d4} each), and 17th level ({@dice 4d4} each).

action.name: 3rd Level: Hell's Lash (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the deceiver lashes a whip of crimson energy between them and a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Constitution saving throw or take {@damage PBd4} fire damage and be tethered. A tethered creature takes {@damage PBd4} damage at the beginning of each of their turns. A tethered creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: 5th Level: Armor of Deception (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the deceiver weaves frightening illusions around a creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The illusions last for 1 minute. A creature who attacks the target while the illusions are active must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Wisdom saving throw or take {@damage PBd6} psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} until the end of their next turn. A creature who succeeds on the saving throw is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

action.name: 7th Level: Mote of Hell (1/Day)
entries: As an action, the deceiver manifests a pocket of Hell, creating a 15-foot-radius sphere of brimstone and darkness centered on a point within 150 feet of them. That area becomes difficult terrain. A creature who starts their turn in that area or enters it for the first time on a turn takes {@damage PBd6} fire damage. A creature who ends their turn in that area must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Wisdom saving throw or take {@damage PBd6} psychic damage from the screams of the damned in their mind.

name: Decrepit Hyphan Brute

trait.name: Grounded
entries: The brute has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid being moved against its will.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the brute can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Sun Sickness
entries: While in sunlight, or if it takes 5 or more radiant damage in a single turn, the brute has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of its next turn. The brute dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

action.name: Broken Sword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

legendaryHeader: The fungal guardians (brute, duskcap, and sporeslinger) can take 3 legendary actions between them, with the brute choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time, and only at the end of another creature's turn. The fungal guardians regain spent legendary actions at the start of the turn of the guardian with the highest initiative.

legendary.name: Smush
entries: The brute moves up to 5 feet and can occupy the space of a creature one or more sizes smaller than it. A creature whose space it enters must make a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and pushes the brute back to the space from which it moved. While the brute occupies the space of a creature it knocked prone in this way, the creature is grappled (escape {@dc 13}). Until this grapple ends, it is restrained.

legendary.name: Rampage (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The brute moves up to its speed and can move through the spaces of creatures one or more size categories smaller than it. Each creature whose space it moves through must make a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw, taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage and being knocked prone on a failure, or taking half as much damage and not being knocked prone on a success. A creature can be affected by this action no more than once per turn.

variant.name: No Legendary Actions
entries: In scenarios other than The Veiled Lady monster hunt, you may wish to use these hyphans without their legendary actions. If you do so, the brutes' and duskcaps' CRs change as follows (the Sporeslinger's CR stays the same):
Without legendary actions, the Decrepit Hyphan Brute's challenge rating is 1.

variant.name: Teamwork Trio
entries: A brute, duskcap, and sporeslinger that bore an especially close connection pre-hyphanation can bring the experience of that teamwork into the hyphan colony. Such individuals often form teams of three, acting in concert to strike more often, and perform feats that lone hyphans cannot.

name: Decrepit Hyphan Duskcap

trait.name: Cunning Action
entries: The duskcap can take a bonus action on each of its turns in combat. This action can be used only to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: The duskcap deals an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the duskcap that isn't incapacitated and the duskcap doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Sun Sickness
entries: While in sunlight, or if it takes 5 or more radiant damage in a single turn, the duskcap has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of its next turn. The duskcap dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

action.name: Spike
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

legendaryHeader: The fungal guardians (brute, duskcap, and sporeslinger) can take 3 legendary actions between them, with the duskcap choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time, and only at the end of another creature's turn. The fungal guardians regain spent legendary actions at the start of the turn of the guardian with the highest initiative.

legendary.name: Flanking Strike
entries: The duskcap moves up to 20 feet and makes one attack with its Spike.

legendary.name: Spike Storm (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The duskcap fires a torrent of spikes in either a 20-foot cone or in a 10-foot sphere centred on it. Each other creature in the area must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage on a failure or half as much damage on a success.

variant.name: No Legendary Actions
entries: In scenarios other than The Veiled Lady monster hunt, you may wish to use these hyphans without their legendary actions. If you do so, the brutes' and duskcaps' CRs change as follows (the Sporeslinger's CR stays the same):
Without legendary actions, the Decrepit Hyphan Duskcap's challenge rating is 1.

variant.name: Teamwork Trio
entries: A brute, duskcap, and sporeslinger that bore an especially close connection pre-hyphanation can bring the experience of that teamwork into the hyphan colony. Such individuals often form teams of three, acting in concert to strike more often, and perform feats that lone hyphans cannot.

name: Decrepit Hyphan Sporeslinger

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The sporeslinger is a 3rd-level spellcaster and can cast the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Sorcery Points
entries: The sporeslinger has 3 sorcery points. It regains all its spent sorcery points when it finishes a long rest. It can spend its sorcery points on the following options:

items.name: Quickened Spell
entries: When the sporeslinger casts a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, it can spend 2 sorcery points to change the casting time to 1 bonus action for this casting.

items.name: Twinned Spell
entries: When the sporeslinger casts a spell that targets only one creature and doesn't have a range of self, it can spend a number of sorcery points equal to the spell's level to target a second creature in range with the same spell (1 sorcery point if the spell is a cantrip).

trait.name: Sun Sickness
entries: While in sunlight, or if it takes 5 or more radiant damage in a single turn, the sporeslinger has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of its next turn. The sporeslinger dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

action.name: Sporestaff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage. Hit or miss, if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the sporeslinger and its hyphan allies until the end of the sporeslinger's next turn.

legendaryHeader: The fungal guardians (brute, duskcap, and sporeslinger) can take 3 legendary actions between them, with the sporeslinger choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time, and only at the end of another creature's turn. The fungal guardians regain spent legendary actions at the start of the turn of the guardian with the highest initiative.

legendary.name: Smokescreen
entries: The sporeslinger shakes its staff, creating a 5-foot-diameter sphere of black smoke centred on it that heavily obscures the area. It then moves up to its speed.

legendary.name: Rage Spores (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The sporeslinger blows a plume of spores in a 20-foot cone. Each non-hyphan creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or immediately use its reaction to make a weapon attack against a randomly determined, non-hyphan creature within its reach/range.

variant.name: Teamwork Trio
entries: A brute, duskcap, and sporeslinger that bore an especially close connection pre-hyphanation can bring the experience of that teamwork into the hyphan colony. Such individuals often form teams of three, acting in concert to strike more often, and perform feats that lone hyphans cannot.

name: Decrepit Skeleton
languages: understands the languages they knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Bone Weapons
entries: The skeleton's weapon attacks are magical. They use their bones as ammunition for their bone bow, regrowing used bones every dusk.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the skeleton takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the skeleton takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Bone Bow (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage. If the target is a creature and three or more skeleton minions joined the attack, the skeletons can choose another creature they can see within 5 feet of the original target. The second target takes 2 piercing damage.

action.name: Bone Knife (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 slashing damage.

trait.name: Illusionary Lure
entries: The Deep Angler can create an image of an object, effect, or creature, which surrounds its lure, causing the chosen effect to look as if it were floating in space. The image can't create sound or smell, and physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, since things can pass through it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Deep Angler makes two attacks: one with its Chomp and one with its Lure.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) piercing damage, and the target is swallowed if it is a Large or smaller creature. A swallowed creature is {@condition Blinded} and {@condition Restrained}, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the Deep Angler, and takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the Deep Angler's turns.

The Deep Angler can hold up to 3 creatures in its mouth at a time. If the Deep Angler takes 15 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the Deep Angler must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which enters an empty space within 10 feet of the Deep Angler. If the Deep Angler dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement.

action.name: Lure
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition Blinded} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The drake has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the drake has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drake makes one Bite attack, two Claw attacks, and one Stinger attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. A {@condition poisoned} creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a failure, the creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage. On a success, the condition ends. When animate dead is cast on one or more creatures killed by this poison, the spellcaster requires no material components and can cast the spell as an action.

action.name: Enervating Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The deep drake exhales pain-inducing, purple-black energy in a 90-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) necrotic damage and is {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition stunned}.

trait.name: Psionic Shroud
entries: The dreamer is immune to divination spells and to any effect that would sense their emotions or read their thoughts.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dreamer makes two Tendrils attacks and uses Dream Spores, if available.

action.name: Tendrils
entries: {@atk mp} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage. If the target is {@condition charmed} by the dreamer, the dreamer regains hit points equal to half the psychic damage dealt.

action.name: *Dream Spores (5th-Order Power; Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dreamer releases a cloud of psionic spores. Each creature within 60 feet of them must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the dreamer for 1 minute.
While {@condition charmed} in this way, a creature must use their movement during their turn to move within 10 feet of the dreamer by the safest available route.
A creature {@condition charmed} in this way can repeat the saving throw whenever they take damage, ending the effect on themself on a success.

reaction.name: Rouse Dreamer
entries: When a creature makes an attack against the dreamer, the dreamer chooses a creature {@condition charmed} by the dreamer within the attack's range, and the {@condition charmed} creature becomes the target of the attack instead.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The deep dreg can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Watery Camouflage
entries: The deep dreg has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks to {@action Hide|XPHB} in any area {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB} by murky water or aquatic features.

trait.name: Catch of the Day (1/Turn)
entries: The deep dreg can deal an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage to a {@condition Prone|XPHB} or {@condition Restrained|XPHB} creature it hits with a weapon attack.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage, or 6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Piercing damage if wielded with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Net
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 3} to hit, range 5/15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. {@h}The target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. A creature can take an action to free itself or another creature in a net with a successful {@dc 10} Strength check. Dealing 5 Slashing damage to the net (AC 10) frees the target without harming it and destroys the net.

trait.name: Abyssal Aura
entries: Allies within 30 feet who can see and hear the deep knight have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions. The deep knight can't use this trait if it is {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The deep knight can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Unwavering Sentinel
entries: Creatures provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action from the deep knight even if they take the {@action Disengage|XPHB} action before leaving its reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deep knight makes one Harpoon attack and one Bite attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Harpoon
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Piercing damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave str} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} The target is pulled up to 20 feet toward the deep knight.

bonus.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave str} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The deep one casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The deep one can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The deep one has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deep one makes two claw and one bite attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, Reach 10 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, Reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The deep one can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Frenzied Rage
entries: If a deep one takes 10 or more damage from a single attack, it has advantage on its Claws attack and gains a +2 bonus to damage with its Claws until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) slashing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The deep one archimandrite casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The deep one archimandrite can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Frenzied Rage
entries: If a deep one archimandrite takes 15 or more damage from a single attack, it has advantage on all attack rolls and gains a +4 bonus to all damage rolls until the end of its next turn. For the duration, it can make one Unholy Trident attack as a bonus action on its turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deep one archimandrite makes one Claw attack and one Unholy Trident attack, or it makes three Jolt attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Unholy Trident
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage plus 13 ({@damage 2d12}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Jolt
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) lightning damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Call of the Archimandrite (1/Day)
entries: With a ringing shout, the archimandrite magically calls {@dice 1d4} reef sharks or 1 swarm of quippers, provided the archimandrite is at least partially submerged in a body of water that can contain the creatures. The called creatures arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of the archimandrite and obeying its spoken commands. The creatures remain for 1 hour, until the archimandrite dies, or until the archimandrite dismisses them as a bonus action. Each deep one within 1 mile of the archimandrite can hear this call, though these deep ones are under no magical compulsion to make their way toward the archimandrite.

trait.name: Mythos Fanaticism
entries: If the deep one hybrid can see a Mythos creature of size Large or larger, it gains a +5 bonus to Initiative rolls and gains 2 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn.

action.name: Trident
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, Reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 2}, range 80/320 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8}) Piercing damage.

reaction.name: My Life for Yours
