entries: {@actTrigger} A Mythos creature without this Reaction is hit by a melee attack. {@actResponse} This creature becomes the target of the triggering attack if it is in range of the original attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The deep one priest casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The deep one priest can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Frenzied Rage
entries: If a deep one priest takes 10 or more damage from a single attack, it has advantage on melee attack rolls and gains a +4 bonus to melee damage rolls until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Voice of the Deeps
entries: The deep one priest can spend 5 minutes giving a speech in a rolling, droning voice that fascinates listeners. At the end of the speech, each creature that heard it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or forget the events of the past 10 minutes or keep no memory of the events of the next 5 minutes (the priest's choice). On a successful saving throw, a creature is immune to the priest's Voice of the Deeps for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deep one priest makes one Claws attack and one Jolting Touch attack.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Jolting Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) lightning damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The deep siren casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}, +7 to spell attacks):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The deep siren can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deep siren makes two Storm Lash attacks.

action.name: Storm Lash
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away from the deep siren.

action.name: Discordant Song (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 15}, each creature of the deep siren's choice in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the deep siren. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Psychic damage, and the target must roll {@dice 1d6} and subtract the result from each {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} it makes. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. It automatically succeeds after 1 minute.

action.name: Illusory Appearance
entries: The deep siren covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like another creature of her general size and shape. The illusion ends if the siren takes a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to end it or if she dies.

The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the siren could appear to have smooth skin, but someone touching them would feel their fishy flesh. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check to discern that the siren is disguised.

bonus.name: Misty Step
entries: The deep siren magically teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

trait.name: Explosive Death
entries: The deepdreck explodes when it dies. {@actSave dex} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the deepdreck. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Poison damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

trait.name: Fragrance Aversion
entries: The deepdreck has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and saving throws while within 10 feet of burning incense or a creature wearing Perfume.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The deepdreck can burrow through solid rock at half its {@variantrule Burrow Speed|XPHB} and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deepdreck makes two attacks, using Claw or Putrid Emission in any combination.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Putrid Emission
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, range 60 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of the deepdreck's next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The degenerate titan has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The degenerate titan can use its Reality‑Bending Shout. It then makes three Greatclub attacks or two Rock attacks.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Reality-Bending Shout
entries: The degenerate titan utters a scream that vibrates the fabric of reality around one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The titan can attempt to end one magical effect of its choice of 3rd level or lower on the target. This effect works like the {@spell dispel magic} spell, except the titan must always make an ability check. The titan's ability check for this is +4.

action.name: Earthstrike {@recharge 5}
entries: The degenerate titan slams its fists onto the ground, creating a shockwave in a 60-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) force damage and is flung 20 feet away from the titan and knocked {@condition prone}, as the earth buckles and tosses the creature. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't flung or knocked {@condition prone}. If a flung creature strikes a solid surface, the creature takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was flung. If the creature is flung at another creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The dragon is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The dragon may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the dragon can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the dragon has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Alien Intellect
entries: The dragon is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the dragon's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes one Bite attack and uses Contaminated Rend twice.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Force damage.

action.name: Contaminated Rend
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15}, one creature within 5 feet of the dragon. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

action.name: Octarine Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Radiant damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

bonus.name: Dimension Hop
entries: The dragon teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

trait.name: Misty Camouflage
entries: A delerium dreg has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks to hide in any area obscured by mist or fog.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage, or 6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

variant.name: Aquatic (Deep One or "Fishfolk")
entries: These mutated creatures have piscine faces, gills, fins, and fish scales. They are garbed in wet rags and carry spears and shields, and dwell deep within the sewers and underground caverns below the city.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: An aquatic dreg can breathe air and water. It has a swimming speed of 30 feet.

entries.name: Blindsight
entries: An aquatic dreg gains {@sense blindsight} with a radius of 30 feet.

entries.name: Death Burst
entries: When a bloated delerium dreg dies, it explodes in a burst of corrupt offal. Each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures who fail their saving throw by 5 or more gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.

entries.name: Bile Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: The bloated delerium dreg exhales a 15-foot cone of acid. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures who fail their saving throw by 5 or more gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.

entries.name: Armoured Shell
entries: A chitinous dreg has AC 18.

entries.name: Spectral Vision
entries: A cyclopean dreg gains {@sense truesight} 60 feet. It has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

entries.name: Mad Certainty
entries: A cyclopean dreg is immune to the {@condition frightened} condition and psychic damage.

entries.name: Psychic Shriek {@recharge 6}
entries: Creatures within 20 feet of the cyclopean dreg must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Displacement
entries: Attack rolls against a displaced dreg have disadvantage. If it is hit by an attack, this trait is disrupted until the end of its next turn. This trait is also disrupted while the displaced dreg is {@condition incapacitated} or has a speed of 0.

entries.name: Teleport {@recharge 4}
entries: The displaced dreg magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Before or after teleporting, the dreg can make one melee attack. If this attack hits, it deals an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage.

entries.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, a frenzied dreg can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the frenzied dreg hits with it.

entries.name: Illumination
entries: A lambent delerium dreg sheds bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet.

entries.name: Octarine Beam
entries: The lambent dreg targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures who fail their saving throw by 5 or more gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.

entries.name: Bounding Leap
entries: The leeching dreg's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

entries.name: Blood Drain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage, and the dreg attaches to the target. While attached, the dreg can't attack. Instead, at the start of each of the dreg's turns, the target takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

The attached dreg moves with the target whenever the target moves, requiring none of the dreg's movement. The dreg can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement on its turn. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the dreg.

entries.name: Normal Semblance
entries: The lurking dreg has advantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) checks to pass itself off as a normal humanoid creature.

entries.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: The dreg deals an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the dreg that isn't {@condition incapacitated} and the dreg doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spined dreg has a climb speed equal to its walking speed. It can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The dreg makes three spike attacks.

entries.name: Spike
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage.

entries.name: Amorphous
entries: The tentacled dreg can move through a space as narrow as 6 inches wide without squeezing.

entries.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the tentacled dreg can't use its tentacles on another target.

items.name: Amphibious
entries: An aquatic dreg can breathe air and water.

items.name: Death Burst
entries: When a bloated delerium dreg dies, it explodes in a burst of corrupt offal. Each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures who fail their saving throw by 5 or more gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.

items.name: Bile Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: The bloated delerium dreg exhales a 15-foot cone of acid. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures who fail their saving throw by 5 or more gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.

items.name: Spectral Vision
entries: A cyclopean dreg gains truesight 60 feet. It has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

items.name: Mad Certainty
entries: A cyclopean dreg is immune to the {@condition frightened} condition and psychic damage.

items.name: Psychic Shriek {@recharge}
entries: Creatures within 20 feet of the cyclopean dreg must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Displacement
entries: Attack rolls against a displaced dreg have disadvantage. If it is hit by an attack, this trait is disrupted until the end of its next turn. This trait is also disrupted while the displaced dreg is {@condition incapacitated} or has a speed of 0.

items.name: Teleport {@recharge 4}
entries: The displaced dreg magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Before or after teleporting, the dreg can make one melee attack. If this attack hits, it deals an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage.

items.name: Illumination
entries: A lambent delerium dreg sheds bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet.

items.name: Octarine Beam
entries: The lambent dreg targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures who fail their saving throw by 5 or more gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.

items.name: Bounding Leap
entries: The leeching dreg's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

items.name: Blood Drain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage, and the dreg attaches to the target. While attached, the dreg can't attack. Instead, at the start of each of the dreg's turns, the target takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

The attached dreg moves with the target whenever the target moves, requiring none of the dreg's movement. The dreg can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement on its turn. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the dreg.

items.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spined dreg has a climb speed equal to its walking speed. It can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

items.name: Multiattack
entries: The dreg makes three spike attacks.

items.name: Spike
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage.

items.name: Amorphous
entries: The dreg can move through a space as narrow as 6 inches wide without squeezing.

items.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the tentacled dreg can't use its tentacles on another target.

trait.name: Misty Camouflage
entries: A dreg has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks when taking the {@action Hide|XPHB} action in any area obscured by mist or fog, including the Haze.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage. Critical {@h}{@actSave con} {@dc 10}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Akyishigal casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Cloak of Swarms
entries: Akyishigal emits a cloud of flying, stinging insects from his mouth, eyes, and tears in his skin that spreads out in a 5-foot radius from him. At the start of each of his turns, Akyishigal chooses whether this cloak is active.

While this cloak is active, Akyishigal has disadvantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks, and creatures attacking Akyishigal can't benefit from traits and features that rely on a creature's allies distracting or surrounding the demon, such as the Pack Tactics trait or Sneak Attack feature. In addition, each creature that isn't a Construct or Undead that starts its turn in the cloud takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) piercing damage and must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage and become {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature emits a stench of decomposition, and uncontrolled insects attack that creature in preference to other targets.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Akyishigal fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Akyishigal has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Akyishigal makes four Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Call Spawn (1/Day)
entries: Akyishigal magically calls one spawn of Akyishigal. The spawn arrives in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as an ally of Akyishigal and obeying its telepathic commands. The spawn remains for 1 hour, until Akyishigal dies, or until Akyishigal dismisses it as a bonus action.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: Akyishigal magically transforms into a Large or smaller insectoid Beast or back into his true form, which is a Fiend. His statistics, other than his size, are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying transforms with him. He reverts to his true form if he dies.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: Akyishigal magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

legendary.name: Skitter (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Akyishigal moves up to half his speed and makes one Claw attack. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Akyishigal uses Spellcasting.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Camazotz casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 22}):

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that touches Camazotz or hits him with a melee attack while within 5 feet of him takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: Camazotz has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Camazotz fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Camazotz has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Camazotz makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}38 ({@damage 8d6 + 10}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw or its Strength score is reduced by {@dice 1d4}. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. A Humanoid that dies from this reduction rises {@dice 1d4} days later as a vampire under Camazotz's control, unless the Humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. Camazotz can have no more than five vampires under his control at a time.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}31 ({@damage 6d6 + 10}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Camazotz exhales unholy fire in a 30‑foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw, taking 33 ({@damage 6d10}) fire damage and 33 ({@damage 6d10}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Call Bats (3/Day)
entries: Camazotz magically calls {@dice 4d6} giant bats or swarms of bats, or he magically calls {@dice 2d6} vrocks that have membranous instead of feathered wings. The called creatures arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of Camazotz and obeying his telepathic commands. The creatures remain for 1 hour, until Camazotz dies, or until Camazotz dismisses them as a bonus action. Camazotz can have no more than twenty four giant bats or swarms of bats, or twelve vrocks under his control at a time.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: Camazotz magically transforms into a Large giant bat covered in smoldering ashes, or back into his true form, which is a Fiend. His statistics, other than his size, are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying transforms with him. He turns into a pile of greasy ash if destroyed.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: Camazotz makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Camazotz moves up to his speed, or he flies up to half his speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Camazotz uses Spellcasting.

legendary.name: Fiery Wing Beat (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Camazotz beats his wings, extinguishing mundane and magical light sources. Each creature within 10 feet of Camazotz must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Mechuiti casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 22}):

trait.name: Demon Lord's Ichor
entries: When Mechuiti is subjected to piercing damage or slashing damage, a spray of caustic blood spurts from his hide. Each creature within 10 feet of Mechuiti must succeed on a {@dc 24} Constitution saving throw or becoming infected with the Mechuiti's deadly ichor disease and be {@condition poisoned} until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours that elapse, the target must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hp maximum by 14 ({@dice 4d6}) on a failure. This reduction lasts until the disease is cured. The creature dies if the disease reduces its hp maximum to 0. The disease can be cured by the {@spell greater restoration} spell or similar magic or when the creature succeeds on three saving throws.

trait.name: Fiery Weapons
entries: Mechuiti's weapon attacks are magical. When Mechuiti hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 6d6} fire damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Immolating Corona
entries: At the start of each of Mechuiti's turns, each creature within 10 feet of him takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage and must succeed on a {@dc 24} Constitution saving throw or catch fire. A creature that touches Mechuiti or hits him with a melee attack while within 5 feet of him takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage and must succeed on a {@dc 24} Constitution saving throw or catch fire. Until a creature uses an action to douse the fire, the creature on fire takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Mechuiti fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Mechuiti has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Speak with Simians
entries: Mechuiti can communicate with apes and monkeys as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Mechuiti can use his Frightful Presence. He then makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}31 ({@damage 4d10 + 9}) piercing damage plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d8 + 9}) slashing damage plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage. If Mechuiti scores a critical hit, he rolls damage dice three times, instead of twice.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of Mechuiti's choice that is within 120 feet of Mechuiti and aware of him must succeed on a {@dc 24} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Mechuiti's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Burning Acid Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Mechuiti exhales fire and acid in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw, taking 49 ({@damage 14d6}) fire damage and 49 ({@damage 14d6}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Mechuiti moves up to his speed, or he climbs up to half his speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Burn from the Inside
entries: Mechuiti chooses a creature within 120 feet of him that is infected with the Mechuiti's deadly ichor disease. The target must make a {@dc 24} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage and 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage and catches fire. On a success, the target takes half the damage and doesn't catch fire. Until a creature uses an action to douse the fire, the target takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Mechuiti uses Spellcasting.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Qorgeth casts one of the following spells, requiring no material or somatic components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 19}):

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Qorgeth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Qorgeth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Qorgeth's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: Qorgeth can burrow through solid rock and leaves a 15-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Qorgeth makes one Bite attack, two Crush attacks, and one Stinger attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 2d12 + 9}) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by Qorgeth. A swallowed creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and it takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage at the start of each of Qorgeth's turns.

If Qorgeth takes 50 damage or more in a single turn from a creature inside it, Qorgeth must succeed on a {@dc 25} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of Qorgeth. If Qorgeth dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape the corpse by spending 30 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

action.name: Crush
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 2d10 + 9}) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is {@condition restrained} until Qorgeth moves. A creature, including the {@condition restrained} creature, can use an action to free the {@condition restrained} creature by succeeding on a {@dc 21} Strength check.

action.name: Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d6 + 9}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 33 ({@damage 6d10}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour. On a success, the target takes half the damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. A creature that fails the saving throw by 10 or more is also {@condition paralyzed} while {@condition poisoned} in this way.

legendary.name: Shriek
entries: Each creature within 60 feet of Qorgeth and that can hear the demon must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary.name: Death Roll (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Qorgeth moves up to half its speed straight toward a creature and makes one Crush attack against the creature. Each object and structure between Qorgeth and the target takes 33 ({@damage 6d10}) bludgeoning damage.

legendary.name: Devour (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Qorgeth makes one Bite attack.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spider makes two melee attacks: one with its bite and one with its stinger; or the spider can make one attack with its web spinner followed by a melee attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 14} Constitution {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}. On a failed save, the target takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. If this poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is {@condition paralyzed} while {@condition poisoned} in this way.

action.name: Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d12 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Web Spinner
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 40 ft., one target. {@h} The target is pulled 40 feet toward the spider and is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). The spider can {@action grapple} only one creature at a time in this way. As an action, the spider can cocoon a creature it has {@condition grappled} in webbing, causing it to be {@condition restrained} and ending the {@condition grappled} condition.

reaction.name: Arterial Spray
entries: When the spider takes damage while below half its hit point maximum, it can spray poisonous blood in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 14} Constitution {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}. On a failed save, a creature takes 13 ({@damage 3d8}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. If this poison damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, the creature is stable but {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is {@condition paralyzed} while {@condition poisoned} in this way.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spiderling can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The spiderling ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 13} Constitution {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Demonglass Gargoyle

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: Infernal; may know either Common or Goblin

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the gargoyle's {@spell Darkvision|XPHB}.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the gargoyle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate statue.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gargoyle makes one Bite attack and two Foul Claws attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Foul Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage.

bonus.name: Fiendish Presence
entries: The gargoyle activates or deactivates an aura of supernatural malevolence. {@actSave cha} {@dc 15}, creatures that start their turn within 15 feet of the gargoyle while the aura is active and can see it. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the gargoyle's Fiendish Presence trait for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Tool of the Horned King
entries: The demonglass goblin has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against spells and other magical effects cast by Fiends.

trait.name: Witness Tyranny
entries: The demonglass goblin gains 2 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} when a creature within 5 feet of it is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 80/320 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The goblin takes the {@action Disengage|XPHB} or {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

variant.name: Demonglass Champion
entries: A typical demonglass warrior is embedded with a small shard of demonglass, sufficient to influence the warrior but little more. Mortal champions of Tol Kharash may bear larger shards that carry a greater fragment of a fiend. These shards grant greater powers, but over time, the fiend consumes the mortal from within, until eventually the mortal is just a puppet controlled by the possessing spirit. A demonglass champion can possess one or more of the traits and actions below. The rarest of these is the Shape-Shift action, which is usually only held by those who also have the Hollow One trait. If the warrior has either of these traits/actions, the DM must decide what sort of fiend the shard contains; it could be anything from an imp to a pit fiend!

entries.name: Devil's Sight
entries: The demonglass warrior can see normally in darkness, both magical and nonmagical, to a distance of 120 feet.

entries.name: Hollow One
entries: The demonglass warrior is considered a Fiend instead of its standard creature type. The warrior is controlled by the spirit of the fiend, and the consciousness of the mortal host passively observes.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The demonglass warrior has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Will of Iron
entries: The demonglass warrior has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Shape-Shift (1/Day)
entries: The demonglass warrior shape-shifts into the form of a Fiend. Any equipment they are wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (their choice). The host's statistics and capabilities—including Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma—are replaced by those of the new form. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until the host is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. An exceptionally powerful warrior might be able to maintain the effect for a longer time. When the transformation ends, the host reverts to their previous form, with the same {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} they had before the transformation. However, if they revert as a result of dropping to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, any excess damage carries over to the new form. For example, if the host takes 10 damage in Fiend form and only has 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} left, they revert and take 9 damage.

entries.name: Wrath of the Horned King
entries: The demonglass warrior's spellcasting ability is Charisma. The demonglass warrior can innately cast the following spells, requiring no Material components.

entries.name: At Will:
entries: {@spell Eldritch Blast|XPHB}

entries.name: 3/Day Each:
entries: {@spell Hellish Rebuke|XPHB} (level 2 version) 1/Day Each: {@spell Fear|XPHB}

trait.name: Enchanted Cage
entries: The savant is immune to damage and can't be the target of spells or effects as long as its cage exists. The cage has a flying speed of 30 feet while the savant is inside of it, moving at the mental command of the savant. When the cage is destroyed, the savant floats gently to the ground. The cage has AC 19, 75 hp, and is immune to piercing, poison, and psychic damage. A non-derro that touches the cage or hits it with a melee weapon attack while within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn. The cage disintegrates if exposed to sunlight for 1 hour.

trait.name: Maddening Babble
entries: The savant constantly babbles eldritch nonsense while it can see any non-derro creatures and isn't {@condition incapacitated}. Each non-derro creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the savant and can hear the babbling must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition incapacitated} until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: The savant takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn outside the cage and in sunlight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fetal savant makes two Psychic Burst attacks.

action.name: Psychic Burst
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) psychic damage.

action.name: Soul Exchange {@recharge}
entries: The savant exchanges its soul with one Humanoid it can see within 20 feet of it. Its body becomes {@condition paralyzed}, the target's soul inhabits the savant's {@condition paralyzed} body, and the savant inhabits the target's body, taking full control of it. The savant retains its alignment, its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, its Psychic Burst action, and its immunity to being {@condition charmed} and {@condition frightened}. It otherwise uses the target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.

The exchange lasts until the target's body or the savant's body is reduced to 0 hp, the savant ends it as a bonus action, or the savant is forced out by an effect like the {@spell dispel evil and good} spell. When the exchange ends, the target returns to its body, regaining control, and the savant's soul returns to its body, which is no longer {@condition paralyzed}. The target is immune to this savant's Soul Exchange for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the exchange ends.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the shadow antipaladin is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the antipaladin instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Insanity
entries: The shadow antipaladin has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The shadow antipaladin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Necrotic Weapons
entries: The shadow antipaladin's weapon attacks are magical. When the antipaladin hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 2d8} necrotic damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the shadow antipaladin has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The derro makes two Scimitar or Heavy Crossbow attacks.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Infectious Insanity {@recharge 5}
entries: The shadow antipaladin magically assaults the minds of up to three creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage and is {@condition incapacitated} for 1 minute as its mind fills with thoughts of eldritch terrors and otherworldly entities. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition incapacitated}. An {@condition incapacitated} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The shadow antipaladin adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the antipaladin must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

name: Desert Cat
languages: Terran and understands Common but can't speak it

trait.name: Desert Camouflage
entries: The desert cat has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in sandy terrain.

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The desert cat can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the desert cat doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The desert cat has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) slashing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of the desert cat's next turn.

action.name: Sand Step
entries: The desert cat teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see that contains dirt, sand, or other fine earth.

variant.name: Desert Cat Familiar
entries: Spellcasters who are particularly attuned to the elemental planes or are inherently familiar with the desert's dunes may occasionally find and bind a desert cat familiar, especially those spellcasters who embody the desert cat's curiosity and propensity for chaos. A bound desert cat's behavior is erratic and varies greatly depending on its master's influence. Desert cats also are exceptionally skilled at reaching otherwise difficult-to-reach locations to cause trouble, especially around precious gems and metals. A desert cat serving as a familiar has the following trait.

entries.name: Familiar
entries: At the GM's discretion, warlocks with the Pact of the Chain feature can choose a desert cat as their familiar, in addition to the forms listed in their class. While the two are bonded, the master can sense what the desert cat senses as long as they are within 1 mile of each other. If its master causes it physical harm, the desert cat will end its service as a familiar, breaking the telepathic bond.

trait.name: Desert Walk
entries: Difficult terrain composed of sand or gravel doesn't cost the desert giant extra movement.

trait.name: Sand Camouflage
entries: The giant has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in sandy terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two Falchion attacks.

action.name: Falchion
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 6d4 + 8}) slashing damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 12} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 4d10 + 8}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: True Name
entries: If a creature the adjudicator can hear within 60 feet of them speaks the adjudicator's true name aloud, the adjudicator loses their damage resistances, damage immunities, and Devilish Charm reaction for 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The adjudicator makes two Infernal Injunction attacks and uses Adjudicator's Interdiction, if available.

action.name: Infernal Injunction
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 5d8 + 5}) fire damage, and the target must make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the adjudicator chooses for the target to become either {@condition charmed} by or {@condition frightened} of them until the end of the target's next turn.

action.name: Adjudicator's Interdiction {@recharge 5}
entries: The adjudicator places an infernal seal on one creature they can see within 120 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or be interdicted until the adjudicator dies. While interdicted, a creature's speed is halved, they can't take reactions, and they can't regain hit points. A {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power, a {@spell lesser restoration} or {@spell remove curse} spell, or a similar supernatural effect ends the effect early.

action.name: Bad Deal (1/Day)
entries: Three creatures the adjudicator can see within 60 feet of them must make a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a target must choose to either take a -5 penalty to AC or a -5 penalty to ability checks and attack rolls. This penalty lasts for 10 minutes (save ends at end of turn).

reaction.name: Devilish Charm (2/Day)
entries: When the adjudicator is targeted by an attack, power, spell, or other supernatural effect by a creature they can see within 60 feet of them, the creature must make a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition charmed} by the adjudicator until the start of the creature's next turn, and the adjudicator chooses a new target the adjudicator can see for the triggering effect. The new target must be within the triggering effect's range.

trait.name: Hellfire
entries: Fire damage dealt by the jurist ignores damage resistance.

trait.name: True Name
entries: If a creature the jurist can hear within 60 feet of them speaks the jurist's true name aloud, the jurist loses their damage resistances, damage immunities, and Devilish Charm reaction for 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jurist makes two Fire and Brimstone attacks.

action.name: Fire and Brimstone
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or gain one festering wound. A creature takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage at the start of each of their turns for each festering wound they have. A creature who receives supernatural healing loses all festering wounds.

action.name: Inferno {@recharge 5}
entries: The jurist makes one Fire and Brimstone attack against each enemy they can see within 60 feet of them.

bonus.name: Ashes to Ashes
entries: The jurist chooses a creature they can see within 120 feet of them who has one or more festering wounds. One of the target's wounds ignites and they take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage.

reaction.name: Devilish Charm (1/Day)
entries: When the jurist is targeted by an attack, power, spell, or other supernatural effect by a creature they can see within 60 feet of them, the creature must make a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition charmed} by the jurist until the start of the creature's next turn, and the jurist chooses a new target the jurist can see for the triggering effect. The new target must be within the triggering effect's range.

trait.name: Hellish Resistance
entries: While in Hell or within 60 feet of a devil with a challenge rating of 9 or higher, the legate has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

trait.name: True Name
entries: If a creature the legate can hear within 60 feet of them speaks the legate's true name aloud, the legate loses their damage resistances, damage immunities, and Devilish Charm reaction for 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The legate makes two Infernal Pike attacks.

action.name: Infernal Pike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage, and the legate chooses one of the following effects:

items.name: Focused Hate
entries: The target has disadvantage on attack rolls made against creatures other than the legate until the end of the legate's next turn.

items.name: Hellbite
entries: The target takes an extra 5 ({@damage 2d4}) fire damage.

items.name: Skewer
entries: The legate deals 5 ({@damage 1d10}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage to another creature within 5 feet of the target.

reaction.name: Devilish Charm (1/Day)
entries: When the legate is targeted by an attack, power, spell, or other supernatural effect by a creature they can see within 60 feet of them, the creature must make a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition charmed} by the legate until the start of the creature's next turn, and the legate chooses a new target the legate can see for the triggering effect. The new target must be within the triggering effect's range.

trait.name: True Name
entries: If a creature the magistrate can hear within 60 feet of them speaks the magistrate's true name aloud, the magistrate loses their damage resistances, damage immunities, and Devilish Charm reaction for 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The magistrate makes two Infernal Knife attacks and one Obsidian Kris attack.

action.name: Infernal Knife
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage, and the target is {@condition frightened} of their allies until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Obsidian Kris
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage, and if the target is {@condition frightened}, they can't take reactions until the {@condition frightened} condition ends for them.

reaction.name: Devilish Charm (2/Day)
entries: When the magistrate is targeted by an attack, power, spell, or other supernatural effect by a creature they can see within 60 feet of them, the creature must make a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition charmed} by the magistrate until the start of the creature's next turn, and the magistrate chooses a new target the magistrate can see for the triggering effect. The new target must be within the triggering effect's range.

trait.name: Importunity
entries: At the start of the notary's turn, they can grant an infernal blessing to a non-minion ally they can see within 60 feet of them (no action required). The next time that ally makes an attack roll or saving throw before the start of the notary's next turn, the ally can add a +1 bonus to the roll. This bonus increases by 1 (maximum bonus of +5) for each notary who grants an infernal blessing to the creature.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the notary takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the notary takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: True Name
entries: If a creature the notary can hear within 60 feet of them speaks the notary's true name aloud, the notary loses their damage immunities and Importunity trait for 24 hours.

action.name: Brimstone (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. {@h}4 fire damage.

hp.special: Eight times their level (number of d10 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Daggers)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}{@damage 2d4 + PB} piercing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the retainer can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Misleading Strike (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the retainer makes a signature attack. On a hit, the target must use their reaction, if available, to make a weapon attack against a creature of the retainer's choice.

action.name: 5th Level: Adjuration (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the retainer grants an infernal blessing to an ally they can see within 60 feet of them. The next time that ally makes an attack roll before the start of the retainer's next turn, the ally adds a +PB bonus to the roll. If the attack hits, it deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} damage.

action.name: 7th Level: Hellbitten Knives (1/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the retainer imbues their daggers with hellfire. For 1 minute, their signature attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} fire damage and ignores damage resistances.

trait.name: Scent of Death
entries: Creatures that can smell have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks made to find the devil's glove.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The devil's glove can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Tendril
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage, and the devil's glove attaches to the target. While attached, the devil's glove can't make Tendril attacks against other targets, and if the target is a creature, the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn if it can smell the devil's glove.
The devil's glove can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the devil's glove as an action.

action.name: Decaying Bloom (2/Day)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 12}, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the devil's glove. {@actSaveFail} 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} until the start of the devil's glove's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Symbiosis
entries: The devil's glove forms a magical bond with a willing creature it touches. The bonded creature doesn't need to eat or drink, and the creature has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition. The bond ends when the creature dies, the devil's glove dies, the devil's glove ends the bond (no action required), or when the devil's glove uses this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} again.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The devilbound gnome casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Infernal Blessing
entries: While the devilbound gnome is conscious and wearing no armor and wielding no shield, it adds its Charisma modifier to its AC (included above) and saving throws. In addition, magical darkness doesn't impede the gnome's darkvision.

trait.name: Infernal Bond
entries: The devilbound gnome is magically bound to an imp. The imp acts as an ally of the gnome's, obeying its spoken commands. The gnome can perceive through the imp's senses, speak through its mouth, and communicate with it telepathically even if the two aren't on the same plane of existence.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The devilbound gnome has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devilbound gnome makes three Hellish Blast attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Hellish Blast
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) fire damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage.

action.name: Hell's Servitors (1/Day)
entries: The devilbound gnome magically calls {@dice 1d4} devils with a challenge rating of 4 or lower, or it calls 1 devil with a challenge rating of 6 or lower. The called Fiends arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of the gnome and obeying its spoken commands. The Fiends remain for 1 hour, until the gnome dies, or until the gnome dismisses them as a bonus action.

action.name: To Hell and Back (1/Day)
entries: The devilbound gnome sends one creature it can see within 60 feet of it hurling through Hell. The target must make a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the target takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) fire damage as Hell pulls on the creature. On a failure, the target is {@condition incapacitated} and disappears, as it takes a quick trip through the nightmarish landscapes of Hell. At the end of the gnome's next turn, the target reappears in the space it previously occupied, or the nearest unoccupied space, and takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) psychic damage.

reaction.name: Fiendish Sacrifice
entries: When the devilbound gnome is reduced to 0 hp, it can sacrifice a Fiend called with the Hell's Servitor's action or sacrifice its bonded imp, preventing the damage and killing the chosen Fiend. If the gnome sacrifices its bonded imp, it loses its Infernal Blessing and Infernal Bond traits until it receives a new imp from its patron devil.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The digipede makes one Bite attack and two Talons attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) Slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Lightning damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the digipede's next turn.

action.name: Eye Beam {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Lightning damage, and the target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. {@actSaveFail 2} The target has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition. {@actSaveFail 3} The target has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Dimensional Attunement
entries: A dimensional shambler gains 1 Dimension Point at the end of its turn during combat or when it is otherwise threatened. It begins an encounter with 0 points and can have up to 4.

trait.name: Dimensional Warping
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 14}, if a creature within 30 feet of the dimensional shambler attempts to teleport. {@actSaveFail} The creature doesn't teleport. {@actSaveSuccess} The creature teleports as normal.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The dimensional shambler has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dimensional shambler makes up to four Dimensional Claw attacks and uses Disdainful Banishment. It can't attack the same creature more than twice with Dimensional Claw when it uses Multiattack.

action.name: Dimensional Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, Reach 10 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}). It can Grapple up to two Medium or smaller creatures at a time.

action.name: Disdainful Banishment
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 14}, one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the dimensional shambler. {@actSaveFail} The target is teleported up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the dimensional shambler can see.

bonus.name: Dimensional Flurry
entries: A dimensional shambler can spend 3 Dimension Points to gain an extra use of Legendary Action. It must use the additional use before its next turn.

bonus.name: Dimensional Rend
entries: A dimensional shambler can spend 1 Dimension Point to extend its claws through space and time, increasing its Reach with Dimensional Claw to 30 feet and allowing it to ignore all cover with those attacks until the end of its turn.

bonus.name: Dimensional Step
entries: A dimensional shambler can spend 3 Dimension Points to teleport itself and all creatures it has {@condition Grappled|XPHB} to a chosen destination it has visited within the past month.

bonus.name: Teleport
entries: The dimensional shambler teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The dimensional shambler makes up to two Dimensional Claw attacks.

legendary.name: Shift
entries: The dimensional shambler uses Dimensional Step.

legendary.name: Step
entries: The dimensional shambler uses Teleport.

trait.name: Boil and Bubble
entries: While the dingpot doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, it can provide enough heat to boil water within its vessel.

action.name: Steam Spray
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 60 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) Fire damage, and the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll it makes before the start of the dingpot's next turn. Being underwater doesn't grant {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to this Fire damage.

action.name: Brew (1/Day)
entries: The dingpot produces a magical elixir within its vessel. The elixir remains potent for 24 hours. It can choose from the following brews:

action.name: Healing Draught
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, a creature can drink the elixir to regain 4 ({@dice 1d6 + 1}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

action.name: Lucky Draught
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, a creature can drink the elixir to gain startling luck for 10 minutes. When the creature fails an ability check or a saving throw, it can reroll the {@dice d20} and use the new roll. Once this causes a roll to succeed, the effects of the elixir end early.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Diorite casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Diorite makes 3 Eldritch Bolt attacks. Up to three of these attacks can be replaced by Stone to Flesh. She also makes one Sculptor's Claws attack.

action.name: Sculptor's Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a successful save. If the target fails a saving throw against this ability while it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition, it instead has the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition. It can continue to make saving throws at the end of each of its turns, ending the petrification on a successful save.

action.name: Eldritch Bolt
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 120 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Force damage.

action.name: Stone to Flesh
entries: Diorite ends the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition on one creature she touches. Diorite regains 16 ({@dice 3d10}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and the newly un-Petrified creature has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for 10 minutes.

legendary.name: Diorite's Fury
entries: Diorite makes a Sculptor's Claws attack or an Eldritch Bolt attack.

legendary.name: Belief in Stone
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 15}, one creature Diorite can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage and the target believes one of its arms has been turned to stone until the end of its next turn. While affected, the creature cannot make use of that arm or use an item it is holding with that arm (though it can switch a held item to a different hand).

legendary.name: Whispers of Stone (2 Legendary Actions)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point Diorite can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage and is {@condition Frightened|XPHB} of Diorite until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The dipsa can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Discreet Bite
entries: The bite of a dipsa is barely perceptible and the wound is quickly anesthetized. When the dipsa hits with a Bite attack, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to notice the dipsa and its attack. Each time the creature takes acid damage from an attached dipsa, it can repeat this check, noticing the dipsa on a success. A creature that takes acid damage from the dipsa while below half its hp maximum automatically succeeds on this check.

trait.name: Ooze Nature
entries: The dipsa doesn't require sleep.

trait.name: Swamp Camouflage
entries: The dipsa has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}1 piercing damage, and the dipsa attaches to the target. While attached, the dipsa can't attack, and at the start of each of the dipsa's turns, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage and must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or have its hp maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

The attached dipsa moves with the target whenever the target moves, requiring none of the dipsa's movement. It can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement on its turn. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the dipsa.

bonus.name: Translucent
entries: The dipsa takes the Hide action.

trait.name: Exceptional Vision
entries: The bird has a +10 bonus to Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The bird doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they fly out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: High-Speed Dive (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the bird descends at least 30 feet on their turn, they can take the Dash action as a bonus action. When they do, they have advantage on the next attack they make before the end of their turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bird makes two attacks using Heavy Beak, Rending Talons, or both.

action.name: Heavy Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target is {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the start of the bird's next turn.

action.name: Rending Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). While grappling a target, the bird's Beak attacks against that target are made with advantage, and the bird can't attack another target. Each time the target makes a check to end the grapple, the target takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) slashing damage.

action.name: Crushing Grip
entries: The bird's powerful talons crush a {@condition grappled} target. The target must make a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw, taking 17 ({@damage 5d6}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target fails the save by 5 or more, they are also {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the end of their next turn.

bonus.name: Spot
entries: The bird makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

trait.name: Bonemonger
entries: Whenever the dire bunny first sees a bone, it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or become distracted until it possesses the bone or the bone is no longer in its line of sight. While distracted, it spends its movement and actions trying to get closer to the bone and sequester it. A distracted dire bunny whose owner issues a command to it repeats the saving throw at the end of its next turn, ending the effect on a success and becoming immune to the allure of any bone for the next hour.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Detect Thoughts (1/Day)
entries: The dire bunny learns the surface thoughts of one creature it can see within 30 feet of it for 1 minute. It can attempt to probe deeper into the creature's mind, using an action to force the target to make a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw, per the {@spell detect thoughts} spell.

name: Dirt Mournling
languages: understands the languages of their creator but can't speak

trait.name: Anguish Unleashed
entries: When the mournling dies, the sadness they contain is released into the world. Each creature within 30 feet of the mournling who can hear them must make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The mournling is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

trait.name: Puddle of Mud
entries: When the mournling leaves a space, the ground in that space becomes difficult terrain for their enemies for 10 minutes.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mournling makes three attacks using Slam, Mudslide, or both, and they can use Dust Storm, if available.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 20}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, the target is {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Mudslide
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 12} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, the target and each Huge or smaller creature of the mournling's choice within 5 feet of the target are pulled up to 30 feet toward the mournling.

action.name: Dust Storm (1/Day)
entries: The mournling hurls dirt, gravel, and sand. Each creature within 60 feet of them must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

bonus.name: Break and Reform
entries: The mournling teleports to an unoccupied space they can see within 30 feet of them.

reaction.name: Stuck Fast
entries: When the mournling is hit by a melee weapon attack, they capture the weapon that struck them in quickhardening mud, disarming the attacker. A creature who can reach the weapon can use an action or bonus action to make a {@dc 19} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, freeing the weapon on a success. The mournling can't use this reaction on attacks made with natural weapons.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The grick's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 12} {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The psyche can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The psyche makes two Electroshock attacks. It can also use Hypnotize, if available.

action.name: Electroshock
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}35 ({@damage 10d6}) Lightning damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the psyche's next turn.

action.name: Hypnotize {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, each creature of the psyche's choice in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the psyche. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition (save ends). While {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

action.name: Mental Possession
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 16}, one creature the psyche can see within 5 feet. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this psyche's Mental {@variantrule Possession|XPHB} for 24 hours. {@actSaveFail} The target is possessed by the psyche; the psyche disappears, and the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and loses control of its body. The psyche now controls the body, but the target retains awareness. The psyche can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that specifically target Undead. The psyche's game statistics are the same, except it uses the possessed target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, as well as the target's Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or the psyche leaves as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the possession on a success. When the possession ends, the psyche appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this psyche's Mental {@variantrule Possession|XPHB} for 24 hours.

bonus.name: Teleport
entries: The psyche teleports to an unoccupied space within 60 feet.

trait.name: Displacement
entries: Attack rolls against the dreg have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}. If it is hit by an attack roll, this trait does not apply until the end of its next turn. This trait does not apply while the dreg has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition or has a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 0.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

bonus.name: Teleport {@recharge 4}
entries: The dreg teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Before or after teleporting, the dreg can make one melee attack. If this attack hits, it deals an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The dissimortuum can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The dissimortuum doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dissimortuum makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one Claw attack with a use of Terrifying Mask.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d8 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Terrifying Mask
entries: Each non-Undead creature within 60 feet of the dissimortuum that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A {@condition frightened} creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target becomes immune to the dissimortuum's Terrifying Mask for the next 24 hours.

name: Dodecahedrooze

trait.name: Reactive Mutations
