entries: Immediately after the ooze takes damage, it gains resistance to that damage type. The ooze can have up to four resistances from this trait. If the ooze has its maximum number of resistances, the oldest resistance is lost when a new one is gained.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze uses Engulf and makes two Pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The ooze moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Small or smaller  creatures' spaces. Whenever the ooze enters a creature's space, the creature must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the ooze. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

On a failed save, the ooze enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 13 ({@damage 2d12}) acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is {@condition restrained}, and takes 26 ({@damage 4d12}) acid damage at the start of each of the ooze's turns. When the ooze moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a {@dc 17} Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage and the target suffers one of the following random effects (roll a {@dice d12}):
1. The target takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) force damage.
2. The target takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) bludgeoning damage.
3. The target takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) piercing damage.
4. The target takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) slashing damage.
5. The target takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) fire damage.
6. The target takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) cold damage.
7. The target takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) lightning damage.
8. The target takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) thunder damage.
9. The target takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) necrotic damage.
10. The target takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) radiant damage.
11. The target takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) poison damage.
12. The target takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) psychic damage.

legendaryHeader: The ooze can take 2 legendary action, choosing the option below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The ooze regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The ooze makes one Pseudopod attack

trait.name: Burrowed Tunnels
entries: If the dogmole burrows at half its burrowing speed, it can leave a 5-foot diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dogmole makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Wormkiller Rage
entries: When the dogmole takes damage from a Small or larger insectoid Beast, such as a giant centipede, or when it deals damage to such a creature, it enters a special rage for 3 rounds. While in this rage, it has advantage on attack rolls and Strength checks and deals an extra 2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage with its Bite attack, but its Armor Class is reduced by 2. The dogmole can't end this rage willingly.

trait.name: Burrowed Tunnels
entries: If the juggernaut burrows at half its burrowing speed, it can leave a 10-foot diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Stout
entries: The juggernaut has advantage on Strength and Dexterity checks and saving throws made against effects that would push it or knock it {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Relentless (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the juggernaut takes 15 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hp, it is reduced to 1 hp instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dogmole juggernaut makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. it: 12 ({@damage 3d4 + 5}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Wormkiller Rage
entries: When the juggernaut takes damage from a Small or larger insectoid Beast, such as a giant centipede, or when it deals damage to such a creature, it enters a special rage for 3 rounds. While in this rage, it has advantage on attack rolls and Strength checks and deals an extra 5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage with its Bite attack, but its Armor Class is reduced by 2. The juggernaut can't end this rage willingly.

name: Dohma Raskovar

trait.name: Adrenaline Rush
entries: If Raskovar fails a saving throw, he can expend a use of his Dohma Rally without gaining its benefits (no action required) and succeed instead.

trait.name: Relentless (1/Turn)
entries: When Raskovar isn't {@condition incapacitated} and he is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, he can make an attack against an enemy (no action required) before the hit point reduction is resolved. If the attack hits and its damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, Raskovar drops to 1 hit point instead of 0 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Raskovar makes three Repeating Crossbow attacks or two War Mace attacks.

action.name: War Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Repeating Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d12 + 1}) piercing damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Reinforcements (1/Day)
entries: Raskovar takes the Dodge action, and ten orc blitzers appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of him.

bonus.name: Dohma Rally (3/Day)
entries: Raskovar regains 20 hit points, and he gains resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until the end of his next turn.

reaction.name: On the House
entries: When a creature Raskovar can see within 30 feet of him fails an ability check or misses with an attack roll, that creature can reroll the check or attack, choosing either result.

legendaryHeader: Raskovar has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Close In
entries: Each ally within 60 feet of Raskovar who can hear him can move up to their speed. After this movement, each enemy within 5 feet of at least one creature who moved must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of Raskovar for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

legendary.name: Action 2: Lockdown
entries: Each ally within 60 feet of Raskovar who can hear him can make a Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check with advantage to grapple an enemy within their reach (no action required). Then Raskovar can move up to his speed.

legendary.name: Action 3: Do It Myself
entries: Raskovar moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks. At the end of the movement, he can make up to five War Mace attacks with advantage.

trait.name: Adamant Amalgam
entries: If the dolguul is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Strength or Constitution saving throw to take only half damage, the dolguul instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dolguul makes one Hook attack and one Cleaver attack.

action.name: Hook
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 15 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Piercing damage, and the target is pulled up to 10 feet towards the dolguul.

action.name: Cleaver
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 10 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) Slashing damage, and the target begins bleeding. While bleeding, a creature takes 2 ({@dice 1d4}) points of Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The bleeding ends after 1 minute, if the creature regains at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}, if a creature within 5 feet of the bleeding creature uses a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to expend a use of a {@item Healer's Kit|XPHB}, or if a creature within 5 feet of the bleeding creature makes a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) check.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Piercing damage. The target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}) if it is a Large or smaller creature. While grappling in this way, the dolguul can't use its Bite attack on another target.

bonus.name: Into the Meat Grinder
entries: If the dolguul hits with both a Hook attack and a Cleaver attack in the same turn, it makes a Bite attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The domovoi casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

trait.name: House Guardian
entries: When the domovoi finishes a long rest in a structure with up to 2,500 square feet of floor space, the structure becomes magically protected. This works like the {@spell guards and wards} spell, except the domovoi can choose only two effects from the spell to place in the warded area.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The domovoi makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The domovoi magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the domovoi wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

bonus.name: Protector's Step
entries: The domovoi magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space within a structure protected by its House Guardian trait or within 30 feet of the exterior of that structure. Swirls of golden light, sparkles of starlight, or tendrils of inky shadow (the domovoi's choice) appear at the origin and destination when it uses this bonus action.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The doomcaller is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 18}, {@hit 10} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following spells prepared:
footerEntries: *The doomcaller casts this spell on itself before combat.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The doomcaller has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target has disadvantage on their next attack roll. Additionally, all attacks against the target by allies of the doomcaller are made with advantage until the start of the doomcaller's next turn.

action.name: Summon Fiend (1/Day)
entries: The doomcaller chooses what to summon and attempts a magical summoning. A doomcaller has a 60 percent chance of summoning {@dice 1d6} succubi or {@dice 1d4} barbed devils. A summoned fiend appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of its summoner, does as it pleases, and can't summon other fiends. The summoned fiend remains for 1 minute, until it or its summoner dies, or until its summoner takes a bonus action to dismiss it.

reaction.name: Ill Fortune (3/Day)
entries: When a creature the doomcaller can see makes an attack roll, a saving throw, or an ability check, the doomcaller can roll a {@dice d20} and choose to use this roll in place of the attack roll, saving throw, or ability check.

trait.name: Arcane Doubling
entries: While in combat, at the start of each of its turns, the doppelrat rapidly creates duplicates of itself as an automatic defense mechanism. These duplicates immediately form into a swarm of rats in the doppelrat's space, acting as allies of the doppelrat and obeying its body language commands. The swarm acts on the doppelrat's turn, and the doppelrat can use its reaction to move up to its speed with the swarm, provided it is in the swarm's space when the swarm moves. The swarm remains for 1 minute, until the doppelrat dies, or until the doppelrat dismisses it as a bonus action. The doppelrat can have no more than two swarms of rats under its control at a time.

trait.name: Hidden Original
entries: While the doppelrat is in the space of a swarm it created with Arcane Doubling, it is indiscernible from the other rats and has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover}. A creature must take an action to visually inspect the swarm and succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to find the doppelrat among its duplicates. Once a creature succeeds on this check, the doppelrat loses {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and spells from that creature and that creature's allies until the doppelrat starts its turn in the same space as one of its swarms.

trait.name: Horrific Doppeling
entries: Characterized by the growing and sloughing off of tumors shaped like the infected creature, horrific doppeling is a disease that infects creatures attacked by doppelrats. Until the disease is cured, the creature is {@condition poisoned}. At the end of each long rest, the infected creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or shed a tumor that looks like a Tiny version of itself. Though disturbing, the tumor is merely a mass of shed skin and fat that decays as normal. The disease is cured after the creature succeeds on two saving throws.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The doppelrat has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or contract the horrific doppeling disease (see the Horrific Doppeling trait).

trait.name: Void Warping
entries: The area around the dorreq is warped by its connection to the Void. A creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the dorreq must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or its speed is halved until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dorreq makes one Bite attack and two Tentacles attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}) and pulled up to 5 feet closer to the dorreq. Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}. The dorreq can grapple up to two creatures at a time.

action.name: Void Thrum {@recharge 5}
entries: The dorreq emits a barely audible, vibrating thrum laced with Void energy. Each creature within 20 feet of the dorreq must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) thunder damage and 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Stone Step
entries: The dorreq teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. The origin and destination spaces must contain a stone or rocky surface, such as a cliff face or rocky terrain.

name: Doty X
languages: understands the languages that {@creature Taryon Darrington|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Tary} speaks

trait.name: Arcane Surge (4/Day)
entries: When Doty hits a target, {@creature Taryon Darrington|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Tary} can channel magical energy to deal an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) force damage to the target as long as {@creature Taryon Darrington|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Tary} is not {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Dedicated Servant
entries: Doty has an additional 20 hit points, and has a +2 modifier to {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1}, {@quickref ability checks|PHB|2|0} using skill proficiencies, and attack rolls.

trait.name: Limited Vocabulary
entries: Doty can say the following words in Common: "Tary," "Yes," "Correct," "Absolutely," "Soon," and "Handsome."

trait.name: Vigilant
entries: Doty can't be surprised.

action.name: Empowered Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) force damage.

action.name: Repair (3/Day)
entries: Doty regains 15 ({@dice 2d8 + 6}) hit points.

reaction.name: Deflect
entries: If a creature within 5 feet of Doty that he can see makes an attack against a creature other than Doty, he can impose {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|disadvantage} on the attack roll. The attacker then takes 6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) force damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The downcast apostate's spellcasting ability is Charisma. The apostate can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The downcast apostate is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks). It regains its expended spell slots when it finishes a short or long rest. It knows the following warlock spells:

trait.name: Apostate's Weapons
entries: The downcast apostate's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Morningstar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic or radiant damage (downcast apostate's choice).

trait.name: Action Surge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The downcast mercenary takes one extra action.

trait.name: Indomitable (2/Day)
entries: If the downcast mercenary fails a saving throw, it can reroll the saving throw and use the new roll.

trait.name: Thaumaturge
entries: The downcast mercenary can cast {@spell thaumaturgy} at will.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The downcast mercenary makes three attacks.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Reanimator casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}, +9 to spell attacks):

trait.name: Special Immunities
entries: Dr. Everett Freed, Reanimator is immune to the {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Reanimator makes two Electric Jolt or Necrotic Blast attacks.

action.name: Electric Jolt
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}35 ({@damage 10d6}) Lightning damage, and the target has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the Reanimator's next turn.

action.name: Necrotic Blast
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 9}, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}36 ({@damage 8d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the Reanimator's next turn.

action.name: Touch of Death (1/Day)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}200 Poison damage. This damage ignores {@spell Resistance|XPHB} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison damage and can't be reduced or prevented in any way. If the target is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it automatically fails death saving throws until it finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. A Heal or {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB} spell ends this effect early.

action.name: Reanimate {@recharge 5}
entries: The Reanimator targets the corpse of one of its destroyed creations it can see within 30 feet. The target returns to life with 45 ({@dice 10d8}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. The target has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all damage and {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Creator's Command
entries: The Reanimator chooses a creature it can see that was reanimated or created by it. The target can use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make an attack with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} or move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

reaction.name: Bodyguard
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the Reanimator can see targets it with an attack or spell that targets only the reanimator. {@actResponse} The Reanimator chooses one of its creations within 10 feet and switches spaces with it. The creation becomes the target instead.

trait.name: Resting Protections
entries: While the Dragon is {@condition Unconscious}, it can't become affected or detected by spells of 3rd level or lower.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Draconic Charm
entries: One Humanoid the Dragon can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition Charmed} for 1 day. The {@condition Charmed} target obeys the Dragon's spoken commands.

If the target suffers any harm from the Dragon or another creature or receives a harmful command from the Dragon, the charm ends. If a target's saving throw is successful, or if the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to this Dragon's Draconic Charm for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Limited Amphibiousness
entries: The dragon eel can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 6 hours to avoid suffocating.

trait.name: Shocking Hide
entries: A creature that touches the dragon eel or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) lightning damage.

trait.name: Storm Glide
entries: During storms with ample rain or lightning, the dragon eel gains a flying speed equal to its swimming speed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon eel makes one Bite attack and one Tail Slap attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d8 + 8}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) lightning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Tail Slap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 5d8 + 8}) bludgeoning damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) lightning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the eel. The dragon eel can choose to not push a target.

action.name: Lightning Breath {@recharge}
entries: The dragon eel exhales lightning in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each target in that line must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 ({@damage 10d10}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Dragon Frog
languages: understands Common and Naku Naku but can't speak

trait.name: Magic Removal
entries: When a creature or object becomes enclosed within the Dragon Frog's mouth, any spell of 3rd level or lower on the target ends.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The Dragon Frog's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or with-out a running start.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Pulling Tounge
entries: The Dragon Frog lashes out its tongue at a Medium or smaller creature or object it can see within 25 feet of it. If the target is a creature, it is pulled to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the Dragon Frog, unless it succeeds on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw. If the target is an object, it falls to the ground at the Dragon Frog's feet; if the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature must succeed on a contested Strength check or have the object pulled away from it.

legendary.name: Quick Attack
entries: Immediately after the Dragon Frog pulls a creature with its Pulling Tongue, it makes a Chomp attack against it.

trait.name: Arcane Acumen
entries: The dragonet has advantage on Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) checks made to reveal information about supernatural effects and objects they can see. Additionally, they always know if their emotions are being sensed, their thoughts are being read, or they are being targeted or perceived by any divination spells.

trait.name: True Words
entries: When a creature speaks in Draconic, the dragonet has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks to determine whether they are lying.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Revealing Breath (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The dragonet exhales sparkling light in a 15-foot cone. Each object in that area is outlined in light for 1 minute, and each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or also be outlined in light for the duration. Outlined creatures and objects shed dim light in a 5-foot radius, and if any outlined creatures or objects bear magic, the dragonet can learn its school of magic, if any, by looking at it. Any attack roll against an outlined creature or object has advantage if the attacker can see the target, and the outlined creature or object can't benefit from being {@condition invisible}.

action.name: Truesight (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: For 1 minute, the dragonet gains truesight out to a range of 60 feet.

trait.name: Elemental Affinity
entries: The dragonleaf tree has immunity to a type of damage based on the type of dragon that grew it: acid (black, copper), cold (silver, white), fire (brass, gold, red), lightning (blue, bronze), or poison (green).

trait.name: Eternally Loyal
entries: The dragonleaf tree has advantage on ability checks and saving throws against influence or effects that would encourage it or force it to act against its draconic master. If {@condition charmed} or controlled and directed to act against its master, the tree can immediately repeat the effect's saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon leaf tree makes three Slam or Throw Leaves attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage of the type noted in the Elemental Affinity trait.

action.name: Throw Leaves
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 4d4 + 2}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage of the type noted in the Elemental Affinity trait.

action.name: Elemental Leaves {@recharge}
entries: The dragonleaf tree's leaves rain acid, shed bolts of lightning, shake loose icicles, or similarly emit the elemental energies of the dragon that grew the tree. Each creature within 20 feet of the dragonleaf tree must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 {@damage 12d6} damage of the type noted in the Elemental Affinity trait.

trait.name: Greedy
entries: Whenever the dragonling first detects treasure worth 100 gp or more that isn't being worn or carried, it must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or get distracted. While distracted, it spends its movement and actions trying to get close to, and frolic in, the treasure. A distracted dragonling repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success and becoming immune to the allure of that treasure for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Metallic Character
entries: When the dragonling's tamer finishes a long rest, the dragonling gains an affinity for the element associated with the first precious metal it touches. This affinity grants the dragonling resistance to that damage type and lasts until its tamer next finishes a long rest. Copper gives acid affinity, gold gives fire, and magnetite & silver give cold.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Contaminated Regeneration
entries: The sewer gator regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn as long as it is in contaminated water. The gator dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Amphibious Lunge
entries: If the sewer gator swims 20+ feet on its turn, it can long jump or high jump up to 60 feet. If it ends this jump within 5 feet of a creature, it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on its next Crushing Bite attack against that creature, and that attack deals an additional 40 ({@damage 9d8}) Piercing damage.

trait.name: Predatory Stealth
entries: The sewer gator has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks to {@action Hide|XPHB} in water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sewer gator makes two attacks. It can't make both a Crushing Bite attack and a Tail Strike attack against the same target.

action.name: Crushing Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 15 ft. {@h}33 ({@damage 4d12 + 7}) Piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 19}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and the sewer gator can't use Crushing Bite against another target.

action.name: Tail Strike
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 15 ft. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet away from the sewer gator and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Death Roll
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 15 ft., one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the sewer gator. {@h}33 ({@damage 4d12 + 7}) Piercing damage. {@actSave str} {@dc 19}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and {@condition Helpless|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} conditions until it escapes the sewer gator's grapple.

reaction.name: Submerge
entries: {@actTrigger} The sewer gator takes damage while in water. {@actResponse} The sewer gator swims half its speed and takes the {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

trait.name: Irresistible Payment
entries: As an {@action Influence|XPHB} action, a creature that offers the drakkenhob alcohol or any amount of gold and succeeds on a {@dc 16} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) check forces the drakkenhob to accept the offer and immediately take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} to get away from the creature by the safest route possible.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drakkenhob makes two Rend attacks.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Piercing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Psychic damage.

action.name: Terrifying Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage, and the target drops whatever it is holding and has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition. A {@condition Frightened|XPHB} target takes the Dash action and moves away from the drakkenhob by the safest route on each of its turns unless there's nowhere to move. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Call the Hounds
entries: The drakkenhob lets out a wolf-like howl and magically summons three hunting hounds (use the Wolf stat block) that appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of it. The hounds take their turn immediately after the drakkenhob on the same {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, and they obey the drakkenhob's mental commands. The hounds vanish when they or the drakkenhob drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, or when the drakkenhob uses this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} again.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The drakon can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Dissolving Gaze
entries: When a creature that can see the drakon's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of the drakon, the drakon can force it to make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw if the drakon isn't {@condition incapacitated} and can see the creature. On a failed save, the creature takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage, its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the acid damage it takes, and it is {@condition paralyzed} until the start of its next turn. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The creature dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the drakon until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the drakon in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drakon makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 4d4}) acid damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Acid Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The drakon exhales acidic vapors in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking 28 ({@damage 8d6}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The drangolin can burrow through solid rock at half their burrow speed and leaves behind a 3-foot-diameter tunnel when they burrow. Tiny and Small creatures can move through this tunnel normally, and Medium and Large creatures can squeeze through it. This tunnel collapses after 10 minutes.

action.name: Signature Attack (Claws)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} slashing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Spit Breath (2 Ferocity)
entries: The drangolin breathes fire at their foe. This attack uses the statistics for their signature attack, except the fire is a ranged weapon with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 60 feet. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} damage, and all the damage dealt by the attack is fire damage instead of piercing damage.

action.name: 3rd Level: Roll Out (5 Ferocity)
entries: The drangolin moves up to their walking speed in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks. The drangolin can end this movement in a space that contains another creature. If they do, that creature takes 2 × PB bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet the drangolin traveled, and they must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, the creature is pushed 5 feet out of the drangolin's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice.

action.name: 5th Level: Rend and Roast (8 Ferocity)
entries: The drangolin makes two signature attacks against the same target, then breathes fire on them. The target must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage PBd6} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Ash Shot (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: When an enemy the drangolin can see moves within 5 feet of the drangolin's caregiver, the drangolin sprays the enemy with ash. If the drangolin is within 30 feet of their caregiver, the target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the start of the drangolin's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Draven can cast the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 19}):

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When Draven makes an attack, he has advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Profane Sacrifice (1/Turn)
entries: When Draven hits a creature with a melee attack, he can sacrifice his vitality to empower the attack. The target's speed drops to 0 until the start of his next turn, and Draven takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Draven makes three Gloom Dagger attacks.

action.name: Gloom Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d4 + 8}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 3d4}) necrotic damage, and Draven can move the target up to 10 feet horizontally. If the damage from this attack reduces a creature to 0 hit points, Draven regains a use of Blood of the Dragon.

action.name: Blood of the Dragon (1/Day)
entries: Draven boils the blood of up to three creatures he can see within 60 feet of him. Each target takes 33 ({@damage 6d10}) necrotic damage and must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn) and knocked {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Creeping Dread
entries: Draven chooses a creature he can see within 30 feet of him in an area of dim light or darkness. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or move their speed in a direction chosen by Draven. A creature with advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened} has advantage on this saving throw, and a creature who can't be {@condition frightened} automatically succeeds on it.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The dread skeljaskra deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dread skeljaskra makes two attacks, using Rend, Burning Spit, or Spiked Tail in any combination.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 6d8 + 6}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Burning Spit
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 10} to hit, range 90 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) Poison damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} conditions until the start of the skeljaskra's next turn.

action.name: Spiked Tail
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 5d10 + 6}) Piercing damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet.

action.name: Crushing Roll {@recharge 5}
entries: If the dread skeljaskra begins its turn in its Armored Ball form, it can roll up to 60 feet. {@actSave dex} {@dc 16} Each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} that is 15 feet wide. {@actSaveFail} 32 ({@damage 5d12}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

reaction.name: Armored Ball
entries: {@actTrigger} The dread skeljaskra takes 30 or more damage. {@actResponse} The skeljaskra curls into a ball until the start of its next turn. While this effect lasts, the creature has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, and it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The dream eater doesn't provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Moth Ward
entries: A creature holding a moth's wing automatically succeeds on saving throws against the dream eater's Hypnotic Wings.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The dream eater can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dream eater makes two Talons attacks and can use Devour Dreams.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}) from one of two talons, and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends.

action.name: Devour Dreams
entries: The dream eater unfurls its tongue and devours the dreams from a creature's mind. {@actSave cha} {@dc 16}, a creature the dream eater is grappling, or a creature within 5 feet of it that has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition ({@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} creatures fail automatically). {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Psychic damage, and the creature's Charisma score decreases by {@dice 1d6}. A creature reduced to 0 Charisma by this effect doesn't recover lost Charisma when it finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, and it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until its mind is restored with a {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB}, {@spell Heal|XPHB}, or {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Hypnotic Wings
entries: The dream eater's wings shine with dazzling rainbow colors until the start of its next turn, emitting {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the dream eater and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 30 feet. {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, each creature in the dream eater's {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}. {@actSaveFail} Until the start of the dream eater's next turn, the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, and its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0.

trait.name: Dream Eater's Caress
entries: A creature that starts its turn {@condition grappled} by the dream eater must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 2d4}) psychic damage. The dream eater gains temporary hp equal to the psychic damage dealt.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dream eater uses its Lotus Scent. It then makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the creature is {@condition restrained}. The dream eater has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Lotus Scent
entries: The dream eater secretes an oily chemical that most creatures find intoxicating. Each creature that isn't a Construct or Undead within 15 feet of the dream eater must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. While {@condition poisoned}, the creature is {@condition charmed} by the fiend. A {@condition poisoned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dream eater's Lotus Scent for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Waking Dreams {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature within 20 feet of the dream eater must make a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage and is {@condition incapacitated} for 1 minute. When it moves, an {@condition incapacitated} creature moves in a random direction. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition incapacitated}. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The dream eater magically transforms into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form, which is a Fiend. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

name: Dream Whisperer
languages: all languages known before the curse

trait.name: Aura of Confusion
entries: A creature that starts its turn or moves within 25 feet of a Dream Whisperer must succeed on a {@dc 13} Intelligence saving throw or be affected as if they had failed a save against the {@spell Confusion|XPHB} spell.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Dream Whisperer has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The Dream Whisperer can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Dream Whisperer makes three Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Slashing damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave int} {@dc 13}. {@actSaveFail} The Dream Whisperer gains {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against the target for 1 minute, and the target rolls on the Lost Memories table.

entries.caption: Lost Memories
outro: A {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} spell reverses this effect and restores the victim's memory.
rows: The target becomes deeply suspicious of a character or NPC of the GM's choice. They gain the following flaw: "I know they are seeking to betray me. I have to act first—it's me or them!"
The target forgets all memories of a loved one of the GM's choice. The next time the target sees them, it's as if they are meeting them for the first time.
The target becomes stricken with doubt and gains the following flaw: ""The world is out to get me, and I can't win. I may as well give up now."
The target forgets how to speak in one language known, decided by the GM.
The target forgets the location of something important to them, of the GM's choice. It may be the location of a goal, their home settlement, or a hidden treasure.
The target loses an inconsequential memory such as what they ate a few nights ago or the name of an unimportant NPC.

name: Dreamholder

trait.name: Phantasmal Cone
entries: The dreamholder's central eye creates an area of phantasmagoric horrors—illusory manifestations unique to each creature—within a 120-foot cone. At the start of each of its turns, the dreamholder decides which way the cone faces and whether the cone is active. Each creature within the cone at the end of the dreamholder's turn must succeed on a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) psychic damage and become frightened of the dreamholder and the illusions within the area until the end of the dreamholder's next turn.
As an affected creature is surrounded by these illusions, the source of its fear is in every direction, rendering it unable to move in any direction while it can see these sources of its fear.

trait.name: Inconsistent Incoporeality
entries: When the dreamholder takes 10 or more psychic or thunder damage in a single instance, it becomes corporeal until the start of its next turn. While corporeal, it loses its Incorporeal Movement trait; its immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage; and its immunity to the grappled and restrained conditions.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The dreamholder can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dreamholder fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Dreameater
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) psychic damage.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The dreamholder shoots four of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one to four creatures it can see within 120 feet of it:

items.name: 1. Charm Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the dreamholder for 1 hour, or until the dreamholder harms the target.

items.name: 2. Confusion Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be afflicted by the confusion spell until the end of its next turn.

items.name: 3. Static Ray
entries: The target must make a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, a target has muddled thoughts for 1 minute. During that time, it rolls a d6 and subtracts the number rolled from all its attack rolls and ability checks, as well as its Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 4. Rot Ray
entries: The target must make a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, its grey matter deteriorates, it takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) necrotic damage, and it has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls it makes until the end of its next turn. On a success it takes half as much damage and suffers no additional effects.

items.name: 5. Incorporeal Shunt Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or become momentarily incorporeal, be pushed up to 20 feet directly away from the dreamholder, and then rematerialise. The creature takes 22 ({@damage 5d8}) force damage if it rematerialises inside an object. If the creature rematerialises in another creature's space, both creatures take this damage. The target is then pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

items.name: 6. Nightmare Ray
entries: The target is assailed by illusory manifestations of its fears. It must make a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw, taking 27 ({@damage 5d10}) psychic damage on a failure or half as much damage on a success.

legendaryHeader: The dreamholder can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The dreamholder regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Eye Ray
entries: The dreamholder uses one random eye ray.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: The dreamholder teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of it. If it is within its lair it doesn't need to see this space to teleport to it.

legendary.name: Mirror (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Two illusory dreamholders appear within 30 feet of the dreamholder, and the dreamholder can then immediately teleport, switching places with one of the illusory duplicates. Physical interaction with the illusory dreamholder, such as hitting it with an attack, reveals it to be an illusion. A creature can use its action to make a {@dc 17} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|PHB}) check to inspect one dreamholder within 30 feet of it, determining if it's an illusion on a success. When the dreamholder uses an eye ray, all the illusions fire the same eye rays at the same target, and when it teleports, so too do the illusions. All the illusions disappear at the end of the dreamholder's next turn.

name: Drella Swoop
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

spellcasting.name: Touched
headerEntries: Drella knows the {@spell shocking grasp} cantrip. Charisma is her spellcasting ability for this cantrip (Spell attack {@hit 5}).

spellcasting.name: Songbird (Recharges after a Long Rest)
headerEntries: Drella casts the {@spell charm person} spell at 1st level without using a spell slot or somatic components. Charisma is her spellcasting ability for this spell (save {@dc 13}).

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Drella can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. She lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement and takes no falling damage. She cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

trait.name: Wing Flap
entries: As a bonus action, Drella can use her powerful feathered arms to propel herself upward up to half her movement speed. Drella can use this in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

trait.name: Cunning Action
entries: On each of her turns, Drella can use a bonus action to take the {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, or {@action Hide} action.

trait.name: Fated (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: Drella can choose to reroll any attack roll, ability check, or saving throw.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: Drella deals an extra 14 {@damage 4d6} damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Drella's that isn't {@condition incapacitated} and Drella doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Drella makes two dagger attacks. She can replace one of these attacks with a shocking grasp.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature they must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, becoming {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute on a failure. Drella has three {@condition poisoned} daggers on her person which she prepared ahead of time. The poison dries and becomes useless 1 hour after its application.

action.name: Shocking Grasp
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage. If the target is a creature, they can't take reactions until the start of Drella's next turn.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drowned maiden makes three Hair attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Draining Kiss.

action.name: Hair
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) slashing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}) if it is a Large or smaller creature. She can grapple up to three creatures at a time. The hair holding a creature can be attacked and destroyed (AC 15; 15 hp; immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage).

action.name: Draining Kiss
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the maiden and that she is grappling must make a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage, and its Strength is reduced by {@dice 1d6}. On a success, the target takes half the damage, and its Strength isn't reduced. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its Strength is reduced to 0.

action.name: Illusory Appearance
entries: The maiden covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like another creature of her general size and Humanoid shape. The illusion ends if the maiden takes a bonus action to end it or if she dies. The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to discern that the maiden is disguised.

bonus.name: Reel
entries: The drowned maiden pulls each creature {@condition grappled} by her up to 15 feet straight toward her.

name: Drowned Raider Vaettir
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Grave Goods Sense
entries: The drowned raider vættir can pinpoint the location of creatures wearing or carrying one of the vættr's personal items or grave goods within 60 feet of it, and the vættr can sense the general direction of its personal items and grave goods within 1 mile of it.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: A destroyed drowned raider vættir gains a new body in 24 hours, regaining all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and becoming active again. The new body forms in a random unoccupied space within 100 feet of where it fell. This trait doesn't function if the vættir is put to rest (typically by returning its remains to its burial mound).

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the drowned raider vaettir has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks and attack rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drowned raider vaettir makes two attacks using Battleaxe or Javelin in any combination.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Water Purge
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 12} Each creature in a 20-foot-long, 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The vampire casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}, +9 to spell attacks):

trait.name: Blood Sacrifice
entries: A creature with the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition also has the {@condition Helpless|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition against the vampire's attacks.

trait.name: Plasma Absorption
entries: Each time a creature takes damage from the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition while within 30 feet of the vampire, the vampire regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the damage dealt.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The vampire regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes three attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Draining Bite or Spellcasting.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Bloodthorn Whip
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 30 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d4}).

action.name: Draining Bite
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, or {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

action.name: Bloodroots {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the vampire. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The quori casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

trait.name: All-Around Vision
entries: The quori can't be {@status surprised|XPHB} while it isn't {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}.

trait.name: Aura of Fury
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, any creature that starts its turn in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the quori. {@actSaveFail} The target becomes enraged. While enraged, the target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all melee attack rolls, and all attack rolls made against the target have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The quori has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Track Hatred
entries: When the quori deals damage to any creature, it forms a psychic link with the target for 24 hours. During that time, the quori has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks to track the target. The quori can attempt to track the target at any range, even if it is on another plane of existence. Abilities such as the {@spell Pass Without Trace|XPHB} spell or the Ranger's Nature's Veil feature do not impede the quori's ability to track its target. The quori remains alert to danger even when it is tracking while traveling.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quori makes three Tentacle attacks.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 10 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 17}) from one of three tentacles. While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Fire damage and 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage at the start of each of the quori's turns.

action.name: Possession {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 16}, one Humanoid the quori can see within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target is possessed by the quori; the quori disappears and the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and loses control of its body. The quori now controls the body, but the target retains awareness. The quori can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that specifically target Aberrations. The quori's game statistics are the same, except it uses the possessed target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, as well as the target's Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or the quori leaves as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. When the possession ends, the quori appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this quori's {@variantrule Possession|XPHB} for 24 hours. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this quori's {@variantrule Possession|XPHB} for 24 hours.

action.name: Recall Agony {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, one creature the quori can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 67 ({@damage 15d8}) Psychic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

reaction.name: Incite Fury
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature under the effects of the quori's Aura of Fury targets the quori with an attack. {@actResponse} The target attacks another creature of the quori's choice within the targets range.

trait.name: Baleful Glare
entries: When a creature that can see the eyes of the dullahan's severed head starts its turn within 30 feet of the dullahan, the dullahan can force it to make a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw if the dullahan isn't {@condition incapacitated} and can see the creature. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition frightened} until the start of its next turn. While {@condition frightened} in this way, the creature must take the Dash action and move away from the dullahan by the safest available route. A doomed creature that fails this saving throw is {@condition restrained} while {@condition frightened} instead.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the dullahan until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the dullahan in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

trait.name: Relentless Advance
entries: Moving through difficult terrain doesn't cost the dullahan extra movement, and the dullahan can move across the surface of water as if it were harmless, solid ground.

trait.name: Relentless Nature
entries: The dullahan doesn't require food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dullahan makes three Spine Whip or Necrotic Bolt attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Seal the Doom.

action.name: Spine Whip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition prone} as it is wracked with pain.

action.name: Necrotic Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Seal the Doom
entries: The dullahan points at a creature doomed by Deathly Doom within 40 feet of it that it can see. The creature must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target immediately drops to 0 hp if it is below half its hp maximum. On a success, the target is immune to the dullahan's Seal the Doom for the next 24 hours.

bonus.name: Deathly Doom
entries: The dullahan magically dooms a creature for 1 hour. It can have only one creature doomed at a time. If it dooms another, the effect on the previous target ends. The dullahan knows the direction to the doomed creature as long as both are on the same plane of existence.

trait.name: Adhesive (Object or Terrain Form Only)
entries: The dune mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A creature adhered to the dune mimic is also {@condition grappled} by it (escape {@dc 15}). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage. The dune mimic can harden its outer surface, so only the creatures it chooses are affected by this trait.

trait.name: False Appearance (Object or Terrain Form Only)
entries: While the dune mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary sandy object or terrain feature.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The dune mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature {@condition grappled} by it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dune mimic makes three Pseudopod attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Engulf.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the dune mimic is in object or terrain form, the target is subjected to the mimic's Adhesive trait.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The dune mimic engulfs a Large or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by it. The engulfed target is {@condition blinded}, {@condition restrained}, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the mimic's turns or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) slashing damage, as the creature is lacerated by the mimic's sand-coated form. If the mimic moves, any engulfed creatures move with it. The mimic can have no more than two creatures engulfed at a time.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The dune mimic transforms into a Huge sand- or gravel-covered object, shapes itself into a sandy or rocky terrain feature no larger than a 20-foot cube or transforms back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The guide can see up to 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the guide is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the guide instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Spirit Hand
entries: The guide can cast {@spell mage hand} at will, requiring no verbal or somatic components. The guide can cast this spell and control the hand as a bonus action, and when the guide casts the spell, it can make the hand {@condition invisible}.

trait.name: Stunning Strike (1/Turn)
entries: When the guide hits a creature with a melee attack, it can force the target to make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is {@condition stunned} until the end of the guide's next turn.

trait.name: Supernatural Attacks
entries: The guide's weapon attacks are magical, and its Spirit Strike can hit targets on the Ethereal Plane.

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While the guide is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The guide makes three attacks.

action.name: Spirit Strike
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) force damage.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Deflect Missile
entries: In response to being hit by a ranged weapon attack, the guide deflects the missile. The damage it takes from the attack is reduced by 18 ({@dice 1d10 + 13}). If the damage is reduced to 0, the guide catches the missile if it's small enough to hold in one hand and the guide has a hand free. It can then make a ranged weapon attack with the caught missile, which has an attack bonus of {@d20 +5}, a normal range of 20 feet, and a long range of 60 feet. On a hit, the target takes 6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) damage of the missile's type.

trait.name: Spirit Hand
entries: The initiate can cast {@spell mage hand} at will, requiring no verbal or somatic components. The initiate can cast this spell and control the hand as a bonus action, and when the initiate casts the spell, it can make the hand {@condition invisible}.

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While the initiate is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The initiate makes two attacks.

action.name: Spirit Strike
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) force damage.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the leader is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the leader instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Spirit Hand
entries: The leader can cast {@spell mage hand} at will, requiring no verbal or somatic components. The leader can cast this spell and control the hand as a bonus action, and when the leader casts the spell, it can make the hand {@condition invisible}.

trait.name: Stunning Strike (1/Turn)
entries: When the leader hits a creature with a melee attack, it can force the target to make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is {@condition stunned} until the end of the leader's next turn.

trait.name: Supernatural Attacks
entries: The leader's weapon attacks are magical, and its Spirit Strike can hit targets on the Ethereal Plane.

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While the leader is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

trait.name: Invisibility (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the leader can magically turn {@condition invisible} until the start of its next turn, or until it makes an attack or casts a spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The leader makes four attacks.

action.name: Spirit Strike
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) force damage.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Deflect Missile
entries: When the leader is hit by a ranged weapon attack, it deflects the missile, reducing the damage by 26 ({@dice 1d10 + 21}). If the damage is reduced to 0, the leader catches the missile if it's small enough to hold in one hand and the leader has a hand free. It can then make a ranged weapon attack with the caught missile, which has an attack bonus of {@d20 +8}, a normal range of 20 feet, and a long range of 60 feet. On a hit, the target takes 9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) damage of the missile's type.

reaction.name: Phase (5/Day)
entries: When the leader is hit by an attack, it partially slips into the Border Ethereal, reducing the damage it takes from the attack by 16 ({@dice 2d10 + 5}).

variant.name: Durheim Leader with Lightseer's Gaze
entries: The {@item lightseer's gaze|GriffonsSaddlebag2} is a precious and heavily guarded artifact within Durheim Monastery, originally worn by Lightseer Attiskin. He left explicit provision that only in times of dire need should the mantle of Lightseer be taken up. Wearing the {@item lightseer's gaze|GriffonsSaddlebag2} causes {@condition blinded|PHB|blindness}, but the stars and celestial bodies in the heavens are still visible. The mysterious item also rewrites history, forcing the bearer to select a new name - only the bearer is aware that they ever had a different name.
At the GM's discretion, a Durheim Leader can wield the {@item lightseer's gaze|GriffonsSaddlebag2}, causing the following changes to its stat block:

items: It has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks.
It has {@sense blindsight} out to a range of 120 feet, but is blind beyond this radius.
It gains the Innate Spellcasting trait below.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The leader's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 17}). The leader can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:
2/day: {@spell spirit guardians}
4/day: {@spell calm emotions}

name: Durixaviinox

trait.name: Frosted Resistance (3/Day)
entries: When Durixaviinox fails a saving throw, he can succeed instead. When he does, his speed is halved and he can't take the Disengage action until the end of his next turn.

trait.name: Hoarfrost
entries: Cold damage dealt by Durixaviinox ignores damage resistance.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: Durixaviinox can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost him extra movement.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Durixaviinox makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage, and the target can't take reactions until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) slashing damage, and Durixaviinox can move the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

action.name: Numbing Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Durixaviinox exhales a freezing blast in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 42 ({@damage 12d6}) cold damage and is {@condition restrained} until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition restrained}.

bonus.name: Icy Grip
entries: Durixaviinox encases a creature he can see within 60 feet of him in ice. The target must make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) cold damage and is {@condition restrained}. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition restrained}. A creature can use an action to break themself or another creature they can reach out of the ice, ending the {@condition restrained} condition.

reaction.name: Withering Frost
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of Durixaviinox hits him with an attack, Durixaviinox releases a burst of cold energy. Each creature within 5 feet of him must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage.

legendaryHeader: Durixaviinox has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Raging Blizzard
entries: Durixaviinox beats his wings, and frigid winds and hail swirl around him. Each creature within 120 feet of him must make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage, is pushed 60 feet directly away from Durixaviinox, and is knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed or knocked {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Action 2: Royal Defense
entries: Durixaviinox calls the faithful soul of a spectral guard to fight at his side. The guard uses the frost giant wind sprinter stat block, but they are an Undead instead of a Giant. The guard acts immediately after Durixaviinox and follows his verbal commands. While the guard is within 60 feet of Durixaviinox, Durixaviinox gains resistance to all damage. If Durixaviinox dies, the guard is destroyed.

legendary.name: Action 3: Frost Cataclysm
entries: Durixaviinox releases a pulse of frigid energy followed by a shock wave of force in a 120-foot-radius sphere centered on him. Each enemy in that area must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 45 ({@damage 10d8}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Immediately after, each enemy in that area must make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw, taking 45 ({@damage 10d8}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: The dusktail has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

trait.name: Resilience
entries: The dusktail has advantage on saving throws made to resist being {@condition poisoned}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h} {@damage 1} piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The dryad casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The dryad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
entries: The dryad can communicate with beasts and plants as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Tree Stride
entries: Once on her turn, the dryad can use 10 feet of her movement to step magically into one dead tree within her reach and emerge from a second dead tree within 60 feet of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large or bigger.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The duskthorn dryad makes two Thorned Slam or Thorn attacks.

action.name: Thorned Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Thorn
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d4 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Children of the Forest (1/Day)
entries: The dryad magically calls {@dice 1d4} boars, constrictor snakes, or wolves, or it calls 1 child of the briar.
