The called creatures arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of the dryad and obeying her spoken commands. The creatures remain for 1 hour, until the dryad dies, or until the dryad dismisses them as a bonus action.

trait.name: Twisted
entries: When the dust goblin attacks a creature from hiding, the target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Like the Wind
entries: The Dust Bunny's movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

action.name: Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 0} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Dust Kick
entries: The Dust Bunny kicks up dust at a creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition Incapacitated} and begin sneezing uncontrollably until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Jump
entries: The Dust Bunny disappears in a poof of dust, teleporting up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The dwarven ringmage casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: The dwarven ringmage has advantage on saving throws against poison.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dwarven ringmage can use its Ring Magic. It then makes three Ring Staff attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Ring Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (the ringmage's choice).

action.name: Ring Magic
entries: The dwarven ringmage draws circles of magic in the air and sends them toward one creature it can see within 30 feet of it, causing one of the following effects:

items.name: Rings of Binding
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} by magical rings until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Rings of Bravery
entries: The target can't be {@condition frightened} and has advantage on melee weapon attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Rings of Protection
entries: The target has a +2 bonus to its Armor Class until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Rings of Retribution
entries: When any creature hits the target before the start of the ringmage's next turn, the creature takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (the ringmage's choice).

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The dyra can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: Whenever the dyra takes damage while grappling a creature, the creature {@condition grappled} by it also takes half the damage the dyra took.

trait.name: Lightning Susceptibility
entries: If the dyra takes lightning damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of its next turn, and if it's grappling a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or the grapple ends.

trait.name: Metal Stride
entries: While moving on a metallic object, structure, or surface, the dyra's speed is doubled.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The dyra can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dyra makes two pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, the dyra can't constrict another target, and the target takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Electrical Overload
entries: If the dyra takes 25 lightning damage or more during a single turn, it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition paralyzed} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The dyra is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The dyra's weapon attacks are considered magical.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The dyra deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dyra uses its Electrostatic Discharge, if available. It then makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Electrostatic Discharge {@recharge 5}
entries: The dyra expels a burst of electricity in a 15-foot radius around itself. Each creature other than the dyra in the area must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) lightning damage and is {@condition stunned} until the end of the dyra's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition stunned}.

reaction.name: Voltaic Grounding
entries: When the dyra is subjected to lightning damage, it makes a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, it takes no damage instead and its Electrostatic Discharge immediately recharges if it wasn't already charged.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The eala makes two Wing Blades attacks.

action.name: Wing Blades
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The eala breathes fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The eala's fire breath ignites flammable objects and melts soft metals, such as gold and lead, in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

reaction.name: Swan Song
entries: When the eala is reduced to 0 hp, it can use its last breath to sing a plaintive and beautiful melody. Each creature within 20 feet of it that can hear the eala must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition incapacitated} until the end of its next turn. While {@condition incapacitated}, the creature's speed is reduced to 0.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The elemental can burrow through mundane, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn't disturb the material they move through. While they use Earth Glide, the elemental can't be used as a mount.

action.name: Signature Attack (Slam)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} bludgeoning damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Stretch Attack (2 Ferocity)
entries: The elemental makes a signature attack with a reach of 10 feet. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} damage, and the elemental can pull the target 5 feet toward them.

action.name: 3rd Level: Earthshaker (5 Ferocity)
entries: The elemental strikes the ground, and each creature within 10 feet of them must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. The elemental's caregiver automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

action.name: 5th Level: Transmute Ground (8 Ferocity)
entries: The elemental picks a 10-foot-square area of ground they can see within 30 feet of them. Each creature standing in the area must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength saving throw or partially sink into the ground and become {@condition restrained}. A creature can use their action to make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, freeing themself or another creature within their reach on a success and ending the {@condition restrained} condition for the freed creature.

bonus.name: Toss Me
entries: While the elemental is within 5 feet of their caregiver, they can hurl the caregiver 5 × PB feet in any direction, including up. If the caregiver would normally take damage from a fall after being thrown, they can negate the damage with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the spark takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the spark takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Trampling Rampage
entries: If an enemy who is touching the ground starts their turn within 5 feet of two or more earth sparks, the enemy must make a Strength saving throw with a DC equal to 12 plus the number of earth sparks within 5 feet of the enemy. On a failed save, the enemy falls {@condition prone}, and they can't stand up until there are fewer than two earth sparks within 5 feet of them.

action.name: Shatter Smash (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Snort Rocks (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 bludgeoning damage. If the target is a flying creature, they must succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. The DC for this saving throw equals 12 plus the number of sparks who joined the attack.

name: Eater of Dust
languages: and Void Speech but can't speak

trait.name: Magic Maw
entries: The eater of dust's Maw-Arm attacks are magical. When the eater hits with its Maw-Arm, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 3d8} necrotic damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The eater of dust regains 5 hp at the start of its turn. If it takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of eater's next turn. The eater dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The eater of dust makes one Maw-Arm attack and two Necrotic Blast attacks, or it makes three Necrotic Blast attacks.

action.name: Maw-Arm
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) piercing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or its hp maximum is reduced by amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the eater regains hp equal to that amount. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

action.name: Necrotic Burst
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d8 + 3}) necrotic damage.

bonus.name: Hungry Step
entries: The eater of dust magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of a creature that isn't a Construct or Undead.

trait.name: Customized Poison
entries: The assassin prepares and applies specialized poisons to its weapons. The first time each turn that the assassin deals weapon damage to a creature, choose one of the following:

items.name: Abduction
items.entry: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. The condition ends if the target takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it. {@actSaveSuccess} The target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Annihilation
items.entry: The target takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Poison damage.

items.name: Debilitation
items.entry: The target takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) Poison damage, and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of the assassin's next turn.

items.name: Suffocation
items.entry: The target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. While {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} in this way, the target can't speak or breathe.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the assassin is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the assassin instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The assassin makes three attacks using its Daggers or one attack using its Heavy Crossbow.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 4d4 + 5}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 9} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: The assassin takes the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

reaction.name: Smoke Bomb (2/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} The assassin takes damage from another creature. {@actResponse} The assassin creates smoke in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}. The area becomes {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB} for 1 minute or until dispersed by a strong wind. As part of this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, the assassin can move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and take the {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The enforcer makes two attacks using their Dagger and Fighting Chain in any combination.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Fighting Chain
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 12}). The enforcer can only have one creature grappled by its fighting chain.

bonus.name: Strangle
entries: The enforcer deals 4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage to a target {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by its {@item Fighting Chain|GrimHollowPG24}, and the target is unable to speak until the start of the enforcer's next turn or until it is no longer {@condition Grappled|XPHB}.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The edimmu can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If destroyed, an edimmu rises again in {@dice 2d4} days, regaining all its hp and becoming active again. When the edimmu rises, it appears within 5 feet of its remains. Only burying its mortal remains in consecrated or hallowed ground prevents this trait from functioning.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The edimmu doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Water Siphon
entries: The edimmu has advantage on attack rolls against creatures made of or gaining power from magical water, such as water elementals, water jinnborn, water genies, and sorcerers with water-based origins. In addition, such creatures have disadvantage on the saving throw against the edimmu's Draining Touch and Multiattack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The edimmu makes two Draining Touch attacks. If both attacks hit one creature that isn't a Construct or Undead, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of {@condition exhaustion}. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is also {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Draining Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest after drinking 1 pint of water. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The eel hound can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The eel hound has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the hound's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). Until this grapple ends, the creature is {@condition restrained}, and the hound can't Bite another target.

action.name: Slick Spittle
entries: The eel hound covers the ground in a 5-foot square centered on a point it can see within 10 feet of it with its slippery spittle. Each creature standing in that area must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. The spittle remains on the ground for 1 minute.

bonus.name: Water Step
entries: The eel hound teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. The origin and destination spaces must contain enough water to partially submerge the hound.

trait.name: Altered Reality
entries: The cnidarian has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition for creatures {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by it.

trait.name: Hallucinogenic Bioluminescence
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the cnidarian and can see it is subjected to the following effect unless the cnidarian chooses otherwise. {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition (save ends). While {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, the target regards all other creatures as enemies except the cnidarian, whom it regards as an ally.

Whenever the target makes an attack or casts a detrimental spell, it must choose its target at random from the creatures it can see within range. If a creature provokes an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action from the target, it must make the attack, if able. If the target ends its turn without taking an Attack or {@action Magic|XPHB} action, it takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage.

Unless {@status surprised|XPHB}, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against the cnidarian until the start of its next turn. If the creature looks at the cnidarian in the meantime, that creature must immediately make the saving throw.

trait.name: Neon Illumination
entries: The cnidarian sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 30-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 30 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cnidarian makes two Tendrils attacks.

action.name: Tendrils
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 10 ft. {@h}27 ({@damage 6d8}) Necrotic damage, or 48 Necrotic damage if the target is {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by the cnidarian.

reaction.name: Reflexive Flash
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the cnidarian can see within 30 feet deals damage to it. {@actResponse d}{@actSave con} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the cnidarian that can see it. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Radiant damage and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

name: Eikthyrnir
languages: Understands Common, Dwarven, Elvish, and the Northern Tongue, but cannot speak

action.name: Ram
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d12 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Necrotic damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, and the eikthyrnir moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Piercing damage and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: Grasping Thorns
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 15} A Large or smaller creature within 30 feet is pulled adjacent to the eikthyrnir and has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (Escape {@dc 15}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Battle Frenzy
entries: The einherjar has advantage on all attack rolls it makes while it is below 30 hp.

trait.name: Fearsome Gaze
entries: The stare of an einherjar is especially piercing to Humanoids. It has advantage on any Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check it makes against a Humanoid.

trait.name: Runic Weapons
entries: The einherjar's weapon attacks are magical. When the einherjar hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 3d8} radiant damage (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The einherjar makes two Battleaxe attacks, or it makes three Celestial Bolt attacks. It can replace one attack with Celestial Blessing, if available.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage, or 9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Celestial Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d8 + 2}) radiant damage.

action.name: Celestial Blessing {@recharge 5}
entries: The einherjar calls on its celestial patrons for one of the following blessings:

items.name: Odin's Strength
entries: The einherjar roars a battle prayer to Odin. Each friendly creature within 60 feet of the einherjar and that can hear the prayer deals an extra 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage when it hits with any weapon. In addition, when an affected creature makes an attack roll, the creature can roll a {@dice d6} and add the number rolled to the attack roll.

items.name: Valkyries' Mercy
entries: The einherjar pleads for the assistance of the valkyries to save one friendly creature it can see within 60 feet of it that has been reduced to 0 hp. The creature regains 13 {@dice 3d8} hp. Once the einherjar has aided a creature with Valkyries' Mercy, it can't target that creature with Valkyries' Mercy again until the creature finishes a long rest.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Dragon Frog fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Removal
entries: When a creature or object becomes enclosed within the Dragon Frog's mouth, any spell of 6th level or lower on the target ends.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The Dragon Frog's long jump is up to 90 feet and its high jump is up to 45 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Dragon Frog makes three attacks: one with its Chomp and two with its Claws.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) piercing damage, and the target is swallowed if it is a Large or smaller creature. A swallowed creature is {@condition Blinded} and {@condition Restrained}, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the Dragon Frog, and takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the Dragon Frog's turns.

The Dragon Frog can hold up to three creatures in its mouth at a time. If the Dragon Frog takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the Dragon Frog must succeed on a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which enters an empty space within 10 feet of the Dragon Frog. If the Dragon Frog dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition Restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 1d10 + 8}) slashing damage.

action.name: Croak {@recharge 5}
entries: The Dragon Frog lets out a ground-shaking croak that warps the environment in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 66 ({@damage 12d10}) thunder damage and is pushed 15 feet away from the Dragon Frog. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.
If the Dragon Frog has any creatures in its mouth when it uses its Croak, they all fall {@condition Prone} in unoccupied spaces within 15 feet of the Dragon Frog.

legendary.name: Claw
entries: The Dragon Frog makes a Claw attack.

legendary.name: Leap
entries: The Dragon Frog leaps into the air before slamming back down to the ground. Each creature within 30 feet of the Dragon Frog when it lands must succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition Prone}.

legendary.name: Pulling Tongue (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Dragon Frog lashes out its tongue at a Huge or smaller creature or object it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target is a creature, it is pulled to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the Dragon Frog, unless it succeeds on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw; the Dragon Frog can then make a Chomp attack against it as part of this same action. If the target is an object, it enters the Dragon Frog's mouth; if the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature must succeed on a contested Strength check or have the object pulled away from it.

name: Elder Lava Wurm
languages: and Terran but can't speak them

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The wurm can hold its breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Limited Flight
entries: The wurm can only fly for up to 1 minute at a time. If it ends its turn in the air after 1 minute of consecutive flight and nothing else is holding it aloft, it falls.

trait.name: Noxious Resilience
entries: The wurm has advantage on saving throws made against harmful gases and vapors (such as the effects of a stinking cloud or a green dragon's poison breath).

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The wurm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Volcanic Body
entries: The wurm sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. In addition, whenever a creature enters the area within 10 feet of the wurm for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wurm makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Molten Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: The wurm exhales molten metal in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 38 ({@damage 11d6}) fire damage and its speed is reduced by 15 feet. If a target's speed is reduced to 0 by this effect, it becomes {@condition restrained}. A creature can take an action to scrape or wash off the metal, ending the effect. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and its speed isn't reduced.

trait.name: Shadow Sight
entries: The drake has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks made while in dim light or darkness, and magical darkness doesn't impede the drake's darkvision.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elder shadow drake makes one Bite attack and two Tail Slap attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail Slap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The drake magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks, uses Shadow Step, or starts its turn in sunlight, or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the drake wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it. The drake must be in dim light or darkness to use this action.

action.name: Stygian Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The elder shadow drake spits a ball of black liquid on a point the dragon can see within 60 feet of it. The ball bursts into a 20-foot-radius sphere of black mist centered on that point for 1 minute. Each creature in the mist when it appears must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 42 ({@damage 12d6}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The mist spreads around corners, and its area is magical darkness. No natural light can illuminate the mist. If any of the mist overlaps with an area of light created by a spell of 1st level or lower, the spell creating the light is dispelled.

bonus.name: Shadow Step
entries: The drake teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. The origin and destination spaces must be in dim light or darkness.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The elder thing casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The elder thing has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elder thing makes up to two Grasping Tentacle attacks and uses Spellcasting.

action.name: Grasping Tentacle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, Reach 20 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 18}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB} the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

action.name: At Will:
entries: {@spell Charm Person|XPHB}, {@spell Scorching Ray|XPHB}, {@spell Thunderwave|XPHB}.
1/day: {@spell Cone of Cold|XPHB}, {@spell Fear|XPHB}, {@spell Ice Storm|XPHB}.

bonus.name: Surgical Eye
entries: The elder thing assesses the anatomy of a creature it can see within 30 ft. and makes a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Medicine}) check. If it succeeds, its attacks against the target are critical hits on die rolls of 18 or higher for the next minute or until it uses Surgical Eye against a different target. If the elder thing succeeds on this check a second time against the same creature, its attacks against the target are instead critical hits on die rolls of 16 or higher for the next minute or until it uses Surgical Eye against a different target.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The elder thing makes a Grasping Tentacle attack.

legendary.name: Ghoulish Study
entries: The elder thing uses Surgical Eye.

legendary.name: Sudden Movement
entries: The elder thing moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

items.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) Slashing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Eldrick Runeweaver is a 20th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 19}, {@hit 11} to hit with spell attacks). He can cast shield and invisibility at will and has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Eldrick Runeweaver wears a {@item robe of the archmagi}, carries a {@item staff of power}, and wears a {@item ring of spell storing}. He carries {@dice 2d6} {@filter very rare spell scrolls and potions|items|type=potion;scroll|rarity=very rare}.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Eldrick Runeweaver fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Eldrick Runeweaver has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Staff of Power
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

legendary.name: Cantrip
entries: Eldrick Runeweaver casts a cantrip.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: Eldrick Runeweaver teleports 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 actions)
entries: Eldrick Runeweaver casts a spell using a spell slot.

hp.special: 75 (10d8 + 30) plus 75 (10d8 + 30) per player character

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (1/Round)
headerEntries: Eldrick casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 21}, +13 to spell attacks):

2e: {@spell Bigby's Hand|XPHB} (Eldrick may use an {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} to control the hand once per round)

spellcasting.name: Greater Spellcasting (1/Round)
headerEntries: Eldrick casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 21}, +13 to spell attacks):

trait.name: Academy Rings (1/Day)
entries: Eldrick can cast a spell from Spellcasting without expending a use of it.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Eldrick has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Warding Aura
entries: Eldrick projects a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of warding magic. The first time on each turn that a creature within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} deals damage or casts a spell on Eldrick, that creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Force damage and is pushed 10 feet away from Eldrick.

action.name: Eldrick always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On his turn, Eldrick can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Eldrick takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

action.name: Prismatic Blast
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 15}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (Eldrick's choice).

action.name: Teleport
entries: Eldrick teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet.

action.name: Chain Lightning {@recharge 5}
entries: Eldrick casts {@spell Chain Lightning|XPHB}, using the spellcasting ability in Spellcasting.

action.name: Dispel Magic (1/Round)
entries: Eldrick casts {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB}, using the spellcasting ability in Spellcasting.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: Eldrick chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. Eldrick can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

reaction.name: Counterspell
entries: Eldrick casts {@spell Counterspell|XPHB} in response to that spell's trigger, using the spellcasting ability from Spellcasting.

trait.name: Air Form
entries: The eldritch cataclysm can enter a {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

trait.name: Cyclonic Storm
entries: The eldritch cataclysm emits a 120-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of high winds that disperse gases and vapors and extinguish unprotected flames. Ranged attacks that pass through the area have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}. Objects that are not worn or carried are blown away {@dice 1d6 x 5} feet in a random direction. A creature that starts its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave str} {@dc 17} (flying creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}). {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of its next turn. Failure by 5 or More: The target is flung {@dice 1d6 x 5} feet in a random direction, landing with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The eldritch cataclysm uses Chain Lighting or Icy Bolt, then uses Meteor Stike or Quake.

action.name: Chain Lightning
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 12}, range 120 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) Lightning damage, the target has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the cataclysm's next turn, and the lightning leaps to another creature of the cataclysm's choice within 15 feet of the first target. The cataclysm makes a separate {@spell Chain Lightning|XPHB} attack against the target. The cataclysm can make any number of {@spell Chain Lightning|XPHB} attacks in this way, but a creature can be targeted only once each time the cataclysm takes this action.

action.name: Icy Bolt
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 12}, range 120 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) Cold damage. {@hom}The target and each creature within 5 feet of it are subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Cold damage, and the target has the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dc 17}).

action.name: Meteor Strike
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 15-foot radius, 40-foot tall {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point the cataclysm can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Fire damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Quake
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the cataclysm. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Thunder damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The eldritch crawler is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The eldritch crawler may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the eldritch crawler can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the eldritch crawler has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Alien Intellect
entries: The eldritch crawler is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the eldritch crawler's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Insectoid Limbs
entries: The eldritch crawler can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check. It ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 12}, one target within 5 ft. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Contaminated Venom
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 12}, one target within 40 feet. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Void Walker
entries: The eldritch crawler climbs through a tear in reality, traveling from the Material Plane to the Space Between Worlds or vice versa.

reaction.name: Fractured Reality
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature misses the eldritch crawler with an attack. {@actResponse} The eldritch crawler teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet, briefly leaving behind a fractured image of itself being hit by the attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The dreg casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dreg makes two Psychic Blast attacks.

action.name: Psychic Blast
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) Psychic damage and the dreg pushes the target 10 feet straight away from itself.

action.name: Synaptic Shock {@recharge}
entries: The dreg unleashes a storm of psychic energy in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 60 feet of it. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 13} Intelligence saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage and has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

bonus.name: Hazewarp Hex
entries: The dreg chooses a creature it can see within 60 feet of it and one of the following conditions: {@condition Addled|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, {@condition Clumsy|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, {@condition Enfeebled|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, or {@condition Sickened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}. {@actSave cha} {@dc 13}, the targeted creature. {@actSaveFail} The target becomes cursed by the dreg for one minute or until the dreg dies or uses this ability again. While cursed in this manner, a creature becomes vulnerable to Psychic damage and gains the chosen condition (sane ends). {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to the dreg's Hazewarp Hex for 24 hours.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The herald is a 12th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Otherworldly Calm
entries: The eldritch herald has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}. Also, attempts to read the herald's thoughts fail. The creature making the attempt must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Handaxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Prophecy of Doom (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The eldritch herald chooses a point it can see within 120 feet of it and rolls on the Eldritch Effects table. Each creature within 15 feet of that point must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be subjected to an eldritch effect for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The eldritch priest is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:

action.name: Greatclub
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Prophecy of Doom (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The eldritch priest chooses a point it can see within 120 feet of it and rolls on the Eldritch Effects table. Each creature within 15 feet of that point must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be subjected to an eldritch effect for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The trickster casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}, +5 to spell attacks):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The trickster makes two Psychic Blade attacks.

action.name: Psychic Blade
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) Psychic damage.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: The trickster takes the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The troll regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Force or Psychic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes two Claw attacks and one Bite attack. It can replace its Bite attack with Corrupting Blast if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) Piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Corrupting Blast {@recharge 5}
entries: The troll blasts a corrupting beam at a point it can see within 300 feet. {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, all creatures in a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on that point. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage and gains a level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Forced Mutation
entries: The troll is so contaminated that it changes form constantly, growing new appendages or exploding out of its old skin into a new form. The troll may manifest one of the following mutations. The mutation stays in effect until a new one is chosen.

bonus.name: Grotesque Wings
entries: The troll gains a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to is {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, but it falls if it ends its turn in the air.

bonus.name: Cyclopean Eye
entries: Corrupting Blast now recharges on a 4-6, and the troll gains Truesight 30 ft.

bonus.name: Extra Arms
entries: The troll can make two additional Claw attacks as part of the Multiattack action.

bonus.name: Spider Legs
entries: The troll gains a {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB} equal to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

bonus.name: Reflective Flesh
entries: The troll has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition until it makes an attack.

bonus.name: Crystalized Carapace
entries: The troll's {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} becomes 20.

trait.name: Elemental Nature
entries: The elemental locus doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Immortal
entries: If the elemental locus dies, it returns to life in {@dice 1d12} months, regaining all its hp and becoming active again. The new body appears in a space of the locus's choice within its bound land. Only a {@spell wish} spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

trait.name: Land Bound
entries: The elemental locus is bound to an area of land or ocean no larger than 100 square miles. If it leaves this region, it loses its Spawn Elemental action. If it remains outside the region, it automatically teleports back to the center of this area after 24 hours, regardless of distance.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The elemental locus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The elemental locus deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Unstoppable
entries: Moving through difficult terrain doesn't cost the elemental locus extra movement, and its speed can't be reduced.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental locus makes three Slam attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spawn Elemental.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}31 ({@damage 5d8 + 9}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Spawn Elemental
entries: The elemental locus magically creates up to {@dice 2d6} mephits or 1 Elemental with a challenge rating of 5 or lower. The Elementals arrive at the start of the locus's next turn, acting as allies of the locus and obeying its spoken commands. The locus can create only Elementals that share an element with a terrain feature comprising at least 100,000 square feet of the locus's bound land. For example, a desert-bound locus can't create a water-based Elemental, unless its bound desert contains an oasis or other source of water around the size of a small pond. The Elementals remain for 1 hour, until the locus dies, or until the locus dismisses them as a bonus action. The locus can have any number of Elementals under its control at one time, provided the combined total CR of the Elementals is no higher than 8.

action.name: Smack
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) damage of the type associated with the spirit.

action.name: Duplicate (1/Day)
entries: The spirit casts the {@spell Duplicate|ObojimaTallGrass} spell (spell save {@dc 10}), using Intelligence as its spellcasting ability, requiring no material components

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The vampire regains 25 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. If the vampire takes radiant damage, it regains 10 hit points from the next use of this trait instead.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The vampire has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: The vampire has the following flaws:

items.name: Forbiddance
items.entry: The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

items.name: Stake to the Heart
items.entry: The vampire dies if a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into its heart while it is {@condition incapacitated} in its resting place.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes three attacks, only one of which can be a bite.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, the vampire can grapple the target (escape {@dc 19}).

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage and 17 ({@damage 5d6}) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains hit points equal to that amount. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried rises the following night as a vampire spawn under this vampire's control.

action.name: Fey Majesty
entries: The vampire targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see or hear the vampire, the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition charmed}. The {@condition charmed} target regards the vampire as a friend to be heeded and protected. Although not under the vampire's control, it takes the vampire's requests in the most favorable way and is a willing target for the vampire's bite.

While the target is {@condition charmed}, the vampire can communicate with the target telepathically within 300 feet. The vampire can use a bonus action to force the target to repeat the saving throw. If the save fails, the vampire can render the creature full of despair (disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls) or confused (as the {@spell confusion} spell) for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the despair or confusion on itself on a success.

Each time the vampire or the vampire's allies do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the vampire dies, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

action.name: Mist Form
entries: The vampire polymorphs into a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form. Anything it wears or carries transforms with it. While in mist form, the vampire can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 30 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, but it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws. A vampire in mist form is immune to nonmagical damage, except damage from sunlight, and has resistance to damage other than radiant. The vampire reverts to its true form if it dies.

reaction.name: Misty Escape
entries: When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, the vampire transforms into its Mist Form instead of falling {@condition unconscious}. If the vampire can't transform, it dies.

While it has 0 hit points in mist form, the vampire dies if it takes damage three times or radiant damage once. It can't willingly revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or die. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then {@condition paralyzed} until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.

legendary.name: Move and Claw
entries: The vampire moves up to its speed and attacks once with its claws.

legendary.name: Bite (2 Actions)
entries: The vampire makes one bite attack.

legendary.name: Purify Blood (2 Actions)
entries: Even if the vampire can't take actions, one condition ends on it.

action.name: Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) bludgeoning damage.

name: Elora Quickwit
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Elora can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. She lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement, and takes no falling damage. Elora can't glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

trait.name: Talons
entries: Elora has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface her talons could reasonably grip.

trait.name: Convincing
entries: Elora has advantage on all Charisma checks made to convince someone of her knowledge of anything pertaining to the {@skill History} skill.

trait.name: Cunning Action
entries: Elora can use a bonus action to take the {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, or {@action Hide} action.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: Elora deals an extra 10 {@damage 3d6} damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Elora's that isn't {@condition incapacitated} and Elora doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Elora makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Uncanny Dodge (3/Day)
entries: Elora halves the damage from an attack that hits her. Elora must be able to see the attacker.

trait.name: Beast Hunter
entries: The elvish veteran archer has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks to track Beasts and on Intelligence ({@skill Nature}) checks to recall information about Beasts.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The elvish veteran archer has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put the archer to sleep.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: The elvish veteran archer has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

trait.name: Point Blank Hunter
entries: A longbow deals one extra die of its damage when the archer hits with it (included in the attack). In addition, when the archer makes a ranged attack with a longbow, it doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll from being within 5 feet of a hostile creature, though it may still have disadvantage from other sources.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elvish veteran archer makes three Shortsword attacks or two Longbow attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the archer can pin part of the target's clothing or body to the ground or to a nearby wall or tree. If it does so, the target is {@condition restrained}. A creature, including the target, can take its action to remove the arrow and free the {@condition restrained} target by succeeding on a {@dc 14} Strength check.

action.name: Arrow Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: The elvish veteran archer fires a flurry of arrows in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Emaciated Tavern Mimic Brain

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The brain is a 5th-level spellcaster and can cast the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Central Nervous System
entries: The mimic's brain is the central nervous system of the tavern mimic. The first time the brain takes damage on a turn, it takes an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) psychic damage. As a reaction to taking this damage, the brain can relocate itself to any location within the tavern.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The brain has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the brain fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Sensitive Gut
entries: The brain's blindsight extends throughout its interior structure.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The brain can use its action to polymorph into a different building or back into its true, tavern form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment or creatures it is wearing or carrying aren't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Warded
entries: The brain can't be harmed or affected by attacks or effects that originate from outside of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The brain makes two attacks, one with its Pseudopod and one with its Squirt.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Squirt
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) acid damage.

legendaryHeader: The brain can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The brain regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The brain makes one attack.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The brain casts a spell.

legendary.name: Immune Response (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: A torrent of pus gushes from a 10-foot-radius area of the brain's ceiling. Each creature directly under that area must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The roc has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Searing Presence
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the roc takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The roc sheds bright light in a 40-foot radius and dim light for an additional 40 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The roc makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d8 + 8}) piercing damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d6 + 8}) slashing damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Inferno {@recharge 5}
entries: The roc beats its wings, creating a swirling conflagration. Each creature within 30 feet of the roc must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Echolocation
entries: The Emberbat can't use its blindsight while {@condition deafened}.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The Emberbat has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing.

trait.name: Ember Flame
entries: The emberbat can create a flame from its nose at will. It sheds bright light in a 5-foot-radius and dim light in another 5 feet beyond this. This effect lasts until it is dismissed, which the emberbat can do at anytime. When lit, the flame also provides a small damage boost to the emberbat's bite (already included in stat block).

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 0} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage plus 1 fire damage.

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The emerald eye doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The emerald eye is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Psychically Bound
entries: The emerald eye must be psychically bound to a creature to survive. It loses 5 ({@dice 2d4}) hp for every hour it is not bound to a creature or every hour it is more than 30 feet away from its bound creature.

action.name: Phrenic Burst
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 5} to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) psychic damage.

action.name: Bind
entries: The emerald eye chooses a creature it can see within 30 feet of it that has an Intelligence of 6 or higher. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or the eye psychically binds itself to the target. If the target succeeds on the saving throw by 5 or more, it knows the eye attempted to bind to it. Otherwise, the target is unaware of the attempt. While bound to the emerald eye, the creature has resistance to psychic damage, but it has disadvantage on saving throws against the eye's Compulsion. The eye can be bound to only one target at a time. If it binds to another, the effect on the previous target ends.

action.name: Compel
entries: The emerald eye magically compels one creature it can see within 30 feet of it to move. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the eye for 1 minute. At the start of each of the {@condition charmed} target's turns, the emerald eye chooses a direction horizontal to the eye, and the target must use as much of its movement as possible to move in that direction on its turn. The target can take its action before it moves. The target can't be compelled to move into an obviously deadly hazard, such as a fire or pit, but it will provoke opportunity attacks to move in the designated direction. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Emerald Order cult leader casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

trait.name: Blessed Weapons
entries: The cult leader's weapons are blessed by its deity, and its weapon attacks are magical. When the cult leader hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 3d8} radiant damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Divine Blessing
entries: While the cult leader is conscious and wearing no armor and wielding no shield, it adds its Wisdom modifier to its Armor Class (included above). In addition, it has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Prophetic Tactics
entries: The cult leader has advantage on initiative rolls. In addition, at the start of each of the cult leader's turns, one friendly creature within 30 feet of the cult leader has advantage on the first attack roll it makes before the start of the cult leader's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Emerald Order cult leader makes three Mace or Radiant Bolt attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Radiant Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 8} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) radiant damage.

reaction.name: Esoteric Vengeance
entries: When a creature the cult leader can see within 30 feet of it hits it with an attack, the cult leader intonates a mind-bending arcane secret, and the attacker takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage.

name: Empowered Bog Body
languages: understands the languages they knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Acidic Blood
entries: A creature who deals piercing or slashing damage to the bog body while within 5 feet of them takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d6 + 8}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}). Until this grapple ends, the bog body can't make a Slam attack against another target.

action.name: Sling Mud
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d4 + 8}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Submerge
entries: If the bog body is in swampy terrain, they can submerge themself beneath the water and mud. While submerged, the bog body is heavily obscured.

If the bog body is grappling a target when they submerge, the target submerges with them. While submerged, the target is heavily obscured, {@condition restrained}, and unable to breathe, and takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage at the start of each of their turns.
A bog body can resurface as a bonus action. When they do so, a target they have {@condition grappled} also resurfaces.

name: Empty Cloak
languages: understands Elvish and Umbral but can't speak

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The empty cloak doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Diligent Sentinel
entries: The empty cloak has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks.

trait.name: Shadow Construction
entries: Made mostly of shadow, the empty cloak bursts into pieces then dissipates when a creature scores a critical hit against it.

trait.name: Wrapping Embrace
entries: The empty cloak can occupy a Medium or smaller creature's space and vice versa. It has advantage on attack rolls against any creature in the same space as it.

action.name: Razor Cloak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Shadow Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Shadow Snare
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. {@h}The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} by tendrils of shadow. A creature, including the {@condition restrained} creature, can take its action to free the {@condition restrained} creature by succeeding on a {@dc 14} Strength check. The tendrils of shadow can be attack and destroyed (AC 12; hp 10; vulnerability to radiant damage; immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage).

bonus.name: Protective Embrace
entries: When a creature the cloak can see attacks a creature in the cloak's space, the cloak can briefly wrap itself around the creature in its space. The creature in its space takes only half the damage from the attack, and the cloak takes the other half.

trait.name: Celestial Arsenal
entries: The Empyrean brazen bull's weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Death Throes
entries: When the Empyrean brazen bull dies, it explodes, and each creature within 20 feet of it must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 {@damage 6d6} fire and 21 ({@damage 6d6}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Soulfire Nimbus
entries: At the start of each of the Empyrean brazen bull's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) radiant damage. A creature that touches the Empyrean brazen bull or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) radiant damage.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The Empyrean brazen bull deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Unrelenting Charge
entries: If the Empyrean brazen bull moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving thrown or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the Empyrean brazen bull can make one attack with its bite or hooves against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target., {@h}24 ({@damage 3d10 + 8}) bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage. If the target is a creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 20}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the Empyrean brazen bull can't bite another target.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 3d12 + 8}) piercing damage and 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 feet., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 3d10 + 8}) bludgeoning damage and 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The Empyrean brazen bull makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside the Empyrean brazen bull, and it takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage at the start of each of theEmpyrean brazen bull's turns. If the Empyrean brazen bull takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the Empyrean brazen bull must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of the empyrean brazen bull. If the Empyrean brazen bull dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: The stag has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stag makes three Ram or Lightburst attacks.

action.name: Ram
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Lightburst
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) radiant damage, and the target is outlined in a golden light, giving attack rolls against them advantage until the start of the stag's next turn.

action.name: Starcall (1/Day)
entries: The stag calls down a magical shower of stars on an area that is 60 feet long and 5 feet wide within 120 feet of the stag. Each enemy in that area must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 ({@damage 8d6}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Each other willing creature in that area regains 15 hit points.

The stars then create a 10-foot-high wall of opaque radiant light in that area. Each creature in the wall's space is pushed out of it by the shortest route. The creature chooses which side of the wall to end up on. The wall lasts for 1 minute or until the stag is {@condition incapacitated} or dies. Any enemy who enters the wall of light for the first time on a turn must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Starlight Infusion
entries: The stag infuses radiant energy into a willing creature they can see within 60 feet of them. That creature deals an extra 5 radiant damage with weapon attacks until the start of the stag's next turn.

reaction.name: Nature's Ward
entries: When the stag or a creature they can see within 30 feet of them takes damage, the stag magically creates a protective barrier around that creature. The barrier reduces that damage to the protected creature by 20, then vanishes.

trait.name: Fire Form
entries: The entropic flame can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the flame or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage. In addition, the flame can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage and catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The entropic flame sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The entropic flame makes three hurl flame attacks. Before or after making each attack, the entropic flame can teleport up to 10 feet to a space it can see. It may teleport into a space occupied by another creature.

action.name: Hurl Flame
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Fire Form
entries: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

trait.name: Enduring Flame
entries: Flames within 10 feet of the elemental can't be extinguished, and the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition can't end for creatures within 10 feet of the elemental.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The elemental sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 30-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} in an additional 30 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes three Dancing Flame attacks.

action.name: Dancing Flame
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 3d6} Fire).

bonus.name: Flickerjump
entries: The elemental teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

name: Entropic Watcher

hp.special: 73 (7d10 + 35) plus 73 (7d10 + 35) per player character

languages: telepathy 120 ft. Understand all languages but can't speak

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The entropic watcher is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The entropic watcher may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the entropic watcher can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the entropic watcher has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Alien Intellect
entries: The entropic watcher is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the entropic watcher's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Corrupting Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the entropic watcher takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The entropic watcher has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Withering Gaze
entries: The entropic watcher's eye creates a 150-foot long, 10-foot wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} of withering magic. At the start of each of its turns, the entropic watcher decides which way the line faces and whether the line is active. Creatures in the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} have {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Necrotic damage and can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

action.name: The entropic watcher always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the entropic watcher can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the entropic watcher takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Tendrils
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 40 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 18}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. The entropic watcher has ten tendrils, each of which can grapple one creature.

items.name: Insanity Beam (1/Round)
