entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 10}, range 60 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d10}) Necrotic damage, and the beam leaps to another target. The entropic watcher makes another Insanity Beam attack against a new target within 30 feet of the first. A creature can be targeted by only one Insanity Beam per turn. For each additional creature the beam hits, its damage increases by 5 ({@dice 1d10}).

action.name: Dimensional Glide
entries: The entropic watcher moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

action.name: Shadow Crash {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 18}, each creature in a 30-foot radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point the entropic watcher can see within 150 feet. {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}'s area is filled with magical {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} for 1 minute or until the entropic watcher uses Shadow Crash again. A creature that ends its turn in the area takes 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Contaminated Grasp
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 18}, one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the entropic watcher. {@actSaveFail} 16 ({@damage 3d10}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Force Barrier
entries: The entropic watcher creates a shimmering octarine 10-foot-by-10-foot wall of force centered on a point within 150 feet. The wall lasts for 1 minute or until the entropic watcher has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition or dies. The wall appears in any orientation it chooses, and can be free floating or resting on a solid surface. If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (the entropic watcher's choice).

Nothing can physically pass through the wall. It is immune to all damage and can't be dispelled by {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB}. A {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB} spell destroys the wall instantly, however. The wall also extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel through the wall.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The entropic watcher chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The entropic watcher can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Eoghan is an 18th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks). He has the following druid spells prepared:
footerEntries: *spells found in Appendix D of Dungeons of Drakkenheim.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Eoghan has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Time-Warping Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) force damage.

action.name: Drift Forward {@recharge 5}
entries: The drifter chooses one creature it can see within 5 feet of its future self. The target must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage and is pulled forward in time. On a success, the target takes half the damage and isn't pulled forward in time. A target pulled forward in time disappears, along with the drifter's future self, as the future self pulls the target with it. At the end of the drifter's next turn, the target and the drifter's future self reappear in the spaces they previously occupied, or the nearest unoccupied spaces. When the target reappears, it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn as it recovers from the disorienting experience.

bonus.name: Call to the Future (1/Day)
entries: The eonic drifter calls to a future version of itself, which appears in an unoccupied space the drifter can see within 30 feet of it. The drifter's future self acts on the drifter's turn, and each turn it makes one Time-Warping Staff attack against a creature of the drifter's choice or uses the Help action to aid the drifter. The future self can be attacked and destroyed (AC 13; hp 30; resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage; immunity to poison and psychic damage), otherwise it remains until the drifter dismisses it as a bonus action or the drifter finishes a long rest. If the drifter's future self is destroyed, the drifter must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Assassinate
entries: During her first turn, Erestee has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit Erestee scores against a {@status surprised} creature is a critical hit.

trait.name: Sneak Attack
entries: Once per turn, Erestee deals an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Erestee that isn't {@condition incapacitated} and Erestee doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: Erestee takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

bonus.name: Fast Hands
entries: Erestee makes a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check, uses her thieves' tools to disarm a trap or open a lock, or takes the Use an Object action.

bonus.name: Unseemly Unseelie
entries: Erestee uses a combination of rude gestures and sounds to distract one creature she can see within 30 feet. If the target can hear and see Erestee, it has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The erina has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Hardy
entries: The erina has advantage on saving throws against poison.

trait.name: Spines
entries: A creature that touches the erina or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage. In addition, a creature {@condition grappled} by or grappling the erina takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage at the start of the erina's turn.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) slashing damage

action.name: Sling
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The erina has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Hardy
entries: The erina has advantage on saving throws against poison.

trait.name: Spines
entries: A creature that touches the erina or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage. In addition, a creature {@condition grappled} by or grappling the erina takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage at the start of the erina's turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The erina defender makes two Shortsword or Shortbow attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Protective Interference
entries: When a friendly creature the erina defender can see within 5 feet of it is the target of an attack, the defender can impose disadvantage on the attack roll. To do so, the defender must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

trait.name: Flowing Form
entries: The essence can enter an enemy's space and stop there, and they can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Gasping Aura
entries: While within 10 feet of the essence, creatures who need to breathe can't take reactions or speak.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The essence makes two Breathless Rend attacks.

action.name: Breathless Rend
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage.

bonus.name: Convocation of Breath (2/Day)
entries: The essence imbues the power of breath in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Hide in Breath.} The Elemental tries to hide inside the body of a creature within 10 feet of them who isn't a Construct, an Elemental, an Ooze, or an Undead. The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or the Elemental retreats inside the target until the start of the Elemental's next turn. While inside the target, the Elemental can't take actions and has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the target.

{@b Toxic Breath.} The Elemental exudes a noxious aura 10 feet in every direction for 1 minute or until dispersed by a moderate or stronger wind. That area is lightly obscured, and each creature who needs to breathe who starts their turn in that area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of their next turn.

bonus.name: Breathstealer's Shimmer (1/Day)
entries: The essence becomes {@condition invisible} then takes the Hide action. This invisibility ends if the essence makes an attack or uses Convocation of Breath.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The essence makes two Wind Talons attacks. They can replace one attack with a use of Bluster or Lightning Squall, if available.

action.name: Wind Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Bluster
entries: The essence unleashes a 30-foot cone of wind. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be moved up to 10 feet in any direction.

action.name: Lightning Squall (3/Day)
entries: The essence hurls a small lightning storm at a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) lightning damage and is {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, they take half as much damage and aren't {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}.

bonus.name: Convocation of Air (1/Day)
entries: The essence imbues the power of air in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Rising Whirlwind.} Each creature of the Elemental's choice within 30 feet of them must make a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw against a violent whirlwind. On a failed save, the target rises 10 feet upward and is {@condition restrained} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). A target {@condition restrained} in this way rises an additional 10 feet at the start of each of their turns. Another creature who can reach the target can use an action to pull them free of the effect, ending the {@condition restrained} condition for that creature. The whirlwind ends if the Elemental dies or chooses to end it (no action required).
{@b Vortex Terrain.} A vortex swirls around the Elemental. For 1 minute, the area within 20 feet of the Elemental is difficult terrain for enemies.

trait.name: Water Glide
entries: While within 5 feet of a liquid or solid surface, the essence gains a flying speed equal to their swimming speed. While flying, the essence doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The essence makes two Water Wing attacks and one Lightning Tail Whip attack.

action.name: Water Wing
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the same creature is hit twice with this attack on a turn, they are vulnerable to lightning damage until the end of the essence's turn.

action.name: Lightning Tail Whip
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage, and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away from the essence.

bonus.name: Convocation of Water (1/Day)
entries: The essence imbues the power of water in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Scalding Steam.} The Elemental spouts blistering steam. Each non-Elemental creature within 15 feet of them must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) fire damage and is {@condition blinded} until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition blinded}.

{@b Waters of Vitality.} The Elemental regains 25 hit points and can end one of the following conditions affecting them: {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition poisoned}, or {@condition stunned}.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The fish can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The fish can see 30 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

action.name: Ether Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage plus 1 force damage.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The fish enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The trickster's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The trickster makes two attacks.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The trickster enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

bonus.name: Spectral Sight (Recharges After a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As a bonus action, the trickster can gain the effects of the {@spell see invisibility} spell for 1 minute or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell).

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The everbug has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h} {@damage 1} piercing damage.

action.name: Noxious Defense (1/Day)
entries: The everbug secretes a noxious liquid with a potent stench. For the next minute, each creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the everbug, or that enters within 5 feet of the everbug for the first time each turn must succeed on a {@dc 12} saving throw against the stench or become {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: Excess can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Excess makes one Bite attack and one Sting attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). While {@condition grappled}, a target takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage at the start of each of Excess's turns, and Excess can't make a Bite attack against another target.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Swallow
entries: Excess makes a Bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature who they are grappling or hidden from.

If the attack hits, the target is swallowed as Excess enlarges their head and stomach. The swallowed target is no longer {@condition grappled}, but they are {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, have total cover against attacks and other effects outside Excess, and take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage at the start of each of Excess's turns. Excess can have only one target swallowed at a time.
If Excess dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by them and can escape from the corpse by using 5 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: Excess takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

name: Executioner

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands common but does not speak

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Executioner fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The Executioner is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Executioner has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The Executioner's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If the Executioner is destroyed, it returns with all its hit points in 24 hours unless a {@spell disintegrate} spell is cast on its remains.

action.name: Guillotine Blade
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 10 ft., or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 6d6 + 9}) slashing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. Immediately after making a ranged attack, this weapon flies back to the Executioner's hands.

action.name: Necrotic Vents {@recharge 5}
entries: The Executioner vents necrotic gas in a 30-foot radius. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw, taking 45 ({@damage 10d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature who fails this saving throw by 5 or more gains one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.

legendary.name: Lumber Forward
entries: The Executioner moves half its speed.

legendary.name: Attack (Costs 2 actions)
entries: The Executioner makes a melee or ranged attack with its Guillotine Blade.

legendary.name: Summon Shadows. (Costs 3 actions)
entries: The Executioner targets up to six humanoid corpses it can see within 60 feet of it that have died violently. Each target's spirit rises as a shadow in the space of its corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The shadows act after the Executioner on the same initiative count, are under its control, and remain for 1 minute or until they're destroyed. They disappear if the Executioner is destroyed.

hp.special: 250 (20d12 + 140) plus 250 (20d12 + 140) per player character

trait.name: Dimensional Anchor
entries: The Executioner can't be teleported or sent to another plane of existence unless it chooses to be.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The Executioner is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If the Executioner is destroyed, it reforms with all of its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} 1 minute later unless a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell is used to stop it. A {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell used in this manner is always stressful, and the caster must roll to determine whether or not they can cast the {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell ever again.

trait.name: Necrotic Vents
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the Executioner takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Stoic
entries: The Executioner can't take Reactions.

trait.name: Bound to Slaughter
entries: If the Executioner begins its turn more than 100 feet away from Slaughterstone Square, it disappears into the Haze and reappears 1 minute later at the center of Slaughterstone Square.

action.name: The Executioner always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the Executioner can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Executioner takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

action.name: Lumber Forward (1/Round)
entries: The Executioner moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

action.name: Death Grip
entries: Spectral chains appear around one creature within 300 feet of the Executioner. The target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}), and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends. The condition ends if the Executioner uses Death Grip against a different target

action.name: Guillotine Blade
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 18}, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}45 ({@damage 10d6 + 10}) Slashing damage which ignores any {@spell Resistance|XPHB} or {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Slashing damage. Immediately after making a ranged attack, this weapon flies back to the Executioner's hands. Critical {@h}The target dies unless it has the Epic {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} action or Legendary {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} trait.

action.name: Destroyer (1/Round)
entries: The Executioner chooses a Huge or smaller object or structure within 5 feet of it. Alternatively, it can choose a spell or magical effect within 30 feet of it. The object or structure is destroyed, or the spell or effect ends.

action.name: Summon Grasping Shadows (1/Round)
entries: The Executioner targets {@dice 1d4} corpses within 300 feet of it. Each target's spirit rises as a {@creature Grasping Shadow|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Grasping Shadows} in the nearest unoccupied space. The spirits act each round on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count 20, and disappear if the Executioner is destroyed.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The Executioner chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Executioner can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

trait.name: Blessed Weapons
entries: When the Exorcist hits with any weapon, the weapon unleashes holy fire, causing the target to have the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d6} Radiant; included in the attacks below).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The exorcist makes two attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Grasping Ghost.

action.name: Radiant Sword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Slashing damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d6} Radiant).

action.name: Blessed Crossbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 80/320 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d6} Radiant).

action.name: Grasping Ghost
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 15}, one creature the exorcist can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target is moved 30 feet in a horizontal direction of the exorcist's choice. At the end of this movement, the target has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the exorcist's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Expel Evil (1/Day)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, each Celestial, Fey, Fiend, and Undead that can see and hear the exorcist. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} and {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} conditions and must move as far from the exorcist as it can on its turns. The effect lasts for 1 minute or until the target takes damage, the exorcist has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, or the exorcist dies.

action.name: Last Rites {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, one creature the exorcist can see within 60 feet that isn't a Celestial or Construct (Fiends and Undead have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}). {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Radiant damage. If the target is a Fiend or Undead, it instead takes 64 Radiant damage and is turned to ash if the effect reduces it to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

bonus.name: Spiritual Healing
entries: One creature the exorcist can see regains 35 {@dice 10d6} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once a creature benefits from Spiritual {@variantrule Healing|XPHB}, it can't do so again until it finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

reaction.name: Negate Spell (3/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the exorcist can see within 60 feet is casting a spell. {@actResponse} If the spell is level 3 or lower, the spell fails, but any spell slots or charges aren't wasted.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The eye crawler has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The eye crow can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a person whispering, a baby crying, or an animal chittering. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The eye crow has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the crow's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage. If the eye crow scores a critical hit on a creature, the target is {@condition blinded} until the end of the crow's next turn.

name: Eye Golem

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Blinding Demise
entries: When the golem reduces a creature to 0 hp, it can blind the creature permanently. If it does so, the creature is reduced to 1 hp instead.

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The golem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Light-Infused Fists
entries: The golem's Slam attacks are magical. When the golem hits with a Slam attack, the attack deals an extra {@damage 4d8} radiant damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The eye golem can use its Primal Voice of Doom. It then makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Gaze of Ancient Light {@recharge 5}
entries: The golem opens all of its eyes and emits a burst of blinding light. Each creature within 30 feet of it must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) radiant damage and is {@condition blinded} for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition blinded}. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more is also {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn. A {@condition blinded} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Primal Voice of Doom
entries: The golem intones a disturbing invocation of the sun god at one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. The {@condition frightened} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The host casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}, +8 to spell attacks):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The host makes two Enchanted Strike attacks.

action.name: Enchanted Strike
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Psychic damage.

action.name: Illusory Assault {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the host. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of the host's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Faerie Step
entries: The host teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

reaction.name: Fey Escape
entries: {@actTrigger} The host takes damage. {@actResponse} The host has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition and teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet. The host remains {@condition Invisible|XPHB} until the start of its next turn or until it makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.

trait.name: Bright
entries: When the faerie-o'-fire isn't invisible, it sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet.

trait.name: Ephemeral
entries: The faerie-o'-fire can't wear or carry anything.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The faerie-o'-fire can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Solar Flare
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage. Until the end of the creature's next turn, the creature sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet, attack rolls against the creature have advantage, and the creature can't benefit from being invisible.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The faerie-o'-fire magically turns invisible until it attacks or uses its Consume Life, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell).

bonus.name: Consume Life
entries: As a bonus action, the faerie-o'-fire can target one creature it can see within 5 feet of it that has 0 hit points and is still alive. The target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw against this magic or die. If the target dies, the faerie-o'-fire regains 10 ({@damage 3d6}) hit points.

trait.name: Fey Touched
entries: Magic can't put the faevlin to sleep. Only a creature of the fey type can cause the faevlin to become {@condition charmed}, and a faevlin always knows if a non-fey creature attempted to render it {@condition charmed}.

trait.name: Sneaky
entries: The faevlin can use a bonus action to take the Hide action.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Fey Fade
entries: When an attack misses a faevlin, the faevlin can teleport up to 30 feet in a random direction, arriving in a safe, unoccupied space.

spellcasting.name: Inflame Greed
headerEntries: Fafnir casts {@spell Compel Avarice|NorthlandsWorldbook}, requiring no Material components or {@status Concentration|XPHB} and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}). Fafnir cannot take this action again until the start of his next turn.

trait.name: Armor of Greed (3/Day)
entries: When Fafnir is hit by attack, he can choose for the attack to miss instead. If the attack is a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}, he must spend two uses of this trait to cause it to miss. Each time Fafnir uses this ability, creatures have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against him until the end of his next turn.

trait.name: Aura of Avarice
entries: Creatures within 1 mile of Fafnir's lair have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saves against spells and effects that compel them to take or steal things, and they feel deeply protective of their own belongings and covetous of the belongings of others.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
entries: If Fafnir fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks using Bite or Constrict in any combination.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Piercing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Poison damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 18} One Huge or smaller creature Fafnir can see within 10 feet of him. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}) and the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the Grapple ends. Fafnir can only grapple one creature at a time with this ability.

action.name: Misfortune Breath {@recharge 4}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 17} Each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 31 ({@damage 7d8}) Poison damage, and the creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} until the end of Fafnir's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

legendary.name: Toxic Blood Spray
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17} Each creature within 20 feet of Fafnir. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 4d4}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of the target's next turn. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Fafnir cannot take this action again until the start of his next turn. Fafnir can only use this ability if he's missing at least one of its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

legendary.name: Entrap
entries: Fafnir moves up to half his {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and makes one Constrict attack.

trait.name: Enchanted Antlers
entries: The far darrig's attacks with its Antler Glaive are magical. When the far darrig hits with an Antler Glaive attack, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d6} force damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Speak with Beasts
entries: The far darrig can communicate with Beasts as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The far darrig makes two Antler Glaive attacks.

action.name: Antler Glaive
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage or slashing damage (the far darrig's choice) plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) force damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Woodland Friends (1/Day)
entries: The far darrig magically calls {@dice 1d4} elk or giant weasels. The called Beasts arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of the far darrig and obeying its spoken commands. The Beasts remain for 1 hour, until the far darrig dies, or until the far darrig dismisses them as a bonus action.

bonus.name: Nimble Woodsman
entries: The far darrig takes the Dash or Disengage action. The far darrig can use this bonus action only if it is in a forest.

name: Far Dweller
languages: telepathy 120 ft. understands all languages but can't speak

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The far dweller casts one of the following spells, requiring no components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The far dweller is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The far dweller may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the far dweller can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the far dweller has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Alien Intellect
entries: The far dweller is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the far dweller's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Force damage, and the target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Contaminate
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, one creature within 120 feet of the far dweller. {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Mind Scramble {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} (creatures maintaining {@status Concentration|XPHB} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}). {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Psychic damage, or 48 Psychic damage if the target was maintaining {@status Concentration|XPHB}. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

bonus.name: Pluck the Puppet Strings
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, one creature within 60 feet of the far dweller. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage, and the target must immediately use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} toward a creature of the far dweller's choice. If it ends this movement within reach of the creature, it must make a melee weapon attack against the creature with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Vanish to the Space Between Worlds (3/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} The far dweller takes damage. {@actResponse} The far dweller takes no damage and vanishes to the Space Between Worlds. At the start of its next turn, the far dweller reappears in an unoccupied space of its choice within 60 feet of the space it left.

name: Far Dweller Abductor
languages: telepathy 120 ft. understands all languages but can't speak

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The far dweller casts one of the following spells, requiring no components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}, +7 to spell attacks):

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The far dweller is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The far dweller may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the far dweller can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the far dweller has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Alien Intellect
entries: The far dweller is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the far dweller's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Unfathomable Presence
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the far dweller and can see it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave int} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} conditions until the start of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to the Unfathomable Presence of all far dweller abductors for 24 hours.

Unless {@status surprised|XPHB}, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against the far dweller until the start of its next turn. If the creature looks at the far dweller in the meantime, that creature must immediately make the saving throw.

action.name: Mind Warp
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 120 ft. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) Psychic damage, and the target must roll {@dice 1d4} and subtract the result from the next saving throw it makes before the end of the far dweller's next turn.

action.name: Devour Thoughts
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 15}, one creature within 30 feet of the far dweller. {@actSaveFail} 19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) Psychic damage, and the target's Intelligence score is reduced by {@dice 1d4}. If this effect reduces the target's Intelligence to 0, it has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

action.name: Abduct
entries: The far dweller casts {@spell Plane Shift|XPHB} without components, targeting itself and each {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} creature within 10 feet of it.

bonus.name: Psychic Step
entries: The far dweller magically teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

reaction.name: Counterspell (1/Day)
entries: The far dweller casts {@spell Counterspell|XPHB} in response to that spell's trigger, using the spellcasting ability in Spellcasting (Psionics).

name: Far Dweller Mastermind

hp.special: 60 (8d8 + 24) plus 60 (8d8 + 24) per player character

languages: telepathy 120 ft. Understand all languages but can't speak

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics) (1/Round)
headerEntries: The far dweller casts one of the following spells, requiring no components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 19}, +11 to spell attacks):

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The far dweller is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The far dweller may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the far dweller can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the far dweller has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Alien Intellect
entries: The far dweller is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the far dweller's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Eldritch Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the far dweller takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage.

trait.name: Magic Deflection
entries: The far dweller has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. If the far dweller is targeted by a spell of level 4 or lower, the caster must succeed on a {@dc 19} Intelligence saving throw or the spell fails and the caster takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Psychic damage.

action.name: The far dweller always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the far dweller can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the far dweller takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) Force damage, and the target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Contaminate
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 19}, one creature within 120 feet of the far dweller. {@actSaveFail} 45 ({@damage 10d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Mind Scramble {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 19}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} (creatures maintaining {@status Concentration|XPHB} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}). {@actSaveFail} 42 ({@damage 12d6}) Psychic damage, or 72 Psychic damage if the target was maintaining {@status Concentration|XPHB}. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Pluck the Puppet Strings (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 19}, one creature within 120 feet of the far dweller. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Psychic damage, and the target must immediately use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} toward a creature of the far dweller's choice. If it ends this movement within reach of the creature, it must make a melee weapon attack against the creature with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Phase Out (1/Round)
entries: The far dweller teleports to an unoccupied space within 120 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of the far dweller when it arrives is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave int} {@dc 19}. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Defenseless|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The far dweller chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The far dweller can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

reaction.name: Step Through Time and Space
entries: {@actTrigger} The far dweller takes damage. {@actResponse} The far dweller takes no damage and teleports to an unoccupied space within 60 feet. The next attack roll made against the far dweller has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

name: Fate Eater
languages: telepathy 100 ft. understands all but can't speak

trait.name: Visionary Flesh
entries: A creature that eats the flesh of a fate eater must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour. On a success, the creature gains the benefits of the divination spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fate eater makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Alter Fate {@recharge 5}
entries: The fate eater alters the fate of one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The creature must make a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 36 ({@damage 8d8}) psychic damage, and its fate is altered. Roll a {@dice d6} to determine which of the following alterations affects the creature. On a success, the creature takes half the damage, and its fate isn't altered. A creature with an altered fate for 1 minute or less can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, a creature with an altered fate can repeat the saving throw at the end of each long rest, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: 1 Forgotten Training
entries: The creatures loses the use of one random class feature, such as Action Surge or Channel Divinity, for 1 minute.

action.name: 2 Lost Potential
entries: One of the creature's ability scores, chosen at random, is reduced by 2.

action.name: 3 Seeing the Alternates
entries: The creature is {@condition incapacitated} for 1 minute.

action.name: 4 Shifting Memories
entries: The creature loses proficiency in one random skill and gains proficiency in another random skill.

action.name: 5 Took the Lesser Path
entries: The creature's current hp total becomes its hp maximum.

action.name: 6 Untied from the Loop
entries: When the creature moves, it moves in a random direction for 1 minute.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The warlock is a 15th-level spellcaster and can cast the following spells, using Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Eldritch Mind
entries: The warlock has advantage on saving throws made to maintain its concentration.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The warlock makes three simultaneous Eldritch Blast attacks against the same or different targets within range.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Eldritch Blast
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: {@hit 9} to hit, range 300 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) force damage and the warlock can choose to move the target 10 feet further from or closer to the warlock in a straight line.

action.name: Plunge of the Deep (1/Short or Long Rest)
entries: The warlock teleports it and up to six other willing creatures it can see within 30 feet of it to a body of water it has seen (pond-sized or larger) within 2 miles of it.

bonus.name: Fathomcaller's Tentacle (4/Day)
entries: The warlock summons a 10-foot-long tentacle at a point it can see within 60 feet of it, which lasts for 1 minute or until it uses this action again. When it creates the tentacle, the warlock can make a melee spell attack ({@hit 9} to hit) with the tentacle against a target within 10 feet of it, dealing 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage on a hit. On its subsequent turns, the warlock can use a bonus action to move the tentacle up to 30 feet and repeat the attack.

reaction.name: Fathom's Caress
entries: When the warlock or a creature the warlock can see takes damage while within 10 feet of the tentacle summoned by Fathomcaller's Tentacle, it can choose one of those creatures and reduce the damage to that creature by 9 ({@damage 2d8}).

resist.note: from attacks not made with cold iron weapons

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The fear smith casts one of the following spells, requiring no verbal or material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

trait.name: Distortion Gaze
entries: Those who meet the gaze of the fear smith experience the world seeming to twist at unnatural angles beneath their feet. When a creature that can see the fear smith's eye starts its turn within 30 feet of the fear smith, the fear smith can force the creature to make a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw if the fear smith isn't {@condition incapacitated} and can see the creature. On a failed save, the creature is disoriented until the start of its next turn. While disoriented, a creature can't take the Dash or Disengage action, and when it moves for the first time on its turn, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the fear smith until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the fear smith in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

trait.name: Hidden Eye
entries: The fear smith has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The fear smith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fear smith makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Heart-Stopping Stare.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage. If the target is disoriented by Distortion Gaze, the fear smith regains hp equal to the amount of psychic damage dealt.

action.name: Heart-Stopping Stare
entries: The fear smith terrifies a creature within 30 feet of it with a look. The target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) psychic damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn. The fear smith regains hp equal to the psychic damage dealt.

resist.note: from weapons that aren't enchanted with spells for the {@book Bane|TLotRR|6|3. Select Banes} of the undead

trait.name: Deathless
entries: If damage reduces the Fell Wraith to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant, from a critical hit, or from a weapon enchanted with spells for the {@book Bane|TLotRR|6|3. Select Banes} of the Undead. On a success, the Fell Wraith drops to 1 hit point instead.

trait.name: Sunlight Weakness
entries: While in sunlight, the Fell Wraith has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Fell Wraith can use its Strike Fear. It then makes a melee attack.

action.name: Sword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage, or 7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Strike Fear
entries: Each non-undead creature of the Fell Wraith's choice that is within 60 feet of the Fell Wraith and aware of it gains 1 Shadow point from Dread, resisted by a {@dc 12} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a target becomes {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target is also {@condition stunned} while {@condition frightened} in this way. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the Fell Wraith's Strike Fear for the next 24 hours.

name: Fellforged
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The fellforged doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Inhabiting Spirit
entries: The fellforged is inhabited and animated by a specter. If the fellforged fails a saving throw against an effect that turns undead, the specter is expelled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the fellforged with the hp total it had before it was expelled. The specter otherwise uses the statistics of a specter.

Without its animating specter, the fellforged becomes dormant for 1 minute then crumbles to pieces and is destroyed. The expelled specter can reinhabit the dormant fellforged as a bonus action while within 5 feet of the fellforged, making it active again and using the specter's current hp as the fellforged's hp total.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the fellforged has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fellforged makes two Necrotic Slam attacks.

action.name: Necrotic Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

bonus.name: Burst Gears
entries: The specter within the fellforged strains the construct's body, sending broken springs and gears flying. Each creature within 5 feet of the fellforged must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Each time the fellforged uses this bonus action, its speed is reduced by 5 feet, and it can't use this bonus action if its speed is 0. Its speed returns to normal when it finishes a long rest.

name: Fenrikyn
languages: Understands Abyssal and Giant but can't speak

trait.name: Mystical Chain
entries: The mystical chain attached to the fenrikyn is its greatest weakness and can be severed by an attack dealing 20 Slashing damage against AC 17, which deals no damage to the fenrikyn. If the fenrikyn's chain is destroyed, it takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Psychic damage and has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. It also loses its Chain Attack action, Whirling Chain action, and Deflecting Chain Reaction.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fenrikyn makes one Bite attack and one Chain attack. If its Mystical Chain has been broken, it instead makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Chain
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}). While grappled, the target cannot move further than 20 feet from the fenrikyn, and its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced by 10 feet.

action.name: Whirling Chain {@recharge 6}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16} All creatures within 20 feet of the fenrikyn. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed or pulled 10 feet. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Deflecting Chain
entries: {@actTrigger} The fenrikyn is hit by an attack. {@actResponse} The fenrikyn adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

trait.name: Coffin Boat
entries: The ferryman rides an open coffin on a swell of swamp water, allowing it to travel with a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 40 feet over any surface, including liquids, ignoring {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. The coffin can hold two other Medium creatures. Two Small creatures or four Tiny creatures count as one Medium creature.

While riding the coffin, the ferryman has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, and the coffin moves with the ferryman unless the ferryman has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. The coffin has AC 15; HP 25; {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage.
If the coffin is destroyed, the ferryman can magically create a new one using a 10-minute ritual.

trait.name: Payment
entries: The ferryman must peacefully offer a ride in its boat to a creature that takes the {@action Influence|XPHB} action to offer it 3 CP. If that creature is cursed by the ferryman, the curse ends. If the boat is full, the ferryman must return to offer the creature a ride once its current passengers leave the boat. If the creature or its allies damage the ferryman or force it to make a saving throw, this effect ends and the creature can't use that ferryman's Payment trait again.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The ferryman regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ferryman makes two Lantern Pole attacks and uses Hexed Lantern if available.

action.name: Lantern Pole
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Hexed Lantern (1/Day)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 13}, each creature of the ferryman's choice in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} The creature is cursed for 1 minute and must subtract {@dice 1d4} from {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests}.

name: Festerhulk
languages: understands Common and Giant but can't speak

trait.name: Fungal Step
entries: The festerhulk ignores {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} caused by plants or fungi.

trait.name: Spore Cloud
entries: At the end of each of the festerhulk's turns, each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the festerhulk takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. A Giant or Humanoid killed by this damage rises as a new creature 24 hours later: Festerhulk (if a Giant), {@creature Zombie|XMM} (if a Humanoid).

trait.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: The festerhulk takes 10 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The festerhulk makes two Fetid Slam attacks and uses Slime Mold if available.

action.name: Fetid Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. Hit:20 ({@damage 2d12 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Slime Mold (1/Day)
entries: The festerhulk disgorges a mass of ravenous slime mold into an unoccupied space within 20 feet. This mass uses the Black Pudding stat block except it is a Plant, and its size is Medium. The mass acts on the festerhulk's {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}. It, and any masses it Split into, dries up and dies in 1 hour.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The battlechef is an 8th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 14}, {@d20 +6} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Divine Strike (1/Turn)
entries: When the battlechef hits a creature with a weapon attack, the battlechef can cause the attack to deal an extra 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid or poison damage (battlechef's choice) to the target.

trait.name: Poison Resilience
entries: The battlechef has advantage on saving throws against {@condition poisoned|PHB|poison}.

trait.name: Strong Stomach (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: While the battlechef is {@condition drunkenness|GriffonsSaddlebag2|drunk}, it can choose to magically suppress the alcohol's effects for 1 minute.

action.name: Handaxe
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Create Healing Draft (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The battlechef creates a magical potion in its free hand or at its feet (battlechef's choice). A creature that drinks this potion regains 15 ({@dice 2d6 + 8}) hit points. The potion turns to dust and is lost if the battlechef finishes a short or long rest before it is consumed.

reaction.name: Table-Turner (3/Day)
entries: When the battlechef is hit by an attack from a creature within 5 feet of it, the creature must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned|PHB} until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition poisoned|PHB}.

name: Fext
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Eldritch Weapons
entries: The fext's weapon attacks are magical. When the fext hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 2d8} force damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The fext has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Patron's Blessing
entries: While the fext is conscious and wearing no armor and wielding no shield, it adds its Charisma modifier to its AC (included above).

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The fext doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fext makes two Eldritch Blade or Eldritch Fury attacks.

action.name: Eldritch Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) force damage.

action.name: Eldritch Fury
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) force damage.

action.name: Patron's Might {@recharge 5}
entries: The fext channels its patron's awe‑inspiring presence, terrifying those nearby. Each creature within 10 feet of the fext must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) psychic damage and is {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition frightened}. A {@condition frightened} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Feyward Tree

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Aversion to Cold
entries: If the feyward tree takes cold damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and its speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The feyward tree doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Enchanted Leaves
entries: The feyward tree's Razor-Leafed Branch attacks are magical. When the tree hits with its Razor-Leafed Branch, the branch deals an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) force damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The feyward tree is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever the feyward tree is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hp equal to the lightning damage dealt.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The feyward tree has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Warden's Reach
entries: A creature within 15 feet of a feyward tree that moves away from it provokes an opportunity attack even if the creature takes the Disengage action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The feyward tree makes two Razor-Leafed Branch attacks.

action.name: Razor-Leafed Branch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) force damage.

action.name: Flaying Leaves {@recharge 5}
entries: The feyward tree launches a barrage of razor-sharp cold iron leaves from its branches. Each creature within 20 feet of the tree must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 ({@damage 8d6}) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

fly.condition: (10 ft. fly 80 ft. in eagle form)

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The angel casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Ever Connected
entries: Fidele angels are magically connected. Damage taken by the fidele angel is split evenly between the fidele angel and its paired fidele angel. The angel that was the original target of the attack takes any damage that won't divide evenly. All other effects, such as reducing ability scores or being the target of a {@spell bless} spell, affect only the target.

trait.name: Immortal Nature
entries: The fidele angel doesn't require food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The angel's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Unshakeable Fidelity
entries: No spell, feature, trait, magic, or other effect can cause a fidele angel to act against or harm its mate or change its love or loyalty toward its mate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fidele angel makes three Longsword or Radiant Bolt attacks. Alternatively, it makes one Beak attack and two Talons attacks.

action.name: Longsword (Humanoid or True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) slashing damage, or 10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Beak (Bird Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons (Bird Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Radiant Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) radiant damage.

action.name: To My Lover's Side
entries: If its mate is more than 1 mile away from it, the fidele angel can magically teleport, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of its mate. The angel can use this action even if its mate is on another plane of existence.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The fidele angel transforms into a Medium or smaller Humanoid, a Large or smaller birdlike Beast, or back into its true form, which is a winged Celestial. Without wings, it loses its flying speed. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The Field Giant has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Without Need
entries: The Field Giant doesn't require food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Tail Slap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Huge or smaller, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be pushed 30 feet away from the Field Giant.

trait.name: Fiendish Audacity
entries: The handler's AC includes its Charisma modifier.

trait.name: Fiendish Fury
entries: The handler deals an extra 11 ({@damage 2d10}) damage when it hits with a melee weapon attack (included in the attacks).

trait.name: Fiendish Vigour
entries: The handler gains 10 temporary hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the handler takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the handler's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The handler makes three attacks with its Morningstar or Tommybow.

action.name: Morningstar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Brittlebone Splinterspray Tommybow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 30/120 ft., two creatures within 5 feet of each other. {@h}11 ({@damage 3d4 + 4}) piercing damage. Reload (4).

reaction.name: Guardian
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the handler is the target of an attack, the handler can choose to become the target of the attack instead of the original target.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The host casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}, +9 to spell attacks):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The host makes two Fiery Claws attacks and uses Hellfire Chain, if available.

action.name: Fiery Claws
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d6} Fire).

action.name: Hellfire Chain {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 17}, one creature the host can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. While {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, the target takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Fire damage at the start of each of its turns. At the end of each of its turns, the target makes a {@dc 17} Strength check, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Fiendish Agility
entries: The host takes the {@action Dash|XPHB} or {@action Disengage|XPHB} action.

reaction.name: Hellish Rebuke
entries: The host casts {@spell Hellish Rebuke|XPHB} ({@dc 17}, level 4 version) in response to that spell's trigger, using the spellcasting ability in Spellcasting.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: A jerbeen's long jump is 30 feet, and their base high jump is 15 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Team Tactics
entries: Jerbeens can take the {@action Help} action as a bonus action.

action.name: Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Warforged Symbiote
entries: A messenger can only remain active for 8 hours after it detaches from a warforged body, after which time its energy dissipates and it gains the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition. An {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} messenger must complete a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} while attached to a warforged, after which it regains its energy, as well as regaining all lost {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

action.name: Dash
entries: The messenger gains extra movement equal to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.
{@note Requires Use by a {@race Warforged|EFA}}

A delicate winged creature, this homunculus was designed to facilitate communication between warforged soldiers during the Last War. A {@item Final Messenger|ExploringEberron24} is a Tiny Construct with an AC of 20, 6 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet. It has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison damage and Psychic damage, and all conditions other than {@condition Unconscious|XPHB|Unconsciousness}. If it is forced to make an ability check or a saving throw, treat all its ability scores as 10 (+0). It has {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet. It has no limbs and the only action it can take on its turn is the {@action Dash|XPHB} action.

If you are a warforged, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to integrate a Final Messenger into your body. While it is part of your body, the messenger cannot be targeted by any attack. You can only have one messenger attached to your body at a time. A messenger can only remain active for 8 hours after it detaches from a warforged body, after which time its energy dissipates and it gains the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition. An {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} messenger must complete a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} while attached to a warforged, after which it regains its energy, as well as regaining all lost {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

A Final Messenger holds four pieces of data, accessible only to the warforged it is attached to. While the messenger is attached to you, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to review the data currently stored within the messenger, and if you choose to, change any or all of these data points.

items: A destination for the messenger. This can be very specific (a particular apartment in Sharn) or more general (an open marketplace).
A target individual. This could be a specific person or a category ("Any Karrnathi warforged").
A single image recorded through the eyes of a warforged attached to the messenger.
A message of up to 25 words.

entries: You can release the messenger as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, at which point it flies to its destination by the most direct route possible. Once it reaches the destination it seeks the target individual; if no target has been set, it approaches the nearest warforged.

If you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} while a Final Messenger is attached to you, it immediately detaches and seeks out its target. It retains its stored message, but replaces its stored image with the last thing you saw before dropping to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Healing Heat
entries: When the lightbearer targets a fire giant with an attack, spell, or other supernatural effect that deals fire damage, that target instead regains a number of hit points equal to the damage that would be dealt. The target can choose to be hit by this attack or fail their saving throw against this effect.

trait.name: Molten Flesh
entries: The first time a creature other than a fire giant touches the lightbearer or hits them with a melee attack on a turn, that creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lightbearer makes two attacks using Slam, Living Blaze, or both. They can replace one attack with a use of Flamelash.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, the target must choose between being knocked {@condition prone} or pushed 10 feet away from the lightbearer.

action.name: Living Blaze
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 180 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) fire damage, and the lightbearer can ricochet the flame toward another target within 5 feet of the first. The lightbearer makes another spell attack roll against the second target with disadvantage, dealing the same damage on a hit.

action.name: Flamelash
entries: The lightbearer extends a whiplike flame to strike a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) fire damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, the lightbearer moves the target up to 10 feet horizontally.

bonus.name: Travel by Fire (3/Day)
entries: The lightbearer chooses two willing creatures they can see within 30 feet of them. Each target takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage and teleports, swapping places with the other target.

trait.name: Heat and Pressure
entries: When an enemy moves out of the red fist's reach, the enemy must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or gain a level of {@condition exhaustion}. Creatures with resistance or immunity to fire damage are immune to this effect.

trait.name: Molten Flesh
entries: The first time a creature other than a fire giant touches the red fist or hits them with a melee attack on a turn, that creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The red fist makes two Unarmed Strike attacks.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
