entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage. If the same creature is hit twice with this attack on a turn, they are {@condition blinded} until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Hurl Flame
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 180 ft., one target. {@h}34 ({@damage 8d6 + 6}) fire damage.

reaction.name: Guardian Block (3/Day)
entries: When an enemy within 10 feet of the red fist hits a creature other than the red fist with an attack, the red fist halves the damage dealt by that attack. The red fist then makes an Unarmed Strike against the attacker.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the trooper takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the trooper takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Molten Flesh
entries: The first time a creature other than a fire giant touches the trooper or hits them with a melee attack on a turn, that creature takes 7 fire damage.

action.name: Unarmed Strike (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}3 bludgeoning damage plus 3 fire damage, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. The DC for this saving throw equals 12 + the number of troopers who joined the group attack.

action.name: Rock (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}6 bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Little Flames
entries: The spark sheds bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet. If an enemy starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more fire sparks, they take 6 fire damage.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the spark takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the spark takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Ember Claw (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 fire damage.

trait.name: Enforce Good Deeds
entries: A creature that has received assistance, such as healing or a glowing feather, from the firebird must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be affected by the {@spell geas} spell for 30 days. While under the geas, the affected creature must assist nonhostile creatures suffering from starvation or thirst by alleviating the starvation or thirst.

trait.name: Fiery Weapons
entries: The firebird's weapon attacks are magical. When the firebird hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 2d6} fire damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Glowing Feathers
entries: The firebird sheds bright light in a 5- to 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius. The firebird can alter the radius as a bonus action. If the firebird willingly gifts a feather to a creature, the feather sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet indefinitely.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The firebird has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Warming Presence
entries: The firebird and each creature within 5 feet of it are immune to the effects of cold environments, provided the cold is caused by naturally occurring weather and climate. When the firebird is inside a structure, it can choose for this trait to affect all creatures within the structure (no action required), regardless of how close they are to it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The firebird makes one Beak attack and one Talon attack.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Talon
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Blinding Ray {@recharge 5}
entries: The firebird fires a burning ray of light from its tail feathers in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) fire damage and is {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition blinded}.

action.name: Healing Feathers (3/Day)
entries: The firebird touches another creature, brushing its wings against the creature. The target magically regains 10 {@dice 3d6} hp and is freed from any disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

trait.name: Elemental Nature
entries: The firegeist doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Hide By Firelight
entries: The firegeist has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in fire or in areas lit by nonmagical fire.

trait.name: Magical Light Sensitivity
entries: While in an area of light created by a spell or other magical effect, the firegeist has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

trait.name: Variable Illumination
entries: The firegeist sheds dim light in a 5- to 20-foot radius. It can alter the radius as a bonus action.

trait.name: Water Susceptibility
entries: For every 5 feet the firegeist moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.

action.name: Burning Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object, it ignites. If the target is a creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or ignite. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Burning Terror {@recharge 5}
entries: The firegeist assaults the mind of one creature it can see within 30 feet of it with the painful, humiliating memory of the firegeist's first death. The target must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage and is {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. On a success, the target takes half the damage and isn't {@condition frightened}. While {@condition frightened}, the creature takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Evasive Maneuvers
entries: While flying, the firelance's armor class is equal to its passive {@skill Acrobatics} check.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h} {@damage 1} piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points.

trait.name: Limited Amphibiousness
entries: The Fish Folk can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

trait.name: Lucky Fool (1/Day)
entries: When the Fish Folk would fail an ability check by rolling a 5 or lower on the die, it can choose to replace the die roll with a 12 instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Fish Folk makes two melee attacks: one with its Chomp and one with its Sword.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Sword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Occupation
entries: Forester

trait.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Fierce, Rustic

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Fitch Talltree makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

action.name: Archet Hunting Bow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage. If Fitch Talltree scores a critical hit, he rolls damage dice three times, instead of twice.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Defiance
entries: As a bonus action, Fitch Talltree can spend one Hit Die to heal himself.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The fjord troll can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The fjord troll regains 15 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fjord troll makes two Gouge attacks.

action.name: Gouge
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Water Stream
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 14} Each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Cold damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is pushed up to 10 feet away from the fjord troll. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Aquatic Charge
entries: The fjord troll swims up to half its {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB}.

trait.name: Massive Bulk
entries: A flab giant can't take the Dash action. In addition, a creature attempting to grapple, push, or knock the giant {@condition prone} has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks to do so.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two Slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller creature, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Squatting Pin
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the flab giant must make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 22 ({@damage 5d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and is {@condition restrained} until the grapple ends. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition restrained}, but it remains {@condition grappled} until it escapes. While {@condition restrained}, a creature takes 8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the giant's turns. If the flab giant moves, the target is no longer {@condition restrained} or {@condition grappled}.

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that touches the flame dragon or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d10 + 1}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 ({@damage 5d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The flamekeeper casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}, +6 to spell attacks):

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) Piercing damage, or 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Piercing damage if wielded with two hands.

action.name: Searing Light
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 14}, one creature the flamekeeper can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Radiant damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the start of the flamekeeper's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Radiant Flames
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 14}, each creature of the flamekeeper's choice in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the flamekeeper. {@actSaveFail} 16 ({@damage 3d10}) Radiant damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Magical {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} in the area is dispelled.

name: Flaming Skeleton
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Heated Weapons
entries: When the skeleton hits with a metal melee weapon, the weapon deals an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The skeleton sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Ignite
entries: The skeleton flings itself at a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). On a failed save, the target also takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns, even after the {@action grapple} ends. If the target or a creature within 5 feet of it uses an action to put out the flames, or if some other effect douses the flames (such as the target being submerged in water), the effect ends.

name: Flesh Mournling
languages: understands the languages of their creator but can't speak

trait.name: Horrid Sob
entries: When an enemy who can hear the mournling starts their turn within 30 feet of the mournling, the enemy must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the mournling until the start of their next turn. A creature who succeeds on their saving throw is immune to the Horrid Sob of all flesh mournlings for 24 hours.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The mournling is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mournling makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is {@condition frightened} of the mournling, the target falls {@condition prone}.

action.name: Agonizing Wail {@recharge 5}
entries: The flesh mournling screams with unbearable pain in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area who can hear the mournling must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature's eyes water uncontrollably, they take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) psychic damage, and they can't see anything more than 5 feet away until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

resist.note: from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Adamantine

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The fleshcrafter is an 8th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Flesh Bond
entries: As long as the fleshcrafter and its flesh golem are within 120 feet of each other, the fleshcrafter can communicate with it telepathically. In addition, whenever the fleshcrafter casts a spell with a range of touch while within 120 feet of the golem, the golem can use its reaction to deliver the spell as if it had cast the spell, using the fleshcrafter's spell attack modifier and save DC. Whenever the fleshcrafter takes lightning damage, the golem regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

trait.name: Frenzy Control
entries: While the fleshcrafter is alive and conscious, its flesh golem can't go berserk. If the fleshcrafter dies, its flesh golem immediately goes berserk.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

name: Fleshcrawler
languages: Telepathy 120 ft. (can communicate only with other fleshcrawlers or infected creatures)

trait.name: Infect Humanoid
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 15} A creature {@condition Restrained|XPHB} in a fleshcrawler's fleshwebs for 1 hour. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for {@dice 1d4} days. While a creature has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition in this way, the fleshcrawler can issue telepathic instructions that the creature does its best to obey. If it completes an order and doesn't receive further direction from the fleshcrawler, it acts and moves as it likes, focusing on protecting itself. Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition on a success. A creature with the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition can make a save to end the effect at the end of each day.
If a creature is still {@condition Charmed|XPHB} at the end of the duration, it dies, and its body transforms into a flesh cocoon gestating a new fleshcrawler that hatches in 1 hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fleshcrawler makes two attacks, using Fleshwarp Strike and Necrotic Bolt in any combination.

action.name: Fleshwarp Strike
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Necrotic damage and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} target rolls a Constitution saving throw ({@dc 15}) to end this condition.

action.name: Necrotic Bolt
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) Necrotic damage.

bonus.name: Fleshwebs {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 15} One creature the fleshcrawler can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the web is destroyed (AC 15; HP 15; {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage).

trait.name: Bridle Binding
entries: If a creature puts a bridle on the fleshdobbin (treat as securing {@item Manacles|XPHB}), the fleshdobbin has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition while it wears the bridle, and it can't take the bridle off on its own.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The fleshdobbin can't shape-shift.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fleshdobbin makes one Claw attack and one Wailing Halberd attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 10 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Wailing Halberd
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 15 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Psychic damage.

action.name: Shriek {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Psychic damage. In addition, the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the fleshdobbin can see hits it with a melee attack roll while the fleshdobbin is wielding a Melee weapon. {@actResponse} The fleshdobbin adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

name: Fleshling Construct

hp.special: 70 + 10 for each spell level above 7

languages: understands the languages known by the target

action.name: Strangle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hitYourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier}, reach 5 ft. {@h}{@damage 2d8 + summonSpellLevel} Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape DC equals your spell save DC) and can't speak. Until the grapple ends, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and is {@hazard Suffocation|XPHB|suffocating}.

action.name: Constrict
entries: The fleshling construct constricts a target that it is grappling, doing {@damage 2d8 + summonSpellLevel} Bludgeoning damage.

name: Flintclaw
languages: understands Abyssal and Infernal but can't speak them

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The flintclaw has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the flintclaw moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the flintclaw can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Running Leap
entries: The flintclaw's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet when it has a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The flintclaw makes two claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Obscuring Form
entries: Other creatures in the swarm's space are {@condition blinded}.

trait.name: Shrink
entries: When the swarm is reduced to half their hit points, their size becomes Large.

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The swarm has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The swarm makes three Flutter Cutter attacks.

action.name: Flutter Cutter
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. {@h}26 ({@damage 6d6 + 5}) slashing damage, or 33 ({@damage 8d6 + 5}) slashing damage if the target is a Construct made of stone or is holding or wearing an object that emits bright light.

bonus.name: Devour Stone
entries: The swarm feeds on a mundane object or structure within 5 feet of them that is made mostly of stone.
If the swarm targets a Medium or smaller object, it is entirely devoured. If the swarm targets a structure or a Large or larger object, the swarm devours a 5-foot-cube portion of it.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The spirit's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 12}). The spirit can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Body Bite (1/Day)
entries: While the spirit has at least 5 hit points, a friendly creature can use a bonus action to take a bite out of the spirit. The spirit takes {@damage 1d4} piercing damage, and the creature regains a number of hit points equal to the damage taken.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The spirit regains 2 hit points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 hit point.

action.name: Push
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Merciful Exchange
entries: If the flutterflesh reduces a creature to 0 hp with a melee attack, it can cut off one of the creature's limbs. If it does so, the target is reduced to 1 hp instead.

trait.name: Necrotic Weapons
entries: The flutterflesh's weapon attacks are magical. When the flutterflesh hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 2d8} necrotic damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The flutterflesh regains 10 hp at the start of its turn. If the flutterflesh takes fire or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the flutterflesh's next turn. The flutterflesh dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The flutterflesh has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The flutterflesh doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The flutterflesh makes three Bone Spur or Tormenting Gaze attacks. If two Tormenting Gaze attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. A {@condition paralyzed} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Bone Spur
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d12 + 4}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage, and the flutterflesh impales the target on one of its bone spurs, grappling the target (escape {@dc 16}). The flutterflesh can have no more than two creatures impaled at a time.

action.name: Tormenting Gaze
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) psychic damage.

action.name: Creeping Death {@recharge 5}
entries: The flutterflesh emits a wave of necromantic energy, hastening the journey toward death. Each creature within 20 feet of the flutterflesh must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw, taking 45 ({@damage 10d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature below half its hp maximum has disadvantage on this saving throw.

trait.name: A Tinge Lucky (1/Day)
entries: The spirit can choose to grant itself advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it makes.

action.name: Scratch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Arcanomagnetic Repulsion
entries: Attacks against the weapon made with ferrous weapons or ammunition are made at disadvantage.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the weapon remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal weapon.

trait.name: Superconductor
entries: If the weapon takes 10 or more fire damage in a single instance, it falls {@condition prone} and, until the end of its next turn, it is {@condition incapacitated} and its flying speed is reduced to 0 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The weapon makes two melee attacks. It has one of the following attack options, depending on its anatomy.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) force damage.

action.name: Maul
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) force damage.

action.name: Pike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) force damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The flying polyp has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The flying polyp makes up to four Grasping Tentacle attacks and uses Wind Blast (if available).

action.name: Writhing Tentacles
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, Reach 20 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 1d10 + 10}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 24}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Wind Blast {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 24}, each creature in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point the flying polyp can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Cold damage and the target is pushed up to 30 feet away from the flying polyp in a straight line. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

bonus.name: Grasping Wind
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 24}, on creature within 2,000 feet. The flying polyp must have an unblocked line between it and its target, but the line does not need to be straight. The polyp does not need to see the target. {@actSaveFail} The target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced to 0 and cannot be increased until the end of the flying polyp's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} No effect.

bonus.name: Invisibility {@recharge 5}
entries: The flying polyp gains the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The flying polyp makes a Writhing Tentacles.

legendary.name: Sudden Movement
entries: The flying polyp moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The folk of Leng casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The folk of Leng can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

trait.name: Leng Rejuvenation
entries: If the folk of Leng dies on the Material Plane, it gains a new body in {@dice 1d10} days, regaining all its hp and becoming active again, unless it is killed with radiant damage wielded by a good-aligned creature or its remains are sprinkled with holy water within 24 hours of its death. The folk's new body appears in its family's crypt in Leng.

trait.name: Mortal Void Traveler
entries: The folk of Leng doesn't require air or ambient pressure.

trait.name: Phrenic Weapons
entries: The folk of Leng's weapon attacks are magical. When the folk hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 3d6} psychic damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The folk of Leng regains 2 hp at the start of its turn. If the folk of Leng takes fire or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the folk's next turn. The folk of Leng dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Psychic Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) psychic damage.

action.name: Hooked Spider Net
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 10/30 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage, and the target is {@condition restrained}. While {@condition restrained}, the target takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. Any creature, including the {@condition restrained} target, can take an action to remove the net by succeeding on a {@dc 14} Strength check. If the check succeeds by 5 or more, the creature breaks the net instead, and the folk of Leng can't use the broken net again until it finishes a long rest.

bonus.name: Etherealness
entries: The folk of Leng enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

trait.name: Gang Tactics
entries: The Footpad has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Footpad's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Great Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Visceral Sight
entries: The force of blood can see any creature within 120 feet of them who isn't a Construct or an Undead. This sight ignores effects that obscure sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The force of blood makes three Scarlet Longspear attacks. They can replace one attack with a Rend from Within attack.

action.name: Scarlet Longspear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, the force of blood regains 5 hit points.

action.name: Rend from Within
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage plus 26 ({@damage 4d12}) necrotic damage, and the target spends 1 Hit Die with no effect and can't take reactions until the start of their next turn. Miss: 13 ({@damage 2d12}) necrotic damage.

bonus.name: Convocation of Blood
entries: The force of blood imbues the power of blood in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Boiling Blood.} The Elemental boils the blood of a creature within 5 feet of them who isn't a Construct or an Undead. The target must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target must choose to either take 27 ({@damage 5d10}) fire damage or make an attack with a weapon that has a damage die of {@damage 1d4} or greater against a creature of the Elemental's choice. If the attack hits, it deals an extra 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage.

{@b Essence Thief.} The Elemental steals the essence of two creatures the Elemental can see within 30 feet of them. Each target must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw, taking 19 ({@damage 3d12}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The Elemental can then teleport to an unoccupied space they can see within 5 feet of one of the targets.

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The force of earth can burrow through mundane, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the force of earth doesn't disturb the material they move through.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The force of earth makes two Earthbind Strike attacks.

action.name: Earthbind Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target's speed becomes 0 until the start of the force of earth's next turn.

action.name: Shatter Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d12 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, or 47 ({@damage 6d12 + 8}) bludgeoning damage if the target is an object or structure.

bonus.name: Convocation of Earth (1/Day)
entries: The force of earth imbues the power of earth in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Earthen Aura.} Stones rapidly whir around the Elemental in a 10-foot-radius sphere for 1 minute or until they're killed or {@condition incapacitated}. A creature who isn't an Elemental takes 5 slashing damage for every 5 feet they move into or within that area.

{@b Stone Armor.} Stone grows over the Elemental in a protective carapace, and they gain 20 temporary hit points. While the Elemental has these temporary hit points, they are immune to the {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition petrified}, and {@condition stunned} conditions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The force of iron uses Form Stance then makes three Ferrous Blade attacks or three Iron Spike attacks.

action.name: Ferrous Greatblade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. (20 ft. in Polearm Form), one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Iron Spike
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Form Stance
entries: The force of iron shapes their body to gain one of the following benefits until the start of their next turn:

action.name: Polearm Form
entries: The force of iron's melee attacks have a reach of 20 feet instead of 5 feet.

action.name: Reckless Form
entries: The force of iron has advantage on all melee attack rolls, but attack rolls against the force of iron have advantage.

action.name: Shield Form
entries: The force of iron gains a +3 bonus to AC.

action.name: Fire Form (1/Day)
entries: The force of iron's attacks deal an extra 13 ({@damage 2d12}) fire damage on a hit.

bonus.name: Convocation of Iron (1/Day)
entries: The force of iron imbues the power of iron in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Earth Reinforcements.} Five {@creature earth spark|FleeMortals}s appear in unoccupied spaces within 20 feet of the Elemental. The sparks understand the Elemental, follow their verbal commands, and act immediately after the Elemental in the initiative order.

{@b Iron Skin.} Metal covers the Elemental, granting them resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage for 1 minute or until their {@status concentration} is broken (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell).

trait.name: Forest Camouflage
entries: The giant has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in forested terrain.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the forest marauder has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The forest marauder makes two Boar Spear attacks. If both attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the marauder. The marauder can choose not to push a creature.

action.name: Boar Spear
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Forest Ambusher
entries: While in a forest, the forest marauder can take the Hide action.

trait.name: Natural Camouflage
entries: The prowler has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made in the forest. Creatures who attack a target that cannot see them have advantage on their attack roll.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the Forest Prowler moves at least 10 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. The prowler can use its bonus action to make another claw attack against this target.

trait.name: Ambuscade
entries: The prowler can use the dash or hide action as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The prowler makes two claw attacks and one bite attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage,.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target of the bite attack is {@condition prone}, it takes an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) piercing damage.

immune.note: from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine

trait.name: Fire Absorption
entries: Whenever the guardian is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The guardian is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The guardian has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1} against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The guardian's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The guardian makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Runeblade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}36 ({@damage 4d12 + 10}) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 23} Constitution {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or be {@condition blinded} until it deals damage to the guardian.

action.name: Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 2d12 + 10}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet away from the guardian and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Bladestorm {@recharge 5}
entries: The guardian makes a Runeblade attack against every creature within 15 feet of it. On a hit, a target is also pushed up to 15 feet away from the guardian and knocked {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Runeblade
entries: The guardian makes one Runeblade attack.

legendary.name: Kick
entries: The guardian makes one Kick attack.

legendary.name: Trample (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The guardian moves up to 50 feet without triggering {@action opportunity attack|PHB|opportunity attacks}, and can pass through other creature's spaces. Each creature whose space the guardian passes through must make a {@dc 23} Dexterity {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}. On a failure, the creature takes 23 ({@damage 2d12 + 10}) bludgeoning damage and is knocked {@condition prone}. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked {@condition prone}. Any creature that shares the guardian's space when it stops this movement is pushed out of its space into the nearest unoccupied space.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The formless spawn casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}):

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The formless spawn can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The formless spawn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The formless spawn makes up to four attacks, using Bludgeoning Pseudopod or Grasping Tentacle in any combination. It can replace any number of attacks with uses of Crushing Grip or Throw Victim.

action.name: Bludgeoning Pseudopod
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, Reach 10 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Crushing Grip
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 18}, one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the formless spawn. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Bludgeoning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Grasping Tentacle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, Reach 20 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 18}), and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends.

action.name: Throw Victim
entries: The formless spawn throws a Medium or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by it to a space it can see within 30 feet of itself that isn't in the air. {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}, the creature thrown and each creature in the destination space. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only

name: Forzaantirilys

trait.name: Hellfire
entries: Fire damage dealt by Forzaantirilys ignores damage resistance.

trait.name: Ireful Defense (3/Day)
entries: When Forzaantirilys fails a saving throw, she can succeed instead. When she does, attack rolls made against her have advantage until the end of her next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Forzaantirilys makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 2d10 + 10}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage, and the target is set on fire for 1 minute or until the target or a creature who can reach them uses an action to extinguish the flames. A creature who is on fire at the start of their turn takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage. If a creature who is already on fire is set on fire again on a subsequent turn, the damage isn't cumulative, but the duration of the fire resets to 1 minute.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d6 + 10}) slashing damage, and Forzaantirilys can move the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

action.name: Scorching Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Forzaantirilys exhales fire in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 70 ({@damage 20d6}) fire damage, and any mundane metal objects they are wearing or carrying are melted into slag and destroyed. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and their equipment isn't destroyed.

Additionally, the fire remains in that area until the end of Forzaantirilys's next turn. For the duration, that area is difficult terrain, and a creature who enters that area for the first time on a turn or ends their turn there takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage.

bonus.name: Blazing Rush
entries: Forzaantirilys moves up to half her speed. If she enters a creature's space during this move, the creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage.

reaction.name: Ignite the Insolent
entries: When a creature within 120 feet of Forzaantirilys attacks her, the attacker must make a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the attacker is set on fire for 1 minute or until the attacker or a creature who can reach them uses an action to extinguish the flames. A creature who is on fire at the start of their turn takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage. If a creature who is already on fire is set on fire again on a subsequent turn, the damage isn't cumulative, but the duration of the fire resets to 1 minute.

legendaryHeader: Forzaantirilys has three villain actions. She can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. She can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Cinderfall
entries: A 30-foot-radius cloud of smoke and cinders surrounds Forzaantirilys until the end of her next turn. That area is heavily obscured for creatures other than Forzaantirilys. An enemy who needs to breathe and starts their turn within the cloud must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

legendary.name: Action 2: Ashen Armor
entries: Forzaantirilys's skin hardens into a protective armor of ashen scales, granting her 100 temporary hit points. Until all these temporary hit points are gone, a creature within 5 feet of Forzaantirilys who touches her or hits her with an attack takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage.

legendary.name: Action 3: Supernova
entries: Forzaantirilys unleashes a massive burst of light and heat. Each creature within 120 feet of her must make a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) fire damage plus 35 ({@damage 10d6}) radiant damage and is {@condition blinded}. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition blinded}. The blindness lasts until cured by a power, a spell, or a similar supernatural effect that removes the {@condition blinded} condition.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The fossegrim can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The fossegrim has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The fossegrim casts one of the following spells with its musical instrument, but requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

spellcasting.name: Illusory Appearance
headerEntries: The fossegrim casts {@spell Disguise Self|XPHB}. It can appear as a Small or Medium Humanoid.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fossegrim makes two Discordant Chord attacks.

action.name: Discordant Chord
entries: {@atkr m,s} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 feet, one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Thunder damage.

action.name: Torrential Tune (2/day)
entries: The Fossegrim plays its musical instrument, conjuring a wave of water to crash down upon its enemies. {@actSave dex} {@dc 15} All creatures in a 20-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Bewildering Harmonics
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15} One creature the fossegrim can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target becomes confused until the end of its next turn. The target can't take {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|Reactions} and must roll {@dice 1d8} to determine what it does on its next turn:

items: 1-4. The target does nothing.
5-6. The target takes no action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} and uses all its movement to move in a random direction.
7-8. The target makes a melee attack against a random creature within its reach, or it does nothing if it can't make such an attack.

bonus.name: Ventriloquistic Step
entries: The fossegrim teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reaction.name: Cacophonous Note {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature succeeds on a d20 Test within 30 feet of the fossegrim. {@actResponse} The creature must roll again and take the new result.

trait.name: Churning Trunk
entries: Prone creatures can't make opportunity attacks against the cryptic, and the cryptic can move through spaces occupied by {@condition prone} creatures. The first time on a turn the cryptic moves through a space occupied by a {@condition prone} enemy, that enemy takes 7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cryptic makes two Slam attacks and uses Stone Bone Storm.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Stone Bone Storm
entries: The cryptic breaks apart their body, driving a flurry of stones in a 5-foot-wide, 30-foot-long line originating from their space. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage and falling {@condition prone} on a failed save, or taking half as much damage and not falling {@condition prone} on a successful one.
The fossil cryptic then reforms in an unoccupied space in the line's area.

action.name: Shatterstone {@recharge}
entries: The cryptic burrows up to half their speed. If the cryptic ends this movement within 5 feet of the surface, they can breach the surface. Each other creature within 20 feet of the cryptic when they breach must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Stoneshift
entries: The cryptic shifts the ground under the feet of one creature or object touching the ground within 30 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be moved up to 15 feet horizontally. Objects automatically fail this saving throw.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The lepidoptera is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The lepidoptera may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the lepidoptera can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the lepidoptera has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Alien Intellect
entries: The lepidoptera is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the lepidoptera's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Energy Form
entries: The lepidoptera can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so, and it can enter a creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature is moved 20 feet in a random direction.

trait.name: Incomprehensible Vision
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the lepidoptera and can see it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave wis} {@dc 13}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Staggered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is transported to the Border Ethereal. If the target is already on the Border Ethereal, they are transported to the Material Plane instead.

Unless {@status surprised|XPHB}, a creature can avert their eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of their turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the lepidoptera until the start of its next turn. If the creature looks at the lepidoptera in the meantime, that creature must immediately make the saving throw.

trait.name: Multidimensional Presence
entries: If the lepidoptera is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} but hasn't taken damage from a source on both the Material Plane and the Border Ethereal in the last round, it drops to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} instead.

trait.name: Phototaxis
entries: If a source of {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} is within 100 feet of the lepidoptera, it attempts to move closer to the light on its turn.

trait.name: Unraveling Reality
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the lepidoptera when it dies. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is transported from the Material Plane to the Border Ethereal, or vice versa.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lepidoptera makes two Fractal Wing attacks.

action.name: Fractal Wing
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. {@h}35 ({@damage 5d10 + 7}) Force damage.

action.name: Tessellation {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the lepidoptera that doesn't have {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover}. {@actSaveFail} 44 ({@damage 8d10}) Force damage, and the target begins its next turn by moving up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} in a random direction.

If the target has the {@condition Staggered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition, it instead takes no damage, that condition ends, and the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition (save ends). While {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, the target mutters rhymes in a singsong voice and dances to an unheard rhythm, moving up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} in a random direction at the start of each of its turns.

reaction.name: Criss Cross
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature within 60 feet of the lepidoptera touches it or hits it with an attack. {@actResponse d}{@actSave cha} {@dc 17}, the attacker. {@actSaveFail} The attack deals no damage and the attacker is transported from the Material Plane to the Border Ethereal, or vice versa.

trait.name: Deft Snow Walk
entries: The fraughashar can move across icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check, and difficult terrain composed of ice and snow doesn't cost it extra movement. In addition, the fraughashar has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it {@condition prone} while in icy or snowy terrain.

bonus.name: Bounding Leap

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement

action.name: Life Drain

name: Frond Bellewether
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Frond can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. Frond lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement and takes no falling damage. Frond cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

trait.name: Talons
entries: Frond has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface her talons could reasonably grip.

trait.name: Aerial Defense
entries: As long as Frond is falling, gliding, or jumping, attacks made against her have disadvantage.

trait.name: Woodland Hunter
entries: Frond treats three-quarters cover as half cover and half cover as no cover.

entries: Wisps of stinging snow and icy winds surround the storm hurler. When an enemy {@status concentration||concentrating} on a power, a spell, or a similar effect starts their turn within 15 feet of the storm hurler, the enemy must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or lose {@status concentration}.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Ice Javelin
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 120/360 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) piercing damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Slam

The javelins have AC 13, 10 hit points, and vulnerability to fire damage. At the start of the storm hurler's next turn, any javelins with hit points remaining explode, showering icicles in a 20-foot radius. Creatures within the area of one or more explosions must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) cold damage and is {@condition restrained} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition restrained}. Objects within this area take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) cold damage.

reaction.name: Frozen Retribution

trait.name: Burning Ice

trait.name: Iced Skin

action.name: Frigid Punch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Cold damage.

action.name: Frost Bolt
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d10 + 2}) Cold damage.

bonus.name: Frigid Flare {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 12} Each creature within 5 feet of the frost-afflicted. {@actSaveFail} The target takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Cold damage, and its speed is reduced by 10 until the end of the frost-afflicted's next turn.

trait.name: Chilling Acidic Body
entries: A creature that touches the frostveil or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While engulfing a creature, the frostveil takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and the engulfed creature takes the other half.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the frostveil remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a formation of frost and ice.

trait.name: Windborne
entries: In windy conditions, the frostveil's flying speed increases to 30 feet. In a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour), its flying speed increases to 60 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The frostveil makes two Frozen Tendril attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}), and the frostveil uses Snowy Engulf on it.

action.name: Frozen Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Snowy Engulf
entries: The frostveil engulfs a Medium or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by it. The engulfed target is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, and it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the frostveil's turns or take 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) cold damage. If the frostveil moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The frostveil can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

action.name: Spirit Spores {@recharge}
entries: The frostveil releases a puff of psychotropic spores around itself. Each creature within 10 feet of the frostveil must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) cold damage and is {@condition incapacitated} for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition incapacitated}. When an {@condition incapacitated} creature moves, it moves in a random direction. An {@condition incapacitated} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the trolling remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a patch of mushrooms.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the trolling dies, it explodes in a burst of mind-affecting spores. {@actSave wis} {@dc 13}, each creature that isn't a troll in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the troll. {@actSaveFail} 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Psychic damage and has the {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Spore Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The fungusfeaster can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Fungiphage
entries: The fungusfeaster's pseudopod attack deals an extra 4 ({@damage 1d8}) necrotic damage to fungi and fungus creatures such as {@creature shrieker||shriekers} and {@creature violet fungus||violet fungi}. The fungusfeaster regains hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The fungusfeaster can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The fzeg has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the fzeg fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Rampage
entries: When the fzeg reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the fzeg can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The fzeg regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. If the fzeg takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the fzeg's next turn.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The fzeg can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid or back into its true form, that of a wolf-humanoid hybrid. It can transform its body parts as part of attacking with them and can choose whether the change remains after making the attack. Other than its size, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it's wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The fzeg can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fzeg uses its howl, then attacks once with its bite and twice with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 17 ({@damage 5d6}) necrotic damage and is {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn. A humanoid slain after being bitten rises the following night as a fzeglaich under the fzeg's control.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Howl
entries: Each creature of the fzeg's choice that is within 300 feet of the fzeg and able to hear it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the fzeg's Howl for the next 24 hours or until it is {@condition stunned} by the fzeg.

action.name: Night Children (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The fzeg magically calls eight wolves. These wolves arrive in 2 rounds, acting as allies of the fzeg and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until the fzeg dies, or until the fzeg dismisses them as a bonus action.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The fzeg moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Claws
entries: The fzeg attacks with its claws.

legendary.name: Incite
entries: The fzeg chooses one creature that is of a lower Challenge, has a bite attack, and is within 60 feet of the fzeg. Provided the target can see or hear the fzeg, that creature can use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

legendary.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The fzeg attacks with its bite.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The fzeglaich has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Rampage
entries: When the fzeglaich reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the fzeglaich can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The fzeglaich regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. If the fzeglaich takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the fzeglaich's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fzeglaich makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition incapacitated} until the end of its next turn. The fzeglaich regains hit points equal to the amount of necrotic damage dealt.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Gabe is a 10th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 15}, +7 to hit with spell attacks). Gabe has the following spells prepared:

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Gabe can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. He cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

trait.name: Wing Flap
entries: As a bonus action, Gabe can use his powerful feathered arms to propel himself upward up to half his movement speed. Gabe can use it in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

trait.name: Fated (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: Gabe can choose to reroll any attack, skill check, or saving throw.

trait.name: Resilience
entries: Gabe has advantage on saving throws against poison.

action.name: Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d6 - 1}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Charming (3/Day)
entries: When a creature makes an attack against Gabe, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or target the next closest creature within range. If multiple creatures are closest, the attacker chooses. This feature does not work if there are no other creatures within range

name: Gallus Druid
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The druid is a 6th-level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 14}, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The druid has the following spells prepared:

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, the druid can spend a reaction to fly up to their speed in one direction as they descend. They land in an unoccupied space at the end of their movement, and take no falling damage. They cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though they can drop any held items as part of their reaction).

trait.name: Wing Flap
entries: As a bonus action, the druid can use their powerful feathered arms to propel themselves upward up to half their movement speed. The druid can use it in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

trait.name: Seedspeech
entries: The druid can communicate simple ideas to living plants, and is able to interpret their responses in simple language.

trait.name: Spirit Totem (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As a bonus action, the druid calls forth a nature spirit. The spirit appears at a point the druid can see within 60 feet. The spirit creates a 30-foot-radius aura. The spirit is neither an object nor a creature, but is a spectral beast. As a bonus action, the druid can move the spirit to another location within 60 feet. The spirit lasts for 1 minute.

entries.name: Bear Spirit
entries: The druid and allies within the aura gain 9 temporary hit points and have advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.

entries.name: Hawk Spirit
entries: The druid can use their reaction to grant advantage to an ally's attack roll against a target in the aura. The druid and allies within the aura have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks.

entries.name: Unicorn Spirit
entries: If a spell that requires a spell slot heals the druid or allies in the aura, each creature of the druid's choice also gains 4 hit points

action.name: Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Wind's Grace

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Unarmed Attack
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Dart
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Graceful Step
entries: The monk moves 40 feet. This movement does not provoke {@action opportunity attack|phb|opportunity attacks}.

action.name: Inspiring
entries: The monk inspires an ally that can see and hear them. The ally can roll a {@dice d4} and add the number rolled to their next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.

The necromancer lands in an unoccupied space at the end of their movement, and takes no falling damage. The necromancer cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though they can drop any held items as part of their reaction).

action.name: Staff

items.name: Frost Spear
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 15 ft. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d12 + 6}) Slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Cold damage.

items.name: Bitterfrost Cyclone (1/Day)
entries: Galnafur whips up a bone-chilling cyclone that swirls around her for up to 10 minutes. The cyclone generates and repositions up to 3 feet of snow in a 15-foot radius that moves with her, creating {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} for Large and smaller creatures. Additionally, the cyclone protects Galnafur from projectiles. All but the heaviest Ranged weapon attacks targeting her are made at {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}. If she takes damage, she makes a {@status Concentration|XPHB} check to maintain the cyclone. Otherwise, the cyclone lasts for the duration, until Galnafur is {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} or spends a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to end the effect.

trait.name: Occupation
entries: Adventurer, Wizard

trait.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Bold, Cunning

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The gantii'kaas casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The gantii'kaas has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Speak with Stone
entries: The gantii'kaas can communicate with rocks and stones as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gantii'kaas makes two Blinding Claw attacks and one Rock attack.

action.name: Blinding Claw
entries: {@atkr m} +5 , reach 10 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Slashing damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 30/60 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Eruption of Stone {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 20-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} centered on a point the gantii'kaas can see on the ground within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 19 ({@damage 3d12}) Bludgeoning damage on a failed save, and the ground in the target area becomes {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} until cleared. Each 5-foot-square portion of the area requires at least 1 minute to clear by hand. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

reaction.name: Hungry Hands
entries: {@actTrigger} When the gantii'kaas takes damage from a melee attack with a weapon that isn't natural or attached. The gantii'kaas must have a free hand. {@actResponse} The gantii'kaas makes a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand|XPHB}) check against the attacker's Passive Perception. {@actSaveSuccess} The gantii'kaas steals the weapon it was attacked with.

trait.name: Cold Tolerance
entries: The gargath can exist comfortably in temperatures as low as −50 degrees Fahrenheit. It has advantage on Constitution saving throws made to resist effects that deal cold damage.

trait.name: Stampede
entries: If the gargath moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is knocked {@condition prone}, the gargath can then make one Stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Ram
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone} creature. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Maggoty Hide
entries: A creature attacking the garmr in melee that is adjacent to the garmr is subject to the maggots crawling over its rank fur. {@actSave dex} {@dc 13}. {@actSaveFail} The target is infested with maggots, taking 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage at the beginning of each of its turns. An infested target can make another saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect, and the maggots are burnt away if it takes at least 5 Acid or Fire damage. After the creature successfully saves or the maggots are burnt away, it has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to this trait for 1 hour.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The garmr has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the garmr's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Earth Rending Howl {@recharge 6}
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 13} Each creature in a 20-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 17 ({@damage 5d6}) Thunder damage, and the target has the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. Unattended objects and structures in the area are not allowed a saving throw, they take double damage, and the howl ignores their damage threshold.

bonus.name: Rotten Shake {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 13} Each creature within 5 feet of the garmr. {@actSaveFail} The target is infested with maggots (see Maggoty Hide).

trait.name: Reckless

trait.name: Scent of Blood
entries: The garmyr's melee attacks deal an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage to a {@status Bloodied|XPHB} creature.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Battleaxe

trait.name: Strangling Divination
entries: A Humanoid reduced to 0 hp while {@condition grappled} by the garroter crab experiences a brief vision of the future. This effect works like the divination spell, except the reply is only as a mental vision and it can be about any specific goal, event, or activity to occur within 30 days. Once a creature has received a vision in this way, it can't do so again for 30 days.

action.name: Whip-Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}).
