trait.name: Three Heads
entries: The gasdra has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks and on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, {@condition Stunned|XPHB}, or {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} conditions. The gasdra can take one {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} for each of its heads. The extra {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|Reactions} can be used only for {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: While the gasdra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gasdra makes three Beak attacks.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Shifting Camouflage
entries: The gbahali's hide adapts to its current surroundings. The gbahali has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in nonmagical, natural terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gbahali makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the gbahali can't Bite another target.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The gearforged templar doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gearforged templar makes four Greatsword or Javelin attacks. If two Greatsword attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the templar. The templar can choose not to push a creature.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Whirlwind {@recharge 5}
entries: The gearforged templar whirls its greatsword in a great arc. Each creature within 10 feet of the gearforged must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 ({@damage 5d10}) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Defensive Zone
entries: When a creature enters the gearforged templar's reach, the templar makes one Greatsword attack against the creature.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The gearforged templar adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the templar must be able to see the attacker and must be wielding a melee weapon.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: Gegazol can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost her extra movement.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Gegazol fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Gegazol has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If destroyed while her soul vessel remains intact, Gegazol's {@condition unconscious} body rejuvenates within 5 feet of the soul vessel, where she regains 78 ({@dice 12d12}) hit points each day. When she has regained half her hit points, she regains consciousness.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature not immune to the {@condition poisoned} condition that starts its turn within 30 feet of Gegazol must succeed on a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} until the start of that creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to Gegazol's stench for 1 hour.

trait.name: Turning Defiance
entries: Gegazol and undead within 120 feet of her have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Gegazol can use her frightful presence. She then makes three attacks: one with her bite and two with her claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 2d12 + 8}) piercing damage, 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage and 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 23} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of Gegazol's choice within 120 feet of and aware of her must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Gegazol's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Breath of Long Night {@recharge 5}
entries: Gegazol exhales frozen material and rot in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw, taking 45 ({@damage 10d8}) cold damage and 45 ({@damage 10d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Those who fail the save also gain two levels of {@condition exhaustion} until the end of Gegazol's next turn, and those who fail by 5 or more are also {@condition blinded} for 1 minute. A {@condition blinded} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary.name: Daemon Sight
entries: Gegazol gains truesight out to 120 feet until the end of her next turn and can make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Tail
entries: Gegazol makes a tail attack.

legendary.name: Wings of Winter (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Gegazol beats her wings. Each creature within 30 feet of her must succeed on a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw or take 17 ({@damage 2d8 + 8}) bludgeoning damage and 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage, and then fall {@condition prone}. Gegazol can then fly up to half her flying speed.

trait.name: Acidic Touch
entries: At the start of the gelatinooze's turn, it can choose to secrete a small dose of acid (no action required). Each creature that is grappling it or that it is grappling takes acid damage equal to the gelatinooze's Constitution modifier.

trait.name: Dissolve Metal (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: Over the course of 1 minute, the gelatinooze can dissolve up to 1 pound of nonmagical metal it is touching.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) acid damage.

trait.name: Dungeon Born
entries: The geleton has advantage on any ability checks it makes to locate or identify hidden features of dungeons, such as traps or secret passageways.

trait.name: Ooze Ancestry
entries: The geleton doesn't need to breathe. The geleton doesn't require sleep, gaining the benefits of a long rest after spending 4 hours in a trance-like state. The geleton has advantage on saving throws against disease.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The geleton makes two weapon attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage if wielded with two hands.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The gem jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the jelly remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from a natural crystal formation.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gem jelly makes two Pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod (True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Crystalline Shatter (Crystalline Form Only)
entries: The jelly shatters their hardened outer layer, returning to their true form and sending crystal shrapnel in all directions. Each creature within 10 feet of the gem jelly must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Gem jellies are immune to this damage.

bonus.name: Harden
entries: The gem jelly transforms into a psionically hardened crystalline form or back into their true form. While in crystalline form, the jelly's AC increases to 20, their speed becomes 0, they can't make Pseudopod attacks, they have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, and they gain vulnerability to thunder damage.

reaction.name: Reactive Shatter (Crystalline Form Only)
entries: When the jelly takes thunder damage, they use Crystalline Shatter.

hp.special: 8 + eight times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the jelly remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from a natural crystal formation.

trait.name: Flowing Jelly
entries: The jelly can occupy their caregiver's space and vice versa, and it doesn't count as difficult terrain for them.
While occupying the same space as the jelly, the caregiver can take the Hide action to hide from creatures outside the jelly.

action.name: Signature Attack (Pseudopod)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Stretch Attack (2 Ferocity)
entries: The jelly makes a signature attack with a reach of 10 feet. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} damage, and the jelly can pull the target 5 feet toward them.

action.name: 3rd Level: Crystallize (5 Ferocity)
entries: The jelly grows sharp crystals from the ground in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on the jelly. Until the start of the jelly's next turn, that area becomes difficult terrain for their enemies, and when an enemy moves into or within that area, the enemy takes 2 × PB piercing damage for every 5 feet they travel.

action.name: 5th Level: Shatter (8 Ferocity)
entries: The jelly ejects jagged crystals from their body toward each enemy within 10 feet of them.
Each target must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage PBd6} piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Germination Stall
languages: the languages its staff knew in life

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The stall's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 15}). The stall can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

trait.name: Alluring Affluence
entries: Whenever a humanoid ends its turn within 60 feet of the stall, it must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has no hint that it is gradually falling under the effects of the stall's enchantment. If a creature succeeds on three of these saves, it is immune to this effect for the next 24 hours. If the creature fails three of these saves, it becomes {@condition charmed} by the stall and must use all its movement on its turns to get as close to the stall as possible. The effect lasts for 24 hours or until the stall dies, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or ends the effect on the creature as a bonus action.

trait.name: Dedicated Staff
entries: The stall comprises a staff of 5 ({@dice 2d4}) {@creature seed coin pollinator|GriffonsSaddlebag2|seed coin pollinators}. This staff collectively shares the stall's Innate Spellcasting and Magic Resistance traits, they can't willingly move more than 150 feet away from the stall, and they seek to defend the stall at all costs, including to their own peril. Some of the stall's effects can use a member or members of its staff as the point of origin.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: The stall is indistinguishable from a normal merchant stall. However, a creature that has {@sense truesight} sees a deep red aura radiating from the stall, and a creature within 30 feet of it that is under the effect of a {@spell detect poison and disease} spell senses the insidious nature of the stall and knows it is a plant creature.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The stall has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The stall doesn't require sleep. If the stall spends 1 hour in direct sunlight, it receives enough nourishment to sustain itself for one day. If the stall dies, it decomposes and is reduced to dirt within 7 days.

action.name: Enthralling Vines
entries: The stall causes dark, creeping vines to protrude from itself and its staff, lashing out at creatures nearby. Each creature of the stall's choice within 10 feet of it or a member of its staff must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} by the vines for 1 minute. While {@condition restrained} in this way, a creature has disadvantage on saving throws against the stall's Alluring Affluence. A creature {@condition restrained} by the vines can use its action to make a {@dc 14} Strength check, freeing itself on a success. These vines disappear if the stall dies, or if it uses this action again. It can also choose to end the effect early on any number of {@condition restrained} creatures it chooses as a bonus action.

action.name: Hostile Takeover
entries: The stall attempts to magically compel one creature {@condition charmed} by it that is within 5 feet of the stall or a member of its staff to swallow a {@creature seed coin|GriffonsSaddlebag2}. The target must make a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target swallows the coin and is subjected to the seed coin's Infestation. When subjected to the effect in this way, the diseased creature is killed in a number of hours equal to half its Wisdom score, unless the disease is removed. If the target successfully saves against this effect or the effect ends for it, it regurgitates the coin and is no longer {@condition charmed} by the stall, and it is immune to the stall's Alluring Affluence for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Bred to the Saddle
entries: The gerridae can't be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened} while it has a rider.

trait.name: Water Bound
entries: For every hour the gerridae spends on dry land, its hp maximum is reduced by 2 ({@dice 1d4}).

trait.name: Water Walker
entries: The gerridae can move across the surface of water as if it were harmless, solid ground. This trait works like the {@spell water walk} spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gerridae makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

name: Gerta Downyruff
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Gerta can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. She lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement, and takes no falling damage. Gerta can't glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: Gerta has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Patterned Feathers
entries: Gerta has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks when she attempts to hide in a forest.

trait.name: Talons
entries: Gerta has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface her talons could reasonably grip.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Gerta makes two ranged attacks.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage. Gerta can choose to {@action grapple} a target hit by this attack as a bonus action.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Ephemeral Body
entries: The crawler can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

trait.name: Seer's Strand
entries: The crawler can see and hear through the space of its Ether Webs as if it were in that space.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The crawler can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The crawler ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the crawler knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crawler makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, it has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of the crawler's next turn.

action.name: Ether Webs (2/Day)
entries: The crawler fills a 5-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} with {@condition Invisible|XPHB}, ephemeral webs for 8 hours. If the web isn't anchored between two solid masses (such as walls or trees) or layered across a floor, wall, or ceiling, the web collapses on itself and vanishes. When a creature touches the webbing, the crawler knows the location of the creature as long as they are on the same plane of existence.

name: Ghost Dragon

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The dragon can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The dragon can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. It takes 5 ({@dice 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon can use its Horrifying Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Withering Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) necrotic damage, plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) cold damage.

action.name: Withering Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Withering Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d8 + 1}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Horrifying Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages {@dice 1d4 × 10} years. A {@condition frightened} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the {@condition frightened} condition on itself of a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Horrifying Presence for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a {@spell greater restoration} spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

action.name: Chilling Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales deathly cold energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 ({@damage 18d6}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendaryHeader: The dragon can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The dragon regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The dragon makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: The dragon makes a tail attack.

legendary.name: Etherealness (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of the dragon must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) necrotic damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

trait.name: Locked Saddle
entries: The ghost knight can't be knocked {@condition prone}, dismounted, or moved against its will while mounted.

trait.name: Mounted Warrior
entries: The ghost knight is rarely seen without its warhorse skeleton mount. The warhorse skeleton wears custom barding that raises its Armor Class to 15, and it has immunity to necrotic damage. While the ghost knight is mounted, its mount can't be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Necrotic Weapons
entries: The ghost knight's weapon attacks are magical. When the knight hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 2d6} necrotic damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Spirited Charge
entries: If the ghost knight moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature while mounted and then hits with a Lance attack on the same turn, the ghost knight can use a bonus action to command its mount to make one melee weapon attack against that creature as a reaction.

trait.name: Turning Defiance
entries: The ghost knight and any undead within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The ghost knight doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ghost knight makes three Battleaxe or Lance attacks. If the ghost knight is mounted, it can make two Battleaxe or Lance attacks, and its mount can make one melee weapon attack.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Lance
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d12 + 3}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

name: Ghost Sycophant

hp.special: Six times their level (number of d6 Hit Dice equal to their level)

languages: any two languages they knew in life

action.name: Signature Attack (Dark Essence)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage. This spell's damage increases by {@damage 1d10} when the sycophant reaches 5th level ({@damage 2d10}), 11th level ({@damage 3d10}), and 17th level ({@damage 4d10}).

action.name: 3rd Level: Call of the Dead (3/Day)
entries: When the sycophant hits a creature with a signature attack, the target must also succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the sycophant for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: 5th Level: Astral Presence (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the sycophant becomes {@condition invisible} for 1 minute or until they use a bonus action to end this effect. While {@condition invisible}, the sycophant can move through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain, and the sycophant's signature attacks deal an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} damage to creatures who can't see them. The sycophant takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if they end their turn inside an object.

action.name: 7th Level: Whispers of the Dead (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the sycophant chooses up to PB creatures they can see within 30 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Charisma saving throw or make an attack against their nearest ally (no action required). A {@condition frightened} creature has disadvantage on the saving throw.

trait.name: Ghostly Body (Ghostwalk Form Only)
entries: The ghostwalk spider has resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage and to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks, and it has immunity to the {@condition grappled}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition petrified}, and {@condition restrained} conditions.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement (Ghostwalk Form Only)
entries: The ghostwalk spider can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ghostwalk spider makes one Bite attack and one Ghostly Snare attack, or it makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) piercing damage. If the ghostwalk spider is in its true form, the target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 13 ({@damage 3d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hp, the target is stable but {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour, even after regaining hp, and is {@condition paralyzed} while {@condition poisoned} in this way.

action.name: Ghostly Snare (Ghostwalk Form Only, Recharge 4-6)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}The target is {@condition restrained} by {@condition invisible} webbing. While {@condition restrained} in this way, the target is {@condition invisible}. As an action, the {@condition restrained} target can make a {@dc 15} Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 12; hp 15; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

bonus.name: Ghostwalk
entries: The ghostwalk spider magically takes on a ghostly form or returns to its true, tangible form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying becomes ghostly with it. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

name: Ghoul
languages: the languages they knew in life

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ghoul makes one Barbed Tongue attack and one Claws attack. If both attacks hit the same creature, the target is {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the end of the target's next turn.

action.name: Barbed Tongue
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage, and the target can't take reactions until the end of their next turn.

bonus.name: Hungry Charge
entries: The ghoul moves up to half their speed in a straight line. If the ghoul moves at least 15 feet and ends this movement within 5 feet of a creature, they have advantage on the next attack roll they make against that creature until the end of the ghoul's next turn.

name: Ghoul Craver
languages: the languages they knew in life

trait.name: Ever So Hungry
entries: Enemies can't take the Disengage action while three or more cravers are within 5 feet of them.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the craver takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the craver takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Just a Taste (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}1 slashing damage, and the next non-minion ghoul who attacks that target before the start of the craver's next turn gains a bonus to the attack roll equal to the number of cravers who joined the attack.

trait.name: Blood Scent
entries: The ghoul lord has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks to Search for creatures who are not Constructs or Undead. It can automatically detect any creature that isn't a Construct or Undead within 10 feet of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ghoul lord makes two attacks.

action.name: Soulbinding Mace
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Necrotic damage. {@actSave cha} {@dc 13}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Jinxed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 1d6}; save ends).

action.name: Abyssal Pull
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, range 120 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target is pulled 15 feet toward the ghoul lord.

bonus.name: Shield Slam
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 14}, one creature within 5 feet of the ghoul lord. {@actSaveFail} The target is pushed 10 feet away from the ghoul lord and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

reaction.name: Unyielding
entries: {@actTrigger} The ghoul lord is subjected to an effect that would move it, cause it to have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, or both. {@actSaveFail} The ghoul lord is neither moved nor has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Deathly Teeth
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d10 + 3}) Necrotic damage, and the target can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} until the start of the ghoul priest's next turn.

bonus.name: Reanimate
entries: The ghoul priest chooses the corpse of a ghoul it can see within 60 feet. The ghoul returns to life with 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and stands up.

action.name: Multiattack

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the giant ant can't Bite a different target.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage. The target must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 11 ({@damage 2d10}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The giant ant queen has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Queen's Scent
entries: Giant ants within 30 feet of the queen have advantage on attack rolls against any creature that attacked the queen within the last minute.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant ant queen makes two Bite attacks and one Sting attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the giant ant queen can't Bite a different target.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage. The target must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: The antlion has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has {@status surprised}.

trait.name: Burrowed Camouflage
entries: While it is at least partially burrowed, the antlion has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in sand or loose earth.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). Until this grapple ends the antlion can't bite another target.

reaction.name: Snapping Jaws
entries: While the antlion is benefiting from its Burrowed Camoflage and not grappling a creature, when a creature the antlion can sense moves into the antlion's space, it can make a bite attack against that creature.

trait.name: Bloodmire Adaptation
entries: The eel is immune to the diseases described in the {@table Bloodmire Diseases|GriffonsSaddlebag2} table.

trait.name: Water and Blood Breathing
entries: The eel can breathe only underwater or under bloodwater.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The eel makes two bite attacks.

action.name: Bite

trait.name: Bioluminescent Glow
entries: The Giant Bora Bug emits a soft light from its spiked wing casing, shedding dim light in a 10-foot radius around it.

action.name: Horn Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Spike Flurry {@recharge 5}
entries: The Giant Bora Bug releases a flurry of spikes. Each creature within 10 feet of the Giant Bora Bug must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The snake can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the snake moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with its horns on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The snake makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its horns. It can use its constrict attack in place of one other attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage and become {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the creature is {@condition restrained}, and the snake can't constrict another target.

action.name: Horns
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage.

action.name: Hypnotize {@recharge}
entries: The snake causes its horns to begin flashing with a dazzling array of colors. Each creature of the snake's choice within 60 feet of it that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition charmed} by the snake for 1 minute. A {@condition charmed} creature must spend each of its turns moving toward the snake by the shortest and most direct route. A {@condition charmed} creature already within 5 feet of the snake doesn't move and takes no actions on its turn. While {@condition charmed} in this way, the snake has advantage on attack rolls against the creature. If an affected creature takes any damage, or if another creature uses an action to shake the creature out of its trance, the creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The Giant Jellyfish can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Toxins
entries: A creature that comes in physical contact with a Giant Jellyfish must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage and become {@condition Stunned} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The Giant Koi can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Giant Koi makes three Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) bludgeoning damage

trait.name: Bloodmire Adaptation
entries: The mosquito is immune to the diseases described in the {@table Bloodmire Diseases|GriffonsSaddlebag2} table.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Pixie has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. Innate Spellcasting. The Pixie's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: {@spell Druidcraft|PHB}, {@spell Jolt|ObojimaTallGrass}, {@spell Root Grab|ObojimaTallGrass}, {@spell Transparency|ObojimaTallGrass}

1/day each: {@spell Confusion|PHB}, {@spell Control Animal|ObojimaTallGrass}, {@spell Detect Thoughts|PHB}, {@spell Entangle|PHB}, {@spell Obscure Object|ObojimaTallGrass}, {@spell Pacify Person|ObojimaTallGrass}, {@spell Sleep|PHB}, {@spell Whelm Weapon|ObojimaTallGrass}

trait.name: Gift of Flight
entries: The Pixie magically grants a creature it can see a Flying speed of 30 feet. The creature keeps its Flying speed, as long as the Pixie is holding its breath. The Pixie can hold its breath for a number of minutes equal to 1 + its Constitution modifier (minimum of 30 seconds). The Pixie can only grant this effect to one creature at a time, and when the effect ends, it must wait 1 minute before using it again.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The giant ratling has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant ratling makes two Claw attacks and one Bite attack. It can replace up to two attacks with uses of Hurl Ratling.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Slashing damage. Critical {@h}The target has the {@condition Staggered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of the giant ratling's next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d12 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Hurl Ratling
entries: The giant ratling picks up a willing Medium or smaller ratling ally or corpse within 5 feet. {@actSave dex} {@dc 14}, one creature the giant ratling can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The hurled ratling takes the same damage and lands with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: Enrage {@recharge 5}
entries: The giant ratling gains 15 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. Until the {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} are lost, the giant ratling has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength-based {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests}.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The rat has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The rat has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the rat's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The rat can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw, taking 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is {@condition paralyzed} while {@condition poisoned} in this way.

trait.name: Flora Flit
entries: Once on each of its turns, the lizard can use 10 feet of its movement to step magically into any living flora (such as a plant, mold, or fungus) within 5 feet of it and emerge from a second living flora within 60 feet of it, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second flora. Both florae must be Medium or larger. If the lizard takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Nature Stride
entries: Moving through nonmagical {@quickref difficult terrain||3} costs the lizard no extra movement. It can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.

trait.name: Organic Camouflage
entries: The lizard has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in flora.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Retaliatory Spores
entries: When the lizard takes bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, it ejects a flurry of poisonous spores around itself. Each creature within 5 feet of the lizard must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Snap Jaw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is also {@condition Grappled} (escape {@dc 12}) as the Venus Fly Rat clamps down with its powerful jaws. While {@condition Grappled} in this way, the target takes 4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Tail Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Pollen Burst {@recharge 5}
entries: The Venus Fly Rat releases a burst of pollen in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or be affected by the {@spell Confusion} spell for 1 minute. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Giant Zombie
languages: understands the languages they knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Negative Nerves
entries: Whenever a creature deals 7 damage or less to the zombie, the zombie takes no damage instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zombie makes two Fist attacks.

action.name: Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). The zombie has two fists, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Toxic Exhalation {@recharge 5}
entries: The zombie spews toxic vomit in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Shove Away
entries: When a Huge or smaller creature within 10 feet of the zombie hits them with a melee attack, the zombie pushes the creature up to 10 feet away.

name: Gibbering Mouther
languages: speaks all languages but doesn't understand any

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The gibbering mouther is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

trait.name: Primordial Influence
entries: A {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} enemy who starts their turn within 20 feet of the gibbering mouther must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, that creature's body is altered in an otherworldly way of the GM's choice—they might flicker in and out of reality, sprout miniature fingers from their fingers, or have their physical form altered in a similarly alien way. This alteration doesn't affect the creature's game statistics. A {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power of 4th order or higher, a {@spell greater restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect reverses this alteration.

While altered in this way, a creature must repeat the saving throw whenever they finish a long rest. On a failed save, their previous alteration worsens or they experience another chaotic alteration of the GM's choice. If a creature fails this saving throw three times after their initial alteration, they transform into a gibbering mouther controlled by the GM, and only a {@spell wish} spell can restore the creature to their original form.

trait.name: Viscous Vicinity
entries: The gibbering mouther envelops their surroundings in their shifting reality. The area within 20 feet of them is difficult terrain for other creatures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gibbering mouther makes two Reality Rend attacks. They can replace one attack with a use of Pull.

action.name: Reality Rend
entries: {@atk mp} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the start of the gibbering mouther's next turn.

action.name: Pull
entries: The gibbering mouther warps reality around up to three creatures they can see within 60 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 30 feet directly toward the gibbering mouther.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The gibbering mouther is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

trait.name: Viscous Vicinity
entries: The gibbering mouther envelops their surroundings in their shifting reality. The area within 10 feet of them is difficult terrain for other creatures.

action.name: Signature Attack (Reality Rend)
entries: {@atk mp} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} psychic damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Stretch Attack (2 Ferocity)
entries: The gibbering mouther makes a signature attack with a reach of 10 feet. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} damage, and the gibbering mouther can pull the target 5 feet toward them.

action.name: 3rd Level: Reality Pull (5 Ferocity)
entries: The gibbering mouther warps reality around up to PB enemies within 60 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 20 feet directly toward the gibbering mouther.

action.name: 5th Level: Vicinity Shift (8 Ferocity)
entries: The gibbering mouther and each ally within 30 feet of them gains a +PB bonus to damage rolls and has their speed doubled until the start of the gibbering mouther's next turn. Additionally, the gibbering mouther can make one signature attack as part of this action.

name: Gil Hopper
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Gil can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. Gil lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement and takes no falling damage. Gil cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or sheilds (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

trait.name: Aerial Defense
entries: As long as Gil is falling, gliding, or jumping, attacks made against him have disadvantage.

trait.name: Talons
entries: Gil has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface his talons could reasonably grip.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The gilded devil casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the gilded devil's darkvision.

trait.name: Golden Flail
entries: The gilded devil's Golden Flail attacks are magical. When the devil hits with the Golden Flail, the flail deals an extra {@damage 4d6} fire damage (included in the attack). In addition, the devil can transform the flail into gold jewelry or back into a weapon as a bonus action.

trait.name: Liar's Largesse
entries: If a creature accepts a gift of jewelry from the gilded devil, the creature becomes cursed until cured by a {@spell remove curse} spell or similar magic. While cursed, the creature has disadvantage on saving throws against the devil's spells and abilities.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The gilded devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gilded devil makes two Golden Flail attacks or three Hurl Flame attacks.

action.name: Golden Flail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Hurl Flame
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) fire damage.

action.name: Teleport {@recharge 4}
entries: The gilded devil magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

action.name: Voracious Greed
entries: The gilded devil magically consumes up to 1 cubic foot of nonmagical jewelry or coins made of precious material within 5 feet of it. It regains 5 hp for every 200 gp of the consumed objects' value. If the jewelry or coins are being worn or carried by a creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw to prevent the consumption.

bonus.name: Betrayal of Riches {@recharge 4}
entries: One creature wearing jewelry (an object made of precious material and worth at least 100 gp) the gilded devil can see within 60 feet of it must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 13 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage and suffers an effect until it finishes a short rest. The effect is based on the location of the worn jewelry (devil's choice if worn in multiple locations): on upper limbs, its melee damage is halved; on lower limbs, its speed is halved; on head, it is {@condition blinded} or {@condition deafened} (devil's choice); on body, it has vulnerability to bludgeoning damage. On a success, the target takes half the damage and doesn't suffer an additional effect.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The gilitrutt troll regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gilitrutt troll makes two Bite or three Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite (Hound Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Claw (Troll Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Slashing damage.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The gilitrutt troll shape-shifts into a Large hound ({@variantrule Speed|XPHB} 40 ft.), or it returns to its troll form. Its game statistics, other than its size and {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, are the same in each form (except where noted). Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

trait.name: Occupation
entries: Counsellor, Seer

trait.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Grim, Wary

trait.name: Frigid Aura
entries: Nonmagical flames within 15 feet of the troll are snuffed out. Ongoing magical flames, such as those from a {@spell Flaming Sphere|XPHB} or {@spell Wall of Fire|XPHB} spell, also have a chance of being snuffed out. If any part of such a magical flame overlaps with the aura, the caster must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw. {@actSaveFail} The spell ends. If the caster succeeds on the save, they do not need to make additional saves for that casting of that spell.

trait.name: Icy Carapace
entries: A creature within 5 feet of the troll that hits it with a melee attack takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Cold damage.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The glacial troll regains 15 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the glacial troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the glacial troll's next turn. The glacial troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The glacial troll makes three Ice Rend attacks. It can substitute one Ice Rend attack with its Hoary Breath.

action.name: Ice Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Cold damage.

action.name: Hoary Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16} One target within 5 feet of it. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 3d6}) Cold damage, and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition for 1 minute due to ice forming around it. A creature with the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition can make a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw at the end of each of its turns to break free from the ice, ending the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The bulette can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Steam Aura
entries: At the end of each of the bulette's turns, each creature of the bulette's choice in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the bulette takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Fire damage unless the bulette has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The bulette can burrow through solid ice and leaves a slick, 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bulette makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d12 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Fire damage.

action.name: Steam Eruption {@recharge 5}
entries: If the bulette is burrowed no more than 20 feet deep in solid ice, it spends 5 feet of movement to burrow directly upward, emerging from the ice and jumping to a space within 5 feet of where it emerged. {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}, each creature in the space where the bulette emerged or its destination space. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The target is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space within 5 feet of where the bulette emerged or its destination space.

entries: The glass gator can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Constricting Lunge
entries: If the glass gator jumps at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Claw attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the gator can make one Constrict attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The glass gator's long jump is up to 15 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Transparent
entries: The glass gator has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide while underwater or in dim light.

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) slashing damage.
