Until the grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage at the start of each of its turns, and the glass gator can't use Constrict on another target.

reaction.name: Silt Cloud (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: When it takes damage while underwater and within 5 feet of the bottom of a body of water, the glass gator stirs up a 10-foot-radius sphere of silt centered on it. The silt spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. It lasts for 1 minute or until a strong current disperses it. The glass gator can then swim up to half its speed. The cloud of silt doesn't move with the glass gator.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The everbug has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

action.name: Shatterbite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h} {@damage 1} piercing damage + 3 ({@damage 1d6}) thunder damage.

action.name: Glass Song (1/Day)
entries: The glassbeetle weaves a strange and beautiful melody, which it can maintain for up to 10 minutes, or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Creatures within 100 feet of the glassbeetle who can hear this song must succeed on a {@dc 12} Intelligence saving throw or become {@condition charmed} by the glassbeetle for as long as they can hear the music.

name: Glinda Nightseed
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Glinda is a 9th level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 15}, +7 to hit with spell attacks). Glinda has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Glinda can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. Glinda lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement, and takes no falling damage. Glinda cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

trait.name: Wing Flap
entries: As a bonus action, Glinda can use her powerful feathered arms to propel herself upward up to half her movement speed. Glinda can use it in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

trait.name: Seedspeech
entries: Glinda can communicate simple ideas to living plants, and is able to interpret their responses in simple language.

action.name: Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d6 - 1}) bludgeoning damage, or 3 ({@damage 1d8 - 1}) bludgeoning damage if used with both hands.

trait.name: Blighted Aura
entries: The ground in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the gloomwood is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} from mushrooms and fungus that grow in the area. A creature that ends its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Carved Past
entries: As an action, a creature can use a Dagger or Woodcarver's Tools to carve the name in Sylvan of the ancient home of the gloomwoods into the gloomwood's trunk. Until the gloomwood finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, it can't use its Fungal Fling or Spore Stomp actions.

trait.name: Fungal Step
entries: The gloomwood ignores {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} caused by plants or fungi.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gloomwood makes two attacks, using Slam or Fungal Fling in any combination.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}) from one of two branches. Until the grapple ends, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Fungal Fling
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 10}, range 60/180 ft. {@h}23 ({@damage 5d6 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Spore Stomp {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage. {@hom}Each creature within a 20-foot {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on the target must make the following saving throw. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

name: Glutted Dreamholder

trait.name: Phantasmal Cone
entries: The dreamholder's central eye creates an area of phantasmagoric horrors—illusory manifestations unique to each creature—within a 150-foot cone. At the start of each of its turns, the dreamholder decides which way the cone faces and whether the cone is active. Each creature within the cone at the end of the dreamholder's turn must succeed on a {@dc 20} Intelligence saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage and become frightened of the dreamholder and the illusions within the area until the end of the dreamholder's next turn.
As an affected creature is surrounded by these illusions, the source of its fear is in every direction, rendering it unable to move in any direction while it can see these sources of its fear.

trait.name: Inconsistent Incoporeality
entries: When the dreamholder takes 15 or more psychic or thunder damage in a single instance, it becomes corporeal until the start of its next turn. While corporeal, it loses its Incorporeal Movement trait; its immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage; and its immunity to the grappled and restrained conditions.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The dreamholder can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dreamholder fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Dreameater
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}49 ({@damage 8d10 + 5}) psychic damage.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The dreamholder shoots five of the following magical eye rays at random (roll a d6 to determine which ray isn't fired), choosing one to five creatures it can see within 120 feet of it:

items.name: 1. Charm Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the dreamholder for 1 hour, or until the dreamholder harms the target.

items.name: 2. Confusion Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or be afflicted by the confusion spell until the end of its next turn.

items.name: 3. Static Ray
entries: The target must make a {@dc 20} Intelligence saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, a target has muddled thoughts for 1 minute. During that time, it rolls a d6 and subtracts the number rolled from all its attack rolls and ability checks, as well as its Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 4. Rot Ray
entries: The target must make a {@dc 20} Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, its grey matter deteriorates, it takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) necrotic damage, and it has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls it makes until the end of its next turn. On a success it takes half as much damage and suffers no additional effects.

items.name: 5. Incorporeal Shunt Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw or become momentarily incorporeal, be pushed up to 30 feet directly away from the dreamholder, and then rematerialise. The creature takes 36 ({@damage 8d8}) force damage if it rematerialises inside an object. If the creature rematerialises in another creature's space, both creatures take this damage. The target is then pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

items.name: 6. Nightmare Ray
entries: The target is assailed by illusory manifestations of its fears. It must make a {@dc 20} Intelligence saving throw, taking 44 ({@damage 8d10}) psychic damage on a failure or half as much damage on a success.

legendaryHeader: The dreamholder can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The dreamholder regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Eye Ray
entries: The dreamholder uses one random eye ray.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: The dreamholder teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of it. If it is within its lair it doesn't need to see this space to teleport to it.

legendary.name: Mirror (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Two illusory dreamholders appear within 30 feet of the dreamholder, and the dreamholder can then immediately teleport, switching places with one of the illusory duplicates. Physical interaction with the illusory dreamholder, such as hitting it with an attack, reveals it to be an illusion. A creature can use its action to make a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|PHB}) check to inspect one dreamholder within 30 feet of it, determining if it's an illusion on a success. When the dreamholder uses an eye ray, all the illusions fire the same eye rays at the same target, and when it teleports, so too do the illusions. All the illusions disappear at the end of the dreamholder's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The seraph's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 16}). The seraph can innately cast the following spells, using only verbal components:

1: {@spell create food and water} (the food is tasty and the seraph can create wine instead of water)

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The seraph has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Seraphic Weapons
entries: The seraph's weapon attacks are magical. When the seraph hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage (included in the attacks).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The seraph makes three attacks, only one of which can be a bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 3d12 + 5}) piercing damage and 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the seraph can't bite another target.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage and 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Tongue
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 20 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d4 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}) and pulled to within 5 feet of the seraph. Until the grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the seraph can't use its tongue or bite on another target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The seraph makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it holds {@condition grappled}. If the attack hits, the target takes the bite's damage, the grapple ends, and the target is swallowed. While swallowed, a creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against anything originating outside the seraph, and takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage and 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage at the start of each of the seraph's turns. The seraph can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If the seraph takes 35 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the seraph must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the swallowed creature, which falls {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of the seraph. If the seraph dies, the swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The gnarljak doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the gnarljak remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal bear trap.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gnarljak makes one Gnawing Bite attack and two Chain Tail attacks, or it makes three Chain Tail attacks.

action.name: Gnawing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage, and the gnarljak attaches to the target. While attached, the gnarljak can't make Gnawing Bite attacks, and at the start of each of the gnarljak's turns, the target takes 14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage.

The attached gnarljak moves with the target whenever the target moves, requiring none of the gnarljak's movement. It can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement on its turn. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the gnarljak by succeeding on a {@dc 16} Strength check.

action.name: Chain Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Secure Tail
entries: When within 10 feet of the ground, structure, wall, or other solid surface, the gnarljak can secure its tail spike on a point in the surface within 10 feet of it. While secured, the gnarljak can't be knocked {@condition prone}, it can't move more than 10 feet from that point, and its Chain Tail attack's reach is reduced to 5 feet. If the gnarljak is attached to a creature while its tail is secured, the creature is {@condition restrained} until the gnarljak is no longer attached to it.

trait.name: Bloodscent
entries: The abyssal archer knows the location of each creature who doesn't have all their hit points within 60 feet of them.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target's walking speed is reduced by a cumulative 5 feet until they regain at least 1 hit point.

reaction.name: Death Frenzy
entries: When an ally the abyssal archer can see within 30 feet of them is reduced to 0 hit points, the abyssal archer moves up to half their speed and makes a Bite attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The summoner makes two attacks using Bite, Three-Tail Flail, Fire Blast, or a combination of them. They can replace one attack with a use of Demonic Howl, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, another creature the summoner can see within 30 feet of them magically regains 7 ({@damage 2d6}) hit points. If this attack is made against a willing ally, it automatically hits.

action.name: Three-Tail Flail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 3d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 5 feet away from the summoner.

action.name: Fire Blast (Cantrip)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Demonic Howl {@recharge 5}
entries: Until the beginning of the summoner's next turn, each ally within 30 feet of the summoner who can hear them has advantage on attack rolls.

action.name: Uplift (3/Day)
entries: The gnoll magically turns an allied {@creature abyssal hyena|FleeMortals} into a {@creature gnoll marauder|FleeMortals} for 1 hour.

bonus.name: Summon Abyssal Hyenas (3/Day)
entries: The summoner summons {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature abyssal hyena|FleeMortals}s, who appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of the summoner. The hyenas act immediately after the summoner's turn and follow the summoner's commands.

reaction.name: Death Frenzy
entries: When an ally the summoner can see within 30 feet of them is reduced to 0 hit points, the summoner moves up to half their speed and makes a Bite attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bonesplitter makes two attacks using Bite, Spiked Flail, or both. They can replace one attack with a use of Bloody Roar, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage, or 11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage if the target is {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Spiked Flail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and the bonesplitter can't make Spiked Flail attacks.

action.name: Bloody Roar {@recharge}
entries: The bonesplitter roars, spitting a spray of blood. Each ally within 10 feet of them who can see them can make a weapon attack (no action required), provided that ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

bonus.name: Over Here!
entries: The bonesplitter yanks a creature they are grappling. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or swap spaces with the bonesplitter.

reaction.name: Death Frenzy
entries: When an ally the bonesplitter can see within 30 feet of them is reduced to 0 hit points, the bonesplitter moves up to half their speed and makes a Bite attack.

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the gnoll brute hits with it (included in the attacks).

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the gnoll brute moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack on the same turn, the target takes one extra die of the weapon's damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Instinctive
entries: The gnoll brute has advantage on initiative rolls and saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}. If surprised, the gnoll can still act normally on its first turn.

trait.name: Rampage
entries: When the gnoll brute reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the gnoll can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gnoll brute makes one bite attack and one claws attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Shared Rampage
entries: If any creature allied with and within 100 feet of the gnoll brute uses its Rampage trait, the gnoll brute can use its Rampage trait, too, provided the brute can see that ally.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cackler makes one Bite attack or one Chill Touch attack and uses Moment of Brutality.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Chill Touch (Cantrip)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of the cackler's next turn.

action.name: Moment of Brutality
entries: The cackler targets a creature they can see within 30 feet of them, magically flooding them with fury. The target must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw, which they can choose to fail. A creature who can't be {@condition charmed} succeeds on this saving throw automatically. On a failed save, the target takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage, then makes a Bite attack against a creature of the cackler's choice within 5 feet of the target. If the target has no Bite attack, they make an unarmed strike that deals piercing damage equal to {@damage 1d4} + their Strength modifier on a hit.

action.name: Fiendish Cackle {@recharge 5}
entries: The cackler unleashes a spine-chilling laugh. Each enemy within 30 feet of them who can hear them must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the cackler for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

reaction.name: Death Frenzy
entries: When an ally the cackler can see within 30 feet of them is reduced to 0 hit points, the cackler moves up to half their speed and makes a Bite attack.

reaction.name: Fell Teleport
entries: When a creature who the cackler can see within 30 feet of them dies, the cackler magically teleports into the space the creature occupied.

hp.special: Eight times their level (number of d10 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Bite)
entries: {@atk mw} +3 plus damage. Beginning at 7th level, the gnasher can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Frenzied Bite (3/Day)
entries: When a creature the gnasher can see within 30 feet of them is reduced to 0 hit points, the gnasher can use a reaction to move up to half their speed and then make a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 5th Level: Flurry of Fangs (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the gnasher makes a signature attack against up to PB creatures within 5 feet of them.

action.name: 7th Level: Horrific Feast (1/Day)
entries: When the gnasher reduces a creature to 0 hit points with their signature attack, they can consume part of the creature as part of the attack, gaining {@damage PBd10} temporary hit points. Each enemy within 30 feet of the gnasher who can see them must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the gnasher until the end of the gnasher's next turn.

trait.name: Harrying Attacks
entries: If the gnoll attacks more than one creature in the same turn, the first target has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The gnoll has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the gnoll's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gnoll makes one Bite attack and two Battleaxe attacks.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Lightning Lope
entries: The gnoll takes the Dash or Disengage action.

trait.name: Life Eater
entries: When an enemy the mage-gorger can see within 30 feet of them regains hit points, the mage-gorger chooses one non-minion ally they can see within 30 feet of them. That ally regains 2 hit points.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the mage-gorger takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the mage-gorger takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Wizard Ripper (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 slashing damage plus 2 acid, cold, fire, or lightning damage (mage-gorger's choice), and until the start of the mage-gorger's next turn, the target has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain {@status concentration}, including any Constitution saving throw triggered by this attack. Only one damage type is chosen for this attack regardless of how many mage-gorgers joined it.

trait.name: Rampaging Charge
entries: If the marauder moves at least 10 feet straight toward a creature and hits them with a Flail attack on the same turn, the marauder can make a Bite attack against that target as a bonus action.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Flail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Death Frenzy
entries: When an ally the marauder can see within 30 feet of them is reduced to 0 hit points, the marauder moves up to half their speed and makes a Bite attack.

trait.name: Death Feast
entries: When an ally within 5 feet of the wildling is reduced to 0 hit points, the wildling can deal 1 piercing damage to a creature within 5 feet of them (no action required), provided the wildling isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the wildling takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the wildling takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Flail (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} by each wildling who joined the attack (escape {@dc 10} plus the number of wildlings who have it {@condition grappled}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the wildling can't make a Flail attack against another creature. A wildling can choose to release the {@condition grappled} creature while other wildlings still have them {@condition grappled}, reducing the escape DC accordingly.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The gnome casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}):

trait.name: Prescience
entries: When the gnome finishes a long rest, roll a {@dice d20} and record the number rolled. Before their next long rest, they can replace one attack roll, saving throw, or ability check made by them or a creature that they can see, using this prescience roll. They must choose to do so before the roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gnome uses Dispensing Apparatus and makes one weapon attack.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Acidic Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) acid damage.

action.name: Dispensing Apparatus
entries: A gnomish distiller carries a backpack-like apparatus designed to expel a variety of damaging mixtures. While wearing the apparatus, a distiller can create one of the following effects, the same effect cannot be used twice in a row:

items: The apparatus expels a 20-foot-radius sphere of poisonous gas centered on a point the distiller chooses within 30 feet. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. The gas lingers in the air for 1 minute. A creature that starts its turn in the cloud must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or spend its action that turn retching and reeling.

The apparatus expels a shower of a caustic solution in a line 30 feet long and 5 feet wide in a direction of the distiller's choice. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

The apparatus expels slick grease in a 10-foot square centered on a point the distiller chooses within 30 feet. When the grease appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Alchemical Capsule
entries: The gnome breaks one of two capsules, contained in artificial teeth, and immediately gains the benefits of the stored potion. Either choose which two potions the gnome has or assume they have a potion of invisibility and a potion of growth.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The gnoph-keh has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gnoph-keh makes six Rending Claw attacks.

action.name: Rending Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, Reach 10 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) Slashing damage.

bonus.name: Heart of the Storm
entries: The gnoph-keh can generate a supernatural storm that fills the area around it in a howling blizzard. Driving snow and wind fill the area in a 300-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} centered on the gnoph-keh. The area is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB}, and exposed flames in the area are doused. This effect ends if the gnoph-keh has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition or dies. It can also dismiss the effect as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.
A creature that ends its turn in this {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Cold damage.

name: Goat-Knight Steed

items.name: Shared Spells
entries: Any spell the {@creature Kraghammer Goat-Knight|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|goat-knight} casts with a range of self also targets the goat.

items.name: Summoned Nature
entries: When a goat-knight steed drops to 0 hit points, it disappears, leaving behind no physical form. The {@creature Kraghammer Goat-Knight|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|goat-knight} can also dismiss the steed at any time as an action, causing it to disappear. In either case, the same steed is summoned when the {@creature Kraghammer Goat-Knight|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|goat-knight} casts {@spell find steed}.

languages: understands Dwarvish but can't speak it

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the goat-man moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Slam attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The goat-man makes one Bite attack and two Slam attacks. If both Slam attacks hit the same target, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The goatstealer has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the goatstealer's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Stench
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 12}, any creature that starts its turn in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the goatstealer. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to the Stench of all goatstealers for 1 hour.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 12}). Until the grapple ends, at the start of each of the goatstealer's turns, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The gobblegeist doesn't provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Repelled by Stars
entries: The gobblegeist can't willingly move to a space within 10 feet of a seven-pointed star drawn on a surface or woven from wicker.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gobblegeist makes two Beak attacks. It can replace one attack with a Talons attack.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage. The target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the gobblegeist regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to that amount.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}) from both talons, and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends.

action.name: Eye Beam
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 120-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line. {@actSaveFail} 6 ({@damage 1d12}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the start of the gobblegeist's next turn.

trait.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The Goblin Archer can take the {@action Disengage} or {@action Hide} action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: The Goblin Archer deals an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the Goblin Archer that isn't incapacitated and the Goblin Archer doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the Goblin Archer has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Jagged Knife
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Bow of Horn
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target cannot regain hit points and has disadvantage on death saving throws while {@condition poisoned} in this way.

variant.name: Hateful Orcs
entries: Some Orcs direct their spite towards some specific folk. To reflect this, the Loremaster may add to an Orc adversary the Hatred special trait.

items.name: Hatred (subject) (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As a bonus action, the creature can gain advantage on attack rolls against the subject of its hatred until the start of its next turn.

For example, the Orcs and Goblins of Goblin-town hate Dwarves, and will attack a Company that includes Dwarves with blind fury. The Orcs of Mount Gram fiercely hate all Hobbits instead, and will relentlessly attack a Company including any.

items.name: Hatred (subject) (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As a bonus action, the Goblin Archer can gain advantage on attack rolls against the subject of its hatred until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Backstab
entries: When the assassin has advantage on their attack roll against a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead, their attacks deal an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage and inflict a bleeding wound on the target that lasts until the bleeding creature regains at least 1 hit point. A bleeding creature loses 2 hit points for each bleeding wound they have at the start of their turn. Any creature who can reach the target can use an action to stanch all the target's wounds, ending the effect.

trait.name: Crafty
entries: The assassin doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they move out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Summon Shadows (1/Day)
entries: A 10-foot-radius sphere of magical darkness emanates from a point the assassin can see for 1 minute. The darkness spreads around corners. Except for the assassin, a creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness, and mundane light can't illuminate it. At the start of their turn, the assassin can move the darkness up to 30 feet to a point they can see (no action required). If the assassin takes damage, the effect ends.

bonus.name: Sneak
entries: The assassin takes the Hide action.

trait.name: Crafty
entries: The cursespitter doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they move out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Toxic Touch (Cantrip)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Brittle Bone Hex (Cantrip)
entries: The cursespitter chooses one creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target's bones are wracked with pain until the end of their next turn. The first time the target willingly moves or uses an action, a bonus action, or a reaction before then, they must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: To Me!
entries: The cursespitter chooses up to two willing creatures they can see within 30 feet of them. Each creature is teleported to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the cursespitter.

action.name: Dizzying Hex (2/Day; 1st-Level Spell)
entries: The cursespitter chooses one creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target falls {@condition prone} and can't stand back up for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

reaction.name: Cowardly Commander
entries: When a creature the cursespitter can see hits them with an attack, the cursespitter chooses a willing ally within 5 feet of them. The attack hits the ally instead.

trait.name: Crafty
entries: The lackey doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they move out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the lackey takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the lackey takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Tiny Stabs
entries: If an enemy starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more lackeys who can see them, the enemy must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1 piercing damage for each lackey within 5 feet. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 + the number of lackeys within 5 feet of the enemy.

action.name: Dagger (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage.

hp.special: Seven times their level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Daggers)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 2d4 plus PB} piercing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the sneak can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Weaving Knives (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the sneak moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Before, during, or after the move, they can make two signature attacks.

action.name: 5th Level: Sneak and Stab (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the sneak takes the Hide action. If the sneak hits a creature they are hidden from with an attack on the same turn, the creature takes an extra {@damage PBd10} piercing damage, and the sneak can immediately take the Hide action (no action required).

action.name: 7th Level: Poisoned Blade (1/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the sneak covers a dagger in a special poison, which lasts for 1 hour or until the sneak hits a creature with a signature attack. A creature hit with the {@condition poisoned} dagger must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage PBd12} poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at the end of turn). On a successful save, the target takes only half as much damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}.

trait.name: Crafty
entries: The sniper doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they move out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Sniper
entries: If the sniper misses with a ranged weapon attack while they are hidden, they remain hidden. Additionally, if the sniper hits a target with a ranged weapon attack while they have advantage on the attack roll, the attack deals an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Sneak
entries: The sniper takes the Hide action.

trait.name: Crafty
entries: The spinecleaver doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they move out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Strong Grip
entries: Wielding a heavy weapon doesn't impose disadvantage on the spinecleaver's attack rolls.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d12 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Handaxe
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Tricksy Warrior
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the spinecleaver misses them with an attack, the spinecleaver can make a melee attack against the creature with disadvantage.

trait.name: Crafty
entries: The underboss doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they move out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The underboss makes two Shortsword attacks or two Shortbow attacks. They can replace one attack with a use of Command.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Command
entries: The underboss chooses one ally they can see within 30 feet of them. If the target can hear the underboss, the target can use their reaction to move up to their speed or make one weapon attack.

bonus.name: Get Reckless {@recharge}
entries: Each willing ally within 30 feet of the underboss who can hear them becomes reckless until the start of the underboss's next turn. While reckless, a creature has advantage on attack rolls, and attack rolls against the creature have advantage.

reaction.name: Cowardly Commander
entries: When a creature the underboss can see hits them with an attack, the underboss chooses a willing ally within 5 feet of them. The attack hits the ally instead.

trait.name: Crafty
entries: The underboss doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they move out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The underboss makes two Shortsword attacks or two Shortbow attacks. They can replace one attack with a use of Command.

entries: The underboss chooses one ally they can see within 30 feet of them. If the target can hear the underboss, the target can use their reaction to move up to their speed or make one weapon attack.

bonus.name: Get Reckless {@recharge}
entries: Each willing ally within 30 feet of the underboss who can hear them becomes reckless until the start of the underboss's next turn. While reckless, a creature has advantage on attack rolls, and attack rolls against the creature have advantage.

reaction.name: Cowardly Commander
entries: When a creature the underboss can see hits them with an attack, the underboss chooses a willing ally within 5 feet of them. The attack hits the ally instead.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The underboss can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Crafty
entries: The underboss doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they move out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Servant Senses
entries: Ithu'rath can sense anything the underboss senses, and Ithu'rath can speak through their body.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The underboss makes two Shortsword attacks or two Shortbow attacks. They can replace one attack with a use of Command.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Command
entries: The underboss chooses one ally they can see within 30 feet of them. If the target can hear the underboss, the target can use their reaction to move up to their speed or make one weapon attack.

bonus.name: Get Reckless {@recharge}
entries: Each willing ally within 30 feet of the underboss who can hear them becomes reckless until the start of the underboss's next turn. While reckless, a creature has advantage on attack rolls, and attack rolls against the creature have advantage.

reaction.name: Cowardly Commander
entries: When a creature the underboss can see hits them with an attack, the underboss chooses a willing ally within 5 feet of them. The attack hits the ally instead.

trait.name: Crafty
entries: The warrior doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they move out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Fleet Foot
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the warrior misses them with a melee attack, the warrior can move up to half their speed.

trait.name: Occupation
entries: River-daughter

trait.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Absent-minded, Fair-spoken

trait.name: Cursed Form
entries: The Goro Goro can't regain hit points, except through the use of its Delectable Flavor trait.

trait.name: Delectable Flavor
entries: The Goro Goro regains 3 ({@dice 1d6}) hit points whenever it hits a creature with its Chomp attack that is drunk or affected by its Drunken Aura.

trait.name: Drunken Aura
entries: Any creature hostile to the Goro Goro that starts its turn within 20 feet of the Goro Goro must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, unless the Goro Goro is {@condition Incapacitated}. On a failed save, the creature is inebriated by potent fermented magic until the start of its next turn. While inebriated in this way, a creature takes a -4 penalty to all ability checks and attack rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Goro Goro makes two attacks: one with its Claw one with its Chomp.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d12 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Giant Sake Cup
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d12 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is trapped under the Goro Goro's giant sake cup. A trapped creature is {@condition Blinded} and {@condition Restrained}, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the giant sake cup, and suffers one level of {@condition exhaustion} at the end of each of its turns.

A trapped creature or an ally within 5 feet of the giant sake cup can try to lift it with a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, ending its effects on a success. The effect also ends early if the Goro Goro makes another Giant Sake Cup attack or otherwise lifts the cup.

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when Gothrolg hits with it (included in the attack).

trait.name: Indominable Heart
entries: Gothrolg has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition poisoned}, {@condition stunned}, or put to sleep.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If Gothrolg surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage from the attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Gothrolg makes three melee attacks.

action.name: Morningstar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage, or 7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage if used to make a ranged attack.

action.name: Necrotic Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Gothrolg exhales a burst of withering energy in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Goxomoc
languages: understands all languages but can't speak

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Goxomoc can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Earthbinder
entries: Enemies within 60 feet of Goxomoc can't fly, and when Goxomoc moves within 60 feet of a flying enemy, the enemy falls.

trait.name: Lightning Lord
entries: If Goxomoc is reduced to 0 hit points, he sheds his flesh form and becomes {@creature Xogomoc|FleeMortals}. Any conditions or other supernatural effects that were affecting Goxomoc continue affecting Xogomoc.

trait.name: Psionic Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Goxomoc fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead, and he can't use Energy Eyes or Shockwave until the end of his next turn.

trait.name: Psionic Weapons
entries: Goxomoc's weapon attacks are psionic.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: Goxomoc deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Goxomoc makes one Bite attack, two Claw attacks, and one Stomp attack, and he uses Energy Eyes.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}36 ({@damage 4d12 + 10}) piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 20}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and Goxomoc can't bite another target. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, they die and Goxomoc consumes their remains.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 2d10 + 10}) slashing damage, and Goxomoc moves the target up to 10 feet horizontally.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target who isn't {@condition grappled} by Goxomoc. {@h}23 ({@damage 2d12 + 10}) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Huge or smaller, they are knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Energy Eyes (3rd-Order Power)
entries: Goxomoc beams energy from his eyes at a creature he can see within 300 feet of him. The target must make a {@dc 25} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) fire or lightning damage (Goxomoc's choice) on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Catastrophic Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Goxomoc breathes lightning in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 27} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 71 ({@damage 11d12}) fire or lightning damage (Goxomoc's choice) and is teleported to an unoccupied space of Goxomoc's choice within that area. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't teleported.

bonus.name: Shockwave (2nd-Order Power)
entries: A psionic shock wave emanates from Goxomoc. Each creature of his choice within 15 feet of him must succeed on a {@dc 25} Strength saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) force damage and be pushed up to 20 feet directly away from him.

reaction.name: Volcanic Punishment
entries: When Goxomoc takes damage, he teleports along with any creatures he is grappling in a burst of lava to an unoccupied space he can see within 30 feet of him. Each creature within 10 feet of the space he left must make a {@dc 27} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendaryHeader: Goxomoc has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Rumble
entries: Goxomoc stomps the ground, unleashing a wave of debilitating psionic energy. Mundane objects within 90 feet of Goxomoc that aren't being worn or carried take 55 ({@damage 10d10}) force damage. Creatures within 90 feet of Goxomoc are knocked {@condition prone} and must succeed on a {@dc 27} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} and embedded in the ground. A creature can use an action to make a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check, freeing themself or another creature within their reach on a success.

legendary.name: Action 2: Thunder
entries: Goxomoc disappears in a crack of thunder, along with any creatures he is grappling, and reappears in an unoccupied space he can see within 120 feet of him. Each creature within 30 feet of either the space he left or his new space must make a {@dc 27} Constitution saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Action 3: Eruption
entries: Goxomoc unleashes a psionic scream of anguish in the mind of enemies within 120 feet of him. Each target must make a {@dc 25} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 44 ({@damage 8d10}) psychic damage and then becomes vulnerable to all damage dealt by Goxomoc until the end of his next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and does not become vulnerable to damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The graffiti casts one of the following spells,requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: The graffiti is incapacitated while in the area of antimagic. If targeted by {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB}, the graffiti must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or become Unconscious for 1 minute.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The graffiti regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the graffiti is splashed with water, targeted by {@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB}, or takes Cold damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. Its body is destroyed only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Solvent Susceptibility
entries: The graffiti is instantly destroyed by Universal Solvent.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The graffiti can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Surface Bound
entries: The graffiti can only move along contiguous flat surfaces, such as walls or floors.

action.name: Satire
entries: The graffiti shapes itself into a satirical representation of a foe. {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, one creature within 60 feet that can see the graffiti. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage and the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of the graffiti's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Transposition
entries: The air quivers around creatures near the graffiti. {@actSave cha} {@dc 15}, up to five creatures the graffiti can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} The creature teleports to an unoccupied space capable of supporting the creature within 120 feet.

action.name: Summon Public Opinion {@recharge}
entries: The graffiti conjures a swarm of Drakkenheim citizen spirits within 120 feet of itself. The swarm uses the Chorus stat block. The chorus acts immediately after the graffiti on the same {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, and it obeys the graffiti. The chorus disappears after 1 minute or the graffiti dies

resist.note: from mundane attacks that aren't adamantine

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless, the giant is indistinguishable from a statue.

trait.name: Stone Flesh
entries: When a creature attacks the giant with a melee weapon that isn't adamantine and rolls a 1 on the {@dice d20} for that attack, that weapon is destroyed if it is mundane. If that weapon is supernatural, it loses all supernatural properties for 1 hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two Greatclub attacks.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. If the same creature is hit twice with this attack on a turn, they have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

name: Grasping Shadow
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but mostly just screams

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The shadow can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Spectral Grasp
entries: The shadow causes one creature it can see within 5 feet to have the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition. A target that takes an action to escape automatically ends the grapple.

action.name: Death Row
entries: The shadow moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, pulling a creature it has {@condition Grappled|XPHB} with it.

trait.name: Dazzling Illumination
entries: The Gravekeeper projects a brilliant corona of light which sheds bright light to a range of 60 feet, and causes attack rolls against it to have disadvantage. If it is hit by an attack, this trait is disrupted until the end of its next turn. This trait is also disrupted while the Gravekeeper is {@condition incapacitated} or has a speed of 0.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Gravekeeper fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Lantern Blast
entries: Magical octarine beams flash from the Gravekeeper's many lanterns. Each beam has a different power. Each creature within 120 feet of the Gravekeeper which is not behind {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} rolls a {@dice d6} to determine which colour ray affects it. The DC for all saving throws is 18:

items.name: 1. Dispelling Blast
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) psychic damage, and any spell or magical effect upon the target ends. A creature who fails this saving throw has their {@status concentration} broken on any spell they were actively maintaining.

items.name: 2. Forceful Blast
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) force damage, be pushed 20 feet away, and knocked {@condition prone}.

items.name: 3. Blinding Blast
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) radiant damage and be {@condition blinded} for 1 minute. A {@condition blinded} creature can repeat the saving throw on each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 4. Contaminating Blast
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) necrotic damage and gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.

items.name: 5. Igniting Blast
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) fire damage, and catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

items.name: 6. Freezing Blast
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) cold damage, and it can't take a reaction until the end of its next turn. Moreover, on its next turn, it must choose whether it gets a move, an action, or a bonus action; it gets only one of the three. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and suffers none of the blast's other effects.

legendary.name: Slam
entries: The Gravekeeper makes a slam attack.

legendary.name: Glide
entries: The Gravekeeper moves its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Lantern Blast (Costs 3 actions)
entries: The Gravekeeper uses its Lantern Blast.

hp.special: 73 (7d10 + 35) plus 73 per player character (7d10 + 35)

trait.name: Dazzling Aura
entries: The gravekeeper sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 60-foot radius. A creature that starts its turn in the {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Radiant damage.

action.name: The gravekeeper always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the gravekeeper can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the gravekeeper takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 10 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Lantern Blast
entries: Magical octarine beams flash from one of the Gravekeeper's many lanterns at one creature it can see within 120 feet that is not behind {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover}, subjecting it to one of the following effects (the gravekeeper can only use each blast once per round):

items.name: Dispelling Blast
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Psychic damage. Any spell or magical effect on the target ends, and it has the {@condition Bewildered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: Forceful Blast
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Force damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet away from the gravekeeper and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: Blinding Blast
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Radiant damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: Contaminating Blast
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: Igniting Blast
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 10d6} Fire). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: Freezing Blast
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Cold damage, and the target has the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dc 18}). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Glide (1/Round)
entries: The gravekeeper moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

action.name: Sludge Column {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 18}, each creature in a 10-foot radius, 60-foot tall {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder}, centered on a point within 120 feet of the Gravekeeper. {@actSaveFail} 42 ({@damage 12d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Animate Walls {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}, each creature within 10 feet of any number of walls within 120 feet of the gravekeeper. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 18}). The wall sprouts limbs to facilitate this grapple, which disappear when the condition ends.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The gravekeeper chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting it and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The gravekeeper can use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

name: Gray Thirster
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Thirst Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the gray thirster must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of {@condition exhaustion}. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the gray thirster's Thirst Aura for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Thirsting Dead Nature
entries: The gray thirster doesn't require air, food, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gray thirster makes two Claw attacks, or it makes one Claw attack and one Withering Turban attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Withering Turban
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target has disadvantage on this saving throw if it failed the saving throw against the thirster's Thirst Aura. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest with no levels of {@condition exhaustion}. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

action.name: Drought (1/Day)
entries: The gray thirster draws the moisture from containers and creatures around it. Nonmagical water and other liquids within 20 feet of the thirster that aren't being worn or carried turn to dust. Each creature within 20 feet of the thirster that isn't a Construct or Undead must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage and up to 5 gallons of nonmagical liquid it is wearing or carrying turn to dust. On a success, a creature takes half the damage, and nonmagical liquids it is wearing or carrying don't turn to dust. Plants, Oozes, creatures with the Amphibious or Water Breathing trait, and creatures made mostly of water, such as water elementals or steam mephitis, have disadvantage on the saving throw.

trait.name: Hideous Toughness (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the Great Cave-troll takes 14 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Great Cave-troll makes two melee attacks, only one of which can be with its bite. It can use its Strike Fear instead of its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d4 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). If the target is Small or smaller, it is also {@condition restrained} until this {@action grapple} ends. While grappling the target, the Great Cave-troll has advantage on attack rolls against it and cannot use this attack against other targets.

action.name: Strike Fear
entries: Each non-undead creature of the Great Cave-troll's choice that is within 60 feet of the Great Cave-troll and aware of it gains 2 Shadow points from Dread, resisted by a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a target becomes {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target is also {@condition stunned} while {@condition frightened} in this way. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the Great Cave-troll's Strike Fear for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Even Death May Die
entries: When Great Cthulhu drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or would be killed outright, it instead transforms into a cloud of green mist that fills its space. At the start of each of Great Cthulhu's turns, it gains one recovery point but otherwise cannot use actions or legendary actions other than Relentless Horror. When it gains its fourth recovery point, its maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} return to normal if they have been reduced and it regains all lost {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. It reforms its physical body in a space of its choice within 10 miles of its location. It then loses all recovery points.

If Great Cthulhu is the target of a {@spell Banishment|XPHB} spell while in this cloud form cast with a 9th-level spell slot, it automatically fails its saving throw and is instead sent to R'lyeh where it slumbers for {@dice 10d10} years.

trait.name: Horrid Aura
entries: A non-mythos entity that starts its turn within 30 feet of Great Cthulhu takes 10 Psychic damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (6/Day)
entries: If Great Cthulhu fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Great Cthulhu makes six Crushing Claw attacks.

action.name: Crushing Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 19}, Reach 25 ft. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d8 + 10}) Bludgeoning damage and the target is either knocked {@condition Prone|XPHB} or moved up to 20 ft. in a straight line from Great Cthulhu.

action.name: Apocalyptic Majesty {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 23}, creatures of Great Cthulhu's choice that can see or hear it within 500 ft. {@actSaveFail 1} The target takes 110 ({@damage 20d10}) Psychic damage, and is {@condition Frightened|XPHB} of Great Cthulhu until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. {@actSaveFail 2} On its next turn, Great Cthulhu controls the target. This effect ends at the end of that turn.

legendary.name: Disdainful Swipe
entries: Great Cthulhu makes two Crushing Claw attacks.

legendary.name: Relentless Horror {@recharge 5}
entries: Great Cthulhu chooses one of the following options:

items: It teleports up to 200 ft. to an unoccupied space.
It immediately ends one spell or condition affecting it.
It ends one spell or magical effect of its choice within 120 ft. of it.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The drake casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}, {@hit 10} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Illumination
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, the drake can produce dim light in a 15 ft radius, or bright light in a 15 ft radius and dim light for an additional 15 ft radius. The drake can end this effect as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

trait.name: Prickly Pines
entries: If a creature successfully hits the drake with a melee attack, the creature takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
entries: If the drake fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drake makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) Incandescent Breath or (B) Spellcasting to cast {@spell Color Spray|XPHB|Colour Spray}.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 10 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Radiant damage.

action.name: Incandescent Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 19}, each creature in a 90 ft long, 5 ft wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 55 ({@damage 10d10}) Radiant damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

legendary.name: Bright Tail Lash
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 17}, a creature the drake can see within 15 ft. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Radiant damage, and the target is knocked {@condition Prone|XPHB}.

legendary.name: Pounce
entries: The drake moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, and it makes one Rend attack.

legendary.name: Twinkling Lights
entries: The drake uses Spellcasting to cast {@spell Faerie Fire|XPHB}.

trait.name: Massive Frame
entries: The great ogre has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength saving throws and Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The great ogre makes two greatclub attacks or throws two javelins.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 50/200 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Hideous Belch {@recharge 6}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13} All creatures in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Poison damage, and the creature has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. A creature with the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect upon itself.

reaction.name: Tense Muscles {@recharge 6}
entries: {@actTrigger} The great ogre is hit by an attack that deals Bludgeoning, Slashing, or Piercing damage. {@actResponse} The great ogre takes half damage from the triggering attack.

trait.name: Hideous Toughness (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the Great Orc Bodyguard takes 7 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

trait.name: Horrible Strength
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the Great Orc Bodyguard hits with it (included in the attack).

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the Great Orc Bodyguard has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Great Orc Bodyguard makes two melee attacks, or one melee attack and one ranged attack.

action.name: Battle Axe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) slashing damage or 14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage, or 12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

bonus.name: Aggressive
entries: As a bonus action, the Great Orc Bodyguard can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

variant.name: Hateful Orcs
entries: Some Orcs direct their spite towards some specific folk. To reflect this, the Loremaster may add to an Orc adversary the Hatred special trait.

items.name: Hatred (subject) (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As a bonus action, the creature can gain advantage on attack rolls against the subject of its hatred until the start of its next turn.

For example, the Orcs and Goblins of Goblin-town hate Dwarves, and will attack a Company that includes Dwarves with blind fury. The Orcs of Mount Gram fiercely hate all Hobbits instead, and will relentlessly attack a Company including any.

items.name: Hatred (subject) (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As a bonus action, the Great Orc Bodyguard can gain advantage on attack rolls against the subject of its hatred until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Horrible Strength
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the Great Orc Chief hits with it (included in the attack).

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the Great Orc Chief has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Great Orc Chief makes two melee attacks, or one melee attack and one ranged attack.

action.name: Heavy Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage, or 15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) slashing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage, or 13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Yell of Triumph (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: Each creature of the Great Orc Chief's choice that is within 30 feet of it and can hear it gain advantage on attack rolls and Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks until the start of the Great Orc Chief's next turn. The Great Orc Chief can then make one attack as a bonus action.

bonus.name: Aggressive
entries: As a bonus action, the Great Orc Chief can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The Great Orc Chief adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the Great Orc Chief must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

reaction.name: Redirect Attack
entries: When a creature the Great Orc Chief can see hits it with an attack, the Great Orc Chief chooses another Orc within 5 feet of it. The two Orcs swap places, and the chosen Orc becomes the target instead.

variant.name: Hateful Orcs
entries: Some Orcs direct their spite towards some specific folk. To reflect this, the Loremaster may add to an Orc adversary the Hatred special trait.

items.name: Hatred (subject) (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As a bonus action, the creature can gain advantage on attack rolls against the subject of its hatred until the start of its next turn.
