For example, the Orcs and Goblins of Goblin-town hate Dwarves, and will attack a Company that includes Dwarves with blind fury. The Orcs of Mount Gram fiercely hate all Hobbits instead, and will relentlessly attack a Company including any.

items.name: Hatred (subject) (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As a bonus action, the Great Orc Chief can gain advantage on attack rolls against the subject of its hatred until the start of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Yithian casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Yithian has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Time Master
entries: When the Yithian rolls {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, it may choose to treat the result of its {@dice d20} roll as a 5 or 15. It may also apply this effect to up to six willing creatures it can see.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Yithian makes two Snapping Claw attacks.

action.name: Snapping Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, Reach 15 ft. {@h}29 ({@damage 4d10 + 7}) Slashing damage.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The Yithian makes a Snapping Claw attack.

legendary.name: Spell
entries: The Yithian uses Spellcasting, but can only cast spells it can use at will.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The chrysalis can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the chrysalis fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Regenerative State
entries: The chrysalis' hit points reset to its maximum at the start of its turn.

trait.name: Sticky Mucus
entries: When a creature hits the chrysalis with a melee attack, it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or become disarmed as its weapon stays stuck to the creature. A creature can use an action to make a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics|PHB}) check, freeing a stuck weapon within its reach on a success. If the attack requires that the attacker touch the aboleth (GM's discretion), then the attacker becomes grappled (escape {@dc 20}) on a failed save. While it is grappled, it can't use that limb. If the attack is a bite, then the creature can't speak while it is grappled in this way.

trait.name: Transitional State
entries: The chrysalis turns into an aboleth broodmother at the start of its fourth turn after becoming a chrysalis, ending any grapples it is a part of.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chrysalis makes four Sticky Ectoplasm attacks. Each attack must be against a different target.

action.name: Sticky Ectoplasm
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 12} to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) acid damage and the target's speed is reduced by 15 feet until the target uses an action to remove the ectoplasm. A creature whose speed is reduced to 0 feet by this effect is restrained (escape {@dc 20}).

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The lesser crawling one casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The greater crawling one has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Implacable Evil
entries: When a greater crawling one is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it falls into a pile of rotting flesh, worms, and maggots. If it takes at least 40 Fire damage before the end of its next turn, the greater crawling one is permanently destroyed. It can still be targeted by spells and effects that target creatures. Otherwise, the greater crawling one reforms in {@dice 2d6} days. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the tomb it was originally buried in.

action.name: Slimy Grasp
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, Reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Necrotic damage.

legendary.name: By My Command
entries: The greater crawling one chooses up to three willing Undead or Mythos creatures it can see. Each of the chosen creatures can take a Reaction to move up to its Speed, and each creature gains Advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the greater crawling one's next turn.

legendary.name: Squirming Escape
entries: The greater crawling one teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The greater dark young of Shub-Niggurath casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}):

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The greater dark young of Shub-Niggurath has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The greater dark young of Shub-Niggurath makes four Flailing Tentacle attacks. It can replace two attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Flailing Tentacle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, Reach 30 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 18}).

legendary.name: Swarming Tentacles
entries: The greater dark young of Shub-Niggurath makes two Flailing Tentacle attacks.

legendary.name: Clamor of Hooves
entries: The greater dark young of Shub-Niggurath moves up to its Speed.

trait.name: Potent Poison
entries: Undead with resistance or immunity to poison damage or the {@condition poisoned} condition can be affected by the swarm's poison.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

trait.name: Weight of Wings
entries: A creature that starts its turn in the swarm's space has its speed halved and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or become {@condition blinded}. Both effects end when the creature ends its turn outside the swarm's space. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the blinding effect of Weight of Wings for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The swarm makes two Bites attacks.

action.name: Bites
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. {@h}21 ({@damage 6d6}) piercing damage, or 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hp or fewer. The target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. On a success, it takes half the damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. A {@condition poisoned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The greater star-spawn of Cthulhu casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The greater star-spawn of Cthulhu can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The greater star-spawn of Cthulhu has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The greater star-spawn of Cthulhu makes two Crushing Fist attacks.

action.name: Crushing Fist
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, Reach 20 ft. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage.

legendary.name: Flabby Claws
entries: The greater star-spawn of Cthulhu makes a Crushing Fist attack.

legendary.name: Eldritch Contradictions
entries: The greater star-spawn of Cthulhu uses Spellcasting.

legendary.name: Ravening for Delight
entries: The greater star-spawn of Cthulhu moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The winged wretch makes three Rend attacks.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Thunderous Shriek {@recharge 5}
entries: The winged wretch emits a cacophonous wave of energy. {@actSave con} {@dc 12}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 17 ({@damage 5d6}) Thunder damage, and the target has the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, the hag can cast the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Envenom
entries: Each ally within 30 feet of the hag deals an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage with weapon attacks, provided the hag isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes one Poison Claw attack and uses Granny Says.

action.name: Poison Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Granny Says
entries: The hag affects one other willing creature they can see within 30 feet of them with one of the following effects:

items: The target magically switches places with the hag.
The target uses their reaction, if available, to make an attack.

action.name: Naughty Mousey (3/Day; 5th-Level Spell; Concentration)
entries: The hag chooses a creature they can see within 60 feet of them and attempts to transform them into a Beast of the hag's choice with a challenge rating of 2 or lower. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be transformed for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While transformed, the target's game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the chosen Beast, though they retain their alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. The target's gear melds into the new form. They can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of their equipment. They can't speak or cast spells but can take any action the Beast can take. If the target drops to 0 hit points while in this form, they revert back to their original form with half the number of hit points they had before they transformed.

reaction.name: Get Gone
entries: When an ally within 30 feet of the hag is targeted with an attack, the hag can turn the target {@condition invisible} until the start of the target's next turn, potentially imposing disadvantage on the triggering attack roll and causing it to miss. To use this reaction, the hag must be able to see the ally and the attacker.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The green slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

action.name: Spike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) acid damage.

action.name: Flee
entries: To save itself from danger, the green slime can sever off a part of its body to cause a distraction. The slime chooses to lose any number of hit points when using this ability. For each hit point lost, a tiny copy of the slime leaps from its body and moves 30 feet in a random direction, after which it falls lifeless.

name: Gregor Thornspur, Magistrate of Alderheart
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Gregor can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. He cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

trait.name: Wing Flap
entries: As a bonus action, Gregor can use his powerful feathered arms to propel himself upward a distance equal to half his movement speed. He can use it in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

trait.name: Fated (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: Gregor can choose to reroll any attack roll, skill check, or saving throw.

trait.name: Damage Resistance
entries: Gregor is resistant to poison damage.

trait.name: Resilience
entries: Gregor has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned}.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Gregor adds 2 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, Gregor must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The grendelkyn can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Shadow Armor
entries: The grendelkyn is surrounded by a writhing mantle of shadows. This mantle adds 3 to its AC (included in its stats) and grants it {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks in {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} or {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB}.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the grendelkyn has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks and attack rolls, and it loses its Shadow Armor. Additionally, it cannot use its Shadow Snare Action, and any existing Shadow Snare melts.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The grendelkyn makes one Bite and one Claws attack. It can replace its Claws attack with Shadow Snare.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Piercing damage. On a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of the grendelkyn's next turn.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Shadow Snare
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) Cold damage, and the target is wrapped in shadowy tendrils extending from the grendelkyn's body, and the target is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions. A creature can make a new Dexterity Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns to free itself. Otherwise, it remains ensnared by the tendrils for 1 minute. The Shadow Snare also vanishes if it is exposed to sunlight, the grendelkyn dies or has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, or it chooses to use Shadow Snare against a new target.

bonus.name: Shadow Port
entries: A grendelkyn in an area of {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}. If the grendelkyn teleports while it has a creature trapped in a Shadow Snare, that creature also teleports 30 feet, to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the grendelkyn that is in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}. If no such space is available, the grendelkyn releases the trapped creature when it teleports.

reaction.name: Frenzied Shriek
entries: {@actTrigger} The grendelkyn is {@status Bloodied|XPHB}. {@actResponse} All creatures within 20 feet of the grendelkyn make a {@actSave wis} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. A creature affected by the shriek can make a new Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect on itself.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The grep can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a whisper or chitter. A hearer can discern the sounds are imitations with a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) check.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Slashing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The greyfur casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

trait.name: Glide
entries: The greyfur has membranes between its fore and hind limbs that expand when falling to slow its rate of descent to 60 feet per round, landing on its feet and taking no falling damage. It can move up to 5 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it falls. The greyfur can't gain height with its gliding membranes alone. If subjected to a strong wind or lift of any kind, it can use the updraft to glide farther.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The greyfur lemurfolk makes two Greyfur's Staff or Arcane Bolt attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Greyfur's Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) force damage.

action.name: Arcane Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) force damage.

trait.name: Steady
entries: The griffon has advantage on ability checks and saving throws against being knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Swoop
entries: If the griffon flies more than 20 feet in a straight line toward their target and then hits them with a Claw attack on the same turn, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). While the target is {@condition grappled} in this way, the griffon has advantage on Beak attacks against the target but can't make Claw attacks. Grappling a Medium or smaller creature imposes no penalty on the griffon's speed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The griffon makes one Beak attack, and they can make one Claw attack, use Buffet, or use Piercing Cry.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Buffet
entries: The griffon beats their wings in mighty gusts of wind. Each creature not {@condition grappled} by the griffon within a 30-foot cone originating from the griffon must make a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) bludgeoning damage, is pushed 5 feet away from the griffon, and is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Piercing Cry
entries: The griffon lets out an earsplitting screech. Each enemy within 60 feet of the griffon who can hear them must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the griffon for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for them, they are immune to the Piercing Cry of all griffons for the next 24 hours.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

trait.name: Learning to Fly
entries: The griffon has a flying speed of 10 × PB feet.

action.name: Signature Attack (Beak)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Violent Attack (2 Ferocity)
entries: The griffon makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} slashing damage, and the griffon can move the target 5 feet in any direction.

action.name: 3rd Level: Grabbed from Above (5 Ferocity)
entries: The griffon makes a signature attack against a Medium or smaller creature. On a hit, the target is also {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}) if they weren't already. While {@condition grappled} in this way, the target is {@condition restrained} and the griffon can't make a signature attack against another target.

action.name: 3rd Level: Bombs Away (5 Ferocity)
entries: The griffon flies up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If the griffon has a creature {@condition grappled}, the grapple doesn't halve the griffon's speed and the griffon can end the grapple at any point during this movement. If the griffon ends the grapple before the end of their turn and the target takes bludgeoning damage from that fall, the target takes an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} bludgeoning damage.

action.name: 5th Level: Backdraft (8 Ferocity)
entries: The griffon flies up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. When the griffon ends this movement, each creature within 15 feet of them must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage PBd6} bludgeoning damage and is knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: Grihoo can hold its breath indefinitely.

trait.name: Infinite Heads
entries: Grihoo has an infinite number of heads. Whenever it takes 60 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. On its next turn, the number of attacks it makes as part of its Multiattack decreases by one (to a minimum of three) and it can't use its Snapping Frenzy. At the end of Grihoo's turn, it replaces all of its missing heads that died since its last turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Grihoo fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Grihoo has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Grihoo's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Reactive
entries: Grihoo can take one reaction on every turn in a combat.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Grihoo makes five bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 2d10 + 9}) piercing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage.

action.name: Snapping Frenzy
entries: Grihoo unleashes a flurry of bites in its vicinity, making one bite attack against any number of creatures within 30 feet of it, with a separate attack roll for each target.

action.name: Transpositional Swallow {@recharge 5}
entries: Grihoo chooses one creature it can see within 120 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw or be teleported inside of Grihoo's stomach. While inside Grihoo, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside Grihoo, and it takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) acid damage and 28 ({@damage 8d6}) force damage at the start of each of Grihoo's turns.

If Grihoo takes 60 damage or more on a single turn, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or expel all creatures that were teleported inside of it, teleporting them to a random space on the ground within 60 feet of Grihoo. If Grihoo dies, a creature that was teleported inside of it is no longer {@condition restrained} and can escape from the corpse by using 60 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Counter Conjuration
entries: When a creature Grihoo can see or hear within 300 feet of it casts a conjuration spell or magically summons a creature, Grihoo interrupts the casting or summoning, causing it to fail and have no effect. Grihoo then regains hit points equal to 15 times the spell slot's level, if it interrupted a spell, or equal to the challenge rating of the creatures being summoned, if it interrupted a summoning.

legendary.name: Bite
entries: Grihoo makes one bite attack.

legendary.name: Teleport (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Grihoo magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary.name: Crushing Infinity (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Grihoo channels the overwhelming weight of infinity, crushing each creature inside of it. A swallowed creature must make a {@dc 24} Constitution saving throw, taking 55 ({@damage 10d10}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Shifting Camouflage
entries: The grilp has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks and can hide from creatures who are observing them.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, they must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or gain vulnerability to fire and necrotic damage until the start of the grilp's next turn.

action.name: Necrotic Mote
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 3} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage.

hp.special: 5 plus five times your Ranger level (the grim has a number of Hit Dice [d8s] equal to your Ranger level)

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The grim can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. The grim takes {@damage 1d10} Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Shared Fate
entries: Add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to any ability check or saving throw the grim makes.

action.name: Ominous Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hitYourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier}, reach 5 ft. {@h}{@dice 1d6 + 3} plus your Wisdom modifier Necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn.

reaction.name: Baleful Howl
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature moves out of the grim's reach. {@actResponse d}{@actSave wis} Your spell save DC, the triggering creature. {@actSaveFail} The target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 until the end of the turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The vampire casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The vampire regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes two attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Bite or Spellcasting.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Bite
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15}, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, or {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) Necrotic damage, and the vampire regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

bonus.name: Shadow Step
entries: The vampire teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The grim jester casts one of the following spells, requiring no components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Last Laugh
entries: Unless it is destroyed in a manner amusing to the god of death that created it, the grim jester gains a new body in {@dice 1d20} days, regaining all its hp and becoming active again. The new body appears in a place of the god's choosing.

trait.name: Mock the Dying
entries: Death saving throws made within 60 feet of the grim jester have disadvantage.

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The grim jester has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The grim jester doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The grim jester can use its Killing Joke. It then makes two Necrotic Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Necrotic Claw
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 9} to hit, range 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Killing Joke
entries: The grim jester tells an ancient, nihilistic joke to one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or fall {@condition prone} in a fit of laughter, becoming {@condition incapacitated} and unable to stand up for 1 minute. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is reduced to 0 hp instead. The {@condition incapacitated} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save or ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Joker's Shuffle {@recharge}
entries: The grim jester exchanges locations with a Medium or smaller creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The jester and target each teleport to the other's space, and each becomes covered in a magical illusion to look and sound like the other. A creature must take an action to visually inspect an illusion and succeed on a {@dc 19} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to discern that the jester and target are disguised. The illusions last for 1 minute, until the jester dies, or until the jester dismisses them as a bonus action.

trait.name: Brutal Critical
entries: When Grog scores a critical hit, he rolls double weapon damage dice as usual, then rolls 3 additional weapon damage dice.

trait.name: Feral Instinct
entries: Grog has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on initiative rolls.

trait.name: Melee Master
entries: Grog can take a −5 penalty to any melee attack roll to gain a +10 bonus to the damage roll.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of his turn, Grog can gain {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against him have {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} until the start of his next turn.

trait.name: Relentless Rage
entries: If Grog is reduced to 0 hit points while raging, he drops to 1 hit point instead if he succeeds on a {@dc 10} Constitution {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Grog wears a {@item belt of dwarvenkind}. He wields the {@item Bloodaxe|EGW} (a +2 magic weapon), a {@item dwarven thrower}, and the {@item Titanstone Knuckles (Exalted)|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Titanstone Knuckles}.

trait.name: Spellbreaker
entries: When Grog damages a creature that is concentrating on a spell, that creature has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|disadvantage} on the {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} to maintain its {@status concentration}. In addition, Grog has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1} against spells cast by creatures within 5 feet of him.

trait.name: Toughness
entries: Grog has an additional 40 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Grog makes two attacks (three when raging) with his {@item Bloodaxe|EGW}, {@item dwarven thrower}, or {@item Titanstone Knuckles (Exalted)|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Titanstone Knuckles}.

action.name: {@item Bloodaxe|EGW}
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 1d12 + 14}) slashing damage and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage. If the target is reduced to 0 hit points, Grog gains 10 temporary hit points.

action.name: {@item Dwarven Thrower}
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60, one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 2d8 + 15}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Titanstone Knuckles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 1d4 + 12}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Enlarge (Recharges after a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|Long Rest})
entries: Grog casts {@spell enlarge/reduce} on himself to grow in size for 10 minutes. While enlarged in this way, he has resistance to cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage.

bonus.name: Rage (Recharges after a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|Short or Long Rest})
entries: Grog enters a rage that lasts until he falls {@condition unconscious} or chooses to end it (no action required). While raging, Grog gains the following benefits:

items: He has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on Strength checks and Strength {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1}.
He deals an extra 4 damage when he hits a target with a melee weapon attack (included in attacks)
He has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage
He can't be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}
He can make an additional melee weapon attack (included in the Multiattack action)

entries: When Grog's rage ends, he gains one level of {@condition exhaustion}.

reaction.name: Opportunist
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of Grog casts a spell or deals damage to him, Grog can make a melee weapon attack against that creature.

items.name: Contaminating Beam
entries: The grotesque gargant magically forces a creature it can see within 60 feet of it to make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. The creature takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save and gains one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: A grotesque gargant regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn as long as it is within the Deep Haze. The gargant dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Misty Camouflage
entries: The grotesque gargant has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks to hide in any area obscured by mist or fog.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The gargantuan regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn as long as it is within the Deep Haze. The gargantuan dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Misty Camouflage
entries: The gargantuan has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks to hide in any area obscured by mist or fog, including the Deep Haze of Drakkenheim.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gargantuan makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 15 ft. {@h}40 ({@damage 4d10 + 8}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hurl Delerium Chunk
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 12}, range 120/300 ft. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d8 + 8}) Bludgeoning damage and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@hom}The delerium chunk explodes creating the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 20}, the targeted creature and each creature within 10 feet of it. {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Necrotic damage and gain one level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} An {@table Arcane Anomalies|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} occurs in the space where the delerium chunk exploded.

name: Gruesome Plushy Swarm

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Incessant Babble
entries: At the start of its turn, the plushies in the swarm spout inane statements—in extremely saccharine tones—such as "You're my best friend!" "I love you!" "Hugs are my favorite!" "It's time for some fun!" and "Let's play!" The incessant babble has no effect on Fey, Constructs, or Undead. Each other creature within 60 feet of the swarm that can hear it must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage and becomes {@condition frightened} of the swarm for 1 minute. A {@condition frightened} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the swarm's incessant babble for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The plushy swarm is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The plushy swarm has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The plushy swarm's flensing knives attacks are magical.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and it can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny plushy. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

action.name: Flensing Knives
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. {@h}21 ({@damage 6d6}) slashing damage, or 10 ({@damage 3d6}) slashing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The tyrannosaur's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). The tyrannosaur can innately cast the following spells, requiring only somatic components:

trait.name: Enraged Casting {@recharge 4}
entries: While the tyrannosaur has half of its hit points or fewer, it can cast one of its innate spells as a bonus action, even if the normal casting time for that spell is an action.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The tyrannosaur has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tyrannosaur makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}32 ({@damage 4d12 + 6}) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the tyrannosaur can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The grymhare can use a bonus action to polymorph into a Tiny rabbit, or back into its true form, which is Medium. Its statistics, other than its size and its available actions, are the same in either form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The grymhare has advantage on attack rolls against any creature {@condition grappled} by it.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The grymhare has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The grymhare has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the grymhare surprises a creature and hits it with a beak attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) damage from the attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The grymhare makes one attack with its tentacles against each creature of its choice within its reach simultaneously. It then makes one beak attack.

action.name: Beak (True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Bite (Rabbit Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tentacle (True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}) and the grymhare pulls it up to 5 feet straight toward it.

trait.name: Towering Strength
entries: The gug is considered to be a Gargantuan giant for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gug makes two four Grasping Claw attacks, or it makes two Grasping Claw attacks and two Stomp attacks. It can replace one Grasping Claw attack with a use of Fling or Swallow.

action.name: Grasping Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}) if it is a Large or smaller creature. The gug has four Grasping Claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft. {@h}20 ({@damage 2d12 + 7}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Fling
entries: One Large or smaller object held or creature {@condition grappled} by the gug is thrown up to 60 feet in a random direction and knocked {@condition prone}. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The gug makes one Grasping Claw attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside the gug, and it takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the gug's turns. A gug can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If the gug takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the gug must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of the gug. If the gug dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

name: Gurt Hallowfen
languages: can speak with beasts of any size which represent spiders, insects, worms, or other bugs

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Gurt is a 7th-level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). They have the following bard spells prepared:

trait.name: Taunt (2/Day)
entries: Gurt can use a bonus action on their turn to target one creature within 30 feet of them. If the target can hear Gurt, the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the start of Gurt's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Gurt makes two weapon attacks, one with their rapier and one with their dagger.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Bile Blast
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 10-foot cone. {@actSaveFail} 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Acid damage and are {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} ({@dice 2d8} Acid). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Hurl Fetid Flesh {@recharge 5}
entries: The Gutbuster Hulk rips off a chunk of its mutated flesh and hurls it at a point it can see within 120 feet. {@actSave con} {@dc 14}, each creature within a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on that point. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

trait.name: Reactive
entries: The dreg can take one {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} on every turn in combat.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dreg makes two Gut Flail attacks.

action.name: Gut Flail
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 15 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

reaction.name: Flailing Guts
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature enters a space within 15 feet of it. {@actResponse} The dreg makes one Gut Flail attack against that creature.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Death Sense
entries: The sphinx can pinpoint, by scent, the location of each creature below half its hp maximum within 60 feet of it, and it can sense the general direction of creatures that don't have all of their hp within 1 mile of it. In addition, the sphinx can foretell the age and manner of a creature's death by looking at it. This effect doesn't take into account possible circumstances that might change the outcome, such as the casting of powerful spells or the creature making a radical change in its life's path.

trait.name: Inscrutable
entries: The sphinx is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks made to ascertain the sphinx's intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The sphinx's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sphinx makes one Beak attack and two Claw attacks. If both Claw attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) slashing damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Carrion Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The gypsosphinx exhales rotting breath in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) poison damage and 27 ({@damage 6d8}) necrotic damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature has disadvantage on death saving throws. A {@condition poisoned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary.name: Beak Attack
entries: The sphinx makes one Beak attack.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The sphinx uses Spellcasting.

legendary.name: Teleport (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The sphinx magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

name: H'rethi, Soul of the Desert
languages: telepathy 1 mile and understands Common and Terran but can't speak

trait.name: Immovable
entries: H'rethi can't move or be moved by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: H'rethi is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: When H'rethi fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: H'rethi has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Shattering Destruction
entries: When H'rethi drops to 0 hit points, it shatters and is destroyed. Any creature on the ground within 30 feet of H'rethi must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) piercing damage and 22 ({@damage 4d10}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: H'rethi makes three Soul Ray attacks.

action.name: Soul Ray
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 11} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) force damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) radiant damage, and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.

action.name: Fortify {@recharge 5}
entries: H'rethi gains 50 temporary hit points, and all attack rolls made against it have disadvantage until the start of its next turn.

reaction.name: Absorb Magic (3/Day)
entries: When H'rethi takes damage from a spell or other magical effect, it instead takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to the damage dealt. H'rethi is still subject to any other effects that might accompany the damage.

legendary.name: Sand Lash
entries: A tendril-like whip rises from the ground, striking at one creature within 120 feet of H'rethi. The target must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) slashing damage, and if it is Large or smaller, it is also {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). If the target is already {@condition grappled}, it becomes {@condition restrained} until the grapple ends.

legendary.name: Create Sentry (2 Actions)
entries: H'rethi creates a 5-foot-radius, 15-foot-high pillar of compacted sand in an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of it. When H'rethi uses its Multiattack on its turn, it can make one additional SouI Ray attack for each pillar that exists. Each of these additional attacks originates from a different pillar and only deals the force damage from the attack. The pillar is an object that can be damaged and thus destroyed. It has AC 15 and 30 hit points. Reducing the pillar to 0 hit points causes it to crumble into dust.

legendary.name: Dispel Magic (2 Actions)
entries: H'rethi casts {@spell dispel magic}. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma for this spell.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The hafgufa can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Seagoing Lurker
entries: The hafgufa has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@skill Stealth|XPHB} checks when underwater.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The hafgufa deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hafgufa makes four Tentacle attacks. It can replace one attack with its Bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) Piercing damage. The hafgufa has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on this attack roll against a creature grappled by one of its tentacles.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 18}) from one of four tentacles, and the hafgufa can pull the target up to 25 feet straight toward itself.

action.name: Reeking Mist {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17} Each creature in a 40-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition for 10 minutes. At the end of each of its turns, a target can repeat the saving throw, ending the condition on a success.

bonus.name: Swallow
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 18} One Large or smaller creature within 5 feet that is {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the hafgufa (it can have up to six creatures swallowed at a time). {@actSaveFail} The target is swallowed, and the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition ends. A swallowed creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, it has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects outside the hafgufa, and it takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Acid damage at the start of each of the hafgufa's turns.

If the hafgufa takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the hafgufa must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the hafgufa and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. If the hafgufa dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting {@condition Prone|XPHB}.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The hafgufa spawn can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Seagoing Lurker
entries: The hafgufa spawn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@skill Stealth|XPHB} checks when underwater.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hafgufa spawn makes four Tentacle attacks. It can replace one attack with Bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Piercing damage. The hafgufa spawn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on this attack roll against a creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by one of its tentacles.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}) from one of four tentacles, and the hafgufa spawn can pull the target up to 10 feet straight toward itself.

action.name: Reeking Mist (1/Day)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13} Each creature in a 20-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}. {@actSaveFail} Target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition for 10 minutes. At the end of each of its turns, a target can repeat the saving throw, ending the condition on a success.

trait.name: Aura of Command
entries: Halorin and any Undead within 30 feet of him have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn Undead.

trait.name: Pendant of Grave Regeneration
entries: Halorin regains 5 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Halorin makes one Shield Slam attack and one Mace attack. If he hits the same creature with both attacks, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than Halorin until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Shield Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Unyielding Protection
entries: When a willing ally within 5 feet of Halorin is hit by an attack, he swaps places with that creature without provoking opportunity attacks and is hit by the attack instead. To use this reaction, Halorin must be able to see the ally and the attacker.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hamingja has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hamingja casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}):

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Radiant Touch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) Radiant damage.

action.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The hamingja shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or smaller Beast or Humanoid. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except its {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} is only available in its true form or a form possessing wings. Any equipment it's wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

reaction.name: Shot of Luck (3/day)
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the hamingja is bonded to fails an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. {@actResponse} The creature adds {@dice 1d6} to its die roll, potentially turning the failure into a success.

name: Hamlin Hurlwind
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Careful Aim
entries: If Hamlin chooses to only attack once with his heavy crossbow on a turn, he makes that attack with advantage.

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Hamlin can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement and takes no falling damage. He cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

trait.name: Patterned Feathers
entries: Hamlin has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made in a forest environment.

trait.name: Talons
entries: Hamlin has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface his talons could reasonably grip.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Hamlin makes two heavy crossbow attacks or three shortsword attacks.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage. Hamlin can choose to {@action grapple} a Large or smaller target hit by this attack as a bonus action.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The Hammer Gull has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Hammer Gull makes two Peck attacks.

action.name: Peck
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Boulder Drop
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 120/240 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition Prone}.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The hammerhead can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The hammerhead has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The hammerhead can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hammerhead has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The hammerhead's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hammerhead makes three attacks: one with its bite, one with its slam, and one with its tail.

action.name: Banishing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the hammerhead. A swallowed creature is considered to be on the Ethereal Plane, it is {@condition incapacitated}, and it takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) force damage at the start of each of the hammerhead's turns. A swallowed creature can make a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw at the start of each of its turns. On a successful save, the creature reappears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the hammerhead.

If the hammerhead takes 50 or more damage in a single turn, it must succeed on a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which reappear in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the hammerhead. If the hammerhead dies, a swallowed creature can make a {@dc 10} Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, the creature reappears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the hammerhead. On a failed save, the creature is no longer {@condition incapacitated}, but it is banished to the Ethereal Plane.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. This attack deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) force damage.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The hammerhead enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

reaction.name: Spectral Strike
entries: When the hammerhead takes damage from a creature it can see within 120 feet of it, it teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of that creature and immediately makes one slam or tail attack against it.

name: Hannity Lerune
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

spellcasting.name: Touched
headerEntries: Hannity knows the {@spell gust barrier|HumblewoodCampaignSetting}{@cite New Humblewood Content|HumblewoodTales|*} cantrip. Charisma is her spellcasting ability for this cantrip.

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Hannity can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. She lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement, and takes no falling damage. Hannity can't glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

trait.name: Fated (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: Hannity can choose to reroll any attack, skill check, or saving throw.

trait.name: Resilience
entries: Hannity has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned}.

trait.name: Wing Flap
entries: As a bonus action, Hannity can use her powerful feathered arms to propel herself upward up to half his movement speed. Hannity can use it in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

action.name: Cutlass
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) slashing damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage.

resist.note: from mundane attacks with shadow form

trait.name: Amethyst Die (3/Day)
entries: When Harlo makes an ability check, saving throw, or attack roll, he can roll a {@dice d6} and add the number rolled to the number rolled on the {@dice d20} roll. He then takes psychic damage equal to twice the number rolled on the {@dice d6}.
Harlo can use this die even in his shadow form.

trait.name: Fear Resistant
entries: Harlo has advantage on saving throws he makes to avoid or end the {@condition frightened} condition on himself.

trait.name: Mind Link
entries: Harlo can communicate telepathically with any Amethyst Knife boss regardless of distance, provided they are on the same plane of existence.

trait.name: Telepathic Shroud
entries: Harlo is immune to any effect that would sense his emotions or read his thoughts, as well as to all divination spells.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Harlo makes two Mind Splinter attacks.

action.name: *Mind Splinter (1st-Order Power)
entries: {@atk mp,rp} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) psychic damage, and Harlo is {@condition invisible} to the target until the start of his next turn.

action.name: Shadow Form (1/Day; 4th-Order Power; Concentration)
entries: Harlo transforms his body into an amorphous shadow, along with everything he is wearing or carrying, and gains the following benefits for 10 minutes:

items: He has a flying speed of 60 feet.
He has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks.
He has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks and can attempt to hide without cover.
He can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

entries: While in this form, Harlo can't pick up or wield objects except for his Amethyst Die.

bonus.name: I'm Over Here
entries: Harlo chooses an enemy within 60 feet of him who he can see but who can't see him. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or make a weapon attack against a creature of Harlo's choice.

bonus.name: Sneaky
entries: Harlo takes the Hide action.

reaction.name: Shared Condition
entries: When Harlo is {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, or {@condition stunned}, he chooses a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 feet of him who doesn't already have the condition or is immune to it. The chosen creature then gains the condition for the duration, and Harlo loses the condition. He can use this reaction even while {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Echolocation
entries: The harpy can't use their blindsight while {@condition deafened}.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 3d4 + 2}) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature {@condition charmed} by the harpy, they are also {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). Until this grapple ends, the harpy can't use their Talons attack on another target.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Alluring Song
entries: The harpy starts singing a beautiful song. They continue singing until they choose to stop (no action required) or until they become {@condition deafened} or {@condition incapacitated}. When a non-harpy creature starts their turn within 200 feet of the singing harpy, if that creature shares a language with the harpy and can hear them, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the harpy until the harpy stops singing or the target can't hear them anymore.

While {@condition charmed} in this way, the target can't willingly move on their turn, and they can't attack, damage, or target any unwilling harpy with any effect. If the {@condition charmed} target takes damage from a source other than a harpy, they can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.
A creature who succeeds on a saving throw to resist or end this effect is immune to the Alluring Song of all harpies for 1 hour.

bonus.name: Beckon
entries: The harpy chooses any number of creatures {@condition charmed} by their Alluring Song. Each target must use their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed in a direction chosen by the harpy. If this movement would lead the target into hazardous terrain, they can make a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw before moving. On a successful save, the target's reaction is not used and they are no longer {@condition charmed} by Alluring Song.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The Harpy has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Dive Bomb
entries: If the Harpy misses its attack while flying, its movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks from the target.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The harpy makes two attacks with its Claws.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Battle Fury (1/Day)
entries: If a Harpy sees an ally fall {@condition unconscious} or die, it makes a Claw attack or gains 5 temporary hit points (its choice).

hp.special: Seven times their level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their level)

trait.name: Echolocation
entries: The harpy can't use their blindsight while {@condition deafened}.

action.name: Signature Attack (Talons)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 2d4 plus PB} slashing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the fledgling can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Wind Sweep (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the fledgling moves up to their flying speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If they end this movement within 5 feet of an enemy they can see, the fledgling can make a signature attack against them.

action.name: 5th Level: Food Grab (3/Day)
entries: When the fledgling hits a Medium or smaller creature with a signature attack, the target is also {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}). The fledging then moves up to their fly speed without provoking opportunity attacks (no action required). While grappling the target, the fledgling can't attack another creature.

action.name: 7th Level: Harpy Song (1/Day)
entries: As an action, the fledgling starts singing for 1 minute. Each creature within 60 feet of the fledgling who can hear them and who understands Common or Giant must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the fledgling until they can't hear the fledgling singing anymore. While {@condition charmed} in this way, a creature can't willingly harm any of the fledgling's allies.

name: Harvester of Lies
languages: the languages it knew in life

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The harvester's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 14}). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring only that the harvester be wearing its coat of lies:

trait.name: Coat of Lies
entries: While wearing their specially prepared coat, the harvester's AC is increase by 2 and it can use its innate spellcasting.

trait.name: Hear Lies
entries: The harvester hears all lies uttered within 1 mile of it and knows the liar's distance and direction while the harvester choses to concentrate.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The harvester can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Trackless
entries: The harvester leaves no tracks to indicate where it has been or where it's headed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The harvester makes three attacks, only one of which can be sever tongue.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).

action.name: Sever Tongue
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one humanoid {@condition grappled} by the harvester of lies. {@h}33 ({@damage 8d6 + 5}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or have their tongue ripped out. A creature without a tongue cannot speak or cast spells with verbal components. A creature is immune to this effect if it is immune to slashing damage, doesn't have or need a tongue, or has legendary actions.
A tongue can be reattached within 1 hour of being severed with a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check, or at can be regrown using magic that replaces lost limbs.

name: Haugbui
languages: telepathy 120 ft. all the languages it knew in life

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The haugbui casts one of the following spells, requiring no components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}):

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The haugbui can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the haugbui has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The haugbui has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The hangbui doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The haugbui makes three Psychic Blast attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Psychic Blast
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 5d8 + 5}) psychic damage.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The haugbui magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the haugbui wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

bonus.name: Sepulchral Scrying {@recharge}
entries: While within 1 mile of its burial mound, the haugbui creates an {@condition invisible} sensor within 5 miles of the mound for 1 minute. When it uses this bonus action and as a bonus action on each of its turns for the duration, the haugbui can switch between using its own senses and projecting its senses through the sensor. While projecting its senses through the sensor, it can see, hear, telepathically communicate, and cast spells as if it was in the sensor's space, and it is {@condition blinded} and {@condition deafened} with regard to its own senses. The sensor can be dispelled ({@dc 14}).

trait.name: Incorporeal Cloud
entries: The haunt can occupy another creature's space and vice versa. In addition, the haunt can move through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain.
The haunt takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if they end their turn inside an object.

trait.name: Invisibility
entries: The haunt is {@condition invisible}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The haunt makes two Spectral Wrath attacks.

action.name: Spectral Wrath
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the haunt's space. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d12 + 4}) force damage.

action.name: Wave of Despair {@recharge 5}
entries: The haunt unleashes a wave of psychic pain. Each enemy within 20 feet of the haunt must make a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw, taking 33 ({@damage 6d10}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Possess Object
entries: The haunt can magically manipulate a Large or smaller object within 30 feet of them that isn't being worn or carried by another creature. The haunt can exert fine control on objects under their control, such as playing piano keys, slamming doors, opening windows, or writing with a quill.

As part of this bonus action, the haunt can hurl the object up to 30 feet in any direction or use it as a ranged weapon to attack one creature within 30 feet of the object. The object has a +8 bonus to hit and deals 15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage on a hit. The GM might rule that a specific object deals piercing or slashing damage based on its form.

name: Haunted Reflection
languages: understands any languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Limited Telepathy
entries: The reflection can magically communicate simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically with any creature within 100 feet of it that can understand a language.

trait.name: Death Shift
entries: If damage reduces the reflection to 0 hit points, it can make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is thunder or from a critical hit. The reflection automatically fails this saving throw if there are no other reflective surfaces within 60 feet of it. On a success, the reflection regains 10 hit points and uses its Mirror Step (no action required) as the previous reflective surface that contained it is destroyed.

trait.name: Unsettling Glare
entries: When a creature that can see the reflection starts its turn within 60 feet of the reflection, the reflection can force the creature to make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw if the reflection isn't {@condition incapacitated}. A target automatically succeeds on this saving throw if it can't be {@condition frightened}. On a failed save, the creature has disadvantage on ability checks and its speed is halved until the start of its next turn.

Unless {@status surprised}, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the reflection until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the reflection in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

action.name: Concentrated Ire
entries: The reflection focuses a wave of psychic fury at one creature it can see within 120 feet of it. The target must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that has averted its eyes from the reflection has advantage on this saving throw, and takes no damage if it succeeds on the save.

action.name: Mirror Step
entries: The reflection teleports into another nonmagical, metallic reflective surface of its choice that it can see within 60 feet of it.

reaction.name: Magic Reflection
entries: When the reflection is the only target of a spell or other magical effect that misses it or whose saving throw it succeeds, the reflection reflects the spell or effect back at its source. The source must be within 120 feet of the reflection or this effect fails. The reflection uses the spell save DC, attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original source.

name: Havel of the Autumn Moon
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Havel is a 4th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 13}, +5 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following spells prepared:

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Havel can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. Havel cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of their reaction).

trait.name: Wing Flap
entries: As a bonus action, Havel can use his powerful feathered arms to propel himself upward up to half his movement speed. He can use it in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

trait.name: Seedspeech
entries: Havel can communicate simple ideas to living plants, and is able to interpret their responses in simple language.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Hawkren is an 11th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Arcane Siphon
entries: Once per turn, when Hawkren deals damage to a creature with a spell, he regains 9 ({@dice 2d8}) hit points.

trait.name: Deathly Resilience (1/Day)
entries: When Hawkren takes damage that would reduce him to 0 hit points, he is reduced to 1 hit point instead and can immediately use his reaction to cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The haze hulk makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Hurl Foetid Flesh {@recharge 5}
entries: The gutbuster rips off a chunk of its mutated flesh and hurls it towards a space it can see within 120 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 28 ({@damage 8d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Invisibility
entries: The hunter magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the hunter wears or carries is invisible with it.

entries.name: Lashing Tendrils
