entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: 14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}) if it is a Large or smaller creature. The hunter has two lashing tendrils and can grapple up to two creatures at once.

entries.name: Reel
entries: As a bonus action the hunter pulls each creature {@condition grappled} by it up to 25 feet straight toward it.

entries.name: Mutant Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the juggernaut to 0 hit points, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the juggernaut drops to 1 hit point instead.

entries.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the juggernaut moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a slam attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the juggernaut can make another slam attack against it as a bonus action.

items.name: Hurl Foetid Flesh {@recharge 5}
entries: The gutbuster rips off a chunk of its mutated flesh and hurls it towards a space it can see within 120 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 28 ({@damage 8d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Invisibility
entries: The hunter magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the hunter wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

items.name: Lashing Tendrils
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}) if it is a Large or smaller creature. The hunter has two lashing tendrils and can grapple up to two creatures at once.

bonus.name: Reel
entries: As a bonus action the hunter pulls each creature {@condition grappled} by it up to 25 feet straight toward it.

trait.name: Mutant Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the hulk to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it makes a Constitution saving throw ({@dc 5} plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}. On a successful save, the hulk drops to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hulk makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Trample {@recharge 5}
entries: The hulk moves its speed. During this movement, it can move through the spaces of Medium and smaller creatures, as well as structures made of wood or stone that are less than 1 foot thick. When the hulk enters another creature's space for the first time during this movement, it can make one Slam attack against that creature. If the target is a creature, it is subject to the following effect. {@actSave str} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The targeted creature has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: If damage reduces the haze husk to 0 hit points, the delerium fragments in its body explode in a burst of contaminated energy, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. Each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage. Creatures who fail this saving throw by 5 or more gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.

name: Haze Husk
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) Bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Death Burst
entries: {@actTrigger} The haze husk is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by damage that isn't Radiant or from a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}. {@actResponse d}{@actSave con} {@dc 10}, each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the haze husk. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage. Failure by 5 or More: The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

hp.special: 76 (8d8 + 40) plus 76 (8d8 + 40) per player character

trait.name: Haze Aura
entries: A creature starting its turn within 30 feet of Lenore is subjected to the following effect: {@actSave con} {@dc 19}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains a {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Tendrils
entries: Lenore's long hair can latch onto surfaces to pull her in any direction. She has a {@variantrule Flying|XPHB} {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 40 feet (included in {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}) but cannot move more than 30 feet from a solid surface, including walls and ceilings.

action.name: Lenore always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On her turn, she can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Lenore takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn.

action.name: Tentacle Hair
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 15 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d4 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Contaminated Eye Blast
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 9}, range 120 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Force damage, plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 19}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}.

action.name: Grim Reveal (1/Round)
entries: Lenore removes her mask, revealing her horrific form. {@actSave wis} {@dc 19}, creatures within 60 feet of her who can see her. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition (save ends).

action.name: Octarine Wall (1/Day)
entries: Lenore summons a shimmering wall within 120 feet of her. The wall can be up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick. Alternatively, she can shape the wall into a sphere up to 30 feet in diameter centered on a point she can see within range. The wall has three octarine layers. When a creature attempts to reach into or pass through the wall, it does so one layer at a time through all the wall's layers. {@actSave con} {@dc 19}. Failure:

Layer 1: 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage and the target gains one level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition; Layer 2: 17 ({@damage 5d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains two levels of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has the {@condition Defenseless|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition; Layer 3: 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains three levels of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and the {@condition Helpless|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. The wall can be destroyed by taking at least 100 Radiant or Force damage.

action.name: Radiant Gaze (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 19}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 44 ({@damage 8d10}) Radiant damage and the target gains one level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. If Lenore sees her reflection within the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}, she gains the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} conditions for {@dice 1d6} hours and can't take the Epic {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} for the duration.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: Lenore chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting her and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11 or higher, the effect ends on her. Lenore can use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

items.name: Multiattack
entries: The haze wight makes two longsword attacks or two longbow attacks. It can use its Contaminated Touch or Create Haze Husk in place of one longsword attack.

items.name: Contaminated Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.

items.name: Create Haze Husk
entries: The wight targets a humanoid within 10 feet of it that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute and died violently. It rises as a haze husk in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. The haze husk is under the wight's control. The wight can have no more than 12 haze husks under its control at one time.

name: Haze Wight
languages: The languages it knew in life

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The haze wight makes two Contaminated Blast attacks.

action.name: Contaminated Blast
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Necrotic damage. The first time the target is hit by a Contaminated Blast each turn, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 13}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

bonus.name: Animate Haze Husk
entries: The haze wight reanimates the corpse of a haze husk it can see within 60 feet. The haze husk is revived with 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and immediately stands.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The vampire is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The vampire may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The vampire has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the vampire's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes two attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Contaminated Bite.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d4 + 5}) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Contaminated Bite
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, or {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveFail} 17 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Delerium Healing
entries: The vampire touches a delerium shard and regains 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the vampire has used a delerium shard in this way, it can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

bonus.name: Aggressive
entries: The vampire moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} toward a {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature it can see.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Crone Songs
entries: The harpy sings a magical melody in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, choosing one of the following effects. Allies of the Crone are unaffected.

action.name: Breakneck Hymn
entries: Each creature in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that can hear the harpy has {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Bludgeoning damage from falling until the start of the harpy's next turn.

action.name: Disarming Tune
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 15}, each creature in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that can hear the harpy. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of the harpy's next turn.

action.name: Mesmerizing Melody
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, each creature in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that can hear the harpy. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of the harpy's next turn.

action.name: Piercing Notes
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15}, each creature in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that can hear the harpy. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Thunder damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

bonus.name: Aerial Maneuver
entries: The harpy takes the {@action Dash|XPHB} or {@action Disengage|XPHB} action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The harpy makes two attacks.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Aerial Maneuver
entries: The harpy takes the {@action Dash|XPHB} or {@action Disengage|XPHB} action.

reaction.name: Chorus
entries: {@actTrigger} The harpy is within the area of another harpy's song. {@actResponse} The harpy joins in on the song, choosing a creature within 30 feet. The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on its next saving throw against the song.

trait.name: Pluck
entries: The harpy doesn't need to spend extra movement to drag a Medium or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The harpy makes three attacks.

action.name: Grasping Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}). Until the grapple ends, the harpy can't use its Grasping Talons on another target.

action.name: Barbed Javelin
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Lightning damage.

bonus.name: Aerial Maneuver
entries: The harpy takes the Dash or Disengage action.

reaction.name: Chorus
entries: {@actTrigger} The harpy is within the area of another harpy's song. {@actResponse} The harpy joins in on the song, choosing a creature within 30 feet. The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on its next saving throw against the song.

action.name: Proboscis
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage. If the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, its Intelligence score is reduced by {@dice 1d4} until it finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. The target dies if this effect reduces its Intelligence score to 0.

action.name: Delerium Dust {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the hazewing moth. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Radiant damage, and the target has the {@condition Addled|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

bonus.name: Hypnotic Flutter
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of the hazewing moth that can see it (hazewing moths automatically succeed). {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends). If the target is already {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, it instead has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends). If the target is already {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, it also has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition (save ends both).

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Anchored
entries: The chrysalis is firmly anchored in place. It can't be forced to move or teleport unless it chooses to be.

trait.name: Haze Aura
entries: The chrysalis conjures Deep Haze in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, which renders its area {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB}. A creature that starts its turn in the area is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 10}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Harden
entries: The chrysalis regains 7 ({@dice 2d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, gaining any excess healing as {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

reaction.name: Sudden Emergence
entries: {@actTrigger} The chrysalis is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. {@actResponse} Roll {@dice 1d6}. On a 6, a Hazewing Moth Adult emerges from the chrysalis, sharing its {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count. On a 1-5, vile goo spills out of the chrysalis, and each creature within 5 feet of it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

hp.special: 125 (7d20 + 49) plus 125 (7d20 + 49) per player character

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (1/Round)
headerEntries: He Who Laughs Last casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 26}):

trait.name: Inscrutable
entries: He Who Laughs Last is immune to any effect that would sense his emotions or read his thoughts, as well as any divination spell that he refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the demon lord's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Mortal Coil
entries: He Who Laughs Last projects a 150-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of death and decay. A creature that ends its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} suffers an {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level and ages 10 ({@dice 3d6}) years. The creature removes an {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level gained in this way at the end of its turn, but only if it ends its turn outside the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. A creature's original age can be restored with {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB} or similar magic.

action.name: He Who Laughs Last always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On his turn, He Who Laughs Last can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, He Who Laughs Last takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Scornful Whip
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 16}, reach 120 ft. {@h}30 ({@damage 5d8 + 8}) Force damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pulled 30 feet toward He Who Laughs Last.

items.name: Walking Shadow (1/Round)
entries: He Who Laughs Last moves up to half his {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

action.name: Sleep No More (1/Round)
entries: He Who Laughs Last casts {@spell Power Word Kill|XPHB}.

action.name: Out Brief Candle (1/Round)
entries: He Who Laughs Last casts {@spell Finger of Death|XPHB} (save {@dc 24}).

action.name: Dusty Death (1/Round)
entries: He Who Laughs Last casts {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB} (save {@dc 24}).

action.name: Cage of Sorrows (1/Round)
entries: He Who Laughs Last creates a wall of bone on a solid surface it can see within 120 feet of himself. The wall appears as a flat surface made up of one 10-foot-square panel. The wall is 1 foot thick and lasts for 1 minute or until the wall is destroyed (AC 15, 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage, {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Bludgeoning and Thunder damage).

If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (GM's choice) and subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: He Who Laughs Last chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. He Who Laughs Last can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

name: Hedge Bard
languages: can also speak with beasts of any size which represent spiders, insects, worms, or other bugs

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The bard is a 4th-level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 13}, +5 to hit with spell attacks). They have the following bard spells prepared:

trait.name: Taunt (2/Day)
entries: The bard can use a bonus action on their turn to target one creature within 30 feet of them. If the target can hear the bard, the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the start of the bard's next turn

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bard makes two weapon attacks, one with their rapier and one with their dagger.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Curl Up
entries: The bard curls up into a spiny ball. While curled up in this way they cannot move, attack, or cast spells with somatic components, and their base armor class becomes 19. Any creature that misses the hedge bard with a melee attack while they are curled up takes {@damage 2d4} points of piercing damage from their sharp quills. If a creature hits the bard while they are curled up, however, the bard is knocked {@condition prone} in their space at the end of the turn. The bard may uncurl themselves at any point during their turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hedge mage is a 4th-level spellcaster that uses Intelligence as its spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}; {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). The hedge mage has the following wizard spells prepared:

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

name: Hedge Witch
languages: can also speak with beasts of any size which represent spiders insects worms or other bugs

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The witch is a 2nd-level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 13}, +5 to hit with spell attacks). The witch has the following warlock spells prepared:

trait.name: Dark One's Blessing
entries: When the witch reduces a hostile creature to 0 hit points, the witch gains 5 temporary hit points.

trait.name: Repelling Blast
entries: When the witch hits a creature with eldritch blast, they can push the creature up to 10 feet away in a straight line.

action.name: Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 1} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d6 - 1}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Fiendish Vigor
entries: The witch can cast {@spell false life} at will as a 1st-level spell.

action.name: Curl Up
entries: The witch curls up into a spiny ball. While curled up in this way they cannot move, attack, or cast spells with somatic components, and their base armor class becomes 19. Any creature that misses the witch with a melee attack while they are curled up takes {@damage 2d4} points of piercing damage from their sharp quills. If a creature hits the witch while they are curled up, however, the witch is knocked {@condition prone} in their space at the end of the turn. The witch may uncurl themselves at any point during their turn.

name: Hedy Crest
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Hedy can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. Hedy lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement and takes no falling damage. Hedy cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

trait.name: Talons
entries: Hedy has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface her talons could reasonably grip.

trait.name: Aerial Defense
entries: As long as Hedy is falling, gliding, or jumping, attacks made against her have disadvantage.

trait.name: Woodland Hunter
entries: Hedy treats three-quarters cover as half cover and half cover as no cover.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Hedy makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, ranged 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

name: Hellhound
languages: understands Common and Infernal but can't speak

trait.name: Hardened by Flame
entries: When the hound is subjected to fire damage, they take no damage. Instead, their skin darkens and hardens, and their AC increases to 18 until the end of their next turn.

trait.name: Stealthy Hunter
entries: The hound has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks to track other creatures and on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks to hide from creatures who are unaware of their presence.

action.name: Hellish Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage.

action.name: Hellfire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The hound exhales flame in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature who isn't a hellhound who fails the saving throw is lit on fire for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), or until the target or another creature who can reach them uses an action to extinguish the flames. A creature who is on fire at the start of their turn takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage. If a creature who is already on fire is set on fire again on a subsequent turn, the damage isn't cumulative, but the duration of the fire resets to 1 minute.

reaction.name: Tug of War
entries: When an enemy within 5 feet of the hound hits the hound with a melee attack, the hound can make a Hellish Bite attack against that enemy. If the hound's attack hits, the enemy is also {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}), and if the triggering attack was a weapon attack, the weapon used in the triggering attack can't be used to make any more attacks while the target is {@condition grappled}. The grapple ends if the hound attacks a different target with Hellish Bite.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

trait.name: Consult Hell (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: The hound's caregiver can talk to the hound about a specific course of action that the caregiver plans to take within the next 30 minutes, tapping into divinatory power through the hound's connection to the infernal realm. After 1 minute, the hound then gives a response based on its own objective prophetic sense of the outcome: one bark for good results, two barks for bad results, three barks for both good and bad results, and no barks for results that aren't especially good or bad.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The hound has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

action.name: Bite (Signature Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Lava Spittle (2 Ferocity)
entries: The hound makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} damage, and the hound can choose another creature within 5 feet of the target, dealing PB fire damage to that creature.

action.name: 3rd Level: Brutal Charge (5 Ferocity)
entries: The hound can move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. During or at the end of this move, they can make a signature attack against one target within reach.

action.name: 5th Level: Fire Breath (8 Ferocity)
entries: The hound exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage PBd6} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Hellhound Cur
languages: understands Common and Infernal but can't speak

trait.name: Crossfire
entries: If a creature starts their turn within 10 feet of two or more curs, that creature takes {@damage 4} fire damage.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the cur takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the cur takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Hellish Bite (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 3} fire damage, and if the target isn't a hellhound and the attack was made by more than one cur, the target must make a Dexterity saving throw with a DC equal to 10 plus the number of curs who joined the attack. On a failed save, the target is lit on fire for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), or until the target or another creature who can reach them uses an action to extinguish the flames. A creature who is on fire at the start of their turn takes fire damage equal to the number of curs who joined the attack. If a creature who is already on fire is set on fire again on a subsequent turn, the damage isn't cumulative, but the duration of the fire resets to 1 minute.

name: Helpful Hand
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The hand can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Finger Jab
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}1 Bludgeoning damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 10}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Latch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}The hand attaches itself to the target. While latched, the hand cannot attack. Instead, at the start of each of the hand's turns, the latched creature takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Necrotic damage. A creature within 5 feet can take an action to detach the hand with a successful {@dc 13} Strength check. The hand can also detach itself at any time during its turn (no action required).

bonus.name: Helper
entries: The hand takes the Help action.

trait.name: Blood Sense
entries: The hemonculus knows the location of any {@status Bloodied|XPHB} creature within 60 feet of it, unless the creature is a Construct or Undead.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The hemonculus doesn't provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hemonculus has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage, and the hemonculus attaches to the target. While attached, the hemonculus automatically hits the target with its Claw attacks.
The hemonculus can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the hemonculus as an action.

action.name: Exsanguinate (1/Day)
entries: The hemonculus magically draws blood from nearby creatures. {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, each creature of the hemonculus' choice in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the hemonculus. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} until the start of the hemonculus's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} If the hemonculus is attached to a creature, the hemonculus regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Necrotic damage taken by that target.

trait.name: Blood Armor
entries: Each time a creature with blood hits the herald with a melee attack while within 10 feet of the herald, the creature takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) necrotic damage, and the herald's AC increases by 1 until the end of its next turn. The herald's AC can't be increased to more than 20 from this trait.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The herald makes three Herald's Staff or Blood Bolt attacks, or it makes two Herald's Staff attacks and one Grasping Slam attack.

action.name: Herald's Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Grasping Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns, and the herald can't use its Grasping Slam on another target.

action.name: Blood Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 5d8 + 3}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature with blood, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Call Blood {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature with blood within 10 feet of the herald must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 45 ({@damage 10d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The herald then gains temporary hp equal to the single highest amount of necrotic damage dealt. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more also suffers one level of {@condition exhaustion}.

bonus.name: Grant Blood Rage
entries: The herald of blood infuses reckless rage in one creature it can see within 60 feet of it that isn't a Construct or Undead. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be enraged for a number of rounds equal to the target's Constitution modifier. While enraged, the target has advantage on all melee attack rolls, and attack rolls against it have advantage. When the rage ends, the target takes 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage and suffers one level of {@condition exhaustion}. A creature with any levels of {@condition exhaustion} automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

name: Herald of Calamity
languages: all languages known before the curse

trait.name: Aura of Calamity
entries: An aura of misfortune surrounds the herald in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Creatures other than the herald within the area have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@dice d20} Tests. Whenever a creature in the area other than the herald takes damage from any source other than another creature (such as a trap, a hazard, or a fall), it takes the maximum possible damage.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The Herald of Calamity can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Invisibility
entries: The Herald of Calamity has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition unless it is in an area illuminated by moonlight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Herald of Calamity makes two Life Drain attacks.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) Necrotic damage, and the Herald of Calamity regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half the amount of Necrotic damage dealt.

reaction.name: Mishap
entries: {@actTrigger} An attack roll against the Herald of Calamity hits it. {@actResponse} The herald gains a +6 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB|AC} against the triggering attack. If this causes the attack to miss, it is redirected to a creature of the Herald's choice within 5 feet of it. Use the original attack roll to determine the success of the redirected attack.

trait.name: Made of Shadows (Shadow Form Only)
entries: The herald of darkness has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, it can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Shadow's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the herald's darkvision.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The herald of darkness makes two Embrace Darkness or Shadow Sword attacks.

action.name: Embrace Darkness (Shadow Form Only)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the herald's space. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Shadow Sword (Fiend Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Majesty of the Abyss {@recharge 5}
entries: The herald of darkness emits a sinister burst of infernal power. Each creature within 15 feet of the herald and that can see it must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) necrotic damage and is {@condition blinded} for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition blinded}. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more is also {@condition paralyzed} until the end of its next turn. A {@condition blinded} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Shadow Shape
entries: The herald magically transforms into a Large shadow or back into its true form, which is a Fiend. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Endless Footwork
entries: When the herald's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0, attack rolls made against it have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}, and if its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 at the start of its turn, it takes 20 Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Perfect Grace
entries: The herald doesn't provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} when it leaves an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The herald makes three Banner Pole attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Lethal Jape.

action.name: Banner Pole
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10} (with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} if the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0), reach 10 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) Slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Thunder damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, the herald can move it to any other unoccupied space within the Banner Pole's reach.

action.name: Lethal Jape
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, a creature the herald can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 24 ({@damage 7d6}) Psychic damage, and the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Wave the Banner
entries: {@actTrigger} An ally of the herald's within 60 feet misses with an attack roll or fails a saving throw. {@actResponse} The ally can reroll the {@dice d20} and must use the new roll.

name: Hexahedrooze

trait.name: Reactive Mutations
entries: Immediately after the ooze takes damage, it gains resistance to that damage type. The ooze can have up to two resistances from this trait. If the ooze has its maximum number of resistances, the oldest resistance is lost when a new one is gained.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze makes two Pseudopod attacks. It can replace one attack with Engulf.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The ooze moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Small or smaller  creatures' spaces. Whenever the ooze enters a creature's space, the creature must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the ooze. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

On a failed save, the ooze enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is {@condition restrained}, and takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the ooze's turns. When the ooze moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a {@dc 13} Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage and the target suffers one of the following random effects (roll a {@dice d6}):
1. The target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) force damage.
2. The target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage.
3. The target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage.
4. The target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) slashing damage.
5. The target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) cold damage.
6. The target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

legendaryHeader: The ooze can take 1 legendary action, choosing the option below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The ooze regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The ooze makes one Pseudopod attack

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Ophelia casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}, +8 to spell attacks):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ophelia makes two Spiritual Weapon attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Spiritual Weapon
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. {@h}25 ({@damage 6d6 + 4}) Radiant damage.

bonus.name: Healing Word (3/Day)
entries: Ophelia casts {@spell Healing Word|XPHB} using the spellcasting ability from Spellcasting.

name: High Mage Vairae

trait.name: Draining Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Vairae fails a saving throw, they can choose to succeed instead. When they do, Vairae has disadvantage on spell attacks until the end of their next turn.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: Vairae has the Rejuvenation trait found in the lich stat block.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: Vairae has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

trait.name: Turn Immunity
entries: Vairae is immune to effects that turn Undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Vairae uses Glare of Undeath and makes four attacks using Conflagration, Immortal Pain, Magic Drain, or a combination of them.

action.name: Conflagration (4th-Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 14} to hit, range 150 ft., one target. {@h}35 ({@damage 10d6}) fire damage, and if the target takes both an action and a bonus action on their next turn, they take an extra 17 ({@damage 5d6}) fire damage at the end of that turn.

action.name: Immortal Pain (4th-Level Spell)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft., one creature. {@h}28 ({@damage 8d6}) psychic damage, and the target is afflicted with pain. While afflicted in this way, the creature's attacks deal half damage. After each attack the afflicted creature makes against an enemy, the afflicted creature can make a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw, ending the effect on a success. A {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power, a {@spell lesser restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect also ends the effect.

action.name: Magic Drain (4th-Level Spell)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d12}) necrotic damage. If the target is currently affected by any spells not cast by Vairae, the target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or those effects end for the target.

action.name: Glare of Undeath
entries: Vairae glares at one creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or be compelled to hug themself tightly as protection against an unbearably cruel world. A creature hugging themself in this way is {@condition restrained} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). A creature the target can hear and understand can use an action to make a {@dc 22} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Machinations of Bone (2/Day)
entries: Each enemy within 30 feet of a point Vairae can see within 150 feet of them must make a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a target's innards fly from their body and they take 54 ({@damage 12d8}) piercing damage, fall {@condition prone}, and can't stand up until they recieve supernatural healing.

bonus.name: Necrotic Form (3rd-Level Spell)
entries: Vairae enters a shadow form and can move up to their speed. While in this form, Vairae is immune to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and the {@condition grappled} and {@condition restrained} conditions, and they can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. Vairae reverts to their true form at the end of their turn.

reaction.name: Baleful Teleport (6th-Level Spell)
entries: When a creature Vairae can see within 120 feet of them targets Vairae with an attack, Vairae utters a word of arcane power. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 22} Charisma saving throw or be teleported up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space Vairae can see, and if Vairae is no longer a valid target for the triggering attack, the attacker must choose a new target or the attack misses.

legendaryHeader: Vairae has three villain actions. They can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. They can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Cages of Wasting
entries: A cage of black energy springs forth around each enemy within 60 feet of Vairae. Each target must make a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 27 ({@damage 5d10}) necrotic damage and is {@condition restrained} in the cage for 1 minute or until Vairae is destroyed (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition restrained}. If a {@condition restrained} creature teleports out of their cage, the effect ends for them.

legendary.name: Action 2: My Magic Alone
entries: Vairae unleashes a wave of canceling magic. Each creature within 60 feet of Vairae must make a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target can't benefit from magic items or cast spells of 4th level or higher until the end of Vairae's next turn.

legendary.name: Action 3: Necrostorm
entries: Vairae fires black bolts of magic from their body. Each creature within 60 feet of them must make a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw, taking 78 ({@damage 12d12}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The spirit of a Humanoid killed by this damage rises at the start of Vairae's next turn as a wraith who permanently follows Vairae's verbal commands.

name: High Priest
languages: one regional language plus two other languages

trait.name: Enraging Sacrifice
entries: When the priest dies, each ally within 40 feet who can see the priest gains 20 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} and a +4 bonus to attack and damage rolls for 1 hour.

trait.name: Zealous Aura
entries: The priest radiates an aura of zeal in a 40-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from it. Each ally in the area has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} checks, and their successful attacks deal an extra {@damage 3d6} Radiant damage. This aura becomes inactive if the priest has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The high priest makes three Sharp Rebuke attacks.

action.name: Sharp Rebuke
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) Radiant damage, and one ally of the priest within 20 feet of the target can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to regain 9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and make a melee attack.

action.name: Call Soldiers of the Faith
entries: The high priest calls forth celestials that take the form of {@dice 1d4 + 1||Warrior Veterans} {@creature Warrior Veteran|XMM|Warrior Veterans} or {@dice 1d3||Lions} {@creature Lion|XMM|Lions} that enter the {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} at the end of the high priest's turn. The celestials follow the priest's commands and remain for 1 minute or until slain.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

bonus.name: Inspiring Monologue (3/Day)
entries: The priest chooses any number of allies within 60 feet who can hear the priest. Until the end of the priest's next turn, each target has  {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}, and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions and does not provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

reaction.name: To Me!
entries: {@actTrigger} The priest is attacked or targeted by a spell. {@actResponse} The high priest chooses a Small or Medium ally within 5 feet of itself. The priest and that ally swap places, and the ally gains 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} and becomes the target of the attack or spell instead.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The highland wolf has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the highland wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: In the first round of combat, the Highway Robber has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has {@status surprised}.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the Highway Robber surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage from the attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Highway Robber makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

action.name: Short Sword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Bow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Hunting Prowess
entries: If the Hill Dragon didn't make an attack on its previous turn, its speed increases by 15 feet. This benefit can stack up to three times (a maximum increase of 45 feet). Once the Hill Dragon makes an attack, its speed resets to normal.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Hill Dragon makes two attacks: one with its Chomp and one with its Claw.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition Prone}.

bonus.name: Use of Terrain
entries: The Hill Dragon takes the Hide action; it can only use this bonus action if it is in a field or grassy environment.

trait.name: Distracted
entries: When the clobberer targets a creature with an attack, another creature within range of that attack can use their reaction to distract the clobberer. If the clobberer can see or hear the distracting creature, the clobberer targets them with the attack instead.

trait.name: Pummel
entries: When the clobberer hits a {@condition prone} creature with a melee weapon attack, the attack deals an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage, and that target's speed is reduced to 0 until the end of their next turn.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The clobberer's attacks deal double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The clobberer makes two attacks using Greatclub, Rock, or both.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Hill Quake
entries: The clobberer falls {@condition prone}, and each creature on the ground within 20 feet of the clobberer must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. Structures in that area take 33 ({@damage 6d10}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Distracted
entries: When the flunky targets a creature with an attack, another creature within range of the attack can use their reaction to distract each flunky joining in the attack. Each flunky who can see or hear the distracting creature joins a group attack targeting that creature instead. If one or more flunkies can't see or hear the distracting creature, those flunkies join a separate group attack on the original target instead.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the flunky takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the flunky takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: The Hills Are Alive
entries: A Large or smaller creature who ends their turn within 10 feet of two or more flunkies must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Rock (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}4 bludgeoning damage, or 5 bludgeoning damage if the target is {@condition prone}.

name: Hoard Golem

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The golem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Enchanted Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical. When the golem hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 4d8} force damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Strike with Awe
entries: A creature that enters a space within 120 feet of the hoard golem or starts its turn there must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks while it remains within 120 feet of the golem.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hoard golem makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) force damage.

action.name: Thieving Whirlwind {@recharge 5}
entries: The hoard golem partially disperses into a whirlwind of coins, gemstones, and other valuables then re-coalesces. Each creature within 20 feet of the golem must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 44 ({@damage 8d10}) bludgeoning damage and loses one object it is wearing or carrying. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and doesn't lose an object. Each object the golem steals must weigh no more than 20 pounds and not be wrapped around or firmly attached to a creature. For example, the golem could steal a belt pouch full of coins or a creature's jewel-encrusted dagger, but it can't steal a creature's shirt or armor. The hoard golem steals objects of high value over those of minimal value. The stolen object becomes part of the golem's body and can't be retrieved until the golem dies.

trait.name: Infernal Ichor
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the brandbearer reduces the brandbearer to 0 hit points, the brandbearer's corpse unleashes a spray of burning orange ichor. The creature who reduced the brandbearer to 0 hit points takes {@damage 1} fire damage.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the brandbearer takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the brandbearer takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Too Hot to Handle
entries: Whenever an enemy takes fire damage from a non-minion creature, the enemy takes an extra {@damage 1} fire damage for each brandbearer within 5 feet of them.

action.name: Searing Grasp (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 4} fire damage. If three or more brandbearers joined the attack, the target has disadvantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects that deal fire damage until the start of the brandbearer's next turn.

trait.name: Battle Ready
entries: The captain and each ally within 60 feet of them who can hear them have advantage on initiative rolls and can't be surprised, provided the captain isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Infernal Ichor
entries: When the captain dies, their corpse unleashes a spray of burning orange ichor. Each creature within 5 feet of the captain takes 5 fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The captain makes two Blightblade or two Eye Fire attacks. They can replace one attack with a use of On My Mark.

action.name: Blightblade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Eye Fire
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage.

action.name: On My Mark
entries: The captain commands an ally within 60 feet of them who can hear them to attack. That ally can make a weapon attack (no action required), dealing an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage on a hit.

bonus.name: Lead the Charge (1/Day)
entries: The captain and each ally within 30 feet of them who can see them can move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

reaction.name: Hidden Gift (3/Day)
entries: When an ally the captain can see within 30 feet of them takes damage, the captain magically turns that ally {@condition invisible}. The ally remains {@condition invisible} until the end of their next turn or until they attack, deal damage, or force another creature to make a saving throw.

trait.name: Fiery Leap
entries: The firerunner's long jump is up to 30 feet and their high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start. The first time a firerunner lands after a jump on their turn, each creature within 5 feet of them takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Infernal Ichor
entries: When the firerunner dies, their corpse unleashes a spray of burning orange ichor. Each creature within 5 feet of the firerunner takes 5 fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The firerunner makes two Fire Scimitar attacks.

action.name: Fire Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Blaze Sprint {@recharge 5}
entries: The firerunner moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Each creature they come within 5 feet of during this movement must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Infernal Ichor
entries: When the incendiarist dies, their corpse unleashes a spray of burning orange ichor. Each creature within 5 feet of the incendiarist takes 3 fire damage.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Blazing Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, they are set on fire. While on fire, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage at the end of each of their turns, and the target or another creature who can reach them can use an action to put out the flames. A creature who is already on fire suffers no additional effect from being set on fire in this way again.

action.name: Fire Mote {@recharge}
entries: The incendiarist shoots an explosive mote of fire at a creature they can see within 100 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage and, if they are Large or smaller, fall {@condition prone}. All other creatures within 15 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Infernal Ichor
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the recruit reduces the recruit to 0 hit points, the recruit's corpse unleashes a spray of burning orange ichor. The creature who reduced the recruit to 0 hit points takes 1 fire damage.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the recruit takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the recruit takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Tactical Positioning
entries: When a non-minion ally attacks a creature, that ally gains a +1 bonus to the attack roll for each recruit within 5 feet of the target (maximum bonus of +5).

action.name: Longsword (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1} slashing damage.

resist.note: from mundane attacks in smoke form

trait.name: Amorphous (Smoke Form Only)
entries: The smokebinder can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Infernal Ichor
entries: When the smokebinder dies, their corpse unleashes a spray of burning orange ichor. Each creature within 5 feet of the smokebinder takes 3 fire damage.

action.name: Toxic Flame
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage. If the smokebinder has advantage on the attack roll, the target is {@condition poisoned} and can't speak until the end of the target's next turn.

action.name: Choking Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage. If the smokebinder has advantage on the attack roll, the target can't speak until the end of the target's next turn.

bonus.name: Smoke Form (1/Day)
entries: The smokebinder transforms from flesh into a magical gray smoke for 1 minute. Any equipment they are wearing or carrying is also transformed for the duration.

While in smoke form, the smokebinder gains a flying speed equal to their walking speed, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks, and immunity to the {@condition grappled} and {@condition restrained} conditions.
The smokebinder can revert to their true form as a bonus action. If the smokebinder becomes {@condition incapacitated} or dies, they revert to their true form.

bonus.name: Sneak (Smoke Form Only)
entries: The smokebinder takes the Hide action.

hp.special: Seven times their level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Flame Touch)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell ignites if it isn't being worn or carried. This spell's damage increases by {@damage 1d10} when the tactician reaches 5th level ({@damage 2d10}), 11th level ({@damage 3d10}), and 17th level ({@damage 4d10}).

action.name: 3rd Level: Heat Seeker (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the tactician makes a signature attack but doesn't make an attack roll for it. Instead, the attack automatically hits, and each ally within 30 feet of the target can use their reaction to move up to their speed toward the target.

action.name: 5th Level: Beacon (3/Day)
entries: When the tactician hits with a signature attack, each creature within 5 feet of the target can use a reaction to make a melee weapon attack against the target.

action.name: 7th Level: Explosion (1/Day)
entries: As an action, the tactician hurls a ball of fire at a point they can see within 120 feet of them. The ball explodes in a 20-foot-radius sphere, forcing each enemy in that area to make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage PBd12} fire damage and is pushed 20 feet away from the center of the area. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed. The fire spreads around corners and ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

trait.name: Infernal Ichor
entries: When the trooper dies, their corpse unleashes a spray of burning orange ichor. Each creature within 5 feet of the trooper takes 2 fire damage.

action.name: Fire Flail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage, and another target within 5 feet of the first takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) fire damage.

action.name: Brimstone Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) fire damage.

bonus.name: Fight Me, Coward
entries: The trooper hexes a creature within 5 feet of them who isn't already hexed by another trooper. The first time on a turn a hexed creature damages a creature other than the trooper, the hexed creature takes 5 fire damage. The hex lasts until the start of the trooper's next turn.

trait.name: Infernal Ichor
entries: When the mage dies, their corpse unleashes a spray of burning orange ichor. Each creature within 5 feet of the mage takes 5 fire damage.

action.name: Infernal Teleport
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, they must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or be teleported up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space the mage can see.

action.name: Rain Hellfire (2nd-Level Spell)
entries: The mage rains fire down on a point they can see within 60 feet of them. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire spreads around corners, and it ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried.

action.name: Unhallowed Ground (3rd-Level Spell; Concentration)
entries: The mage chooses a point on the ground that they can see within 60 feet of them. A 20-foot square of glowing, unholy energy appears on the ground centered on that point and lasts for up to 1 minute. Each enemy in that area is vulnerable to fire damage.

reaction.name: Spell Siphon
entries: When a creature the mage can see within 60 feet of them casts a spell, the mage reflects some of the spell's magical energy back at the caster. The caster must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) force damage per level of the triggering spell (minimum {@damage 1d6} force damage).

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The apothecary casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}, +4 to spell attacks):

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 30/120 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Poison damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Medical Treatment (3/Day)
entries: The apothecary touches another creature. The target regains 20 ({@dice 4d8 + 2}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and the apothecary ends one disease or condition affecting the target, choosing from the {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, and {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} conditions.

bonus.name: Adrenaline Boost
entries: One ally within 5 feet of the apothecary can use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and make an attack.

spellcasting.name: Quarry
headerEntries: The scout casts {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB}, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scout makes two attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the scout's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Smoke Bomb (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
headerEntries: The trapper casts {@spell Fog Cloud|XPHB} without the need for components, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

trait.name: Powder Keg
entries: If the trapper takes damage from a critical hit, it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or the attack ruptures their alchemical supplies and gunpowder. Each creature within 15 feet of the trapper (including the trapper) is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Trapper's Crossbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 60/120 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) Piercing damage, and the target is subjected to one of the following effects of the trapper's choice:

items.name: Bola Shot
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Tranquilizer Shot
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Net Shot (1/Day)
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

action.name: Set Trap (5/Day)
entries: The trapper sets a trap in a space within 5 feet of it. A creature that moves within 5 feet of the trap immediately sets it off, affecting each creature in a 5-foot radius centered on the trap. The trap can be one of the options listed for the Trapper's Crossbow or one of the following additional options:

items.name: Fire Trap
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 1d8}).

items.name: Shock Trap
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Frost Trap
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dc 10}).

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The veteran casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}, +4 to spell attacks):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The veteran makes two attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the veteran's next turn.

bonus.name: Quarry
entries: The veteran casts {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB}, using the spellcasting ability from Spellcasting.

bonus.name: Quick Ascent
entries: The veteran moves up to 30 feet in a straight line in any direction, provided it ends its turn adjacent to a solid surface.

trait.name: Implant Egg
entries: If the horakh reduces a creature to 0 hp with a Bite attack or as a bonus action while within 5 feet of a creature with 0 hp, the horakh can implant an egg in the creature. The implanted egg rests in the creature's eye socket for 14 days while it incubates. A host creature can carry only one horakh egg to term at a time. While the egg is implanted, the host can't use its eye and has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight. Exactly 24 hours before the egg hatches, the host becomes {@condition blinded}. When the egg hatches, the young horakh erupts from the host's head, killing the host in the process.

A {@spell lesser restoration} spell cast on the host destroys the egg. Alternatively, a creature other than the host can take an action to remove the egg by succeeding on a {@dc 16} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check. On a failure, the host takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The horakh's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The horakh makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) piercing damage. If the horakh scores a critical hit, it removes one of the target's eyes, provided the target has eyes, and places the eye in a fluid sac on its thorax. While missing half or less of its total number of eyes, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight. While missing more than half its total number of eyes, the target is {@condition blinded} until its sight is restored.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) slashing damage.

bonus.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the horakh takes the Hide action.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If Horns moves at least 20 feet in a straight line towards an enemy, his antler attack deals an extra 3 {@dice 1d6} points of piercing damage. If the target of the charge is Large or smaller, they must make a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from Horns.

trait.name: Surge of Vigor (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: If Horns is dealt damage equal to half or more of his current remaining hit points (even if his HP is reduced to 0 by the attack), he immediately regains 8 ({@dice 1d12 + 2}) hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Horns makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Antlers
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d10 + 1}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Horns adds 2 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, Horns must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

trait.name: Broken Mind
entries: If the horror is the target of a greater restoration spell or more powerful restorative magic, it sees through the dreamholder's illusions and can't be beguiled by the dreamholder for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Slow Fall
entries: While in a dreamscape, a horror is constantly under the effects of the feather fall spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The horror makes three attacks.

action.name: Phantom Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) psychic damage.

action.name: Horrifying Appearance
entries: Each creature within 60 feet of the horror that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this horror's Horrifying Appearance for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The horror flit hunter can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Breed
entries: When the horror flit hunter kills a Small or larger creature, a new horror flit swarm emerges from the corpse {@dice 1d4} hours later.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The horror flit hunter can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The horror flit hunter makes two bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

name: Hospital Horror
