languages: understands Common and Deep Speech but can't speak

trait.name: Aversion to Needles
entries: If the horror takes Piercing damage, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The horror has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the horror's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The horror makes two Graft Blade attacks.

action.name: Graft Blade
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Slashing damage.

bonus.name: Stim Burst
entries: The horror takes the Dash action and can jump up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

hp.special: 5 plus five times your Pugilist level (the hound has a number of Hit Dice [d8s] equal to your Pugilist level)

trait.name: Pack Bond
entries: Add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to any ability check or saving throw the beast makes.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} Bonus equals your Constitution modifier plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, reach 5 ft. {@h}{@damage 2d4 + 2} plus your Constitution modifier Piercing damage. If the target is a creature Large or smaller, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC equals 8 plus your Constitution modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) or one of the following effects of your choice occur: the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, or it is pushed 5 feet away from the hound.

name: Hound of Sauron
passive: 15 (20 when relying on hearing or smell)

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The Hound of Sauron has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The Hound of Sauron has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Hound of Sauron's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Hound of Sauron makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must make a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}) and the Hound of Sauron cannot use its claws on another target.

name: Hound of the Night
languages: understands Elvish and Umbral but can't speak

trait.name: Fey Scent
entries: The hound of the night has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell. If it is tracking a Fey, Giant, or Humanoid whose scent it knows, the hound can continue tracking that creature if the creature moves into the Border Ethereal or teleports, provided the creature isn't in the Border Ethereal for more than 1 minute or that the creature doesn't teleport more than 100 feet at a time.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hound of the night makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Frost Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The hound exhales frost in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 ({@damage 6d8}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Teleport {@recharge 4}
entries: The hound magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Before or after teleporting, the hound can make one Bite attack.

name: Hourglass Widow
languages: the languages it knew in life

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The widow's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 20}, {@hit 12} to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
footerEntries: *The widow casts these spells before combat.

trait.name: Accelerate Through Time (2/Day)
entries: The widow takes one additional action.

trait.name: Master of Time
entries: The widow can choose to be unaffected by effects that modify time or change its speed. The widow can affect others frozen in a time stop or other stasis-like effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the widow fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The widow regains 25 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes fire or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the widow's next turn. The widow's body is destroyed only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The widow has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The widow uses disintegrating touch and withering gaze.

action.name: Disintegrating Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) force damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or have their speed decreased by 15 feet for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The effects are cumulative.

action.name: Withering Gaze
entries: A creature within 30 feet that the widow can see suffers 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage.

legendary.name: Eldritch Blast
entries: The widow casts {@spell eldritch blast}.

legendary.name: Sudden Rush (2 Actions)
entries: The widow teleports to a space it can see within 30 feet and uses disintegrating touch before or after it teleports.

legendary.name: Frozen in Time (3 Actions)
entries: All creatures within 20 ft. of the widow must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the end of the creature's next turn.

name: House of Horror
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

trait.name: Construction
entries: Creatures can enter the house's space and navigate it as a normal building. The house makes attacks from any surface or object that isn't being worn or carried within its space. It doesn't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ranged attack rolls due to an enemy being within 5 feet of it.

If a creature deals 30 or more damage in a single turn to a 5-foot section of the house's structure, the house must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or a 5-foot opening appears in that space until the start of the creature's next turn.

trait.name: Exorcism Susceptibility
entries: If the house is targeted by a {@spell Dispel Evil and Good|XPHB} spell, it has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition. At the end of each of its turns, it can make a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw, ending the condition on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, a creature inside the house that throws a flask of Holy Water against the house and succeeds on a {@dc 20} Charisma check affects the house as above.

trait.name: Soul Trap
entries: A Humanoid that dies within the house has its soul trapped there until the house dies. The creature can't be returned to life by any means short of a {@spell True Resurrection|XPHB} or {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The house makes three attacks, using Structure Slam or {@variantrule Object|XPHB} Fling in any combination, and it uses Agonized Souls.

action.name: Structure Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Force damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}). The house can grapple up to two creatures at a time, using animated furniture, objects, or fixtures such as stair railings.

action.name: Object Fling
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 11}, range 20/60 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d4 + 6}) Bludgeoning or Piercing damage (house's choice). If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Agonized Souls
entries: The house's stolen souls torment a victim. {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, a creature within 10 feet of the house. {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

bonus.name: Alter Structure
entries: The house can reshape itself to change the location of walls, doors, floors, and other features of its construction. When one of these features appears or disappears, a creature within 5 feet of a changing feature can make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the creature chooses which side of a feature it ends up on, or it moves to the nearest unoccupied space to avoid falling.

trait.name: Lead by Example
entries: If the Howler hits a creature with its first attack on its turn, it can forgo its second attack to bolster its allies. Each friendly creature that saw the Howler make the attack gains a +2 bonus to its attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Sleep Deprived
entries: The Howler has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or magically put to sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Howler makes two attacks: either one with its Chomp and one with its Club, or two with its Longbow.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Regroup
entries: Each friendly creature within 20 feet of the Howler can move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks

reaction.name: Discouraging Chuckle
entries: When a creature misses the howler with an attack, the howler must release a gut curling bout of laughter, provided it has its reaction available. The next time the attacker makes an attack roll or ability check before the end of its next turn, it must roll a {@dice d4} and subtract the number rolled from the total.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Howler makes three attacks: one with its Chomp and two with its Shortsword. Alternatively, it makes two attacks with its Longbow.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Tricky Maneuver
entries: If the Howler hits a creature with its first Longbow attack on its turn while hidden, it can forgo its second attack to take the Hide action.

reaction.name: Paranoid
entries: The Howler can't be {@status surprised}.

reaction.name: Sleep Deprived
entries: The Howler has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or magically put to sleep.

reaction.name: Discouraging Chuckle
entries: When a creature misses the howler with an attack, the howler must release a gut curling bout of laughter, provided it has its reaction available. The next time the attacker makes an attack roll or ability check before the end of its next turn, it must roll a {@dice d4} and subtract the number rolled from the total.

trait.name: Sleep Deprived
entries: The Howler has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or magically put to sleep.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Discouraging Chuckle
entries: When a creature misses the Howler with an attack, the Howler must release a gut curling bout of laughter, provided it has its reaction available. The next time the attacker makes an attack roll or ability check before the end of its next turn, it must roll a {@dice d4} and subtract the number rolled from the total.

walk.condition: (20 ft. fly 120 ft. in roc form)

trait.name: Keen Sight (Roc Form Only)
entries: Hraesvelgr has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Influence Weather
entries: Nearby weather responds to Hraesvelgr's desires. At the start of each minute, Hraesvelgr can choose to change the precipitation and wind within 3 miles of him by one stage, up or down (no action required). This effect works like the changing weather conditions aspect of the {@spell control weather} spell, except Hraesvelgr can't change the temperature and the conditions change immediately.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Hraesvelgr fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Hraesvelgr makes one Beak attack and two Talon attacks, or he makes three Fist attacks. Alternatively, he can make three Gale Blast attacks. If two Fist attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Beak (Roc Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Fist (Giant Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Talons (Roc Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d6 + 7}) slashing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}. Hraesvelgr has two talons, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Gale Blast
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 11} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Swallow (Roc Form Only)
entries: Hraesvelgr makes one Beak attack against a Large or smaller creature he is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside Hraesvelgr, and it takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) acid damage at the start of each of Hraesvelgr's turns. Hraesvelgr can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If Hraesvelgr takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, Hraesvelgr must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of Hraesvelgr. Hraesvelgr has disadvantage on this saving throw if he isn't in his roc form. If Hraesvelgr dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by him and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

action.name: Sudden Gust {@recharge 5}
entries: Hraesvelgr unleashes a powerful gust of wind in a 60-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 63 ({@damage 18d6}) bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 15 feet away from Hraesvelgr. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't pushed.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: Hraesvelgr transforms into a roc or back into his true form, which is a Giant. His statistics, other than his speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. He reverts to his true form if he dies.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: Hraesvelgr makes a Fist or Talons attack.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Hraesvelgr moves up to his speed, or flies up to half his flying speed if in roc form, without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Ear-Splitting Screech (Costs 2 Actions; Roc Form Only)
entries: Hraesvelgr lets out an ear-splitting screech. Each creature within 30 feet of Hraesvelgr must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) thunder damage and be {@condition deafened} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the hraptnon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hraptnon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Undying
entries: Unless the hraptnon's Stillborn Heart is removed from its pool, the hraptnon's death is temporary. One of its countless xakalonus offspring grows into the hraptnon in 24 hours.
In addition, the hraptnon loses its immunities if the Stillborn Heart is removed from the pool.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hraptnon makes three melee attacks: one bite and two claws. Alternatively, the hraptnon can make two spine attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition incapacitated} until the end of the hraptnon's next turn.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Spine
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target is knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition restrained}. The target must escape ({@dc 20}) to remove the {@condition restrained} condition and be able to stand.

reaction.name: Spawn Xakalonus
entries: If the hraptnon takes 20 points of damage or more from a single attack, it can spawn a xakalonus, which appears in a space adjacent to the hraptnon and attacks on the same initiative count as the hraptnon.

legendary.name: Claw
entries: The hraptnon makes a claw attack.

legendary.name: Baneful Howl (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The hraptnon casts {@spell bane} as a 3rd level spell ({@dc 20} to resist).

legendary.name: Life Drain (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: One xakalonus within 30 feet of the hraptnon dies. The hraptnon regains hit points equal to half the hit points of the xakalonus that died.

trait.name: Psionic Immunity
entries: The hulking brain is unaffected by psionic powers manifested by voiceless talkers unless the brain wishes to be.

trait.name: Psychic Scream
entries: When the brain drops to 0 hit points, each creature within 30 feet of them must make a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The brain makes three Bash attacks.

action.name: Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until the grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and has disadvantage on saving throws against psionic powers. The brain can grapple up to four creatures at once.

action.name: Squeeze
entries: Each creature {@condition grappled} by the brain must make a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Psionic Invigoration (1/Day)
entries: Each willing voiceless talker within 60 feet of the brain regains the use of one psionic power of the voiceless talker's choice, and the voiceless talker has advantage on attack rolls until the end of the brain's next turn.

trait.name: Frightened Anger (Hulking Form Only)
entries: The hulking whelp has disadvantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects that reduce strong emotions, such as the {@spell calm emotions} spell.

trait.name: Pacify (Hulking Form Only)
entries: A friendly creature that has interacted peacefully with the hulking whelp in its whelp form can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. The hulking whelp must be able to hear the creature, who must take an action to make a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check. If the check succeeds, the hulking whelp transforms back into its whelp form on its next turn and stops attacking. If the hulking whelp takes damage before then, it remains in its hulking form and continues attacking.

trait.name: Unleashed Emotion (Hulking Form Only)
entries: On each of the hulking whelp's turns, it attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the hulking whelp attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack for two turns in a row, the hulking whelp uses Change Shape to return to its whelp form and stops attacking.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hulking whelp makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The hulking whelp transforms into a Huge, hulking canine or back into its true whelp form, which is Fey. Its statistics, other than its size and creature type, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

reaction.name: Defensive Transformation (Whelp Form Only)
entries: When the hulking whelp is hit with an attack or when a creature it can see or hear within 30 feet of it threatens to harm it, it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or transform into its hulking canine form (see the Change Shape bonus action).

trait.name: Empower Patron
entries: A non-minion creature serves as the mage's patron in exchange for the mage's protective magic. At the start of the patron's turn, the patron gains temporary hit points equal to twice the number of apprentice mages within 60 feet of them who chose them as a patron and can see them.

trait.name: Exploit Weakness
entries: When the mage makes or joins an attack that's made with advantage, the attack deals an extra 1 damage per mage who made or joined the attack.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the mage takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the mage takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Lightning Strike (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. {@h}2 lightning damage, and if this attack was made by more than one mage, each mage who joined the attack picks one creature within 30 feet of the original target. Each creature picked takes 2 lightning damage for each mage who targeted them; the mage's Exploit Weakness trait does not increase this damage.

action.name: Thunder Crack (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 thunder damage, and the target can't make opportunity attacks until the start of their next turn.

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When the brawler makes an attack, they have advantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The brawler makes two attacks using Grab, Haymaker, or both.

action.name: Grab
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). Until this grapple ends, the brawler can't grab another creature.

action.name: Haymaker
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, or 10 ({@damage 3d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage against a {@condition grappled} target.

action.name: Throw
entries: The brawler throws one Medium or smaller creature they are grappling or object they are holding up to 30 feet horizontally. If the thrown target is a creature, they fall {@condition prone} after this throw. If the thrown target would enter the space of a creature or solid object that is no more than one size smaller than it, the thrown target collides with it and stops in the nearest unoccupied space, taking 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. A Large or smaller creature hit by this thrown target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take the same amount of damage and fall {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Meat Shield
entries: When the brawler is grappling a target and is hit by a ranged attack made by another creature the brawler can see, the brawler gains a +2 bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If this bonus causes the attack to miss the brawler, it hits the {@condition grappled} target instead.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The brawler can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When the brawler makes an attack, they have advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Servant Senses
entries: Ithu'rath can sense anything the brawler senses, and Ithu'rath can speak through their body.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The brawler makes two attacks using Grab, Haymaker, or both.

action.name: Grab
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). Until this grapple ends, the brawler can't grab another creature.

action.name: Haymaker
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, or 10 ({@damage 3d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage against a {@condition grappled} target.

action.name: Throw
entries: The brawler throws one Medium or smaller creature they are grappling or object they are holding up to 30 feet horizontally. If the thrown target is a creature, they fall {@condition prone} after this throw. If the thrown target would enter the space of a creature or solid object that is no more than one size smaller than it, the thrown target collides with it and stops in the nearest unoccupied space, taking 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. A Large or smaller creature hit by this thrown target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take the same amount of damage and fall {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Meat Shield
entries: When the brawler is grappling a target and is hit by a ranged attack made by another creature the brawler can see, the brawler gains a +2 bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If this bonus causes the attack to miss the brawler, it hits the {@condition grappled} target instead.

trait.name: Death Chant
entries: When an enemy succeeds on a death saving throw while within 30 feet of three or more acolytes who aren't {@condition incapacitated}, the success instead counts as a failure, and if the roll was a 20, the enemy doesn't regain hit points.

trait.name: Exploit Weakness
entries: When the acolyte makes or joins an attack that's made with advantage, the attack deals an extra 1 damage per acolyte who made or joined the attack.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the acolyte takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the acolyte takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Transfer Life (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}2 necrotic damage, and if this attack was made by more than one acolyte, a creature of the acolytes' choice within 30 feet of them regains 1 hit point per acolyte who joined this group attack.

action.name: Necrotic Bolt (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}2 necrotic damage.

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When the cultist makes an attack, they have advantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Scythe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage, and the cultist regains hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt.

action.name: Death Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage, and the target's weapon attacks deal half damage until the start of the cultist's next turn.

action.name: Blackfire Blessing (1/Day)
entries: The cultist empowers up to 10 non-minion allies within 30 feet of them. For 1 minute or until the cultist dies, each creature's weapons burn with black fire and deal an extra 2 ({@damage 1d4}) necrotic damage on a hit.

bonus.name: Rise, My Minions! (1/Day)
entries: The cultist chooses up to three creatures within 30 feet of them who died within the last minute. These creatures return to life with 1 hit point, but they can't regain hit points, and they die after 1 minute.

reaction.name: Life from Death
entries: When a creature the cultist can see within 30 feet of them fails a death saving throw or dies, the cultist siphons their faltering life energy. The cultist chooses a creature within 30 feet of the cultist who isn't {@condition unconscious}, and that creature regains 14 ({@damage 4d6}) hit points.

trait.name: Exploit Weakness
entries: When the guard makes or joins an attack that's made with advantage, the attack deals an extra 1 damage per guard who made or joined the attack.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the guard takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the guard takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Overwhelm
entries: If a Medium or smaller enemy starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more guards who can see them, until the start of the enemy's next turn, the enemy's speed is reduced by 5 feet for each guard within 5 feet of them. If this reduces the enemy's walking speed to 0, they are {@condition restrained} until the start of their next turn.

action.name: Spear (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage.

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When the knave makes an attack, they have advantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The knave makes two Morningstar or two Javelin attacks. They can replace one attack with a Shield Bash attack.

action.name: Morningstar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage, or 13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage if the target is {@condition prone}.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Stay Down
entries: The knave kicks one {@condition prone} creature within 5 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or their speed is reduced to 0 until the end of their next turn.

hp.special: Nine times their level (number of d12 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Halberd)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d10 plus PB} slashing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the mercenary can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Battlefield Medicine (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the mercenary restores {@damage PBd8} hit points to a creature they can see within 5 feet of them.

action.name: 5th Level: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: The mercenary takes the Attack action, making each attack with advantage and dealing an extra {@damage PBd4} slashing damage on a hit.

action.name: 7th Level: Halberd Master (3/Day)
entries: When a creature enters a space within the mercenary's reach, the mercenary uses a reaction to make a signature attack with advantage against that creature. If this attack hits, it deals an extra {@damage PBd6} slashing damage.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the raider moves at least 15 feet straight toward a target and then hits the target with a melee attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage.

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When the raider makes an attack, they have advantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Handaxe
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Shield Shove
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet away from the raider.

reaction.name: Splinter Shield
entries: When the raider is wielding a shield and is hit by an attack made by a creature they can see, the raider gains a +4 bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If this causes the attack to miss, the raider's shield breaks, and until they get a new shield, their AC is reduced by 2 and they can't use this reaction or make a Shield Shove attack.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: In the first round of combat, the scoundrel has advantage on attack rolls against any surprised creature.

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When the scoundrel makes an attack, they have advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Hit 'Em Where It Hurts
entries: When the scoundrel has advantage on a weapon attack roll, the attack deals an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage on a hit.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage, and the scoundrel can make a dagger attack against the target with advantage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, the wizard can cast the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When the wizard makes an attack, they have advantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Arcane Staff
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 6d6}) lightning damage.

action.name: Gust of Wind (1/Day; 2nd-Level Spell; Concentration)
entries: A 10-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line of strong wind gusts from the wizard for 1 minute. Each creature who starts their turn in that area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away from the wizard. Each creature in that area must spend 2 feet of movement for every 1 foot they move toward the wizard.

The gust disperses gas or vapor, and it extinguishes candles, torches, and similar unprotected flames. It has a 50 percent chance to extinguish protected flames like lanterns. The wizard can use a bonus action to change the direction in which the wind blasts from them.

action.name: Lightning Bolt (3/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
entries: The wizard fires magical lightning in a 5-foot-wide, 100-foot-long line. Each creature in the line must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 ({@damage 8d6}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The lightning ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

reaction.name: Arcane Shield (3/Day)
entries: When the wizard is hit by an attack, they magically gain a +5 bonus to AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss. If the attacker is within 10 feet of the wizard, the attacker must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) thunder damage and be pushed 10 feet away from the wizard.

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When the trickshot makes an attack, they have advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Point Blank Shooting
entries: When the trickshot hits a creature within 30 feet of them with a ranged weapon attack, they deal an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage. Additionally, being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose disadvantage on the trickshot's ranged attack rolls.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Bayonet
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Ricochet Bolt {@recharge 5}
entries: The trickshot uses a special ricocheting bolt to make one Heavy Crossbow attack against a target within 100 feet of them, then a second Heavy Crossbow attack against a different target within 30 feet of the first target.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The trickshot can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When the trickshot makes an attack, they have advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Point Blank Shooting
entries: When the trickshot hits a creature within 30 feet of them with a ranged weapon attack, they deal an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage. Additionally, being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose disadvantage on the trickshot's ranged attack rolls.

trait.name: Servant Senses
entries: Ithu'rath can sense anything the trickshot senses, and Ithu'rath can speak through their body.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Bayonet
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Ricochet Bolt {@recharge 5}
entries: The trickshot uses a special ricocheting bolt to make one Heavy Crossbow attack against a target within 100 feet of them, then a second Heavy Crossbow attack against a different target within 30 feet of the first target.

hp.special: 54 (4d12 + 28) plus 54 (4d12 + 28) per player character

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the troll remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a gigantic mushroom.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The troll regains 30 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Rotting Aura
entries: Any creature who starts its turn in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the troll takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage unless the troll has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: On its turn, the troll can move as normal
entries: However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the troll takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} of its choice at the end of each player character's turn:

action.name: Spore Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}33 ({@damage 6d8 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Grasping Tendrils
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 60 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) Slashing damage and if the target is Huge or smaller, the troll pulls the target up to 20 feet straight towards itself.

action.name: Entangling Mycelia (Recharge when {@status Bloodied|XPHB})
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 15}, each creature of the troll's choice in a 30-foot radius centered on it. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition (save ends).

action.name: Spawn Trolling (1/Round)
entries: The troll creates a Fungal Trolling which appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of it. The fungal trolling acts immediately after the troll uses this action, then acts after the troll's turn on subsequent rounds.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The troll chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. A troll can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hundun casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Inscrutable
entries: The hundun is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks made to ascertain the hundun's intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hundun has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Radiant Fists
entries: The hundun's Slam attacks are magical. When the hundun hits with a Slam attack, the attack deals an extra {@damage 2d6} radiant damage (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hundun can use its Motivating Babble. It then makes four Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage.

action.name: Motivating Babble
entries: The hundun babbles incoherently at one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or suffer one of the following effects until the end of its next turn. Roll a {@dice d4} to determine which effect happens.

action.name: 1 Distracted
entries: The target is distracted with a flood of new ideas and has disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

action.name: 2 Enlightened
entries: The target's mind fills with solutions to many of its problems, reducing its burden on itself. Its speed is increased by half, and its jump distance is doubled.

action.name: 3 Inspired
entries: The target is inspired by new ideas and has advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

action.name: 4 Struck with Genius
entries: The target's speed is reduced to 0 and it must use its next action to write itself a note, tie a small knot, or create some other physical reminder of the great idea that just struck it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hulk makes two Lashing Tendril attacks and one Belly Maw attack.

action.name: Lashing Tendrils
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 60 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}). The hulk can grapple up to two creatures at once.

action.name: Belly Maw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The hulk casts {@spell Invisibility|XPHB} on itself, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spell-casting ability.

bonus.name: Reel
entries: The hulk pulls each creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by it up to 25 feet straight toward it.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hunting horror casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Light Sensitivity
entries: While in {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}, the hunting horror has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and checks.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hunting horror has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hunting horror makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack, It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, Reach 20 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, Reach 20 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 18}).

bonus.name: Prey's Doom
entries: The horror unravels a target's life force with a bite. The hunting horror studies one creature it can see within 30 feet of itself. For 1 minute, once on each of the hunting horror's turns when it hits the target with an attack roll using its Bite attack, it can cause the target to take an extra 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} until the end of hunting horror's next turn. On each of the hunting horror's subsequent turns, it can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to deal 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage to the target automatically.

This effect ends if the target is ever outside the range, if it has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} from the hunting horror, if it is on a different plane of existence, or if hunting horror uses this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on a different creature.

legendary.name: Gnashing Teeth
entries: The hunting horror makes one Bite attack.

legendary.name: Crushing Horror
entries: A creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the hunting horror takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Bludgeoning damage.

legendary.name: Pursuit of Prey
entries: The hunting horror moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The huskarl makes two attacks, using Battle Axe and Javelin in any combination.

action.name: Battle Axe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Piercing damage.

reaction.name: Interpose
entries: {@actTrigger} An ally within 5 feet of the huskarl takes damage. {@actResponse} The huskarl takes the damage instead.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The hyphan can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the hyphan has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Poison Spray
entries: One creature within 15 feet of the hyphan must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 6 ({@damage 1d12}) poison damage.

action.name: Calming Spores (1/Day)
entries: One creature within 30 feet of the hyphan must succeed on a {@dc 12} Charisma saving throw or have its emotions calmed for the next minute. A willing creature can choose to fail this saving throw. The hyphan can choose to suppress any effect causing the target to be charmed or frightened. When this effect ends, any suppressed effect resumes, provided that its duration hasn't expired in the meantime. Alternatively, the hyphan can make the target indifferent about creatures of its choice that the target is hostile toward. This indifference ends if the target is attacked or harmed by a spell or if it witnesses any of its friends being harmed. When the effect ends, the creature becomes hostile again, unless the GM rules otherwise.

name: Hyphan Brute

trait.name: Grounded
entries: The brute has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid being moved against its will.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the brute can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Sun Sickness
entries: While in sunlight, or if it takes 10 or more radiant damage in a single turn, the brute has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of its next turn. The brute dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The brute makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Broken Sword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

legendaryHeader: The fungal guardians (brute, duskcap, and sporeslinger) can take 3 legendary actions between them, with the brute choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time, and only at the end of another creature's turn. The fungal guardians regain spent legendary actions at the start of the turn of the guardian with the highest initiative.

legendary.name: Smush
entries: The brute moves up to 5 feet and can occupy the space of a creature one or more sizes smaller than it. A creature whose space it enters must make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 13 ({@damage 2d12}) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and pushes the brute back to the space from which it moved. While the brute occupies the space of a creature it knocked prone in this way, the creature is grappled (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends, it is restrained.

legendary.name: Rampage (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The brute moves up to its speed and can move through the spaces of creatures one or more size categories smaller than it. Each creature whose space it moves through must make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw, taking 13 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage and being knocked prone on a failure, or taking half as much damage and not being knocked prone on a success. A creature can be affected by this action no more than once per turn.

variant.name: No Legendary Actions
entries: In scenarios other than The Veiled Lady monster hunt, you may wish to use these hyphans without their legendary actions. If you do so, the brutes' and duskcaps' CRs change as follows (the Sporeslinger's CR stays the same):
Without legendary actions, the Hyphan Brute's challenge rating is 5.

variant.name: Teamwork Trio
entries: A brute, duskcap, and sporeslinger that bore an especially close connection pre-hyphanation can bring the experience of that teamwork into the hyphan colony. Such individuals often form teams of three, acting in concert to strike more often, and perform feats that lone hyphans cannot.

name: Hyphan Duskcap

trait.name: Cunning Action
entries: The duskcap can take a bonus action on each of its turns in combat. This action can be used only to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: The duskcap deals an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the duskcap that isn't incapacitated and the duskcap doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Sun Sickness
entries: While in sunlight, or if it takes 10 or more radiant damage in a single turn, the duskcap has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of its next turn. The duskcap dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

action.name: Spike
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

legendaryHeader: The fungal guardians (brute, duskcap, and sporeslinger) can take 3 legendary actions between them, with the duskcap choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time, and only at the end of another creature's turn. The fungal guardians regain spent legendary actions at the start of the turn of the guardian with the highest initiative.

legendary.name: Flanking Strike
entries: The duskcap moves up to 20 feet and makes one attack with its Spike.

legendary.name: Spike Storm (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The duskcap fires a torrent of spikes in either a 20-foot cone or in a 10-foot sphere centred on it. Each other creature in the area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 ({@damage 5d6}) piercing damage on a failure or half as much damage on a success.

variant.name: No Legendary Actions
entries: In scenarios other than The Veiled Lady monster hunt, you may wish to use these hyphans without their legendary actions. If you do so, the brutes' and duskcaps' CRs change as follows (the Sporeslinger's CR stays the same):
Without legendary actions, the Hyphan Duskcap's challenge rating is 4.

variant.name: Teamwork Trio
entries: A brute, duskcap, and sporeslinger that bore an especially close connection pre-hyphanation can bring the experience of that teamwork into the hyphan colony. Such individuals often form teams of three, acting in concert to strike more often, and perform feats that lone hyphans cannot.

name: Hyphan Sporeslinger

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The sporeslinger is a 7th-level spellcaster and can cast the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Sorcery Points
entries: The sporeslinger has 7 sorcery points. It regains all its spent sorcery points when it finishes a long rest. It can spend its sorcery points on the following options:

items.name: Quickened Spell
entries: When the sporeslinger casts a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, it can spend 2 sorcery points to change the casting time to 1 bonus action for this casting.

items.name: Twinned Spell
entries: When the sporeslinger casts a spell that targets only one creature and doesn't have a range of self, it can spend a number of sorcery points equal to the spell's level to target a second creature in range with the same spell (1 sorcery point if the spell is a cantrip).

trait.name: Sun Sickness
entries: While in sunlight, or if it takes 10 or more radiant damage in a single turn, the sporeslinger has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of its next turn. The sporeslinger dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

action.name: Sporestaff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage. Hit or miss, if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the sporeslinger and its hyphan allies until the end of the sporeslinger's next turn.

legendaryHeader: The fungal guardians (brute, duskcap, and sporeslinger) can take 3 legendary actions between them, with the sporeslinger choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time, and only at the end of another creature's turn. The fungal guardians regain spent legendary actions at the start of the turn of the guardian with the highest initiative.

legendary.name: Smokescreen
entries: The sporeslinger shakes its staff, creating a 5-foot-diameter sphere of black smoke centred on it that heavily obscures the area. It then moves up to its speed.

legendary.name: Rage Spores (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The sporeslinger blows a plume of spores in a 25-foot cone. Each non-hyphan creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or immediately use its reaction to make a weapon attack against a randomly determined, non-hyphan creature within its reach/range.

variant.name: Teamwork Trio
entries: A brute, duskcap, and sporeslinger that bore an especially close connection pre-hyphanation can bring the experience of that teamwork into the hyphan colony. Such individuals often form teams of three, acting in concert to strike more often, and perform feats that lone hyphans cannot.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the Hypnotic Eldritch Blossom remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary flower.

action.name: Contaminated Nectar
entries: The Hypnotic Eldritch Blossom targets one creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.

action.name: Hypnotic Pollen (recharges on a short or long rest)
entries: The Hypnotic Eldritch Blossom releases a cloud of glittering pollen out to a radius of 30 feet. Creatures in the area must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition charmed} by the Hypnotic Eldritch Blossom for 1 minute. While {@condition charmed}, the creature is {@condition incapacitated} and must use all its movement on its turns to get as close to the Hypnotic Eldritch Blossom as possible.
The effect ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.

reaction.name: Spell Reflection
entries: If the hypnotic eldritch blossom makes a successful saving throw against a spell which targets only it and does not have an area of effect, or a spell attack misses it, the blossom can choose another creature (including the spellcaster) it can see within 30 feet of it. The spell targets the chosen creature instead of the hypnotic eldritch blossom. If the spell forces a saving throw, the chosen creature makes its own save. If the spell was an attack, the attack roll is rerolled against the chosen creature.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the eldritch blossom remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary flower.

action.name: Contaminated Touch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 2}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 10}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. If the target is {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by the eldritch blossom, it is hit automatically and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on its save.

action.name: Hypnotic Pollen (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 10}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the eldritch blossom. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. While {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and must approach the eldritch blossom on its turns, taking the most direct path possible and moving through hazards. The effect ends early if a creature takes an action to shake the target out of its stupor.

reaction.name: Spell Reflection
entries: {@actTrigger} The eldritch blossom succeeds on its save against a spell that targets only the eldritch blossom and doesn't have an area of effect, or a spell attack misses the eldritch blossom. {@actResponse} The eldritch blossom chooses a creature it can see within 30 feet as the spell's new target (the original caster is a valid target). If the spell forces a saving throw, the new target makes its own save. If the spell has an attack roll, the original caster rerolls the attack against the new target.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hypnovulfen has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hypnovulfen makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack, and it can use Swallow.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 5 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 17}), and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Swallow
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 20}, one Medium or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the hypnovulfen (the hypnovulfen can have only one creature swallowed at a time). {@actSaveFail} The hypnovulfen swallows the target, which is no longer {@condition Grappled|XPHB}. While swallowed, a creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects outside the hypnovulfen, and takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Psychic damage at the start of each of the hypnovulfen's turns. If the creature dies from this damage, the hypnovulfen absorbs its memories and regains 25 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

If the hypnovulfen takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the hypnovulfen must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls in a space within 10 feet of the hypnovulfen and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. If the hypnovulfen dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition Restrained|XPHB} and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting {@condition Prone|XPHB}.

bonus.name: Hypnotic Gaze {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 19}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. A creature holding a keepsake from a loved one succeeds automatically. {@actSaveFail} The creature has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until it takes damage. While {@condition charmed}, it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and must move as close to the hypnovulfen as possible by the safest route. The creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

trait.name: Aversion to Fire
entries: If the elemental takes Fire damage, its Piercing Form trait doesn't function on its next turn, and it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Piercing Form
entries: At the start of each of its turns, the elemental deals 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Piercing damage to any creature with 5 feet of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two Ice Claw attacks.

action.name: Ice Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Cold damage.

action.name: Shard Spray {@recharge 4}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Cold damage, and the creature's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The gargoyle doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gargoyle makes two attacks, using Claw or Ice Dart in any combination.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Ice Dart
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 30/60 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) Piercing damage.

trait.name: Chilling Presence
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of the ice maiden must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) cold damage. Unprotected, nonmagical flames within 15 feet of the maiden are extinguished, and water freezes if it remains within 15 feet of the maiden for at least 1 minute.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The ice maiden can move across icy and snowy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost her extra movement.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ice maiden has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Snow Sight
entries: The ice maiden can see through areas obscured by snow or fog without penalty.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ice maiden makes two Ice Blade or Ice Bolt attacks.

action.name: Ice Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Ice Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 8} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) cold damage.

action.name: Kiss of the Frozen Heart
entries: The ice maiden kisses a willing Humanoid, freezing the target's heart. The target has immunity to cold damage, but it is {@condition charmed} by the ice maiden until the maiden ends the effect (no action required) or until the target is kissed by a creature that loves it. The {@condition charmed} target obeys the maiden's verbal commands. If the target suffers any harm from the maiden or her allies, or if it receives a suicidal command, it can make a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. The maiden can have no more than three Humanoids {@condition charmed} at a time.

action.name: Icy Embrace {@recharge 5}
entries: The ice maiden blasts wintry weather on a point she can see within 60 feet of her. Each creature within 15 feet of that point must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) cold damage and is {@condition restrained} by ice until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition restrained}. The area then becomes icy, difficult terrain for 1 minute.

bonus.name: Snow Step
entries: The ice maiden teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space she can see. The origin and destination spaces must contain snow or ice.

name: Icosahedrooze

trait.name: Reactive Mutations
entries: Immediately after the ooze takes damage, it gains resistance to that damage type. The ooze can have up to six resistances from this trait. If the ooze has its maximum number of resistances, the oldest resistance is lost when a new one is gained.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the ooze fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze uses Engulf and makes three Pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The ooze moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Small or smaller  creatures' spaces. Whenever the ooze enters a creature's space, the creature must make a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the ooze. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

On a failed save, the ooze enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 21 ({@damage 2d20}) acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is {@condition restrained}, and takes 42 ({@damage 4d20}) acid damage at the start of each of the ooze's turns. When the ooze moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a {@dc 21} Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage and the target suffers one of the following random effects (roll a {@dice d20}):
1. The target takes 10 ({@damage 1d20}) force damage.
2. The target takes 10 ({@damage 1d20}) bludgeoning damage.
3. The target takes 10 ({@damage 1d20}) piercing damage.
4. The target takes 10 ({@damage 1d20}) slashing damage.
5. The target takes 10 ({@damage 1d20}) fire damage.
6. The target takes 10 ({@damage 1d20}) cold damage.
7. The target takes 10 ({@damage 1d20}) lightning damage.
8. The target takes 10 ({@damage 1d20}) thunder damage.
9. The target takes 10 ({@damage 1d20}) necrotic damage.
10. The target takes 10 ({@damage 1d20}) radiant damage.
11. The target takes 10 ({@damage 1d20}) poison damage.
12. The target takes 10 ({@damage 1d20}) psychic damage.

13. The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained}. The target or a creature within reach of the target can use its action to make a {@dc 21} Strength check, freeing the {@condition restrained} creature on a success.
14. The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or be afflicted by the {@spell confusion} spell for 1 minute*.
15. The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or be afflicted by the reduce effect of the {@spell enlarge/reduce} spell for 1 minute*.
16. The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or be afflicted by the enlarge effect of the {@spell enlarge/reduce} spell for 1 minute*.
17. The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or be afflicted by the {@spell zippit!|HelianasGuidetoMonsterHunting} spell for 1 minute*.

18. The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by 10 {@damage 1d20} until it finishes a long rest. The ooze regains a number of hit points equal to this value. A creature whose hit point maximum is reduced to 0 dies.
19. The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be engulfed by the ooze.
20. Roll twice more on this table.
*These spells don't require {@status concentration}. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendaryHeader: The ooze can take 3 legendary action, choosing the option below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The ooze regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The ooze makes one Pseudopod attack

trait.name: Apostasy Aura
entries: The idolic deity's presence causes devout followers to doubt their faith. When a creature attempts to use divine or celestial power, such as a cleric casting a spell or a paladin using Divine Smite, it must make a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the spell, class feature, or other divine or celestial power is expended, but it has no effect.

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The idolic deity doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the idolic deity remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal statue.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The idolic deity can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The idolic deity can use its Seduce the Righteous. It then makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) psychic damage.

action.name: Seduce the Righteous
entries: The idolic deity corrupts one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, or saving throws (the idolic deity's choice) until the end of its next turn. Creatures that wield divine or celestial power, such as clerics, paladins, or aasimars, have disadvantage on the saving throw.

bonus.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the idolic deity takes the Hide action.

trait.name: Hungry Dead Nature
entries: The ghoul requires no air or sleep.

trait.name: Turning Defiance
entries: The ghoul and any ghouls within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn Undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The imperial ghoul makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage, and, if the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or contract the darakhul fever disease.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach, one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or Undead, it must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The amphithere can breathe air and water.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage.

action.name: Poison Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The young amphithere exhales a blast of stinging venom in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this attack remains stable but is {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points. If a creature has total cover from the young amphithere, it is not affected by the breath attack.

name: Infernal Chancellor Lazivos

trait.name: Security for Speed (3/Day)
entries: When Lazivos fails a saving throw, he can succeed instead. When he does, his speed is halved and he can't take bonus actions or reactions until the end of his next turn.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: Lazivos has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

trait.name: True Name
entries: If a creature Lazivos can hear within 60 feet of him speaks his true name aloud, Lazivos loses his damage resistances, damage immunities, and Devilish Charm reaction for 24 hours. Lazivos's true name is Minto Abi.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lazivos makes three attacks using Infernal Rapier, Chancellor's Decree, or both.

action.name: Infernal Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage, and the target is marked with an infernal sigil until the end of their next turn. While marked, a creature can't hide or benefit from being {@condition invisible}, and attack rolls against them have advantage.

action.name: Chancellor's Decree
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 12} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) psychic damage, and the target must make a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is {@condition charmed} by Lazivos until the end of his next turn or until Lazivos or one of his allies harms the target.

action.name: Diabolic Deposition {@recharge 5}
entries: Lazivos commands the attention of each enemy within 30 feet of him who can hear him. Each target must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature must choose to either take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) fire damage plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) psychic damage or be {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature must either choose to take half as much damage or be {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the end of their next turn. Succeed or fail, if a creature is already {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, they must choose the damage

bonus.name: As I Say
entries: Lazivos commands a creature {@condition charmed} by him to use their reaction, if available, to make a weapon attack against a target of his choice.

reaction.name: Devilish Charm
entries: When Lazivos is targeted by an attack, power, spell, or other supernatural effect by a creature he can see within 60 feet of him, the creature must make a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition charmed} by Lazivos until the start of the creature's next turn, and Lazivos chooses a new target he can see for the triggering effect. The new target must be within the triggering effect's range.

legendaryHeader: Lazivos has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Welcome, Friends
entries: Lazivos invokes an infernal word of power. Up to three enemies within 60 feet of him who can hear him must make a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a target is {@condition charmed} by Lazivos for 1 hour (save ends at end of turn) or until Lazivos or one of his allies harms the target. On a successful save, a target takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) psychic damage.

legendary.name: Action 2: Heed My Commands!
entries: Lazivos and each ally within 60 feet of him moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Each creature {@condition charmed} by Lazivos moves up to half their speed in a direction he chooses (no action required).

legendary.name: Action 3: Deceptive Stratagem
entries: Lazivos switches places with a willing creature of his choice within 120 feet of him. Immediately afterward, up to five creatures of Lazivos's choice within 120 feet of him can make a melee attack (no action required).

trait.name: Fiendish Audacity
entries: The handler's AC includes its Charisma modifier.

trait.name: Fiendish Fury
entries: The handler deals an extra 16 ({@damage 3d10}) damage when it hits with a melee weapon attack (included in the attacks).

trait.name: Fiendish Vigour
entries: The handler gains 15 temporary hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the handler takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the handler's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The handler makes four attacks with its Morningstar or Tommybow.

action.name: Morningstar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Brittlebone Splinterspray Tommybow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 11} to hit, range 30/120 ft., two creatures within 5 feet of each other. {@h}15 ({@damage 4d4 + 5}) piercing damage. Reload (5).

reaction.name: Guardian
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the handler is the target of an attack, the handler can choose to become the target of the attack instead of the original target.

action.name: Multiattack
