entries: The infernal tormentor makes two greatsword attacks. It can use infernal leash in place of one attack.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Infernal Leash {@recharge}
entries: A flaming whip appears in the infernal tormentor's hand or from its greatsword and lashes at a creature the tormentor can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw. A creature that has signed a fiendish contract has disadvantage on this save. On a failure, the creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage, is pulled 10 feet closer to the tormentor, and is cursed for 1 minute or until the tormentor uses this action again. This curse also ends if the target enters hallowed ground.

While cursed, the target can't move more than 30 feet from the tormentor. Also while the curse lasts, the target takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) extra fire damage from the tormentor's greatsword attacks. The tormentor can use a bonus action to move the target 10 feet to an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the tormentor. If this space is dangerous, the target receives a new saving throw before moving, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The leader's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells (spell save {@dc 15}), requiring no material components:

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The leader is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). It regains its expended spell slots when it finishes a short or long rest. It knows the following warlock spells:

trait.name: Eldritch Heads (3/Day)
entries: When the leader hits a creature with an attack, the leader can cause the target to take an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage. Alternatively, as a bonus action, the leader can regain 9 ({@dice 2d8}) hit points. While the leader has at least one use of this trait remaining, it can't be {@status surprised} and creatures with the Pack Tactics trait gain no benefit from that trait against the leader.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

name: Injector
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The injector makes four Syringe attacks. It can replace any number of attacks with uses of Booster Dose instead.

action.name: Syringe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d4 + 6}) Piercing damage, and the target is subjected to one of the following effects (roll {@dice 1d4}; reroll if the injector has already used that effect during this turn):

items.name: Lethal Injection
entries: The target takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Poison damage.

items.name: Numbing Solution
entries: The target takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Cold damage and is subjected to the following effect: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dc 16}).

items.name: Mind Dampener
entries: The target takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage and is subjected to the following effect: {@actSave int} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Bewildered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

items.name: Induced Necrosis
entries: The target takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Necrotic damage and is subjected to the following effect: {@actSave str} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

action.name: Booster Dose
entries: The injector administers a tincture to a {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} creature it can see within 5 feet that isn't a Construct, choosing from the effects below. Once a creature benefits from a tincture, it can't gain that benefit again until it finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

action.name: Adrenaline Rush
entries: The target can use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action or make one weapon attack with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Inoculation
entries: The injector chooses Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, or Poison damage. The target gains {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the chosen damage type for 1 minute.

action.name: Restorative Fluid
entries: The target regains 35 {@dice 10d6} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. If the target is already at its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} Maximum, it gains these as {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} instead.

action.name: Focus
entries: The target has the {@condition Valor|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition {@dice 1d4} for 1 minute.

reaction.name: Unstable Tank
entries: {@actTrigger} The injector would take damage. {@actResponse} The injector reduces that damage to 0, and one of its tanks violently explodes. The injector chooses one of the effects of its Syringe or Booster Dose. Each creature within 20 feet of it is affected as if the Injector hit it with its Syringe or used Booster Dose on it. The injector can't use that effect until it finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The ink devil casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the ink devil's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ink devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Devil's Ink
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be marked with a small, fiendish tattoo for 24 hours. Devils have advantage on attack rolls against the marked target, and the target has disadvantage on saving throws against the spells and abilities of devils.

action.name: Corrupt Scroll
entries: The ink devil touches a scroll, corrupting it. A creature using the scroll must succeed a {@dc 13} Intelligence saving throw or the spell harms the caster (if an offensive spell), helps the nearest devil (if beneficial), or fails, consuming the scroll (if not offensive or if no devils are in range to benefit from the magic).

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The ink devil magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or uses Disrupt Concentration, or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the ink devil wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

bonus.name: Disrupt Concentration
entries: One spellcaster {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell within 30 feet of the ink devil that the devil can see must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or lose {@status concentration} on the spell.

trait.name: Normal Semblance
entries: The harvester has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}) and Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks to pass itself off as an ordinary Small Humanoid such as a Human urchin or a Halfling.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The harvester makes two Surgical Claw attacks.

action.name: Surgical Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Slashing damage, and the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 2d4}).

action.name: Syringe (1/Day)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Piercing damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 11}. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Poison damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} If this Poison damage reduces the target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it is stabilized but has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 hour, even if it regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. While {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Latch {@recharge 5}
entries: The harvester moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}. If it ends this movement within 5 feet of a Medium or larger creature, it can make one Surgical Claw attack against that creature. {@h}The harvester attaches to the target. While attached, the harvester has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against the target. The attached harvester moves with the target, using none of the harvester's movement. The harvester can detach itself by using 5 feet of movement on its turn. A creature within 5 feet, including the target, can take an action to detach the harvester with a successful {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: The harvester takes the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The inspired casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

trait.name: Dual Mind
entries: The inspired has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom saving throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The inspired makes two Crysteel Dagger attacks. It can replace one attack with {@spell Vicious Mockery|XPHB}.

action.name: Crysteel Dagger
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Force damage.

variant.name: Quori Vessel
entries: The inspired are vessels for quori spirits, allowing the quori to manifest a portion of their power while the vessel is possessed. An inspired can gain benefits depending on the type of quori possessing it. The quori also gains access to the inspired's knowledge and features.

entries.name: All-Around Vision
entries: The inspired can't be {@status surprised|XPHB}.

entries.name: Enemies Abound (1/Day)
entries: The inspired can cast the {@spell Enemies Abound|XGE} spell (spell save {@dc 13}).

entries.name: Suggestion (3/Day)
entries: The inspired can cast the {@spell Suggestion|XPHB} spell (spell save {@dc 13}), requiring no material components.

entries.name: All Around Vision
entries: The inspired can't be {@status surprised|XPHB}.

entries.name: Arcane Eye (3/Day)
entries: The inspired can cast the {@spell Arcane Eye|XPHB} spell, requiring no material components.

entries.name: Fear (1/Day)
entries: The Inspired can cast the {@spell Fear|XPHB} spell (spell save {@dc 13}), requiring no material components.

items.name: All Around Vision
entries: The inspired can't be {@status surprised|XPHB}.

items.name: All Around Vision
entries: The inspired can't be {@status surprised|XPHB}.

name: Interloper
languages: telepathy 90 ft. (conveys simple emotions) understands all languages but can't speak

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The interloper is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The interloper may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the interloper can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the interloper has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Alien Intellect
entries: The interloper is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the interloper's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Special Immunities
entries: Interloper is immune to the {@condition Jinxed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The interloper is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The interloper may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The interloper has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the interloper's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The interloper makes one Spindly Claw attack and one Suckered Bite attack. If the interloper has used Siphon Spell since the end of its last turn, it can instead make three Spindly Claw or Suckered Bite attacks.

action.name: Spindly Claw
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 11}, one creature within 5 ft. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Necrotic damage and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. Succes: half damage only.

action.name: Suckered Bite
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 15}, one creature within 5ft. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage and the target has the {@condition Bewildered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends) and the interloper regains 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. {@actSaveSuccess} half damage only.

action.name: Delerium Healing
entries: The interloper touches a delerium shard and regains 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the interloper has used a delerium shard in this way, that shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

action.name: Plane Shift (1/Day)
entries: The interloper casts {@spell Plane Shift|XPHB} targeting only itself, requiring no components and using Charisma as its spellcasting ability.

bonus.name: Teleport
entries: The interloper teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

reaction.name: Siphon Spell
entries: {@actTrigger} A spell is cast by a creature within 60 feet of the interloper. Response - Intelligence Saving throw: {@dc 14}, that creature. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Psychic damage and the spell fails, but no resources are expended by the spell's casting.

trait.name: Alien Mind
entries: If a creature tries to read the intruder's mind or deals Psychic damage to it, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw or have the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Gliding Levitation
entries: The invader hovers 6 inches above the ground and leaves no tracks. It ignores {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} caused by conditions on the ground, can move over liquids, and takes no damage from falling.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The invader has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Weak Constitution
entries: The invader has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition. If the invader is {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} at the start of its turn, it takes 20 Necrotic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The invader makes three Disrupting Touch attacks and uses Unnerving Glare if available.

action.name: Disrupting Touch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Force damage. A creature killed or an object destroyed by this damage is reduced to a fine gray dust.
Magic items, and any equipment worn or carried by a disintegrated creature, don't disintegrate.

action.name: Unnerving Glare {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, one creature the invader can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the start of the invader's next turn.

reaction.name: Otherworldly Slip
entries: {@actTrigger} The invader takes damage. {@actResponse} The invader teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet and can cause the following—{@actSave int} {@dc 16}, each creature within a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the space where the invader vanished or appeared (invader's choice). {@actSaveFail} 16 ({@damage 3d10}) Psychic damage, and the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Death Flash
entries: The invisiboar emits a bright flash of light when it dies. {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the invisiboar. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

trait.name: Invisible
entries: The invisiboar always has the Invisible condition unless it's in the area of an {@spell Antimagic Field|XPHB} spell or similar effect.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the boar moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Piercing damage and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Hungry Dead Nature
entries: The ghoul requires no air or sleep.

trait.name: Turning Defiance
entries: The iron ghoul and any ghouls within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn Undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The iron ghoul makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack, or it makes three Glaive attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or contract the darakhul fever disease.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or Undead, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Glaive
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 100/400, one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Hellborn
entries: The barbarian has advantage on any Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) or Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check it makes when interacting with fiends.

trait.name: Rage (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the barbarian can enter a rage that lasts for 1 minute. The rage ends early if the barbarian is knocked {@condition unconscious} or if its turn ends and it hasn't attacked a hostile creature or taken damage since its last turn. While raging, the barbarian gains the following benefits:

items: It has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
It gains a +2 bonus to the damage roll of any melee weapon attacks it makes (included in the attack).
It has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the barbarian can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While the barbarian isn't wearing any armor, its AC includes its Constitution modifier. It can use a shield and still gain this benefit.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: While the barbarian is raging, it makes two melee attacks, one of which must be with its claw.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage, or 12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage while raging.

action.name: Hellfire Claw (While Raging Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 bludgeoning or slashing damage (barbarian's choice) plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Feral Instinct
entries: The gladiator has advantage on initiative rolls. Additionally, if the gladiator is {@status surprised} at the beginning of combat and isn't {@condition incapacitated}, it can act normally on its first turn, but only if it enters its rage before doing anything else on that turn.

trait.name: Hellborn
entries: The gladiator has advantage on any Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) or Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check it makes when interacting with fiends.

trait.name: Planar Conspirator (1/Day)
entries: The gladiator can cast the {@spell contact other plane} spell, but only as a ritual.

trait.name: Rage (4/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the gladiator can enter a rage that lasts for 1 minute. The rage ends early if the gladiator is knocked {@condition unconscious} or if its turn ends and it hasn't attacked a hostile creature or taken damage since its last turn. While raging, the gladiator gains the following benefits:

items: It has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
It gains a +3 bonus to the damage roll of any melee weapon attacks it makes (included in the attack).
It has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
If it succeeds on a grapple check, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage, and it takes another 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage at the end of each of its turns until the grapple ends.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the gladiator can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While the gladiator isn't wearing any armor, its AC includes its Constitution modifier. It can use a shield and still gain this benefit.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gladiator makes two melee attacks. While the barbarian is raging, it can make one additional attack with its claw.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage, or 14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) slashing damage while raging.

action.name: Hellfire Claw (While Raging Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning or slashing damage (gladiator's choice) plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Influence Weather
entries: Nearby weather responds to the isonade's desires. At the start of each minute, the isonade can choose to change the precipitation and wind within 1 mile of it by one stage, up or down (no action required). This effect works like the changing weather conditions aspect of the {@spell control weather} spell, except the isonade can't change the temperature and the conditions change immediately.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The isonade has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The isonade deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The isonade can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The isonade makes one Bite attack and two Tail Slap attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}36 ({@damage 4d12 + 10}) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the isonade. A swallowed creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside the isonade, and it takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the isonade's turns. An isonade can have no more than four creatures swallowed at a time. If the isonade takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of the isonade. If the isonade dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

action.name: Tail Slap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d6 + 10}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Breach
entries: If the isonade swims at least 20 feet as part of its movement, it can use this action to emerge in a space on the surface of the water that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures and each creature within 10 of the isonade's space must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 49 ({@damage 14d6}) bludgeoning damage and is knocked {@condition prone}. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and is pushed up to 10 feet out of the isonade's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead falls {@condition prone} in the isonade's space.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The ithjar has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Slippery Serpent
entries: The ithjar has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple or saving throws to avoid being {@condition paralyzed} or {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ithjar attacks once with its bite and once with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the ithjar can't use its tail on another target.

reaction.name: Writhing Escape
entries: When {@condition grappled}, the ithjar can attempt to escape.

name: Ithu'rath

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Ithu'rath can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: Ithu'rath is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

trait.name: Slimy Resistance (3/Day)
entries: When Ithu'rath fails a saving throw, they can succeed on the save by channeling the power of their protective slime. Until the end of Ithu'rath's next turn, creatures have advantage on the saving throw for Ithu'rath's Devolving Tentacle attack.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: Ithu'rath has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ithu'rath makes six Devolving Tentacle attacks and uses Piscine Transformation.

action.name: Devolving Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) piercing damage. The first time a creature is hit with this attack on a turn, they must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be injected with a degenerative psionic slime (save ends at end of turn). While slimed, each time the creature makes an attack roll or an ability check, they must roll a {@dice d4} and subtract the number rolled from the {@dice d20} roll. At the end of a slimed creature's turn, the size of the subtracted die increases by one: the {@dice d4} becomes a {@dice d6}, the {@dice d6} becomes a {@dice d8}, and so on, to a maximum of {@dice d12}. The {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power or {@spell lesser restoration} spell also ends this effect.

action.name: Piscine Transformation (3rd-Order Power)
entries: Ithu'rath targets a creature with a head, legs, or torso they can see within 60 feet of them, blasting them with a pulse of transformational energy. The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or undergo one of the following transformations of the Ithu'rath's choice:

items: {@b Head.} The target's head transforms into the head of a fish, proportionately sized for their body. They can't speak.
{@b Legs.} The target's legs become fins. Their walking speed is reduced to 10 feet (unless their walking speed is slower), and they gain a swimming speed of 30 feet.

{@b Torso.} The target's torso becomes the body of a fish with gills. They can only breathe water and can hold their breath for 1 hour. If the target isn't underwater when this transformation takes effect, they begin suffocating.

entries: The transformation lasts until a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power of 4th order or higher or the {@spell greater restoration} spell affects the target. A target who suffers all three transformations at once is permanently transformed into a hybrid fishlike creature and can only be returned to their original form by a {@spell wish} spell or similar supernatural effects.

bonus.name: Jaunt (3rd-Order Power)
entries: Ithu'rath teleports 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see.

reaction.name: Liquefy (3rd-Order Power)
entries: When a creature within 30 feet of Ithu'rath hits them with an attack, Ithu'rath can psionically barrage that creature. That creature must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be pushed 5 feet away from Ithu'rath and be {@condition restrained} until the end of the creature's next turn, as their lower body temporarily melts into an immovable goo.

legendaryHeader: Ithu'rath has three villain actions. They can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. They can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Skeletal Collapse
entries: Ithu'rath targets one or more creatures with a skeleton within 60 feet of them, attempting to temporarily melt their ligaments. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage and have disadvantage on Strength- and Dexterity-based ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

legendary.name: Action 2: Psychic Pulse
entries: Ithu'rath channels a pulse of telekinetic energy to scour and harry their foes. Each enemy within 60 feet of Ithu'rath must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) force damage and be moved up to 30 feet in any direction.

legendary.name: Action 3: Slime Storm
entries: Ithu'rath unleashes a cloud of transformative slime. Each creature within 60 feet of Ithu'rath who isn't an olothec or a slime servant must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 45 ({@damage 10d8}) piercing damage and is {@condition blinded} until the end of their next turn as their eyes temporarily turn into insectoid feelers. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition blinded}.

trait.name: Camouflaged Webs
entries: With 10 minutes of work, the j'ba fofi can create a camouflaged web in a 10-foot cube. The web must be anchored between two solid masses or layered across a floor, wall, or ceiling. A camouflaged web layered over a flat surface has a depth of 5 feet. The web is camouflaged to match its surroundings, requiring a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to notice them. Each creature that starts its turn in the camouflaged web or that enters it during the creature's turn must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained}. A creature, including the {@condition restrained} creature, can take its action to break the webbing and free the {@condition restrained} creature by succeeding on a {@dc 13} Strength check. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; hp 5; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

trait.name: Forest Camouflage
entries: The j'ba fofi has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in forested terrain.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The j'ba fofi can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Spider Passivism
entries: No spider can willingly attack the j'ba fofi, unless attacked first. A spider can be forced to do so through magical means.

trait.name: Web Sense
entries: While in contact with a web, the j'ba fofi knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The j'ba fofi ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hp, the target is stable but {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour, even after regaining hp, and is {@condition paralyzed} while {@condition poisoned} in this way.

action.name: Call Spiderlings (1/Day)
entries: The j'ba fofi releases pheromones and calls 1 swarm of spiders. The spiders arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of the j'ba fofi and obeying its pheromone commands. The spiders remain for 1 hour, until the j'ba fofi dies, or until the j'ba fofi dismisses them as a bonus action.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks not made with cold iron weapons

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The jack of strings has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jack of strings makes two Mocking Slap attacks.

action.name: Mocking Slap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Animate Puppet
entries: The jack of strings animates up to three wooden puppets it can see within 60 feet of it. This works like the {@spell animate objects} spell, except the wooden puppet uses the statistics of a Small object, regardless of the puppet's actual size. The jack can have no more than five puppets animated at one time.

action.name: Puppet Link
entries: One humanoid or beast the jack of strings can see within 60 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or become magically linked to the jack's marionette. This link appears as a barely perceptible string between the jack's marionette and the target. A linked creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the link on a success.

While a target is linked, the jack of strings can use its reaction at the start of the target's turn to control the linked target. The jack of strings can make the target move, manipulate objects, attack, or take other purely physical actions. The jack can't make the target cast spells. While controlled, the target moves awkwardly and has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. If the target receives a suicidal command from the jack of strings, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

The jack of strings can have only one target linked at a time. If it links another, the effect on the previous target ends. If a creature dies while linked to the jack's marionette, the creature's body becomes a wooden puppet that resembles the creature.

trait.name: Spearhead
entries: If the jaculus moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Bite attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 4 ({@damage 1d8}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The jaculus's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jaculus makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

items.name: Anguished
entries: Jalin is {@condition miserable|TLotRR}, and has disadvantage on all ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws.
If a Jalin's {@dice d20} roll is a 1 or 2, the roll is a failure regardless of the DC for any ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.

name: Janky Koboldzilla

trait.name: Apotheosis (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the koboldzilla would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 145 hit points, it recharges its Dragon Breath, its Dexterity increases to 27 (+8), and its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma increase to 16 (+3). Additionally, all kobold pilots are incinerated in the process, it can't use its Koboldapult legendary action until it finishes a short or long rest, and the koboldzilla can use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 8,400 XP (16,800 XP total) for defeating the koboldzilla after its Apotheosis activates.

trait.name: Constructed Weakness
entries: The koboldzilla has the following flaws:

items.name: Arcanothermic Engine
items.entry: If the koboldzilla takes 10 or more cold damage in a single turn, it can't recharge its Dragon Breath action until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Rustable
items.entry: If the koboldzilla takes 10 or more acid damage in a single turn, it becomes restrained until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The koboldzilla is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the koboldzilla fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Loose Plating
entries: When the koboldzilla is reduced to 70 hit points or fewer for the first time since it last finished a long rest, it loses some of its armour plating. Its AC is reduced to 18, its walking speed is doubled, and its Dexterity increases to 20 (+5). These effects last until it finishes a long rest.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The koboldzilla deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The koboldzilla makes two attacks: one with its Gazebo Smash and one with its Tail.

action.name: Gazebo Smash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., each target within a 5-foot-radius circle. {@h}12 ({@damage 3d4 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Dragon Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The koboldzilla exhales fire in a 40-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 ({@damage 7d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendaryHeader: The koboldzilla can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The koboldzilla regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: The koboldzilla makes one Tail attack.

legendary.name: Koboldapult (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The koboldzilla fires a cluster of kobolds at a point within 120 feet of the koboldzilla. Each creature within 20 feet of that point must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success. Additionally, 2 ({@dice 1d4}) kobolds survive this ordeal, and land prone in unoccupied spaces within the area. These kobolds act on initiative count 1.

mythicHeader: If the koboldzilla's Apotheosis trait has activated in the last hour, it can use the options below as legendary actions.

mythic.name: Takeoff
entries: The koboldzilla upregulates its arcanothermic engine. Each creature within 15 feet of the koboldzilla must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) fire damage and be knocked prone. The koboldzilla can then fly up to 60 feet and begin to hover.

At the end of the next turn, the koboldzilla lands. Each creature in the space where the koboldzilla lands must make a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone and restrained until the koboldzilla moves out of the creature's space. Alternatively, the creature can use an action to make a {@dc 16} Strength ({@skill Athletics|PHB}) check, exiting prone in the nearest unoccupied space on a success. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage, is not knocked prone, and moves to the nearest unoccupied space.

mythic.name: Arcanothermic Overcharge (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The koboldzilla recharges and uses its Dragon Breath.

trait.name: Aura of Command
entries: The jarl and {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} creatures within 10 feet of it can't be {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} while the jarl isn't {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}.

trait.name: Mental Fortitude
entries: The jarl has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts. In addition, it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain a creature's intentions or sincerity.

trait.name: Resilient Leader (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the jarl fails a save, it can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jarl makes three attacks, using Longsword and Longbow in any combination.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Force damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5} to hit, range 150/600 feet., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Force damage.

bonus.name: Loyal Heroism
entries: The jarl inspires up to two {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll or save it makes before the start of the jarl's next turn.

reaction.name: Evade
entries: {@actTrigger} The jarl is {@status Bloodied|XPHB} and is hit by an attack. {@actResponse} The jarl adds 3 to its AC against that attack. If that causes the attack to miss, the jarl can move up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} away from the attacker without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Jedar can cast the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}):

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When Jedar makes an attack, he has advantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Warhammer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Nameless Reach (2/Day; 1st-Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 4} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage, and the next attack roll made against this target before the end of Jedar's next turn has advantage.

action.name: Animate Bones (1/Day)
entries: Jedar animates three {@creature decrepit skeleton|FleeMortals}s, who appear in unoccupied spaces Jedar can see within 30 feet of him. The skeletons act immediately after Jedar on the same initiative count and follow his verbal orders.
If Jedar dies, the skeletons are destroyed.

bonus.name: Bone Shield
entries: Jedar destroys a decrepit skeleton under his control and chooses a creature he can see within 60 feet of him. The target gains 7 ({@dice 2d6}) temporary hit points.

name: Jell Platena
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Fated (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: Jell can choose to reroll any attack roll, skill check, or saving throw.

trait.name: Songbird (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: Jell can cast {@spell charm person}. Charisma is her spellcasting ability and the spell does not require any somatic components to cast.

action.name: Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The commoner's long jump is 30 feet, and its base high jump is 15 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Team Tactics
entries: The commoner can take the {@action Help} action as a bonus action.

action.name: Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) bludgeoning damage

resist.note: from nonmagical Attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Death in Shadow
entries: When the jerbeen horror dies, its body and its equipment dissolve into shadows and disappear, leaving nothing behind.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jerbeen makes three dagger attacks or two shortbow attacks. It can use its Frostbite Touch in place of one dagger attack.

action.name: Frostbite Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) cold damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., range 20/60 feet, one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The swashbuckler's base long jump is 30 feet, and their base high jump is 15 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Team Tactics
entries: The swashbuckler can take the {@action Help} action as a bonus action.

trait.name: Sharp Witted Defense
entries: While the swashbuckler is wearing light or no armor and wielding no shield, their AC includes their Charisma modifier.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The swashbuckler makes three attacks, one with a dagger and two with their rapier.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Riposte
entries: The swashbuckler reduces the damage dealt by one melee attack that would hit them by 4 ({@dice 1d8}), and deals that much piercing damage to their attacker. The swashbuckler must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The thief's long jump is up to 30 feet and their high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Team Tactics
entries: The thief can take the {@action Help} action as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thief makes two dagger attacks.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Opportunist
entries: When a creature fails a melee attack roll against the thief, the thief can make a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check against a DC equal to 10 + the target creature's Dexterity modifier. On a success, the thief steals one item of the GMs choosing from the target. It cannot be an item actively held or worn by the target.

trait.name: Occupation
entries: Horse-trader, Ostler

trait.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Cunning, Secretive

trait.name: Explorer
entries: As long as she is outside and can see the sky, Jonall can always tell which way is north. If given one minute with a map to find her bearings, she can always identify the safest, most direct route to a location.

trait.name: Hard Headed
entries: If Jonall moves at least 20 feet straight towards a creature and then hits it with a headbutt attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Sure Footing
entries: Jonall ignores nonmagical difficult terrain.

trait.name: Traveler's Tales
entries: Jonall makes {@skill History} checks with advantage for anything related to towns, cities, or prominent regional features, such as unique geographic formations or landmarks.

action.name: Headbutt
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit; reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage, or 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 2} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d8}) piercing damage.

name: Jorumungkyn
languages: Understands Draconic but can't speak it.

trait.name: Poisonous Secretions
entries: The jorumungkyn constantly oozes poison into its surroundings. A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of a jorumungkyn (or 30 feet in water) takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jorumungkyn makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack and uses Constrict.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 19} One Huge or smaller creature the jorumungkyn can see within 15 feet. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage. The target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 19}) and has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the Grapple ends.

bonus.name: Glare of the Deep (2/Day)
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 14} One creature within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. While {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. If the target is more than 5 feet from the jorumungkyn, the target moves on its turn toward the jorumungkyn by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet of the jorumungkyn. Before moving into damaging terrain and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the jorumungkyn, the target repeats the save. {@actSaveSuccess} The target has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the jorumungkyn's Glare of the Deep for 24 hours.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If the jotun fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The jotun has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Material Bound
entries: The jotun has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to any spell or effect that would force it to leave the Material Plane, unless the jotun wants to leave. It has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws against effects that would return it to the Material Plane from another plane of existence.

trait.name: Too Big to Notice
entries: While the jotun remains motionless in nonmagical, natural terrain, it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The jotun casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 20}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jotun makes three Greatclub or Rock attacks in any combination. Instead of one of those attacks, it can use Icy Sweep or cast Fear.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d8 + 10}) Bludgeoning damage plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Cold damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 17} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}32 ({@damage 4d10 + 10}) Bludgeoning damage plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Cold damage.

action.name: Icy Sweep {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 23} Each creature within 20 feet of the jotun. {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Bludgeoning damage and 54 ({@damage 12d8}) Cold damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet away from the jotun and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Rock Catching
entries: {@actTrigger} The jotun is hit by a ranged weapon attack. {@actResponse} The jotun reduces the damage by {@dice 1d20 + 30}. If this reduces the damage to 0, the jotun can throw the weapon or ammunition at a creature within 60 feet of it, using the same attack roll total and damage total of the originating creature.

legendary.name: Hurl
entries: The jotun makes a Rock attack.

legendary.name: Smash
entries: The jotun makes a Greatclub attack.

legendary.name: Titanic Power
entries: The jotun casts a spell or uses Icy Sweep, if available.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The jotun casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 20}):

trait.name: Demigod's Vitality
entries: The jotun's ability scores and hp maximum can't be reduced except by means of a {@spell wish} spell.

trait.name: Icy Weapons
entries: The jotun's weapon attacks are magical. When the jotun hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 6d8} cold damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The jotun has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Material Bound
entries: The jotun is immune to any spell or effect that would force it to leave the Material Plane, unless the jotun wants to leave. It has disadvantage on saving throws against effects that would return it to the Material Plane from another plane of existence.

trait.name: Too Big to Notice
entries: While the jotun remains motionless in nonmagical, natural terrain, it has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jotun can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three Greatclub or Rock attacks.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d8 + 10}) bludgeoning damage plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) cold damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 17} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}32 ({@damage 4d10 + 10}) bludgeoning damage plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) cold damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the jotun's choice within 120 feet of the jotun and aware of it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the jotun's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Icy Sweep {@recharge 5}
entries: The jotun swings its ice-coated greatclub in a wide arc. Each creature within 20 feet of the jotun must make a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 36 ({@damage 8d8}) bludgeoning damage and 54 ({@damage 12d8}) cold damage and is pushed up to 15 feet away from the jotun and knocked {@condition prone}. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't pushed or knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Rock Catching
entries: If a rock or similar object is hurled at the jotun, the jotun can, with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw, catch the missile and take no bludgeoning damage from it.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Jourrael's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 15}). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: Jourrael can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. They take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if they end their turn inside an object.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: Jourrael deals an extra 35 ({@damage 10d6}) damage when they hit a target with a weapon attack and have {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Jourrael that isn't {@condition incapacitated} and Jourrael doesn't have {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|disadvantage} on the attack roll.

trait.name: Inevitable
entries: If Jourrael is reduced to 0 hit points, they do not fall {@condition unconscious} but becomes an incorporeal spirit for 24 hours. During this time, Jourrael can't return to their original form until they returns to full hit points. In this form, they are {@condition invisible}, can't attack or interact with corporeal creatures or objects, and can't be targeted by spells. After 24 hours have passed, Jourrael regains 1 hit point and returns to their original form with four levels of {@condition exhaustion}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Jourrael makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

action.name: Spectral Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d6 + 7}) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour. If the {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} fails by 5 or more, the target is also {@condition unconscious} while {@condition poisoned} in this way. The target wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

action.name: Void Dagger
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 12} to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d4 + 7}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: Jourrael can take the {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, or {@action Hide} action.

bonus.name: Mirrored Form (Recharges after a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|Short Rest})
entries: Jourrael manifests three illusory duplicates that hover in her space. Each time a creature targets Jourrael with an attack, roll a {@dice d20} to see if it hits one of the duplicates. If there are three duplicates, a duplicate is targeted on a roll of 6 or higher. With two duplicates, a duplicate is targeted on a roll of 8 or higher. A single duplicate is targeted on a roll of 11 or higher. A duplicate's AC is 17, and it is destroyed if hit. Jourrael can hide the duplicates as a bonus action.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Jourrael adds 5 to her AC against one melee attack that would hit her. To do so, she must see the attacker

trait.name: Regenerate
entries: The hulk regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn. If the hulk takes Acid or Cold damage, this trait doesn't function on the hulk's next turn. The hulk dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Out of My Way
entries: The hulk moves more than 10 feet in a straight line. {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, each creature within 5 feet of its path. {@actSaveFail} The target is pushed 5 feet away from the hulk and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hulk makes two Rusty Blade attacks. It can replace one Rusty Blade attack with Whirlwind if available.

action.name: Rusty Blade
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) Slashing damage and the creature gains the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} {@dice 2d6} condition.

action.name: Whirlwind {@recharge 5}
entries: The hulk twirls its blades around it in a violent, heavy swing. {@actSave str} {@dc 17}, each creature within 10 feet of the hulk. {@actSaveFail} 27 ({@damage 6d6 + 6}) Slashing damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Rip and Tear
entries: The hulk makes one Rusty Blade attack against a {@condition Prone|XPHB} creature.

name: Jumaga The Sky Salamander
languages: understands Common and Torum but can't speak

trait.name: Color Shift
entries: Jumaga naturally changes color to blend into its environment, giving it advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide from creatures that are more than 300 feet away from it.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Jumaga fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Jumaga's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: New Life
entries: When Jumaga dies, a new great beast is born into the world.

trait.name: Spirit of Obojima (1/Day)
entries: If Jumaga drops below 200 hit points, its color turns a bright orange for 1 minute. For the duration, its Chomp attack deals an extra 5 ({@damage 1d10}) poison damage on a hit, and it regains 5 ({@dice 1d10}) hit points each time it's targeted by a spell of 3rd level or lower.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Jumaga makes three attacks: two with its Chomp and one with its Tail.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage. Paralyzing Breath (Recharge 5-6). Jumaga exhales its paralyzing breath in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: Jumaga makes a Tail attack.

legendary.name: Skin Toxins (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Jumaga's body excretes a dangerous toxin. Until the start of Jumaga's next turn, creatures that touch it or hit it with a melee attack take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) poison damage.

legendary.name: Bestial Hiss (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Jumaga produces a thunderous hiss which terrifies creatures around it. Each creature within 150 feet of Jumaga must succeed on a {@dc 25} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition Pacified|ObojimaTallGrass} until the end of the creature's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The justice is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 13}). It has the following paladin spells prepared:

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The justice makes two attacks.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Mind Link
entries: Jutkarr can communicate telepathically with any Amethyst Knife boss regardless of distance, provided they are on the same plane of existence.

trait.name: Poison Resistant
entries: Jutkarr has advantage on saving throws he makes to avoid or end the {@condition poisoned} condition on himself.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Jutkarr makes two Deserved Transfer attacks.

action.name: *Deserved Transfer (2nd-Order Power)
entries: {@atk mp,rp} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) psychic damage, and one creature Jutkarr can see within 30 feet of him gains temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

action.name: Psionic Resilience (2/Day; 4th-Order Power)
entries: Jutkarr touches a willing creature and gives them immunity to one of the following conditions for 1 hour: {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition petrified}, {@condition poisoned}, or {@condition stunned}. Additionally, if the target suffers from the chosen condition, that condition is suppressed for 1 hour.

reaction.name: Shared Condition
entries: When Jutkarr is {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, or {@condition stunned}, he chooses a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 feet of him who doesn't already have the condition or is immune to it. The chosen creature then gains the condition for the duration, and Jutkarr loses the condition. He can use this reaction even while {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Natural Camouflage
entries: The prowler has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made in the forest. Creatures who attack a target that cannot see them have advantage on their attack roll.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the prowler moves at least 10 feet toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. The prowler can use its bonus action to make another claw attack against this target.

trait.name: Ambuscade
entries: The prowler can take the {@action Dash} or {@action Hide} action as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The prowler makes one claw attack and one bite attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage. If the target of the bite attack is {@condition prone}, it takes an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: The antlion has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has {@status surprised}.

trait.name: Burrowed Camouflage
entries: While it is at least partially burrowed, the antlion has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in sand or loose earth.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the antlion surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 16 ({@damage 3d10}) damage from the attack.

trait.name: Antlion Cone
entries: The antlion can spend 10 minutes digging a cone-shaped pit in the sand, or some other loose earth. The cone is 20 feet deep and 40 feet across, and the sides are steep enough that the loose earth they are made with is a falling hazard. A standing creature that moves within the cone (even if by forced movement) for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. A creature that falls {@condition prone} while within the cone rolls to the bottom.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends the antlion can't bite another target or use its sand throw, and if the target is a creature, it is {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Sand Throw
entries: One creature the antlion can sense within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Snapping Jaws
entries: When a creature the antlion can sense moves to within the reach of the antlion's bite and the antlion is not grappling a creature, it can make a bite attack against that creature.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The kackle can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Lantern Vulnerability
entries: The kackle's lantern has AC 15 and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage. Any damage the lantern takes deals half that amount of Force damage to the kackle.

action.name: Lantern Flame
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft. {@h}Varies by lantern color (kackle's choice):

action.name: Blue
entries: 7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Cold damage, and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Green
entries: 20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) Necrotic damage, and the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Purple
entries: 10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Red
entries: 15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Fire damage, and the target starts {@hazard burning|XPHB}, taking 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Fire damage instead of the regular burning damage.

bonus.name: Flickering Teleport
entries: The kackle teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. The kackle can then change its lantern color, and it can create the following—{@actSave dex} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the kackle's destination space. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 3d8}) damage of the same type as the current Lantern Flame color. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Kafuka's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The Kafuka can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts
entries: Kafuka can comprehend and verbally communicate with Beasts as if they shared a language.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Summon Swarm (2/Day)
entries: If available, the Kafuka causes a group of tiny woodland animals to form a swarm and attack a creature that the Kafuka can see.
This swarm of woodland creatures uses the {@creature Swarm of Rats} stat block and immediately disperses when it takes damage

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The kalke has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Sense Magic
entries: The kalke senses magic within 120 feet of it at will and can sense the general direction of spells being cast within 1 mile of it. This trait otherwise works like the {@spell detect magic} spell but isn't itself magical.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Use Magic Item {@recharge 5}
entries: The kalke activates a magic item in its possession and can ignore all class, race, and level requirements on the item. The kalke must make a {@dc 11} Intelligence saving throw. On a success, the item activates normally. On a failure, the item doesn't activate and can't be used again until the next dawn. If the kalke fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it causes a magical backlash. Each creature within 5 feet of the kalke, including the kalke, must make a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw, taking 5 ({@damage 2d4}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The kalke takes the Disengage or Hide action.

trait.name: Cunning Action
entries: On each of her turns, Kaybella can use a bonus action to take the {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, or {@action Hide} action.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If Kaybella is subjected to an effect that allows her to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, Kaybella instead takes no damage if she succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if she fails.

trait.name: Expert Cartography
entries: Kaybella has a +6 bonus to any ability check she makes using {@item cartographer's tools|PHB}, in addition to the ability modifier used for the check.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: Kaybella deals an extra 31 ({@dice 9d6}) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the agent that isn't {@condition incapacitated} and the agent doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Kaybella wields a {@item pick and pocket|GriffonsSaddlebag2} and has a {@item hoarder's haul|GriffonsSaddlebag2} and a {@item wayfinder sphere|GriffonsSaddlebag2}, which are all described in appendix A.

trait.name: Elusive
entries: No attack roll can have advantage against Kaybella while she isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Reliable Talent
entries: Whenever Kaybella makes an ability check that lets her add her proficiency bonus, she can treat a {@dice d20} roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Kaybella makes two attacks with her {@item pick and pocket|GriffonsSaddlebag2}.

action.name: Pick and Pocket
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d4+ 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: Kaybella halves the damage that she takes from an attack that hits her. Kaybella must be able to see the attacker.

trait.name: Hound's Tooth
entries: The keeper can comprehend and verbally communicate with dogs and other canids (beasts only).

trait.name: Pack Master
entries: Allied beasts within 60 feet of the keeper have advantage on saving throws to resist charm and fear effects.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The keeper has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the keeper's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the keeper has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Unseelie Blessing
entries: The keeper has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put them to sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The keeper makes two weapon attacks.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Command
entries: The keeper casts the {@spell command} spell, without expending a spell slot. Beasts have disadvantage on the saving throw.

bonus.name: Shadow Traveler (3/Day)
entries: While in shadows, dim light, or darkness, the keeper disappears into the darkness and reappears in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. A tendril of inky smoke appears at the origin and destination when it uses this trait.

trait.name: Raven Tongue
entries: The keeper can comprehend and verbally communicate with ravens and other corvids (beasts only).

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the keeper has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Unseelie Blessing
entries: The keeper has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put them to sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The keeper makes two Rapier attacks or two Hand Crossbow attacks.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Change Shape (2/Day)
entries: The keeper can polymorph into a swarm of ravens or back into their true form. While in raven form, the keeper can't speak, their walking speed is 5 feet, and they have a flying speed of 50 feet. Their statistics, other than their size and speed, are unchanged. Anything they are wearing transforms with them, but nothing they are carrying does. They revert to their true form if they die.

action.name: Raven Sight
entries: The keeper of ravens can see through the eyes of any raven they are aware of within 10 miles. The keeper sees what the raven sees and hears what it hears until the start of the keeper's next turn. During this time, the keeper's own ears and eyes are deaf and blind.

bonus.name: Change Shape (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The keeper magically transforms into a swarm of ravens or back into their true form. Their statistics, other than size, are the same in each form. Any equipment they are wearing or carrying in Humanoid form melds into the swarm of ravens form. They can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of their equipment. They revert to their Humanoid form if they die.

bonus.name: Shadow Traveler (3/Day)
entries: While in shadows, dim light, or darkness, the keeper disappears into the darkness and reappears in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. A tendril of inky smoke appears at the origin and destination when it uses this trait.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The keeper casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Blight Dependent
entries: If the keeper is targeted by an effect that ends the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition, it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Force damage and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Fungal Step
entries: The keeper ignores {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} caused by plants or fungi.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The keeper makes two attacks, using Blight Staff or Spore Spray in any combination, and it uses Rotting Ritual.

action.name: Blight Staff
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Spore Spray
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 8}, range 60 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) Poison damage. If the target is a creature, it has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of the keeper's next turn.

action.name: Rotting Ritual
entries: The keeper magically creates one of the following effects of its choice. It can't use the same effect twice in a row.

action.name: Frenzying Spores
