entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, a creature the keeper can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the target must immediately take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make a melee or ranged attack against a creature of the keeper's choice that is within reach or range of the attack. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Blight Spawn
entries: The keeper magically summons a Rotweaver (lacks a Hunting Horn) in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of itself. The rotweaver takes its turn immediately after the keeper on the same {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, and it obeys the keeper. The rotweaver vanishes after 1 minute, or when it or the keeper dies.

action.name: Devouring Fungus
entries: Life-sapping fungus sprouts from the ground in a 60-foot radius centered on the keeper.

The area is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}, and a creature has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition while within the area. The fungus remains for 1 minute, until the keeper uses this effect again, or until it dies.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Keldar casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as her spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Keldar makes two attacks using Longsword or Handaxe in any combination. She can replace one of her attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Thunder damage.

action.name: Handaxe
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Thunder damage. Creatures within 5 feet of the target take 1 Thunder damage.

bonus.name: Percussive Shove
entries: Kelda's drum emits a blast of percussive force. {@actSave dex} {@dc 13} Each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} Target is pushed away from Kelda to the end of the line.

reaction.name: Thunderous Rebuke
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature Keldar can see makes an attack roll against her. {@actResponse} {@actSave dex} {@dc 13} The triggering creature. {@actSaveFail} Triggering creature takes {@damage 1d6} Thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from Keldar.

name: Kenna Brightspark
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Kenna can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. Kenna lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement, and takes no falling damage. Kenna cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

trait.name: Talons
entries: Kenna has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface her talons could reasonably grip.

trait.name: Learned
entries: Kenna gains proficiency in one of the following skills: {@skill Arcana}, {@skill History}, {@skill Nature}, or {@skill Religion}.

trait.name: Skulker
entries: Kenna has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made in dim light or darkness.

action.name: Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) slashing damage.

spellcasting.name: Invisibility
headerEntries: The ketgrinn casts {@spell Invisibility|XPHB} on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ketgrinn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The ketgrinn can mimic any voice it has heard, or a voice it has stolen (see Consume Voice below). A creature that hears the voice can tell it's an imitation with a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) check. The DC increases to 19 for a voice the ketgrinn has stolen.

trait.name: Riddle Bound
entries: As an {@action Influence|XPHB} action, a creature that poses a riddle to the ketgrinn and succeeds on a {@dc 16} Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}) check gives the ketgrinn the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the start of the creature's next turn. Each riddle posed increases the DC for future riddles by 1 for 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ketgrinn makes two Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Consume Voice.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage, and if the target is a creature, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next saving throw the ketgrinn forces it to make before the end of the ketgrinn's next turn.

action.name: Consume Voice
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 14}, one creature within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Psychic damage, and the ketgrinn steals the target's voice. The target can't speak or make any verbal sound while its voice is stolen.

The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If it fails three of these saving throws, the loss is permanent, and its voice only returns when the ketgrinn dies. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Teleport
entries: The ketgrinn teleports up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Keyleth is a 20th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 22}, {@hit 14} to hit with spell attacks). She has the following druid spells prepared:

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: Keyleth has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1} against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put her to sleep.

trait.name: Focused
entries: Keyleth has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on Constitution {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1} made to maintain {@status concentration} on spells.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Keyleth wears a {@item circlet of wisdom|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn} (which increases her Wisdom score by 2), {@item +2 leather armor}, and a {@item +2 Ring of Protection|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|ring of protection with a +2 bonus}. She wields the {@item Spire of Conflux (Exalted)|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Spire of Conflux}.

action.name: Shapechange
entries: Keyleth casts {@spell shapechange} to transform into a {@creature planetar}, an {@creature adult bronze dragon}, or {@filter another creature of CR 20 or lower that is not a construct or undead|bestiary|Challenge Rating=[0;&20]|type=!construct;!undead|source=null}.

action.name: Meteor ({@creature Earth Elemental} Form Only)
entries: When Keyleth falls at least 20 feet, she lands with meteoric force. Each creature within 20 feet of her must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or take {@damage 1d6} bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet Keyleth fell. Keyleth still takes {@quickref falling|XGE|2|0|falling damage} while in {@creature earth elemental} form.

action.name: Chain Lightning
entries: Keyleth casts {@spell chain lightning} (spell save {@dc 22}) from the {@item Spire of Conflux (Exalted)|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Spire of Conflux} at a creature she can see within 150 feet of her.

bonus.name: Wild Shape
entries: Keyleth magically {@spell polymorph|phb|polymorphs} into a beast or elemental of CR 6 or lower. Her game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the new form, but she retains her alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. She also retains all of her skill and {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} proficiencies, in addition to gaining those of the new form. She assumes the new form's hit points and Hit Dice and returns to the number of hit points she had when she reverts to her normal form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by her new form (her choice). She reverts to her humanoid form as a bonus action, or when she falls {@condition unconscious}. Her attacks in Wild Shape form are magical, and she can cast spells while transformed.

bonus.name: Healing Word (4th Level)
entries: Keyleth casts {@spell healing word}, restoring 16 ({@dice 4d4 + 6}) hit points to herself or another creature she can see within 60 feet of her.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The kiir's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 14}). The kiir can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The kiir has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Planar Grounding
entries: The kiir can't be banished or otherwise unwillingly sent to another plane of existence.

trait.name: Undetectable Nature
entries: The kiir is always under the effects of the {@spell nondetection} spell. In addition, while it's under the effects of disguise self, its illusion isn't automatically detected by truesight, and the DC to discern the illusion increases to 24.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Teleport
entries: The kiir magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

action.name: Recall (1/Day)
entries: The kiir teleports to its home plane or city, as if by the plane shift or teleport spell.

trait.name: Hidden Home
entries: The kikimora can spend 1 minute scribing a magical symbol on a wall, baseboard, cupboard, or other semi‑permanent object within a structure. The symbol remains until the kikimora inscribes another symbol elsewhere. While within 5 feet of the surface where the symbol is inscribed, the kikimora can use an action to touch the symbol and be transported to an extradimensional space just large enough to hold the kikimora and up to 50 pounds of nonmagical objects. Only the kikimora can enter this space, along with any nonmagical objects it is wearing or carrying, up to the extradimensional space's limits. While inside the extradimensional space, the kikimora can see out as if through a 2-foot-by-2-foot window centered on the symbol and can exit the space as an action, appearing in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the surface where the symbol is inscribed.

If the kikimora is killed or if it creates a second symbol while objects remain within the extradimensional space, the objects are safely ejected to an unoccupied space nearest the surface where the first symbol was inscribed.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The kikimora has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kikimora makes three Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Domestic Magic
entries: The kikimora can cast the {@spell mending}, minor illusion, and {@spell prestidigitation} cantrips at will, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The kikimora magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the kikimora wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

action.name: House Pests (1/Day)
entries: The kikimora magically calls 1 swarm of bats, insects, or rats. The called creatures arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of the kikimora and obeying its spoken commands. The Beasts remain for 1 hour, until the kikimora dies, or until the kikimora dismisses them as a bonus action.

bonus.name: Homeward Step
entries: While within a structure containing its hidden home (see the Hidden Home trait), the kikimora magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space within 15 feet of the hidden home's symbol.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Grayfinger casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 22}):

3e: {@spell Flesh to Gold} (as Flesh to Stone)

trait.name: Cave Stride
entries: Once on each of his turns, Grayfinger can expend 10 feet of his movement to magically step into one stalagmite within his reach and emerge from a second stalagmite within 60 feet of the first, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second stalagmite. Both stalagmites must be Large or bigger. This movement does not provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Grayfinger has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Thelanian Protagonist
entries: Grayfinger cannot be permanently killed. If reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, his physical form dissipates, leaving behind one of his summoned ancient treasures in place of his body. Grayfinger reforms in his lair {@dice 1d4} days later and starts plotting how to retrieve what he lost from his collection.

trait.name: This Power Belongs to Me (3/Day)
entries: If Grayfinger fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead. If the saving throw was caused by a magical effect, Grayfinger can choose to store that power inside one of his magical rings until the following dawn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Grayfinger makes two Claw attacks and one attack with each ancient weapon he has summoned (see Treasure from the Vault).

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 13}, reach 10 ft. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d12 + 6}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Daashor's Perfect Edge (If Summoned)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 10 ft. {@h}20 ({@damage 2d12 + 7}) Slashing damage, and the target takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) damage at the start of each of its turns until a creature uses an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} to stop the bleeding with a {@dc 21} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) check.

action.name: Vvaraak's Dragonscale Spear (If Summoned)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 15 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 1d10 + 7}) Piercing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Acid damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Intelligence saving throw or be unable to expend a spell slot of level 7 or higher until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Culsir's Mighty Wand (If Summoned)
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 14}, range 120 ft. {@h}28 ({@damage 6d6 + 7}) Force damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Vault of Stone {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave dex} DC22, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from Grayfinger. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Bludgeoning damage and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. A {@condition Restrained|XPHB} creature can end the effect by using an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} and succeeding on a {@dc 21} Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) check.

bonus.name: Treasure from the Vault
entries: Grayfinger expends the magical power stored in one of his rings (see This Power Belongs to Me) to summon from his vault one ancient weapon of his choice: Daashor's Perfect Edge, Vvaraak's Dragonscale Spear, or Culsir's Mighty Wand.

The summoned weapon floats within Grayfingers reach; he can wield all summoned weapons simultaneously and keep his hands free to make Claw attacks. Summoned weapons disappear after 1 minute, or when Grayfinger is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

reaction.name: Hungry Hands
entries: {@actTrigger} Grayfinger takes damage from a melee attack with a weapon that isn't natural or attached. Greyfinger must have a hand free. {@actResponse} Grayfinger makes a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand|XPHB}) check against the attacker's {@variantrule Passive Perception|XPHB}. {@actSaveSuccess} Grayfinger steals the weapon he was attacked with.

legendary.name: Rapid Attacks
entries: Grayfinger makes an attack with a summoned weapon.

legendary.name: Raise Stalagmite
entries: Grayfinger creates a 10-foot- tall, 5-foot-diameter stalagmite in a space he can see within 60 feet. Creatures within 10 feet of the stalagmite when it is created must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Bludgeoning damage.

legendary.name: Moving Mountains (2 Legendary Actions)
entries: Grayfinger recharges and immediately uses his Vault of Stone ability.

name: Kingfissure Worm

trait.name: Multiple Tongues
entries: The worm has three tongues, each of which can be targeted with attacks (AC 20, immunity to psychic damage) while that tongue is grappling a creature. When a tongue takes 35 damage or more in a single turn, that tongue is destroyed, releasing any target it was grappling. The worm can't use a destroyed tongue with their Multiattack or Tongue Grab action until they finish a long rest. Damaging or destroying a tongue deals no damage to the worm.

trait.name: Slowed, Not Stopped (3/Day)
entries: When the worm fails a saving throw, they can choose to succeed instead. When they do, their speed and the reach of their Tongue Grab attack are each reduced by a cumulative 10 feet until they finish a long rest. The worm's speed and reach can't be reduced below 5 feet in this way.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half their burrowing speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in their wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The worm can make a number of Tongue Grab attacks equal to the number of tongues they currently have (see Multiple Tongues). The worm can replace any number of those attacks with a use of Swallow.

action.name: Tongue Grab
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage, and the creature is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}). Until this grapple ends, the worm can't use this tongue against another target.

action.name: Maw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d8 + 9}) piercing damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, they must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed (as if by the worm's Swallow action).

action.name: Swallow
entries: The worm pulls a Huge or smaller {@condition grappled} creature into their maw and swallows them. A swallowed creature is no longer {@condition grappled}, but they are {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, have total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns.

If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside them, the worm must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution check at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of whom fall {@condition prone} in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the worm. If the worm dies, a swallowed creature can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Tongue Sweep
entries: The worm violently swings a creature they have {@condition grappled}. The {@condition grappled} creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage, and each enemy within 10 feet of the {@condition grappled} creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Tongue Recall
entries: When one of the worm's tongues takes damage that doesn't immediately destroy it, the worm can release any target that tongue is grappling and recall the tongue back inside the worm's body. That tongue can't be targeted until the worm uses it to grapple a creature again.

legendaryHeader: The worm has three villain actions. They can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. They can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Open the Earth
entries: The worm writhes, sending tremors through the ground and opening a 20-foot-wide, 100-foot-long, 40-foot-deep fissure in the ground, originating from the worm. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature falls into the fissure, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage from the fall and landing {@condition prone}. On a successful save, a creature flees to the closest unoccupied space outside the fissure's area.

legendary.name: Action 2: Earth Breach
entries: The worm burrows up to half their speed and then bursts through the surface, breaching the ground in a 10-foot-radius circle. Huge and smaller creatures within that area must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed (as if by the worm's Swallow action).

legendary.name: Action 3: Better Out Than In
entries: The worm projectile vomits the contents of their stomach in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, creatures who were swallowed by the worm are regurgitated, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage and landing {@condition prone} in an unoccupied space of the worm's choice within that area.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Tongue Lash)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} acid damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Distracting Attack (2 Ferocity)
entries: The worm makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals its normal effects, and the next attack roll made against the target before the start of the worm's next turn has advantage.

action.name: 3rd Level: Tongue Grab (5 Ferocity)
entries: The worm makes a signature attack. On a hit, the target is also {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and the worm can't make a signature attack against another target.

action.name: 5th Level: Swallow (8 Ferocity)
entries: The worm attempts to swallow a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage PBd6} bludgeoning damage and is swallowed. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't swallowed. The worm can have only one target swallowed at a time.

A swallowed target is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, they have total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and they take {@damage PBd6} acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns. Whenever the worm takes damage, they must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or regurgitate the swallowed creature, who falls {@condition prone} in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the worm. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 or half the triggering damage, whichever is higher. If the worm is {@condition incapacitated} or dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by the worm and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Item Storage
entries: The worm can swallow an object without harming it by storing the object in a second stomach. They can use this bonus action again to regurgitate a specific stored object without disturbing any other objects in their second stomach. A regurgitated object lands in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the worm.
The worm's second stomach can hold up to PB × 10 pounds of objects, not exceeding a volume of 10 cubic feet.

name: Kingkiller Hydra

hp.special: 92 (8d12 + 40) plus 92 (8d12 + 40) per player character

languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Corrosive Aura
entries: The area within 30 feet of the hydra is filled with corrosive fumes and is {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB}. A creature that starts its turn in the fumes takes 20 ({@damage 8d4}) Acid damage.

trait.name: Head Count
entries: The hydra can't make more Bite or Spit Acid attacks each round than it has heads, and each head can only be used to make one Bite or Spit Acid attack each round.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The hydra has five heads. Whenever the hydra takes 25 damage or more in a single turn, one of its heads dies. The hydra dies if all of its heads are dead.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} that can be used only for {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

trait.name: Special Immunities
entries: The hydra is immune to the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} (Acid only) condition.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: While the hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

action.name: The hydra always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the hydra can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the hydra takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 20 ft. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d8 + 8}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Spit Acid
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 14}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}20 ({@damage 8d4}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 8d4} Acid). While {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Grow Heads
entries: The hydra can only perform this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} if one or more of its heads died this round, unless the head was killed by Fire damage. The hydra grows two heads, and regains 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

action.name: Hydra Fury (1/Round)
entries: The hydra makes one Bite attack or one Spit Acid attack for each head that hasn't yet made an attack this round.

action.name: Trample (1/Round)
entries: The hydra moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action. During this movement, it can move through the spaces of Huge or smaller creatures. Each creature the hydra moves over is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 22}. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Tail (1/Round)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 15 ft. {@h}34 ({@damage 4d12 + 8}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed up to 20 feet away from the hydra.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The hydra chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The hydra can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

name: Kiona the Dread Lord

trait.name: Corrupting Phasing
entries: Kiona can move through other creatures and objects. Kiona takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if she ends her turn inside an object. A creature takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage the first time Kiona passes through them on a turn.

trait.name: Incorporeal Empowerment
entries: Each incorporeal Undead within 120 feet of Kiona ignores difficult terrain.

trait.name: Spiritual Sacrifice (3/Day)
entries: When Kiona fails a saving throw, she can lose 15 hit points and choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Kiona makes two Energy Siphon attacks.

action.name: Energy Siphon
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one creature. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of Kiona's next turn. Kiona gains temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt by this attack.

action.name: Rise from Death (1/Day)
entries: Kiona conjures three shadows, two specters, or one wraith under her control. Each summoned creature appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of Kiona and acts immediately after her turn on the same initiative count.

bonus.name: Path of Pain
entries: Kiona chooses one other incorporeal Undead within 120 feet of her who can see her. That Undead can move up to their speed.

reaction.name: Death's Breath
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of Kiona hits her with an attack, she breathes a toxin at the creature. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of their next turn.

legendaryHeader: Kiona has three villain actions. She can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. She can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Restrain Them!
entries: A 20-foot-radius sphere of spectral arms emerges from a point Kiona can see within 120 feet of her. Each enemy in that area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} until the end of Kiona's next turn.

legendary.name: Action 2: Ruinous March
entries: Kiona and each ally within 60 feet of her can move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Action 3: Vitality Drain
entries: Kiona and each ally within 60 feet of her can make a melee attack (no action required). A creature hit by one of these attacks gains a level of {@condition exhaustion}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The kishi casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Fiendish Weapons
entries: The kishi's weapon attacks are magical. When the kishi hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 2d8} cold damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Two Heads
entries: The kishi has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks and on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition stunned}, and knocked {@condition unconscious}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The kishi has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kishi makes one Bite attack and two Spear attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage.

bonus.name: Trophy Shield
entries: The kishi absorbs some of the essence of a creature it killed since the end of its previous turn and magically creates a grisly trophy of the creature on its shield or spear. For 1 hour, its Armor Class becomes 20, and creatures of the same type as the slain creature have disadvantage on attack rolls against the kishi.

trait.name: Charm Resistant
entries: Kishina has advantage on saving throws she makes to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} condition on herself.

trait.name: Light Landing
entries: Kishina takes no damage from falling.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: Kishina's long jump is up to 45 feet and her high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Kishina makes four Unarmed Strike attacks or three Throwing Knife attacks.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage, or 20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage on a critical hit.

action.name: Throwing Knife
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d4 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Painful Sprint {@recharge}
entries: Kishina moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks, hitting a pressure point on each enemy she can see who she passes within 5 feet of during this move. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throwing or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of their next turn. A creature who fails this save by 5 or more also falls {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Throw
entries: Kishina attempts to throw a Large or smaller enemy she can see within 5 feet of her. The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or be moved up to 15 feet away from her and be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Shield (3/Day; 1st-Level Spell)
entries: When Kishina is targeted by an attack or a {@spell magic missile} spell, she conjures an {@condition invisible} barrier of force. Until the start of her next turn, she gains a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and takes no damage from magic missile.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Klar can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: Klar can mimic animal sounds. A creature who hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: Klar's long jump is up to 40 feet and their high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Klar makes one Bite attack and one Mantis Claws attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Mantis Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 f., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, the target is {@condition restrained}. Moving while grappling a Medium or smaller target doesn't halve Klar's speed. Klar can have only one target {@condition grappled} in this way at a time.

bonus.name: Bellowing Roar (1/Day)
entries: Klar lets loose a terrifying roar.

Each creature within 30 feet of Klar who can hear them must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of Klar for 1 minute. If a creature {@condition frightened} in this way takes damage, they can repeat this saving throw, ending the effect on themself on a success.

bonus.name: Kangaroo Leap
entries: Klar jumps up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The knifewing doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Glider
entries: The knifewing can't ascend while flying and its altitude decreases by 5 feet for every 30 feet it flies. If flying, the knifewing falls if it doesn't fly at least 30 feet during its turn.

action.name: Knifewing (Flying Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks not made with cold iron weapons

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the knight has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Unseelie Blessing
entries: The knight has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put them to sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The knight makes two Longsword attacks and one Shield Bash attack.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the beginning of the knight's next turn.

bonus.name: Shadow Commander
entries: The knight casts {@spell darkness}, requiring no material components. The knight must concentrate on this spell as normal.

reaction.name: Shield Master
entries: When the knight is attacked by a creature they can see within 5 feet, they gain a +5 bonus to their AC. If the attack misses, the knight may immediately make a Shield Bash attack against the target.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Theodore Marshal is a 20th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks). He has the following paladin spells prepared:

trait.name: Divine Strikes
entries: Theodore Marshal's weapon attacks are magical. When he hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 4d8} radiant damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Theodore Marshal fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Theodore Marshal wields a {@item holy avenger longsword}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Theodore Marshal makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Holy Avenger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 1d8 + 8}) slashing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: Theodore Marshal makes one weapon attack.

legendary.name: Holy Bolt (Costs 2 actions)
entries: Theodore Marshal casts {@spell guiding bolt} without expending a spell slot.

hp.special: 94 (11d8 + 44) plus 94 (12d8 + 44) per player character

trait.name: Aura of Righteousness
entries: Theodore projects a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of radiant power. Allies in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws. A {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature that starts its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Radiant damage.

action.name: Theodore always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On his turn, Theodore can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Theodore takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Holy Avenger Longsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 13}, reach 5 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d12 + 5}) Slashing damage, and the target suffers one of the following effects of Theodore's choice.

items.name: Divine Smite
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Radiant damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Searing Smite
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d6} Fire). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Thunderous Smite
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away from Theodore and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Shield
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 13}, reach 5 ft or range 30/90 ft. {@h}19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of its next turn. {@hom}After being thrown, the shield returns to Theodore's hand.

action.name: Charge (1/Round)
entries: Theodore moves up to his {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} toward a {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature he can see. He gains {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the next weapon attack he makes this round.

action.name: Call the Sacred Flame {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point within 60 feet of Theodore. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Radiant damage plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition (save ends).

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: Theodore chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. Theodore can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

trait.name: Shield? Shield!
entries: The adeptus gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't {@condition incapacitated} or {@condition prone}. To benefit from this trait, the adeptus must be wielding a shield.

action.name: Firecracker
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 4} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 2d4}) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition deafened} until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Shocking Grasp (Cantrip)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d8}) lightning damage, and the target can't take reactions until the start of their next turn. The adeptus has advantage on this attack roll if the target is wearing metal armor.

action.name: Lesser Magic Missile (1/Day; 1st-Level Spell)
entries: The adeptus creates three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of their choice who they can see within 120 feet of them. A dart deals 2 ({@damage 1d2 + 1}) force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously, and the adeptus can direct them to hit one creature or several. This action is considered to be the {@spell magic missile} spell for the purpose of other spells and effects.

trait.name: Apothecary
entries: At the start of each of the kobold alchemist's turns, the alchemist chooses one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. The alchemist has resistance to that damage type until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The kobold has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kobold makes two Alchemical Dagger or Alchemical Bolt attacks.

action.name: Alchemical Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 {@damage 1d4 + 3} piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage of the type determined by Apothecary.

action.name: Alchemical Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) damage of the type determined by Apothecary.

action.name: Alchemical Vapors {@recharge}
entries: The kobold alchemist releases alchemical vapors pleasing to draconic senses and unpleasant to all others. Each creature that isn't a dragonborn or kobold within 15 feet of the alchemist must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking 17 ({@damage 5d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Each dragonborn and kobold within 15 feet of the alchemist has resistance to damage of the type determined by Apothecary for 1 minute.

action.name: Explosive Flask {@recharge 5}
entries: The kobold alchemist throws a flask of volatile substances at a point it can see within 30 feet of it. The flask explodes, and each creature within 15 feet of that point must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 14 {@damage 4d6} damage of the type determined by Apothecary and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. A {@condition poisoned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Shield? Shield!
entries: The artifex gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't {@condition incapacitated} or {@condition prone}. To benefit from this trait, the artifex must be wielding a shield.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The artifex makes one Chain Hook attack and uses Activate Trap, if available.

action.name: Chain Hook
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 15/30 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, they must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet toward the artifex.

action.name: Activate Trap (3/Day)
entries: The artifex activates one of the following hidden traps; the artifex can't use the same trap two rounds in a row:

action.name: Spiky Pit Trap
entries: The artifex chooses a point on the ground that they can see within 60 feet of them, opening a concealed 15-foot-square trapdoor on the ground centered on that point to reveal a 10-foot-deep pit trap lined with spikes. Creatures on the ground in the trapdoor's area must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature falls into the pit and takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage from the spikes and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage from the fall. On a successful save, a creature moves to the nearest unoccupied space outside that area.

action.name: Swarm of Bees Trap
entries: The artifex chooses a point on the ground that they can see within 60 feet of them, causing a buried canister to erupt and release a 15-foot-radius, 10-foot-high cylinder of swarming bees. When a creature enters the swarm's area for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, they must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. At the start of each of the artifex's turns, the swarm moves 10 feet away from the artifex in a straight line. The swarm disperses after 1 minute or when the artifex dies.

action.name: Wall of Fire Trap
entries: The artifex chooses a point on the ground that they can see within 60 feet of them, igniting a concealed trench of oil and creating a 20-foot long, 15-foot high, and 1-foot-thick wall of fire. When the wall appears, each creature within its area must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature who enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends their turn there takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage. The wall is opaque and lasts for 1 minute.

trait.name: Shield? Shield!
entries: The centurion gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't {@condition incapacitated} or {@condition prone}. To benefit from this trait, the centurion must be wielding a shield.

action.name: Pilum
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Firetail Pilum (2/Day)
entries: The centurion ignites a pilum then uses it to make a ranged Pilum attack against a target within 60 feet of them. Hit or miss, the target and each creature in a 5-foot-wide line between the target and the centurion must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 2d4}) fire damage. The line smolders for 1 minute, creating a 5-foot-wide, 20-foot-tall wall of opaque smoke. A creature within reach of the pilum can use an action to extinguish it, causing the smoke to dissipate.

action.name: Boom Pilum!!! (1/Day)
entries: The centurion straps a vial of unstable ores to a pilum then uses it to make a ranged Pilum attack against a target within 60 feet of them. Hit or miss, the ores explode after the attack. The target and each creature within 10 feet of them must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) thunder damage, is knocked {@condition prone}, and is {@condition deafened} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature takes only half as much damage and isn't knocked {@condition prone} or {@condition deafened}.

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the chieftain hits with it (included in the attack).

trait.name: Chieftain's Presence
entries: Dragons and kobolds within 30 feet of the chieftain can't be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The kobold chieftain has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the chieftain's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the kobold chieftain has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kobold makes three Spear or Shortbow attacks.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage, or 13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. A {@condition poisoned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Inspiring Shriek (Recharge after Short or Long Rest)
entries: The kobold chieftain shrieks a draconic battle cry. Each creature that isn't a dragonborn or kobold within 30 feet of the chieftain must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A {@condition frightened} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Each dragonborn and kobold within 30 feet of the chieftain is inspired for 1 minute. Whenever an inspired creature makes an attack roll or saving throw, the creature can roll a {@dice d4} and add the number rolled to the attack roll or saving throw.

reaction.name: Springspike Shield
entries: When the kobold chieftain is wielding its shield and is hit by a melee attack within 5 feet of it, the chieftain can fire one of its shield spikes at the attacker. The attacker takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage.

hp.special: Eight times their level (number of d10 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Gladius)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d8 plus PB} piercing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the decanus can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Reinforce (3/Day)
entries: When the decanus sees an ally within 30 feet of them being targeted by an attack, the decanus can use a reaction to move up to their speed toward the target. If the decanus ends their movement within 5 feet of the target, the target gains a +PB bonus to their AC until the beginning of the decanus's next turn, including against the triggering attack.

action.name: 5th Level: Shield Bash (3/Day)
entries: The decanus attempts to topple a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. Succeed or fail, the decanus then makes two signature attacks against any creature within reach.

action.name: 7th Level: One-Kobold Army (1/Day)
entries: The decanus moves up to their speed, then makes a number of signature attacks equal to the number of enemies within 5 feet of them (minimum of three attacks). Each enemy within range must be attacked at least once. On a hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the decanus for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

trait.name: Shield? Shield!
entries: The legionary gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't {@condition incapacitated} or {@condition prone}. To benefit from this trait, the legionary must be wielding a shield.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The legionary makes two Gladius attacks. They can replace one attack with a Shield Bash attack.

action.name: Gladius
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Reinforce
entries: When an ally within 10 feet of the legionary is targeted by an attack, the legionary can move to the nearest unoccupied space within 5 feet of that creature. If that creature also has the Shield? Shield! trait, they gain the benefit of that trait against the triggering attack. To use this reaction, the legionary must be able to see the ally and the attacker.

trait.name: Constructed Weakness
entries: The kobold mech has the following flaw:

items.name: Rustable
items.entry: If the kobold mech takes 10 or more acid damage in a single turn, it becomes restrained until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The kobold mech has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Piloted
entries: The kobold mech is piloted by a kobold. The kobold dies if the kobold mech is reduced to 0 hit points.

trait.name: Self-Destruct
entries: When the kobold mech is reduced to 0 hit points, its cache of dynamite immediately explodes. Each creature within 20 feet of the kobold must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) thunder damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Multiattacks
entries: The kobold mech makes two attacks with its Cavitation Drill. It can replace one of these attacks with a Javelin Missile.

action.name: Cavitation Drill
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) thunder damage.

action.name: Javelin Missile (6/Day)
entries: The kobold mech fires a dynamite-strapped javelin at a point it can see within 120 feet of it. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) thunder damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

trait.name: Shield? Shield!
entries: The signifer gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't {@condition incapacitated} or {@condition prone}. To benefit from this trait, the signifer must be wielding a shield.

trait.name: Standard Bearer
entries: Each kobold unit can have one or more signifers, whose weapon is their unit's battle standard. If a signifer drops their signum, they use the kobold tiro stat block instead. If an allied kobold tiro uses an action to pick up a signum not carried by another creature, that tiro uses the kobold signifer stat block instead. When a signifer or tiro's stat block changes in this way, any conditions or effects currently affecting them remain active, and their hit points and hit point maximum remain the same.
A signum that isn't being held by a creature can be damaged; it has AC 15, 5 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The signifer makes two Signum attacks.

action.name: Signum
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Shield Wall Formation
entries: The signifer chooses up to four kobolds within 60 feet of them who can hear them. Each kobold can use their reaction to move up to their speed, and each kobold who does so must end this movement within 5 feet of an ally.

bonus.name: Glory to the Legion (1/Day)
entries: The signifer and each ally within 30 feet of them who can hear them regains 5 ({@damage 2d4}) hit points.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the tiro takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the tiro takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Shield? Shield!
entries: The tiro gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't {@condition incapacitated} or {@condition prone}. To benefit from this trait, the tiro must be wielding a shield.

trait.name: Testudo
entries: When the tiro finishes a long rest, they choose a non-minion creature to be their commander. While a tiro who isn't {@condition incapacitated} or {@condition prone} is within 5 feet of their commander, the commander gains a cumulative +1 bonus to AC (maximum bonus of +5).

action.name: Pugio (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage.

trait.name: Improvised Tools
entries: The kobold trapsmith can use any Tiny objects at hand to pick locks and disarm traps, as if any such object was part of a set of thieves' tools. It is proficient in using Tiny objects in this way. In addition, the trapsmith has advantage on ability checks to pick locks and disarm traps.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The kobold trapsmith has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the trapsmith's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the kobold trapsmith has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The trapsmith uses Makeshift Trap then makes one Dagger or Spare Part attack.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Spare Part
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage or slashing damage (the trapsmith's choice).

action.name: Makeshift Trap
entries: The kobold trapsmith cobbles together a quick trap with materials at hand and throws it at a point on the ground it can see within 30 feet of it. The trapsmith chooses one of the following traps. Each creature in the trap's area must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or suffer the trap's effects.

items.name: Bursting Much-Heavy Net
items.entry: Each creature that fails the saving throw within 10 feet of where the trap lands takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage and is {@condition restrained} for 1 minute. A creature can take an action to free the {@condition restrained} creature by succeeding on a {@dc 13} Strength check.

items.name: Spikes-on-Spikes
items.entry: Each creature within 10 feet of where the trap lands takes 10 ({@damage 4d4}) piercing damage and the area within 10 feet of the point is difficult terrain for 1 minute.

items.name: Spring-Loaded Whirly Blades
items.entry: Each creature that fails the saving throw within 10 feet of where the trap lands takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) slashing damage and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Static-Generating Thingamabob
items.entry: Each creature that fails the saving throw within 5 feet of where the trap lands takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage and is {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Shield? Shield!
entries: The veles gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't {@condition incapacitated} or {@condition prone}. To benefit from this trait, the veles must be wielding a shield.

action.name: Pilum
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage. If the attack hits a creature wielding a shield, the veles can embed the pilum in the shield, giving the target disadvantage on attack rolls until the target either stops wielding the shield or uses an action to remove the pilum from it. The veles carries six pila.

bonus.name: Pivot
entries: The veles moves up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Not What I Seem
entries: The venator begins combat disguised as an inexperienced warrior. They have advantage on their first weapon attack roll against a creature who hasn't seen them make an attack.

trait.name: Shield? Shield!
entries: The venator gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't {@condition incapacitated} or {@condition prone}. To benefit from this trait, the venator must be wielding a shield.

action.name: Dolabra
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Net
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 5/15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. {@h}The target is {@condition restrained} until they are freed. A creature can use their action to make a {@dc 10} Strength check, freeing themself or another creature within their reach on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) also frees the creature without harming them and destroys the net. The venator carries one net.

bonus.name: Lost in the Crowd
entries: The venator takes the Hide action. They have advantage on their Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check if they are within 5 feet of two or more allied kobolds.

bonus.name: Then We Light the Net on Fire!
entries: The venator chooses a creature within 5 feet of them who is {@condition restrained} by a net and lights that net on fire. While {@condition restrained} by the net, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage at the start of each of their turns. Each time the net deals damage, roll any die. On an odd result, the net burns away and is destroyed, freeing the {@condition restrained} creature. A creature who attempts to free the {@condition restrained} creature from the net (as described in the venator's Net attack) automatically puts out the fire as part of that action, regardless of whether that check succeeds.

name: Koboldzilla

trait.name: Apotheosis (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the koboldzilla would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 310 hit points, it recharges its Dragon Breath, its Dexterity increases to 27 (+8), and its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma increase to 18 (+4). Additionally, all kobold pilots are incinerated in the process, it can't use its Koboldapult legendary action until it finishes a short or long rest, and the koboldzilla can use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 33,000 XP (66,000 XP total) for defeating the koboldzilla after its Apotheosis activates.

trait.name: Constructed Weakness
entries: The koboldzilla has the following flaws:

items.name: Arcanothermic Engine
items.entry: If the koboldzilla takes 20 or more cold damage in a single turn, it can't recharge its Dragon Breath action until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Rustable
items.entry: If the koboldzilla takes 20 or more acid damage in a single turn, it becomes restrained until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The koboldzilla is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the koboldzilla fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Loose Plating
entries: When the koboldzilla is reduce to 165 hit points or fewer for the first time since it last finished a long rest, it loses some of its armour plating. Its AC is reduced to 19, its walking speed is doubled, and its Dexterity increases to 20 (+5). These effects last until it finishes a long rest.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The koboldzilla deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The koboldzilla makes two attacks: one with its Gazebo Smash and one with its Tail.

action.name: Gazebo Smash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., each target within a 5-foot-radius circle. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Dragon Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The koboldzilla exhales fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 ({@damage 12d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendaryHeader: The koboldzilla can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The koboldzilla regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: The koboldzilla makes one Tail attack.

legendary.name: Koboldapult (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The koboldzilla fires a cluster of kobolds at a point within 120 feet of the koboldzilla. Each creature within 20 feet of that point must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success. Additionally, 3 ({@dice 1d4 + 1}) kobolds survive this ordeal, and land prone in unoccupied spaces within the area. These kobolds act on initiative count 1.

mythicHeader: If the koboldzilla's Apotheosis trait has activated in the last hour, it can use the options below as legendary actions.

mythic.name: Takeoff
entries: The koboldzilla upregulates its arcanothermic engine. Each creature within 15 feet of the koboldzilla must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) fire damage and be knocked prone. The koboldzilla can then fly up to 60 feet and begin to hover.

At the end of the next turn, the koboldzilla lands. Each creature in the space where the koboldzilla lands must make a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone and restrained until the koboldzilla moves out of the creature's space. Alternatively, the creature can use an action to make a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics|PHB}) check, exiting prone in the nearest unoccupied space on a success. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage, is not knocked prone, and moves to the nearest unoccupied space.

mythic.name: Arcanothermic Overcharge (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The koboldzilla recharges and uses its Dragon Breath.

trait.name: Breaker of Boats
entries: The kongamato deals double damage to objects and structures made of wood or lighter materials.

trait.name: Carry Off
entries: The kongamato can fly at half its flying speed when dragging two creatures it has {@condition grappled} or at its full flying speed if dragging only one creature it has {@condition grappled}.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The kongamato doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kongamato makes one Beak attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. The kongamato has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Terrifying Screech {@recharge 5}
entries: The kongamato releases a screech in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) thunder damage and is {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition frightened}.

name: Koptourok
languages: understands the languages they knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Breathless Aura
entries: Enemies within 30 feet of the koptourok can't speak, and if they are a creature who needs to breathe, they also have disadvantage on Constitution saving throws.

trait.name: Wings of Breath
entries: The koptourok gains a flying speed equal to their walking speed if they have at least one enemy within 30 feet of them. If the koptourok starts their turn in the air and doesn't have a flying speed, they fall.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The koptourok makes two Choking Grasp attacks.

action.name: Choking Grasp
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 30 ft., one creature. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is pulled to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the koptourok and {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, the target is {@condition restrained} and the koptourok's speed isn't halved by the grapple.

action.name: Last Gasp
entries: The koptourok attempts to steal the breath from each creature they are grappling. Each target must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The koptourok gains temporary hit points equal to 5 times the number of creatures who failed their save.

reaction.name: Thunderous Deflation
entries: When the koptourok drops to 30 hit points or fewer, they unleash a shrieking wail. Each creature within 30 feet of the koptourok must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) thunder damage and is {@condition deafened} until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition deafened}. The koptourok then releases all creatures they are grappling and flies up to their speed.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness does not impair the koralk's darkvision.

trait.name: Harvester Venom
entries: The koralk produces a potent poison that liquefies the innards of those affected by it. Every hour that elapses after a creature succumbs to this poison, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage, and its hp maximum is reduced by that amount. Creatures with resistance or immunity to poison or the {@condition poisoned} condition can be affected by this poison. Such creatures have advantage on the saving throw. This potent poison remains within the creature's body until removed by the {@spell greater restoration} spell or similar magic. If a creature dies while suffering from this poison, it rises as a lemure 1 hour later under the control of the nearest non-lemure devil within 1 mile.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The koralk has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Steadfast
entries: The koralk can't be {@condition frightened} while it can see an ally within 30 feet of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The koralk makes one Bite attack, one Scythe attack, and three Stinger attacks. It can replace its Scythe attack with a Vestigial Arms attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Scythe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d4 + 5}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or succumb to the devil's venom (see the Harvester Venom trait).

action.name: Vestigial Arms
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the creature is {@condition restrained}, and the devil can't use its Vestigial Arms on another target.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kot bayun can use its Slumbering Song. It then makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The kot bayun magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or uses Slumbering Song, or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the kot bayun wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

action.name: Slumbering Song
entries: The kot bayun sings a magical song to one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw on fall {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the kot bayun uses a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue singing, the target has disadvantage on this saving throw. Otherwise, the effect ends for a target if the target takes damage while below half its hp maximum.

If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the kot bayun's Slumbering Song for the next 24 hours. The kot bayun can have up to two creatures {@condition unconscious} from its song at a time.

action.name: Healing Purr (2/Day)
entries: The kot bayun purrs at a creature it can see within 15 feet of it. The target magically regains 10 ({@dice 3d6}) hp and is freed from any disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The goat-knight is a 6th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following paladin spells prepared:

trait.name: Aura of Protection
entries: Whenever the goat-knight or a creature friendly to it within 10 feet of it makes a {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}, that creature gains a +2 bonus (included in the goat-knight's {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1} above). The goat-knight must be conscious to grant and gain this bonus.

trait.name: Divine Health
entries: The goat-knight is immune to disease.

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: The goat-knight has resistance to poison damage and {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1} against poison.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The goat-knight makes two warhammer attacks.

action.name: Warhammer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The krake spawn can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The krake spawn makes one Bite attack and eight Tentacle attacks, or it makes four Freezing Water Bolt attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft, one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 1d10 + 7}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d6 + 7}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}. The krake spawn has eight tentacles, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Freezing Water Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Ink Cloud {@recharge 5}
entries: While underwater, the krake spawn emits a 20-foot-radius cloud of ink all around itself. Each creature in the cloud must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 55 ({@damage 10d10}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink.

action.name: Vomit Forth the Deeps {@recharge 5}
entries: The krake spawn sprays half‑digested food from its maw in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) acid damage plus 27 ({@damage 5d10}) poison damage and is {@condition incapacitated}. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

bonus.name: Water Jet
entries: Each creature within 5 feet of the krake spawn must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. The spawn then swims up to half its swimming speed without provoking opportunity attacks. The spawn must be underwater to use this bonus action.

name: Kraken
languages: understands all languages but can't speak

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The Kraken can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Discorporation
entries: When the Kraken drops to 0 hit points or dies, all conditions and other effects end for them. They teleport back to the place where they slumber, return to life with all their hit points, and fall {@condition unconscious}.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The Kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Slowed Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Kraken fails a saving throw, they can choose to succeed instead, and their speed is reduced by a cumulative 10 feet for 24 hours.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: The Kraken has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Kraken makes four Tentacle attacks or uses Mental Lance three times.
