action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) bludgeoning damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}). The Kraken has ten tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Mental Lance (3rd-Order Power)
entries: {@atk rp} {@hit 18} to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage, and the target is {@condition frightened} of the Kraken until the start of the Kraken's next turn.

action.name: Psionic Storm
entries: The Kraken creates a psionic storm, entrapping a vehicle they can see within 120 feet of them. While entrapped in the storm, the vehicle is {@condition restrained}. The storm ends if the Kraken's {@status concentration} is broken (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell) or if they are more than 120 feet from the vehicle. If the Kraken's turn ends three times before the storm ends, the vehicle is reduced to 0 hit points and this effect ends.

action.name: Skull-Splitting Howl (1/Day)
entries: The Kraken telepathically howls in the mind of each enemy within 120 feet of them. Each target must make a {@dc 26} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) psychic damage and can't concentrate on powers or spells until the start of the Kraken's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

bonus.name: Telekinetic Fling
entries: The Kraken throws a creature they are grappling into an unoccupied space the Kraken can see within 60 feet of them. The target lands {@condition prone} and takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Psychic Reprisal
entries: When the Kraken is damaged by an attack, each enemy within 30 feet of the attacker (including the attacker) must make a {@dc 26} Wisdom saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendaryHeader: The Kraken has three villain actions. They can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. The Kraken can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Psionic Tentacles
entries: Psionically conjured tentacles make a Tentacle attack on each enemy within 120 feet of the Kraken. The Kraken then uses Telekinetic Fling on each creature they are grappling.

legendary.name: Action 2: Psionic Ink
entries: The Kraken teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space they can see. Each creature within 30 feet of the space the Kraken left must make a {@dc 26} Dexterity saving throw or be covered in psionic ink, which they can use an action to wipe away. A creature covered in psionic ink takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) psychic damage at the start of each of their turns.

legendary.name: Action 3: The Ocean's Wrath
entries: The Kraken unleashes a wave of intense psionic power. Each creature within 120 feet of the Kraken must make a {@dc 26} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 65 ({@damage 10d12}) psychic damage and is {@condition frightened} of the Kraken for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Resilience
entries: Krall has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned}.

trait.name: Skulker
entries: Krall has advantage on {@skill Stealth} checks made in dim light or total darkness.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Krall makes three melee attacks, two with his rapier and one with his parrying dagger.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Parrying Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Krall adds 2 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. Krall must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

trait.name: Death in Shadow
entries: When the fang dies, its body dissolves into shadows and disappears, leaving nothing behind.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The fang has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Shadow Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the fang's {@sense darkvision}.

trait.name: Shadow Stalk
entries: The fang can hover 5 feet above land or water as part of its movement, requiring no action. While hovering, it is unaffected by difficult terrain and makes no sound as it moves.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Shadow Manipulation {@recharge 5}
entries: The fang conjures chilling shadows near itself. Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from the fang must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The area inside the cube is heavily obscured by magical darkness until the start of the fang's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kronen makes two Claw attacks and uses Loathsome Presence.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Loathsome Presence
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, each creature that can see the kronen. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute (save ends). If the creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, it is immune to the kronen's Loathsome Presence for 24 hours.

bonus.name: Scuttle
entries: The kronen takes the {@action Dash|XPHB} action.

reaction.name: Infestation
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature ends its turn within 5 feet of the kronen. {@actResponse d}{@actSave dex} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target is covered in cockroaches. It takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Piercing damage at the end of each of its turns until a creature takes an action to swipe the cockroaches off its body.

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: The heat Krusgr exudes from his body is so intense it provides him with {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold damage. In addition, any creature within 5 feet of him that strikes his heated body with a melee attack takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Krusgr makes two attacks, using Flame Sword or Hammer Throw in any combination.

action.name: Flame Sword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 10 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 8}) Slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Fire damage.

action.name: Hammer Throw
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 12}, range 60/240 ft. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d10 + 8}) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Fire damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet straight away from Krusgr and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Angrboda's Tears {@recharge 5}.
entries: Krusgr can expel a stream of boiling iron from his eyes. {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Fire damage, and the creature suffers 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level from the hot metal. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage and negates any further effect.

trait.name: Avoidance
entries: If the lacuna is subjected to an effect that allows them to make a saving throw to take only half damage, they instead take no damage if they succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if they fail.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the lacuna remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from a normal statue.

trait.name: Fiend Between
entries: The lacuna doesn't have a walking speed and can't benefit from any bonus to their speed.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: The lacuna has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lacuna makes three Grief-Eater attacks and uses Infuse Sadness, if available.

action.name: Grief-Eater
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20 ft., one creature. {@h}29 ({@damage 4d10 + 7}) psychic damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Infuse Sadness (1/Day)
entries: Each enemy the lacuna can see within 30 feet of them must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or be overwhelmed with grief for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While a creature is overwhelmed, attacks against them are made with advantage.

bonus.name: Slip Between
entries: The lacuna teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space they can see.

reaction.name: Slip Away
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of the lacuna targets them with an attack, the lacuna teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space they can see. If the lacuna is no longer a valid target for the triggering attack, the attacker must choose a new target or the attack misses.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Avalla can cast the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When Avalla makes an attack, she has advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: Avalla has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Lightning Lash (Cantrip)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) lightning damage, and Avalla can move the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

action.name: Iron Terror (1/Day; 4th-Level Spell)
entries: Avalla projects a terrifying illusion of the High Command to each enemy in a 30-foot cone. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} of each member of the High Command for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Iron Shackles (1/Day; 3rd-Level Spell; Concentration)
entries: Avalla conjures animated iron chains at a point she can see on the ground within 60 feet of her. The chains fill a 15-foot- square on the ground centered on that point and last for 1 minute. When a creature enters that area for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, they must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (save ends at start of turn). A creature {@condition restrained} in this way takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage at the end of each of their turns.

action.name: Iron Ring (2/Day)
entries: If not in the Cyst, Avalla teleports to the Cyst. If in the Cyst, she teleports to a place she has visited.

reaction.name: Escape Ring
entries: When Avalla isn't in the Cyst and an ally she can see within 60 feet of her drops to 0 hit points, she expends a use of Iron Ring and teleports herself to the Cyst along with each willing ally within 60 feet of her who isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

reaction.name: Spellcasting Feedback
entries: When a creature Avalla can see within 60 feet of her casts a spell, she taps into the caster's mind and sabotages their magic. The creature can choose either to cast the spell then take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) psychic damage per level of the spell cast, or to let the spell fail. If the spell fails, the creature's spell slot is expended with no effect and their action is wasted.

items: Sindarin

name: Lady Emer

trait.name: Stone Sacrifice (3/Day)
entries: When Emer fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead by ending the effects of her Stone Gaze on a creature of her choice within 300 feet of her.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Emer uses Pinning Shot or makes three attacks using Snake Bite, Longbow, or both. She also uses Stone Gaze or Envenomed Stone, if available.

action.name: Snake Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}17 ({@damage 5d6}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of Emer's next turn. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the target can't take reactions.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 11} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Pinning Shot
entries: Emer makes three Longbow attacks against a creature touching the ground within 150 feet of her. If at least two of those attacks hit, the target is {@condition restrained} by arrows pinning their limbs to the ground. A creature {@condition restrained} in this way or another creature who can reach them can use an action to pull out the arrows and end the condition.

action.name: Stone Gaze
entries: Emer fires beams of energy from her eyes at up to three creatures she can see within 60 feet of her. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or begin turning to stone (save ends at end of turn). While turning to stone, a creature's speed is reduced by 10 feet and they have disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saving throws. If a creature who is turning to stone is targeted by this action again and fails their save, their speed is reduced by another 10 feet and they are {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the effect ends.

If a creature who is turning to stone and {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} in this way is targeted by this action again and fails their save, they are {@condition petrified} and can no longer make saving throws to end the effects of Stone Gaze. The petrification lasts until the creature is restored by Emer's Stone Sacrifice trait, a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power of 4th order or higher, a {@spell greater restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect.

action.name: Envenomed Stone {@recharge 5}
entries: Emer utters an ancient hex. Each creature within 60 feet of her who is being turned to stone by her Stone Gaze must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 44 ({@damage 8d10}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Mesmerizing Eyes
entries: The glowing eyes of Emer's snakes gaze at one creature Emer can see within 60 feet of her. If the target can see Emer, they must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} until the start of the target's next turn. A target {@condition charmed} in this way must immediately use their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed in a direction of Emer's choice.

reaction.name: Blinding Mucus
entries: When a creature Emer can see within 5 feet of her hits her with a melee attack, Emer spits venom at their eyes. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage and be {@condition blinded} until the start of their next turn.

legendaryHeader: Emer has three villain actions. She can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. She can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: I See You!
entries: Emer uses Stone Gaze against each enemy she can see within 60 feet of her.

legendary.name: Action 2: Medusa's Evolution
entries: Emer grows wings from her back, gaining a flying speed of 40 feet, then she moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks. After 1 minute, the wings crumble to dust and her flying speed is lost.

legendary.name: Action 3: Stone Puppets
entries: Emer mentally manipulates the stone in each creature who is being turned to stone by her Stone Gaze. Emer and each of those creatures move up to their speed then make a weapon attack against a creature of Emer's choice (no action required).

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Feluciana's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 22}, {@hit 14} to hit with spell attacks). Feluciana can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Feluciana fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Feluciana has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Petrifying Glare
entries: When a creature that can see Feluciana's eyes starts its turn within 60 feet of her, she can force the creature to make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw if she isn't {@condition incapacitated} and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly {@condition petrified}. Otherwise, a creature that fails the save begins to turn to stone and is {@condition restrained}. The {@condition restrained} creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming {@condition petrified} on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by a {@spell greater restoration} spell cast at 7th level or higher spell or other magic.

Unless {@status surprised}, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see Feluciana until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at Feluciana in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

trait.name: Serpentine Reactiveness
entries: Once per turn, Feluciana can make an opportunity attack with her snake hair without expending her reaction.

trait.name: Virulent Weapons
entries: Feluciana's weapon attacks are magical. In addition, damage from her weapon attacks ignores resistance to poison damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Feluciana makes four attacks: one with her bident and three with her snake hair. When available, she can use her Petrifying Beam in place of her three attacks with her snake hair.

action.name: Bident
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage and 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The bident flies back to Feluciana's hand immediately after making a ranged attack with it.

action.name: Snake Hair
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Petrifying Beam {@recharge 5}
entries: Feluciana's snakes focus a beam of petrifying energy at one creature she can see within 90 feet of her. A creature that has averted its eyes from Feluciana gains no benefit against this effect. The targeted creature must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature begins to turn to stone and is {@condition restrained}. It must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw at the end of its next turn or become {@condition petrified} until freed by a {@spell greater restoration} spell cast at 7th level or higher or other magic.

reaction.name: Retaliating Lash
entries: When a creature within 15 feet of Feluciana deals damage to her, one of her snakes lashes out, coiling itself around the creature. The target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or become {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}) and be pulled up to 10 feet toward Feluciana.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Feluciana moves up to her speed.

legendary.name: Snake Hair
entries: Feluciana makes an attack with her snake hair.

legendary.name: Summon Snakes (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Feluciana magically summons 4 ({@dice 1d4 + 2}) flying snakes or 1 swarm of poisonous snakes. A summoned creature appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of Feluciana, acts as her ally, and shares her Virulent Weapons trait. It remains for 1 minute, until it or Feluciana dies, or until she dismisses it as an action.

trait.name: Depicted Demise
entries: The lake dredger takes 20 Force damage at the start of its turn if it can see a creature holding a created depiction (such as a drawing, painting, or carving) of the lake dredger.

trait.name: Silt Stealth
entries: The lake dredger has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks made when in an area with aquatic plants or seaweed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lake dredger makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}), and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 15 ft. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: Swallow
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}, one Large or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the lake dredger (the lake dredger can only have one creature swallowed at a time). {@actSaveFail} The lake dredger swallows the target, which is no longer {@condition Grappled|XPHB}. While swallowed, the creature has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition, has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Three-Quarters Cover} against attacks and other effects outside the lake dredger, and takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Necrotic damage at the start of each of the lake dredger's turns.

As an action, the swallowed creature can escape through the lake dredger's ribcage. The creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Piercing damage and emerges in a space within 5 feet of the lake dredger. If the lake dredger dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition Restrained|XPHB} and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting {@condition Prone|XPHB}.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The lake troll can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The lake troll has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The lake troll regains 10 hp at the start of its turn. If the lake troll takes cold or fire damage, it regains only 5 hp at the start of its next turn. If the lake troll takes both cold and fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the lake troll's next turn. The lake troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lake troll makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. If both Claw attacks hit one creature that is wielding a weapon, the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or the target's weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If the weapon's penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. If the target is wielding more than one weapon, the troll chooses which weapon to affect.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d8 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} +9 to to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Cave Apex
entries: The lamasombra's unnatural scales, padded feet, and bones allow them to avoid detection. They can't be detected with tremorsense. When the lamasombra is in darkness or dim light, they are {@condition invisible} to creatures with darkvision, but they are visible in dim light to creatures without darkvision.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The lamasombra can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lamasombra makes one Bite attack and one Tongue attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 6d8 + 6}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, they must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or contract boiling wastes disease. Until the disease is cured, the target can't regain hit points, and the lamasombra can sense the direction to the creature's location as long as they're on the same plane of existence.

action.name: Tongue
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 6d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage, or 37 ({@damage 9d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage if the target is a creature who can't see the lamasombra. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, they are pulled up to 15 feet in a straight line toward the lamasombra.

bonus.name: Nightmarish Cunning
entries: The lamasombra takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

trait.name: Octarine Glow
entries: The dreg sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 15-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 15 feet.

trait.name: Arcane Hunger
entries: The dreg has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against creatures that have one or more levels of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dreg makes three Octarine Beam attacks.

action.name: Octarine Beam
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Radiant damage, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}.

action.name: Wave of Contamination {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15}, each creature within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Radiant damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Necrotic damage and gain one level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

name: Lamplighter
languages: understands Common but does not speak

trait.name: Lantern Light
entries: The lamplighter sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 20-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 10 feet. This light goes out if the lamplighter dies.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Lantern Beams
entries: The lamplighter emits two different magical beams from their lanterns, choosing two targets they can see within 60 feet.

items.name: Blasting Light
items.entry: {@actSave str} {@dc 13}, one creature within 60 feet who can see the lamplighter. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Force damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

items.name: Blinding Light
items.entry: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, one creature within 60 feet who can see the lamplighter. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Radiant damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the start of the lamplighter's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

items.name: Burning Light
items.entry: {@actSave dex} {@dc 13}, one creature within 60 feet who can see the lamplighter. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Fire damage, and the target is burning. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

items.name: Witch Light
items.entry: {@actSave wis} {@dc 13}, one creature within 60 feet who can see the lamplighter. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition. While {@condition Charmed|XPHB} in this way, the target must use all of their movement on their turns to move toward the lamplighter. At the end of each of their turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on themself on a success. The target has advantage on its saves to end this effect if it's taken damage from the lamplighter. After 1 minute, the target is no longer {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by the lamplighter.

reaction.name: Warding Flare
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature targets the lamplighter with an attack. {@actResponse} The lamplighter's lanterns flare, and the target has disadvantage on their attack rolls against the lamplighter this turn.

trait.name: Magical Darkness Hypersensitivity
entries: While in an area of magical darkness, the lantern dragonette can't fly or use Lantern Belly, and it takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage each minute.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Fire Breath
entries: The lantern dragonette breathes fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half the damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Lantern Belly
entries: The dragonette sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet or stops shedding light. To shed light, it must have eaten at least 4 ounces of candle wax in the past 24 hours. It can shed light for up to 1 hour for every 4 ounces of candle wax it has eaten in the past 24 hours, to a maximum of 4 hours every 24 hours.

trait.name: Eternal Torment
entries: If a last memory dies, it reappears {@dice 1d4} days later, unleashing a howling scream that can be heard up to 300 feet away.

trait.name: Silhouette
entries: The last memory can only move along contiguous flat surfaces, such as walls or floors. It cannot fly or swim and must always be in contact with a surface. Additionally, the last memory ignores all natural {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} and can climb without making an ability check.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The last memory doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Sorrowful Touch
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 3d6 + 2}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Anguish {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 10}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the last memory that can hear it. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage and the target becomes {@condition Jinxed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} {@dice 1d6} (save ends).

hp.special: Nine times their level (number of d12 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Molten Slam)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 + PB} bludgeoning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage. A flammable object hit by this attack ignites if it isn't being worn or carried. Beginning at 7th level, the bastion can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Burning Embrace (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the bastion makes a signature attack against a creature within range. If the attack hits, the target is also {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, a target is {@condition restrained} and takes {@damage PBd6} fire damage at the start of each of their turns.

action.name: 5th Level: Melting Grasp (3/Day)
entries: When the bastion hits a creature with a signature attack, the creature takes an extra {@damage PBd4} fire damage. If the target is wielding a mundane metal weapon, the bastion partially melts the target's weapon, giving it a permanent -2 penalty to attack and damage rolls. If the target is wielding a supernatural metal weapon, the penalty lasts for 1 hour instead.

action.name: 7th Level: Eruption (1/Day)
entries: As an action, the bastion erupts, shooting a 30-foot cone of earth and lava from their head. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes {@damage PBd6} bludgeoning damage plus {@damage PBd6} fire damage and is knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and is not knocked {@condition prone}. The lava spreads around corners and ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried.

name: Lava Wurm
languages: and Terran but can't speak them

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The wurm can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

trait.name: Noxious Resilience
entries: The wurm has advantage on saving throws made against harmful gases and vapors (such as the effects of a stinking cloud or a green dragon's poison breath).

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The wurm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Volcanic Body
entries: The wurm sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet. In addition, whenever a creature enters the area within 5 feet of the wurm for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) fire damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage.

action.name: Molten Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: The wurm exhales molten metal in a 15-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage and its speed is reduced by 10 feet. If a target's speed is reduced to 0 by this effect, it becomes {@condition restrained}. A creature can take an action to scrape or wash off the metal, ending the effect. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and its speed isn't reduced.

trait.name: Glide
entries: The lemurfolk has membranes between its fore and hind limbs that expand when falling to slow its rate of descent to 60 feet per round, landing on its feet and taking no falling damage. It can move up to 5 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it falls. The lemurfolk can't gain height with its gliding membranes alone. If subjected to a strong wind or lift of any kind, it can use the updraft to glide farther.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Blowgun
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 25/100 ft., one creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also {@condition unconscious} while {@condition poisoned} in this way. The target wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

trait.name: Berserk
entries: Whenever the lenchtahg starts its turn with 54 hit points or fewer, roll a {@dice d6}. On a 1, the lenchtahg recalls its former life and current agony, and it goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the lenchtahg attacks the nearest creature it can see. It treats all creatures as enemies and makes any opportunity attack it can. Also, it has advantage on attack rolls, but all attack rolls against it have advantage. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the lenchtahg moves as far as it can toward the closest creature.

Once the lenchtahg goes berserk, it remains so until destroyed or it has more than 54 hit points. Also, a fiend can calm the lenchtahg. The lenchtahg must be able to understand the fiend, who must take an action to make a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check. If the check succeeds, the lenchtahg ceases being berserk.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The lenchtahg has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The lenchtahg's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Radiant Absorption
entries: Whenever the lenchtahg is subjected to radiant damage from a source other than a lenchtahg, it takes no damage and instead regains hit points equal to half the radiant damage dealt to it.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If the lenchtahg's head survives its demise, the head must be doused in holy water and ritually consecrated in a 1-hour ceremony or be the target of a {@spell dispel evil and good} spell. If it isn't, then the lenchtahg reappears in 6 days, emerging from a fiery explosion in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on the head. Creatures in that area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 {@damage 8d6} damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one. The head can't rejuvenate in a holy {@spell hallow} spell's area.

trait.name: Water Aversion
entries: If drenched in 5 gallons or more of water, or any amount of holy water, the lenchtahg has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lenchtahg makes two claw attacks, makes one claw attack and uses radiant gaze once, or uses radiant gaze twice.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage and 9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage.

action.name: Radiant Gaze
entries: The lenchtahg targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it with burning radiance. The target gains no benefit from cover and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) radiant damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Lendarick is a 10th-level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). Lendarick has the following spells prepared:

trait.name: Fated (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: Lendarick can choose to reroll any attack, skill check, or saving throw.

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Lendarick can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement and takes no falling damage. He cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

trait.name: Resilience
entries: Lendarick has advantage on saving throws against poison.

trait.name: Wing Flap
entries: As a bonus action, Lendarick can use his powerful feathered arms to propel himself upward up to half his movement speed. Lendarick can use it in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

action.name: Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d6 - 1}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Charming (3/Day)
entries: When a creature makes an attack against Lendarick, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or target the next closest creature within range. If multiple creatures are closest, the attacker chooses. This feature does not work if there are no other creatures within range.

name: Lenny
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

spellcasting.name: Touched
headerEntries: Lenny knows the {@spell light} cantrip. Charisma is his spellcasting ability for this cantrip.

trait.name: Fated (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: Lenny can choose to reroll any attack roll, skill check, or saving throw.

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Lenny can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement and takes no falling damage. He cannot glide while carrying heavy objects or heavy weapons (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

trait.name: Wing Flap
entries: As a bonus action, Lenny can use his powerful feathered arms to propel himself upward up to half his movement speed. Lenny can use this in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

trait.name: Resilience
entries: Lenny has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lenny makes two attacks.

action.name: Shortened Spear
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage, or 5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage if used with two hands.

trait.name: Radiant Gaze
entries: When a creature that can see Lenore's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of her, Lenore can force it to make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw if she isn't {@condition incapacitated} and can see the creature. The creature takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. In addition, creatures who fail this saving throw gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see Lenore until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at Lenore in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.
If Lenore sees herself reflected on a polished surface within 30 feet of her and in an area of bright light, she becomes {@condition blinded} and {@condition incapacitated} for {@dice 1d6} hours.

action.name: Tentacle Hair
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lenore makes three attacks with her Tentacle Hair.

action.name: Tentacle Hair
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 10 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}.

bonus.name: Radiant Gaze {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Radiant damage and the target gains one level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. If Lenore sees her reflection within the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}, she gains the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} conditions for {@dice 1d6} hours.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The leshy can mimic animal sounds and Humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

trait.name: Plant Camouflage
entries: The leshy has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
entries: The leshy can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Vine-Wrapped Weapons
entries: The poisonous vines growing from the leshy entwine around its weapon. When the leshy hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 2d4} poison damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Woodland Stride
entries: Difficult terrain composed of magical or nonmagical plants doesn't cost the leshy extra movement.

action.name: Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage.

action.name: Frightening Mien {@recharge 5}
entries: The leshy briefly appears to grow to an enormous size, taking on a malicious mien before returning to normal. Each creature within 15 feet of the leshy and that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A {@condition frightened} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature is immune to Frightening Mien if it can see through illusions.

action.name: Encourage Growth (1/Day)
entries: The leshy whispers magical words of growth to nonmagical plants on a point it can see within 30 feet of it. The plants burst with life and spread rapidly. The area within 20 feet of that point becomes difficult terrain for 24 hours.

name: Lesser Aboleth Broodmother

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the aboleth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Infectious Mucus
entries: The aboleth is surrounded by infectious mucus. A creature that touches the aboleth or that hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is diseased. For the first hour of the disease, the creature takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) necrotic damage if it ends its turn out of water (it must be at least neck-deep to avoid this damage). After the first hour and until the disease is cured, a creature is unable to gain the benefits of a short or long rest if it does not spend the rest at least neck-deep in water.
A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more becomes a host of a broodling egg that hatches in 3d6 days.

trait.name: Probing Telepathy
entries: If a creature communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature's greatest desires if the aboleth can see the creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The aboleth makes two Tentacle attacks and uses Birth, if available.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a saving throw against the aboleth's Infectious Mucus trait.

action.name: Birth (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The aboleth produces a broodling in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it.

action.name: Entrance (3/Day)
entries: The aboleth targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the aboleth until the aboleth dies or until it is on a different plane of existence from the target. The charmed target is under the aboleth's control and can't take reactions, and the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance.

Whenever the charmed target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends. No more than once every 24 hours, the target can also repeat the saving throw when it is at least 1 mile away from the aboleth.

legendaryHeader: The aboleth can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time, and only at the end of another creature's turn. The aboleth regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Jet
entries: The aboleth spurts out a pall of ink, heavily obscuring a 20-foot-radius sphere of water centred on the aboleth until the start of its next turn. It then moves up to its swimming speed.

legendary.name: Tentacle
entries: The aboleth makes one Tentacle attack.

legendary.name: Suction Drain (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The aboleth attempts to grapple one creature within 10 feet of it with a special tentacle. A creature charmed by the aboleth automatically fails this check. If the aboleth succeeds on the check, the creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage and the aboleth regains a number of hit points equal to half the damage dealt. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The seraph's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 14}). The seraph can innately cast the following spells, using only verbal components:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The seraph has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Seraphic Weapons
entries: The seraph's weapon attacks are magical. When the seraph hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The seraph makes three attacks.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage and 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Tempting Call
entries: The seraph calls out a tempting promise to one creature that can hear it withing 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature cannot take actions for 1 minute, as it dwells on the promise the seraph made. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a success. Each failed saving throw after the initial failure deals 9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage to the target

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The chrysalis can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If the chrysalis fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Regenerative State
entries: The chrysalis' hit points reset to its maximum at the start of its turn.

trait.name: Sticky Mucus
entries: When a creature hits the chrysalis with a melee attack, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or become disarmed as its weapon stays stuck to the creature. A creature can use an action to make a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics|PHB}) check, freeing a stuck weapon within its reach on a success. If the attack requires that the attacker touch the aboleth (GM's discretion), then the attacker becomes grappled (escape {@dc 15}) on a failed save. While it is grappled, it can't use that limb. If the attack is a bite, then the creature can't speak while it is grappled in this way.

trait.name: Transitional State
entries: The chrysalis turns into a lesser aboleth broodmother at the start of its fourth turn after becoming a chrysalis, ending any grapples it is a part of.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chrysalis makes three Sticky Ectoplasm attacks. Each attack must be against a different target.

action.name: Sticky Ectoplasm
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) acid damage and the target's speed is reduced by 15 feet until the target uses an action to remove the ectoplasm. A creature whose speed is reduced to 0 feet by this effect is restrained (escape {@dc 15}).

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The lesser crawling one casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The lesser crawling one has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Relentless Evil
entries: When a lesser crawling one is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it falls into a pile of rotting flesh, worms, and maggots. If it takes at least 15 Fire damage before the end of its next turn, the lesser crawling one is permanently destroyed. It can still be targeted by spells and effects that target creatures. Otherwise, the lesser crawling one reforms in {@dice 2d6} days. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the tomb it was originally buried in.

action.name: Slimy Grasp
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, Reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) Necrotic damage, and a Medium or smaller creature has its Speed reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn as it is covered in slime and maggots.

legendary.name: By My Command
entries: The lesser crawling one chooses up to three willing Undead or Mythos creatures it can see. Each of the chosen creatures can take a Reaction to move up to its Speed, and each creature gains Advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the lesser crawling one's next turn.

legendary.name: Squirming Escape
entries: The lesser crawling one teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The lesser dark young of Shub-Niggurath casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The lesser dark young of Shub-Niggurath has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lesser dark young of Shub-Niggurath makes four Flailing Tentacle attacks. It can replace two attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Flailing Tentacle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, Reach 20 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 13}).

legendary.name: Swarming Tentacles
entries: The lesser dark young of Shub-Niggurath makes two Flailing Tentacle attacks.

legendary.name: Clamor of Hooves
entries: The lesser dark young of Shub-Niggurath moves up to its Speed.

trait.name: Multiattack
entries: The demon makes two attacks, one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Foul Odor (1/day)
entries: The demon emits a cloud of poisonous gas that fills a 20-foot sphere and persists for 1 minute until it disperses into the surrounding air. The cloud spreads around corners, and the affected area is heavily obscured. Any creature that is completely within the cloud at the start of its turn must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw against the poison. On a failed save, the creature spends its action on that turn retching and reeling. Creatures immune to poison are immune to this effect. A moderate wind (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses the cloud after 4 rounds. A strong wind (at least 20 miles per hour) will disperse it after 1 round.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The seraph's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 13}). The seraph can innately cast the following spells, using only verbal components:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The seraph has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Seraphic Weapons
entries: The seraph's weapon attacks are magical. When the seraph hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage (included in the attacks).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The seraph makes three attacks, only one of which can be a bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) piercing damage and 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the seraph can't bite another target.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage and 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Tongue
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}) and pulled to within 5 feet of the seraph. Until the grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the seraph can't use its tongue or bite on another target.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

trait.name: Light Incorporeality
entries: The devil is semi-incorporeal when standing in moonlight and is immune to all nonmagical attacks in such conditions. Even when hit by spells or magic weapons, it takes only half damage from a corporeal source, with the exception of force damage. Holy water can affect the devil as it does incorporeal undead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devil makes one Bite attack, one Claw attack, and one Tail attack. Alternatively, it can use Hurl Moonlight twice.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hurl Moonlight
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d10}) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition blinded} until the end of the devil's next turn.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The devil magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the devil wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

bonus.name: Light Step
entries: The devil teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 80 feet to an unoccupied space (in moonlight) it can see.

entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

entries: The devil is semi-incorporeal when standing in moonlight and is immune to all nonmagical attacks in such conditions. Even when hit by spells or magic weapons, it takes only half damage from a corporeal source, with the exception of force damage. Holy water can affect the devil as it does incorporeal undead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devil makes one Bite attack, one Claw attack, and one Tail attack. Alternatively, it can use Hurl Moonlight twice.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hurl Moonlight
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d10}) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition blinded} until the end of the devil's next turn.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The devil magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the devil wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

action.name: Summon Devil (1/Day)
entries: The devil can attempt a magical summoning. As an action, the devil has a 30 percent chance of summoning a lesser lunar devil.

bonus.name: Light Step
entries: The devil teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 80 feet to an unoccupied space (in moonlight) it can see.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The lesser star-spawn of Cthulhu casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The lesser star-spawn of Cthulhu can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The lesser star-spawn of Cthulhu has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lesser star-spawn of Cthulhu makes two Crushing Fist attacks.

action.name: Crushing Fist
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, Reach 15 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage.

legendary.name: Flabby Claws
entries: The lesser star-spawn of Cthulhu makes one Crushing Fist attack.

legendary.name: Eldritch Contradictions
entries: The lesser star-spawn of Cthulhu uses Spellcasting.

legendary.name: Ravening for Delight
entries: The lesser star-spawn of Cthulhu moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

name: Lesser Veiled Lady

trait.name: Communication Spores
entries: The Veiled Lady's telepathy extends throughout its lair. It communicates using images and emotion.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the Veiled Lady fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Mycelial Form
entries: The Veiled Lady can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Sun Sickness
entries: While in sunlight, or if it takes 5 or more radiant damage in a single turn, the Veiled Lady has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of its next turn. The Veiled Lady dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Veiled Lady uses either its Infectious Spores or Shackles of Pain, if available, then makes a Halluciwhip attack.

action.name: Halluciwhip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 3d4 + 3}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Infectious Spores (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The Veiled Lady exhales a cloud of spores at a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or become afflicted by the fungal infection* spell for 1 minute. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Shackles of Pain (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The Veiled Lady exhales a cloud of spores at a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or become afflicted by the shackles of pain* spell. The Veiled Lady can have only one creature afflicted by Shackles of Pain at a time.

bonus.name: Detritivore
entries: As a bonus action, the Veiled Lady can target one Small or larger corpse not under the effects of the gentle repose spell within 15 feet of it, draining it of its essence and regaining 10 ({@damage 3d6}) hit points. Once a corpse has been targeted by this feature, it becomes desiccated and can't be targeted again.

legendaryHeader: The Veiled Lady can take 2 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Veiled Lady regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Hyphal Tether
entries: Tendrils of grasping hyphae burst from the ground, grabbing at one creature the Veiled Lady can see within 30 feet of it. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or become grappled (escape {@dc 13}). Until this grapple ends, that creature is restrained.

legendary.name: Mycelial Reconstitution
entries: The Veiled Lady dissolves into mycelia, ending any grapples or restraining effects to which it is currently subjected, and reappears in an unoccupied space on the ground it can see within 30 feet of it. This does not end grapples created by the Veiled Lady's Hyphal Tether.

legendary.name: Whip
entries: The Veiled Lady makes a Halluciwhip attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Lestheris can cast the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Charm Resistant
entries: Lestheris has advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} condition on herself.

trait.name: Dark Calling
entries: Each other creature within 30 feet of Lestheris has disadvantage on death saving throws.

trait.name: Tome of the Ethereal
entries: Lestheris can see 120 feet into the Ethereal Plane.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lestheris makes two Grave Grasp or two Necrotic Lance attacks.

action.name: Grave Grasp (Cantrip)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of Lestheris's next turn.

action.name: Necrotic Lance (1st-Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.
Lestheris can destroy a shade under her control within 30 feet of her and deal an extra 4 ({@damage 1d8}) necrotic damage to the target.

action.name: Animate Spirits (2/Day)
entries: Lestheris animates two shades.

The shades appear in unoccupied spaces Lestheris can see within 30 feet of her. The shades act immediately after Lestheris on the same initiative count and follow her verbal orders. If Lestheris dies, the shades are destroyed.

reaction.name: Ethereal Step (3/Day)
entries: When a creature Lestheris can see within 60 feet of her targets her with an attack, power, or spell while she isn't on the Ethereal Plane, she can choose one of the following effects:

items: Lestheris enters the Ethereal Plane, then returns to the plane and the space she left at the start of her next turn.

entries: If that space is occupied, she returns to the nearest unoccupied space of her choice.
• She teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

hp.special: 70 + 10 for each spell slot level above 7

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The spirit can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spirit makes a number of Rend attacks equal to half this spell's level (round down).

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hitYourSpellAttack your spell attack modifier} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d10 + 5 + summonSpellLevel} Piercing damage.

action.name: Roar
entries: {@actSave con} DC equals your spell save DC, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} No effect.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: The leyleech has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature who can cast spells, the leyleech chooses one of the target's spellcasting abilities. That ability score is reduced by 1 (min- imum score of 1) until the target finishes a short or long rest, and the leyleech's form becomes charged for 1 minute or until they use Magic Purge.

action.name: Magic Purge (Charged Form Only)
entries: The leyleech spews corrupted magical energy at a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The leyleech is no longer charged, and the target must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Bite)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Sparking Attack (2 Ferocity)
entries: The leyleech makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} damage, and if the target hits the leyleech with an attack before the start of the leyleech's next turn, the target takes PB lightning damage.

action.name: 3rd Level: Anomalous Terrain (5 Ferocity)
entries: The area within 10 feet of the leyleech becomes difficult terrain for their enemies until the start of their next turn. When an enemy enters that area for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, they must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage PBd4} force damage.

action.name: 5th Level: Magic Purge (8 Ferocity)
entries: The leyleech spews corrupted magical energy at a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage PBd8} force damage and is {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the start of the leyleech's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}.

reaction.name: Absorb Magic (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: When the leyleech's caregiver is within 30 feet of them and the leyleech or their caregiver is affected by a spell of 3rd level or lower, the leyleech consumes the spell's magic, and it has no effect on the leyleech and their caregiver.

trait.name: Bibliophile
entries: The library automaton understands any written language it can see, provided it is touching the surface on which the words are written.

trait.name: Bibliotelekinesis
entries: The library automaton is surrounded by an {@condition invisible}, shapeless, magical force that can perform simple tasks at the automaton's command. This force has a Strength equal to the automaton's Strength, and it can interact with objects up to 15 feet away from the automaton. The automaton can use this force to perform simple tasks that a Small humanoid with two hands could do, such as opening a door, moving a bookshelf's ladder, picking up and organizing books, and similar tasks. The automaton can't use this force to make attacks or wield a weapon or shield.

trait.name: Book Safekeeper
entries: The library automaton's body contains a small, extradimensional space. This space can hold up to 100 pounds of Small or smaller objects. This space can hold only books, scrolls, parchment, or other written works on paper or other paper- or wood-like materials. The automaton is the only creature capable of retrieving items from this space while it is alive. If the automaton is destroyed, the objects within its extradimensional space are ejected into an unoccupied space nearest it.

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The library automaton doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Piston-Powered Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 2d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Unnerving Gaze
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on the next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it makes before the start of the automaton's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, the lich can cast the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 20}):

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If the lich is destroyed but their soulstone is intact, their soul retreats into the stone. While the lich's soul is in the stone, a creature who can see the stone at the start of their turn must succeed on a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the stone until the end of their next turn. While {@condition charmed} in this way, the creature must do everything in their power to move toward and touch the stone, avoiding obvious hazards.

If a creature touches the stone while the lich's soul is inside, the creature must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature drops to 0 hit points and the lich reforms with all their hit points in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the soulstone. On a successful save, the creature loses half their hit points and the lich reforms with half their hit points in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the soulstone.
The soulstone has AC 19, 50 hit points, and immunity to all damage except force and thunder.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: The lich has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

trait.name: Turn Immunity
entries: The lich is immune to effects that turn Undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lich uses Glare of Undeath and makes four attacks using Biting Acid, Disruptive Thunder, Pain of Ages, or a combination of them.

action.name: Biting Acid (3rd-Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 12} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 5d8}) acid damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of the lich's next turn.

action.name: Disruptive Thunder (3rd-Level Spell)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d10}) thunder damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, the lich can move them up to 45 feet horizontally.

action.name: Pain of Ages (3rd-Level Spell)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft., one creature. {@h}21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage, and the first time the target hits a creature with an attack before the start of the lich's next turn, that attack deals half damage.

action.name: Glare of Undeath
entries: The lich's eyes flare with supernatural power at one creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or be compelled to hug themself tightly as protection against an unbearably cruel world. A creature hugging themself in this way is {@condition restrained} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). A creature the target can hear and understand can use an action to make a {@dc 20} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Horrid Woe (2/Day)
entries: The lich sends negative energy coursing through a creature they can see within 90 feet of them. The target is seared with pain and must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw, taking 61 ({@damage 7d8 + 30}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A target reduced to 0 hit points by this damage becomes stable but can't regain hit points, and their spirit turns into a wraith who appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of their body. This wraith acts on the lich's turn immediately after them, and they obey the lich's verbal commands to the best of their ability. If the wraith or lich are destroyed, the wraith disappears, the target's spirit returns to their body, and the target can regain hit points.

action.name: Life Absorption (1/Day; 9th-Level Spell; Concentration)
entries: The lich unleashes a wave of life-sapping energy. Each enemy within 120 feet of them must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage at the start of each of their turns for 1 minute, and the lich gains temporary hit points equal to the total damage dealt.

bonus.name: Necrotic Form (3rd-Level Spell)
entries: The lich enters a shadow form and moves up to their speed. While in this form, the lich is immune to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and the {@condition grappled} and {@condition restrained} conditions, and they can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. The lich reverts to their true form at the end of their turn.

reaction.name: Immortal Insight
entries: When another creature the lich can see makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, the lich can cause the roll to be made with advantage or disadvantage.

name: Lich Hound
languages: understands Common and Darakhul but can't speak

trait.name: Blood Sense
entries: The lich hound can pinpoint the location of creatures that aren't Constructs or Undead within 60 feet of it and can sense the general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of it.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The lich hound has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The lich hound doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lich hound can use its Eerie Howl. It then makes two Bite attacks. If both attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) slashing damage and be {@condition incapacitated} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Eerie Howl
entries: The lich hound releases an eerie howl that fades in and out and echoes strangely. Each creature within 30 feet of the lich hound must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the lich hound's Eerie Howl for the next 24 hours.

bonus.name: Ethereal Jaunt
entries: The lich hound magically shifts from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane, or vice versa.

name: Lich Troll
languages: the languages it knew in life and Giant

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The lich troll is an 11th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). The lich troll has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the lich troll fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The lich troll regains 15 hit points at the start of its turn. If the lich troll takes acid or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function until the start of the lich troll's next turn. The lich troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lich troll makes two claw attacks. Alternately, the lich troll can cast {@spell chill touch} or ray of frost twice.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage.

legendary.name: Cantrip
entries: The lich troll casts a cantrip.

legendary.name: Claw
entries: The lich troll makes a claw attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Petra makes three attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of Petra's next turn.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: Petra takes the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

reaction.name: Skirmisher
entries: {@actTrigger} A hostile creature Petra can see ends its turn within 5 feet of her. {@actResponse} Petra moves up to her {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

trait.name: Avoidance
