entries: If the lightbender is subjected to an effect that allows them to make a saving throw to take only half damage, they instead take no damage if they succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if they fail.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the lightbender moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits them with a Claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the lightbender can make one Bite attack against them as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lightbender makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks, or uses their Tail Whip twice.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail Whip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage.

action.name: Hypnotic Mane (1/Day)
entries: The lightbender discharges the light absorbed in their mane into a brilliant, mesmerizing display. Each creature within 15 feet of the lightbender must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the lightbender for 1 minute. While {@condition charmed} in this way, a creature is {@condition incapacitated} and has a speed of 0. If a creature {@condition charmed} in this way takes damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of their stupor, the condition ends for that creature.

reaction.name: Afterimage
entries: When the lightbender is hit by an attack, they can reveal that the attacker is attacking a past visual imprint of the lightbender. The lightbender appears in an unoccupied space they can see within 30 feet of their imprint, the attack misses, then the imprint disappears. The lightbender can't use this reaction if the attacker relies on senses other than sight, such as blindsight, or if they can perceive illusions as false, as with truesight.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Bite)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Tail Whip (2 Ferocity)
entries: The lightbender makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} radiant damage to the target, and a different creature the lightbender chooses within 15 feet of them takes PB radiant damage.

action.name: 3rd Level: Silent Pounce (5 Ferocity)
entries: The lightbender teleports 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see. Before or after teleporting, the lightbender can make a signature attack. If the attack hits, the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: 5th Level: Hypnotic Mane (8 Ferocity)
entries: Each creature within 10 feet of the lightbender must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the lightbender until the end of the lightbender's next turn. While {@condition charmed} in this way, a creature is {@condition incapacitated} and has a speed of 0. If a creature {@condition charmed} in this way takes damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of their stupor, the condition ends on that creature.

reaction.name: Shared Afterimage (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: When the lightbender and their caregiver are within 30 feet of each other and one of them is hit by an attack, the lightbender reveals that both they and their caregiver are past visual imprints. The lightbender and the caregiver each appear in an unoccupied space they can see within 30 feet of their imprints, the attack misses, then the imprints disappear. The lightbender can't use this reaction if the attacker relies on senses other than sight, such as blindsight, or if they can perceive illusions as false, as with truesight.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The eel can breathe air and water. They can survive out of water for up to 8 hours.

trait.name: Slippery
entries: The eel has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid or end the {@condition grappled} condition on themself.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Electric Pulse
entries: The eel channels energy toward a creature within 20 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, made with disadvantage if the target is touching the eel. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) lightning damage and is {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}.

trait.name: Electrifying Flesh
entries: A lightning giant's flesh constantly sparks with electricity. A creature striking a lightning giant with a melee weapon must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Lightning damage, or 5 ({@damage 1d10}) damage if the weapon is made out of a conductive metal such as iron. A lightning giant can suppress this ability with a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lightning giant makes two attacks, using Lightning Staff or Static Fling in any combination.

action.name: Lightning Staff
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Lightning damage.

action.name: Static Fling
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) Lightning damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet.

action.name: Static Discharge (Recharge 6 or Special)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15} All creatures in a 20-foot radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} surrounding the lightning giant. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Lightning Damage, and the target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Absorb Lightning
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the lightning giant can see within 60 feet (other than itself) deals Lightning damage to a creature other than the lightning giant. {@actResponse} The lightning giant absorbs the Lightning damage into its staff, negating that damage against its original target. This also recharges its Static Discharge ability.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the panther is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Feline Fall
entries: When the panther falls and isn't {@condition incapacitated}, it can subtract up to 100 feet from the fall when calculating falling damage.

trait.name: Flashing Movement
entries: Whenever the panther moves on its turn, it can instead choose to teleport to an unoccupied space it can see, including into the air, leaving a harmless streak of electrical energy in its path. When it teleports in this way, it must spend an amount of movement equal to the distance it teleported.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The panther has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The panther makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Lightning Strike {@recharge 4}
entries: If the panther teleports at least 20 feet into the air as part of its movement, it can then use this action to fall into a space that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity or Constitution saving throw (target's choice) or be knocked {@condition prone} and take 9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage and 21 ({@damage 6d6}) lightning damage. On a successful save, the creature takes only half the damage, isn't knocked {@condition prone}, and is pushed 5 feet out of the panther's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead falls {@condition prone} in the panther's space.

action.name: Necrotic Drain
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) necrotic damage, or 13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) necrotic damage if the target can't see the lightthief.

action.name: Into the Light {@recharge}
entries: The lightthief teleports inside a light source they can see within 15 feet of them that is emitting bright or dim light. While inside the light source, the lightthief has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the light source. If the light source is extinguished by any means other than the lightthief's Steal Light action, the lightthief is forced out, appears in an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of the light source, and is {@condition paralyzed} until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Steal Light (Inside Light Source Only)
entries: The lightthief can cause the light they are inside to erupt in a burst of brilliant radiance. Each creature within 15 feet of the light source must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) radiant damage and loses any darkvision they have for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and doesn't lose their darkvision. After this, the light source extinguishes and the lightthief appears in an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of the light source.

trait.name: Limited Telepathy
entries: The likho can magically transmit simple messages and images to any creature within 120 feet of it that can understand a language. This form of telepathy doesn't allow the receiving creature to telepathically respond.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the likho moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the likho can make one Claw attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The likho has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The likho can use its Disruptive Gaze. It then makes four Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Disruptive Gaze
entries: One creature the likho can see within 60 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws until the end of its next turn.

name: Liminal Herald
languages: telepathy 120 ft. understands all languages but can't speak

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The liminal herald is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The liminal herald may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the liminal herald can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the liminal herald has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Alien Intellect
entries: The liminal herald is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the liminal herald's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The liminal herald makes two Eldritch Beam or contaminated touch attacks. It can also use Mind Scramble or Warp Call.

action.name: Contaminated Touch
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, one target within 5 ft. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} half damage only.

action.name: Eldritch Beam
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 120 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 3d6 + 2}) Force damage.

action.name: Mind Scramble {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} (creatures maintaining {@status Concentration|XPHB} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}). {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, or 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Psychic damage if the target is maintaining {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

action.name: Warp Call
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 13}, one creature the liminal herald can see within 90 feet. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the target is teleported into an unoccupied space the liminal herald can see within 60 feet. The chosen space must be on a surface or in a liquid that can support the target without the target having to squeeze.

bonus.name: Dimension Hop
entries: The liminal herald teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

reaction.name: Reflect Pain
entries: {@actTrigger} The liminal herald takes damage from an attack or spell that only targets it. {@actResponse} The attacker or spellcaster takes Psychic damage equal to the damage dealt by the triggering attack or spell.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The lindwurm can move across icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Sure-Footed Skater
entries: While the lindwurm is on snow or ice, it has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lindwurm makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. It can replace its Bite attack with one Constrict attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or contract a disease and be {@condition poisoned} until the disease is cured. At the end of each long rest, the diseased creature must repeat the saving throw. On a failure, the creature suffers one level of {@condition exhaustion} and doesn't regain expended Hit Dice from the rest. On a success, the creature's {@condition exhaustion} level decreases by one, and it regains expended Hit Dice as normal from the rest. If a successful saving throw reduces the diseased creature's level of {@condition exhaustion} below 1, the creature recovers from the disease, ending it.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the lindwurm can't Constrict another target.

trait.name: Disease Immunity
entries: The lindwyrm is immune to all nonmagical diseases.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the lindwyrm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lindwyrm makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws. The lindwyrm can substitute a swallow attack for one of its claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) piercing damage and the target must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a hit, the target is also {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the lindwyrm can't bite another target.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Swallow
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Huge or smaller creature the lindwyrm is grappling. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) piercing damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside the lindwyrm, and it takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) acid damage at the start of each of the lindwyrm's turns. The lindwyrm can have only one target swallowed at a time.

If the lindwyrm takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the lindwyrm must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of the lindwyrm. If the lindwyrm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Claw Attack
entries: The lindwyrm makes a claw attack.

legendary.name: Burrowing Rush (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The lindwyrm burrows its speed and comes up beneath a target touching the ground, making a bite attack. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Thorn-Covered
entries: If the Lion's Blume attempts to grapple a creature, the target takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage whether the grapple succeeds or not. While {@condition Grappled} by the Lion's Blume, the target takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Limited Amphibiousness
entries: The Lionfish King can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 12 hours to avoid suffocating.

trait.name: Lucky Fool (2/Day)
entries: When the Lionfish King would fail an ability check or miss with an attack roll by rolling a 5 or lower on the die, he can choose to replace the die roll with a 15 instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Lionfish King makes three attacks: one with his Chomp and two with his Cutlass.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Cutlass
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Poisonous Spray
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 15/30 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d12}) poison damage.

Whether the attack hits or misses, the target and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition Poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Royal Decree
entries: The Lionfish King commands a Fish Folk that can hear him to use its reaction to make an attack against a creature that he can see.

trait.name: Darkness Hypersensitivity
entries: The liosalfar takes 15 necrotic damage when it starts its turn in magical darkness. While in magical darkness, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

trait.name: Elemental Nature
entries: The liosalfar doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Inscrutable
entries: The liosalfar is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks made to ascertain the liosalfar's intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

trait.name: Light Form
entries: The liosalfar can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. In addition, it sheds bright light in a 10- to 30‑foot radius and dim light for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius. The liosalfar can alter the radius as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The liosalfar makes two Radiant Touch or Ray of Light attacks. If both Radiant Touch attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Radiant Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}29 ({@damage 4d10 + 7}) radiant damage.

action.name: Ray of Light
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 8} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}31 ({@damage 6d8 + 4}) radiant damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Mesmerizing Radiance
entries: The liosalfar causes the light radiating from its body to shift color and pattern in a spellbinding display. Each creature within 60 feet of the liosalfar and that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} until the display ends. The liosalfar must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue the display. It can stop the display at any time, and the display ends if the liosalfar is {@condition incapacitated}. While {@condition charmed} by the liosalfar's display, a creature is also {@condition incapacitated}, and its speed is reduced to 0, as it is transfixed by the display. The effect ends for a {@condition charmed} creature if it takes any damage or if someone uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.

trait.name: Exceptional Smell
entries: The bear has a +10 bonus to Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell, and they can smell creatures even through dirt, snow, and water.

trait.name: Natural Camouflage
entries: The bear has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made in their native terrain.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage, or maximum damage if the target is a Plant.

action.name: Swat
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing or bludgeoning damage (bear's choice), and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Agile Landing
entries: The wildcat takes no damage from falling 40 feet or less, provided they aren't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Hunter's Pounce
entries: If the wildcat hits a Small or smaller target and had advantage on the attack roll, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). While grappling the target in this way, the wildcat can't attack another creature.

trait.name: Natural Camouflage
entries: The wildcat has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made in their native terrain.

trait.name: Sprint (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: When the wildcat moves on their turn in combat, they can triple their speed until the end of their turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage, plus an extra 2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage if the target is {@condition grappled} or {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage, plus an extra 2 ({@damage 1d4}) slashing damage if the wildcat had advantage on the attack roll.

bonus.name: Sneak
entries: The wildcat takes the Hide action.

trait.name: Hazardous Fumes
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the ooze has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d4} Acid). While {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, the creature also has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition. While the creature remains within 10 feet of the ooze, the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition cannot be removed in any way.

trait.name: Liquid Form
entries: The ooze can squeeze through a space as narrow as 1 inch, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 10 ({@damage 4d4}) Acid damage. The ooze has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on ability checks it makes to initiate or escape a grapple.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze makes two Pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 10 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 4d4}) Acid damage.

hp.special: 70 (4d20 + 28) plus 70 per player character (4d20 + 28)

trait.name: Digestive Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn in the living city's space takes 10 ({@damage 4d4}) Acid damage. At the start of its turn, the living city decides whether its Digestive Aura is active until the start of its next turn (no action required).

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the living city remains motionless in its Structural Form, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary structure or vehicle, such as a house or a sailing ship.

trait.name: Structural Form
entries: The living city can spend 10 minutes in {@status Concentration|XPHB} to shape-shift into a Gargantuan structure or back into its true, amorphous form. Its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

While in the form of a structure, the living city takes up its entire space and creates floors, walls, doorways, and windows within its space which resemble and behave like normal structures, while leaving behind open space within it to create rooms. Creatures can pass through the open spaces and stop there as if moving through a normal structure.

The walls and floors of the living city can be damaged and thus breached. Each 5-foot-by-5-foot section has AC 15 and 30 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Reducing a section to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} destroys it and deals 30 damage to the living city. A living city can only take this damage once per turn.

In addition, the living city extrudes pieces of itself inside its space which resemble furnishings and everyday objects. The extrusions appear, feel, sound, and behave exactly like the mimicked objects. A thin, slimy tendril connects any furnishings or objects to the body of the living city. The tendril has AC 15 and 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}. If the tether is severed or destroyed, the simulacra melts into goo, but does no harm to the living city.

trait.name: No Exit
entries: When it rolls for {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, the living city reflexively closes the windows, doors, and other egress points on the outside of its body, preventing creatures inside it from leaving its space.

A creature in the living city's space that attempts to leave its space using teleportation or planar travel is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave cha} {@dc 20}. {@actSaveFail} 27 ({@damage 5d10}) Psychic damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The teleportation or planar travel fails.

action.name: The living city always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the living city can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the living city takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 0 ft. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Grasping Tendril
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed or pulled 10 feet (the living city's choice).

action.name: Haunting Whispers
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 15}, one creature in the living city's space. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition (save ends).

action.name: Shifting Form
entries: The living city alters the composition of a 10-foot-by-10-foot area inside it, creating walls, doors, windows, stairs, or furnishings. It can choose to make the area {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. Creatures inside the living city who are not directly observing the shift must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) check to notice the change.

If the living city creates a wall that cuts through another creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (the living city's choice). If a creature would be surrounded on all sides by the wall (or the wall and another solid surface), that creature can make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a success, it can use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to its speed so that it is no longer enclosed by the wall.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The living city chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The living city can use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

trait.name: Fog Form
entries: The Living Deep Haze can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Deep Haze
entries: A creature who enters or starts its turn in the same space as the Living Deep Haze must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage and gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Living Deep Haze makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Fog Form
entries: The elemental can enter a {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

trait.name: Deep Haze
entries: A creature that enters the same space as the elemental or starts its turn there is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 13}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage.

name: Living Wick
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The living wick doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Wick-Powered
entries: The living wick is inactive and {@condition unconscious} while its wick is unlit. When its wick is lit, it obeys the commands of the creature that lit the wick, and it sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The living wick's hp maximum is reduced by 2 ({@dice 1d4}) for every 24 hours it remains lit and active, and no effect short of a {@spell wish} spell can remove this reduction. The living wick dies when its hp maximum is reduced to 0.

A creature grappling the active living wick can take its action to extinguish the wick by succeeding on a {@dc 12} Dexterity check. A creature within 5 feet of a living wick that is dormant from an unlit wick can take an action to light the wick, gaining command of the living wick.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Consuming Inferno
entries: The living wick's controller can command the living wick to rapidly burn through the remains of its wick, creating a devastating ball of fire. Each creature within 20 feet of the living wick must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Flammable objects in the area and that aren't being worn or carried ignite. The living wick then dies, becoming a lifeless puddle of wax.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The bloodeye can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bloodeye makes one Bite or one Bola attack and uses Bloodeye Bolt or Mesmeric Lure, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Bola
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition restrained} by the bola. A creature can use their action to make a {@dc 10} Strength check, freeing themself or another creature within their reach from the bola on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the bola (AC 10) destroys it and frees a creature {@condition restrained} by it without harming them.

action.name: Bloodeye Bolt (3/Day)
entries: The bloodeye shoots blood from their eyes at one creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Mesmeric Lure (3/Day)
entries: The bloodeye hypnotically stares at one creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or all creatures other than the bloodeye are {@condition invisible} to them until the end of the bloodeye's next turn.

reaction.name: Reptilian Escape (1/Day)
entries: If the bloodeye fails a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, they lose their tail and succeed instead. They regrow their tail when they finish a long rest.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The bloodeye can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Servant Senses
entries: Ithu'rath can sense anything the bloodeye senses, and Ithu'rath can speak through their body.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bloodeye makes one Bite or one Bola attack and uses Bloodeye Bolt or Mesmeric Lure, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Bola
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition restrained} by the bola. A creature can use their action to make a {@dc 10} Strength check, freeing themself or another creature within their reach from the bola on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the bola (AC 10) destroys it and frees a creature {@condition restrained} by it without harming them.

action.name: Bloodeye Bolt (3/Day)
entries: The bloodeye shoots blood from their eyes at one creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Mesmeric Lure (3/Day)
entries: The bloodeye hypnotically stares at one creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or all creatures other than the bloodeye are {@condition invisible} to them until the end of the bloodeye's next turn.

reaction.name: Reptilian Escape (1/Day)
entries: If the bloodeye fails a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, they lose their tail and succeed instead. They regrow their tail when they finish a long rest.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The grunt can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the grunt takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the grunt takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Bite (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} by each grunt who joined the attack (escape {@dc 10} plus the number of grunts grappling; on a success, the target escapes every grunt grappling them). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the grunts who joined the attack can't bite another target.

action.name: Javelin (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage.

hp.special: Eight times their level (number of d10 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Greatsword)
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 2d6 plus PB} slashing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the hunter can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Wrenching Bite (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the hunter makes a signature attack against a Large or smaller creature. On a hit, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}). Until the grapple ends, the target takes PB piercing damage at the end of each of their turns, and the hunter can't use their Wrenching Bite against another target.

action.name: 5th Level: Thrashing Tail (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the hunter makes a signature attack against a Large or smaller creature. On a hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. While the hunter is within 5 feet of this {@condition prone} target, the target can't stand up unless they use an action to make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the target can stand up.

action.name: 7th Level: Hypnotic Sleep (1/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the hunter drones lullingly. Each creature within 5 feet of the hunter who can hear them must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute. An {@condition unconscious} target wakes up if they take damage, the hunter becomes {@condition incapacitated}, the hunter moves more than 5 feet away from the target, or another creature uses an action to rouse the target.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The scaletooth can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scaletooth makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the scaletooth can move them 5 feet in any direction or grapple them (escape {@dc 12}). Until this grapple ends, the scaletooth can't make a Tail attack against another target.

action.name: Rending Bite
entries: The scaletooth makes a Bite attack with advantage against one creature they have {@condition grappled}, dealing an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage on a hit.

reaction.name: Reptilian Escape (1/Day)
entries: If the scaletooth fails a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, they lose their tail and succeed instead. They regrow their tail when they finish a long rest.

trait.name: Aerial Agility
entries: While the terrorsaur is flying, their AC is 16.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The terrorsaur can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Running Start
entries: The terrorsaur can use only their flying speed if they first either fall 10 feet without hitting the ground or walk 10 feet in a straight line on that turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The terrorsaur makes one Bite attack and one Glaive attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Glaive
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Blowgun {@recharge}
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one creature. {@h}1 piercing damage plus 17 ({@damage 5d6}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

reaction.name: Reptilian Escape (1/Day)
entries: If the terrorsaur fails a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, they lose their tail and succeed instead. They regrow their tail when they finish a long rest.

reaction.name: Skulking Retreat
entries: If the terrorsaur takes damage from a melee attack, they can move up to half their speed.

trait.name: Deadly Sharpshooter
entries: Attacking at long range with a ranged weapon doesn't impose disadvantage on Llyvessa's attack rolls.

trait.name: Elf Glamour (1/Day)
entries: When a creature targets Llyvessa with an attack, power, or spell, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by her until the end of her next turn (no action required).

trait.name: Mind Link
entries: Llyvessa can communicate telepathically with any Amethyst Knife boss regardless of distance, provided they are on the same plane of existence.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Llyvessa makes two Scimitar or Longbow attacks. Alternatively, she makes one Longbow attack and uses Psychic Shot, if available.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d6 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Psychic Shot {@recharge 5}
entries: Llyvessa makes a Longbow attack that ignores cover, and which can pass through mundane solid objects up to 5 feet thick that aren't being worn or carried.

bonus.name: Jaunt (1/Day; 3rd-Order Power)
entries: Llyvessa or one willing creature within 5 feet of her teleports to an unoccupied space Llyvessa can see within 30 feet of her.

reaction.name: *Control Projectiles (3/Day; 2nd-Order Power)
entries: When a creature Llyvessa can see within 60 feet of her makes a ranged weapon attack, she gives the creature advantage or disadvantage on the attack roll (her choice).

reaction.name: Shared Condition
entries: When Llyvessa is {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, or {@condition stunned}, she chooses a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 feet of her who doesn't already have the condition or is immune to it. The chosen creature then gains the condition for the duration, and Llyvessa loses the condition. She can use this reaction even while {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Digestive Enzymes
entries: The gag fly has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against a {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} target.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The gag fly can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Proboscis
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Acid Spray {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 2d4} Acid). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Bloat Burst
entries: {@actTrigger} The gag fly is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or takes damage from a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}. {@actResponse d}{@actSave dex} {@dc 12}, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the gag fly. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 2d4} Acid).

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The lob frog's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Poison Skin
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the lob frog hits it with a melee attack, that creature takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Distracted|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

action.name: Throw Frogspawn
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 30/60 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage. If the target is a creature, the egg sticks to the target's body, melding with its flesh. A creature within 5 feet of the egg can take an action to remove the egg, dealing 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage to the target in the process. If the egg is still attached to the target at the end of its next turn, the target is infected with a disease and has the {@condition Sickened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the disease ends. The disease can't be cured except by magic.

Every hour, the target is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels gained in this way can't be removed until the disease is cured. If the target suffers a Monstrous Transformation, it dies and its flesh falls away, birthing a Lob Frog.

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever Logger is subjected to lightning damage, they take no damage and instead regain a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Logger makes two Slam attacks. If they are in a fury (see Nature's Fury), they instead make three Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Entangling Vines
entries: Vines lash out from Logger's body.

Each enemy within 30 feet of them must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 1d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}) and pulled up to 30 feet directly toward Logger.

bonus.name: Nature's Fury (1/Day)
entries: Logger enters a fury for 1 minute.

While in a fury, Logger has advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, and they can make an extra Slam attack when they use Multiattack. If Logger ends their turn without damaging another creature on that turn, the fury ends early.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Elias Drexel is a 20th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks). He knows the following ranger spells:

spells: {@spell tree stride} (works on buildings instead of trees)

trait.name: Survivor
entries: At the start of each of his turns, Elias Drexel regains 10 hit points if he has no more than half of his hit points left. He does not gain this benefit if he has 0 hit points.

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when Elias Drexel hits with it (included in the attack).

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Elias Drexel fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Elias Drexel wields a {@item +3 Longsword}, wears a {@item +3 breastplate} and the {@item Lord Commander's Badge|DungeonsDrakkenheim}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Elias Drexel uses Leadership. He then makes four attacks with either his longsword or his longbow.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Leadership (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: For 1 minute, Elias Drexel can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that he can see within 120 feet of him makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature can add a {@dice d4} to its roll provided it can hear and understand Elias Drexel. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if Elias Drexel is {@condition incapacitated}.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Elias Drexel adds 5 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, Elias Drexel must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: Elias Drexel makes one weapon attack.

legendary.name: Command
entries: Elias Drexel chooses one ally he can see. If that ally can see and hear him, that ally can make one weapon attack as a reaction and gains advantage on the attack roll. The attack deals an extra 10 {@damage 3d6} damage on a hit.

hp.special: 85 (10d8 + 40) plus 85 (10d8 + 40) per player character

trait.name: Intimidating Aura
entries: Elias projects a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of imposing command. An ally that start its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the first attack roll it makes before the start of its next turn. A {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature that starts its turn in the Emenation takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Thunder damage and is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to Elias's Intimidating Aura for 24 hours.

action.name: Elias always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On his turn, Elias can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Elias takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Lord Commander's Blade
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 5 ft. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) Slashing damage, and Elias can apply one of the following martial masteries to the target:

items.name: Wound
entries: The target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d4}).

items.name: Topple
entries: The target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Sap
entries: The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll it makes before the start of start of Elias's next turn.

items.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 12}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) Piercing damage, and Elias can apply one of the following martial masteries to the target:

items.name: Push
entries: If the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed up to 10 feet away from Elias.

items.name: Slow
entries: The target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dc 15} Constitution save ends).

action.name: Command
entries: Elias chooses one ally he can see. If the ally can see and hear him, it can use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make one weapon attack with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}. On a hit, the attack deals an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage.

action.name: Flare (1/Round)
entries: Elias chooses a point he can see within 60 feet and fires at flare at it, signaling the Hooded Lantern's bombardment. Elias recharges his Artillery Strike. He can only use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} if it's the first {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} he has taken this round.

action.name: Artillery Strike (Recharge Special)
entries: Elias can only use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} if it's the last {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} he takes this round. {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 20-foot radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on the point Elias chose with his Flare {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: Elias chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. Elias can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When Erasmus makes an attack, he has advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Master Tactician
entries: At the start of a combat encounter, Erasmus chooses when he acts in the initiative order after all other creatures have rolled initiative.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Erasmus makes two Greatsword attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of I'm Right Here.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, they have disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than Erasmus until the end of their next turn.

action.name: I'm Right Here
entries: Erasmus taunts a creature he can see within 5 feet of him who can hear him. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to attack Erasmus. If the creature attacks, an ally within 30 feet of Erasmus who isn't {@condition incapacitated} can make a weapon attack against the creature (no action required).

action.name: Iron Ring (2/Day)
entries: If not in the Cyst, Erasmus teleports to the Cyst. If in the Cyst, he teleports to a place he has visited.

bonus.name: Mark
entries: Erasmus chooses a creature he can see within 60 feet of him and marks them until the start of his next turn. The first time one of Erasmus's allies deals damage to a marked creature on each turn, the creature takes an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage.

bonus.name: Reposition
entries: Erasmus and each ally within 60 feet of him who can hear him moves up to 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Lord of the Feast fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The Lord of the Feast regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point remaining.

trait.name: Close-Quarters Hunter
entries: Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on the Lord of the Feast's ranged attack rolls.

trait.name: Predatory Senses
entries: The Lord of the Feast has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks. He can pinpoint the position of any creature within 120 feet of him that is {@condition invisible}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Lord of the Feast makes three attacks: either one with each of its different arrow attacks, or one with his bite and two with his claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) piercing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage. A target hit by this attack must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft, one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Contaminating Arrow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage. A target hit by this attack must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.

action.name: Ensnaring Arrow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or become {@condition restrained} in a magical snare for 1 minute. A {@condition restrained} target can use its action to repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Harpoon Arrow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it must succeed on {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 20 feet directly toward the Lord of the Feast.

legendary.name: Dash
entries: The Lord of the Feast moves his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Arrow (Costs 2 actions)
entries: The Lord of the Feast makes one arrow attack of his choice.

legendary.name: Call of the Hunt (costs 3 actions)
entries: The Lord of the Feast releases a blood-curdling howl which can be heard all across Drakkenheim. Garmyr within 60 feet who can see and hear the Lord of the Feast can use their reaction to move up to half their speed and make one melee or ranged attack with advantage.

hp.special: 66 (7d10 + 28) plus 66 (7d10 + 28) per player character

trait.name: Aura of Hunger
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the Lord of the Feast takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Close-Quarters Hunter
entries: Being within 5 feet of a {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature doesn't impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the Lord of the Feast's ranged attack rolls.

trait.name: Hunter's Sense
entries: The Lord of the Feast has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against a {@status Bloodied|XPHB} creature.

trait.name: Predatory Senses
entries: The Lord of the Feast has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks. He can pinpoint the position of any creature within 120 feet of him with the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The Lord of the Feast regains 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} remaining.

action.name: The Lord of the Feast always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the Lord of the Feast can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Lord of the Feast takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

items.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 10 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Slashing damage, and the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d4}).

items.name: Poison Arrow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 9}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Poison damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition (save ends).

items.name: Ensnaring Arrow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 9}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition ({@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw ends).

items.name: Harpoon Arrow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 9}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Piercing damage, and if the target is Huge or smaller, it is pulled up to 20 feet toward the Lord of the Feast.

action.name: Reposition
entries: The Lord of the Feast moves up to his {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

action.name: Call of the Hunt (1/Round)
entries: The Lord of the Feast releases a blood-curdling howl that can be heard all across Drakkenheim. All garmyr in the city heed this call and rush towards the Lord of the Feast's current position. Each garmyr within 60 feet who can see and hear the Lord of the Feast can use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and make one melee or ranged attack with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The Lord of the Feast chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. The Lord of the Feast can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks not made with cold iron weapons

trait.name: Huntsman's Weapons
entries: The Lord of the Hunt's weapon attacks are magical. When he hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Lord of the Hunt fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Sure Seat
entries: While mounted and not {@condition incapacitated}, the Lord of the Hunt can't be knocked {@condition prone}, dismounted, or moved against his will.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Lord of the Hunt makes three Spear or Longbow attacks.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage, or 9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) piercing damage if used in two hands, plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage. If the Lord of the Hunt throws the spear, the spear teleports up to 120 feet to the Lord of the Hunt's hand at the start of his next turn. If he has no hand free, the spear teleports to the ground at his feet.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Hunter's Quarry
entries: The Lord of the Hunt magically calls {@dice 3d6} elk or boars, {@dice 1d4} giant boars or giant elk, or 1 elephant. The called Beasts arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of the Lord and obeying its spoken commands. The Beasts remain for 1 hour, until the Lord dies, or until the Lord dismisses them as a bonus action. The Lord can have any number of Beasts under its control at one time provided the combined total CR of the Beasts is no higher than 8.

bonus.name: Fey Mount
entries: The Lord of the Hunt can summon or dismiss a magical Fey mount, mounting or dismounting it as part of this bonus action without spending movement. The mount uses the statistics of a warhorse, except it has 40 hp, is a Fey, has the same damage and condition resistances and immunities as the Lord of the Hunt, and uses the Lord's saving throw bonuses in place of its own. If the mount is slain, it disappears, leaving behind no physical form, and the Lord of the Hunt must wait 1 hour before summoning the mount again.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The Lord of the Hunt increases his AC by 6 against one attack that would hit him. To do so, he must see the attacker and must be wielding a melee weapon.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The Lord of the Hunt makes one Spear or Longbow attack.

legendary.name: Tenacious Stride
entries: The Lord of the Hunt moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If he is mounted, he can force the mount to move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks instead.

legendary.name: Call to the Hunt (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Lord of the Hunt blows his hunting horn and chooses one creature he can see within 60 feet. If the creature can hear the horn, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the Lord of the Hunt for 8 hours. The {@condition charmed} target obeys the Lord's verbal commands. If the target suffers any harm or receives a suicidal command, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. If the target successfully saves against the effect, or if the effect on it ends, the target is immune to the Lord's Call to the Hunt for the next 24 hours. The Lord can have only one target {@condition charmed} at a time. If he charms another, the effect on the previous target ends.

name: Lord Syuul

trait.name: Draw In
entries: If Lord Syuul fails a saving throw while grappling at least one enemy, he can choose to release all {@condition grappled} creatures and succeed on the saving throw instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lord Syuul makes two Tentacle or two Psionic Repeater attacks then manifests a power or uses Memory Transfer.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) psychic damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}).

action.name: Psionic Repeater
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 11} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) force damage.

action.name: Brain Overload (1/Day; 6th-Order Power)
entries: Lord Syuul creates a sudden surge of energy in the mind of a creature he can see within 120 feet of him. The target must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw, taking 77 ({@damage 14d10}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target has a brain and is reduced to 0 hit points, their brain explodes, and if they can't survive without their brain, they die.

action.name: Flay (6th-Order Power)
entries: Lord Syuul shoots a 15-foot cone of psionic energy from his eyes. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 19} Intelligence saving throw, taking 35 ({@damage 10d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Memory Transfer
entries: Lord Syuul psionically plunders the mind of each creature he is grappling. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Intelligence saving throw or take 44 ({@damage 8d10}) psychic damage. If a target fails their saving throw and doesn't escape the grapple by the end of their next turn, they must choose one of these effects:

items: The target's proficiency bonus drops to 0, they can't form new thoughts or speak, and they have disadvantage on all ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. Only the {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power, a {@spell lesser restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect can end this effect. Additionally, until Lord Syuul finishes a long rest, he gains a cumulative +5 bonus to damage rolls.

The target is {@condition charmed} by Lord Syuul for 1 hour. While the target is {@condition charmed}, Lord Syuul can issue the target telepathic commands (no action required), which the target does their best to obey. Each time the target takes damage, they can make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Guise (3rd-Order Power)
entries: Lord Syuul projects a psionic image over his body, transforming his appearance for 1 hour into that of a Medium creature he has seen. When he manifests this power, he can also change the appearance of any equipment he carries.

The changes wrought by this power fail to hold up to physical inspection. A creature can use an action to inspect Lord Syuul's appearance and make a {@dc 19} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check, noticing the image is a projection on a success.

bonus.name: Grappling Jaunt
entries: Lord Syuul and each creature {@condition grappled} by him teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

reaction.name: Brain Drain
entries: When a creature {@condition grappled} by Lord Syuul makes a saving throw against Memory Transfer, Lord Syuul momentarily weakens the creature and the creature has disadvantage on the saving throw.

legendaryHeader: Lord Syuul has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Mindblind
entries: Each enemy Lord Syuul can see within 60 feet of him must make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature can't see creatures other than Lord Syuul for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

legendary.name: Action 2: Was I Ever Here?
entries: Lord Syuul becomes {@condition invisible}, teleports 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see, and can take the Hide action. At the same time, an illusory psionic image of Lord Syuul appears in the space he left, gesturing, speaking, and behaving as he chooses (no action required). A creature who touches the image for the first time on a turn or makes a melee attack against it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage because things can pass through it. Lord Syuul's invisibility ends and his image disappears at the end of his next turn.

legendary.name: Action 3: Mindshatter
entries: Each enemy Lord Syuul can see within 60 feet of him must make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) psychic damage and is {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}.

trait.name: Alluring Presence
entries: When a Humanoid that can see the lorelei starts its turn within 30 feet of the lorelei, the lorelei can force it to make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw if the lorelei isn't {@condition incapacitated} and can see the Humanoid. On a failed save, the Humanoid is {@condition charmed} until the start if its next turn. While {@condition charmed}, the target is {@condition incapacitated} and must move on its turn toward the lorelei by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet of the lorelei for a kiss from her. The Humanoid doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage, the Humanoid can repeat the saving throw. If the saving throw is successful, the effect ends for it, and it regains its senses for the remainder of its turn.

Unless surprised, a Humanoid can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the Humanoid does so, it can't see the lorelei until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the Humanoid looks at the lorelei in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The lorelei can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Free Water Spirit
entries: While in contact with water, the lorelei ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce her speed or cause her to be {@condition restrained}. In addition, she can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being {@condition grappled}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lorelei can use her Stunning Glance. She then makes three Psychic Blast attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Corrupted Kiss.

action.name: Corrupted Kiss
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is {@condition incapacitated} or {@condition restrained}. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) necrotic damage, and the lorelei regains hp equal to that amount.

action.name: Psychic Blast
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) psychic damage.

action.name: Stunning Glance
entries: The lorelei sends a seductive glance at a creature she can see within 30 feet of her. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature is immune to this lorelei's Stunning Glance for the next 24 hours.

name: Lothrem, the Wreathed Dragon

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If Lothrem fails a saving throw, they can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Nature's Restoration
entries: Lothrem regains 10 hit points at the start of their turn if they have at least 1 hit point. If they are in sunlight, they instead regain 20 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lothrem can use their Frightful Presence. They then make three attacks: one with their bite and two with their claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) piercing damage, plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) lightning damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d8 + 8}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of Lothrem's choice that is within 120 feet of Lothrem and aware of them must succeed on a {@dc 23} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Lothrem's Frightful Presense for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Ensnaring Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Lothrem exhales enriching breath on the ground in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide, causing a thick wall of tangled, thorny brush to magically grow in the area. The wall is 20 feet high and blocks line of sight. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 25} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 63 ({@damage 14d8}) piercing damage and is {@condition restrained} in the wall. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition restrained}.

The wall remains until the end of Lothrem's next turn, at which point it withers and disappears. A creature {@condition restrained} in the wall or one that is within 5 feet of the creature can use its action to make a {@dc 19} Strength check, freeing the creature on a success. For the duration, the area is {@quickref difficult terrain||3}, and when a creature moves into or within the area, it takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

action.name: Change Shape
entries: Lothrem magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than their own, or back into their true form. Lothrem reverts to their true form if they die. Any equipment Lothrem is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (Lothrem's choice).

In a new form, Lothrem retains their own alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Lothrem's statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except and class features or legendary actions of that form.

legendaryHeader: The dragon can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Lothrem regains spent legendary actions at the start of their turn.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: Lothrem makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: Lothrem makes a tail attack

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Lothrem beats their wings. Each creature within 10 feet of Lothrem must succeed on a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw or take 15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. Lothrem can then fly up to half their flying speed.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the loxoda moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Slam attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the loxoda can make one Stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The loxoda makes one Slam attack and one Spear attack.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) piercing damage, or 17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone} creature. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tooth-Rattling Pound {@recharge 5}
entries: The loxoda rears up and lands heavily, rattling the land and creatures around it. Each creature in contact with the ground within 20 feet of the loxoda must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 36 ({@damage 8d8}) bludgeoning damage and takes an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) thunder damage at the end of its next turn as the shock waves from the Tooth-Rattling Pound continue up through its body. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and doesn't take extra thunder damage from shock waves.

trait.name: Evasive
entries: Lucas adds his Intelligence modifier as a bonus to Dexterity saving throws (already included in the stat block).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lucas makes two rapier attacks and one bite attack. Or Lucas makes two ranged attacks with his twinshot hand crossbow.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Twinshot Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/90 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage. This special hand crossbow can be fired twice before it needs to be reloaded.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Lucas adds 2 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, Lucas must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

name: Lucky
languages: can understand Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Lucky can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. Lucky can't glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

trait.name: Talons
entries: Lucky has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface his talons could reasonably grip.

trait.name: Assassinate
entries: During his first turn, Lucky has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit Lucky scores against a {@status surprised} creature is a critical hit.

trait.name: Fortunate Insight (3/Day)
