entries: The mage casts {@spell Counterspell|XPHB} in response to that spell's trigger, using the spellcasting ability from Spellcasting.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mavka casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

trait.name: Mounted Warrior
entries: While the mavka is mounted, her mount can't be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Nightmare Mount
entries: The mavka has formed a bond with a nightmare. The nightmare acts as a controlled mount while carrying the mavka, obeying the mavka's spoken commands. Mounting and dismounting the nightmare costs the mavka only 5 feet of movement.

trait.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: The mavka takes 20 radiant damage when she starts her turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, she has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The mavka doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mavka makes two Enervating Slam attacks or three Necrotic Bolt attacks. If she is riding a nightmare, the nightmare can then make one Hooves attack. If both Enervating Slam attacks hit one creature, the mavka regains hp equal to the total necrotic damage dealt by both attacks.

action.name: Enervating Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 16 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Necrotic Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 8} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d10 + 4}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Flame Burst {@recharge 5}
entries: While riding a nightmare, the mavka channels her power into her mount, causing its fiery light to burn those nearby. Each creature within 20 feet of the mavka must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 ({@damage 12d8}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The maw vermin has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The maw vermin makes one Bite attack and three Claw attacks, and it can use Grasping Maw or Glob Launcher.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) Piercing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is swallowed. A swallowed creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, and has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} from effects originating outside the maw vermin. At the start of each of the maw vermin's turns, a swallowed creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or gain one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

The maw vermin can swallow up to three creatures at a time. If the maw vermin takes 20+ damage in a single turn from a creature inside it, the maw vermin must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which land in spaces within 10 feet of the maw vermin with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. If the maw vermin dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) Slashing damage, and if the target is Huge or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}). Until the grapple ends, the maw vermin can't use this Claw on another target. The maw vermin has three Claws.

action.name: Grasping Maw
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 18}, one Medium or smaller creature the maw vermin can see within 15 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the maw vermin.

action.name: Glob Launcher
entries: The maw vermin coats a swallowed creature in acidic goo and launches it at a point within 120 feet of it. {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}, each creature within 10 feet of the launched creature as it lands (the launched creature automatically fails). {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d6} Acid). While {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The mbielu can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

trait.name: Toxic Skin
entries: A creature that touches the mbielu or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage and must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature has disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws as it experiences mild hallucinations. The {@condition poisoned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Rumbling Bellow {@recharge 5}
entries: The mbielu releases a deep bellow that vibrates within the bodies of those nearby. Each creature within 15 feet of the mbielu must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If a creature {@condition poisoned} by the mbielu's Toxic Skin fails this saving throw, it is also {@condition incapacitated} until the end of its next turn as the combined vibrations and hallucinations disorient it.

trait.name: Helpful-ish
entries: The mechakobold desires to help other creatures on their ability checks and will always try to take the Help action in non-combat situations. However, if the check on which the mechakobold helps is a failure, the consequences are always catastrophic (GM's discretion).

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the mechakobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Slingshot
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tie Laces
entries: The mechakobold attempts to tie together the lower limbs of a creature within 5 feet of it using a pair of spare laces. It makes a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand|PHB}) check contested by the target's Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|PHB}) or Strength ({@skill Athletics|PHB}) check. On a success, the target's walking and climbing speeds are halved until it unties its laces as an action, or cuts them with an attack with a slashing weapon.

spellcasting.name: Touched
headerEntries: Medi knows the {@spell mending} cantrip. Charisma is his spellcasting ability for this cantrip.

trait.name: Fated (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: Medi can choose to reroll any attack, skill check, or saving throw.

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Medi can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. Medi can't glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

trait.name: Resilience
entries: Medi has advantage on saving throws against poison.

trait.name: Wing Flap
entries: As a bonus action, Medi can use his powerful feathered arms to propel himself upward up to half his movement speed. Medi can use this in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

action.name: Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Triage (Recharges on a Short or Long Rest)
entries: Medi restores 4 {@dice 1d4 + 2} hit points to a creature other than himself.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The medusa uses Stone Gaze and makes two attacks using Snake Bite, Heavy Crossbow, or both.

action.name: Snake Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of the medusa's next turn.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Stone Gaze
entries: The medusa fires energy beams from their eyes at up to three creatures they can see within 60 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or begin turning to stone (save ends at end of turn). While turning to stone, a creature's speed is reduced by 10 feet and they have disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saving throws.

If a creature who is turning to stone is targeted by this action again and fails their save, their speed is reduced by another 10 feet and they are {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the effect ends.

If a creature who is turning to stone and {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} in this way is targeted by this action again and fails their save, they are {@condition petrified} and can no longer make saving throws to end the effects of Stone Gaze. The petrification lasts until the creature is restored by a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power of 4th order or higher, a {@spell greater restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect.

bonus.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The medusa takes the Disengage or Hide action.

hp.special: Seven times their level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Snake Bite)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d10 plus PB} piercing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the headstrong can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Snake Spit (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the headstrong spits venom at the eyes of a creature within 5 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of their next turn.

action.name: 5th Level: Venomous Bite (3/Day)
entries: When the headstrong hits a creature with a signature attack, the headstrong injects the target with venom. The target must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage PBd6} poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} until the start of the headstrong's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}.

action.name: 7th Level: Stone Gaze (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the headstrong fires energy beams from their eyes at a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Constitution saving throw or begin to turn to stone and be {@condition restrained}.

A target {@condition restrained} in this way must repeat the saving throw at the end of their next turn. On a successful save, the effect ends. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition petrified} for 1 hour or until they are restored by a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power of 4th order or higher, a {@spell greater restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect.

spellcasting.name: Etherealness
headerEntries: The meld cast the {@spell Etherealness|XPHB} spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability. The meld is visible on the Material Plane while on the Border Ethereal and vice versa, but it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The meld can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane and vice versa.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The meld can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object. The meld can also interact with any liquid surface as if it was solid ground.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The meld makes four Withering Slam attacks. It can replace two attacks with a use of Conflicted Soul.

action.name: Withering Slam
entries: {@atk m} +7, reach 10 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Conflicted Soul
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 14}, one creature the meld can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target suffers the effect of the {@spell Confusion|XPHB} spell (no {@status Concentration|XPHB} required to maintain the spell).

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the memory thief has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Unseelie Blessing
entries: The memory thief has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put them to sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The memory thief makes two Shortsword attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Stolen Spell
entries: The memory thief casts a spell it has stolen, using its Perfect Copy reaction, by making an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check with advantage (DC equal to 10 + the level of the spell). The memory thief retains the spell on a failed check. Their innate spellcasting ability score is Charisma (save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks).

bonus.name: Steal Memory
entries: The memory thief attempts to steal a memory from one creature they can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, or it temporarily loses one precious memory. The target has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, or saving throws (memory thief's choice) until the end of its next turn. If the target is a spellcaster that fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it loses one random spell slot of 3rd level or lower until it finishes a long rest.

reaction.name: Perfect Copy
entries: Immediately after a creature casts a spell that targets the memory thief or includes them in its area of effect, the memory thief can force the creature to make a {@dc 15} saving throw with its spellcasting ability modifier. On a failed save, the memory thief negates the spell's effects and steals the knowledge of the spell. The memory thief knows the spell and can cast it using the Stolen Spell action. The memory thief forgets the spell after they cast it or after 8 hours have passed. They can only retain one spell at a time using this ability. The target can't cast stolen spells until it finishes a long rest.

trait.name: Trader's Eye
entries: The merchant has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) checks to determine if goods are of poor quality or a forgery, and it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks to recognize when a creature is attempting to sell it poor quality or forged goods.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chosen makes two attacks, using Shortsword or Quip in any combination.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Quip
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Psychic damage.

bonus.name: Best Bargain
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 13} A creature the merchant can see within 30 feet of it. {@actSaveFail} The target is {@condition Charmed|XPHB} until the start of the merchant's next turn.

reaction.name: Call for Aid (1/day)
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature hits the merchant with an attack while in a populated area. {@actResponse} On {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count 20 of the following round, {@dice 1d4} {@creature Bandit|XPHB|bandits} or {@dice 1d4} {@creature Guard|XPHB|guards} (the merchant's choice) arrive, acting as allies of the merchant and defending it to the best of their abilities. The called allies remain for 1 hour, until the merchant dies, or until the merchant dismisses them as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

trait.name: Trader's Eye
entries: The merchant has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) checks to determine if goods are of poor quality or a forgery, and it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks to recognize when a creature is attempting to sell it poor quality or forged goods.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The merchant captain casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The merchant captain makes four attacks, using Shortsword or Quip in any combination.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Quip
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) Psychic damage.

bonus.name: Fast Talk
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 15} A creature the merchant captain can see within 30 feet of it. {@actSaveFail} The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll or save it makes before the start of the merchant captain's next turn.

reaction.name: Banter (4/day)
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature within 30 feet of the merchant captain fails an attack roll, ability check or saving throw. {@actResponse} The creature rerolls the triggering roll and must use the new result.

name: Merchant Lord
languages: plus up to three other languages

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The merchant is a 7th-level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 14}). They know the following bard spells:

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Magic Coin
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}1 bludgeoning damage plus 13 ({@damage 2d12}) thunder damage.

action.name: Money Talks (4/Day)
entries: The merchant enchants a coin in its hand with divination magic, which lasts for 10 minutes or until the merchant ends the effect early (no action required). For the duration, a creature holding the coin that knows at least one language can understand the meaning of any word the merchant speaks, and when the merchant speaks, that creature understands what the merchant says.

Alternatively, the merchant can use an action to see and hear through the enchanted coin until the start of its next turn, using its own senses as if it were in the coin's space. During this time, the merchant is {@condition deafened|PHB|deaf} and {@condition blinded|PHB|blind} with regard to its own senses.

reaction.name: Chance {@recharge 4}
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of the merchant makes an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, the merchant flips a coin. If it's heads, the creature can roll a {@dice d8} and add the number rolled to the {@dice d20}. If it's tails, one random creature within 60 feet of the merchant gains a {@dice d8}, which it can roll and add to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Merchant of Misthaven casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 21}):

trait.name: I Never Agreed To This (3/Day)
entries: If the Merchant of Misthaven fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead. If the effect was caused by a creature, that creature becomes the new target of the effect and must make a saving throw themselves using the same DC.

trait.name: Let Me See What You Have There
entries: Whenever a creature within 60 feet of the Merchant of Misthaven activates or consumes a magic item of Uncommon or greater rarity or attacks with a magic weapon of Uncommon or greater rarity, the Merchant can teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the user. The Merchant teleports after the attack or the effects of the magic item are resolved.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Merchant has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Merchant's Guile
entries: The Merchant adds her Charisma modifier to her {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}.

trait.name: Thelanian Protagonist
entries: The Merchant of Misthaven cannot be permanently killed. If reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, she collapses into a pile of 777 gold coins. The Merchant reforms in her domain {@dice 1d4} days later, and the coins transform into wooden discs at the same time.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Merchant makes two attacks with her Poisoned Dagger and uses Free Samples.

action.name: Poisoned Dagger
entries: {@atkr m} +10 , reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Free Samples
entries: The Merchant of Misthaven reaches into her bag of tricks and produces a random effect as follows:
{@dice 1d4} Effect

action.name: 1 Exploding Trinket
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 21}, each creature in a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point the Merchant can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 17 ({@damage 5d6}) Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: 2 Regrettable Collectable
entries: The Merchant casts {@spell Summon Fiend|XPHB}, requiring no components. She does not have to concentrate to maintain the spell. The creature disappears after 1 minute, when the Merchant moves more than 100 feet away from it, or when the Merchant dies.

action.name: 3 New Toy
entries: The Merchant casts {@spell Summon Construct|XPHB}, requiring no components. She does not have to concentrate to maintain the spell.
The creature disappears after 1 minute, when the Merchant moves more than 100 feet away from it, or when the Merchant dies.

action.name: 4 Otherworldly Puzzle
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 21}, each creature in a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point the Merchant can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage and the target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. The target can make a {@dc 21} Intelligence (any gaming set) check at the start of its turn to end the effect early.

action.name: Illusory Appearance
entries: The Merchant covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like another creature of her general size and humanoid shape. The illusion ends if the Merchant takes a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to end it or if she dies. A creature must take an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a {@dc 21} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check to discern that the Merchant is disguised.

legendary.name: Sudden Strike
entries: The Merchant makes an attack with her Poisoned Dagger.

legendary.name: A Fair Deal
entries: The Merchant demands an exchange with one creature that she can see within 120 feet. That creature can either regain a spell slot of up to 3rd level, or regain 10, 20, or 30 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. For each spell slot level or every 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} the target gains, the Merchant also regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

legendary.name: Awful Choices (2 Legendary Actions)
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 21}, one creature that can hear the Merchant. {@actSaveFail} The target must choose two creatures it can see that are friendly with it. One of those creatures (target's choice) takes 19 ({@damage 3d12}) Necrotic damage, and the other has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The merfolk casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The merfolk can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Summon Storm
entries: Once per day, one or more merfolk stormcallers can cast {@spell Control Weather|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Ritual|XPHB} that takes 10 minutes to perform. For every additional stormcaller involved in performing the {@variantrule Ritual|XPHB}, the radius of the spell's effect increases by 1 mile, the duration increases by 2 hours, and they can change the weather by one additional stage every {@dice 1d4 x 10} minutes. During the casting, if the stormcallers take any action other than performing the {@variantrule Ritual|XPHB}, they must start over.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stormcaller makes three Lightning Lash attacks.

action.name: Lightning Lash
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 15 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) Lightning damage.

reaction.name: Thunderous Rebuke
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature within 60 feet of the merfolk deals damage to it. {@actResponse d}{@actSave con} {@dc 14}, the triggering creature. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Thunder damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

name: Merle Mossbow
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Merle can spend a reaction to fly up to their speed in one direction as they descend. They land in an unoccupied space at the end of their movement and take no falling damage. They cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though they can drop any held items as part of their reaction).

trait.name: Patterned Feathers
entries: Merle has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks when they attempt to hide in a forest.

trait.name: Talons
entries: Merle has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface their talons could reasonably grip.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) slashing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mi-go casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The mi-go has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Space Traveler
entries: The mi-go does not need to breathe air.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mi-go makes two Claw attacks and uses Spellcasting.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, Reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Hideous Counsel
entries: The mi-go confers with a human brain it has sealed away in a jar. The specimen is specifically chosen for the knowledge it can provide to the mi-go, allowing it to adapt to a variety of situations. The mi-go chooses one of the following benefits: It gains {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls until the end of its turn.
It uses the Dodge action as part of this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.
It gains a +2 bonus to its spell save DC until the end of its turn.

trait.name: Deathly Spores
entries: When a mi-go dies, its body crumbles into millions of spores. Each creature within 10 feet of the mi-go must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Void Traveler
entries: The mi-go doesn't require air, food, drink, sleep, or ambient pressure. It requires only minimal exposure to starlight a few times each year to sustain itself.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mi-go makes two Claw or Psychic Bolt attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) slashing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}) if it is a Large or smaller creature.

action.name: Psychic Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d6 + 7}) psychic damage.

action.name: Spore Burst {@recharge 5}
entries: The mi-go releases hallucinogenic spores in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) poison damage and is {@condition incapacitated} until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The millitaur makes two Handaxe attacks.

action.name: Handaxe
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Poisonous Flask {@recharge 5}
entries: The millitaur hastily combines alchemical substances into a poisonous concoction and throws it at a point the millitaur can see within 30 feet. Each creature within 15 feet of that point must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. A {@condition poisoned} creature can make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Healing Tonic (2/Day)
entries: The millitaur administers a healing tonic to a willing creature within 5 feet of it. The target magically regains 7 {@dice 2d6} hp and is freed from any disease or poison.

trait.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The mimic can imitate any sounds they have heard, including voices. A creature who hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Gnashing Maw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage. If the target is {@condition grappled} by the mimic, they take an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Shapechanger
entries: The mimic polymorphs into a Small, Medium, or Large object or back into their true amorphous form. Other than size, the mimic's statistics are the same in each form. Anything they are wearing or carrying isn't transformed. They revert to their true form if they die.

action.name: Envelop
entries: While grappling a creature, the mimic uses their Shapechanger action to polymorph into an object that is the same size or bigger than the {@condition grappled} creature (if the mimic isn't already in such a form). The creature is then enveloped by the mimic. An enveloped creature is no longer {@condition grappled}, but they can't breathe, are {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, have total cover against attacks and other effects outside the mimic, and take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the mimic's turns. When the mimic moves, the enveloped creature moves with them. The mimic can envelop one creature at a time.

An enveloped creature can use their action to try to escape by making a {@dc 13} Strength check. On a successful check, the creature is no longer enveloped and is shunted to an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of the mimic. The creature automatically escapes if the mimic uses Shapechanger or Panic Shift, becomes {@condition incapacitated}, or dies.

reaction.name: Panic Shift (1/Day)
entries: When the mimic takes damage, they release any {@condition grappled} or enveloped creatures and then polymorph into a Small dense object with spikes, such as an iron ball or helm. While in this form, the mimic's walking and climbing speeds are doubled, they have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks, they can only take the Dash, Disengage, or Shapechanger action, and a creature who touches the mimic or hits them with a melee attack while within 5 feet of them takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage. This effect ends when the mimic dies or uses their Shapechanger action to polymorph into another form.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The mimic can use their action to polymorph into a Small, Medium, or Large object or back into their true amorphous form. Other than size, the mimic's statistics are the same in each form. Anything they are wearing or carrying isn't transformed. They revert to their true form if they die.

trait.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

action.name: Signature Attack (Bite)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Distracting Attack (2 Ferocity)
entries: The mimic makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals its normal effects, and the next attack made against the target before the start of the mimic's next turn has advantage.

action.name: 3rd Level: Adhesive Pseudopods (5 Ferocity)
entries: The mimic attempts to adhere to each creature of their choice within 5 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}).

action.name: 5th Level: I'm You (8 Ferocity)
entries: The mimic uses their Shapechanger trait to polymorph into one Large or smaller creature they can see within 5 feet of them. Other than size, the mimic's statistics do not change, and the mimic reverts to their previous form at the start of their next turn.

After transforming, the mimic can make a signature attack against the target whose form they have taken. Hit or miss, the target must then make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, attacks against the target have advantage and the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of the mimic's next turn.

bonus.name: Wearable Companion
entries: While the mimic is within 5 feet of their caregiver, the mimic can pull themself into the caregiver's space, cover the caregiver's body, and take on the appearance of clothing. While the caregiver is wearing the mimic, the mimic's space is not difficult terrain for the caregiver, the caregiver has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks, and the caregiver can change the appearance of their mimic clothing at will (no action required) as long as the caregiver and mimic aren't {@condition incapacitated}.

Any attack that hits the caregiver also hits the mimic they are wearing, and vice versa, with both taking the full damage and effect of the attack. While worn in this way, the mimic can't move, and they can't take actions other than using a bonus action to revert to their previous form. A mimic automatically reverts to their previous form if they enter a rampage. Upon reverting to their previous form, the mimic is no longer worn by their caregiver, and the mimic enters the nearest unoccupied space of their choice.

trait.name: Shapechanger (Mimic)
entries: The mimic can use its action to polymorph into a keg, mug, vat, or other alcohol-related object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except when it polymorphs into an object it can choose to change its size to Tiny or Small until it polymorphs back into its true form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
entries: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic is also {@condition grappled} by it (escape {@dc 13}). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

trait.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary alcohol-related object.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature {@condition grappled} by it.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the mimic is in object form, the target is subjected to its Adhesive trait.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) poison damage.

trait.name: In Your Space
entries: The mimiature can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the mimiature can move through any opening at least 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the mimiature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the mimiature takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Sticky Swarm (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 bludgeoning damage. Until the end of the target's next turn, they have disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple, and they have advantage on ability checks made to initiate or maintain a grapple. Additionally, if three or more mimiatures joined the attack, the target's appendages become so sticky that until the end of the target's next turn, they can't cast spells with somatic components, they can't drop objects, and they can't interact with objects other the ones they are already holding.

action.name: Group Shapechanger
entries: The mimiature polymorphs into a Tiny object or back into their true amorphous form. If four mimiatures within 5 feet of each other use this action together, they can join together to become one Small object. Anything a mimiature is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. A mimiature in object form reverts to their true form if any mimiature in the group moves, takes an action, or dies.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Minazorond can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Constructed Nature
entries: Minazorond doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While Minazorond remains motionless, he is indistinguishable from an inanimate bronze statue.

trait.name: Faultless Tracker
entries: The creature(s) that caused Minazorond to animate becomes his quarry. Minazorond knows the direction and distance to his quarry as long the quarry remains within Drakkenheim or until Minazorond is destroyed.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: Minazorond is immune to any spell or effect that would alter his form.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Minazorond fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Minazorond has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Minazorond's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If Minazorond is destroyed, he regains all his hit points in 1 hour unless a {@spell disintegrate} spell is cast on his remains.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Minazorond can use his Frightful Presence. He then makes three attacks: one with his bite and two with his claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 2d10 + 9}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d6 + 9}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d8 + 9}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of Minazorond's choice that is within 120 feet of Minazorond and aware of him must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Minazorond's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: Minazorond uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Lightning Breath
entries: Minazorond exhales lightning in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw, taking 88 ({@damage 16d10}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Repulsion Breath
entries: Minazorond exhales repulsion energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 23} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pushed 60 feet away from Minazorond.

action.name: Change Shape
entries: Minazorond magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than his own, or back into his true form. He reverts to his true form if he dies. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (Minazorond's choice).

In a new form, Minazorond retains his alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. His statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: Minazorond makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: Minazorond makes a tail attack.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Minazorond beats his wings. Each creature within 15 feet of Minazorond must succeed on a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 2d6 + 9}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. Minazorond can then fly up to half his flying speed.

hp.special: 95 (7d12 + 49) plus 95 (7d12 + 49) per player character

trait.name: Protective Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Minazorond takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Lightning damage.

trait.name: Construct Resilience
entries: If damage reduces Minazorond to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 plus the damage taken, unless the damage is Radiant or from a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}. On a success, Minazorond drops to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} instead.

action.name: Minazorond always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, Minazorond can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Minazorond takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 10 ft. {@h}33 ({@damage 4d12 + 7}) Piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 17}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 10 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d6 + 7}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 22}, one creature Minazorond can see within 20 feet. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Force damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Shocking Burst
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 20}, one target Minazorond can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Lightning damage, and the target has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Terrifying Roar (Recharges after a Short Rest)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 20}, each creature in a 120-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from Minazorond that can hear it. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Thunder damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition (save ends).

action.name: Breathe Deep (1/Round)
entries: Minazorond's Breath Weapon recharges. Minazorond can only use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} if it's the first {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} it has taken this round.

action.name: Breath Weapon (Special Recharge)
entries: Minazorond uses one of the following breath weapons. It can only use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} if it's the last {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} it takes this round.

action.name: Lightning Breath
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 22}, each creature in a 120-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 81 ({@damage 16d8}) Lightning damage, and the target has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Thunder Breath
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 22}, each creature in a 120-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 66 ({@damage 12d10}) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet away from Minazorond and has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends). Failure by 5 or More: Double damage, and the target also has the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: Minazorond chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. Minazorond can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

reaction.name: Draconic Rebuke
entries: {@actTrigger} Minazorond becomes {@status Bloodied|XPHB}. It can use this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} even if it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition or is otherwise unable to take Reactions. {@actResponse} All conditions and spells on Minazorond immediately end unless it chooses to be affected by them, and it can fly up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action and ignoring {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. Minazorond recharges and immediately uses its Terrifying Roar.

trait.name: Aquatic Camouflage
entries: The leech has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks made to hide in aquatic terrain.

trait.name: Memory Bank
entries: The leech has three memory banks in its body. When encountered, roll {@dice 1d3} to determine how many memory banks are filled with grey matter. The rest are empty.

action.name: Attach
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 0 ft. {@h}The leech attaches to the target. While attached, the leech doesn't attack, and moves with the target, using none of the leech's movement. The leech can detach itself using 5 feet of movement, and detaches immediately if its blood bags are filled or if the target dies.

A creature within 5 feet can take an action to detach the leech with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) check. {@actSaveFail} The leech is still detached, but the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 2d4}). Failure by 5 or More: The leech isn't detached and the target takes 8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Brain Drain
entries: The leech can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} only when it is attached to a creature. That creature is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave int} {@dc 11}. {@actSaveFail} The target's Intelligence score is reduced by {@dice 1d4}, and one of the leech's memory banks is filled. If this effect reduces the target's Intelligence score to 0, it has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition until it regains at least 1 point of Intelligence. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the creature finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

bonus.name: Thought Transfusion
entries: The leech can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} only when it is attached to a creature and has at least one filled memory bank. The attached creature gains {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence-based {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} for 1 minute, and the leech empties one of its filled memory banks.

trait.name: Displacement
entries: Attack rolls against the Mind Siphon have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}, since it projects an illusion that makes it appear near its actual location. This trait is suppressed while the Mind Siphon has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Mind Siphon has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The Mind Siphon can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Mind Siphon makes two Tentacle Tongue attacks at different targets.

action.name: Tentacle Tongue
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 5d8 + 4}) Psychic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}) from the Mind Siphon's Tentacle Tongue, and the target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the Grapple ends. The Mind Siphon can Grapple up to two creatures at the same time.

action.name: Consume Head {@recharge 6}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by Tentacle Tongue. {@actSaveFail} 44 ({@damage 8d10}) Piercing damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} If this damage reduces the target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the Mind Siphon kills it and devours its head.

action.name: Synaptic Eruption {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 16}, each creature within 30 feet of the Mind Siphon. {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of the Mind Siphon's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The mindkiller can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Psionic Immunity
entries: The mindkiller is unaffected by psionic powers manifested by voiceless talkers unless the mindkiller wishes to be.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}).

action.name: Concealing Strike
entries: {@atk rp} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) psychic damage, and the mindkiller is {@condition invisible} to the target until the end of the mindkiller's next turn.

action.name: Mindwipe
entries: A Humanoid {@condition grappled} by the mindkiller must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or the mindkiller enters the Humanoid's body. While inside a Humanoid, the mindkiller has total cover against attacks and other effects originating outside the Humanoid, and the only action the mindkiller can take is to leave the body, exiting in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body.

When a Humanoid ends their turn with the mindkiller inside of them, they must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 10 necrotic damage. If the Humanoid is reduced to 0 hit points, they die and the mindkiller takes over the body, which regains hit points equal to the Humanoid's hit point maximum. The mindkiller retains their Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, their understanding of Deep Speech and Undercommon, and their telepathy. They otherwise adopt the target's statistics and can take the actions the creature could take. They know everything the creature knew, including spells, class features, traits, and languages. If the body is reduced to 0 hit points after the mindkiller takes control, the mindkiller must leave it.

A creature wielding a sharp tool or weapon within reach of a Humanoid host or body with a mindkiller inside can use an action to attempt to remove the mindkiller, making an attack roll against the Humanoid's AC if the host is unwilling. On a hit, the creature deals 11 ({@damage 2d10}) slashing damage to the host and must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check. On a successful check, the creature cuts the mindkiller out of the host. On a faiIed check, if this slashing damage reduced the host to 0 hit points, the mindkiller kills the host; otherwise, there is no effect.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The whelp can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the whelp takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the whelp takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Psionic Immunity
entries: The whelp is unaffected by psionic powers manifested by voiceless talkers unless the whelp wishes to be.

trait.name: Resistance Drain
entries: When an enemy within 5 feet of three or more whelps makes a saving throw against a power or psionic effect, the enemy takes a penalty to the save equal to the number of whelps within 5 feet of them.

action.name: Claws (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 slashing damage.

trait.name: Fungal Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of a mindrot thrall must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or become infected with the mindrot disease.

trait.name: Mindrot
entries: A creature infected with this disease manifests symptoms in {@dice 1d4} days after infection, which include migraines and muscle weakness. Until the disease is cured, at the end of each long rest, the infected creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage, and its hp maximum is reduced by that amount. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest after the disease is cured. The creature dies if the disease reduces its hp maximum to 0. One day after the creature dies, it rises as a mindrot thrall. A creature that succeeds on two saving throws recovers from the disease.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mindrot thrall makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Spore Breath {@recharge 4}
entries: The thrall exhales a blast of acidic spores from its rotten lungs in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage and is infected with the mindrot disease (see the Mindrot trait). On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't infected.

trait.name: Flammable
entries: If the elemental takes fire damage, it ignites. It takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns and its weapon attacks deal an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage. If the elemental is subject to heavy rain or takes 5 or more cold damage in a single instance, the flames are extinguished and the effects end.

trait.name: Oil Form
entries: When the elemental moves through water, it uses its swimming speed to skim along the water's surface; it can't submerge below the surface of water without a powerful detergent.

trait.name: Water Form
entries: The elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until it or another creature within reach of the target uses its action to clean the target. This speed reduction can stack; if the target's walking speed is reduced to 0 feet by this effect, it is restrained.

action.name: Arcane Activation
entries: The elemental attempts to possess one Medium or smaller corporeal creature in close proximity to an arcane power source, such as a magitech firearm. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be under the elemental's control until the elemental releases it as a bonus action, or the arcane power source is destroyed or is more than 5 feet from the possessed creature. While the elemental controls a creature in this way, the possessed creature gains the features in the Arcane Possession sidebar.

trait.name: Adhesive
entries: The minimic adheres to anything that touches it. A creature no more than one size larger than the minimic that is adhered to the minimic is also grappled by it (escape {@dc 12}).

trait.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
entries: While the minimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The minimic can use its action to polymorph into an object equal to it in size, or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage. The target is subjected to the minimic's Adhesive trait.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) acid damage.

trait.name: Intrusive Thoughts
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the Demon must succeed on a {@dc 11} Intelligence saving throw or allow the Demon's magic to influence its mind until the end of its next turn. A creature under this effect takes an extra 4 ({@damage 1d8}) psychic damage whenever it is hit by the Demon's Chomp attack.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Demon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Demon makes two attacks: one with its Chomp and one with its Spectral Pass.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Spectral Pass
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d12 + 2}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Dizzying Gore
entries: If the minotaur moves at least 20 feet straight toward a Large or smaller creature and then hits the creature with a Goring Horns attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the start of the minotaur's next turn.

trait.name: Minotaur Senses
entries: The minotaur always knows which way is north and can't become lost.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The minotaur makes one Maul attack and one Goring Horns attack.

action.name: Maul
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, the minotaur can push the target 5 feet away.

action.name: Goring Horns
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Retaliatory Gore
entries: When a creature the minotaur can see within 40 feet of them deals damage to the minotaur, the minotaur can move up to their speed. If the minotaur ends this movement within 5 feet of that creature, the minotaur can make a Goring Horns attack against them.

hp.special: Eight times their level (number of d10 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Goring Horns)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d10 plus PB} piercing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the devastator can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Furious Charge (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the devastator moves up to their speed. At the end of this movement, they can make a signature attack. If that attack hits a Large or smaller creature, the target is pushed up to 10 feet away from the devastator, and the devastator and their allies have advantage on attack rolls against the target until the end of the devastator's next turn.

action.name: 5th Level: Fearsome Gore (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the devastator makes a signature attack against a creature within 5 feet of them. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage PBd10} piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the devastator until the end of the devastator's next turn.

action.name: 7th Level: Retaliatory Charge (1/Day)
entries: When a creature the devastator can see within 40 feet of them deals damage to the devastator, the devastator can use a reaction to move up to their speed toward the creature. If the devastator ends this movement within 5 feet of the creature, they can make two signature attacks against the creature with a +PB bonus to those attack and damage rolls.

trait.name: Goring Run
entries: If the lackey moves at least 20 feet straight toward an enemy and then ends their movement within 5 feet of the enemy, the enemy takes 1 piercing damage.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the lackey takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the lackey takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Goring Horns (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 piercing damage. If this attack was made by more than one lackey, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be moved 5 feet horizontally for each minion who joined the attack. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 plus the number of lackeys who joined the attack.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The lackey can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Goring Run
entries: If the lackey moves at least 20 feet straight toward an enemy and then ends their movement within 5 feet of the enemy, the enemy takes 1 piercing damage.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the lackey takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the lackey takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Servant Senses
entries: Ithu'rath can sense anything the lackey senses, and Ithu'rath can speak through their body.

action.name: Goring Horns (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 piercing damage. If this attack was made by more than one lackey, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be moved 5 feet horizontally for each minion who joined the attack. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 plus the number of lackeys who joined the attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mirager casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Sensuous Grace
entries: The mirager moves with a flowing grace that Humanoids find appealing. If the mirager moves at least 10 feet on its turn, each Humanoid within 30 feet of it that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition charmed} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mirager makes two Slam attacks. If both Slam attacks hit a Medium or smaller creature, the target is also {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). The mirager can grapple only one creature at a time.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Thirsting Kiss
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is {@condition grappled} by the mirager, {@condition incapacitated}, or {@condition restrained}. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) necrotic damage, and the mirager gains temporary hp equal to half that amount.

action.name: Blow Kiss
entries: The mirager blows a kiss at a creature {@condition charmed} by it. The target must make a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) psychic damage and is {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and the {@condition charmed} condition immediately ends on it.

action.name: Illusory Appearance
entries: The mirager covers itself and anything it is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes it look like another creature of its general size and Humanoid shape. The illusion ends if the mirager takes a bonus action to end it or if the mirager dies.

The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the mirager could appear to have smooth skin, but someone touching it would feel its rough, sand-like skin. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to discern that the mirager is disguised.

bonus.name: Sand Dancer
entries: While in sandy terrain, the mirager takes the Dash or Disengage action.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The miremal can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Muddled Escape (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the miremal takes 7 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hp, it is reduced to 1 hp instead and becomes a puddle of filthy swamp water. At the start of the miremal's next turn, it can move up to 15 feet as a puddle. Then it returns to its normal form.

trait.name: Swamp Camouflage
entries: The miremal has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The miremal makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Bog Spew {@recharge 5}
entries: The miremal spews a noxious stream of bog filth mixed with stomach acid at one creature it can see within 20 feet of it. The target must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage and is {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn. On a success, the target takes half the damage and isn't {@condition blinded}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The blood hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Confounding Ugliness
entries: Any Humanoid that starts its turn within 60 feet of the hag and can see the hag's true form must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition incapacitated} until the start of its next turn. If the Humanoid's saving throw is successful, it is immune to the hag's Confounding Ugliness for the next 24 hours.

Unless the target is surprised or the revelation of the hag's true form is sudden, the target can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the Humanoid does so, it can't see the hag until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the Humanoid looks at the hag in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mirror hag can use her Reconfiguring Curse. She then makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. She can replace her Bite attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Reconfiguring Curse
entries: The mirror hag curses one creature she can see within 60 feet of her, corrupting its form. The target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a success, the target is immune to the hag's Reconfiguring Curse for the next 24 hours. On a failure, the target is cursed, suffering one of the following effects of the hag's choice:

items.name: Disfigured
entries: The target's skin erupts with growths and lesions, and it has disadvantage on all Charisma checks made to influence Humanoids, except for {@skill Intimidation}.

items.name: Sickly
entries: The target becomes frail and unhealthy, and it has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws. It regains only half its lost hp at the end of a long rest, and it halves the result of any Hit Dice rolled to restore hp during a short rest.

items.name: Twisted
entries: The target's limbs and spine become bent and clumsy. It has disadvantage on all Dexterity checks and Dexterity saving throws, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet.

items.name: Withered
entries: The target's muscles atrophy, and it has disadvantage on all Strength checks and Strength saving throws.

trait.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
entries: The mirrormic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mirrormic is also grappled by it (escape {@dc 15}). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

trait.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
entries: If the mirrormic is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the mirrormic move or act, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|PHB}) check to discern that the mirrormic is animate.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The mirrormic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The mirrormic can use its action to polymorph into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mirrormic uses Distort if available, and then makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Distort (Object Form Only; Recharge 4-6)
entries: The mirrormic projects a 15-foot cone of distortion until the start of its next turn. Each creature in the area that can see the mirrormic must succeed on {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or lose balance and fall prone. A creature that fails by 5 or more is incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw. If the creature does so, it can't see the mirrormic until the start of the mirrormic's next turn, when it can avert its eyes again.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the mirrormic is in object form, the target is subjected to its Adhesive trait.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The missionary casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}, +5 to spell attacks):

trait.name: Unshakeable Faith (1/Day)
entries: When the missionary would fail a saving throw, it can reroll the save with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}. It must use the new roll.

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) Bludgeoning damage, or 5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) Bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands.

action.name: Sacred Fire
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 120 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) Radiant damage.

bonus.name: Healing Word (3/Day)
entries: The missionary casts {@spell Healing Word|XPHB} using the spellcasting ability from Spellcasting.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The dragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the dragon can attempt to end one magical effect of its choice of 2nd level or lower on the target. This effect works like the {@spell dispel magic} spell, except the dragon must always make an ability check. Its ability check for this is +4.

action.name: Shard Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The mithral dragon spits metallic shards in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The area becomes difficult terrain until the start of the dragon's next turn, then the shards dissolve into wisps of silvery smoke.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Mizanoros's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 22}, {@hit 14} to hit with spell attacks). Mizanoros can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Aura of Punishment
entries: Whenever a hostile creature within 30 feet of Mizanoros takes damage, that creature takes an extra 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Mizanoros has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Mizanoros's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, Mizanoros can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Mizanoros fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Mizanoros wields Hatred, the Wrathful Edge, a sentient weapon with an Intelligence of 14, a Wisdom of 13, and a Charisma of 17. It has hearing and darkvision out to a range of 120 feet. The weapon communicates telepathically with Mizanoros and can speak, read, and understand Common and Infernal.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Mizanoros makes three attacks: one with its sting and two with Hatred, the Wrathful Edge. It can cast any of its at will spells in place of one Hatred, the Wrathful Edge attack.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@dice 3d4 + 10}) piercing plus 15 ({@damage 3d8}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 24} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned}. The {@condition poisoned} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Boil Blood {@recharge 5}
entries: Mizanoros attempts to magically boil the blood of up to three creatures it can see within 120 feet of it. Each target must make a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw, taking 41 ({@damage 6d12}) fire damage and 41 ({@damage 6d12}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that is {@condition poisoned} by Mizanoros's sting has disadvantage on this saving throw, and a creature that doesn't have blood is immune to this effect.

action.name: Hatred, the Wrathful Edge
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 1d12 + 11}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire or lightning damage (Mizanoros's choice). If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, Mizanoros gains temporary hit points equal to the fire or lightning damage dealt.

bonus.name: Blood Transfer (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, Mizanoros can cast the {@spell vampiric touch} spell. For the duration, he can repeat the attack on each of his turns as a bonus action.

legendary.name: Hatred Attack
entries: Mizanoros makes one attack with Hatred, the Wrathful Edge.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Mizanoros moves up to his speed.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Mizanoros casts a spell.

legendary.name: Accursed Step (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Mizanoros magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing and carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. Mizanoros can then choose one creature he can see within 5 feet of him. The target must make a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw, taking 44 ({@damage 8d10}) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Mizanoros regains hit points equal to the amount of necrotic damage dealt.

trait.name: Fiery Body
entries: A creature that touches the mjork or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The mjork sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius.

trait.name: Smoke Sense
entries: A mjork in contact with smoke has blindsight in that smoke's area in a radius of up to 120 feet.

trait.name: Water Susceptibility
entries: For every 5 feet the mjork moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mjork makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Blinding Soot
entries: A creature that takes fire damage from a mjork asher's attacks must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the mjork's next turn.

trait.name: Fiery Body
entries: A creature that touches the mjork asher or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Smoke Sense
entries: A mjork asher in contact with smoke has blindsight in that smoke's area in a radius of up to 120 feet.

trait.name: Smoke Shroud
