entries: While the mjork asher has 41 or more hit points, smoke renders a sphere within 20 feet of it heavily obscured. This smoke goes around corners. Even while the mjork has 40 or fewer hit points, tendrils of this smoke extend to 60 feet from the mjork, providing smoke for the Smoke Sense of all mjorks. However, the whole shroud dissipates during any round the mjork is exposed to moderate (at least 10 miles per hour) or stronger wind.

trait.name: Water Susceptibility
entries: For every 5 feet the mjork asher moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mjork asher makes two attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage and Blinding Soot.

action.name: Hurl Soot
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, ranged 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 3d6 + 2}) fire damage and Blinding Soot.

action.name: Create Sootlings (1/Day)
entries: The mjork asher chooses a point within 60 feet of it that it can sense. Smoke fills a 20-foot radius sphere centered on that point. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. This smoke lasts until the start of the mjork's next turn or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it. Unless dispersed before the start of the mjork's next turn, a sootling swarm forms in a space in the area, favoring a space a creature hostile to the mjork occupies. The swarm takes its turn just after the mjork and obeys the mjork's verbal commands (no action for the mjork). If issued no commands, the swarm acts independently, often attacking a creature that isn't its ally. The swarm can survive indefinitely after being created.

trait.name: Fiery Body
entries: A creature that touches the mjork burner or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Fire Path
entries: The mjork burner leaves fire behind in any space it moves through. Until the start of the mjork's next turn, any creature that enters this area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) fire damage. The fire can ignite flammable objects (not creatures), causing the mjork's Fire Path to last longer.

trait.name: Ignite
entries: A creature or flammable object ignites if it takes fire damage from the mjork burner's attacks. Until a creature takes an action to douse this fire, the target takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The mjork burner sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for another 10 feet.

trait.name: Smoke Sense
entries: A mjork burner in contact with smoke has blindsight in that smoke's area in a radius of up to 120 feet.

trait.name: Water Susceptibility
entries: For every 5 feet the mjork burner moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mjork burner makes two attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage, 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage, and Ignite.

action.name: Hurl Fire
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, ranged 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) fire damage and Ignite.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the mjork charger moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a slam attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Fiery Body
entries: A creature that touches the mjork charger or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The mjork charger sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius.

trait.name: Momentum
entries: If the mjork charger moves on its turn before attacking, creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls for opportunity attacks against it.

trait.name: Smoke Sense
entries: A mjork charger in contact with smoke has blindsight in that smoke's area in a radius of up to 120 feet.

trait.name: Water Susceptibility
entries: For every 5 feet the mjork charger moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mjork makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

name: Mjork Sootling
languages: understands Ignan and Terran but can't speak

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that ends its turn grappling the sootling takes 1 fire damage.

trait.name: Smoke Sense
entries: A sootling in contact with smoke has blindsight in that smoke's area in a radius of up to 120 feet.

trait.name: Water Susceptibility
entries: For every 5 feet the sootling moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.

action.name: Burn
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) fire damage.

name: Mjork Sootling Swarm
languages: understands Ignan and Terran but can't speak

trait.name: Hot Soot
entries: A creature that ends its turn in the sootling swarm's space takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) fire damage, or 2 ({@damage 1d4}) fire damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer. The creature must also succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} and unable to breathe until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Smoke Sense
entries: A sootling swarm in contact with smoke has blindsight in that smoke's area in a radius of up to 120 feet.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The sootling swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points

trait.name: Water Susceptibility
entries: For every 5 feet the sootling swarm moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 2 cold damage.

action.name: Burns
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. {@h}10 ({@damage 4d4}) fire damage, or 5 ({@damage 2d4}) fire damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

trait.name: Ethereal Coat
entries: The mngwa's AC includes its Charisma modifier (included above).

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The mngwa can see 30 feet into the Ethereal Plane when on the Material Plane and vice versa.

trait.name: Feline Passivism
entries: No felines or weretigers can willingly attack the mngwa. They can be forced to do so through magical means.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The mngwa has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The mngwa has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the mngwa's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Running Leap
entries: With a 10-foot running start, the mngwa can long jump up to 25 feet.

trait.name: Speak with Felines
entries: The mngwa can communicate with felines as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mngwa makes one Ethereal Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Ethereal Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) force damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

bonus.name: Ethereal Step
entries: The mngwa magically shifts from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane, or vice versa. When it leaves or enters the Material Plane, a puff of gray smoke briefly appears in the space on the Material Plane it leaves or enters.

trait.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
entries: The mock adheres to anything that touches it. The mock has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against any creature adhered to it. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the mock as an action.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) Piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Acid damage.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The mock shape-shifts to resemble a Tiny object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true blob form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Earth Bump
entries: As the mohler burrows under a Large or smaller creature on the ground within 5 feet of them, the mohler shifts the ground. The creature above them must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Ground Grinder
entries: The mohler burrows up to their burrowing speed. Ground within 5 feet of where the mohler burrows becomes difficult terrain.

reaction.name: Zip
entries: If the mohler fails a Dexterity saving throw while burrowing, they succeed instead.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Claw)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} slashing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Earth Bump (2 Ferocity)
entries: The mohler burrows up to their speed and chooses one Large or smaller creature they come within 5 feet of during the move. The target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: 3rd Level: Sinkhole (5 Ferocity)
entries: The mohler burrows up to their speed and targets a creature they can sense on the surface within 10 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} by the ground until the start of the mohler's next turn.

action.name: 5th Level: Terranova (8 Ferocity)
entries: Each creature on the ground within 10 feet of the mohler must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength saving throw or take {@damage 1d6 plus PB} bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. A creature who fails this saving throw by 5 or more is {@condition restrained} by the ground (save ends at end of turn). A creature can use their action to free themself or another creature within their reach, ending the effect.

reaction.name: Quick Pit (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: If the mohler's caregiver fails a Dexterity saving throw while they are within 10 feet of the mohler and the mohler isn't {@condition incapacitated} or {@condition restrained}, the mohler pulls the caregiver out of danger. The caregiver succeeds on the saving throw instead.

trait.name: Regrowth
entries: When a mold spider dies, unless fire destroyed it, it releases spores that regrow a mold spider in 3 days.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The mold spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 slashing damage.

trait.name: Burrow
entries: Molefolk cannot burrow into solid rock, but they can move through softer material like soil or loose rubble, leaving a usable tunnel 5 feet in diameter.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The molefolk has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Dirt Dive
entries: The molefolk dives into the earth directly below them and can move up to their burrow speed. Moving in this manner does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

trait.name: Coldfire Weapons
entries: The monolith champion's weapon attacks are imbued with blue fey fire and magical. When the champion hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 3d8} cold damage or fire damage (included in the attack), the champion's choice.

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The monolith champion doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The monolith champion makes one Greatsword attack and one Slam attack.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) cold damage or fire damage (the champion's choice). If the target is within a fey court or castle, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or become {@condition invisible}, silent, and {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute, while an illusory version of the target under the champion's control remains visible and audible. The illusion shouts to the target's allies for a retreat or similar action. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself and destroying the illusory double on a success.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) cold damage or fire damage (the champion's choice).

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

trait.name: Coldfire Weapons
entries: The monolith footman's weapon attacks are imbued with blue fey fire and magical. When the footman hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d8} cold damage or fire damage (included in the attack), the champion's choice.

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The monolith footman doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Simple Construction
entries: A critical hit against the footman causes it to burst into pieces and be destroyed. Each creature within 5 feet of the footman must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 2d4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The footman makes two Shortsword attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) cold damage or fire damage (the footman's choice). If the target is within a fey court or castle, the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Charisma saving throw or become {@condition invisible}, silent, and {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute, while an illusory version of the target under the footman's control remains visible and audible. The illusion shouts to the target's allies for a retreat or similar action. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself and destroying the illusory double on a success.

trait.name: Faith
entries: When the monster hunter rolls a 1 on the {@dice d20} of an ability check or saving throw, it can reroll the die, and it must use the new roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The monster hunter makes two attacks, using Handaxe or Silver Knife in any combination.

action.name: Handaxe
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage, plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Slashing damage if the attack roll was made with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Silver Knife
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage, plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Slashing damage if the attack roll was made with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Wooden Stake
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Aim
entries: The monster hunter gives itself {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll it makes during the current turn.

reaction.name: Save Ally
entries: {@actTrigger} An ally within 5 feet has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition. {@actResponse} The ally can immediately make an escape roll with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

name: Moonflower
languages: can speak with beasts of any size which represent spiders, insects, worms, or bugs.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Moonflower is a 4th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). She has the following bard spells prepared:

trait.name: Soulful Rhapsody (2/Day)
entries: Moonflower can use a bonus action on her turn to target one creature within 30 feet of her. If the target can hear Moonflower, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or become overcome with emotion from Moonflower's performance, becoming {@condition incapacitated} until the start of Moonflower's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Moonflower makes two weapon attacks with her rapier.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Curl Up
entries: Moonflower curls up into a spiny ball. While curled up in this way she cannot move, attack, or cast spells with somatic components, and her base armor class becomes 19. Any creature that misses Moonflower with a melee attack while she is curled up takes {@dice 2d4} points of piercing damage from her sharp quills. If a creature hits the bard while she is curled up, however, Moonflower is knocked {@condition prone} in her space at the end of the turn. Moonflower may uncurl themselves at any point during her turn.

resist.note: from attacks not made with cold iron weapons

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Moonlit King casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (save {@dc 19}):

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Moonlit King fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Moonlit Weapons
entries: The Moonlit King's weapon attacks are magical. When he hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) radiant damage (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Moonlit King makes three Crystal Staff or Moon Bolt attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting. If two Crystal Staff attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Crystal Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) radiant damage.

action.name: Moon Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 11} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) radiant damage, and the target sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius until the end of its next turn. If the target is a creature in a form other than its true form, it takes an extra 11 ({@damage 2d10}) radiant damage and must succeed on a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw or revert to its true form.

action.name: Animate Shadows {@recharge 5}
entries: The Moonlit King causes the shadows of up to three creatures he can see within 60 feet of him to animate and attack their owners. Each target must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 49 ({@damage 14d6}) necrotic damage, and its Strength score is reduced by {@dice 1d4}. On a success, a creature takes half the damage, and its Strength score isn't reduced. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The creature dies if this effect reduces its Strength to 0.

action.name: Summon Devil (1/Day)
entries: The Moonlit King magically calls a lunar devil to aid him. The devil arrives in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as ally of the Moonlit King and obeying his spoken commands. The devil remains for 1 hour, until the Moonlit King dies, or until the King dismisses it as a bonus action.

bonus.name: Moonlight Step
entries: The Moonlit King teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. The origin and destination spaces must contain moonlight.

reaction.name: Shadow Slip
entries: When a creature the Moonlit King can see within 30 feet of him attacks him, he takes on the quality of his manifest delusions, temporarily becoming ghostly. The attack roll has disadvantage, and if it hits, the Moonlit King takes only half the damage from the attack.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The Moonlit King moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Shift Moonlight
entries: The Moonlit King changes the brightness of each area of moonlight he can see within 120 feet of him from dim light to bright light or vice versa.

legendary.name: Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Moonlit King makes a Crystal Staff or Moon Bolt attack.

legendary.name: Spread Madness (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of the Moonlit King must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or suffer short-term madness. The Moonlit King can use this legendary action only when he is in moonlight.

trait.name: Shadow Camouflage
entries: The moonshadow catcher has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in dim light or darkness.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The moonshadow catcher can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the moonshadow catcher has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Unseelie Blessing
entries: The moonshadow catcher has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put it to sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The moonshadow catcher makes two Shortsword attacks or two Hand Crossbow attacks. They can replace one of those attacks with either a Mooncatcher's Net attack or a Steal Shadow attack.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also {@condition paralyzed} while {@condition poisoned} in this way. The target is no longer {@condition paralyzed} if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

action.name: Mooncatcher's Net
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, ranged 20/60 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. {@h}The target is {@condition restrained} until it escapes the net. A creature can use its action to make a {@dc 16} Strength check to free itself or another creature in the net, ending the effect on a success. Dealing 15 slashing damage to the net (AC 14) frees the target.

action.name: Steal Shadow {@recharge 5}
entries: The moonshadow catcher targets a creature they can see within 60 feet, turning the target's own shadow against them. The target must make a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, they are {@condition restrained} until the end of the moonshadow catcher's next turn. On a successful save, they are {@condition grappled} until the end of the moonshadow catcher's next turn.

bonus.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The moonshadow catcher takes the Disengage or Hide action.

trait.name: Detect Life
entries: The moonshine magically senses the direction of creatures up to 60 feet away that aren't Constructs or Undead.

trait.name: Ephemeral
entries: The moonshine can't wear or carry anything.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The moonshine sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 15-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 15 feet.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The moonshine can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Difficult Terrain
entries: It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The moonshine makes two Gloomy Touch attacks.

action.name: Gloomy Touch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Psychic damage.

action.name: Siphon Life (2/Day)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 11}, one creature that isn't a Construct or Undead the moonshine can see within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of the moonshine's next turn, and the moonshine or a creature of its choice within 30 feet regains 3 ({@dice 1d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Forest Walker
entries: While in forest terrain, the moose has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the moose moved 10+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Bludgeoning damage and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

reaction.name: Fury
entries: {@actTrigger} The moose takes 5 or more damage. {@actResponse} The moose has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Carrier
entries: The morbus kobold can contract a disease but is immune to effects other than cosmetic symptoms.

trait.name: Infection
entries: A creature that touches the morbus kobold or anything it has touched in the past 24 hours is exposed to a disease, usually {@disease sewer plague}.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The morbus kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the morbus kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage and Infection.

action.name: Sling
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and Infection.

action.name: Gore Bag
entries: The morbus kobold throws a sack filled with diseased gore at a point it can see within 20 feet of it. Each creature within 5 feet of the chosen point is subjected to Infection. A kobold usually carries only one such bag at a time.

name: Mordane Swiftgale
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Patterned Feathers
entries: Mordane has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks when he attempts to hide in a forest.

trait.name: Talons
entries: Mordane has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface his talons could reasonably grip.

action.name: Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The mordant snare has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Mordant Puppets
entries: A mordant snare can spend 8 hours draining a dead Humanoid of its fluids and internal organs, replacing them with the snare's acid and filaments. The Humanoid's body then becomes a puppet controlled by the snare. Mordant puppets share a telepathic link with the snare, and each puppet uses the statistics of a zombie. The puppets can't move more than 30 feet away from the snare. The mordant snare can have no more than twelve puppets under its control at one time.

When a puppet is destroyed, each creature within 5 feet of the puppet must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage. If the mordant snare dies, all puppets it controls immediately crumble into desiccated husks as the animating acid and filaments leave them.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mordant snare makes one Bite attack and four Tentacle attacks, or it makes four Acid Spike attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) piercing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}) if it is a Large or smaller creature. The mordant snare has eleven tentacles, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Acid Spike
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) acid damage.

action.name: Hidden Trap
entries: While underground, the mordant snare covers itself in dirt, sand, or other material and lurks just below the surface. The mordant snare is indistinguishable from the ground around it while motionless and covered in this way. When a creature enters the mordant snare's space, the snare can make one Tentacle attack against the creature as a reaction, removing the covering material.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The morphoi can breathe air and water.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Trident
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage, or 6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The morphoi transforms into a Medium Humanoid or back into its true form, which is a Plant. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form when it dies.

trait.name: Forest Camouflage
entries: A moss lurker has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in forested terrain.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The moss lurker has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Poisoned Gifts
entries: A moss lurker can spend 1 minute stirring one of its red claws in a drink or cooked meal, contaminating the food or drink. A creature that eats or drinks the contaminated food or drink must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is also {@condition unconscious} while {@condition poisoned} in this way. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

action.name: Poisoned Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Throw Stone
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is at least 10 feet below the moss lurker, such as at the base of a cliff where the moss lurker stands, the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or take {@damage 1d4} bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet the rock fell before hitting the target, to a maximum of {@dice 10d4}.

action.name: Perfume Poof
entries: The mossling can cast {@spell Pacify Person|ObojimaTallGrass} at will, and its spell save DC is 11.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The Mountain Lion has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pounce (Lion)
entries: If the Mountain Lion moves at least 20 feet toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. The mountain lion can make a bite attack against a {@condition prone} target as a bonus action.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Call Avalanche (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: With a mystic roar, the mountain lion can call down the very rocks. So long as it is in mountainous terrain, it can use its action to cause a rockslide to fall within a 15-foot-radius of a space it can see within 60 feet. Creatures in this area must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 13 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage on a failure and half as much on a success.

trait.name: Aversion to Cold and Fire
entries: If the elemental takes Cold or Fire damage, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 0, and it can't use Engulf until the end of its next turn. However, a creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the elemental has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks made to escape the grapple during that time as well.

trait.name: Mud Form
entries: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot without expending extra movement to do so.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two attacks, using Sticky Slam or Jet in any combination.

action.name: Sticky Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Jet
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 60 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: Engulf
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 15}, one Medium or smaller creature within 10 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target is pulled into the elemental's space and has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}). Until the grapple ends, the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, and it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. When the elemental moves, the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} target moves with it, costing it no extra movement. The elemental can have up to two creatures {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} at a time.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The bodyguard is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: The bodyguard has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bodyguard makes three attacks using Axe Arm, Repeating Crossbow, or both.

action.name: Axe Arm
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d12 + 5}) slashing damage. If the target is wielding at least one weapon, they must make a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target drops one weapon they wield of the bodyguard's choice, and the bodyguard kicks it up to 15 feet away.

action.name: Repeating Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d10}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Magnetic Pull
entries: Each enemy wearing metal armor or made of metal within 30 feet of the bodyguard must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet toward the bodyguard.

reaction.name: Valiar Cloak
entries: When an attack hits a Medium or smaller ally the bodyguard can see within 5 feet of them, the bodyguard forces the attacker to reroll the attack against the bodyguard instead.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The chief is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: The chief has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chief makes three attacks using Pneumatic Fist, Targeting Beam, or both.

action.name: Pneumatic Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, the chief can push them up to 10 feet away.

action.name: Targeting Beam
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 150 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d12}) force damage, and the target is marked by a beam of red light until the end of the chief's next turn. While the target is marked, attack rolls against them have advantage.

bonus.name: Chief's Command
entries: The chief shouts a command to an ally within 60 feet of them who can hear them. The ally can either move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks or make a melee attack (no action required).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The immortal has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects

trait.name: Reconstitute
entries: If the immortal dies, its body reforms 24 hours later unless its remains are incinerated

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The immortal makes three attacks: two with its Khopesh and one with its Glaive. It can replace any number of these attacks with a Rotting Phlegm attack.

action.name: Glaive
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Khopesh
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6} necrotic damage.

action.name: Rotting Phlegm.
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage.

name: Mummy
languages: the languages they knew in life

trait.name: Flammable
entries: Whenever the mummy takes fire damage, they take an extra 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

trait.name: Mummy Dust
entries: Whenever the mummy takes piercing or slashing damage, each creature within 5 feet of them takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) poison damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mummy makes two Desiccating Slam attacks and uses Guardian Curse.

action.name: Desiccating Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. Until the start of the mummy's next turn, the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet and the target can't regain hit points.

action.name: Guardian Curse
entries: The mummy calls down a scourge on one creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, whenever the target takes damage, they take an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage that can't be reduced in any way. The curse lasts until removed by a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power, a {@spell remove curse} spell, or a similar supernatural effect. A target who succeeds on their saving throw is immune to the Guardian Curse of all mummies for the next 24 hours.

name: Mummy Rotwrap
languages: the languages they knew in life

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the rotwrap takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the rotwrap takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Words of Ancient Doom (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature. {@h}4 necrotic damage, and if three or more rotwraps joined the attack, the target can't speak or use telepathy until the end of their next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mutagenist casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}, +7 to spell attacks):

trait.name: Noxious Blood
entries: When a creature hits the mutagenist with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, the creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mutagenist makes two Scalpel attacks and uses Forced Mutation.

action.name: Scalpel
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage, and the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d6}).

action.name: Forced Mutation
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15}, one creature the mutagenist can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains a randomly determined mutation. The mutation lasts for 1 minute, and afterwards, any lost body parts are restored. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Transmogrifying Elixir (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The mutagenist injects itself with a transmogrifying elixir. The mutagenist transforms, using the Grotesque Gargantuan stat block for their altered form. The mutagenist reverts to its normal form after 1 hour or if its transmogrified form is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

bonus.name: Anatomical Precision
entries: The mutagenist gains {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Scalpel attacks until the start of its next turn, as long as it has not moved this turn. The mutagenist's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 0 until the start of its next turn.

reaction.name: Desperate Transformation
entries: {@actTrigger} The mutagenist is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. {@actResponse} The mutagenist uses Transmogrifying Elixir, if available.

trait.name: Anchoring Mask
entries: The nurse has a porcelain mask (AC 15; HP 15; {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage). If the nurse starts its turn and isn't wearing its mask, it must move as far as possible to retrieve its mask if possible, or to reach the closest creature it can see or hear, and it must attack that creature. If it can't see or hear any other creatures, it either stands still and does nothing, or it destroys any objects in its vicinity (50 percent chance of either).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nurse makes two Stab attacks. If it hits a creature with a Stab attack, it can use Inject if available.

action.name: Stab
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Inject {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, a creature the nurse hit with a Stab attack this turn. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 hour. Failure by 5 or More: The {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} target also has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition until it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it awake. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Mutation
entries: The nurse has one of the following mutation action options:

items.name: Cerebral Graft
entries: Part of a psionic creature's brain is grafted to the nurse's own. {@actSave int} {@dc 13}, one creature within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: Tentacle Lash
entries: A tentacle writhes beneath the nurse's skin or clothes. {@actSave dex} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Catalyst (Recharge after Short or Long Rest)
entries: The nurse injects itself with a stimulant. Until the start of the nurse's next turn, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is doubled, it can make one extra Stab attack when it takes the Multiattack action, and it gains a +2 bonus to AC.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Mycete can cast the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

3: {@spell locate animals or plants} {@sup {@cite Casting Times|FleeMortals|A}}

trait.name: Necrotic Absorption
entries: Whenever Mycete is subjected to necrotic damage, she takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

action.name: Parasitic Spores
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, Mycete regains 3 ({@dice 1d6}) hit points.

action.name: Fungal Growth
entries: Mycete causes fungi to proliferate from a point she can see within 60 feet of her. Solid surfaces in a 10-foot square centered on that point become difficult terrain, and a creature who enters that area for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Animate Husks (1/Day)
entries: Mycete animates three rotting zombies, who appear in unoccupied spaces Mycete can see within 30 feet of her. The zombies act immediately after Mycete on the same initiative count and follow her verbal orders. If Mycete dies, the zombies are destroyed.

bonus.name: Spore Eruption
entries: Mycete destroys a rotting zombie under her control, and the zombie violently erupts with toxic spores.
Each enemy within 5 feet of the zombie must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Myling

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Enfeebling Attacks
entries: Each time the myling deals necrotic damage to a creature that is below half its hp maximum, the target's Strength score is reduced by {@dice 1d4}. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The myling doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or the myling attaches to it. While attached, the myling sinks its teeth into the target and can't attack, and at the start of each of the myling's turns, the target takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) necrotic damage.

The attached myling moves with the target whenever the target moves, requiring none of the myling's movement. It can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement on its turn. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the myling by succeeding on a {@dc 13} Strength check.

bonus.name: Bury Alive {@recharge}
entries: The creature to which the myling is attached is knocked {@condition prone}, dragged into the ground, and buried just below the surface, ending the attachment. The buried creature is {@condition restrained} and unable to breathe or stand up. A creature, including the buried creature, can take its action to free the buried creature by succeeding on a {@dc 13} Strength check.

name: Naina
senses: magic. the naina senses magic within 120 feet of her at will. this trait otherwise works like the detect magic spell but isn't itself magical.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The naina casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The naina makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks, or she makes three Slam attacks.

action.name: Bite (True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 3d12 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw (True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 3d12 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Slam (Humanoid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The naina uses one of the following breath weapons:

items.name: Poison Breath
entries: The naina exhales poison breath in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 40 ({@damage 9d8}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Paralysis Breath
entries: The naina exhales paralyzing breath in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Sleep Breath
entries: The naina exhales sleep gas around it. Each creature within 20 feet of the naina must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious} for 10 minutes. This effect ends for a creature if the creature takes damage or another creature uses an action to wake it.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The naina transforms into a Medium Humanoid or back into her true form, which is a Dragon. Her statistics, other than her size, are the same in each form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true from if she dies.

spellcasting.name: Invisibility
headerEntries: The nameless thing casts {@spell Invisibility|XPHB} on itself, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability.

When it casts the spell, the nameless thing can extend the effect of the spell to a creature it is touching. The spell ends early if either creature breaks the spell on itself or if the nameless thing stops touching the other creature. Once the nameless thing extends the spell in this way, it can't do so again until it finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The nameless thing doesn't provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Psychic Strike
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d12 + 3}) Psychic damage, and if the target is a creature, it has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of the nameless thing's next turn.

hp.special: See {@table Table 06. Characteristics|TLotRR|Table 06}

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The Nameless Thing can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the Nameless Thing has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Nameless Thing makes two attacks: one with its primary natural weapon and one with its secondary natural weapon.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Nathaniel casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}, +6 to spell attacks):

trait.name: Sanctified by Falling Fire
entries: When Nathaniel dies, his soul is pulled into the {@item crystal|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|delerium crystal} embedded in his chest.

trait.name: Special Immunities
entries: Nathaniel is immune to the {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

action.name: Sacred Fire
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}35 ({@damage 10d6}) Radiant damage.

name: Necrohydra
languages: the languages its heads knew in life

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The necrohydra has five fleshy heads. While it has more than one head, the necrohydra has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition stunned}, and knocked {@condition unconscious}. Whenever the necrohydra takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its fleshy heads dies. If all its fleshy heads die, the necrohydra can't use or maintain Dreadful Dirge. At the end of its turn, it grows two skeletal heads for each of its fleshy heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken radiant damage since its last turn. The necrohydra regains 10 hp for each skeletal head regrown in this way.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: For each head the necrohydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The necrohydra doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The necrohydra makes as many Bite attacks as it has heads.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d4 + 5}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Dreadful Dirge
entries: The necrohydra's heads emit a cacophonous, moaning wail. Each creature that isn't a Construct or Undead within 30 feet of the necrohydra that can hear the wail must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the wail ends. The necrohydra must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue wailing. It can stop wailing at any time. The wail ends if the necrohydra is {@condition incapacitated}. A {@condition frightened} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Necrotic Bile {@recharge}
entries: The necrohydra spews rotten bile soaked in necrotic energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) poison damage and 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Entrapping Saliva
entries: The necrolisk ignores {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions of a creature with the Incorporeal Movement trait. Creatures swallowed by the necrolisk can't pass through it using Incorporeal Movement or through the Ethereal Plane, and creatures can't teleport out of its stomach.

trait.name: Herb Allergy
entries: If the necrolisk eats a specific concoction of herbs worth 25 GP (such as if a swallowed creature pours them into its stomach as a Utilize action), at the end of the turn, the necrolisk regurgitates anything in its stomach as if it failed the saving throw described in its Swallow {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The necrolisk can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The necrolisk can burrow through solid rock at half its {@variantrule Burrow Speed|XPHB} and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The necrolisk makes one Bite attack and one Claws attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 15 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Force damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}). Until the grapple ends, it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d6 + 6}) Slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Force damage.

action.name: Ephemeral Spit {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 42 ({@damage 12d6}) Force damage, and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Swallow
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}, one Large or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the necrolisk (the necrolisk can only have one creature swallowed at a time). {@actSaveFail} The necrolisk swallows the target, which is no longer {@condition Grappled|XPHB}. While swallowed, the creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects outside the necrolisk, and takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Force damage at the start of each of the necrolisk's turns.

If the necrolisk takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the necrolisk must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls in a space within 10 feet of the necrolisk and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. If the necrolisk dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition Restrained|XPHB} and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting {@condition Prone|XPHB}.

trait.name: Elephants' Bane
entries: The ngobou has advantage on attack rolls against elephants. It can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any elephant or elephant material no older than 48 hours within 120 feet of it.

trait.name: Jagged Hide
entries: At the start of each of its turns, the ngobou deals 4 ({@damage 1d8}) piercing damage to any creature grappling it.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the ngobou can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn. If the ngobou detects an elephant within 120 feet of it, this trait is always active, and the ngobou can't choose to end it until it starts its turn more than 120 feet from an elephant.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the ngobou moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the ngobou can make one Stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone} creature. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Aura of Luck
entries: The nichny is surrounded by an aura that manipulates the luck of those near the nichny. Each friendly creature, other than the nichny, within 10 feet of the Nichny nichny has a +1 bonus to attack rolls and saving throws. Each hostile creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the nichny must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the end of its turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The nichny has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Soothsaying (1/Day)
entries: The nichny can spend 1 minute conversing with a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. During this time, the creature can ask up to three questions about the past, present, or future. At the end of the minute, the nichny then offers two truthful answers and one false answer, each in the form of a paradox, riddle, or cryptic rhyme.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nichny makes two Claw or Luck-Stealing Bolt attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) force damage.

action.name: Luck-Stealing Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) force damage, and the target has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Create Lucky Stone
entries: The nichny magically imbues a small stone with good luck. A creature, other than the nichny, wearing or carrying the stone has a +1 bonus to saving throws. The nichny can have no more than three such stones actively imbued at a time. If it imbues a fourth, the effect on the oldest imbued stone ends. The nichny can end the magic on any of the stones at any time (no action required).

action.name: Teleport {@recharge}
entries: The nichny magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Dendallen casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

spellcasting.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
headerEntries: Dendallen casts {@spell Counterspell|XPHB} or {@spell Shield|XPHB} in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Dendallen makes four attacks, using Staff or Chilling Ray in any combination. He can (A) replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast {@spell Magic Missile|XPHB} or (B) replace two attacks with a use of Spellcasting to cast {@spell Blight|XPHB} (level 5 version).

action.name: Staff
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) Force damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Necrotic damage, and the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on any ability check or saving throw that uses Strength or Constitution. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

action.name: Chilling Ray
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 9}, range 120 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) Cold damage.

trait.name: Ancient Imprisonment
entries: Rage and terror at Nidhogg's imprisonment by Wotan reverberates down the generations within his brood. When rolling saves against effects that cause the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} or {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition, as well as any that would entrap it, the Nidhogg spawn drake has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drake makes one Bite and one Claw attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of the drake's next turn.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Venom Spit {@recharge 4}
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 4d6 + 2}) Poison damage.

bonus.name: Earth Wyrm
entries: The drake burrows 20 feet.

trait.name: Bloodthirsty
entries: The vampire has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against a target with the {@status Bloodied|XPHB} or {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The vampire regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes two attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Bite.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d4 + 5}) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}).

action.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. or range 100/400 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) Force damage, and the target suffers one of the following effects of the vampire's choice (the vampire can't select the same option more than once per turn):

items.name: Poison
entries: The target takes an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Poison damage and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition (save ends, {@actSave con} {@dc 16}).

items.name: Open Wounds
entries: The target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 3d6}).

items.name: Mindmuddler
entries: The target has the {@condition Bewildered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends, {@actSave int} {@dc 16}).

action.name: Bite
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, or {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveFail} 15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) Necrotic damage, and the vampire regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

bonus.name: Meld Into Shadow
entries: In {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}, the vampire casts {@spell Invisibility|XPHB} on itself, requiring no components and using Charisma as its spellcasting ability.

reaction.name: Spectral Dodge
entries: {@actTrigger} The vampire takes damage. {@actResponse} The vampire gains {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to that damage, then moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

vulnerable.special: Damage from weapons wiped with salt

trait.name: Blood Stalker
entries: The night creature has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom checks made to find or track a creature that is missing any {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Salt Susceptibility
entries: The night creature has {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to damage from weapons wiped with salt. A creature can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to wipe salt onto a weapon, which remains coated for 1 minute, or until it hits a creature.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The night creature can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: The night creature takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The night creature makes one Claw attack and uses Bite.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}) from one of two claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 14}, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or that has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, or {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveFail} 6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage. The target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the night creature regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to that amount.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: If the night creature isn't in sunlight, it shape-shifts into a Medium Humanoid or returns to its true form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, the hag can cast the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes two Dream Claw attacks.

action.name: Dream Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) psychic damage. If a target is hit by this attack more than once on a turn, they must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target falls {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), until the target takes damage, or until another creature who can reach the target uses their action to wake them. Creatures who can't be supernaturally put to sleep automatically succeed on this saving throw.

action.name: Vicious Visions (1/Day; 6th-Level Spell)
entries: The hag releases magic dream dust in a 60-foot cone. Each creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} for 1 minute or until they deal damage to another creature. While {@condition charmed}, the creature sees all allies as enemies and all enemies as allies.

action.name: Tiny Time
entries: The hag magically shrinks down to a height of 1 inch, becoming Tiny along with any items they wear or carry. While Tiny, the hag has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide, and they can use a bonus action to enter the head of an {@condition unconscious} Humanoid they can reach or to grow back to the hag's normal size. The hag's game statistics otherwise remain the same.

While the hag is inside a Humanoid's head, that Humanoid is considered haunted by the hag, and the hag has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the head. The hag can speak telepathically to the haunted Humanoid, but the Humanoid is unaware of the source of this telepathic speech. The haunted Humanoid can't gain any benefit from rest unless the hag allows it, and when the Humanoid attempts to sleep, the hag can fill the Humanoid's mind with nightmarish visions.

The hag is expelled from the head and grows back to their normal size if the haunted Humanoid is affected by a {@spell dispel evil and good} spell or similar supernatural effects, or if the hag chooses to exit the head as a bonus action.

bonus.name: Sleepwalk
entries: The hag moves one {@condition unconscious} creature they can see within 60 feet of them up to 30 feet horizontally.

reaction.name: Aren't You Tired?
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the hag hits them with an attack, the hag spits sleep dust at the attacker. The attacker must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, until the end of the hag's next turn, the attacker feels tremendously sleepy, they can't take reactions, and they have disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws. Creatures who can't be supernaturally put to sleep are immune to this effect.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scorpion makes two Claw attacks and one Sting attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). The scorpion has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage and is {@condition blinded} for 1 hour. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition blinded}. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute, and it is {@condition paralyzed} while {@condition poisoned} in this way. A {@condition poisoned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Telepathic Bond
entries: The nightgarm ignores the range restriction on its telepathy when communicating with a falseheart it has birthed. The nightgarm and its falseheart don't need to be on the same plane of existence.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nightgarm makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be swallowed. A swallowed creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside the nightgarm, and it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the nightgarm's turns. The nightgarm can have only one creature swallowed at a time. If the nightgarm takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the nightgarm must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls {@condition prone} in a space within 5 feet of the nightgarm. If the nightgarm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by her and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Lupine Howl (1/Day)
entries: The nightgarm magically calls {@dice 2d4} wolves or 2 dire wolves. The wolves arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of the nightgarm and obeying her telepathic commands. The wolves remain for 1 hour, until the nightgarm dies, or until the nightgarm dismisses them as a bonus action.

trait.name: Ghostly Body (Void Ghost Form Only)
entries: The nihileth has resistance to acid, fire, lightning, and thunder damage, it has immunity to the {@condition prone} condition, and it has immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. In addition, the nihileth can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Infecting Telepathy
entries: If a creature communicates telepathically with the nihileth, or deals psychic damage to it, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or become infected with the nihilethic rot disease.

trait.name: Nihilethic Rot
entries: This disease takes 1 minute to manifest in an infected creature, during which time the disease can be removed with the {@spell lesser restoration} spell. After 1 minute, the creature's flesh becomes slimy and translucent, and the disease can be cured only by the {@spell heal} spell or similar magic. Until this disease is cured, the creature can't regain hp unless it is submerged in water, and it can breathe air and water. The creature must be submerged in water at least once every 2 hours to avoid suffocating, and if it is outside a body of water, it takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage every 10 minutes, unless moisture is applied to its skin before 10 minutes have passed. If a Humanoid dies while infected with this disease, it rises 1 minute later as a nihilethic zombie under the nihileth's control. If a Large giant or monstrosity dies while infected with this disease, it rises 1 minute later as a nihilethic dominator under the nihileth's control.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the nihileth to 0 hp, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the nihileth drops to 1 hp instead.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The nihileth doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Void Aura
entries: The nihileth is surrounded by a chilling cloud. A creature that isn't a construct or undead and that starts its turn within 5 feet of the nihileth must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or its speed is halved until the start of its next turn. In addition, a creature infected with nihilethic rot takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage when it starts its turn within this aura.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nihileth makes two Tentacle attacks and one Tail attack, or it makes three Withering Touch attacks.

action.name: Tail (Undead Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft. one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tentacle (Undead Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or contract the nihilethic rot disease (see the Nihilethic Rot trait).

action.name: Withering Touch (Void Ghost Form Only)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) necrotic damage.

bonus.name: Void Shape
entries: The nihileth magically transforms into a dark purple, Void ghost form or back into its Undead form. Its statistics, other than its speed, resistances, and immunities, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying changes with it. It reverts to its Undead form if it dies.

reaction.name: Void Body
entries: When the nihileth takes damage, it can reduce the damage to 0. Radiant damage can be reduced by only half.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The nihileth makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Tail Swipe
entries: The nihileth makes one Tail attack.

legendary.name: Rotten Drain (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature infected with the nihilethic rot disease within 30 feet of the nihileth takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage, and the nihileth regains hp equal to that amount.

name: Nihilethic Dominator
languages: understands Void Speech and the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Ghostly Body (Void Ghost Form Only)
entries: The nihilethic dominator has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. In addition, the dominator can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the nihilethic dominator to 0 hp, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the dominator drops to 1 hp instead.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The nihilethic dominator doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nihilethic dominator makes three Claw attacks, or it makes two Tendril of the Void attacks.

action.name: Claw (Undead Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Tendril of the Void (Void Ghost Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) cold damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.
