bonus.name: Void Shape
entries: The nihilethic dominator magically transforms into a dark purple, Void ghost form or back into its Undead form. Its statistics, other than its speed and resistances, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying changes with it. It reverts to its Undead form of it dies.

reaction.name: Void Body
entries: When the nihilethic dominator takes damage that isn't radiant, it can reduce the damage by {@dice 1d12}.

name: Nihilethic Zombie
languages: understands Void Speech and the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Ghostly Body (Void Ghost Form Only)
entries: The nihilethic zombie has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. In addition, the zombie can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the nihilethic zombie to 0 hp, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hp instead.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The nihilethic zombie doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Slam (Undead Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Withering Touch (Void Ghost Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d6 + 1}) necrotic damage.

bonus.name: Void Shape
entries: The nihilethic zombie magically transforms into a dark purple, Void ghost form or back into its Undead form. Its statistics, other than its speed and resistances, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying changes with it. It reverts to its Undead form of it dies.

reaction.name: Sacrifice Life
entries: When the nihilethic zombie's controlling nihileth takes damage while within 30 feet of the zombie, the zombie can send its life force to the nihileth. The zombie's hp is reduced by up to the amount of damage the nihileth took, preventing that amount of damage to the nihileth. If this damage reduces the zombie to 0 hp, it is immediately destroyed. A nihileth can benefit from only one zombie's Sacrifice Life for each source of damage it takes.

reaction.name: Void Body
entries: When the nihilethic zombie takes damage that isn't radiant, it can reduce the damage by {@dice 1d12}.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The nkosi has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the nkosi moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Mambele attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the nkosi can make one Bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Mambele (Humanoid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The nkosi transforms into a Large lion or back into its true form, which is Humanoid. Its statistics, other than its size, speed, and AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the pridelord hits with it (included in the attack).

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The pridelord has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the pridelord moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Mambele attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the pridelord can make one Bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pridelord makes three Bite or Mambele attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Pridelord's Roar, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Mambele (Humanoid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage or 11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage if used to make a melee attack.

action.name: Pridelord's Roar {@recharge 4}
entries: Each nkosi of the pridelord's choice within 30 feet of it that can hear it has advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of the pridelord's next turn.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The pridelord transforms into a Large lion or back into its true form, which is Humanoid. Its statistics, other than its size, speed, and AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Eldritch Weapons
entries: The noctiny's weapon attacks are magical. When the noctiny hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d6} force damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The noctiny has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The noctiny makes two Quarterstaff or Eldritch Fury attacks.

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, or 7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage if used in two hands, plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) force damage.

action.name: Eldritch Fury
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) force damage.

trait.name: Arctic Tracker
entries: The Northern hunter has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks to track creatures in forest, cold grassland, and glacial terrain. In addition, {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} composed primarily of snow or ice doesn't cost the Northern hunter extra movement.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Northern hunter makes four attacks, using Longbow or Spear in any combination. The hunter can choose to deal Force damage instead of the weapon's normal damage type.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage. The target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the hunter's next turn. Multiple reductions are not cumulative.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Slashing damage. The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on its next attack roll before the start of the Northern Hunter's next turn.

bonus.name: Slayer (3/Day)
entries: The next attack the Northern hunter makes ignores all {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|Resistances} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immunities} to damage.

bonus.name: Swift Hunter
entries: The Northern hunter moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} toward a {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature it can see.

reaction.name: No Escape
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the Northern hunter can see within 40 feet of it moves into a space more than 10 feet away from it. {@actResponse} {@actSave str} {@dc 16} The hunter flings a bola, tangle of rope, or similar object at the creature. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

name: Nourished Tavern Mimic Brain

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The brain is a 13th-level spellcaster and can cast the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Central Nervous System
entries: The mimic's brain is the central nervous system of the tavern mimic. The first time the brain takes damage on a turn, it takes an additional 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage. As a reaction to taking this damage, the brain can relocate itself to any location within the tavern.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The brain has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the brain fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Sensitive Gut
entries: The brain's blindsight extends throughout its interior structure.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The brain can use its action to polymorph into a different building or back into its true, tavern form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment or creatures it is wearing or carrying aren't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Warded
entries: The brain can't be harmed or affected by attacks or effects that originate from outside of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The brain makes two attacks, one with its Pseudopod and one with its Squirt.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 4d4 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Squirt
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 12} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d4 + 7}) acid damage.

legendaryHeader: The brain can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The brain regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The brain makes one attack.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The brain casts a spell.

legendary.name: Immune Response (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: A torrent of pus gushes from a 20-foot-radius area of the brain's ceiling. Each creature directly under that area must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Nyarlathotep casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 20}):

trait.name: Defeat from Victory
entries: When Nyarlathotep drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or would be killed outright, he is not slain. Instead, his body ripples with energy as it undergoes a horrific transformation. He returns to whatever strange realm he dwells in as his defeated form is torn apart by unseen forces. Mythos creatures with a combined CR of up to 20 emerge from the pile of gore, occupying the nearest, empty space. These creatures attack those who were hostile to Nyarlathotep and fight to the death.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If Nyarlathotep fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Nyarlathotep has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Poisoned Words, Rotten Soul
entries: A creature that succeeds in a Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) check to detect one of Nyarlathotep's lies takes 66 ({@damage 12d10}) Psychic damage and cannot communicate with other creatures for {@dice 3d6} minutes. A creature killed by this trait appears to have died of a heart attack or similar cause.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Nyarlathotep makes two Rending Claw attacks and two Piercing Talon attacks.

action.name: Rending Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, Reach 15 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d8 + 8}) Slashing damage and the target gains the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Piercing Talon
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, Reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 1d10 + 8}) Piercing damage. {@condition Prone|XPHB} creatures have {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to this attack's damage.

action.name: Horrid Tongue Lash {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 24}, creatures of Nyarlathotep's choice within 20 ft. of it; {@actSaveFail} The target takes 66 ({@damage 12d10}) acid damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Shape-Shift
entries: Nyarlathotep shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or it returns to this form. Other than his size, his game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

legendary.name: Swift Claw
entries: Nyarlathotep makes a Rending Claw attack.

legendary.name: Incite Delirium
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 20}, one creature within 120 ft. of Nyarlathotep of its choice; {@actSaveFail} The target uses its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make a weapon attack against a target of Nyarlathotep's choice.

legendary.name: Relentless Horror {@recharge 5}
entries: Nyarlathotep chooses one of the following options:

items: It teleports up to 200 ft. to an unoccupied space.
It immediately ends one spell or condition affecting it.
It ends one spell or magical effect of its choice within 120 ft. of it.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The nymph casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as her spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}).

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The nymph can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Blinding Beauty
entries: When a creature that can see the nymph starts its turn within 30 feet of the nymph, the nymph can force it to make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw if the nymph isn't {@condition incapacitated} and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is permanently {@condition blinded}. Otherwise, a creature that fails its save is {@condition blinded} for 1 minute. A {@condition blinded} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Unless {@status surprised}, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the nymph until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the nymph in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

trait.name: Water Spirit
entries: While the nymph is in contact with or submerged in a body of water, she ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce her speed or cause her to be {@condition restrained}. She can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being {@condition grappled}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nymph uses Nymph's Gaze. She then makes two Dagger attacks.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Nymph's Gaze
entries: The nymph directs her gaze at one creature she can see within 30 feet of her, targeting the creature with one of the following effects:

items.name: Concerned Look
entries: The target regains 10 ({@dice 3d6}) hit points. Once a creature has regained 20 hit points from this stare, it can't regain more hit points from this nymph's Concerned Gaze until it finishes a long rest.

items.name: Glare of Nature's Fury
entries: The target must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Stunning Stare
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or become {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the Stunning Stare of all nymphs for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The troll regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Forest Sense
entries: The troll can pinpoint the location of creatures and moving objects within 120 feet of it as long as both it and the anything it is detecting is in a natural forested area.

trait.name: Shroud of Leaves
entries: The troll is covered head to toe in a shroud of thick leaves. While it has this shroud it is immune to all damage except Fire damage. If the troll takes any Fire damage, the leaves all burn away revealing the gnarled oak wood body of the troll and it loses this trait.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes two Gnarled Claw attacks and one Bite attack

action.name: Gnarled Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 10 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 10 ft. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) Piercing damage and if the target is a creature, the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 2d8}) as thick splinters pierce and remain in the creature's flesh.

bonus.name: Abundant Growth
entries: The troll regains its Shroud of Leaves trait.

bonus.name: Leaf Burst
entries: As long as the troll has its Shroud of Leaves, it can shed its Shroud of Leaves in a burst, losing the trait in the process. {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}, each creature within 15 feet of the troll. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Slashing damage and has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of their next turn.

trait.name: False Appearance (Treant)
entries: While Oakheart remains motionless, he appears as a great oak with charred bark that smolders in places and flames in place of leaves.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The Oakheart deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Oakheart makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) fire damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Animate Trees (1/Day)
entries: Oakheart magically animates one or two trees he can see within 60 feet of him. These trees have the same statistics as Oakheart, except they have Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1, they can't speak, and they have only the Slam action option. An animated tree acts as an ally of Oakheart. The tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies; until Oakheart dies or is more than 120 feet from the tree; or until Oakheart takes a bonus action to turn him back into an inanimate tree. The tree then takes root if possible.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the oblivion brute can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

trait.name: Sunlight Weakness
entries: While in sunlight, the oblivion brute has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

action.name: Soul Drain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d8 + 3}) necrotic damage, and the target must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target's available Hit Dice are reduced by 1. If this effect reduces the target's Hit Dice to 0, the target falls {@condition unconscious}. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, regaining consciousness on a success. Hit Dice lost this way return at the end of a short rest, in time to spend them to regain hit points.

If an oblivion brute kills a living creature with this attack when the creature is at 0 Hit Dice, the target's soul is lost to the realm of shadow. This lost soul can be raised from the dead only with mighty magic, such as wish or divine intervention.

action.name: Unbearable Howl (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The oblivion brute emits a howl in a 30-foot cone. Each creature that isn't {@condition deafened} or undead in the area must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. While {@condition frightened} this way, a creature's speed is halved. A {@condition frightened} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to any oblivion brute's Unbearable Howl for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the oblivion juggernaut can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

trait.name: Sunlight Weakness
entries: While in sunlight, the oblivion juggernaut has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The oblivion juggernaut uses unbearable roar and then uses soul drain.

action.name: Soul Drain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d10 + 4}) necrotic damage, and the target must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target's available Hit Dice are reduced by 2. If this effect reduces the target's Hit Dice to 0, the target falls {@condition unconscious}. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, regaining consciousness on a success. Hit Dice lost this way return at the end of a short rest, in time to spend them to regain hit points.

If an oblivion juggernaut kills a living creature with this attack when the creature is at 0 Hit Dice, the target's soul is lost to the realm of shadow. This lost soul can be raised from the dead only with mighty magic, such as wish or divine intervention.

action.name: Unbearable Roar
entries: Each creature of the oblivion juggernaut's choice that isn't {@condition deafened} and is within 120 feet of the juggernaut must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to any oblivion juggernaut's Unbearable Roar for 24 hours.

trait.name: Shadow Leap
entries: Starting in an area of dim light or darkness, an oblivion leaper can teleport to an unoccupied space also in dim light or darkness. Every foot of teleportation costs the oblivion leaper 1 foot of movement.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the oblivion leaper can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

trait.name: Sunlight Weakness
entries: While in sunlight, the oblivion leaper has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

action.name: Soul Drain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) necrotic damage, and the target must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target's available Hit Dice are reduced by 1. If this effect reduces the target's Hit Dice to 0, the target falls {@condition unconscious}. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, regaining consciousness on a success. Hit Dice lost this way return at the end of a short rest, in time to spend them to regain hit points.

If an oblivion leaper kills a living creature with this attack when the creature is at 0 Hit Dice, the target's soul is lost to the realm of shadow. This lost soul can be raised from the dead only with mighty magic, such as wish or divine intervention.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the oblivion whistler can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

trait.name: Sunlight Weakness
entries: While in sunlight, the oblivion whistler has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

trait.name: Unbearable Whistling
entries: Creatures of the oblivion whistler's choice that aren't {@condition deafened} and start their turn within 30 feet of the oblivion whistler must make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw. A target that fails is {@condition frightened} until the start of its next turn and unable to hide the distress of hearing the whistling, which is the source of the fear and considered to be within line of sight while the target can hear and is within 30 feet of it. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to any oblivion whistler's Unbearable Whistling for 1 hour.

action.name: Soul Drain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) necrotic damage, and the target must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target's available Hit Dice are reduced by 1. If this effect reduces the target's Hit Dice to 0, the target falls {@condition unconscious}. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, regaining consciousness on a success. Hit Dice lost this way return at the end of a short rest, in time to spend them to regain hit points.

If an oblivion whistler kills a living creature with this attack when the creature is at 0 Hit Dice, the target's soul is lost to the realm of shadow. This lost soul can be raised from the dead only with mighty magic, such as wish or divine intervention.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Elson's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks), requiring no material components:

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Elson is an 18th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks). Elson regains his expended spell slots when he finishes a short or long rest. He knows the following warlock spells:

spells: {@spell eldritch blast} (4 beams, +5 to each damage roll)

trait.name: Eldritch Heads (6/Day)
entries: When Elson hits a creature with an attack, he can cause the target to take an extra 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage. Alternatively, as a bonus action, Elson can regain 11 ({@dice 2d10}) hit points. While Elson has at least one use of this trait remaining, he can't be {@status surprised} and creatures with the Pack Tactics trait gain no benefit from that trait against him.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Eldritch Frenzy {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, range 120 ft., up to four targets. {@h}22 ({@damage 5d8}) force damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw or become {@condition stunned} until the end of Elson's next turn.

variant.name: Ochre Elson with Morath, Scepter of the Soul Vortex
entries: Morath, Scepter of the Soul Vortex is an artifact born from a fragment of the Thousand Voices. At the GM's discretion, Elson can wield the scepter, causing the following changes to his stat block:

items: He has a challenge rating of 12 (8,400 XP).
He has resistance to necrotic damage.
He gains a +3 bonus to his spell attack rolls and spell save DC, including for his Eldritch Roar action option (spell save {@dc 20}, +12 to hit with spell attacks).
He knows the {@spell chill touch} cantrip, and can cast the {@spell finger of death} spell once per day.
He has the Bestow Greater Curses and Morath, Scepter of the Soul Vortex traits, as well as the Phantasmal Skull action option (all described below).

entries.name: Bestow Greater Curse (1/Day)
entries: When Elson casts {@spell bestow curse} he can force the target to make its saving throw with disadvantage. On a failed save, the target is simultaneously cursed by all four of the spell's listed options.

entries.name: Morath, Scepter of the Soul Vortex
entries: The rod has 8 charges and regains {@dice 1d3 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. When Elson reduces a humanoid to 0 hit points, the rod regains 1 expended charge. While holding the rod, Elson can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells (save {@dc 20}, attack bonus +12) from it: bestow curse (1 charge), circle of death (4 charges), confusion (2 charges), insect plague (3 charges), ray of enfeeblement (1 charge), or speak with dead (1 charge).

entries.name: Phantasmal Skull
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +12 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage, and Elson regains hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt.

name: Octahedrooze

trait.name: Reactive Mutations
entries: Immediately after the ooze takes damage, it gains resistance to that damage type. The ooze can have up to three resistances from this trait. If the ooze has its maximum number of resistances, the oldest resistance is lost when a new one is gained.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze makes two Pseudopod attacks. It can replace one attack with Engulf.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The ooze moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Small or smaller  creatures' spaces. Whenever the ooze enters a creature's space, the creature must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the ooze. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

On a failed save, the ooze enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is {@condition restrained}, and takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage at the start of each of the ooze's turns. When the ooze moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a {@dc 14} Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage and the target suffers one of the following random effects (roll a {@dice d8}):
1. The target takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) force damage.
2. The target takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage.
3. The target takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) piercing damage.
4. The target takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) slashing damage.
5. The target takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) cold damage.
6. The target takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage.
7. The target takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) lightning damage.
8. The target takes 4 ({@damage 1d8})thunder damage.

legendaryHeader: The ooze can take 1 legendary action, choosing the option below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The ooze regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The ooze makes one Pseudopod attack

trait.name: Enraged
entries: While {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, the octarine tree gains {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all attack rolls.

trait.name: Plant Camouflage
entries: The octarine tree has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks made to {@action Hide|XPHB} in forests.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The octarine tree deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The octarine tree makes three attacks.

action.name: Thwack
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d12 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed 10 feet and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Crushing Roots
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 20 ft. {@h}25 ({@damage 3d12 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. The octarine tree can grapple up to four creatures at a time.

action.name: Delerium Fruit
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 10}, range 60/120 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Necrotic damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. Failure by 5 or More: The target triggers an {@table Arcane Anomalies|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} centered on itself.

bonus.name: Take Root
entries: If the octarine tree has not moved this round, it can plant itself into the ground. It regains 18 ({@dice 4d8}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of its next turn. While {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, the octarine tree has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Prone|XPHB}, and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, and its AC increases to 20. These benefits end early if the tree takes Fire damage.

trait.name: Hundreds of Eyes
entries: The oculo swarm has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight and on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}. In addition, if the swarm isn't {@condition blinded}, creatures attacking it can't benefit from traits and features that rely on a creature's allies distracting or surrounding the swarm, such as the Pack Tactics trait or Sneak Attack class feature.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny eyeball. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The oculo swarm makes two Extract Eye attacks. If both attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or the swarm removes one of its eyes. While missing half or fewer of its total number of eyes, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight. While missing more than half its total number of eyes, the target is {@condition blinded} until its sight is restored. If the target's eye is recovered from the defeated swarm, it can be reattached with a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check, provided the eye is reattached within 1 hour of the target losing the eye.

action.name: Extract Eye
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) piercing damage, or 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hp or fewer.

action.name: Disorienting Gaze {@recharge 5}
entries: The swarm's many eyes suddenly turn in different directions. Each creature within 10 feet of the oculo swarm must make a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage and is disoriented until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't disoriented. A disoriented creature is {@condition incapacitated} and moves in a random direction when it moves.

name: Odwald Ebonhart
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Odwald is a 9th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 15}, +7 to hit with spell attacks). Odwald has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Odwald can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. Odwald lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. Odwald cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

trait.name: Talons
entries: Odwald has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface his talons could reasonably grip.

trait.name: Convincing
entries: Odwald has advantage on all Charisma checks used to convince someone of his knowledge of subject matter pertaining to the Arcana skill.

trait.name: Life Leech
entries: Once per turn, when Odwald kills one or more creatures with a spell of 1st level or higher, he can regain hit points equal to twice the level of the spell, or three times the level if it is a necromancy spell.

action.name: Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d6 - 1}) bludgeoning damage, or 3 ({@damage 1d8 - 1}) bludgeoning damage if wielded with both hands.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Ogden is a 15th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Empowered Undead
entries: Any undead that is under Ogden's control has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead. In addition, it gains a +5 bonus to its attack and damage rolls, and its hit point maximum increases by 20.

trait.name: Leech (5/Day)
entries: When Ogden hits a creature with his quarterstaff that isn't a construct or undead, he can choose to deal an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage and regain hit points equal to the number rolled.

action.name: Leeching Quarterstaff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage, or 6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

bonus.name: Grave Sacrifice
entries: As a bonus action, Ogden can cause one undead under his control to drop to 0 hit points. When he does so, he gains 14 ({@dice 4d6}) temporary hit points.

reaction.name: Grim Revival (3/Day)
entries: Immediately after Ogden kills a humanoid, he causes it to rise as a zombie under his control, as if by the {@spell animate dead} spell.

trait.name: Defiant Anger
entries: When the ogre has half their hit points or fewer, they are resistant to mundane bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ogre makes one Spiked Club attack and one Fist attack.

action.name: Spiked Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). Until this grapple ends, the ogre can't use this fist to attack other targets. The ogre has two fists, one of which holds their club.

action.name: People-Bowling
entries: The ogre throws one Medium or smaller creature they are grappling up to 30 feet horizontally. Each creature in the thrown creature's path must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. After this throw, the thrown creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage and falls {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Bellow (1/Day)
entries: The ogre yells in the face of one creature within 10 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the ogre until the end of the ogre's next turn. A creature who succeeds on their saving throw is immune to all ogres' Bellow for 24 hours.

reaction.name: Violent Focus (1/Day)
entries: If the ogre takes damage while {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, or {@condition poisoned}, they end these conditions on themself.

hp.special: Nine times their level (number of d12 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Spiked Club)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 2d4 plus PB} piercing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the basher can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Angry Denial (3/Day)
entries: When the basher takes damage from a creature the basher can see within 5 feet of them, the basher can use their reaction to instead take no damage and make a signature attack against the creature.

action.name: 5th Level: Throw Away (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the basher grabs a willing Medium or smaller creature they can see within 5 feet of them and hurls the creature to an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the basher. If the creature lands within 5 feet of an enemy, the creature can use a reaction to make a melee attack against that enemy.

action.name: 7th Level: Wide Sweep (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the basher sweeps their spiked club in an enormous circle, making a signature attack against each enemy within 10 feet of them. This attack has a +PB bonus to its attack and damage rolls, and if it hits a Large or smaller creature, the basher can push the target up to 10 feet away from them.

trait.name: Magic-Infused Weapons
entries: The power coursing through the corrupted chieftain's veins flows into its weapons. The chieftain's weapon attacks are magical. When the chieftain hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 2d8} force damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Spiked Hide
entries: A creature that touches the ogre or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The corrupted ogre can use its Chieftain's Command or Chieftain's Might. It then makes two Greatclub or Javelin attacks.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) force damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) force damage.

action.name: Chieftain's Command
entries: The corrupted chieftain barks an order to one Giant it can see within 30 feet of it, sharing a measure of its power with the target. The target has advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of the chieftain's next turn. In addition, the next attack roll against the target before the start of the chieftain's next turn has disadvantage.

action.name: Chieftain's Might
entries: The corrupted chieftain causes its eyes to glow, its muscles to swell, and the ground beneath its feet to rumble. Each creature within 15 feet of the chieftain must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Aggressive
entries: The corrupted chieftain moves up to its speed toward a hostile creature it can see.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the goon takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the goon takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Fist (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 bludgeoning damage, and if this attack was made by more than one goon, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and moved up to 10 feet horizontally. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 plus the number of goons who joined the attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Requires Animal Mask)
headerEntries: The chosen casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components other than its Animal Mask and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Animal Mask
entries: The chosen wears the mask of an animal, imbuing it with the strength of the old gods. When a creature is grappling the chosen, the creature can remove the mask as an action, or as an attack during the Attack action, with a successful {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check. Without its mask, the chosen can't cast spells, its {@status Concentration|XPHB} on any existing spells ends, and the save DC of Song of the Old Ways is reduced by 4.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chosen makes three {@variantrule Ritual|XPHB} Dagger attacks.

action.name: Ritual Dagger
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Radiant or Necrotic damage (the chosen's choice).

action.name: Songs of the Old Ways {@recharge 5}
entries: The chosen sings one of the following songs:

action.name: Blessing of the Harvest
entries: Each creature of the chosen's choice in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the chosen regains 14 ({@dice 4d4 + 4}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

action.name: Song of Sacrifice
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 14}, one creature within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 40 ({@damage 9d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition until the end of the chosen's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Wicker Chant
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 14}, each creature of the chosen's choice in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the chosen. {@actSaveFail} 31 ({@damage 9d6}) Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

bonus.name: Jump (Requires Animal Mask)
entries: The chosen casts {@spell Jump|XPHB}, using the same spell components and spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The olothec can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The olothec is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: The olothec has advantage on saving throws against supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The olothec makes six Devolving Tentacle attacks and uses Piscine Transformation.

action.name: Devolving Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) piercing damage. The first time a creature is hit with this attack on a turn, they must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be injected with a degenerative psionic slime (save ends at end of turn). While slimed, each time the creature makes an attack roll or an ability check, they must roll a {@dice d4} and subtract the number rolled from the {@dice d20} roll. At the end of a slimed creature's turn, the size of the subtracted die increases by one: the {@dice d4} becomes a {@dice d6}, the {@dice d6} becomes a {@dice d8}, and so on, to a maximum of {@dice d12}. The {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power or {@spell lesser restoration} spell also ends this effect.

action.name: Piscine Transformation (3rd-Order Power)
entries: The olothec targets a Humanoid they can see within 60 feet of them with a pulse of transformational energy. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or undergo one of the following transformations of the olothec's choice:

items: {@b Head.} The target's head transforms into the head of a fish, proportionately sized for their body. They can't speak.
{@b Legs.} The target's legs become fins. Their walking speed is reduced to 10 feet (unless their walking speed is slower), and they gain a swimming speed of 30 feet.

{@b Torso.} The target's torso becomes the body of a fish with gills. They can only breathe water and can hold their breath for 1 hour. If the target isn't underwater when this transformation takes effect, they begin suffocating.

entries: This transformation lasts until the target is affected by a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power of 4th order or higher or a {@spell greater restoration} spell. A target who suffers all three transformations at once is permanently transformed into a hybrid fishlike creature and can only be returned to their original form by a {@spell wish} spell or similar magic.

bonus.name: Jaunt (3rd-Order Power)
entries: The olothec teleports 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Oma casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}):

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Oma fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Shadowy Weapons
entries: Oma's weapon attacks are magical. When Oma hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 2d8} necrotic damage (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Oma makes two Mentor's Cane attacks or one Mentor's Cane attack and one Scold attack.

action.name: Mentor's Cane
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Scold
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Call Children (1/Day)
entries: Oma magically calls {@dice 2d4} skeletons or zombies or one orphan of the black (see Tome of Beasts 2 or substitute with will-o'-wisp). The called creatures arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of Oma and obeying her spoken commands. The creatures remain for 1 hour or until Oma dies or dismisses them as a bonus action.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: Oma turns {@condition invisible} until she attacks or uses Call Children or until her {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment she wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with her.

bonus.name: Keeper of the Children
entries: Oma instructs one allied skeletons, zombies, or orphan of the black (see Tome of Beasts 2 or substitute with will-o'-wisp) within 30 feet of her to make one attack as a reaction against a creature Oma attacked this round.

legendary.name: Flight
entries: Oma flies up to half her flying speed.

legendary.name: Mentor's Cane
entries: Oma makes one Mentor's Cane attack.

legendary.name: Time to Play
entries: Oma commands all skeletons, zombies, and orphans of the black (see Tome of Beasts 2 or substitute with will-o'-wisp) she controls within 60 feet of her to move up to half their speed. A creature that moves out of an enemy's reach because of this movement doesn't provoke an opportunity attack.

legendary.name: Oma Knows Best (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Oma targets one creature she can see within 30 feet of her. The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition charmed} for 1 minute. The {@condition charmed} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to Oma Knows Best for the next 24 hours.

name: Oozasis
languages: telepathy 120 ft. understands all languages but can't speak

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The oozasis can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Oasis Appearance
entries: While the oozasis remains motionless and partially submerged on the surface of sand or soil, it is indistinguishable from a small oasis or pond. The oozasis's body provides enough water for plants to grow around it, provided the oozasis remains in the area for an extended period of time. A creature that eats a fruit from a plant growing in the oozasis's water is affected by the Waters of Unfathomable Compulsion trait as if it drank the water.

trait.name: Ooze Nature
entries: The oozasis doesn't require sleep.

trait.name: Waters of Unfathomable Compulsion
entries: A creature that drinks the water of an oozasis experiences a cryptic dream the next time it sleeps. When it wakes, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be affected by the {@spell geas} spell for 30 days. While under the geas, the affected creature must perform a specific, seemingly minor task that furthers the decades-long goals of the oozasis. Such a task could be planting a white rose in a specific garden, rescuing the next endangered young animal the target encounters, or standing in a specific spot at a certain time each day for three days.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The oozasis makes three Pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}. The oozasis can have up to two creatures {@condition grappled} at a time.

action.name: Compelling Vapors {@recharge 5}
entries: The oozasis emits mind-altering vapors. Each creature within 20 feet of the oozasis must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 45 ({@damage 10d8}) psychic damage and suffers either tranquility or turmoil for minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and doesn't suffer tranquility or turmoil. A creature suffering tranquility is {@condition charmed} and can't attack. A creature suffering turmoil is unable to distinguish friend from foe and must move to and attack the nearest creature other than the oozasis on each of its turns, stalking off in a random direction if no creature is in range. A creature suffering tranquility or turmoil can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The oozing vulture has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The oozing vulture has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, the oracle can cast the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Turbulent Escalation
entries: When the oracle starts their turn outdoors while not {@condition incapacitated}, they can stoke a thunderstorm (no action required). For 1 minute or until the oracle uses Turbulent Escalation again, the weather in a 1-mile radius centered on the oracle changes as follows:

items: If the sky is cloudless, it becomes cloudy.
If the sky is cloudy, it begins to rain or snow (oracle's choice).
If it's raining or snowing, the weather becomes stormy.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The oracle uses Tempest Bolt twice. They can replace one use with a Cyclone Staff attack.

action.name: Cyclone Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) thunder damage, and the oracle moves the target up to 10 feet in any direction.

action.name: Tempest Bolt
entries: A bolt of lightning streaks from the oracle to strike one creature they can see within 90 feet of them, or within 300 feet of them if the target is outdoors and the weather is stormy. The target must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 ({@damage 7d8}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target is outdoors and the weather is stormy, they have disadvantage on the saving throw.

bonus.name: Convocation of Storms (2/Day)
entries: The oracle imbues the power of storm in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Lightning Within.} The Elemental becomes charged with lightning. The next time the Elemental hits a target with an attack within the next minute, the attack deals an extra 33 ({@damage 6d10}) lightning damage.

{@b Thunder Burst.} A concussive shock wave erupts from the Elemental toward four creatures they can see within 60 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) thunder damage, be pushed up to 10 feet away from the Elemental, and be {@condition deafened} until the end of the target's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The ratling casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The ratling has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Death Toll
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, one creature the ratling can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 45 ({@damage 10d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Squeak of Doom (1/Day)
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 16}, each {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the ratling that can hear it. {@actSaveFail} 55 ({@damage 10d10}) Psychic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

bonus.name: Ratling Cunning
entries: The ratling takes the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

reaction.name: Tail Barbs
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the ratling can see within 60 feet succeeds on a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}. {@actResponse} The ratling forces the triggering creature to reroll the {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} and use the lower roll.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The Orange Slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Explosive
entries: If the Orange Slime takes fire damage, a portion of its body explodes. Each creature within 10 feet of the slime must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking fire damage equal to the amount dealt to the slime on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Steaming
entries: If water touches the Orange Slime, a burning hot wave of steam erupts from it, filling the area within 20 feet of the slime. The area is heavily obscured until the end of the slime's next turn or until a strong wind disperses it. This steam doesn't impede the vision of Orange and {@creature Yellow Slime|ObojimaTallGrass|Yellow Slimes}.

trait.name: Sulfurous Haze
entries: Creatures within 60 feet of the slime take a -5 penalty to ranged attack rolls against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Orange Slime makes two Spike attacks and uses its Arrange.

action.name: Spike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@dice 2d8}) fire damage.

action.name: Arrange
entries: The Orange Slime attempts to pull a creature within 10 feet of it through its body and into another space. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) fire damage and be moved to an unoccupied space within 15 feet of the slime.

hp.special: Eight times their level (number of d10 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Warhammer)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d10 plus PB} bludgeoning damage. Beginning at 7th level, the blacksmith can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Relentless Rush (3/Day)
entries: When the blacksmith isn't {@condition incapacitated} and they take damage but aren't killed outright, they can make an attack against an enemy (no action required) before the hit point reduction is resolved. If the attack hits, the blacksmith regains twice their PB hit points.

action.name: 5th Level: Reinforce Armor (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the blacksmith touches a piece of armor and fortifies it. For the next 10 minutes, a creature wearing the armor gains a bonus to their AC equal to half the blacksmith's PB.

action.name: 7th Level: Fortify Weapon (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the blacksmith touches a weapon and polishes it. For 1 minute, the weapon is magical and deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} damage.

trait.name: Gnashing Horde
entries: If an enemy the blitzer can see starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more blitzers, the enemy takes 1 piercing damage for each blitzer within 5 feet of them.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the blitzer takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the blitzer takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Relentless Minion
entries: When the blitzer is reduced to 0 hit points while they aren't {@condition incapacitated}, they can deal 1 piercing damage to an enemy within 5 feet of them.

action.name: Spear (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage.

trait.name: Relentless (1/Turn)
entries: When the bloodrunner isn't {@condition incapacitated} and they are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, they can make an attack against an enemy (no action required) before the hit point reduction is resolved. If the attack hits and its damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the bloodrunner drops to 1 hit point instead of 0 hit points.

trait.name: Unimpeded
entries: The bloodrunner can occupy a {@condition prone} creature's space. The first time the bloodrunner enters a {@condition prone} creature's space on the bloodrunner's turn, the {@condition prone} creature takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage. When a {@condition prone} creature in the bloodrunner's space stands up, the creature enters the nearest unoccupied space of their choice.

action.name: Spiked Shield
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage. If the bloodrunner moves at least 10 feet before hitting a Large or smaller creature with this attack, the bloodrunner can choose to knock the target {@condition prone} or push them up to 10 feet away.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Juke
entries: When the bloodrunner makes a Dexterity saving throw, they can gain advantage on the save. To do so, the bloodrunner can't be {@condition prone}, {@condition grappled}, or {@condition restrained}.

resist.special: determined by the conduit's affinity trait

trait.name: Affinity
entries: The conduit has a lifelong affinity for one of the following damage types: cold, fire, or lightning. The chosen type determines the conduit's damage resistance and the damage of their Elemental Discharge and Power Burst actions.

trait.name: Relentless (1/Turn)
entries: When the conduit isn't {@condition incapacitated} and they are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, they can make an attack against an enemy (no action required) before the hit point reduction is resolved. If the attack hits and its damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the conduit drops to 1 hit point instead of 0 hit points.

action.name: Elemental Discharge (Cantrip)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d12 + 3}) damage of the type determined by the conduit's Affinity trait.

action.name: Power Burst (2/Day; 1st-Level Spell)
entries: The conduit unleashes explosive energy in a 15-foot cone. The ground in that area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in that area must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage of the type determined by the conduit's Affinity trait, and they are pushed 10 feet away from the conduit. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.

bonus.name: Rush
entries: The conduit takes the Dash action.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the forcecaller takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the forcecaller takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Relentless Minion
entries: When the forcecaller is reduced to 0 hit points while they aren't {@condition incapacitated}, they can deal 1 force damage to an enemy within 5 feet of them.

action.name: Chainspoken (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}1 force damage. If two or more forcecallers joined the attack, they can deal the same amount of force damage to another creature within 10 feet of the target.

trait.name: Relentless (1/Turn)
entries: When the fury isn't {@condition incapacitated} and they are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, they can make an attack against an enemy (no action required) before the hit point reduction is resolved. If the attack hits and its damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the fury drops to 1 hit point instead of 0 hit points.

action.name: Haymaker Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d12 + 3}) slashing damage, or 12 ({@damage 1d12 + 6}) slashing damage if the target is {@condition prone}. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Healing Rally (1/Day)
entries: The fury regains 5 hit points.

trait.name: Relentless (1/Turn)
entries: When the garroter isn't {@condition incapacitated} and they are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, they can make an attack against an enemy (no action required) before the hit point reduction is resolved. If the attack hits and its damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the garroter drops to 1 hit point instead of 0 hit points.

action.name: Strangle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). Until the grapple ends, the target can't speak intelligibly or cast spells with verbal components. If the attack was made with advantage, the target must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target falls {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute (save ends at start of turn) or until they take damage. A creature can use an action to shake another creature awake who falls {@condition unconscious} in this way.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage. If the attack was made with advantage, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Cloak (1/Day)
entries: The garroter magically turns {@condition invisible} for 1 minute. Any equipment the garroter wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with them. While {@condition invisible}, the garroter's movements make no sound. If the garroter hits a creature with an attack, casts a spell, or takes damage, the effect ends.

trait.name: Relentless (1/Turn)
entries: When the godcaller isn't {@condition incapacitated} and they are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, they can make an attack against an enemy (no action required) before the hit point reduction is resolved. If the attack hits and its damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the godcaller drops to 1 hit point instead of 0 hit points.

action.name: Power Chord (1st-Level Spell)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature who can hear the godcaller. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) thunder damage.

action.name: Cadenza
entries: The godcaller chooses another creature within 30 feet of them. If the target can hear the godcaller, the target can use their reaction to move up to their speed and make an attack.

action.name: Song of the Gods (2nd-Level Spell)
entries: The godcaller and each ally within 30 feet of them who can hear them has advantage on attack rolls until the start of the godcaller's next turn. This effect ends early if the godcaller takes any damage.

bonus.name: Rallying Ostinato (1/Day)
entries: The godcaller and up to three allies within 60 feet of them who can hear them regain 20 hit points, and these creatures ignore difficult terrain for 1 minute.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: The Orc Guard deals an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the Orc Guard that isn't incapacitated and the Orc Guard doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the Orc Guard has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Orc Guard makes two melee attacks, or one melee attack and one ranged attack.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage, or 6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

variant.name: Hateful Orcs
entries: Some Orcs direct their spite towards some specific folk. To reflect this, the Loremaster may add to an Orc adversary the Hatred special trait.

items.name: Hatred (subject) (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As a bonus action, the creature can gain advantage on attack rolls against the subject of its hatred until the start of its next turn.

For example, the Orcs and Goblins of Goblin-town hate Dwarves, and will attack a Company that includes Dwarves with blind fury. The Orcs of Mount Gram fiercely hate all Hobbits instead, and will relentlessly attack a Company including any.

entries: As a bonus action, the Orc Guard can gain advantage on attack rolls against the subject of its hatred until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Spear

reaction.name: No!
entries: When an enemy within 5 feet of the rampart targets another creature with an attack, the attacker must target the rampart instead.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The rampart can breathe air and water.

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage, or 7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Yell of Triumph (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: Each creature of the Orc-chieftain's choice that is within 30 feet of it and can hear it gain advantage on attack rolls and Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks until the start of the Orc-chieftain's next turn. The Orc-chieftain can then make one attack as a bonus action.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The Orc-chieftain adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the Orc-chieftain must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

variant.name: Hateful Orcs
entries: Some Orcs direct their spite towards some specific folk. To reflect this, the Loremaster may add to an Orc adversary the Hatred special trait.

items.name: Hatred (subject) (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As a bonus action, the creature can gain advantage on attack rolls against the subject of its hatred until the start of its next turn.

For example, the Orcs and Goblins of Goblin-town hate Dwarves, and will attack a Company that includes Dwarves with blind fury. The Orcs of Mount Gram fiercely hate all Hobbits instead, and will relentlessly attack a Company including any.

items.name: Hatred (subject) (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As a bonus action, the Orc-chieftain can gain advantage on attack rolls against the subject of its hatred until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Corrupt Desire
entries: A humanoid may bind themselves to the ordeal tree. Each day the petitioner is bound to the tree, they must succeed on a Constitution saving throw with a DC equal to 15 + number of days bound or suffer a level of {@condition exhaustion}. If they survive for 7 days, the ordeal tree may choose to grant a blessing. The tree only does this if the humanoid is evil, once per humanoid. If the humanoid is neutral or good, the tree attacks them.

The blessing is tailored to the petitioner's desires (GM discretion) but might include +1 to an ability score, a feat, expertise in a skill, or the ability to innately cast a 3rd-level (or lower) spell once per day using Charisma as the petitioner's spellcasting ability.

The petitioner also contracts the curse of foul blight (Grim Hallow Campaign Guide). If the petitioner commits a profoundly evil act every day, the curse never advances beyond stage 1. If the petitioner fails to commit the act, the curse automatically escalates.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the ordeal tree remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

trait.name: Heart Sight
entries: The ordeal tree knows the alignment and desires of any creature that binds itself to the tree.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ordeal tree makes two slam attacks and one attack with a vine or enervate.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}29 ({@damage 4d10 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Vine
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) slashing damage, and the creature is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).

action.name: Enervate (2/Day)
entries: A creature bound to the ordeal tree or {@condition grappled} by it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or suffer 44 ({@damage 8d10}) necrotic damage. The ordeal tree gains temporary hit points equal to half the damage done.

trait.name: Alien Mind
entries: If a creature tries to read Orlassk's thoughts or deals Psychic damage to it, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 22} Intelligence saving throw or have the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. The {@condition Stunned|XPHB} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Curse of Stone
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of Orlassk must make a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save the creature has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the start of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If a {@condition Restrained|XPHB} creature fails a saving throw against this trait, it instead has the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition. The {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition lasts until the creature is freed by the {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB} spell or other similar magic. Creatures that have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition are not {@condition Restrained|XPHB} by this trait.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Orlassk fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Orlassk has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Orlassk regains 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn. If Orlassk takes Radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of Orlassk's next turn. Orlassk dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Orlassk makes two attacks with its Claw, and two attacks with its Stone Fist Symbiont.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 5 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d6 + 7}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Stone Fist Symbiont
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 5 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Quickstone Shaping
entries: Orlassk shapes a new minion from among those that have fallen victim to its curse. One {@condition Petrified|XPHB} creature of Orlassk's choice that it can see within 60 feet no longer has the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition, but is polymorphed into a stoneborn form. While transformed, the target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition, and follows Orlassk's commands to the best of its ability. The new form can be any stoneborn Beast, Humanoid, Giant, or Monstrosity whose {@variantrule Challenge Rating|XPHB} is equal to or less than the target's (or the target's level, if it doesn't have a {@variantrule Challenge Rating|XPHB}). The target's game statistics, including mental ability scores, are replaced by the statistics of the chosen form.
The transformation lasts for 1 minute or until the target dies. In its new form, the target gains 40

action.name: Temporary Hit Points
entries: The effect ends early on the target if it has no {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} left. If the effect ends as a result of dropping to 0 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, any excess damage carries over to its normal form.
The creature is limited in the actions it can perform by the nature of its new form, and it can't speak or cast spells.
The target's gear melds into the new form. The creature can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment.

bonus.name: Teleport
entries: Orlassk teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reaction.name: Stonehide Wings
entries: Orlassk gains {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against one attack that would hit it. To do so, it must be able to see the attacker.

legendary.name: Quickstone Reach
entries: Orlassk makes a Stone Fist Symbiont attack. The reach for this attack is 120 feet.

legendary.name: Belief in Stone
entries: Orlassk targets a creature it can see within 60 feet. The target must make a {@dc 22} Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage and believes one of its arms has been turned to stone until the end of its next turn.
While affected, the creature cannot make use of an item it is holding with that arm (though it can switch a held item to a different hand).

legendary.name: Whispers of the Statues (2 Legendary Actions)
entries: Orlassk chooses a point it can see within 60 feet.

Creatures within 20 feet of that point must make a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) Psychic damage and has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.
