A creature {@condition Frightened|XPHB} by this ability can communicate telepathically with any {@condition Petrified|XPHB} creature or any creature affected by Quickstone Shaping that is within 120 ft.

name: Orn Proudbeak
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Orn can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. Orn can't glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

trait.name: Seedspeech
entries: Orn can communicate simple ideas to living plants, and is able to interpret their responses in simple language.

trait.name: Wing Flap
entries: As a bonus action, Orn can use his powerful feathered arms to propel himself upward up to half his movement speed. Orn can use this in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

action.name: Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 1} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 ({@damage 1d4 - 1}) bludgeoning damage or 2 ({@damage 1d6 - 1}) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The orobas casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}):

trait.name: Deceptive Advice
entries: When the orobas casts a spell of the divination school, it has advantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) checks for 1 minute.

trait.name: Hellish Weapons
entries: The orobas's weapon attacks are magical. When the orobas hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 3d8} fire damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The orobas has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Sense Consecrated
entries: The orobas can pinpoint the location of Celestials, consecrated places or objects, and creatures wielding divine or celestial power, such as clerics, paladins, or aasimars, within 60 feet of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The orobas makes one Bite attack, one Flail attack, and one Stomp attack, or it makes four Hurl Flame attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) piercing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) fire damage and 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Flail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d8 + 8}) bludgeoning damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) fire damage.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d6 + 8}) bludgeoning damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) fire damage.

action.name: Hurl Flame
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) fire damage.

action.name: Teleport
entries: The orobas magically teleports, along with any equipment, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reaction.name: Prediction (3/Day)
entries: When the orobas makes an ability check or attack, it can choose to have advantage on the roll.

trait.name: Forbiddance
entries: An orphan of the black can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

trait.name: Sense Law
entries: An orphan of the black can pinpoint the location of a lawful creature within 30 feet of it.

trait.name: Transmit Pain
entries: A creature that hits the orphan of the black with an attack must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The orphan of the black makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Incite Violence {@recharge 5}
entries: The orphan of the black forces a creature it can see within 15 feet of it to commit an outburst of violence. The target must make a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must use its action on its next turn to attack the nearest creature other than the orphan of the black. On a success, the creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage from the violence boiling at the edge of its consciousness. A creature immune to being {@condition charmed} isn't affected by the orphan's Incite Violence.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Oscar Yoren is a 9th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). Oscar Yoren has the following wizard spells prepared:

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

name: Ostinato
languages: telepathy 120 ft. understands Common but can't speak

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The ostinato can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Invisibility
entries: The ostinato is {@condition invisible}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ostinato has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ostinato makes two Cacophony Burst attacks.

action.name: Cacophony Burst
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d8 + 3}) thunder damage.

action.name: Aural Symbiosis {@recharge}
entries: One Humanoid that the ostinato can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or the ostinato merges with the target, becoming an enjoyable, repetitive tune in its host's mind. The ostinato can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, and it can't attack. The host retains control of its body and is aware of the ostinato's presence only as a melody, not as a living entity. The host no longer needs to eat or drink, gains the ostinato's Magic Resistance trait, and has advantage on Charisma checks. In addition, the host has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws, and it can't maintain {@status concentration} on spells or other effects. At the end of each long rest, the host can make a {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check, realizing that the music it hears comes from an external entity on a success.

The Aural Symbiosis lasts until the host drops to 0 hp, the ostinato ends it as a bonus action, or the ostinato is forced out by an effect like the {@spell dispel evil and good} spell. When the Aural Symbiosis ends, the ostinato bursts out from the host's mind in a thunderous explosion of sound, reappearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the host. Each creature within 15 feet of the ostinato when it exits, including the host, must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The host is immune to this ostinato's Aural Symbiosis for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the Aural Symbiosis ends.

action.name: Contagious Tune (1/Day)
entries: While merged with a Humanoid host, the ostinato fills the minds of nearby creatures with the same catchy tune playing in its host's mind. Each creature within 30 feet of the ostinato's host must make a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The ostinato then gains temporary hp equal to the single highest amount of psychic damage dealt. A {@condition deafened} creature is immune to Contagious Tune.

trait.name: Occupation
entries: Wealthy landowner

trait.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Grim, Secretive

trait.name: Adjustable Appendages
entries: The otyugh has seven adjustable appendages, which they can convert into other appendages using their Transform bonus action. In their natural state, the otyugh has one eyestalk, three legs, and three tentacles. These appendages grant the following benefits:

items: {@b Eyestalks.} The otyugh's first eyestalk gives them darkvision out to a range of 60 feet and immunity to the {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} condition, and each additional eyestalk increases their darkvision's range by 60 feet. If the otyugh has no eyestalks, they are {@condition blinded} and lose immunity to the {@condition flanked|FleeMortals} condition.
{@b Legs.} Each leg gives the otyugh a cumulative walking speed of 15 feet.
{@b Tentacles.} The otyugh's number of tentacles determine how many attacks they can make with Multiattack and how many creatures they can grapple with Tentacle Slam.

trait.name: Limited Telepathy
entries: The otyugh can magically transmit simple messages and images to any creature within 120 feet of them that can understand a language. This form of telepathy doesn't allow the receiving creature to telepathically respond.

trait.name: Rot Leech
entries: At the start of each of the otyugh's turns, each creature {@condition grappled} by the otyugh has their hit point maximum reduced by 5 ({@damage 1d10}) for 1 hour. The otyugh regains the same number of hit points. This effect can't reduce a creature's hit point maximum below their current hit points.

trait.name: Trash Traversal
entries: The otyugh ignores difficult terrain. They also have advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in piles of refuse.

trait.name: Vile Stench
entries: A creature who starts their turn within 10 feet of the otyugh must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of the creature's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The otyugh makes one Tentacle Slam attack for each tentacle they currently have (see Adjustable Appendages).

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be diseased with otyuck. A creature with otyuck can't take the Dash action and their speed is halved.

action.name: Tentacle Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}) and {@condition restrained} until the grapple ends. The otyugh can grapple one target for each tentacle they currently have.

bonus.name: Transform
entries: The otyugh converts one of their Adjustable Appendages into an eyestalk, leg, or tentacle.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

trait.name: Trash Traversal
entries: The otyugh ignores difficult terrain. They have advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in piles of refuse.

action.name: Signature Attack (Bite)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Tentacle Slam (2 Ferocity)
entries: The otyugh makes a signature attack. On a hit, the target must also succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}). The otyugh can only grapple one target at a time.

action.name: 3rd Level: Brutal Charge (5 Ferocity)
entries: The otyugh moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. During or after this move, they can make a signature attack against one target.

action.name: 5th Level: Retch (8 Ferocity)
entries: The otyugh regurgitates garbage in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage PBd6} poison damage and is {@condition poisoned}. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}.

bonus.name: Slough Rot (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: The otyugh touches their caregiver and ends one disease or one of the following conditions affecting the caregiver: {@condition blinded}, {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition paralyzed}, or {@condition poisoned}.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the dregsbelcher takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the dregsbelcher takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Trash Traversal
entries: The dregsbelcher ignores difficult terrain. They also have advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in piles of refuse.

trait.name: Whetted Appetites
entries: While within 60 feet of the dregsbelcher, each friendly non-minion otyugh gains a +1 bonus to attack rolls. This bonus increases by 1 (to a maximum of +5) for each dregsbelcher in range of that creature.

action.name: Regurgitate (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/40 ft., one target. {@h}2 bludgeoning damage plus 2 acid damage.

trait.name: Detached Eyes
entries: Six eyes float around the overmind and create their Eye Psionics effects. Each eye is an object that has AC 24, 1 hit point, and a psionic shield that makes it immune to damage. After an eye creates a psionic effect, it loses its psionic shield until the start of the overmind's next turn. If an eye is destroyed, a new eye pops out of the overmind's face to replace it at the end of their next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Eye Psionics
entries: The overmind creates three of the following psionic eye effects. Unless otherwise stated, each eye targets a creature who the overmind can see within 120 feet of them. They can't use the same effect twice in a turn.

items.name: 1. Charm Beam
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the overmind for 1 hour, or until the overmind harms the creature or one of their allies.

items.name: 2. Compulsion Beam
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed toward the closest ally they can see and make a weapon attack against them. Creatures who can't be {@condition charmed} are unaffected.

items.name: 3. Toxic Vapors
entries: The overmind chooses a point they can see within 120 feet of them. Each creature within 10 feet of the point must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

items.name: 4. Telekinetic Beam
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be moved up to 30 feet in any direction and take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) force damage at the end of the move. Alternatively, the overmind can target an object they can see within 120 feet of them that weighs 300 pounds or less and isn't being worn or carried, moving it up to 30 feet in any direction. The overmind can also exert fine control on objects with this effect, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.

items.name: 5. Lightning Bolt
entries: The overmind shoots a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line of lightning. Each creature in the line must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: 6. Fire Beam
entries: The targeted creature must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 36 ({@damage 8d8}) fire damage and catches fire, taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage at the start of each of their turns for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). Any creature can use their action to douse the fire, ending the effect early.

bonus.name: The Great Eye {@recharge}
entries: The overmind's central eye turns solid black and projects a 150-foot cone of energy. If the overmind or any creature in that area is affected by a spell, the spell's effects immediately end for that creature.

reaction.name: Away with You!
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the overmind hits them with a melee attack, the overmind can use Telekinetic Beam on the attacker.

trait.name: Hypersensitive Hearing
entries: The owl harpy has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing, and it can't use its blindsight while {@condition deafened}.

trait.name: Quiet Wings
entries: The owl harpy has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide while flying.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The owl harpy makes two Claw attacks and two Talon attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Talon
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Sleeping Song
entries: The owl harpy sings a magical melody. Every Humanoid and Giant within 300 feet of the harpy that can hear the song must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious} until the song ends. The harpy must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue singing. It can stop singing at any time. The song ends if the harpy is {@condition incapacitated}. An {@condition unconscious} target wakes if it takes damage or if another creature uses an action to wake it. A target that successfully saves is immune to this harpy's song for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Hovering Darkness (3/Day)
entries: While flying, the owl harpy shakes a fine, magical dander from her wings, and a 15-foot radius of magical darkness extends out from her, moves with her, and spreads around corners. The darkness lasts as long as the owl harpy flies and maintains {@status concentration}, up to 10 minutes (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Darkvision can't penetrate this darkness, and no natural light can illuminate it. If any of the darkness overlaps with an area of light created by a spell of 2nd level or lower, the spell creating the light is dispelled.

trait.name: Deadly Leap
entries: The owlbear's long jump is up to 30 feet and their high jump is 15 feet, with or without a running start. If the owlbear leaps at least 20 feet toward a target and then hits them with a Bite or Claw attack, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The owlbear makes one Bite and one Claw attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d12 + 5}) piercing damage, and the owlbear can move the target 5 feet in any direction.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Bear Hug {@recharge 4}
entries: The owlbear attempts to grab and crush a creature they can see within 5 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) bludgeoning damage and is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and is not {@condition grappled}. Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of their turns. The grapple ends if the owlbear uses Bear Hug on another target or makes a Claw attack against another target.

reaction.name: Hulking Rush
entries: When the owlbear takes damage, they can move up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

action.name: Signature Attack (Claw)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} slashing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Violent Attack (2 Ferocity)
entries: The owlbear makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} damage, and the owlbear can move the target 5 feet in any direction.

action.name: 3rd Level: Owlie Oop (5 Ferocity)
entries: The owlbear leaps up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. When they land, each creature within 5 feet of them must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: 5th Level: Bear Hug (8 Ferocity)
entries: The owlbear attempts to grab and crush a creature they can see within 5 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage PBd10} bludgeoning damage and is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}). On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and is not {@condition grappled}. Until this grapple ends, the target is also {@condition restrained}. The grapple ends if the owlbear uses Bear Hug on another target or makes a signature attack against another target.

bonus.name: Give a Hoot (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: The owlbear lets loose a unique battle hoot. If the owlbear's caregiver can hear the owlbear, the caregiver gains 5 × PB temporary hit points.

name: Pact Vampire
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Blood Sense
entries: The pact vampire can pinpoint the location of creatures that aren't Constructs or Undead within 60 feet of it and can sense the general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of it.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the pact vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Poisonous Blood
entries: A creature that hits the pact vampire with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The pact vampire regains 25 hp at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hp and isn't in sunlight. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The pact vampire doesn't require air.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: The pact vampire has the following flaws:

items.name: Stake to the Heart
items.entry: If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into the vampire's heart while the vampire is {@condition incapacitated} in its resting place, the vampire is {@condition paralyzed} until the stake is removed.

items.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
items.entry: The vampire takes 10 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pact vampire makes three Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) poison damage.

action.name: Call Blood
entries: The pact vampire draws the blood out of a bleeding creature's body, where it flows through the air into the vampire's mouth. One creature the vampire can see within 60 feet of it that doesn't have all its hp and isn't a Construct or Undead must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) necrotic damage, and its hp maximum is reduced by that amount. The vampire regains hp equal to half the damage dealt. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

action.name: Charm
entries: One Humanoid the vampire can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition charmed} for 1 day. The {@condition charmed} target obeys the vampire's verbal commands. If the target suffers any harm or receives a suicidal command, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this vampire's Charm for the next 24 hours.
The vampire can have only one target {@condition charmed} at a time. If it charms another, the effect on the previous target ends.

action.name: Children of the Lower Planes (1/Day)
entries: The pact vampire magically calls {@dice 2d4} dretches, {@dice 1d4} imps, or 1 bearded devil. The called Fiends arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of the vampire and obeying its spoken commands. The Fiends remain for 1 hour, until the vampire dies, or until the vampire dismisses them as a bonus action.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The pact vampire moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Call Blood (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The pact vampire uses Call Blood.

legendary.name: Spread Poison (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The pact vampire's blood briefly turns into a mist around it. Each creature within 15 feet of the vampire must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Pale Man is a 16th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 18}, {@hit 10} to hit with spell attacks). The Pale Man has the following wizard spells prepared:
footerEntries: *These spells are from Appendix D of Dungeons of Drakkenheim.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Pale Man fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Insect Body
entries: The Pale Man can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the Pale Man can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect.

trait.name: Crawling Flesh
entries: When the Pale Man is reduced to 0 hit points, it breaks apart into a swarm of insects in the same space. Unless the swarm is destroyed, the Pale Man swarm returns to its cocoon and reforms {@dice 1d6} days later.

action.name: Contaminating Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or receive one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.

action.name: Infest the Flesh {@recharge}
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of the Pale Man must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 5d8}) necrotic damage and be {@condition restrained} by masses of swarming fleshy bugs. The affected creature takes 22 ({@damage 5d8}) necrotic damage at the start of each of the Pale Man's turns. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary.name: Cantrip (Costs 1 Action)
entries: The Pale Man casts one cantrip.

legendary.name: Slither (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Pale Man moves its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Contaminate (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Each creature {@condition restrained} by the Pale Man's Infest the Flesh must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.

hp.special: 76 (8d8 + 40) plus 76 (8d8 + 40) per player character

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (1/Round)
headerEntries: The Pale Man casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}, {@hit 10} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Aura of Fleshy Insects
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 18}, each creature of the Pale Man's choosing who starts its turn within 60 feet of the Pale Man. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 5d8}) Necrotic damage and the target gains one level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}.

trait.name: Crawling Flesh
entries: When the Pale Man is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, he breaks apart into a {@creature Swarm of Contaminated Insects|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} in the same space. Unless the swarm is destroyed, the Pale Man's swarm returns to its cocoon and reforms into the Pale Man {@dice 1d6} days later.

trait.name: Insect Body
entries: The Pale Man can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the Pale Man can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect.

action.name: The Pale Man always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On his turn, the Pale Man can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Pale Man takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn.

action.name: Contaminating Touch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}.

action.name: Forced Mutation
entries: The Pale Man targets a creature within 60 feet who has one or more mutations and magically alters the mutation. The Pale Man chooses one of the target's existing mutations to remove and replaces it with a different one of his choice.

action.name: Infest the Flesh (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} from the Pale Man. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 5d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} ({@dice 3d8} Necrotic) condition. A target also has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition while it is burning in this way. Failure by 5 or more: The target also has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition (save ends) due to masses of swarming fleshy bugs. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Contaminate (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, each creature {@condition Restrained|XPHB} by the Pale Man's Infest the Flesh action. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}.

action.name: Abrupt Contaminant (1/Round)
entries: The Pale Man targets a creature within 60 feet who has one or more levels of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}. That creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage for each level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} it has.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The Pale Man chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11 or higher, the effect ends on him. The Pale Man can use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The panjaian ilharan's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 12}). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Returning Wind
entries: The panjaian ilharan can take a bonus action to choose up to four objects it can see within 60 feet of it. These objects can't be carried or worn by another creature, and they can weigh up to 5 pounds combined. Those objects fly up to 60 feet toward the ilharan, delivered into its hands or open containers, such as sheathes, once within 5 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The panjaian ilharan makes four dagger attacks. It can draw the daggers as part of this action.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Storm Wave {@recharge 5}
entries: The panjaian ilharan unleashes lightning, thunder, and strong wind in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking 6 ({@damage 2d4 + 1}) lightning damage and 6 ({@damage 2d4 + 1}) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Those who fail the saving throw are also pushed up to 15 feet to the edge of the area.

action.name: Gift of Flight (1/Day)
entries: The panjaian ilharan touches up to four willing creatures. Each target gains a flying speed of 30 feet for 1 hour. When the effect ends, the target descends at 60 feet per round for 1 minute, taking no falling damage and landing on its feet if on the ground after that minute.

trait.name: Bibliophile
entries: The paper drake understands any written language it can see, provided it is touching the surface on which the words are written.

trait.name: False Appearance (Book Form Only)
entries: While the drake remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary book.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drake makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack, or it makes two Book Flap attacks.

action.name: Bite (Dragon Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Book Flap (Book Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the drake can fly up to 15 feet without provoking opportunity attacks, as it flaps its pages.

action.name: Claw (Dragon Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Shredded Breath (Dragon Form Only; Recharge 5-6)
entries: The drake exhales sharp shreds of paper in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 10 ({@damage 4d4}) slashing damage and is {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition blinded}.

bonus.name: Fold
entries: The paper drake can fold and reshape its papery body to change its size between Tiny, Small, and Medium. It can also use this bonus action to fold itself into the shape of a book, which doesn't have wings, or back into its Small form. Without wings, it loses its flying speed. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are the same in each form. It reverts to its Small form if it dies.

hp.special: 5 + three times your warlock level

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the ooze remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an oily pool or wet rock.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 + PB} bludgeoning damage

trait.name: Laboratory Adaptation
entries: The pathogenist is immune to disease.

trait.name: Mutated Strains
entries: The pathogenist's attacks and effects ignore the target's {@spell Resistance|XPHB} or {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison damage and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition and disease.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pathogenist makes two Poison Needle attacks.

action.name: Poison Needle
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Poison damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it is stabilized and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 hour, even if it regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. While {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Pestilent Infection {@recharge 5}
entries: The pathogenist infects one creature it can see within 30 feet with a magical disease. At the start of each of its turns, the target is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target gaines one {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level. Third Success: The disease ends.

action.name: Plague Wind (1/Day)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 5d8}) Poison damage plus 23 ({@damage 5d8}) Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} If the target has 25 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or fewer after taking this damage, it dies and its flesh turns to ash, leaving a weathered skeleton.

bonus.name: Heightened Tolerance
entries: The pathogenist ends the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition on itself.

reaction.name: Outbreak
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the pathogenist can see that is infected by its Pestilent Infection is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or dies. {@actResponse} The pathogenist spreads the disease to another creature it can see within 30 feet of the infected creature.

trait.name: Cone of Encouragement
entries: The peeper's central eye emits a beatific gaze, creating an area of encouragement in a 30-foot cone. At the end of each of its turns, the peeper decides which way the cone faces. See Reactions for more details.

trait.name: Scaredy
entries: The peeper has disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws against the frightened condition, and automatically fails these saving throws if it can see the source of its fear and the source is two or more size categories larger than it.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Encourage (2/Day)
entries: As a reaction when a creature within the peeper's cone of encouragement makes an attack roll or saving throw, the peeper can emit verbal or psychic encouragement, granting the target a bonus {@dice d4} to its roll.

trait.name: Militaristic Resolve
entries: The knight has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Pegasus Training
entries: The knight has advantage on ability checks and saving throws it makes to remain mounted on a pegasus. In addition, while mounted, the knight's normal and long ranges of thrown weapons are doubled (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The knight makes two attacks.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. (60/240 ft. while mounted), one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Lance
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit (with disadvantage if the target is within 5 ft.), reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The knight is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 15}). It has the following paladin spells prepared:

trait.name: Bonded Mount
entries: The knight is magically bonded to its pegasus mount, which obeys the knight's commands. If the knight isn't mounted, it can use a bonus action to magically teleport onto its pegasus, provided the two are on the same plane of existence. When it teleports, the knight appears astride its mount, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying. While mounted, the knight can force an attack or spell targeting the pegasus to target the knight instead, and both the knight and its pegasus have advantage on Dexterity saving throws. If its mount dies, the knight can train a new pegasus to serve as its bonded mount over the course of one month.

trait.name: Celestial Favor
entries: When the knight or its mount hit with an attack, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage (included in the attacks below).

trait.name: Militaristic Resolve
entries: The knight has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Pegasus Training
entries: The knight has advantage on ability checks and saving throws it makes to remain mounted on a pegasus. In addition, while mounted, the knight's normal and long ranges of thrown weapons are doubled (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The knight makes two attacks and uses its Strike Order.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. (60/240 ft. while mounted), one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage.

action.name: Lance
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit (with disadvantage if the target is within 5 ft.), reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d12 + 5}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage.

action.name: Strike Order
entries: The knight chooses one friendly creature within 60 feet of it. If the target can see or hear the knight, the target can immediately use its reaction to make one weapon attack.

action.name: Heroic Rally (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The knight bellows a command, emboldening each creature it chooses within 60 feet of it that can hear it. Each target gains 15 ({@dice 2d10 + 4}) temporary hit points and becomes immune to being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened} for 1 minute.

name: Percival de Rolo
alias: Lord Percival Fredrickstein von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

trait.name: Action Surge (2/{@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|Short Rest})
entries: Once on his turn, Percy can take one additional action.

trait.name: Cabal's Ruin
entries: {@item Cabal's Ruin (Exalted)|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Cabal's Ruin} grants Percy {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1} against spells or magical effects. Additionally, {@item Cabal's Ruin (Exalted)|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Cabal's Ruin} has 10 charges. When Percy hits with a weapon attack, he can expend up to 10 charges to have the attack deal {@damage 1d6} extra lightning damage per charge spent.

trait.name: Indomitable (3/{@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|Long Rest})
entries: Percy can reroll a failed {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}.

trait.name: Misfire
entries: When Percy rolls a 2 or lower on the {@dice d20} when making an attack with Animus or Bad News, the attack misses and he can't use the weapon again until he spends an action to repair it. On a misfire with Animus, he takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage.

trait.name: No Mercy
entries: Percy's weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19-20.

trait.name: Ranged Master
entries: Percy's ranged weapon attacks have a +2 bonus to hit (included in attacks), ignore {@quickref cover||3||half cover} and {@quickref cover||3||three-quarters cover}, and have no range penalty. Additionally, Percy can take a −5 penalty to any ranged attack roll to gain a +10 bonus to the damage roll.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Percy wears a {@item ring of lightning resistance} and {@item Cabal's Ruin (Exalted)|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Cabal's Ruin}. He wields Animus and Bad News, which are both +1 weapons.

trait.name: Quick Draw
entries: Percy adds his proficiency bonus to initiative rolls, giving him a +12 to initiative rolls.

trait.name: Toughness
entries: Percy has an additional 40 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Percy makes four ranged attacks with Animus, or two ranged attacks with Bad News. When Percy hits with an attack with either weapon, he can choose one of the following additional effects:

items.name: Deadeye
entries: Percy gains {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on his next attack roll this turn made against the same target.

items.name: Disarm
entries: The target must make a {@dc 20} Strength {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}. On a failure, the target drops one item it is holding of Percy's choice.

action.name: Animus
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 15} to hit, range 320 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) piercing damage and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Bad News
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 15} to hit, range 800 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d12 + 6}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Absorb Magic (Recharges after a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|Short or Long Rest})
entries: When Percy is targeted by an enemy's spell, he can absorb a portion of the spell's energy into {@item Cabal's Ruin (Exalted)|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Cabal's Ruin}. The spell affects him normally, but the cloak gains a number of charges equal to the level of the spell. When he does so, he also gains resistance to one type of damage dealt by the spell until the end of his next turn.

walk.condition: (0 ft., Flying 20 ft. in flying form)

trait.name: Distracting Maneuver
entries: When the Pest Spirit takes the Dash action, it doesn't provoke opportunity attacks until the end of its turn.

trait.name: Hard to Catch
entries: The Pest Spirit has advantage on ability checks and saving throws against grapples and other effects that would impede its movement.

action.name: Frustration
entries: The Pest Spirit interacts with a creature within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or the spirit gains inspiration.

trait.name: Just a Rock
entries: The rock counts as an object. Additionally, it can't take actions and its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} can't be increased.

name: Petra Cloudburst
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Missing Wing
entries: Petra's missing wing means she can't truly glide the way she used to, but she can still use her remaining wing to slow her descent. When falling at least 10 feet, Petra can spend a reaction to gain resistance to falling damage until the end of the turn. Petra can't do this if she is carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

trait.name: Aura of Leadership
entries: Petra and all allies within 10 feet of her who can see her and hear her have advantage on Constitution saving throws and saving throws against {@condition frightened||fear}.

trait.name: Talons
entries: Petra has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks to climb any surface her talons could reasonably grip.

trait.name: Patient
entries: When Petra takes a {@action Ready||readied action}, she has advantage on the first attack roll, skill check, or ability check she makes as a part of that action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Petra makes three melee attacks—two with her cutlass and one with her talons—or she makes two ranged attacks with her twinshot hand crossbow.

action.name: Cutlass
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Twinshot Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/90 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage. This special hand crossbow can be fired twice before it needs to be reloaded.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Petra adds 2 to her AC against one melee attack that would hit her. To do so, Petra must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

trait.name: Spell Vessel
entries: After using its Consume Spell {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, the phage stores the spell until the spell is digested or the phage dies. When the phage dies, the spell takes effect. If the original caster of the spell sees the phage die, it can choose the area or target(s) of the spell as if they had cast it from the phage's space. Otherwise, the spell affects a random area or target(s) from those within range.

trait.name: Warped Space
entries: The phage magically warps space in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Attacks targeting the phage from outside the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}, and the phage has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and effects that originate from outside the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 10 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Piercing damage. If the phage isn't storing a spell, it makes this attack with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} and deals an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Piercing damage on a hit.

action.name: Spit
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 60/120 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Acid damage.

action.name: Digest Spell
entries: The phage digests the spell it has stored, teleporting to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet and making a Spit attack with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

reaction.name: Consume Spell
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature within 120 feet of the phage casts a spell while the phage isn't storing a spell. {@actResponse} The spell has no effect and is stored in the phage.

trait.name: Displacement
entries: The phantasm projects a magical illusion that makes it appear to be standing near its actual location, causing attack rolls against it to have disadvantage. Creatures with truesight ignore this trait. If it is hit by an attack, this trait is disrupted until the end of its next turn. This trait is also disrupted while the phantasm is incapacitated or has a speed of 0 feet.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The phantasm can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The phantasm makes four attacks.

action.name: Phantom Fist
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) psychic damage.

action.name: Horrifying Visage (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature within 60 feet of the phantasm that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this phantasm's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

trait.name: Breathless Warding
entries: A creature holding its breath has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition to the hearse. If the creature takes damage while holding its breath, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or let out its breath and become visible to the hearse until the start of the creature's next turn, when it can hold its breath again.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The hearse can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hearse makes two Ghostly Coachman attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with a use of Trample, if available.

action.name: Ghostly Coachman
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 8}, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Cold damage. If the target is a creature, it can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} until the start of the hearse's next turn.

action.name: Trample {@recharge 5}
entries: The hearse moves in a straight line up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}. {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}, each creature whose space the hearse enters during this action. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Cold damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}), and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Tolling Bell (1/Day)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, each creature of the hearse's choice that it can see in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the hearse. {@actSaveFail} 44 ({@damage 8d10}) Psychic damage, and the creature's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved until the start of the hearse's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Entomb
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 16}, one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the hearse (it can have up to three creatures entombed at a time). {@actSaveFail} The target is entombed in a coffin in the hearse, and the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition ends.

An entombed target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects outside the hearse, and at the start of each of the hearse's turns it takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Necrotic damage and gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level.

If the hearse takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside a coffin, the hearse must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or release all entombed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the hearse and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. If the hearse dies, any entombed creature falls to the ground with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition in the hearse's former space.

name: Phorosfeather
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Phorosfeather is a 5th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). Phorosfeather has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Phorosfeather can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as He descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. Phorosfeather can't glide while carrying heavy objects, or heavy weapons (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

trait.name: Talons
entries: Phorosfeather has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface his talons could reasonably grip.

trait.name: Aerial Defense
entries: As long as Phorosfeather is falling, gliding, or jumping, attacks made against him have disadvantage.

trait.name: Gesme's Wrath
entries: As a bonus action, Phorosfeather can expend a spell slot to cause his melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If Phorosfeather expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each level above 1st.

trait.name: Woodland Hunter
entries: Phorosfeather treats three-quarters cover as half cover and half cover as no cover.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Coven Magic
headerEntries: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell's normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability: {@spell Augury|XPHB}, {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB}, {@spell Identify|XPHB}, {@spell Locate Object|XPHB}, {@spell Lucky Charm|CrookedMoon24} (lasts until the hag casts it again, or chooses to end it with no action required), or {@spell Unseen Servant|XPHB}. The hag must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before using this trait to cast that spell again.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 19}):

trait.name: Disarming Vanity
entries: As an {@action Influence|XPHB} action, a creature that flatters the hag forces it to succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the end of the hag's next turn.

trait.name: Harrying Wings
entries: When the hag rolls {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, it is surrounded by fey spirits in the form of angry pigeons.

The hag's enemies within a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from it have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks and attack rolls. This trait doesn't function if the hag has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting (at will spells only).

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage.

action.name: Agonizing Cackle (1/Day)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 19}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} A target takes 45 ({@damage 10d8}) Psychic damage and has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the start of the hag's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The hag shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

from: {@item plate of the Dawnmartyr (exalted)|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|plate of the Dawnmartyr}

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Pike is a 20th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 19}, {@hit 11} to hit with spell attacks). She has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Gnome Cunning
entries: Pike has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1} against magic.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Pike wields a {@item mace of disruption} and wears {@item gauntlets of ogre power}, {@item boots of speed}, and the {@item plate of the Dawnmartyr (exalted)|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Plate of the Dawnmartyr}.

trait.name: Dawnmartyr's Grace (1/{@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|Long Rest})
entries: When Pike is reduced to 0 hit points while wearing the {@item plate of the Dawnmartyr (exalted)|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Plate of the Dawnmartyr}, she can choose to have a blast of healing flame surround her. She regains 1 hit point and is lifted to her feet. Each enemy within 10 feet of her takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage or radiant damage (her choice).

action.name: Mace of Disruption
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, plus an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage if the target is a fiend or an undead. If the target has 25 hit points or fewer after taking this damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or be destroyed. On a successful save, the creature becomes {@condition frightened} of Pike until the end of her next turn.

action.name: Guiding Bolt (5th Level)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 11} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 8d6}) radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against the target before the end of Pike's next turn has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage}.

bonus.name: Battle Priest (5/{@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|Long Rest})
entries: If Pike uses the {@action Attack} action, she can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

bonus.name: {@spell Healing Word} (4th Level)
entries: Pike casts {@spell healing word}, restoring 16 ({@dice 4d4 + 6}) hit points to herself or another creature she can see within 60 feet of her.

reaction.name: Dawnmartyr's Rebuke
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of Pike hits her with a melee attack, she can deal 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire or radiant damage to it (her choice).

reaction.name: Everlight's Guidance (3/{@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|Short Rest})
entries: When Pike or a creature she can see within 30 feet of her makes an attack roll, she can grant a +10 bonus to the roll. She can grant this bonus after the roll is made but before it hits or misses.

trait.name: Unshakeable Faith (1/Day)
entries: When the pilgrim would fail a saving throw, it can reroll the save with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}. It must use the new roll.

action.name: Club
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) Bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Horrid Stench
entries: If an enemy starts their turn within 10 feet of three or more pitlings, the enemy is {@condition poisoned} until the start of their next turn.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the pitling takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the pitling takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Soul Feast
entries: When the pitling reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the pitling consumes the creature's soul, and the pitling becomes a Category 2 demon of the GM's choice with 1 soul. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell. If the creature was reduced to 0 hit points by a group attack, the GM picks one pitling who joined the attack to consume the soul.

action.name: Spit (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 15/30 ft., one target. {@h}4 poison damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Pixie's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Pixie has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Gift of Flight
entries: The Pixie magically grants a creature it can see a Flying speed of 30 feet. The creature keeps its Flying speed, as long as the Pixie is holding its breath.

The Pixie can hold its breath for a number of minutes equal to 1 + its Constitution modifier (minimum of 30 seconds). The Pixie can only grant this effect to one creature at a time, and when the effect ends, it must wait 1 minute before using it again.

trait.name: Plague Symptoms
entries: The plague carrier is host to a disease created by a pathogenist, chosen from the options below. A creature infected by this disease is subjected to the chosen effect at the start of each of its turns. {@actSave con} {@dc 13}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target suffers the disease's effect. Third Success: The disease ends.

trait.name: Coughing Fits
entries: The target is unable to speak until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Fatigue
entries: The target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced by 5 feet until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Shivers
entries: The target shakes uncontrollably. Each time it fails its saving throw, it drops whatever it is holding.

action.name: Festering Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 2}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d8}) Piercing damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 13}. {@actSaveFail} The target is infected with the plague carrier's Plague Symptoms.

action.name: Bile Spreader
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target is infected with the plague carrier's Plague Symptoms. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

name: Plague Carrion
languages: all languages known before the curse

trait.name: Cloud of Blight
entries: A miasma surrounds the Plague Carrion in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Each time another creature starts its turn or enters the area, it gains a -1 penalty to damage rolls. Multiple instances of this penalty stack, but a creature can't gain it more than once each round. The penalty is removed when the creature finishes a {@variantrule Alternative Resting System|GrimHollowCG24|Quick}, {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short}, or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the Plague Carrion dies, it explodes in a cloud of sickening gas. {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} centered on the Plague Carrion. {@actSaveFail} 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Poison damage, and the creature's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum is reduced by an amount equal to half the Poison damage taken (rounding down). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.
The {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum reduction lasts until the creature finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Plague Carrion makes one Bite attack and one Plague Touch attack, or two Plague Beam attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d8 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Plague Touch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}49 ({@damage 10d8 + 4}) Poison damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} The target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum is reduced by an amount equal to half the Poison damage taken (rounding down).

action.name: Plague Beam
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 8} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d8 + 3}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of the Plague Carrion's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Plague Carrion casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material component and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the plainscow moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the plainscow can make another attack with its hooves as a bonus action.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The planewatcher has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Planar Sense
entries: The planewatcher can pinpoint the location of creatures not native to the plane the planewatcher currently occupies and planar portals within 60 feet of it, and the planewatcher can sense the general direction of such creatures and portals within 1 mile of it.

trait.name: Plane Bound
entries: The planewatcher is immune to any spell or effect that would force it to leave its current plane, unless it wants to leave.

trait.name: Word-Bound
entries: The planewatcher always knows the direction and distance to any creature that dispels, breaks, or otherwise avoids the geas of the promise it made via Planar Ultimatum, provided the planewatcher and the creature are on the same plane of existence. While grappling such a creature, it can cast the {@spell banishment} spell as a bonus action (spell save {@dc 17}) on that creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The planewatcher makes one Radiant Lasso attack and two Enervating Blast attacks, or it makes three Enervating Blast attacks. It can replace two attacks with a use of Planar Ultimatum.

action.name: Radiant Lasso
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) radiant damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}) if the planewatcher isn't already grappling a creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, can't tell a lie, and can't teleport or be transported to another plane of existence unless the planewatcher wills it.

action.name: Enervating Blast
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 9} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) force damage, and the target has disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Planar Ultimatum
entries: The planewatcher demands one creature {@condition grappled} by it to return to the creature's home plane within 24 hours. If the creature doesn't swear to do so, it must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 45 ({@damage 10d8}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one If the creature swears to return, it becomes affected by the {@spell geas} spell for 30 days, which compels the creature to return to its home plane as soon as possible.

bonus.name: Reel
entries: The planewatcher pulls a creature {@condition grappled} by it up to 25 feet straight toward it.

hp.special: 20 (Blooming and Thorny Only) or 30 (Oaken Only) + 10 for each spell level above 2

trait.name: Sylvan Regeneration
entries: The spirit regains 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} and is in direct sunlight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The plant makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (rounded down).

action.name: Petal Burst (Blooming Only)
entries: The plant causes a burst of petals to fill the air within a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. The area is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB} for 1 minute.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hitYourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier}, reach 5 ft. {@h}{@damage 1d8 + 3 + summonSpellLevel} Bludgeoning or Piercing damage (Thorny Only).

reaction.name: Oaken Shield (Oaken Only)
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the plant takes damage from an attack, the plant takes the damage instead.

reaction.name: Prickly Protection (Thorny Only)
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the plant attacks it, the plant makes a Slam attack with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} against the creature.

hp.special: 20 + 10 for each spell level above 2
30 + 10 for each spell level above 2
20 + 10 for each spell level above 2

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The plasmid can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Receptive Telepathy
entries: The plasmid is considered a shark for the purpose of being magically controlled by any sahuagin's Shark {@variantrule Telepathy|XPHB} trait.

trait.name: Solid State (Object Form Only)
entries: When formed into an inanimate object, the plasmid has an AC of 18 and regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. However, the plasmid's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 0 in this form and it cannot attack. It can be used as an item or a set of {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB} when it is in this form.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The plasmid makes three Vicious Pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Vicious Pseudopod
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 10 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Adaptive Shape-Shift (Amorphous Form Only)
entries: When in its true, amorphous form, the plasmid gains one of the following benefits until it uses this action again:

items.name: Truesight
entries: The plasmid gains {@sense Truesight|XPHB} with a range of 30 feet.

items.name: Blindsight
entries: The plasmid gains {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.

items.name: Speed
entries: The plasmid's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} increase to 30 feet.

items.name: Extra Damage
entries: The plasmid's Vicious Pseudopod deals an extra {@damage 1d6} Acid damage on a hit.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The plasmid shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true amorphous form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

name: Platinum Golem

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Divine Custodian
entries: When the golem hits a creature with an {@action opportunity attack}, that creature's speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1} against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Radiant Blast {@recharge}
entries: The golem emits a burst of radiant light in a 20-foot radius. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 18} Constitution {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage and is {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and is not {@condition blinded}.

reaction.name: Divine Judgment
entries: When a creature within 10 feet of the golem makes an attack against a target other than the golem, the golem can make a mace attack against that creature.

name: Pleasantpaw
languages: can speak with beasts of any size which represent spiders, insects, worms, or bugs

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Plesantpaw is a 4th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). He has the following bard spells prepared:

trait.name: Racket (2/Day)
entries: Pleasantpaw can use a bonus action on his turn to target any number of creatures within 30 feet of him. Any of these creatures that can hear Pleasantpaw play or croon his music must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws for one minute. A creature can attempt a new saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that succeeds on their saving throw against this effect, or has the effect ended for it, is immune to Pleasantpaw's racket for 24 hours. Creatures that are immune to being {@condition frightened} are immune to this effect.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) slashing damage, or 6 ({@damage 1d10 + 1}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Curl Up
entries: Pleasantpaw curls up into a spiny ball. While curled up in this way he can't move, attack, or cast spells with somatic components, and his base armor class becomes 19. Any creature that misses Pleasantpaw with a melee attack while he is curled up takes {@dice 2d4} points of piercing damage from his sharp quills. If a creature hits Pleasantpaw while he is curled up, however, Pleasantpaw is knocked {@condition prone} in his space at the end of the turn. Pleasantpaw may uncurl himself at any point during his turn.

name: Podge
languages: can speak with beasts of any size which represent spiders, insects, worms, or bugs

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Podge is a 2nd-level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). He has the following bard spells prepared:

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Curl Up
entries: Podge curls up into a spiny ball. While curled up in this way he cannot move, attack, or cast spells with somatic components, and his base armor class becomes 19. Any creature that misses Podge with a melee attack while they are curled up takes {@dice 2d4} points of piercing damage from their sharp quills. If a creature hits Podge while he is curled up, however, Podge is knocked {@condition prone} in his space at the end of the turn. Podge may uncurl himself at any point during his turn.

reaction.name: Mocking Distraction
entries: Podge hurls jarring insults at an attacking creature he can see within 30 feet of him. The creature rolls {@dice 1d4} and subtracts the result from their attack roll, potentially causing the attack to miss. A creature must be able to hear Podge in order to be affected by their jeers.

trait.name: Contortionist
entries: The pombero can contort its body into unnatural positions, allowing it to easily move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The pombero's destination must still have suitable room to accommodate its volume.

trait.name: Forest Camouflage
entries: The pombero has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in forested terrain.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts
entries: The pombero can communicate with Beasts as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pombero makes two Slam attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Charming Touch, if available.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Charming Touch {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature the pombero can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} for 10 minutes. If the target suffers any harm, the effect ends. Otherwise, the target can repeat the saving throw at the end of every minute, ending the effect on itself on a success. The pombero can have only one creature {@condition charmed} at a time. If it charms another, the effect on the previous creature ends.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The pombero magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or uses Charming Touch, or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the pombero wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

trait.name: Arcane Power Source
entries: An arcane power source—a crystal on the mining suit's rear—can be targeted separately from the mining suit (AC 19, 64 hit points, vulnerability to thunder damage, and immunity to all damage except bludgeoning, force, piercing, and slashing).
