If the mining suit fails a saving throw against an area of effect, the crystal also fails the saving throw. If the power source is destroyed, the tar elemental possessing the mining suit moves into the nearest unoccupied space without provoking opportunity attacks and the mining suit becomes an inanimate object.

trait.name: Flammable
entries: If the mining suit takes fire damage, it ignites. It takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns and its melee attacks deal an additional 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage. If the mining suit is subject to heavy rain or takes 10 or more cold damage in a single instance, the flames are extinguished and the effects end.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mining suit makes three attacks: one with its Claw, one with its Demolition Drill, and one with its Pseudopod.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape {@dc 16}). Until this grapple ends, the mining suit has advantage on attack rolls using its Claw against the target and the mining suit can't use its Claw on another target.

action.name: Demolition Drill
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage.

name: Possessed Pillar

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The possessed pillar doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep

trait.name: Divine Fists
entries: The possessed pillar's weapon attacks are magical. When the pillar hits with a Slam attack, the Slam deals an extra {@damage 2d8} necrotic damage or {@damage 2d8} radiant damage (included in the attack), the pillar's choice.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the pillar remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a statue or a carved column.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The pillar is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The pillar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magnetic Body
entries: The eldritch magic powering the possessed pillar causes the pillar's body to produce a minor magnetic field. When a creature hits the pillar with a weapon made of metal, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or the weapon sticks to the pillar. If the creature can't or won't let go of the weapon, it is also stuck to the pillar and {@condition restrained}. A stuck weapon can't be used. A creature can take its action to remove one metal object from the pillar by succeeding on a {@dc 15} Strength check. The pillar can release one creature or metal object stuck to it as a bonus action. If the pillar dies, all creatures and metal objects stuck to it are released.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The possessed pillar makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage or ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage (the pillar's choice).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Postal Knight makes two melee attacks or three attacks with its Sling.

action.name: Frying Pan
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Sword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Sling
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Defensive Cooking
entries: When wielding a frying pan, the Postal Knight can gain a +1 bonus to AC until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Brother in Arms
entries: If damage is dealt to a friendly creature within 5 feet of the Postal Knight, the Postal Knight and the target each take half of the damage dealt, splitting the damage between them.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: If the spirit is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the spirit move or act, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to discern that the spirit isn't an object.

trait.name: New Form (2/Day)
entries: When the spirit is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, it can choose a different object it can see within 10 feet of it and send its consciousness into that object. After it does so, it drops to 1 hit point instead.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Telekinetic Reach
entries: The spirit casts the {@spell Mage Hand} cantrip. When it does so, the spectral hand created by the spell is {@condition invisible}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spirit makes two attacks.

action.name: Bite, Pinch, or Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Bubble Lift (1/Day)
entries: The spirit casts the {@spell Bubble Lift|ObojimaTallGrass} spell, using Wisdom as its spellcasting ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spirit makes three attacks: two with its chomp and one with its scratch.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Scratch
entries: {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spirit makes two smack attacks.

action.name: Smack
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) damage of the type associated with the spirit.

action.name: Duplicate (2/Day)
entries: The spirit casts the {@spell Duplicate|ObojimaTallGrass} spell (spell save {@dc 11}), using Intelligence as its spellcasting ability, requiring no material components.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The spirit's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 13}). The spirit can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Body Bite (1/Day)
entries: While the spirit has at least 10 hit points, a friendly creature can use a bonus action to take a bite out of the spirit. The spirit takes {@damage 3d4} piercing damage, and the creature regains a number of hit points equal to the damage taken.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The spirit regains 4 hit points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 hit point.

action.name: Push
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: A Tinge Lucky (3/Day)
entries: The spirit can choose to grant itself advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it makes.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spirit makes two scratch attacks.

action.name: Scratch
entries: {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spiritual Sight
entries: The spirit can see 60 feet into the Spirit Realm (Ethereal Plane) when it is on the Physical Realm, and vice versa.

action.name: Spectral Pass
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d12 + 2}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The spirit enters the Spirit Realm (Ethereal Plane) from the Physical Realm, or vice versa. It is visible on the Physical Realm while it is in the Spirit Realm, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

action.name: Incorporeal Transfer
entries: While holding an item, the spirit can cause it to become incorporeal, allowing it to pass through other objects and creatures. If the spirit lets go of the item while inside of an object or creature, the item is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space outside of the object or creature.

action.name: Invisibility (1/Day)
entries: The spirit casts the {@spell Invisibility} spell on itself, using Intelligence as its spellcasting ability, requiring no material components.

action.name: Sleep (1/Day)
entries: The spirit casts the {@spell Sleep} spell, using Intelligence as its spellcasting ability, requiring no material components.

trait.name: Academic Specialty
entries: The Preceptor has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all ability checks using their chosen specialty and gains {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to a type of damage.

items: Biothurge, Master of Warbreed: Medicine, Poison
Blastwright, Master of Machines: Arcana, Fire
Decosopher, Master of Alchemy: Nature, Acid

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Preceptor makes three Scalpel attacks. It can replace one Scalpel attack with an Acid Flask, Incendiary Bomb, or Neurotoxic Cloud.

action.name: Scalpel
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d4 + 5}) Slashing damage, plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Acid Flask (Decosopher)
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Acid damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Acid damage at the end of the target's next turn.

action.name: Incendiary Bomb (Blastwright)
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) Fire damage and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Neurotoxic Cloud (Biothurge)
entries: Targets in a 20-ft. Cone take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage and have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. If the target succeeds on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, it takes half damage and is not {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}.

bonus.name: Impromptu Golem (Biothurge, 1/Day)
entries: The biothurge turns a twisted mass spare bodies parts into a {@b {@creature Zombie|XMM}}. The zombie lasts until the end of the biothurge's next turn or until it is destroyed. The biothurge can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to extend the duration for 1 round.

bonus.name: Latent Decoction (Decosopher, 1/Day)
entries: The decosopher activates a potion stored in its blood stream. The decosopher is affected by its choice of: {@i Haste, Healing (Superior), Speed, or Water Breathing}.

bonus.name: Magitek Interference (Blastwright, 1/Day)
entries: The blastwright enjoins a magical item or golem to cease functioning until the beginning of the blastwright's next turn. If the item is held or is a creature, a successful {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw resists the interference.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Preceptor casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}, +9 to hit with spell attacks):

items.name: Academic Specialty: Master of Warbreed
entries: The Preceptor has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all ability checks using {@skill Medicine|XPHB}  and gains {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Poison.

items.name: Academic Specialty: Master of Machines
entries: The Preceptor has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all ability checks using {@skill Arcana|XPHB}  and gains {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire.

items.name: Academic Specialty: Master of Alchemy
entries: The Preceptor has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all ability checks using {@skill Nature|XPHB}  and gains {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Acid.

hp.special: 6 plus six times your Barbarian level (the beast has a number of Hit Dice [d10s] equal to your Barbarian level)

trait.name: Protective Instinct
entries: When the guardian becomes {@condition Bloodied|XPHB}, it gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half of its maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and is enraged for 10 minutes. While enraged, {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creatures within 5 feet have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against creatures other than the guardian.

trait.name: Vigilant
entries: The guardian can't be {@status surprised|XPHB}.

trait.name: Wild Bond
entries: Add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to any ability check, attack roll, or saving throw the beast makes.

action.name: Natural Weapon
entries: {@atkr m} Bonus equals your attack modifier using Strength, reach 5 ft. {@h}{@damage 1d4 + 2} plus your Rage Damage bonus Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage (your choice when you summon the beast).

reaction.name: Body Block
entries: {@actTrigger} When a creature the beast can see attacks a target other than itself that is within 5 feet of it. {@actResponse} The guardian takes the damage instead of the target.

hp.special: 5 plus four times your Barbarian level (the beast has a number of Hit Dice [d6s] equal to your Barbarian level)

trait.name: Aquatic Assault (Sea Only)
entries: While the beast is submerged in water, it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against creatures without a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} submerged in water.

trait.name: Enraged Strikes
entries: While your {@classFeature Rage|Barbarian|XPHB|1} is active, the beast's attack rolls have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Flyby (Sky Only)
entries: The beast doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Wild Bond
entries: Add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to any ability check, attack roll, or saving throw the beast makes.

action.name: Natural Weapon
entries: {@atkr m} Bonus equals your attack modifier using Strength, reach 5 ft. {@h}{@damage 1d8 + 2} plus your Rage Damage bonus Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage (your choice when you summon the beast).

reaction.name: Harry (Land Only)
entries: {@actTrigger} When a creature the beast can see within 5 feet of it makes an attack roll. {@actResponse} The triggering attack roll has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Elf Glamour (1/Day)
entries: When a creature targets Ellan with an attack, power, or spell, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by him until the end of his next turn (no action required).

trait.name: Resolute Aura
entries: While he is conscious, Ellan and any allies within 20 feet of him who can see him can't be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ellan makes two Bladed Scepter attacks.

action.name: Bladed Scepter
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Command (2nd-Level Spell)
entries: Ellan speaks a one-word command to up to two creatures he can see within 60 feet of him.

Each target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on their next turn. The spell has no effect if the target is Undead, doesn't understand Common or Elvish, or would be directly harmed by following the command. If the target can't follow Ellan's command, the spell ends. Some typical commands and their effects follow:

items.name: Approach
entries: The target moves toward Ellan by the shortest and most direct route, ending their turn if they move within 5 feet of Ellan.

items.name: Drop
entries: The target drops whatever they are holding and then ends their turn.

items.name: Flee
entries: The target spends their turn moving away from Ellan by the fastest available means.

items.name: Grovel
entries: The target falls {@condition prone} and then ends their turn.

items.name: Halt
entries: The target doesn't move and takes no actions.

action.name: Unholy Flame (3rd-Level Spell)
entries: Ellan conjures unholy fire around one creature he can see within 60 feet of him. The target must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) fire damage and is enveloped (save ends at end of turn). While enveloped, a creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage at the start of each of their turns. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't enveloped.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The principle regains 20 hit points at the start of their turn if they aren't {@condition incapacitated}. If they take fire damage, they only regain 10 hit points at the start of their next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The principle makes two Hampering Roots attacks or two Vernal Lash attacks.

action.name: Hampering Roots
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, the target is {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Vernal Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) slashing damage, and the principle moves the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

action.name: Burst from the Earth (1/Day)
entries: The principle causes three Large trees with whipping branches to sprout from the ground in unoccupied spaces the principle can see within 60 feet of them. Each tree has AC 15, 40 hit points, and immunity to psychic damage.

An enemy who starts their turn within 15 feet of one of these trees must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Convocation of Verdure (2/Day)
entries: The principle imbues the power of verdancy in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Roots of the Mind.} For 1 minute, the Elemental can link with each Large or larger plant object they can see within 90 feet of them (no action required). For the duration, the Elemental can perceive, make attacks, and use actions as if they were in the space of a linked plant.

{@b Thunder Burst.} Thorny vines burst from the Elemental. Each enemy the Elemental can see within 30 feet of them must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) piercing damage and is {@condition restrained} until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, they take half as much damage and aren't {@condition restrained}.

trait.name: Absorption
entries: When the protean abomination kills a creature that is neither a construct nor undead, it absorbs the corpse into its body and regains 20 hit points.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The protean abomination can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The protean abomination can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The protean abomination makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Large or smaller target, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}), and the protean abomination uses Engulf on it.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The protean abomination engulfs a Large or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by it. Until the grapple ends the target is {@condition blinded}, {@condition restrained}, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the abomination's turns or take 19 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the abomination moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The abomination can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

trait.name: Absorption
entries: When the abomination kills a creature that is neither a construct nor undead, it absorbs the corpse into its body and regains 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The abomination can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without expending extra movement to do so.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The abomination can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The abomination makes two Slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Large or smaller creature, the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}) and the abomination uses Engulf on the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} creature.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The abomination engulfs a Large or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by it. Until the grapple ends the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, is suffocating, and has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects outside the abomination. If the abomination moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The abomination can have only one creature engulfed at a time. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage. The engulfed creature repeats the save at the start of each of the abomination's turns Success: The target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The psoglav has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The psoglav's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The psoglav makes three Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d12 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The psoglav magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or uses Shadow-Stealing Ray, or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the psoglav wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

action.name: Shadow-Stealing Ray {@recharge 5}
entries: The psoglav emits a beam from its single eye at one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target is pushed up to 20 feet away from the psoglav, and its shadow becomes a creature under the psoglav's control for 24 hours or until the shadow is reduced to 0 hp. On a success, the target is pushed up to 10 feet away from the psoglav and its shadow isn't stolen. Each controlled shadow uses the statistics of a shadow, except it can't create shadows from killing Humanoids. The psoglav can have no more than five shadows under its control at a time. The shadow becomes permanently under the psoglav's control if the shadow's original owner dies.

If a shadow's original owner died within the past minute, the psoglav can command (no action required) the shadow to inhabit and control the body, using the owner's statistics, proficiencies, and class features. A shadow inhabiting a body in this way can't cast spells or activate magic items the owner possessed, and it loses its Amorphous, Shadow {@skill Stealth}, and Sunlight Weakness traits while inhabiting the body. The shadow can inhabit or exit the body as a bonus action. The shadow can inhabit the body for up to 24 hours after the creature died, after which time it is ejected and can't inhabit the body again.
If a creature's saving throw is successful or its shadow is returned to it, the creature is immune to the Shadow-Stealing Ray of all psoglav demons for the next 24 hours.

bonus.name: Shadow Jump (3/Day)
entries: While in shadows, dim light, or darkness, the psoglav disappears into the darkness and reappears in an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The psybird doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Limited Telepathy
entries: The psybird doesn't understand any languages, but can communicate telepathically with other creatures it chooses within its telepathy range. This telepathy can convey emotions or fleeting sensory memories, such as faint echoes of sounds it has heard, or flashes of images it has seen.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hypnotizing Plumage {@recharge}
entries: The psybird attempts to vex nearby creatures with its psionic calls and dazzling plumage. Each creature within 30 feet of the psybird that can see or hear it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition charmed} by the psybird for 10 minutes.
When a creature becomes {@condition charmed} by this effect, apply one of the effects below at random for as long as the creature remains {@condition charmed}.

action.name: 1 Hazy Sight
entries: The creature is unable to see with any definition further than 10 feet from itself. The affected creature is considered to be {@condition blinded} to any creature or object further than 10 feet from itself, as they appear to it only as blurry, amorphous blobs of color.

action.name: 2 Confusion
entries: The creature suffers the effects of the {@spell confusion} spell, though the psybird doesn't need to maintain {@status concentration} on it. The affected creature can repeat its save at the end of each of its turns, ending the charm on itself on a success.

action.name: 3 Stupefaction
entries: The creature suffers disadvantage on all attack rolls and ability checks it makes that use either Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. The creature also temporarily forgets any languages it knows except for the one it has known the longest.

action.name: 4 Dizziness
entries: Any turn in combat during which the creature uses more than half of its movement speed, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. Each time this happens, the creature can repeat its save, ending the effect on a success.

name: Psychic Fragment
languages: can repeat one phrase it knew in life

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The psychic fragment can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The psychic fragment can mimic a single word or phrase it spoke in life. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 11} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

action.name: Withering Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) necrotic damage.

name: Psychic Fragment Swarm
languages: can repeat one phrase it knew in life

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The swarm can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Maddening Voices
entries: The swarm constantly emits a babble of words and phrases spoken in life by its many undead spirits. Each creature that starts its turn within 20 ft. of the swarm must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature is {@condition stunned} until the start of its next turn. A creature that succeeds on a saving throw becomes immune to maddening voices for 24 hours.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Withering Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage, or 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

name: Psychophant
languages: Common (only repeats phrases it has heard)

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The psychophant makes two Psychic Grasp attacks.

action.name: Psychic Grasp
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage and the target has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (Wisdom saving throw {@dc 14} save ends).

action.name: Final Scream {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 40 ({@damage 9d8}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage, and the target is immune to this psychophant's Final Scream for 24 hours.

action.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The psychophant shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid it has seen or reverts to its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form.

bonus.name: Life Siphon
entries: The psychophant deals 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage to a creature it damaged this turn with Psychic Grasp, then regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

bonus.name: Teleport
entries: The psychophant teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. It can bring one creature {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} by its Psychic Grasp, which teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the psychophant's destination space.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: The pudding gremlin explodes when it dies. {@actSave dex} {@dc 11}, each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the pudding gremlin. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: If the pudding gremlin doesn't move on its turn, it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} when taking the Hide action.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft, {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 11}, each creature in a 15 ft {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Create Gremlin (1/Day)
entries: If the pudding gremlin is within 10 ft of an ordinary pudding, it can turn the ordinary pudding into another pudding gremlin. This new pudding gremlin appears in an unoccupied space within 10 ft of the original pudding gremlin and acts as its ally.

name: Pumpkin Head
languages: understands Common plus one other language but only speaks using Mimicry

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The pumpkin head can mimic the voice of the person it replaced or someone it used Personality Consumption on. A creature that hears the voice can tell it's an imitation only with a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) check.

trait.name: Sorrowful Memento
entries: If the pumpkin head can see a creature holding a possession of the person the pumpkin head replaced, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pumpkin head makes one Claw attack and one Pitchfork attack, and it can use Personality Consumption if available.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Pitchfork
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 10 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the pumpkin head can push or pull it 5 feet.

action.name: Personality Consumption {@recharge 5}
entries: The pumpkin head consumes a victim's memories. {@actSave int} {@dc 12}, one creature the pumpkin head can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn, and its Intelligence score decreases by {@dice 1d4}. The target dies if this reduces that score to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way is replaced by a {@creature Pumpkin Head|CrookedMoon24} {@dice 1d8} hours later unless its body is burned.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The jam can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the jam remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a mass of grape jam.

trait.name: Limited Spell Resistance
entries: The jam has advantage on saving throws against spells of 1st level or lower.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The jam regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. If the jam takes necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the jam's next turn.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If the jam dies, it regains all its hit points and becomes active again in 24 hours unless its remains are eaten, destroyed, or targeted by a {@spell dispel magic} spell.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage, plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

name: Putrid Haunt
languages: understands the language it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the putrid haunt remains motionless and {@condition prone} in swampy terrain, it is indistinguishable from a pile of muck and moss.

trait.name: Swamp Walk
entries: Difficult terrain composed of mud, shallow water, and water plants doesn't cost the putrid haunt extra movement.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The putrid haunt doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage.

action.name: Expel Vermin {@recharge}
entries: The putrid haunt vomits forth the leeches, stinging insects, and other swamp vermin infesting its innards in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. A {@condition poisoned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Pygmy Rakshasa

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The rakshasa can cast the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}, +9 to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The rakshasa can't be affected or detected by spells of 4th level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Ninth Life (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the rakshasa would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 153hit points and it gains 50 temporary hit points as deformed, tumorous growths sprout from its skin. Additionally, the rakshasa can use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 11,500 XP (17,400 XP total) for defeating the rakshasa after its Ninth Life activates.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the rakshasa fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rakshasa makes three Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6+4}) slashing damage, and the target is cursed if it is a creature. For the next minute, the target can't be affected by spells or magical effects of 4th level or lower except for those cast by the rakshasa. In addition, the magic of any non-artifact item the target holds, carries, or touches is suppressed while the target is in contact with the item. The curse can be lifted by a {@spell remove curse} spell or similar magic.

reaction.name: Weavebender
entries: When a ranged spell attack or a spell with an area of effect centred on a point targets a creature or point within 30 feet of the rakshasa, the rakshasa can redirect the spell. It can cause a ranged spell attack to target a different creature within 10 feet of the original target (after the attack roll is made but before the outcome is determined), or it can move the area of effect's point of focus by up to 10 feet in any direction.

legendaryHeader: The rakshasa can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The rakshasa regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Devil's Hiss
entries: The rakshasa issues a command to the Handler or a creature {@condition charmed} by it. If the target can hear the rakshasa and is within 120 feet of it, it moves up to half its speed and makes one weapon attack against a creature of the rakshasa's choice within its reach.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The rakshasa casts a spell.

legendary.name: Purr (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The rakshasa lets out a low, thrumming purr. Each creature of the rakshasa's choice within 10 feet of it that can hear it must succeed a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the rakshasa until the end of the rakshasa's next turn. A creature {@condition charmed} in this way regards the rakshasa as its own offspring, acting protectively towards it.

mythicHeader: If the rakshasa's Ninth Life trait has activated in the last hour, it can use the options below as legendary actions.

mythic.name: Wind Strike
entries: The rakshasa teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a creature it can see, and then can make a melee spell attack ({@hit 9} to hit) against that creature. On a hit, the target takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) force damage

mythic.name: Caterwaul (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The rakshasa lets forth an ear-screeching wail. Each creature within 30 feet of the rakshasa that can hear the rakshasa must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) thunder damage and 17 ({@damage 5d6}) psychic damage, and drops anything it is holding as it instinctually covers it ears. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and maintains its grip on what it holds.

name: Pygmy Rakshasa Kingpin

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The maunder makes one Grasp or Bite attack against each creature within its reach. Alternatively, it makes two Eye Beam attacks.

action.name: Grasp
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 13}). The maunder has countless hands and can grapple any number of creatures.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft., one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the maunder. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Piercing damage. A {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} target that is {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the maunder is {@condition Helpless|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} against this attack.

action.name: Eye Beam
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, range 60 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Radiant damage.

bonus.name: Babble
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 10}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the maunder that can hear it. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If Qar is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails.

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When Qar makes an attack, he has advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: Qar has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Qar makes three Unarmed Strike attacks. If he hits the same creature with all three attacks, the target is {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Iron Ring (2/Day)
entries: If not in the Cyst, Qar teleports to the Cyst. If in the Cyst, he teleports to a place he has visited.

reaction.name: No Survivors
entries: When an enemy Qar can see within 40 feet of him drops to 0 hit points, Qar moves up to his speed. If he ends that movement within 5 feet of an enemy, he can make an Unarmed Strike against them.

reaction.name: Voice Stealer (3/Day)
entries: When an enemy Qar can hear within 30 feet of him finishes casting a spell with a verbal component, Qar attempts to steal their voice. The enemy must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or be unable to speak for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

name: Qazyldrath

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Qazyldrath can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Consume Shadow (3/Day)
entries: When Qazyldrath fails a saving throw, they can succeed instead. When they do, any areas of magical darkness in the lair are dispelled, and they can't use Enshroud or Thwart Healing until the end of their next turn.

trait.name: Shadow Strength
entries: Acid and necrotic damage dealt by Qazyldrath ignore damage resistance.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Qazyldrath makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage. If the target is a light source or is wearing or holding a light source, that light is extinguished.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) slashing damage, and Qazyldrath can move the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

action.name: Vacuous Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Qazyldrath exhales dark energy in a line that is 90 feet long and 20 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 ({@damage 7d6}) acid damage plus 24 ({@damage 7d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Additionally, that area is filled with magical darkness for 1 minute. A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness, and no light except a {@spell daylight} spell or a light-creating spell of 5th level or higher can illuminate it.

bonus.name: Enshroud
entries: Shadows cling to one creature Qazyldrath can see within 120 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded} and vulnerable to necrotic damage until the start of Qazyldrath's next turn.

reaction.name: Thwart Healing
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of Qazyldrath regains hit points, Qazyldrath forces them to make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature regains half the number of hit points instead.

legendaryHeader: Qazyldrath has three villain actions. They can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. They can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Burning Globs
entries: Qazyldrath spits acid globules at each enemy they can see within 90 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or have a globule attached to their body. A creature attached to a globule takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage at the start of their turns. A creature can use an action to remove a globule from themself or a creature they can reach.

legendary.name: Action 2: Shadow Form
entries: Qazyldrath becomes semiincorporeal, gaining resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until the end of their next turn. Qazyldrath then teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space that they can see.

legendary.name: Action 3: Sinking Gloom
entries: Qazyldrath summons sticky black acid centered on a point they can see on the ground within 120 feet of them, creating a 5-foot-deep, 20-foot-radius pool. The pool is difficult terrain and lasts for 1 minute. An enemy who starts their turn in the pool takes 24 ({@damage 7d6}) acid damage and must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} until the start of their next turn. An enemy who starts their turn flying within 30 feet of the pool must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be pulled down by living acid, landing in the nearest unoccupied space of their choice within the pool, take 24 ({@damage 7d6}) acid damage, and be {@condition restrained} until the start of their next turn.

name: Queen Bargnot

trait.name: Crafty
entries: Queen Bargnot doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when she moves out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Take My Pain (3/Day)
entries: When Queen Bargnot fails a saving throw against a spell or other supernatural effect, she can choose a willing creature within 30 feet of her. Queen Bargnot succeeds on the saving throw, the creature is targeted with the same spell or effect as if they were in her space, and they fail their saving throw automatically.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Queen Bargnot makes three Shortsword attacks or two Shortbow attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Get In Here
entries: Queen Bargnot shouts for aid and {@dice 1d4} {@creature goblin lackey|FleeMortals}s appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of her.

reaction.name: No Dying!
entries: When an ally Queen Bargnot can see within 30 feet of her is reduced to 0 hit points, they are reduced to 1 hit point instead.

legendaryHeader: Queen Bargnot has three villain actions. She can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn.
She can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: What Are You Waiting For?!
entries: Each ally within 60 feet of Queen Bargnot who can hear her can move up to their speed or make a melee weapon attack (no action required).

legendary.name: Action 2: Focus Fire
entries: Queen Bargnot chooses an enemy she can see with 60 feet of her. Queen Bargnot and each ally within 60 feet of her who can hear her can move up to their speed toward the target.

legendary.name: Action 3: Kill!
entries: Each ally within 60 feet of Queen Bargnot who can hear her can make a weapon attack with advantage (no action required). If the attack hits, it deals an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage.

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks not made with cold iron weapons

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Queen of Night and Magic fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Queen of Night and Magic has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Regal Bearing
entries: While the Queen of Night and Magic is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, her AC includes her Charisma modifier.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Queen of Night and Magic makes three Rapier or Star Strike attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting or Unravel.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Star Strike
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 15} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d8 + 8}) fire damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Unravel
entries: The Queen of Night and Magic ends one magical effect she can see within 60 feet of her. To do so, she must succeed on a Charisma check against a DC of 10 + the spell's level or the magical effect's DC, whichever is higher.

action.name: Shadow Rift {@recharge 5}
entries: The Queen of Night and Magic creates a shadowy rift on a point she can see within 120 feet. Each creature within the 20 feet of the rift must make a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 36 ({@damage 8d8}) cold damage and 36 ({@damage 8d8}) necrotic damage and is {@condition restrained} by wisps of icy shadow for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition restrained}. A {@condition restrained} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Hidden Step
entries: The Queen of Night and Magic magically teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space she can see and takes the Hide action.

reaction.name: Sudden Fraying
entries: When the Queen of Night and Magic is targeted by a spell or included in a spell's area and the spell doesn't have an instantaneous duration, she can use Unravel on the spell, dispelling it after it is cast. She doesn't need to see a spell to target it with this reaction, but she must be able to see at least some portion of an area or object affected by the spell.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The Queen of Night and Magic makes one Star Strike attack. She doesn't have disadvantage on this attack roll from being within 5 feet of a creature, though she can have disadvantage from other sources.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The Queen of Night and Magic moves up to her walking speed or up to half of her flying speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Queen of Night and Magic uses Spellcasting.

legendary.name: Swirling Stars (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The stars on the Queen's gown pulse with brilliant starlight. Each creature within 15 feet of her must succeed on a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Queen of Thieves' innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence. She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material, somatic, or verbal components:

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Queen of Thieves is a 20th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 18}, {@hit 10} to hit with spell attacks). She has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: The Queen of Thieves wears an {@item amulet of proof against detection and location} and a {@item spymaster's signet|dungeonsdrakkenheim}. She wields a {@item +3 rapier}.

trait.name: Canny Defense
entries: While the Queen of Thieves is wearing light or no armour and wielding no shield, her AC includes her Intelligence modifier.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: The Queen of Thieves deals an extra 18 {@damage 5d6} damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the Queen of Thieves that isn't incapacitated and she doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Queen of Thieves fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Memory Thief
entries: Creatures are not aware when the Queen of Thieves reads their thoughts or charms them. Additionally, when a spell cast by the Queen of Thieves that causes creatures to become {@condition charmed} ends, she can make the affected creatures lose their memories. They must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence saving throw or forget up to 8 hours of the time spent {@condition charmed} by her. These memories can be restored with a {@spell heal} spell or similar magic.

action.name: +3 Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target {@h}13 ({@damage 1d8 + 8}) piercing damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d4 + 7}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Misdirection
entries: When she would take damage, the Queen of Thieves becomes {@condition invisible} and teleports 60 feet to an unoccupied space she can see. At the same time, an illusory double of her appears where she was standing and lasts for 1 minute. The invisibility ends if the Queen of Thieves attacks or casts a spell, or after 1 minute.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The Queen of Thieves makes one melee or ranged attack.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The Queen of Thieves moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

hp.special: 83 (15d8 + 15) plus 83 (15d8 + 15) per player character

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (1/Round)
headerEntries: The Queen of Thieves casts one of the following spells, requiring no Verbal or Somatic components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}, +10 to spell attacks):

trait.name: Canny Defense
entries: While the Queen of Thieves is wearing light or no armor and wielding no shield, her AC includes her Intelligence modifier (included above).

trait.name: Masked Identity
entries: The Queen of Thieves is immune to any effect that would sense her emotions or read her thoughts, as well as any divination spell that she refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain her intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Memory Thief
entries: Creatures are not aware when the Queen of Thieves reads their thoughts or imposes the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition on them. Additionally, when a spell cast by the her that causes creatures to become {@condition Charmed|XPHB} ends, she can make affected creatures lose their memories. Each creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence saving throw or forget up to 8 hours of the time spent {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by her. These memories can be restored with a {@spell Heal|XPHB} spell or similar magic.

trait.name: Vexing Aura
entries: The Queen of Thieves projects a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of bewitching magic. At the start of each of her turns, she can choose the aura's effect, which applies to creatures of her choice in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}:

items.name: Enchanting Presence
entries: A creature that starts its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until it ends its turn outside the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. If she deals damage to the creature, the condition ends, and that creature is immune to her Enchanting Presence for 24 hours.

items.name: Mocking Laughter
entries: A creature that starts its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage.

action.name: The Queen of Thieves always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On her turn, she can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on her turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, she takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

action.name: +3 Rapier
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 13}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 1d8 + 8}) Piercing damage plus 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Cutting Words
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 18}, one creature within 120 feet of the Queen of Thieves. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} it makes before the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Dash
entries: The Queen of Thieves moves up to her {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

action.name: Misdirection (1/Round)
entries: The Queen of Thieves becomes {@condition Invisible|XPHB} and teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 60 feet. At the same time, an illusory double of her appears where she was standing. The illusory double, as well as the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition, end if the Queen of Thieves attacks or casts a spell, or after 1 minute.

action.name: Resistance Resistance
entries: The Queen of Thieves chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting her and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on her. She can use this action even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks not made with cold iron weapons

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Queen of Witches casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (save {@dc 20}):

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Queen of Witches has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Moonlit Weapons
entries: The Queen of Witches's weapon attacks are magical. When she hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Queen of Witches fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Token of Favor
entries: The Queen of Witches can spend 1 minute cutting and tying a lock of her hair into a small token of her favor. A creature that is wearing or carrying the favor gains the benefits of the Magic Resistance trait. The Queen can revoke this magic at any time (no action required). If she does so, the creature has disadvantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects for 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Queen of Witches makes three Moonsilver Ring attacks or four Mystical Blast attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of spellcasting. If she hits one creature with two Mystical Blast attacks, the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from her.

action.name: Moonsilver Ring
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage.

action.name: Mystical Blast
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) force damage.

action.name: Spray of Moonlight {@recharge 5}
entries: The Queen of Witches sends moonlight flooding out from her. Each creature within 15 feet of her must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 ({@damage 12d6}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the Queen is standing in an area of moonlight when she uses this action, each creature in the area has disadvantage on the saving throw. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more is {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Absorb Spell
entries: When a creature the Queen of Witches can see within 30 feet of her casts a spell, the Queen can absorb the spell's energy, countering it. This works like the {@spell counterspell} spell, except the Queen must always make a spellcasting ability check, no matter the spell's level. Her ability check for this is +10. If she successfully counters the spell, she regains 5 hp for each level of the spell.

legendary.name: Mystical Blast
entries: The Queen makes one Mystical Blast attack.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: The Queen magically teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space she can see within 60 feet.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Queen of Witches uses Spellcasting.

name: Quicksilver Siege Orb
languages: understands one language of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Bludgeoning Bounce (Orb Form Only)
entries: Whenever the quicksilver siege orb is subjected to bludgeoning damage, it takes no damage and instead is pushed up to 15 feet away from the source of the bludgeoning damage. If the damage is from a critical hit, the orb is pushed up to 30 feet.

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The quicksilver siege orb doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The quicksilver siege orb doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The quicksilver siege orb is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Observant (Orb Form Only)
entries: The quicksilver siege orb has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) and Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks. In addition, if the orb observes a creature for at least 1 minute, it has advantage on the first three attack rolls it makes against the creature.

trait.name: Slippery
entries: The quicksilver siege orb has advantage on saving throws and ability checks made to escape a grapple.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quicksilver siege orb makes three Disk Blade or Slam attacks.

action.name: Disk Blade (Disk Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Slam (Orb Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d4 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Slashing Run {@recharge 4}
entries: The quicksilver siege orb flies up to 20 feet in a straight line, then it flies up to 20 feet in a straight line in a different direction. During this move, it can move through the space of any Large or smaller creature. The first time it enters a creature's space during this move, that creature must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 ({@damage 10d6}) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Shape Quicksilver
entries: The quicksilver siege orb flattens itself into a razor-sharp, whirling disk or back into its orb form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It becomes a puddle of quicksilver if it dies.

name: Quickstone Gargoyle

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine (Hardened Form only)

languages: Terran; may know either Common or Goblin

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the gargoyle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate statue.

trait.name: Quickstone Body
entries: At the start of its turn, if it does not have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, the gargoyle can choose whether it adopts a Hardened or Softened Form, each of which grants bonuses.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gargoyle makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. (15 ft. in Softened Form) {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Slashing damage (12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Slashing damage in Hardened Form).

bonus.name: Fluid Form (Softened Form Only)
entries: The gargoyle takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action.

bonus.name: Remold
entries: The gargoyle transforms into a Medium Humanoid, Humanoid statue it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form, though it still appears to be made of stone, except that it loses its {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} if it takes the shape of a Humanoid without wings. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. The gargoyle can choose to reshape its claws to resemble melee weapons of its choice. The damage dice remain the same, but when it takes a new form it can choose to deal Piercing or Bludgeoning damage instead of Slashing damage. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

reaction.name: Rapid Hardening
entries: {@actTrigger} The gargoyle is hit by a weapon attack roll. {@actResponse} The gargoyle gains a +5 bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

trait.name: Nauseating Stench
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the qwyllion must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. A {@condition poisoned} creature that fails this saving throw is also {@condition incapacitated} while {@condition poisoned} in this way. A {@condition poisoned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the qwyllion's Nauseating Stench for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The qwyllion makes three Claw or Deadly Gaze attacks. If two Deadly Gaze attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition incapacitated} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Deadly Gaze
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) psychic damage. A Humanoid slain by this attack rises 8 hours later as a specter under the qwyllion's control, unless the Humanoid is restored to life. The qwyllion can have no more than ten specters under its control at one time.

action.name: Charm
entries: One Humanoid or Beast the qwyllion can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition charmed} for 1 day. The {@condition charmed} target obeys the qwyllion's verbal commands. If the target suffers any harm or receives a suicidal command, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. If the target successfully saves against the effect, or if the effect on it ends, the target is immune to the qwyllion's Charm for the next 24 hours.
The qwyllion can have no more than one Humanoid and up to three Beasts {@condition charmed} at a time. If it charms another Humanoid or a fourth Beast, the oldest effect on a previous target ends.

resist.note: from attacks not made with cold iron weapons

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The radiant lord casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 19}):

trait.name: Cloak of Dawn
entries: When a creature that can see the radiant lord starts its turn within 60 feet of them, the radiant lord can force it to make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw if the radiant lord isn't {@condition incapacitated} and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails, the creature is {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

Unless {@status surprised}, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the radiant lord until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the radiant lord in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the radiant lord fails a saving throw, they can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Lord of Light
entries: Whenever the radiant lord deals damage, they can choose to change the damage type to radiant. Additionally, creatures that would normally be immune to radiant damage are only resistant to radiant damage dealt by the radiant lord.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The radiant lord has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The radiant lord makes two Starmetal Saber attacks or one Starmetal Saber attack and one Spellcasting attack.

action.name: Starmetal Saber
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, range 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) radiant damage. This is a magical weapon that counts as cold iron for the purpose of overcoming damage resistance.

action.name: Comet Shot
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 11} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 5d10}) radiant damage, and the target begins to glow with starlight. The radiant lord has advantage on the next attack roll made against a glowing target.

action.name: Dazzling Presence
entries: Each creature of the radiant lord's choice that is within 120 feet of the radiant lord and aware of them must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition blinded} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the radiant lord's Dazzling Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Meteor Shower {@recharge 5}
entries: Falling stars hit the ground in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point the radiant lord can see within 300 feet. Each creature in the cylinder must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 ({@damage 8d6}) bludgeoning damage and 35 ({@damage 10d6}) radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Saber
entries: Ectius makes a Starmetal Saber attack.

legendary.name: Burn Away (2 actions)
entries: Ectius ends one spell, magical effect, or condition currently affecting them.

legendary.name: Name the Stars (3 actions)
entries: Ectius invokes the true name of a star and summons a portion of its power. The star appears in an unoccupied space Ectius can see. The star is a 20-foot-radius sphere. When the star appears, each creature (other than Ectius) within its area must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw, taking 33 ({@damage 6d10}) radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature trying to move while within the star must make a successful {@dc 19} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to escape its gravitational pull. If it fails the check, it can't move. The star disappears on the next initiative count of 20.

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When Radlee makes an attack, she has advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: Radlee has advantage on saving throws against being moved against her will or knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Tactical Vigilance
entries: Radlee has advantage on initiative checks.
While she isn't {@condition incapacitated}, Radlee and each ally within 30 feet of her who can see or hear her can't be surprised.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Radlee makes three Halberd or three Longbow attacks. Alternatively, she makes one Halberd attack and uses Backswipe.

action.name: Halberd
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 1d10 + 7}) slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Backswipe
entries: Radlee swings her halberd's shaft at a creature within 5 feet of her. The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Protector
entries: When a creature Radlee can see within 10 feet of her attacks one of her allies, Radlee can make a Halberd attack against the attacker.

trait.name: Cat's Grace
entries: When the rakitten falls and isn't incapacitated, it can subtract up to 30 feet from the fall when calculating falling damage. In addition, it has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid the prone condition.

trait.name: Swipey
entries: While not in combat, the rakitten takes any opportunity it can to knock things off shelves and ledges.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Ethereal Paw
entries: A spectral, magical, floating paw appears at a point the rakitten chooses within 30 feet of it. The paw lasts for 1 minute or until the rakitten dismisses it as a bonus action. The paw vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from the rakitten or if the rakitten uses this action again.

The rakitten can use its action to control the paw. It can use the paw to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial. It can move the paw up to 30 feet each time it uses it. The paw can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ramag has advantage on saving throws against spells or other magical effects.

trait.name: Portal Sense
entries: The ramag can pinpoint the location of planar portals within 100 feet of it and can sense the general direction of planar portals within 1 mile of it. In addition, if the ramag spends 10 minutes studying a portal, it can determine the portal's destination and any requirements to use or activate it.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Portal Traveler {@recharge 5}
entries: The ramag creates and steps into a small portal and out of an identical portal in a space it can see within 60 feet of it. If a creature is in the destination space, the creature must make a {@dc 13} Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, the ramag trades spaces with the creature. On a success, the ramag fails to teleport. Whatever the result, the portal disappears.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The ranger is a 6th-level spellcaster and can cast the following spells, using Wisdom as its spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Land's Stride
entries: Moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs the ranger no extra movement. It can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ranger makes three attacks with its Shortsword or two attacks with its Longbow.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Volley
entries: The ranger makes a separate Longbow attack against each creature of its choice within 10 feet of a point it can see within the weapon's range.

action.name: Whirlwind
entries: The ranger makes a separate Shortsword attack against each creature of its choice within its reach.

bonus.name: Hunter's Mark (1/Short or Long Rest)
entries: The ranger chooses one creature it can see within 90 feet and mystically marks it as its quarry for 1 hour. For the duration, the ranger deals an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage to the target whenever it hits it with a weapon attack, and the ranger has advantage on any Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) or Wisdom ({@skill Survival|PHB}) check it makes to find the creature. If the target drops to 0 hit points before this effect ends, the ranger can use a bonus action on a subsequent turn to mark a new creature.

name: Raptor Deckhand
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, the deckhand can spend a reaction to fly up to its speed in one direction as it descends. It lands in an unoccupied space at the end of its movement, and takes no falling damage. The deckhand can't glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though it can drop any held items as part of its reaction).

trait.name: Talons
entries: The deckhand has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface its talons could reasonably grip.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: The deckhand has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

trait.name: Patient
entries: When the deckhand reacts with a {@action Ready||readied action}, it has advantage on the first attack roll, skill check, or ability check it makes as a part of that action.

trait.name: Sure Footing
entries: The deckhand ignores non-magical difficult terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deckhand makes two melee attacks or two attacks with its hand crossbow.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Saber
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, ranged 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

items.name: Net Gun
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80 ft., one target. {@h} A character hit by a net attack takes no damage but is {@condition restrained}. A {@condition restrained} creature can free itself by using an action to make a {@dc 13} Strength check. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the {@item net|PHB} (AC 13) also frees the creature without harm, ending the effect and destroying the net.

name: Raptor Explorer
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, the explorer can spend a reaction to fly up to their speed in one direction as they descend. They land in an unoccupied space at the end of their movement, and take no falling damage. They cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though they can drop any held items as part of their reaction).

trait.name: Talons

entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 14}, one creature within 15 feet that is infected with a disease. {@actSaveFail} The target has one of the following conditions (the ratling's choice): {@condition Addled|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, {@condition Clumsy|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, or {@condition Enfeebled|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} (save ends). The condition immediately ends and is replace by a new condition if the ratling uses Metastasize on the target again. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Necrotic damage.

bonus.name: Rampant Sickness
entries: The ratling spreads its Infection from an infected target to another creature adjacent to that target.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The ratling has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The ratling has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the ratling's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Sling
