entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 30/120 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Ratling Cunning
entries: The ratling takes the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Slaughter Lord's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the Slaughter Lord fails a {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While the Slaughter Lord is wearing no armor and not wielding a {@item shield|PHB}, its AC includes its Constitution modifier.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Slaughter Lord makes four attacks with its dual greatswords or three attacks with its spear.

action.name: Dual Greatswords
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage, or 15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage if used with both hands to make a melee attack.

bonus.name: Aggressive
entries: The Slaughter Lord can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature it can see.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The Slaughter Lord makes a spear or dual greatswords attack.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The Slaughter Lord moves up to half its speed.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The Slaughter Lord {@action cast a spell|PHB|casts an innate spell}.

trait.name: Stabby Frenzy
entries: When the stabby-stabber hits with a melee attack, it can attack again and continue making additional attacks until it misses. The stabby-stabber cannot move between the attacks made with this trait.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The stabby-stabber can use the {@action Disengage} or {@action Hide} action.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ravenala has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Woodland Stride
entries: Difficult terrain composed of magical or nonmagical plants doesn't cost the ravenala extra movement. In addition, it can pass through magical or nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ravenala makes two Bursting Pod or Slam attacks. If both Slam attacks hit a Medium or smaller creature, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}), and the ravenala uses its Lamenting Engulfment on the target.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Bursting Pod
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage, and each creature within 5 feet of the target, including the target, must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Lamenting Engulfment
entries: The ravenala engulfs a Medium or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by it. The engulfed target is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside the ravenala, and it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw at the start of each of the ravenala's turns or sing a lament of the mistakes and misdeeds it has performed in its lifetime. While singing, the engulfed creature can still act, but it can't otherwise speak, including casting spells with verbal components. If the ravenala moves, the engulfed creature moves with it. The ravenala can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

action.name: Healing Leaves (3/Day)
entries: The ravenala removes a leaf from its head and wraps the leaf around the wounds of one creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target magically regains 10 {@dice 3d6} hp and is freed from any disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

action.name: Encourage Growth (3/Day)
entries: The ravenala whispers magical words of growth to nonmagical plants on a point it can see within 30 feet of it. The plants burst with life and spread rapidly. The area within 20 feet of that point becomes difficult terrain for 24 hours.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the ravencraft to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it makes a Constitution saving throw ({@dc 5} plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}. On a successful save, the ravencraft drops to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} instead.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Harbinger of Doom (2/Day)
entries: The ravencraft lets out a wail of anguish commingling with the croaking of ravens. {@actSave wis} {@dc 11}, one creature within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Death Veil
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature within 30 feet of the ravencraft makes a {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB}. {@actResponse} The creature has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the save.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The doom croaker has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The doom croaker can mimic animal sounds and Humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

trait.name: Rune-Powered Weapons
entries: The ravenfolk's weapon attacks are magical. When the ravenfolk hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 2d8} radiant damage (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The doom croaker makes one Peck attack and one Runestaff attack, or it makes two Rune Blast attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Ghost Wings or Prophetic Call, if available.

action.name: Peck
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Runestaff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Rune Blast
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) radiant damage.

action.name: Ghost Wings
entries: The doom croaker furiously "beats" a set of phantasmal wings. Each creature within 5 feet of the ravenfolk must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Prophetic Magic
entries: The ravenfolk doom croaker can cast the {@spell augury} spell and {@spell thaumaturgy} cantrip at will, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

action.name: Prophetic Caw {@recharge}
entries: The ravenfolk doom croaker caws a prophecy that sounds different to each listener. Each creature within 30 feet of the ravenfolk that can hear it must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. Ravenfolk have advantage on the saving throw. On a failure, a creature hears a prophecy of its doom and is {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. On a success, a creature hears a prophecy of its greatness and has advantage on the first attack roll it makes on each of its turns for 1 minute. A {@condition frightened} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The ravenfolk scout can mimic animal sounds and Humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

action.name: Peck
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Ghost Wings
entries: The ravenfolk scout furiously "beats" a set of phantasmal wings. Each creature within 5 feet of the ravenfolk must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The ravenfolk warrior can mimic animal sounds and Humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

trait.name: Rune-Powered Weapons
entries: The ravenfolk's weapon attacks are magical. When the ravenfolk hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d8} radiant damage (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ravenfolk warrior makes one Peck attack and one Runespear attack, or it makes two Longbow attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Ghost Wings.

action.name: Peck
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Runespear
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Ghost Wings
entries: The ravenfolk warrior furiously "beats" a set of phantasmal wings. Each creature within 5 feet of the ravenfolk must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the start of its next turn

reaction.name: Odin's Call {@recharge}
entries: When the ravenfolk warrior takes damage while below half its hp maximum, it moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

hp.special: 42 (4d10 + 20) plus 42 (4d10 + 20) per player character

trait.name: Writhing Aura
entries: The ground within 30 feet of the ravenous flora is filled with plant roots and becomes {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. A creature that starts its turn in the aura takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage.

trait.name: Poison Ivy
entries: If the ravenous flora would take Poison damage, it instead takes no damage and regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Poison damage it would have received.

action.name: The ravenous flora always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the ravenous flora can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the ravenous flora takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and the ravenous flora can't Bite another target.

items.name: Spit Acid
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 2d4} Acid). While {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Swallow
entries: The ravenous flora makes one Bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it has {@condition Grappled|XPHB}. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed and the grapple ends. The swallowed target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} from attacks and effects outside the flora, and takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns. The flora can have up to four targets swallowed at a time.

If the flora takes 15 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition in unoccupied spaces within 10 feet of it. If the flora dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Hypnotic Pollen (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the ravenous flora. {@actSaveFail} 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends). While {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, the target must spend all of its movement on each of its turns to move directly toward the ravenous flora. During this movement, the target ignores {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} caused by the flora's Writhing Aura.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The ravenous flora chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The ravenous flora can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The ghoul has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the ghoul's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Rancid Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Poison damage.

bonus.name: Aggressive
entries: The ghoul moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} toward a {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature it can see.

trait.name: Dark Ground
entries: As an action, the razorleaf can dig its roots into the ground, securing itself in place and causing the area in a 20-foot radius around it to be shrouded in shadow. While rooted in this way, the razorleaf's speed becomes 0, it can't be knocked {@condition prone}, and its attacks deal an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage. This area is difficult terrain and nonmagical sources of light are only half as effective while within it. Small and smaller beasts with Intelligence 3 or lower in the area lose their natural coloration and turn pale grey. These creatures are {@condition charmed} by the razorleaf while within the area. Plants and trees inside the area turn an ashen color. The razorleaf can recall its roots and end this effect as a bonus action.

trait.name: Do Not Touch
entries: A creature that touches the razorleaf or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Light Sensitivity
entries: While in bright light, the razorleaf has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The razorleaf makes two lacerating leaves attacks.

action.name: Lacerating Leaves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 3d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Shower of Razors {@recharge 5}
entries: The razorleaf shakes loose a deadly shower of slicing leaves. Each creature within 10 feet of the razorleaf must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The reality cyst is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Unhinged Reality
entries: The reality cyst emits a 120-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of unhinged reality. A creature that starts its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until it leaves the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. While {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, the target believes itself to be in an altered and confused environment of shifting forms, and can't see or hear anything else. The target does not perceive itself to be stationary, and instead believes it is walking through a bizarre landscape. It can take an action on its turn to repeat the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the creature succeeds on its save or the effect ends for it, it is immune to the reality cyst's Unhinged Reality for 24 hours.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The reality cyst doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Psychic Whip
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the reality cyst's next turn. The reality cyst can target a creature {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} by its Unhinged Reality with this attack even if the creature has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover}.

bonus.name: Feed
entries: Each creature {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} by Unhinged Reality takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage. The reality cyst regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the total damage dealt, and its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} Maximum increases by the same amount.

reaction.name: Fracture
entries: {@actTrigger} The reality cyst takes damage. {@actResponse d}{@actSave int} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the reality cyst. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Addled|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

name: Reautomata
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Relentless Endurance
entries: If damage reduces the reautomata to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 plus the damage taken, unless the damage is from a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}. On a success, the reautomata drops to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} instead.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The reautomata's {@variantrule Long Jump|XPHB} is up to 50 feet and its {@variantrule High Jump|XPHB} is up to 30 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The reautomata makes two Arm Blade attacks and one Entrapping Rend attack.

action.name: Arm Blade
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) Slashing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed up to 5 feet away from the reautomata and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Entrapping Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft., one {@condition Prone|XPHB} target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) Piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 17}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and the reautomata can't make Entrapping Rend attacks against another target.

bonus.name: Aggressive
entries: The reautomata moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} toward a {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature it can see. This movement doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

name: Reautomata Wrecker
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The reautomata deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The reautomata makes one Drill attack and one Wrecking Ball attack.

action.name: Drill
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 5 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Wrecking Ball
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 20 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage. {@actSave str} {@dc 20}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends) and the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Destructive Rampage {@recharge}
entries: The reautomata moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} in a straight line, moving through the space of any Medium or smaller creature on its path. The first time its enters each creature's space during this move, it can make a Drill or Wrecking Ball attack against that creature.

bonus.name: Overdrive Engine (1/Day; {@status Bloodied|XPHB} Only)
entries: The reautomata's Destructive Rampage recharges, and it gains {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to all damage and conditions until the end of its next turn. For the duration, the reautomata automatically succeeds on all saving throws and Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution-based ability checks and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls. It can't be forced to move or affected by spells of level 8 or lower unless it chooses to be. Features and effects that ignore {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|Resistances} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immunities}, such as a Vorpal Weapon, don't function against the reautomata unless those effects are caused by a level 9 spell or an artifact.

At the end of its next turn, the reautomata dies and explodes. {@actSave dex} {@dc 20}, each creature in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the reautomata when it dies. {@actSaveFail} 20 ({@damage 8d4}) Acid damage plus 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

trait.name: Ascendant Transformation
entries: When Vladimir von Drakken drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, his body explodes in a shower of gore and he reappears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet as Ascendant Vladimir von Drakken. His {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} doesn't change.

trait.name: Aura of Dread
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Vladimir von Drakken takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Bloodthirsty
entries: Vladimir von Drakken has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against a target with the {@status Bloodied|XPHB} or {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

trait.name: Daywalker
entries: Vladimir von Drakken doesn't possess any Vampire Weaknesses from the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Vladimir von Drakken regains 30 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} remaining.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: Vladimir von Drakken can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Vladimir von Drakken always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On his turn, Vladimir von Drakken can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Vladimir von Drakken takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Bloodmourne
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 5 ft. {@h}27 ({@damage 6d6 + 6}) Force damage, and the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d4}). In addition, Vladimir von Drakken can apply one of the following martial maneuvers to the target:

items.name: Advance
entries: Vladimir von Drakken pushes the target 15 feet, then moves up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

items.name: Hamstring
entries: The target has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Overpower
entries: The target has the {@condition Staggered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 5 ft. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 20}).

action.name: Bite (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 20}, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, or {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveFail} 49 ({@damage 14d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dc 20} Constitution save ends). Vladimir von Drakken regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Necrotic damage dealt. A Humanoid killed by this damage rises on its next turn as a Vampire Spawn under Vladimir von Drakken's control.

action.name: Dominate (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 20}, one creature Vladimir von Drakken can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. While {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, the target obeys Vladimir von Drakken's commands and can't take Reactions. Failure by 5 or More: The {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition lasts 24 hours or until Vladimir von Drakken is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Each time the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. {@actSaveSuccess} The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on its next attack roll against Vladimir von Drakken.

action.name: Wing Blast (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 20}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from Vladimir von Drakken. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from Vladimir von Drakken and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Before or after using this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, Vladimir von Drakken can move up to half his {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

action.name: Shadow Step (2/Round)
entries: Vladimir von Drakken teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet that is in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}. He has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the next melee attack he makes before the end of this round.

action.name: Shape-Shift (1/Round)
entries: Vladimir von Drakken shape-shifts into a Tiny bat ({@variantrule Speed|XPHB} 5 ft., {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} 30 ft.) or a Medium cloud of mist ({@variantrule Speed|XPHB} 5 ft., {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} 20 ft. [hover]), or he returns to his vampire form. Anything he is wearing transforms with him.

While in bat or mist form, Vladimir von Drakken can't speak. His game statistics, other than his size and {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, are unchanged, but he can't use {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} other than Shape-Shift and Epic {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB}. While in mist form, Vladimir von Drakken can't speak or manipulate objects, and loses his Aura of Dread. He is weightless and can enter an enemy's space and stop there. If air can pass through a space, the mist can do so, but it can't pass through liquid. He has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all damage.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: Vladimir von Drakken chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. He can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

reaction.name: Spell-Reflecting Strike
entries: {@actTrigger} Vladimir von Drakken makes a successful saving throw against a spell, or a spell attack misses him. {@actResponse} Vladimir von Drakken can choose another creature (including the spellcaster) he can see within 120 feet of him. The spell targets the chosen creature instead of Vladimir von Drakken. If the spell forces a saving throw, the chosen creature makes its own save. If the spell was an attack, the attack roll is rerolled against the chosen creature.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The red hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The red hag can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Blood Sense
entries: The red hag can pinpoint the location of creatures that aren't Constructs or Undead within 60 feet of her and can sense the general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of her.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The red hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts
entries: The red hag can communicate with Beasts as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes two Claw attacks or three Blood Bolt attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Blood Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 8} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature with blood, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Siphon Blood {@recharge 5}
entries: The red hag drains blood from nearby creatures. Each creature that isn't a Construct or Undead within 20 feet of the red hag must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw, taking 35 ({@damage 10d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If at least one creature fails the saving throw, the next spell the red hag casts is cast as if the spell used a spell slot two levels higher than the spell's lowest level.

trait.name: Reactive Venom
entries: If the spider deals poison damage to a creature that is {@condition poisoned}, the target takes an extra 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down and on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Swingline
entries: The spider throws a length of webbing at a point on a surface, such as the ground or wall, it can see within 30 feet of it, attaching one end of the webbing to that point. It then reels in the webbing, pulling itself to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of that point. When the spider moves in this way, opportunity attacks against it have disadvantage. If the spider pulled itself at least 15 feet straight toward a creature, it has advantage on the next Bite attack it makes against that creature before the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Red Cap
entries: The redcap must soak its cap in the blood of a Humanoid that has been dead for no more than 1 hour at least once every 3 days. Every 24 hours past the third day that it goes without soaking its cap in blood in this way, it suffers one level of {@condition exhaustion}. This {@condition exhaustion} can be reduced only when the redcap finishes a long rest after soaking its cap in fresh Humanoid blood, which reduces its {@condition exhaustion} level to 0. If the redcap dies as a result of this {@condition exhaustion}, it crumbles to dust.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The redcap makes one Bleeding Bite attack and two Pike attacks.

action.name: Bleeding Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature other than a Construct or Undead, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or lose 7 {@dice 2d6} hp at the start of each of its turns due to a bleeding wound. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Any creature can take an action to stanch the wound with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check. The wound also closes if the target receives magical healing.

action.name: Pike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Solid Kick
entries: The redcap kicks a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the golem remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary pile of garbage.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature other than a refuse golem that starts its turn within 10 feet of the golem, must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned|phb} until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of all refuse golems for 1 hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing or slashing damage (golem's choice).

action.name: Hurl Junk
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Missile Absorption
entries: When the golem is hit by a ranged weapon attack, it absorbs the projectile into its form. When it does so, the damage it takes from the attack is reduced by 11 ({@dice 2d10}). A creature within 5 feet of the golem can take an action to pull an absorbed projectile out of it with a successful {@dc 15} Strength check.

trait.name: Agile
entries: The reindeer doesn't provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attack} when it moves out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Snowstrider
entries: Snow and ice are not {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} for the reindeer.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Burst of Speed (3/day)
entries: The reindeer's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} doubles until the start of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The chosen is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following sorcerer spells prepared:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The chosen has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1} against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Withering Spells
entries: When the chosen casts a spell of 1st level or higher, the next Withered Hand attack it makes before the end of its next turn deals extra damage equal to {@dice 1d6} per level of the spell cast.

action.name: Withering Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 5d6}) force damage plus extra damage from the Withering Touch trait. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, the creature and everything it is wearing and carrying, except magic items, are reduced to a pile of fine gray dust. The creature can be restored to life only by means of a {@spell true resurrection} or a {@spell wish} spell.

bonus.name: Inescapable Sight
entries: The Chosen selects a creature or object under the effect of {@filter an illusion spell of 4th level or lower|spells|school=I|level=0;1;2;3;4}. One illusion of the Chosen's choice affecting the target is dispelled.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The remnant cultist is an 11th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). The cultist has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Unknowable Secrets
entries: Any attempt to form a mental link with the cultist, cast {@spell scrying} on the cultist, or cast {@spell speak with dead} on the cultist automatically fails, and the creature that initiated the attempt takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage.

trait.name: One-Eyed
entries: The cultist has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|disadvantage} on any attack roll made against a target more than 30 feet away.

trait.name: Spellsteal
entries: If the cultist successfully uses {@spell counterspell} to negate another creature's spell, it can cast the countered spell once before the end of its next turn using one of its spell slots of the same level or higher, and requiring no material components.

action.name: Dagger of Wounding
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage. Hit points lost to {@item sword of wounding|DMG|this weapon's} damage can be regained only through a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|short or long rest}, rather than by regeneration, magic, or any other means.

Once per turn when the cultist hits a creature with an attack using this weapon, it can wound its target. At the start of each of the wounded creature's turns, it takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) necrotic damage for each time it's been wounded by this weapon. It can then make a {@dc 15} Constitution {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}, ending the effect of all such wounds on itself on a success. Alternatively, the wounded creature, or a creature within 5 feet of it, can use an action to make a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check, ending the effect of such wounds on it on a success.

trait.name: Compelled Contest
entries: The reveler can't refuse a contest of skill with Musical Instruments. As an {@action Influence|XPHB} action, a creature can make a Charisma ({@skill Performance|XPHB}) check using a Musical Instrument. The reveler must succeed on a Charisma saving throw with a DC equal to the check's total or take 20 Psychic damage and have the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of the creature's next turn.

trait.name: Dancing Step
entries: The reveler doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} when it leaves an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Ensemble Form
entries: The reveler takes on a specific form: Drone, Drum, or Bell. The form determines certain traits and actions, as well as the instrument the reveler plays (hurdy gurdy, frame drum, or handbells, respectively).

trait.name: Droning Swarm (Drone Only)
entries: A droning swarm of bees surrounds the reveler. {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, each creature that ends its turn in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the reveler. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The reveler makes two Instrumental Blast attacks.

action.name: Instrumental Blast
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Thunder damage.

action.name: Infectious Rhythm (Drum Only)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, up to two creatures the reveler can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Psychic damage, and the target is affected by the {@spell Otto's Irresistible Dance|XPHB|Irresistible Dance} spell (no {@status Concentration|XPHB} required to maintain the spell). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Stunning Clangor (Bell Only)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, one creature the reveler can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 40 ({@damage 9d8}) Thunder damage, and the target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of the reveler's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Moral Quandary
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, a creature can recite the moral of a story using the same theme as the reveler's Storied Form to weaken it for 1 hour. While weakened, the reveler can't take {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|Reactions}, and its AC is reduced by 4.

trait.name: Storied Form
entries: The reveler takes on a specific form: Great Beast, Hero, or Witch. The form determines certain traits and the theme of stories the reveler embodies (powerful monsters, brave heroes, or wicked magicians, respectively).

trait.name: Terror Feeding (Witch Only)
entries: If there is at least one creature with the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition within 30 feet of the reveler at the end of its turn, the reveler gains 15 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The reveler makes three Thrash attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Fabled Assault if available.

action.name: Thrash
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 10 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) Force damage.

action.name: Fabled Assault {@recharge 5}
entries: The reveler uses the option determined by its Storied Form:

action.name: Consuming Bite (Great Beast Only)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, one creature within 5 feet (with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} if the reveler is grappling the target). {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Necrotic damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}), and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The reveler gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Necrotic damage taken.

action.name: Heroic Charge (Hero Only)
entries: The reveler moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} in a straight line without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}, and it can move through other creatures without expending extra movement to do so. {@actSave str} {@dc 17}, each creature whose space the reveler enters. {@actSaveFail} 26 ({@damage 4d12}) Force damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Wicked Storm (Witch Only)
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Lightning damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition. While {@condition Frightened|XPHB} in this way, the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0. A {@condition Frightened|XPHB} target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Dramatic Reversal
entries: {@actTrigger} The reveler is hit by an attack roll. {@actResponse} The reveler adds 4 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

spellcasting.name: Know Fear
headerEntries: Turakbar casts {@spell Detect Thoughts|XPHB}, requiring no components, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}. He can only detect the thoughts of creatures that can be {@condition Frightened|XPHB}. If he probes deeper into a creature's mind, he can only learn the target's fears.

trait.name: Horned King's Curse
entries: Creatures that are cursed by Turakbar (see Pact Gauntlet) have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws, and Turakbar deals an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage whenever he hits a cursed target with a melee attack.

trait.name: Labyrinthine Recall
entries: Turakbar can perfectly recall any path he has traveled.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of his turn, Turakbar can gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all melee attack rolls he makes during that turn, but attack rolls against him have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} until the start of his next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Turakbar makes one Greataxe attack or one Gore attack, and one Pact Gauntlet attack.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d12 + 5}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Pact Gauntlet
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target is cursed by Turakbar for 1 minute (see Horned King's Curse).

action.name: Blood for the Overlord
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, creatures within 40 feet of Turakbar. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Necrotic damage for each creature currently affected by Turakbar's curse and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of their next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage and the target does not have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition. Creatures that are cursed by Turakbar's Pact Gauntlet are no longer cursed.

bonus.name: Ferocious Charge
entries: {@actTrigger} Turakbar moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Gore attack on the same turn. {@actResponse} Turakbar can make a Pact Gauntlet attack.

reaction.name: Bloodlust
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} while within 15 feet of Turakbar. {@actResponse} Turakbar gains 20 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

name: Rhys Birchwalker
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Hunter's Training
entries: Rhys has proficiency with the {@item longbow|phb}, {@item shortbow|phb}, and {@item spear|phb}. Additionally, her familiarity with the longbow means that it is not considered a heavy weapon for her.

trait.name: Talons
entries: Rhys has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface her talons could reasonably grip.

trait.name: Aerial Defense
entries: Creatures who attack Rhys while she ranger is falling, gliding, or jumping have disadvantage on their attack roll.

action.name: Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) slashing damage.

name: Riffin, the Ash-Knight
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Riffin can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. He cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

trait.name: Talons
entries: Riffin rolls advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface his talons could reasonably grip.

trait.name: Maneuver (2/Day)
entries: When Riffin hits with an attack, he can choose to maneuver the enemy out of position, granting an ally within 5 feet of the target the opportunity to use their reaction to move away from this enemy at half their movement speed without provoking an {@action opportunity attack|phb|attack of opportunity}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Riffin makes two short sword attacks.

action.name: Short Sword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage. The knight can choose to grapple a target hit by this attack as a bonus action.

action.name: Wing Crest Shield (1/Day)
entries: Riffin casts the {@spell gust of wind} spell (save {@dc 15}).

trait.name: Chaos Mutations
entries: At the start of each of its turns, the rift swine's body experiences a mutation. Choose an option or roll a {@dice d6} to determine the type of mutation. The mutation lasts until the start of the rift swine's next turn.

trait.name: 1 Acid Boils
entries: The next creature that hits the rift swine with a melee attack while within 5 feet of the rift swine takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage.

trait.name: 2 Acid Saliva
entries: The next melee attack the rift swine makes that hits a creature deals an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage to the creature.

trait.name: 3 Extra Eyes
entries: The rift swine has advantage on the next attack roll it makes.

trait.name: 4 Extra Hooves
entries: The rift swine's speed increases by 10 feet, and the rift swine doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it moves out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: 5 Second Heart
entries: The rift swine gains 10 {@dice 3d6} temporary hp.

trait.name: 6 Toughened Hide
entries: The rift swine has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage (the rift swine's choice).

trait.name: Dozens of Eyes
entries: The rift swine has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight and on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}. In addition, if the rift swine isn't {@condition blinded}, creatures attacking it can't benefit from traits and features that rely on a creature's allies distracting or surrounding the rift swine, such as the Pack Tactics trait or Sneak Attack class feature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rift swine makes one Tusk attack and two Tentacle attacks, or it makes three Warping Bolt attacks.

action.name: Tusk
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}. The rift swine has two tentacles, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Warping Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 4} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 3d6 + 1}) force damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls as reality-warping energies temporarily distort its body.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The rime worm can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Icy Body
entries: A creature that touches the rime worm or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) cold damage.

trait.name: Snow Camouflage
entries: The rime worm has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

trait.name: Snow Stride
entries: The rime worm can burrow through nonmagical snow and ice in addition to sand, earth, and mud. In addition, difficult terrain composed of snow or ice doesn't cost it extra movement.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rime worm makes two Rime Tendril attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Freeze Prey.

action.name: Rime Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage. The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}) if it is a Medium or smaller creature and the rime worm doesn't have another creature {@condition grappled}.

action.name: Freeze Prey
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the rime worm must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition petrified} in ice for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A {@condition petrified} creature that takes fire damage has advantage on the saving throw.

action.name: Black Ice Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: The rime worm sprays slivers of ice in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The area then becomes icy, difficult terrain for 1 minute.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The rime worm grub can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Ravenous Larva
entries: The rime worm grub can make an opportunity attack against any creature that leaves its reach, even if the creature takes the Disengage action. In addition, it has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hp.

trait.name: Snow Camouflage
entries: The rime worm grub has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

trait.name: Snow Stride
entries: The rime worm grub can burrow through nonmagical snow and ice in addition to sand, earth, and mud. In addition, difficult terrain composed of snow or ice doesn't cost it extra movement.

action.name: Rime Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) cold damage.

name: Ripper
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Dismemberment
entries: Creatures killed by attacks made by the ripper can't be restored to life except by a {@spell Resurrection|XPHB} spell or similar magic.

trait.name: Feed on Fear
entries: {@condition Frightened|XPHB} creatures have the {@condition Helpless|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and {@condition Defenseless|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} conditions against attacks made by the ripper.

trait.name: Insensitive to Pain
entries: Critical Hits against the ripper become normal hits.

action.name: Whirling Bonesaw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) Slashing damage, and the ripper can immediately make another Whirling Bonesaw attack against the same target. This attack ignores {@spell Resistance|XPHB} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Slashing damage.

action.name: Gory Display {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, each creature that can see the ripper. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition (save ends). While {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 0 and can't increase.

reaction.name: Unstoppable Lurch
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature deals damage to the ripper. {@actResponse} The ripper moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} toward that creature without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action. If the ripper ends this movement within reach of the creature, it gains {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on its next attack roll against the creature.

name: Risen Reaver
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Blood Sense
entries: The risen reaver can pinpoint the location of creatures that aren't Constructs or Undead within 60 feet of it and can sense the general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of it.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The risen reaver doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The risen reaver makes three Bladed Fist attacks.

action.name: Bladed Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) slashing damage.

bonus.name: Skitter
entries: The risen reaver takes the Dash action.

reaction.name: Infused Arsenal
entries: When the risen reaver is hit with a nonmagical melee weapon or when it starts its turn in the same space as a nonmagical melee weapon that isn't being worn or carried, it absorbs the weapon into its body. If the weapon is being wielded by an attacker, the attacker must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or lose its weapon. For 1 minute, the reaver has resistance to the type of damage dealt by that weapon, and when it hits with its Bladed Fist, the fist deals an extra 2 {@damage 1d4} damage of the type dealt by the weapon. The reaver can absorb no more than three weapons in this way every 24 hours.

name: Risen Sporehusk
languages: understands Common plus one other language it knew but can't speak

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The sporehusk regains 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn. If the sporehusk takes Fire or Radiant damage, this trait doesn't function on the sporehusk's next turn. The sporehusk dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Sunlight Weakness
entries: While in sunlight, the sporehusk has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@dice D20} Tests.

action.name: Grab
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 11}).

bonus.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. (must target a creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the sporehusk). {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Piercing damage.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The giant can hold their breath for 10 minutes.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The giant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Mindful Wader
entries: The giant is immune to the effects of dark water (see Chapter 5 of Book of Ebon Tides for more on dark water).

trait.name: Netted Strike
entries: Once per turn, the giant can deal an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage to a {@condition restrained} creature the giant hits with a weapon attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes a Mooncatcher's Net attack and then two Staff attacks.

action.name: Staff
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Mooncatcher's Net
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, ranged 20/60 ft., one Small, Medium, or Large creature. {@h}The target is {@condition restrained} until it escapes the net. A creature can use its action to make a {@dc 16} Strength check to free itself or another creature in the net, ending the effect on a success. Dealing 15 slashing damage to the net (AC 14) frees the target.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks not made with cold iron weapons

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The River King casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (save {@dc 16}):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The River King can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the River King fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Riparian Weapons
entries: The River King's weapon attacks are magical. When he hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The River King makes two Longsword or Flood Blast attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) slashing damage, or 10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Flood Blast
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 8} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 30 feet away from the River King and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Grasping Whirlpool {@recharge 5}
entries: The River King magically creates a swirling vortex of water centered on a point he can see within 60 feet. The vortex appears in the shape of a cylinder that is 15 feet tall with a 10-foot radius. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 36 ({@damage 8d8}) bludgeoning damage and is {@condition restrained}. On a success, a creature takes half the damage, isn't {@condition restrained}, and can choose to be pushed out of the whirlpool's space. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw. While {@condition restrained}, a creature is unable to breathe unless it can breathe water, and it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw at the end of each of its turns or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage. A creature, including the {@condition restrained} creature, can take an action to free the {@condition restrained} creature by succeeding on a {@dc 18} Strength check. A creature with a swimming speed has advantage on the saving throw and on the Strength check to escape.

reaction.name: Blade Current
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the River King stands up from {@condition prone}, he can make one Longsword attack against that creature.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The River King makes a Longsword or Flood Blast attack.

legendary.name: Flow
entries: The River King moves up to his walking speed, or swims up to half his swimming speed, without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Ripple (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The River King magically ripples like sunlight on the surface of water. Until the start of his next turn, attack rolls against him have disadvantage.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks not made with cold iron weapons

trait.name: Bridge Defender
entries: When the river spirit hits a creature with an opportunity attack, the target's speed becomes 0 until the beginning of the target's next turn. In addition, a river spirit can make an opportunity attack against a creature even if they take the Disengage action before leaving their reach.

trait.name: Duty Bound
entries: The river spirit cannot willingly travel more than 300 feet away from the bridge or other location to which they are bound. If the river spirit if forcibly taken beyond this range, they burst into a spray of mist and instantly reappear, standing atop their bridge. If a river spirit is slain, they disappear for 24 hours and then reappear atop their bridge with full hit points.

Stepping-stones. Wherever the river spirit steps, a solid stepping-stone made of water appears. A river spirit can move in this manner in any direction as if they were flying. The stepping-stones created by the river spirit cannot support the weight of any other creatures, just the river spirit.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The river spirit makes two Longsword attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Liquid Lash
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be pulled 25 feet closer to the river spirit.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: River casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}, +7 to spell attacks):

trait.name: Academy Rings (1/Day)
entries: River can cast a spell from Spellcasting without expending a use of it.

action.name: Force Missile
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 120 ft. {@h}28 ({@damage 8d6}) Force damage.

bonus.name: Misty Step {@recharge 5}
entries: River casts {@spell Misty Step|XPHB} using the spellcasting ability from Spellcasting.

reaction.name: River's Contingency
entries: {@actTrigger} River becomes {@status Bloodied|XPHB}. {@actResponse} River casts {@spell Mislead|XPHB} and teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 30 feet.

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While the brawler is wearing no armor and wielding no {@item shield|PHB}, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The brawler makes three unarmed strikes.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the brawler can choose one of the following additional effects:

items.name: Bruise
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}. On a failure, its speed is reduced by 5 feet until it receives at least 1 point of magical healing. A creature can use its action to make a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check to heal an affected creature within 5 feet of it (including itself), restoring any lost speed on a success.

items.name: Disarm
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or drop one item it is holding. The brawler can choose which item is dropped, and can pick it up.

items.name: Suplex
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Clever Fighter
entries: When the brawler hits with an attack or is targeted by an attack, it can add its Intelligence modifier (+2) to its damage rolls or AC until the end of its turn.

reaction.name: Endurance (Recharges after a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|Short or Long Rest})
entries: When the brawler takes damage, it can reduce the damage by 8 ({@dice 1d12 + 2}).

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The stormborn's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 12}). The stormborn can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the stormborn can gain {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stormborn makes two greataxe attacks. If it is concentrating on {@spell call lightning}, it can also call down a lightning bolt.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) lightning damage.

reaction.name: Endurance (Recharges after a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|Short or Long rest})
entries: When the stormborn takes damage, it can reduce the damage by 10 ({@dice 1d12 + 4}).

trait.name: Hardy
entries: The roachling lord is immune to diseases and has advantage on Constitution saving throws.

trait.name: Unpleasant Scent
entries: The roachling lord has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) checks when interacting with Beasts and on Charisma checks when interacting with Humanoids. If the roachling lord bathes meticulously, it loses this trait for 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The roachling lord makes two Begrimed Shortsword or Begrimed Dart attacks.

action.name: Begrimed Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Begrimed Dart
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

trait.name: Hardy
entries: The roachling is immune to diseases and has advantage on Constitution saving throws.

trait.name: Unpleasant Scent
entries: The roachling has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) checks when interacting with Beasts and on Charisma checks when interacting with Humanoids. If the roachling bathes meticulously, it loses this trait for 24 hours.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Dart
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

name: Rocborne Chief
languages: Common plus up to three other languages

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The chief is a 13th-level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 15}). They know the following ranger spells:

trait.name: Guiding Wind (1/Turn)
entries: The chief can deal an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack. Alternatively, when the chief misses with a weapon attack, they can reroll the attack roll against a different target; the new target must be within 15 feet of the original target and within range of the weapon.

trait.name: Windswept
entries: The chief ignores any movement penalty caused by strong wind and they can't be pushed because of strong wind against their will.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chief makes two attacks.

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage, or 5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

variant.name: Rocborne Chief with Nimbus, First Staff of the Thunderbirds
entries: A chief in possession of Nimbus, first staff of the Thunderbirds is revered, for they've been blessed by their ancestors' spirits. Such a chief is considered a 13th-level ranger and uses the Rocborne chief stat block with the following changes:

items: They have a challenge rating of 8 (3,900 XP).
They know the {@spell shillelagh} cantrip.
They have the Nimbus, First Staff of the Thunderbirds trait, as well as the Nimbus, First Staff of the Thunderbirds and Buffet (Nimbus Special Attack) action options (all described below).

entries.name: Nimbus, First Staff of the Thunderbirds
entries: The staff has 8 charges and regains {@dice 1d6 + 2} expended charges daily at dawn. While holding it, the chief can use an action to expend some of its charges to cast one of the following spells (save {@dc 15}) from it: {@spell lightning bolt} (3 charges), {@spell shatter} (2 charges), {@spell spirit guardians} (3 charges), or {@spell wind wall} (3 charges).

entries.name: Nimbus, First Staff of the Thunderbirds
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit (+9 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, or 10 ({@damage 1d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.

entries.name: Buffet (Nimbus Special Attack)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 10 ({@damage 1d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Backfire
entries: Whenever the turret is critically hit, it backfires. Each creature within 10 feet of the turret (including the turret) must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage as shards of metal shoot outwards. The turret automatically fails this saving throw.

trait.name: Spikey Charge
entries: If the turret moves at least 15 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a bite attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage. If the target is a Small or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Wheels
entries: The turret can't navigate over ledges greater than 6 inches in height. If it tries to, it tumbles and is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rolly turrit makes two attacks.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Cannonette
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

name: Rose Golem

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the language of its creator

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the golem remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a hedge of rose bushes.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If this attack reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it is cursed with thorn's kiss curse (see below).

action.name: Soporific Scent
entries: The golem releases an enchanting scent. Each creature that breathes within 60 feet of the golem must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or immediately fall {@condition unconscious} and into a magical slumber. This slumber lasts for 1 hour or until the sleeper takes damage. The rose golem must take a bonus action on its subsequent turn to continue emitting the scent. It can stop creating the smell at any time. The scent can no longer affect creatures if the golem is {@condition incapacitated}.

Each round the golem continues to emit the soporific scent makes the effect harder to resist. At the beginning of every round that the golem maintains the scent, the DC to resist its effects increases by 1 ({@dc 11} on the first round, {@dc 12} on the second round, {@dc 13} on the third round, and so on).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Rosselbuck has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The Rosselbuck's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Loping Glide
entries: When falling or long jumping at least 30 feet, the Rosselbuck can spend a reaction to fly up to twice its speed in one direction as it descends. The Rosselbuck lands in an unoccupied space at the end of its movement and takes no falling damage.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The Rosselbuck's long jump is up to 60 feet, and its high jump is up to 40 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Rosselbuck makes one antler attack and one kick attack.

action.name: Antler
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Deadly Leap
entries: If the Rosselbuck jumps or glides at least 30 feet as part of its movement, it can land on its feet in a space occupied by one or more other creatures. Each of these creatures must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and take 26 ({@damage 6d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. On a successful save, the creature takes only half the damage, isn't knocked {@condition prone}, and is pushed 5 feet out of the Rosselbuck's space into an adjacent unoccupied space of its choice. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead falls {@condition prone} in the Rosselbuck's space.

legendary.name: Kick
entries: The Rosselbuck makes a kick attack.

legendary.name: Mantle of Spring Everlasting (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Rosselbuck spreads its wings, summoning a pocket of springtime breeze to its surroundings. All allies within 30 feet of the Rosselbuck gain 10 temporary hit points and may immediately spend up to 2 Hit Dice to recover hit points as though they were taking a short rest.

name: Rot Angel
languages: understands Celestial but can't speak it

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The angel doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they fly out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Decaying Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage, or if the target is a corpse or Undead, the damage increases to 36 ({@dice 8d8}).

Additionally, for the next 24 hours, the target is marked for death. A creature who drops to 0 hit points while marked for death immediately fails one death saving throw. This effect isn't cumulative.

bonus.name: Hypnotic Beam
entries: One of the angel's eyes shoots a magic ray at a creature the angel can see within 60 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to move as far as their speed allows toward the angel, avoiding obviously dangerous ground.

reaction.name: Radiant Puff
entries: When the angel is hit with an attack, they release a cloud of spores. Each creature within 10 feet of the angel must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the rot angel's next turn.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The rot monster has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

trait.name: Limited Flight
entries: The rot monster can only fly for up to 1 minute at a time. While flying, it has disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws against effects that would knock it {@condition prone}. If it ends its turn in the air after 1 minute of consecutive flight and nothing else is holding it aloft, it falls.

trait.name: Rot Wood
entries: Any nonmagical weapon made of wood that hits the rot monster rots and deteoriates. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of wood that hits the rot monster is destroyed after dealing damage.

trait.name: Waste Scent
entries: The rot monster can pinpoint, by scent, the location of rotting food and other decaying organic matter within 1 mile of it.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage, plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: The rot monster touches a nonmagical object made of organic matter that it can see within 5 feet of it, causing it to rot and deteriorate. If the object isn't being worn or carried, the touch destroys a 1-foot cube of it. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw to avoid the rot monster's touch.

If the object touched is either armor made of leather or hide, or a wooden shield being worn or carried, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers.
