Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed. If the object touched is a held wooden weapon, it deteriorates as described in the Rot Wood trait.

trait.name: Forest Rot
entries: When the rotbeast dies, they release a burst of infectious air. Each non-Fungus creature within 5 feet of them must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or gain a level of {@condition exhaustion} and become infected with forest rot disease. An infected creature regains half the normal number of hit points when they spend Hit Dice or finish a long rest, and they can't reduce their {@condition exhaustion} level by finishing a long rest.

Each time a creature with forest rot finishes a long rest, they must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature gains another level of {@condition exhaustion}. On a successful save, the creature loses a level of {@condition exhaustion}.
If a successful saving throw reduces the infected creature's level of {@condition exhaustion} below 1, the creature recovers from the disease.

trait.name: Rotwake
entries: When the rotbeast leaves a space, it becomes difficult terrain for creatures other than rotbeasts for 24 hours. When a non-Fungus creature enters that space for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, they must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rotbeast makes two attacks using Weakening Horns, Rotting Hooves, or both.

action.name: Weakening Horns
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Rotting Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or contract forest rot.

bonus.name: Healing Rot (1/Day)
entries: The rotbeast regains 3 ({@dice 1d6}) hit points for each creature within 60 feet of them infected with forest rot.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

trait.name: Rotted Path
entries: The rotbeast and their caregiver ignore mundane difficult terrain.

action.name: Signature Attack (Horns)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Tainting Attack (2 Ferocity)
entries: The rotbeast makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} piercing damage, and the area within 5 feet of the target becomes difficult terrain for the rotbeast's enemies until the start of the rotbeast's next turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Rotting Hooves (5 Ferocity)
entries: The rotbeast moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of the rotbeast's next turn.

action.name: 5th Level: Rotwake Charge (8 Ferocity)
entries: The rotbeast moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks, tainting the ground beneath their hooves and making it mundane difficult terrain for their enemies until the start of the rotbeast's next turn. During this move, the rotbeast can move through the space of Large or smaller creatures as if they were difficult terrain. When a creature enters tainted ground for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, they must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage PBd8} poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Air Form
entries: The rotting wind can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Invisibility
entries: The rotting wind is {@condition invisible}.

trait.name: Poisonous Aura
entries: The rotting wind radiates an aura of poison and decay that slowly pollutes the area within 30 feet of it. Each hour the rotting wind stays in a place, nonmagical plants in the aura begin to wither, and water in the aura becomes {@condition poisoned}. Nonmagical plants in the aura for 24 hours die. A creature that drinks water {@condition poisoned} by the aura must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or contract the tomb rot disease (see the Tomb Rot trait). Creatures immune to the {@condition poisoned} condition are immune to this disease.

trait.name: Tomb Rot
entries: A creature infested with this disease manifests symptoms {@dice 1d4} days after infection, which include muscle weakness and rotten-smelling breath as its body rots from the inside out. Until the disease is cured, at the end of each long rest, the infected creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage and suffer one level of {@condition exhaustion}. This {@condition exhaustion} lasts until the creature finishes a long rest after the disease is cured. A creature that succeeds on two saving throws recovers from the disease.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The rotting wind doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rotting wind makes two Wind of Decay attacks. If both attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or contract the tomb rot disease (see the Tomb Rot trait).

action.name: Wind of Decay
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the rotting wind's space. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage.

name: Rotting Zombie
languages: understands the languages they knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the zombie takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the zombie takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Overwhelm
entries: If an enemy starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more rotting zombies who can see them, the enemy's speed is reduced by 5 feet for each rotting zombie within 5 feet of them until the start of their next turn. If this reduces the enemy's walking speed to 0, they are {@condition restrained} for the duration.

trait.name: Rise Again
entries: The first time a zombie is reduced to 0 hit points by damage other than radiant damage but their body isn't destroyed, they regain hit points equal to their hit point maximum, and they fall {@condition prone} and are {@condition incapacitated} until the start of their next turn.

action.name: Slam (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Fungal Step
entries: The rotweaver ignores {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} caused by plants or fungi.

trait.name: Hunting Horn
entries: The rotweaver carries a hunting horn.
The horn has AC 16, HP 10, and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage.

trait.name: Iron Binding
entries: If the rotweaver has iron wrapped around a part of its body, such as an iron bracelet, Manacles, or Chain (treat any of them as applying Manacles), the rotweaver can move, take an action, or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, but not all three.

action.name: Staff
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Call the Rot (Requires Hunting Horn; Recharge 5-6)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The horn call is audible out to 300 feet, and any noncreature plants in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} die from fungus and rot.

trait.name: Death Strike
entries: When the assassin reduces a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the creature immediately dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The assassin makes three Poison Weapon attacks.

action.name: Poisoned Weapon
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Poison damage. Once per turn, the assassin can apply one of the following additional effects to the target:

items.name: Silent Scream
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Bewildered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends). While {@condition Bewildered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, the target is unable to speak.

items.name: Sap Strength
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition (save ends). While {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, the target also has the {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

items.name: Sluggish Sinews
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends). While {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, the target also has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: The assassin takes the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

name: Rubble Golem

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Collapse {@recharge 5}
entries: The golem targets a 15-foot-diameter circle within 15 feet of itself. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be crushed as the golem leaps and lands in the designated location, turning into a shockwave of rubble and transforming into its rubble form. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 ({@damage 5d8}) bludgeoning damage and is knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked {@condition prone}.

While the golem is in rubble form, the area of impact is considered {@quickref difficult terrain||3}, the golem is {@condition incapacitated} and has resistance to all damage, and it automatically fails Dexterity saving throws.
The golem returns to its original form at the start of its next turn, shunting any creature in its space to another unoccupied space within 5 feet of it.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The rubezahl casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

trait.name: Counting Compulsion
entries: If a creature uses an action to point out an ordered group of objects that the rubezahl can see, such as a pile of gravel, the demon is compelled to count the entire group. Until the end of its next turn, the rubezahl has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and it can't take reactions. Once it has counted a given group of objects, it can't be compelled to count those objects again.

trait.name: False Tongue
entries: The rubezahl has advantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) checks. In addition, magical attempts to discern lies always report that the rubezahl's words are true, and it can't be magically forced to tell the truth.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The rubezahl has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rubezahl makes one Gore attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) piercing damage, and the target creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Thunderstrike {@recharge 5}
entries: The rubezahl calls a sizzling bolt of lightning out of the sky, or from the air if underground or indoors, to strike a point the rubezahl can see within 150 feet of it. Each creature within 20 feet of that point must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 36 ({@damage 8d8}) lightning damage and is {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn. On a success, the creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition stunned}.

trait.name: Gang Tactics
entries: The Ruffian Leader has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Ruffian Leader's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Ruffian Leader makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Great Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Yell of Triumph (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: Each creature of the Ruffian Leader's choice that is within 30 feet of it and can hear it gain advantage on attack rolls and Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks until the start of the Ruffian Leader's next turn. The Ruffian Leader can then make one attack as a bonus action.

trait.name: Lethe
entries: When the ruinant's soul count is 0, they have advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and their Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, the ruinant must use their movement on each of their turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature they can sense with their soulsight, and then if they are able, they must use their action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. The ruinant can't act with any other purpose until they add 1 to their soul count.

trait.name: Soul Devourer
entries: When the ruinant reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the ruinant consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to the ruinant's soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ruinant makes three Bloodletting Claws attacks.

action.name: Bloodletting Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage, and the target can't take reactions this turn.

action.name: Salt Wounds (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: The ruinant chooses up to three creatures they can see within 60 feet of them who don't have all their hit points. Each target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 16 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Corrupt Healing (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of the ruinant regains hit points from a power, a spell, or a similar supernatural effect, the ruinant corrupts the effect. The target regains no hit points, and the target and each of the ruinant's enemies within 5 feet of the ruinant must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take necrotic damage equal to half the number of hit points the effect would have restored.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The gremlin casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 11}):

trait.name: Aura of Drunkenness
entries: The rum gremlin radiates an aura of drunkenness to a radius of 20 feet. Each creature that starts its turn in the aura must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour. A creature that has consumed alcohol within the past hour has disadvantage on the saving throw. While {@condition poisoned}, a creature falls {@condition prone} if it tries to move more than half its speed during a turn. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the rum gremlin's Aura of Drunkenness for 24 hours.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The rum gremlin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The runewright has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The runewright casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The runewright casts the {@spell Misty Step|XPHB} spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The runewright makes three Rune Blast attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Runic Gaze.

action.name: Rune Blast
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Radiant damage (the runewright's choice based on the rune being used).

action.name: Runic Gaze
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 17} One creature the runewright can see with 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition (the runewright's choice) until the start of the runewright's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Sun Rune
entries: {@actTrigger} The runewright is hit by an attack roll. {@actResponse} The attacking creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition Blinded|XPHB} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Rust Drake Lockjaw
entries: A creature infected with this disease manifests symptoms {@dice 1d4} days after infection, which include painful muscle spasms, particularly in the jaw. At the end of each long rest, the infected creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 hour and have its Dexterity score reduced by {@dice 1d4}. This reduction lasts until the disease is cured. If the disease reduces the creature's Dexterity to 0, the creature dies. A creature that succeeds on two saving throws recovers from the disease.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drake makes one Bite attack and two Tail Swipe attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution save or contract the rust drake lockjaw disease (see the Rust Drake Lockjaw trait).

action.name: Tail Swipe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Vomit Scrap {@recharge 5}
entries: The rust drake vomits forth a 15-foot cone of rusted metal. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 5d8}) slashing damage and 22 ({@damage 5d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, each creature that failed the saving throw must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or contract the rust drake lockjaw disease (see the Rust Drake Lockjaw trait).

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Ryan is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks). Ryan can cast {@spell disguise self} and {@spell invisibility} at will and has the following wizard spells prepared:
footerEntries: *Ryan casts these spells on itself before combat.

trait.name: Contingent Docility
entries: If a creature presents an item belonging to Mery to Sable, Sable must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the creature for 1 hour. Sable can repeat the saving throw every 10 minutes, ending the effect on a success. If the effect ends, Sable automatically succeeds on this saving throw for the next 10 minutes.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: Sable has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Sable makes one Bite attack and one Shadow Tendril attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a {@dc 11} Strength check or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Shadow Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) necrotic damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The sable elf casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}):

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The sable elf has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put the sable elf to sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sable elf makes two Shortsword attacks or two Longbow attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, ranged 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The sable elf casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The sable elf has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put them to sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sable elf makes three Spellburn attacks.

action.name: Spellburn
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 5d10}) force damage.

action.name: Voice of Hecate (1/Day)
entries: Hecate speaks profane words of power through the hierophant. All creatures within 300 feet of the sable elf must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A {@condition frightened} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Witch Eye
entries: The sable elf can cast {@spell detect magic} without expending a spell slot.

name: Saddle Slime
languages: understands the languages its summoner speaks

trait.name: Born for the Saddle
entries: The ooze grips firmly onto any object that is inserted into its body to be used as a saddle. A creature riding the ooze on one such saddle has advantage on saving throws made to avoid being dismounted.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Corrode Object (3/Day)
entries: The ooze touches a Medium or smaller nonmagical object that isn't being worn or carried, causing it to corrode and dissolve over the course of 1 minute.

items.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Sagacitous Erusaire's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 16} {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

name: Sage
languages: Mapach understands Auran but can't speak it

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Sage is a 4th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). She has the following druid spells prepared:

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Sage can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. She lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement and takes no falling damage. She cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).

trait.name: Seedspeech
entries: Sage can communicate simple ideas to living plants and is able to interpret their responses in simple language.

trait.name: Wing Flap
entries: As a bonus action, Sage can use her powerful feathered arms to propel herself upward up to half her movement speed. Sage can use it in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

action.name: Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit ({@hit 4} to hit with {@spell shillelagh}), reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage, or 11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage with {@spell shillelagh}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The sahuagin casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The sahuagin has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Limited Amphibiousness
entries: The sahuagin can breathe air and water, but it must be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating outside water.

trait.name: Shark Telepathy
entries: The sahuagin can magically control sharks within 120 feet of itself, using a special telepathy.

trait.name: Toughened Carapace
entries: Any {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against the sahuagin becomes a normal hit.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sahuagin makes three attacks, using Crushing Claw or Cutter Claw in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Crushing Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 10 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}) from the Crushing Claw.

action.name: Cutter Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 10 ft. {@h}24 ({@damage 3d12 + 5}) Slashing damage.

name: Saint Gresha

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

languages: The languages it knew in life

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Saint Gresha is an 8th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). Saint Gresha knows the following sorcerer spells:
footerEntries: *new spell described in Appendix D of Dungeons of Drakkenheim.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: Saint Gresha can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, Saint Gresha has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

action.name: Create Specter
entries: Saint Gresha targets a humanoid within 10 feet of it that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute and died violently. The target's spirit rises as a specter in the space of its corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The specter is under Saint Gresha's control. Saint Gresha can have no more than seven specters under its control at one time.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: Sair doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they fly out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Psionic Bolt (1st-Order Power)
entries: {@atk rp} {@hit 6} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage. If the target is Large or smaller, they are pushed 5 feet away from Sair.

action.name: *Mind Scream (1/Day; 3rd-Order Power)
entries: Sair psionically pierces the mind of each enemy within 30 feet of them. Each target must make a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw, taking 17 ({@damage 5d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is automatically stabilized.

name: Salmon of Knowledge
languages: understands all but can't speak; telepathy 60 ft.

trait.name: Orb of Water
entries: The salmon is surrounded by a sphere of flowing water that moves with it. While inside of the sphere, the salmon has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage. A creature that grapples the salmon can choose to pull it out of the orb of water. The orb of water moves up to 20 feet toward the salmon at the start of each of the salmon's turns. If it enters the salmon's space, the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition ends on the salmon.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The salmon can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The salmon makes two Water Spray attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Prophetic Guidance.

action.name: Water Spray
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 20/60 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Cold damage.

action.name: Prophetic Guidance (2/Day)
entries: A creature the salmon can see within 30 feet gains a flash of foresight. Once in the next minute, when the creature fails a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, it can roll {@dice 1d4} and add it to the total, potentially turning the failure into a success.

reaction.name: Echo from the Current
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature within 5 feet makes an Intelligence or Wisdom check. {@actResponse} The creature can use the salmon's Wisdom modifier (+4) in place of its own ability modifier for the check.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the salt devil's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The salt devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Salt-Encrusted Hide
entries: A creature that touches the salt devil or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The salt devil makes two Scimitar attacks and one Water-Draining Claw attack.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Water-Draining Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature that isn't a Construct or Undead, it must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Plants, Oozes, and creatures with the Amphibious, Water Breathing, or Water Form traits have disadvantage on this saving throw. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target also suffers one level of {@condition exhaustion}.

action.name: Teleport (3/Day)
entries: The salt devil magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

name: Salt Golem

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Blinding Salt Spray
entries: When the salt golem takes damage, thousands of tiny salt crystals erupt from the golem's body, and each creature within 5 feet of the golem must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The golem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Dehydrating Fists
entries: The salt golem's Slam attacks are magical. When the golem hits with a Slam attack, the attack deals an extra {@damage 4d8} necrotic damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The salt golem makes two Slam attacks. If both attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of {@condition exhaustion}.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage.

name: Saltfeather
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Saltfeather can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement and takes no falling damage. Saltfeather cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

trait.name: Hook and Talon
entries: Saltfeather has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks to climb any surface his talons and silvered hook-hand could reasonably grip.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: Saltfeather deals an extra 17 {@damage 5d6} damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Saltfeather that isn't {@condition incapacitated} and Saltfeather doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Skulker
entries: Saltfeather has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made in dim light or darkness.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Saltfeather makes three melee attacks: two with his cutlass and one with his hook.

action.name: Cutlass
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Hook
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage. On a successful hit, Saltfeather may spend a bonus action to {@action grapple} the target (escape {@dc 11}). A target who escapes from this grapple must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage from the hook. This is a silvered weapon.

action.name: Talon
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Bomb (3/Day)
entries: After sparking his hook to light the fuse, Saltfeather lobs an iron shell filled with alchemical explosives. Choose a point within 60 feet of Saltfeather that he can see. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must attempt a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage and 14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much on a successful one.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Saltfeather adds 3 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, Saltfeather must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon. If not grappling a target with his hook, Saltfeather can use it to parry.

trait.name: Sanctified by Falling Fire
entries: When the knight dies, its soul is pulled into the {@item crystal|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|delerium crystal} embedded in its chest.

trait.name: Special Immunities
entries: The knight is immune to the {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The knight makes three Longsword attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Slashing damage, or 9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Slashing damage if wielded with two hands, plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Radiant damage.

bonus.name: Lay on Hands (3/Day)
entries: The knight touches another creature. The target regains 11 ({@dice 2d8 + 2}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and is cured of one disease or the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.

reaction.name: Deny the Witch (3/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the knight can see within 60 feet of it casts a spell. {@actResponse} If the spell is level 3 or lower, the spell fails, but no resources are wasted.

trait.name: Sanctified by Falling Fire
entries: When the monk dies, its soul is pulled into the {@item crystal|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|delerium crystal} embedded in its chest.

trait.name: Special Immunities
entries: Sanctified Monk is immune to the {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While the monk is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier (included above).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The monk makes three {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} attacks or five Dart attacks.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Dart
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, range 20/60 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Flame Step
entries: The monk teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet that is in {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}. It gains {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on its next melee attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The sanctified soul casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}, +7 to spell attacks):

trait.name: Sanctified by Falling Fire
entries: When the sanctified soul dies, its soul is pulled into the {@item crystal|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|delerium crystal} embedded in its chest.

trait.name: Special Immunities
entries: The sanctified soul is immune to the {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) Bludgeoning damage, or 5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) Bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands.

action.name: Guiding Bolt
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 120 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) Radiant damage.

reaction.name: Flash of Light
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the sanctified soul can see makes an attack roll. {@actResponse} The sanctified soul imposes {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the attack roll.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The sand hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The sand hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The sand hag can mimic animal sounds and Humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 16} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

trait.name: Scorpion Walk
entries: Difficult terrain composed of sand or gravel doesn't cost the hag extra movement. In addition, while in sandy terrain, she doesn't leave tracks and has tremorsense out to a range of 30 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes three Claw attacks. If two Claw attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of {@condition exhaustion}. A creature can't suffer more than two levels of {@condition exhaustion} from this effect.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Illusory Appearance
entries: The sand hag covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like another creature of her general size and Humanoid shape. The illusion ends if the hag takes a bonus action to end it or if she dies.

The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to discern that the hag is disguised.

action.name: Scouring Sirocco {@recharge 5}
entries: The sand hag generates a blast of hot wind and sand in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) slashing damage and 9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage and is {@condition blinded} for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition blinded}. A {@condition blinded} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The area is heavily obscured by airborne sand until the start of the sand hag's next turn.

trait.name: Desert Camouflage
entries: The lizard has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in sandy terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lizard makes two attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) piercing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the target takes another 4 ({@damage 1d8}) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. Each time the lizard hits the {@condition poisoned} target with this attack, the damage dealt at the start of each of its turns increases by 4 ({@dice 1d8}). If the {@condition poisoned} target receives magical healing or a creature uses a healer's kit on the target, the target can repeat the Constitution saving throw, ending the {@condition poisoned} condition on a success.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Spit Venom
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 15/30 ft., one target. {@h}The target must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage and 18 ({@damage 4d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Sand Silhouette
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Sand Camouflage
entries: The sand silhouette has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in desert terrain.

trait.name: Sand Form
entries: The sand silhouette can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Sand Glide
entries: The sand silhouette can burrow through nonmagical, loose sand without disturbing the material it is moving through.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The sand silhouette doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Water Hypersusceptibility
entries: For every 5 feet the sand silhouette moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) cold damage. In addition, the silhouette takes 10 cold damage when it starts its turn at least partially submerged in water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sand silhouette makes two Slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}), and the silhouette uses its Engulf on the target.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The sand silhouette engulfs a Medium or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by it. The engulfed target is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, and it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the sand silhouette's turns or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. If the sand silhouette moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The sand silhouette can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

action.name: Haunted Haboob (3/Day)
entries: The sand silhouette creates a storm of whirling sand and wailing souls around itself. The storm is a 10-foot radius, 30-foot-tall cylinder centered on the silhouette and moves with the silhouette for 1 minute, until it ends the storm as a bonus action, or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). The sandstorm's area is lightly obscured, and a creature that starts its turn in the sandstorm's area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage and be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. An engulfed creature automatically succeeds on this saving throw. A {@condition frightened} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: The spider has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has {@status surprised}.

trait.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The spider can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

trait.name: Seize
entries: If the spider has advantage on an attack roll and hits a creature that is Large or smaller, the creature is also {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is {@condition paralyzed} while {@condition poisoned} in this way.

trait.name: Sand Camouflage
entries: The sand spider has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in sandy terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sand spider makes one Bite attack and two Impaling Leg attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Impaling Leg
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns, and the sand spider can't use the same Impaling Leg on another target. The sand spider has four Impaling Legs.

reaction.name: Trapdoor Ambush
entries: When the sand spider is burrowed just below the surface of sand and a Medium or smaller creature enters the space on the surface just above where it is burrowed, the sand spider makes one Impaling Leg attack against the creature, bursting from the sand and revealing itself in the process. The target has disadvantage on the saving throw to avoid being {@condition grappled}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The sandman has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Stuff of Dreams
entries: Made partially from dreams and imagination, the sandman isn't fully real. Any critical hit against the sandman is a normal hit.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sandman makes two Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Dreamer's Sand, if available.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage. Damage from this attack doesn't wake an {@condition unconscious} creature, unless the {@condition unconscious} creature is below half its hp maximum. If the sandman scores a critical hit, the target is cursed with the eye-closer's curse. While cursed, the creature is {@condition blinded} until it finishes a long rest or until the curse is lifted by remove curse or similar magic.

action.name: Encourage Dreams {@recharge 5}
entries: The sandman encourages powerful dreams in the minds of up to three {@condition unconscious} creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target must make a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw. On a failure, nightmares fill the target's mind, and the target takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) psychic damage, wakes from its sleep, and is {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. On a success, pleasant dreams fill the target's mind, and the target regains 10 {@dice 3d6} hp and can choose to remain {@condition unconscious} or awaken. A {@condition frightened} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Dreamer's Sand {@recharge 5}
entries: The sandman throws magical sand in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious} for 10 minutes. This effect ends for a creature if the creature takes damage or another creature uses an action to wake it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sandwyrm makes one Bite attack, one Gore attack, and one Stinger attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d12 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d4 + 5}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hp, the target is stable but {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour, even after regaining hp, and is {@condition paralyzed} while {@condition poisoned} in this way.

reaction.name: Spine Trap
entries: When the sandwyrm is burrowed just below the surface of sand with its back spines exposed and a Medium or smaller creature enters the spines' space, the sandwyrm closes the spines on the creature. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained}. When the sandwyrm moves, a {@condition restrained} creature moves with it. The sandwyrm can have only one creature {@condition restrained} at a time. A creature, including the {@condition restrained} creature, can take an action to free the {@condition restrained} creature by succeeding on a {@dc 15} Strength check.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The vampire casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}, +7 to spell attacks):

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The vampire regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes two attacks and uses Feast, if available. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Blood Drain
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 5d6 + 4}) Necrotic damage, and the vampire regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the damage dealt. The target has the {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dc 15} Constitution save ends).

action.name: Feast {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the vampire. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Necrotic damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The vampire regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

reaction.name: Arcane Denial
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the vampire can see within 60 feet casts a spell of level 3 or lower. {@actResponse d}{@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The spell fails, but no resources are wasted.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The sanguinor's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 20}, {@hit 12} to hit with spell attacks). The sanguinor can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Aura of Punishment
entries: Whenever a hostile creature within 10 feet of the sanguinor takes damage, that creature takes an extra 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The sanguinor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The sanguinor's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the sanguinor can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sanguinor makes three attacks: one with its sting and two with its trident. It can cast any of its at will spells in place of one trident attack.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@dice 3d4 + 8}) piercing plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned}. The {@condition poisoned} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Trident
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d6 + 8}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Boil Blood {@recharge 5}
entries: The sanguinor attempts to magically boil the blood of up to three creatures it can see within 120 feet of it. Each target must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw, taking 39 ({@damage 6d12}) fire damage and 39 ({@damage 6d12}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that is {@condition poisoned} by a sanguinor's sting has disadvantage on this saving throw, and a creature that doesn't have blood is immune to this effect.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The sap demon can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Ooze Nature
entries: The sap demon doesn't require sleep.

trait.name: Season's Change
entries: If the sap demon takes fire damage, its speed is increased by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. If it takes cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sap demon makes two Slam or Lob Sap attacks. If both Slam attacks hit a Medium or smaller creature, the creature is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}).

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Lob Sap
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 3d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Soul Sap {@recharge}
entries: One humanoid the sap demon is grappling or that is {@condition incapacitated} within 5 feet of the sap demon must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be possessed by the sap demon. The sap demon then disappears, and the target is {@condition incapacitated} and loses control of its body. The sap demon now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The ooze can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that restore a creature's hp maximum. The ooze retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma and condition immunities. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.

While possessed, the target's body seeps blood out of its ears, nose, and eyes, and the target takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) acid damage at the end of each hour. Its hp maximum is also reduced by that amount. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest after the possession ends. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hp, the ooze ends it as a bonus action, or the ooze is forced out by an effect like the {@spell greater restoration} spell. When the possession ends, the ooze reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this sap demon's Soul Sap for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The sarcophagus slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The sarcophagus slime doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sarcophagus slime can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes two Slam attacks. It can replace one Slam attack with a use of Corrupting Gaze.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage.

action.name: Corrupting Gaze
entries: One creature the sarcophagus slime can see within 30 feet of it must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The target's hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0. A Humanoid slain by this effect rises 24 hours later as a sarcophagus slime, unless the Humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the sarcophagus slime's choice that is within 60 feet of the sarcophagus slime and aware of it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the sarcophagus slime's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

name: Sathaq Worm
languages: understands Deep Speech and Terran but can't speak

trait.name: Agonizing Aura
entries: The sathaq worm emits ultrasonic noise and minor vibrations that cause pain and subtly disrupt the functions of most creatures. A creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of the sathaq worm must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn. Creatures with resistance or immunity to thunder damage automatically succeed on the saving throw.

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The sathaq worm can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the worm doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Earthen Camouflage
entries: The sathaq worm has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in sandy, muddy, or rocky terrain.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The sathaq worm deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sathaq worm makes one Bite attack and two Slam attacks, or it makes three Slam attacks. It can replace its Bite attack with a use of Swallow.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the sathaq worm can't Bite another target.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The sathaq worm makes one Bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside the worm (including the worm's Agonizing Aura), and takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage and 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the sathaq worm's turns. The sathaq worm can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If the sathaq worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the sathaq worm must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls {@condition prone} in a space within 5 feet of the sathaq worm. If the sathaq worm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Mighty Swing
entries: If the savager doesn't move during its turn, it has advantage on the next Claw attack it makes before the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Spines
entries: A creature that touches the savager or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage. In addition, a creature {@condition grappled} by or grappling the savager takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage at the start of the savager's turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The savager makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. If both Claw attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) slashing damage as the savager rips into the target.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d12 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) slashing damage.

from: {@item +2 Studded Leather Armor of Acid Resistance|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn}

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Scanlan is a 20th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 19}, {@hit 11} to hit with spell attacks). He has the following bard spells prepared:

trait.name: Gnome Cunning
entries: Scanlan has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1} against magic.

trait.name: Focused
entries: Scanlan has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on Constitution {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1} made to maintain {@status concentration} on spells.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Scanlan wields {@item Mythcarver (Exalted)|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Mythcarver}, wears {@item +2 Studded Leather Armor of Acid Resistance|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn} and a {@item +2 ring of protection|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|ring of protection with a +2 bonus}, and carries a {@item hat of disguise} and a {@item wand of magic missiles}.

trait.name: Toughness
entries: Scanlan has an additional 40 hit points.

action.name: Mythcarver
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) force damage.

bonus.name: Arcane Fist (8th Level)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}45 ({@damage 10d8}) force damage. Scanlan can use this bonus action only while concentrating on the {@spell Bigby's Hand||arcane hand} spell.

bonus.name: Bardic Inspiration (6/{@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|Short Rest})
entries: Scanlan grants a Bardic Inspiration die to one creature other than himself within 60 feet of him who can hear him. Once within the next 10 minutes, the creature can roll a {@dice d12} and add the number rolled to one ability check, attack roll, or {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} it makes.  When Scanlan uses this ability, he gains {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on attack rolls with {@item Mythcarver (Exalted)|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Mythcarver} until the end of his turn.

bonus.name: {@spell Healing Word} (5th Level)
entries: Scanlan casts {@spell healing word}, restoring 18 ({@dice 5d4 + 6}) hit points to himself or another creature he can see within 60 feet of him.

reaction.name: Cutting Words
entries: When a creature Scanlan can see within 60 feet of him makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a damage roll, he can expend a use of Bardic Inspiration to roll a {@dice d12} and subtract the number rolled from the creature's roll. The creature also has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|disadvantage} on its next {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: In the first round of a combat, the scarapit has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has {@quickref Surprise|PHB|3|0|surprised}.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The scarapit has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Noxious Resilience
entries: The scarapit can breathe normally in any environment, and it has advantage on saving throws made against harmful gases and vapors (such as {@spell cloudkill} and {@spell stinking cloud} effects, inhaled poisons, and the breath weapons of some dragons).

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The scarapit can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Subterranean Explorer
entries: While the scarapit is underground, it always knows how far it is from the surface, it can't be {@quickref Surprise|PHB|3|0|surprised} while it isn't {@condition incapacitated}, and it has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks made to track creatures.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage, or 21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) piercing damage if the target is {@quickref Surprise|PHB|3|0|surprised}, and the target must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is {@condition paralyzed} while {@condition poisoned} in this way.

trait.name: Assassinate
entries: During his first turn, Scarlet has advantage on attack rolls against any creature who hasn't taken a turn.
The first hit Scarlet scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: Scarlet deals an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Scarlet who isn't incapacitated and Scarlet doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Scarlet makes three Shadow Blade or three Shortbow attacks.

action.name: Shadow Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) necrotic damage. If a target is hit by two or more Shadow Blade attacks on a turn, they must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Razor Garrote
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, they take 22 ({@damage 5d8}) slashing damage at the start of each of their turns, and Scarlet can't attack another target.

action.name: Umbral Breath {@recharge}
entries: Scarlet exhales dark flame in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) necrotic damage and is {@condition frightened} of Scarlet for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition frightened}.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: Scarlet takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

hp.special: Seven times their level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Daggers)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 2d4 plus PB} damage. Beginning at 7th level, the schemer can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 5th Level: Promises and Lies (1/Day)
entries: As an action, the schemer turns enemies into allies. Each creature within 30 feet of the schemer who can hear them and who understand Common or Infernal must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the schemer for 1 minute. While {@condition charmed} in this way, a creature can't willingly harm any of the schemer's allies. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on themself on a success.

action.name: 7th Level: Turncoat (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the schemer chooses up to PB creatures they can see within 30 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Charisma saving throw or make an attack against their nearest ally (no action required). A creature {@condition charmed} by the schemer automatically fails this saving throw.

reaction.name: 3rd Level: Quick Trick (3/Day)
entries: When a creature targets the schemer or an ally within 30 feet of the schemer with an attack, spell, or other magical effect, the schemer can use their reaction to force that creature to make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or effect.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The scheznyki casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Beard Weakness
entries: A creature grappling the scheznyki can take its action to cut off the scheznyki's beard by succeeding on a {@dc 15} Strength check while holding an edged weapon. If its beard is cut off, the scheznyki can't use Spellcasting until its beard regrows.

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the scheznyki hits with it (included in the attack).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The scheznyki has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scheznyki makes three War Pick or Arcane Bolt attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: War Pick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Arcane Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) force damage.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The scheznyki magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment it wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

trait.name: Dark Devotion
entries: The scorpion cultist has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Keen Senses
entries: The scorpion cultist has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks.

trait.name: Scorpion's Blessing
entries: The scorpion cultist has advantage on saving throws against poison. In addition, when the scorpion cultist hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d4} poison damage (included in the attack).

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage.

action.name: Sling
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage.

name: Scoundrel
languages: Thieves' cant plus any two languages

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The scoundrel is a 3rd level spellcaster that uses Intelligence as its spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}; {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). It knows the following spells from the wizard spell list:

trait.name: Cunning Action
entries: On each of its turns, the scoundrel can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: The scoundrel deals an extra 14 {@damage 4d6} damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the scoundrel that isn't incapacitated and the scoundrel doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The sporehusk regains 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If it takes Fire or Radiant damage, this trait doesn't function on the sporehusk's next turn. The sporehusk dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Sunlight Weakness
entries: While in sunlight, the sporehusk has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@dice D20} Tests.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scout makes two attacks, using Shortsword and Longbow in any combination.

action.name: Grab
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 11}).

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 3}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. (must target a creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the sporehusk). {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) Piercing damage.

name: Scrap Reautomata
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Combustion
entries: While the reautomata has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 50 feet and its melee weapon attacks deal an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The reautomata makes two attacks.

action.name: Rusty Weapon
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Slashing damage.

bonus.name: Ignition (Recharges after a Short Rest)
entries: The reautomata has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 2d6} Fire).

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The scream thief can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

action.name: Silence the Living {@recharge 5}
entries: The scream thief forces a humanoid within 30 feet of it to make a DC13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 19 ({@damage 3d12}) psychic damage, is {@condition frightened}, and is unable to vocalize a sound of any kind. The target may repeat the saving throw at the end of its turns to end these effects. On a success the creature takes half as much damage and is not {@condition frightened} or silenced.

reaction.name: Fragment the Spirit
entries: The scream thief targets a creature that died from one of its attacks. The target's spirit rises as 3 ({@damage 1d6}) psychic fragments in the space of its corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The psychic fragments are under the scream thief's control.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The scyza deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: War Harness
entries: While wearing a war harness, the scyza can carry up to thirty-six Medium or smaller creatures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scyza makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage, and the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Tail Whip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is on top of the scyza, the target falls off and lands {@condition prone}.

action.name: Head Crest
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature who can hear, they are {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the end of their next turn by the crest's deep ringing.

action.name: Claw Twister {@recharge}
entries: The scyza claws at the ground in a flurry. Each creature of the scyza's choice within 5 feet of them must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 13 ({@damage 3d8}) slashing damage, is knocked {@condition prone}, and is {@condition blinded} by a cloud of dust until the start of the scyza's next turn.
