On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked {@condition prone} or {@condition blinded}.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Tidal Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales a crushing wave of frigid seawater in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) bludgeoning damage and 11 ({@damage 2d10}) cold damage and is pushed up to 5 feet away from the dragon and knocked {@condition prone}. On a success, the creature takes half the damage and isn't pushed or knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The sea drake can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sea drake makes one bite attack and one tail attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is pulled within 5 feet of the sea drake and {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). Until this grapple ends, the drake can't use its tail on another target.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, the hag can cast the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):
will: {@spell create or destroy water}{@sup {@cite Casting Times|FleeMortals|A}}

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The hag can breathe both air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes one Lightning Strike attack and uses Dry Drowning.

action.name: Lightning Strike
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) lightning damage.

action.name: Dry Drowning
entries: The hag chooses a creature they can see within 120 feet of them, making the target feel as though their lungs are filling with water. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the start of the hag's next turn. A creature who can breathe water or who doesn't need air automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

bonus.name: Sea Storm (1/Day; 3rd-Level Spell; Concentration)
entries: The hag creates a roiling storm with a 60-foot radius centered on themself that moves with them and lasts for 1 minute. The hag has advantage on Lightning Strike attacks against targets in that area, and those attacks deal an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) lightning damage.

reaction.name: Fearsome Glare
entries: When a creature the hag can see within 30 feet of them hits the hag with an attack, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the hag until the end of the hag's next turn.

hp.special: Six times their level (number of d6 Hit Dice equal to their level)

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The apprentice can breathe air and water.

action.name: Signature Attack (Zap)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d8}) lightning damage. This spell's damage increases by {@dice 1d8} when the apprentice reaches 5th level ({@dice 2d8}), 11th level ({@dice 3d8}), and 17th level ({@dice 4d8}).

action.name: 3rd Level: Wash Away (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the apprentice rides a crashing wave. They make a signature attack against an enemy within 5 feet of them and move up to their walking speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If the attack hits, it deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} bludgeoning damage.

action.name: 5th Level: Ride the Lightning (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the apprentice supercharges their foe's nervous system. The apprentice makes a signature attack, and if it deals damage to a creature, the target must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is {@condition incapacitated} and their speed is halved until the end of their next turn.

action.name: 7th Level: Drown (1/Day)
entries: As an action, the apprentice chooses three creatures the apprentice can see within 60 feet of them. Each target feels as though their lungs are filling with water and must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Constitution saving throw. A creature who can breathe water or who doesn't need air automatically succeeds on this saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes {@damage PBd8} force damage, and for 1 minute, they can't speak, their speed is halved, and they are {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect. Another creature within 5 feet of a target can use their action to make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Intelligence ({@skill Medicine}) check, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The sea lindwurm can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sea lindwurm makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) Piercing damage. The target is also subject to the sea lindwurm's paralyzing toxin. {@actSave con} {@dc 14}. {@b First Failure:} The creature has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. The target repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it's still {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, ending the effect on itself on a success. {@b Second Failure:} The target has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition for 1 hour.

action.name: Flipper Slap {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16} All creatures in a 10-foot radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} around the sea lindwurm. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the creature has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Deep Dive
entries: The sea lindwurm moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without drawing {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

trait.name: Constrictor
entries: When the sea serpent hits with its Bite attack, it may make a Constrict attack as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 14} One Huge or smaller creature the serpent can see within 10 feet. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 4d4}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}).

hp.special: 30 + 10 for each spell level above 3

trait.name: Flyby (Scaled Wings only)
entries: The sea serpent doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sea serpent makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (rounded down).

action.name: Allure (Glowing Lantern only)
entries: The sea serpent causes a lantern hanging from one of its fins to glow eerily. {@actSave wis} DC equals your spell save DC, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the sea serpent. {@actSaveFail} The target is {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by the sea serpent until the start of its next turn. Creatures have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the saving throw if the sea serpent has dealt damage to them already this turn, and the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition ends immediately if the sea serpent deals damage to a creature {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by this ability.

action.name: Inhale (Enormous Mouth only)
entries: {@actSave str} DC equals your spell save DC, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} {@damage 1d6 + summonSpellLevel} Psychic damage and the creature is pulled 5 feet straight toward it or, if the creature is already within 5 feet of the sea serpent, it takes an additional {@damage 2d6} Piercing damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hitYourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier}, reach 5 ft. {@h}{@damage 1d6 + 3 + summonSpellLevel} Piercing damage and the creature has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape DC equals your spell save DC). The {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition ends if the sea serpent bites a different creature.

action.name: Thrash
entries: {@atkr m} {@hitYourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier}, reach 10 ft. {@h}{@damage 1d10 + 3 + summonSpellLevel} Bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away from the sea serpent.

trait.name: Entangling Form
entries: A creature that touches the Seaweed Elemental or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or become {@condition Restrained} by the elemental. At the start of each of the {@condition Restrained} creature's turns, it takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) bludgeoning damage as the tendrils of seaweed squeeze it. The {@condition Restrained} creature can spend its action to attempt the saving throw again, ending the effect on a success. If the elemental moves more than 10 feet away from the {@condition Restrained} creature, the effect ends.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: If the Seaweed Elemental is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the Seaweed Elemental move or act, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to discern that the Seaweed Elemental isn't ordinary seaweed.

trait.name: Mostly Clumps
entries: The Seaweed Elemental can move through a space as narrow as 5 inches wide without squeezing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: The seed coin is indistinguishable from a normal copper piece. However, a creature that has {@sense truesight} sees a deep red aura radiating from the seed coin, and a creature within 30 feet of it that is under the effect of a {@spell detect poison and disease} spell senses the insidious nature of the seed coin and knows it is a plant creature.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The seed coin doesn't require sleep. If the seed coin spends 1 minute in direct sunlight or a creature spends 1 hour in direct sunlight while the seed coin is on the creature's person, the seed coin receives enough nourishment to sustain itself for one day. When the seed coin dies, it becomes an ordinary copper piece.

action.name: Infestation
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 0} to hit, reach 0 ft., one humanoid that has the seed coin on its person. {@h}The creature must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or its mind becomes imperceptibly infected with a disease until the seed coin is no longer on the creature's person or the creature dies. Creatures immune to the {@condition charmed} condition are immune to this disease, and a creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to this disease for the next 30 days. The seed coin's influence invades a diseased creature's mind, killing the creature in a number of hours equal to {@dice 1d12} + the creature's Wisdom score, unless the disease is removed. In half that time, the creature becomes {@condition charmed} for the rest of the duration and refuses to part with the seed coin.

If a diseased creature dies while the seed coin is on its person, it immediately regains all its hit points and becomes a {@creature seed coin pollinator|GriffonsSaddlebag2}, as the seed coin takes over its body. The seed coin doesn't gain access to the creature's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies while controlling a creature in this way. This infestation lasts until the {@creature seed coin pollinator|GriffonsSaddlebag2} dies, killing the seed coin.

variant.name: Silver Seed Coin
entries: A rare breed, these seed coins bear an uncanny resemblance to a typical silver piece. Though less prevalent, they are even more potent than their copper kin. Such a silver seed coin uses the seed coin stat block, with the following changes:

items: It has a challenge rating of 1 (200 XP).
Its Intelligence and Charisma scores each increase to 14.
It has immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
It is indistinguishable from a normal silver piece, and it becomes an ordinary silver piece when it dies.
It has the Innate Spellcasting trait below, which it retains after it becomes a seed coin pollinator.
The saving throw for its Infestation increases to DC 12, and it kills a diseased creature in a number of hours equal to {@dice 1d6} + the creature's Wisdom score, rather than {@dice 1d12}.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The seed coin's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). The seed coin can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

items: At will: {@spell prestidigitation}
3/day each: {@spell comprehend languages}, {@spell misty step}
1/day each: {@spell locate creature}, {@spell suggestion}

name: Seed Coin Pollinator
languages: the languages its host knew in life

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: The pollinator is indistinguishable from a normal commoner, and it appears and sounds exactly like the creature it was before becoming infested. However, a creature that has {@sense truesight} sees a deep red aura radiating from the pollinator, and a creature within 30 feet of it that is under the effect of a {@spell detect poison and disease} spell senses the insidious nature of the pollinator and knows it is a plant creature.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The pollinator doesn't require sleep. If the pollinator spends 1 hour in direct sunlight, it receives enough nourishment to sustain itself for one day. When the pollinator dies, it becomes an ordinary humanoid corpse.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) damage.

action.name: Coin Spray {@recharge}
entries: The pollinator hurls a flurry of {@creature seed coin|GriffonsSaddlebag2|seed coins} at one creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must make a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 4d4}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, one of the seed coins gets lodged on the target's body (for example, in a pocket or a fold in its clothing).

trait.name: Poisoned Weapons
entries: The selang's weapons are coated with a magical poison. When the selang hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 3d6} poison damage (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The selang can use its Alien Piping. It then makes two Dagger or Poison Bolt attacks.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Poison Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) poison damage.

action.name: Alien Piping
entries: The selang plays one of the following ear-bending melodies on alien pipes. One creature the selang can see within 60 feet of it is the only creature that can hear the melody. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be affected by the chosen melody.

items.name: Capering
entries: On the target's next turn, it must use all of its movement dancing without leaving its space, and it has disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws.

items.name: Captivating
entries: The target is {@condition charmed} until the end of its next turn, humming along to the selang's pleasant melody.

items.name: Disorienting
entries: The target is {@condition incapacitated} until the end of its next turn, and when it moves, it moves in a random direction.

items.name: Drowsy
entries: The target falls {@condition unconscious} and dreams of evil entities and sinister portals for 10 minutes. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

items.name: Haunting
entries: The target is {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn, and it must take the Dash action and move away from the selang by the safest available route, unless there is nowhere to move.

trait.name: Fey Resilience
entries: The selkie has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saves to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} conditions.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The selkie can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

trait.name: Speak with Pinnipeds
entries: The selkie can communicate with seals, sea lions, and walruses as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The selkie makes one Bite attack and two Tail attacks, or it makes three Spear attacks.

action.name: Bite (Seal Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 +2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Spear (Fey Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Tail (Seal Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The selkie magically transforms into a Medium seal or back into its true form, which is Fey. Its statistics, other than its AC, size, and {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it. It reverts to its true form if it dies. If the selkie is in its true form, it can't use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} unless it is wearing or carrying its bound sealskin.

bonus.name: Charming Escape
entries: The selkie takes the {@action Dash|XPHB} or {@action Disengage|XPHB} action. Each creature within 5 feet of a selkie when it takes the {@action Disengage|XPHB} Action in this way must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw. {@actSaveFail} The creature has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the end of the selkie's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Senmo's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). Senmo can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: {@spell Control Animal|ObojimaTallGrass}, {@spell Fog Cloud}, {@spell Swallow Magic|ObojimaTallGrass}
2/day each: {@spell Beast Transmutation|ObojimaTallGrass}, {@spell Mirror Image}, {@spell Misty Step}
1/day: {@spell Lightning Bolt}

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: Senmo has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Senmo makes two attacks: one with its Beak and one with its Talons.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Black Feather Storm {@recharge}
entries: Senmo flaps its twisted wings, unleashing a flurry of sharp, magical feathers. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) slashing damage and being knocked {@condition Prone} on a failed save, or half as much damage and not being knocked {@condition Prone} on a successful one.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The sentient planetoid is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The sentient planetoid may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the sentient planetoid can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the sentient planetoid has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Alien Intellect
entries: The sentient planetoid is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the sentient planetoid's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Beyond Space and Time
entries: The sentient planetoid always acts on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count 20. Additionally, it can't be moved, teleported, or sent to another plane of existence against its will.

trait.name: Gravitational Pull
entries: The sentient planetoid exerts its own force of gravity in a 100-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. A creature that starts its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} falls towards the sentient planetoid, taking falling damage as appropriate if it collides with the planetoid. A creature can make a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw to grab onto a fixed object it can reach, avoiding the fall on a success.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The sentient planetoid is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The sentient planetoid has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sentient planetoid makes four attacks, only one of which can be an Unfathomable Knowledge attack.

action.name: Unfathomable Knowledge
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 14}, reach 5 ft. or range 250 ft. {@h}39 ({@damage 6d12}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Addled|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} conditions until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Crashing Comet
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 14}, range 150 ft. {@h}27 ({@damage 6d8}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 3d8} Fire).

action.name: All-Knowing Magic {@recharge 5}
entries: The sentient planetoid casts any spell of level 5 or lower, using Intelligence as its spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 22}, +14 to spell attacks).

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The sentinel marshal casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}):

trait.name: Inexorable
entries: The sentinel marshal has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against effects that would cause it to have the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, {@condition Stunned|XPHB}, or {@condition Prone|XPHB} conditions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sentinel marshal makes two Longsword attacks and one Shield Bash attack.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 3}, range 100/400 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d10 + 1}) Piercing damage.

reaction.name: Vigilant Guardian (1/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the sentinel marshal can see within 5 feet of it is hit by an attack roll. {@actResponse} The sentinel marshal swaps places with the target, and it is hit by the attack instead.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The serpentfolk's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 12}). The serpentfolk can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The serpentfolk has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The serpentfolk makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its scimitar.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Coastal Camouflage
entries: The serpopard has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in sandy, muddy, or swampy terrain.

trait.name: Sinuous Strikeback
entries: The serpopard gets two extra reactions that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The serpopard makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Musk (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The serpopard releases foul-smelling musk in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour or until it spends 10 minutes washing off the musk. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. While a creature is {@condition poisoned} in this way, any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the {@condition poisoned} creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its turn.

name: Serum Brute
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius unless Unleashed Eyes is active)

trait.name: Curse Dependent
entries: If the brute is targeted by a {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} spell or similar magic, until it finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, the brute loses its Blindsight, its Withering Eye trait, and its Cursed Gaze action.

trait.name: Stimulant Rush
entries: At the start of its turn, the brute must choose one of the following options (it can't use that option twice in a row):

trait.name: Catalyst Infusion
entries: Until the start of its next turn, the brute's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases to 50 feet, it doesn't provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} when it leaves an enemy's reach, and its {@variantrule Long Jump|XPHB} is up to 30 feet and its {@variantrule High Jump|XPHB} is up to 15 feet with or without a running start.

trait.name: Caustic Secretion
entries: Until the start of its next turn, its Fist attack deals an extra 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Acid damage (included in the Fist attack below).

trait.name: Stim Boost
entries: Gain 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Unleashed Eyes (1/Day)
entries: When the brute is {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, its sealed eyes rip open and unleash its curse. It is no longer blind beyond 60 feet, and it can use its Withering Eye trait and Cursed Gaze action until it finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, whereupon its eyes seal shut again.

trait.name: Withering Eye (Unleashed Eyes Only)
entries: When the brute moves to within 5 feet of a creature, the creature takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Psychic damage. A creature takes this damage only once per turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The brute makes two Fist attacks and can use Cursed Gaze if available.

action.name: Fist
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 10 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage. If Caustic Secretion is active, the target takes an extra 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Acid damage.

action.name: Cursed Gaze (Unleashed Eyes Only)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of the brute's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Devotion
entries: {@actTrigger} An ally within 5 feet takes damage. {@actResponse} The ally gains {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the triggering damage, and the brute takes an amount of Psychic damage equal to the damage the ally takes.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The builder is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The builder deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: The builder has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The builder makes two attacks using Wrecking Ball, Stone, or both, and can use Lay the Foundation, if available.

action.name: Wrecking Ball
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 3d12 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.
Each enemy within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 2d12}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Stone
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d10 + 7}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Lay the Foundation {@recharge}
entries: The builder pours wet concrete on the ground in a 20-foot square starting from a point within 5 feet of the builder. Until the foundation dries in 1 hour, that area is difficult terrain, and when a creature with a Strength score of 20 or less starts their turn in that area, they must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check or be {@condition restrained} until the start of their next turn.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The miner is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: The miner has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The miner can burrow through solid rock at half their burrowing speed and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in their wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The miner makes two attacks using Drill Press, Pneumatic Pick, or both.

action.name: Drill Press
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage. If the target is touching the ground, they are knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition restrained} by the miner's drill. While {@condition restrained} in this way, the target takes 15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage at the start of each of their turns, and the miner can't make Drill Press attacks. The {@condition restrained} condition ends if the miner moves, makes a Drill Press attack, or is destroyed. The target or a creature who can reach them can use an action to pull the target away from the drill, ending the {@condition restrained} condition and dealing 15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage to the target in the process.

action.name: Pneumatic Pick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) piercing damage. If the target is wearing mundane armor, their armor takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers.
Armor reduced to an AC of 10 is destroyed.

action.name: Unload Rocks {@recharge}
entries: The miner hurls rocks and dirt in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 44 ({@damage 8d10}) bludgeoning damage and is {@condition blinded} until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is not {@condition blinded}.

bonus.name: Break Ground {@recharge}
entries: The miner strikes the ground and creates a fissure extending from them in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide, 30-foot-deep line. Each Medium or smaller creature in that area must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature falls into the fissure, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage from the fall and landing {@condition prone}. On a successful save, a creature is shunted 5 feet into an unoccupied space and does not fall into the fissure. If a creature doesn't have an unoccupied space within 5 feet of them, they fall into the fissure.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The engine is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The engine deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: The engine has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The engine makes two attacks using Blade Rake, Force Cannon, or both.

action.name: Blade Rake
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}35 ({@damage 4d12 + 9}) slashing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, they are pulled up to 15 feet toward the engine.

action.name: Force Cannon
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 12} to hit, range 400 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 6d10}) force damage, and the target is {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Burning Oil {@recharge}
entries: The engine shoots burning oil in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 52 ({@damage 15d6}) fire damage and is covered in scalding oil. A creature covered in scalding oil takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage at the start of each of their turns. A creature can use an action to remove the oil from themself or a creature they can reach, ending the effect. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is not covered in scalding oil.

bonus.name: Destructive Rollout
entries: The engine moves up to their speed in a straight line, destroying mundane walls in their path that are less than 10 feet thick. Medium or smaller mundane objects in the engine's path are destroyed if the objects aren't being worn or carried by a creature. The engine can move through the spaces of other creatures during this movement as if they were difficult terrain, and if the engine does so, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Instinctive Ambusher
entries: At the start of the sewer thing's first turn of each combat, if the sewer thing attacks a creature, it can make one additional Tendril Lash attack as part of its Multiattack action.

trait.name: Poison Absorption
entries: Whenever the sewer thing takes Poison damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Poison damage dealt.

trait.name: Toxic Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the sewer thing is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Poison damage.

trait.name: Unexpected Appearance
entries: If the sewer thing is motionless at the start of combat, it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on its {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} roll. Additionally, if a creature hasn't observed the sewer thing move or act, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check to discern that the sewer thing is animate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sewer thing makes two attacks and uses Engulf.

action.name: Tendril Lash
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 30 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}).

action.name: Reel
entries: The sewer thing pulls each creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by it up to 20 feet straight toward it.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The sewer thing engulfs a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of it that is {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by it. The grapple ends. The target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, is suffocating, and is subjected to the following effect at the start of each of the sewer thing's turns. {@actSave con} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Poison damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Acid damage.

If the sewer thing moves, the target moves with it. The sewer thing can have up to four creatures engulfed at a time. An engulfed creature can take an action to escape with a successful {@dc 16} Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check, landing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the sewer thing.

name: Shade
languages: the languages they knew in life

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The shade can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The shade is destroyed if they end their turn inside an object.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the shade takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the shade takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Terrifying
entries: If an enemy starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more shades, the enemy must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the shades until the start of their next turn. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 plus the number of shades within 5 feet of the enemy. On a successful save, the enemy is immune to the Terrifying trait of all shades for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Life Drain (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}1 necrotic damage.

name: Shadhavar
languages: understands Elvish and Umbral but can't speak

trait.name: Magic Horn
entries: The shadhavar's Gore attacks are magical.

trait.name: Shadesight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the shadhavar's darkvision.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadhavar makes one Gore attack and one Hooves attack.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Darkness Aura (1/Day)
entries: A 15-foot radius of magical darkness extends out from the shadhavar, moves with it, and spreads around corners. The darkness lasts as long as the shadhavar maintains {@status concentration}, up to 10 minutes (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Darkvision can't penetrate this darkness, and no natural light can illuminate it. If any of the darkness overlaps with an area of light created by a spell of 2nd level or lower, the spell creating the light is dispelled.

bonus.name: Plaintive Melody (3/Day)
entries: The shadhavar plays a captivating melody through its hollow horn. Each creature within 60 feet of the shadhavar that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} until the start of the shadhavar's next turn. While {@condition charmed}, a creature is {@condition incapacitated}, its speed is reduced to 0, and the shadhavar has advantage on attack rolls against it.

name: Shadow
languages: the languages they knew in life

trait.name: Chilling Phasing
entries: The shadow can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The shadow takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if they end their turn inside an object. A creature takes 1 cold damage the first time a shadow passes through them on a turn.

trait.name: Dark Stalker
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the shadow has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.

action.name: Chilling Grasp
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) cold damage, and the target's Dexterity score is reduced by 2. The target dies if this reduces its Dexterity to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

action.name: Freezing Dark (1/Day)
entries: The shadow pours magical darkness out of their hand in a 15-foot cone. A creature with darkvision who isn't an incorporeal Undead can't see through this darkness, and light can't illuminate it. Each creature in this darkness when it first appears must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage. The darkness remains in that area for 1 minute or until the shadow is destroyed.

bonus.name: Shadow Bind
entries: The shadow targets one creature they can see within 15 feet of them who is in bright or dim light. The target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} by their own shadow (escape {@dc 12}). The grapple ends if the target is no longer in bright or dim light, or if the shadow who used this bonus action is destroyed.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The shadow beast can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The shadow beast has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Shadow Weapons
entries: The shadow beast's weapon attacks are magical. When the shadow beast hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 2d6} necrotic damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the shadow beast has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadow beast makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Frightful Shadows {@recharge 5}
entries: The shadow beast releases a wave of shadows filled with frightening images of eyes, fangs, and other barely seen and terrifying beasts in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 42 ({@damage 12d6}) necrotic damage and is {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition frightened}. A {@condition frightened} creature must take the Dash action and move away from the shadow beast by the safest available route on each of its turns, unless there is nowhere to move. A {@condition frightened} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the shadow blight remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from the stump of a dead tree.

action.name: Frozen Shadow Tendril
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Animate Plants (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The shadow blight magically animates {@dice 1d4} plants within 60 feet of it, turning them into {@creature awakened shrub||awakened shrubs} under its control. These plants' attacks deal an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage. If the shrubs are not destroyed before 1 hour passes, they become new shadow blights.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The shadow fey has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put it to sleep.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the shadow fey has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Shadow Traveler (2/Day)
entries: While in shadows, dim light, or darkness, the shadow fey disappears into the darkness and reappears in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. A tendril of inky smoke appears at the origin and destination when it uses this bonus action.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The shadow fey has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put them to sleep.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the shadow fey has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Traveler in Darkness
entries: The shadow fey has advantage on Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) checks made to know about shadow roads and shadow magic spells or items.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shadow Cloak (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the shadow fey can magically turn {@condition invisible} until they attack, they cast a spell, or their {@status concentration} is broken, up to 1 hour (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the shadow fey wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with them.

bonus.name: Shadow Traveler (3/Day)
entries: While in shadows, dim light, or darkness, the shadow fey disappears into the darkness and reappears in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. A tendril of inky smoke appears at the origin and destination when it uses this trait.

trait.name: Duelist's Mobility
entries: Opportunity attacks made against the duelist have disadvantage. If the duelist is {@condition prone} at the start of its turn, it can immediately stand without costing movement.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The shadow fey has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put it to sleep.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the shadow fey has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadow fey duelist makes two Rapier attacks and one Dagger attack.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d4 + 5}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. A {@condition poisoned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Shadow Traveler (3/Day)

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The shadow fey duelist adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the duelist must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The enchantress casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The enchantress has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put her to sleep.

trait.name: Phrenic Weapons
entries: The enchantress's weapon attacks are magical. When she hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 4d6} psychic damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the shadow fey has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadow fey enchantress makes two Rapier attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Shadow Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) cold damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Beguiling Whispers {@recharge 5}
entries: The enchantress speaks sweet words to a creature she can see within 60 feet of her and that can hear her. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition charmed} for 1 minute. While {@condition charmed} in this way, the creature has disadvantage on Wisdom and Charisma saving throws against spells cast by the enchantress.

action.name: Leadership (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: For 1 minute, the enchantress can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that she can see within 30 feet of her makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature can add a {@dice d4} to its roll, provided it can hear and understand the enchantress. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if the enchantress is {@condition incapacitated}.

bonus.name: Shadow Traveler (3/Day)
entries: While in shadows, dim light, or darkness, the shadow fey disappears into the darkness and reappears in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. A tendril of inky smoke appears at the origin and destination when it uses this bonus action.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the forest hunter is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half the damage, the hunter instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half the damage if it fails.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The shadow fey has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put it to sleep.

trait.name: Forest and Urban Hunter
entries: The forest hunter has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) and Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks to find and track Beasts and Humanoids.

trait.name: Charging Archer
entries: If the forest hunter moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target after hitting the target with a Longbow attack, the forest hunter can make one Dagger attack against the target as a bonus action.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the shadow fey has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadow fey makes two Dagger or Longbow attacks.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

bonus.name: Shadow Traveler (3/Day)
entries: While in shadows, dim light, or darkness, the shadow fey disappears into the darkness and reappears in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. A tendril of inky smoke appears at the origin and destination when it uses this bonus action.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The shadow fey guardian has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put it to sleep.

trait.name: Shadow's Vigil
entries: The guardian has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks, and magical darkness doesn't impede the guardian's darkvision.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the shadow fey has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadow fey guardian makes two Pike or Javelin attacks.

action.name: Pike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Shadow Traveler (2/Day)
entries: While in shadows, dim light, or darkness, the shadow fey disappears into the darkness and reappears in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. A tendril of inky smoke appears at the origin and destination when it uses this bonus action.

reaction.name: Protective Interference
entries: When a friendly creature the shadow fey guardian can see within 5 feet of it is the target of an attack, the guardian can impose disadvantage on the attack roll. To do so, the guardian must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

trait.name: Shadow Camouflage
entries: The shadow goblin has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in dim light or darkness.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the shadow goblin has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Unseelie Blessing
entries: The shadow goblin has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put them to sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadow goblin can make two Greataxe attacks.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d12 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Carving Knife
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60, one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Stink Eye
entries: The shadow goblin targets one creature they can see within 30 feet. If the target can hear and see the shadow goblin, it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the start of the shadow goblin's next turn.

reaction.name: Minion Shield
entries: When the shadow goblin is the target of an attack by a creature they can see, the shadow goblin can choose an ally within 5 feet of them. The two swap places, and the ally becomes the target of the attack instead.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The shadow goblin casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

trait.name: Shadow Camouflage
entries: The shadow goblin has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in dim light or darkness.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the shadow goblin has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Unseelie Blessing
entries: The shadow goblin has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put them to sleep.

action.name: Quill
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Notarize (1/Day)
entries: The shadow goblin chooses one creature they can see within 60 feet and mystically marks it for 24 hours. While a creature is marked in this way, it rolls with disadvantage against any saving throws made to resist the shadow goblin's spells.

action.name: Stink Eye
entries: The shadow goblin targets one creature they can see within 30 feet. If the target can hear and see the scribe, it must succeed on a {@dc 11} Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on the next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes before the start of the scribe's next turn

bonus.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The shadow goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.

reaction.name: Vengeful Jinx
entries: When the shadow goblin is hit by an attack from a creature they can see, they can curse the attacker. The target has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The shadow nymph casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as her spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}).

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The shadow nymph can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Blinding Beauty
entries: When a creature that can see the nymph starts its turn within 30 feet of the nymph, the nymph can force it to make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw if the nymph isn't {@condition incapacitated} and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is permanently {@condition blinded}. Otherwise, a creature that fails its save is {@condition blinded} for 1 minute. A {@condition blinded} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Unless {@status surprised}, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the nymph until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the nymph in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

trait.name: Shadow Dweller
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the shadow nymph's darkvision.

trait.name: Water Spirit
entries: While the shadow nymph is in contact with or submerged in a body of water, she ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce her speed or cause her to be {@condition restrained}. She can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being {@condition grappled}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadow nymph uses Shadow Nymph's Gaze. She then makes two Dagger attacks.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d4 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shadow Nymph's Gaze
entries: The shadow nymph directs her gaze at one creature she can see within 30 feet of her, targeting the creature with one of the following effects:

items.name: Icy Glance
entries: The target must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage and is {@condition restrained} until the end of its next turn as ice forms around its limbs. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition restrained}.

items.name: Shadow Glare
entries: The target must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Stunning Stare
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or become {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the shadow nymph's Stunning Stare for the next 24 hours.

bonus.name: Shadow Blend
entries: The shadow nymph magically turns {@condition invisible} until she attacks or uses Shadow Nymph's Gaze, until she enters an area of bright light, or until she ends it as a bonus action. She can use this bonus action only while in dim light or darkness.

hp.special: 50 (Assassin only) or 40 (Infiltrator only) + 10 for each spell level above 5

trait.name: Incorporeal Passage
entries: The spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. If it ends its turn inside an object, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes {@damage 1d10} Force damage for every 5 feet traveled.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: The spirit may take the {@action Hide|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} when in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (round down).

action.name: Chill Touch (Infiltrator Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hitYourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier}, Reach 5 ft. {@h}{@damage 1d8 + 3 + summonSpellLevel} Cold damage.

action.name: Deathly Bolt (Assassin Only)
entries: {@atkr r} {@hitYourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier}, range 150 ft. {@h}{@damage 2d4 + 3 + summonSpellLevel} Cold damage. If the spirit was hidden when it made the attack, the attack deals an additional {@damage 2d4} Cold damage.

name: Shadowbeast

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

languages: can understand all languages but can't speak

trait.name: Death in Shadow
entries: When the shadowbeast dies, its body and its equipment dissolve into shadows and disappear, leaving nothing behind.

trait.name: Bristling Hide
entries: At the start of each of its turns, the shadowbeast deals 5 ({@damage 1d10}) piercing damage to any creature {@action grapple||grappling} it.

trait.name: Shadow Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the shadowbeast's {@sense darkvision}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The shadowbeast has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadowbeast makes three melee attacks: one with its tail and two with its slam. Alternatively, it can use Spit Flame twice.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Spit Flame
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, range 150 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it also catches fire.

trait.name: Darkwalkers
entries: While in darkness, the shadowspider swarm is {@condition invisible}.

trait.name: Sense Life
entries: The shadowspider swarm can pinpoint the location of a warm, living creature within 30 feet.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The shadowspider swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny shadowspider. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

trait.name: Wasting Wave
entries: A creature that enters the swarm's space for the first time on a turn or ends its turn in the swarm's space must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or gain one level of shadow corruption (see Chapter 5 of Book of Ebon Tides).

action.name: Shadow Bites
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage, or 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer. The target must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage and 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Shadowsteel ghast's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Shadowsteel ghast has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Shadowsteel Coat
entries: The Shadowsteel ghast is coated in metal armor made of Shadowsteel.

trait.name: Shadowsteel Miasma
entries: Creatures of the Shadowsteel ghast's choice that start their turn within 30 feet of the ghast must roll a {@dice d4} and subtract the number rolled from any attack roll or saving throw they make until the start of their next turn. Only one miasma can affect a given creature at a time. A creature that rolls a natural 20 on any attack roll or saving throw while in a Shadowsteel miasma is immune to the miasma of any Shadowsteel ghast for 1 hour.

trait.name: Turning Defiance
entries: The Shadowsteel ghast and any Shadowsteel ghouls within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Shadowsteel ghast makes two claw attacks or casts one at-will spell and makes one claw attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) slashing damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage. A cursed target must make an escalation check. If a target drops to 0 hit points due to this damage and isn't already cursed, they are randomly afflicted with one from among any of the curses in the Grim Hollow Campaign Guide (GM's choice).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Shadowsteel ghoul has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Shadowsteel Coat
entries: The Shadowsteel ghoul is coated in metal armor made of Shadowsteel.

trait.name: Shadowsteel Hunger
entries: The Shadowsteel ghoul has advantage on attack rolls against creatures carrying or wearing Shadowsteel.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Shadowsteel ghoul makes two claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage and 5 ({@damage 2d4}) necrotic damage. A cursed target must make an escalation check. If a target drops to 0 hit points due to this damage and isn't already cursed, roll {@dice 1d4}, and the target is afflicted with a curse based on the result: 1-2 Curse of Damned Aging, 3-4 Curse of Foul Blight. (See Grim Hollow Campaign Guide for information on curses and escalation.)

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The shaman casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shaman makes three attacks, using Ritual Staff or Cursed Bolt in any combination.

action.name: Ritual Staff
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Cursed Bolt
entries: {@atkr rs} {@hit 5} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Inspire Ferocity {@recharge 4}
entries: The shaman inspires ferocity in up to three creatures it can see. Those targets have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and saving throws until the end of the shaman's next turn and gain 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

reaction.name: Minor Elemental Absorption (3/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} The shaman takes Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage. {@actResponse} The shaman gives itself {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to that instance of damage.

trait.name: Engulfing Sack
entries: The mound has a vegetative sack on their body where they carry engulfed creatures. The sack can be attacked (AC 15; 50 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage), which deals no damage to the mound. Destroying the sack frees creatures trapped by the mound's Engulf action. The mound regrows the sack at the beginning of their next turn.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the mound remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from an ordinary mass of vegetation.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mound makes two Vine Lash attacks. They can replace one attack with a use of Engulf, if available.

action.name: Vine Lash
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, the mound can pull the target up to 30 feet toward them.

action.name: Engulf {@recharge 5}
entries: The mound reaches out with writhing vines and attempts to pull in up to two Medium or smaller creatures within 30 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be engulfed in the mound's engulfing sack. An engulfed creature is {@condition restrained}, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the mound, and takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage at the start of each of the mound's turns. When the mound moves, the engulfed creature moves with them. If the mound dies or their engulfing sack is destroyed, each engulfed creature is freed and shunted to an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of the mound.

reaction.name: Poison Froth
entries: When the mound takes damage, the inside of their engulfing sack churns with poison. Each creature engulfed by the mound takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage, and the mound regains a number of hit points equal to the total damage dealt by this reaction to creatures in their sack.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the mound remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from an ordinary mass of vegetation. If the mound's caregiver is Large or smaller, they can use the Hide action to attempt to hide in the same space as their motionless mound.

action.name: Signature Attack (Vine Lash)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Long-Range Lash (2 Ferocity)
entries: The mound makes a signature attack with a reach of 30 feet instead of 5 feet.
If this attack hits a Medium or smaller creature, the mound can pull the target up to 10 feet toward the mound.

action.name: 3rd Level: Verdant Roundup (5 Ferocity)
entries: The mound targets up to PB creatures within 30 feet of them who are Large or smaller. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet toward the mound and take {@damage PBd4} poison damage.

action.name: 5th Level: Engulf (8 Ferocity)
entries: The mound attempts to pull a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet of them into their body. The target must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength saving throw. On a failure, the target is pulled into the mound's space, takes {@damage PBd8} poison damage, and is engulfed. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage, doesn't move, and isn't engulfed.

An engulfed creature is {@condition restrained}, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the mound, and takes {@damage PBd8} poison damage at the start of each of the mound's turns. When the mound moves, the engulfed creature moves with them. An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength check. On a success, that creature is freed and shunted to an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of the mound.
The mound can have one Large or up to four Medium or smaller creatures engulfed at a time.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the pile remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from an ordinary mass of vegetation.

trait.name: Hungry Grab
entries: If an enemy starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more piles, the creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled}. While {@condition grappled} in this way, the target is {@condition restrained}, and at the start of each of the target's turns, they take poison damage equal to the number of piles within 5 feet of them. The saving throw and escape DC equal 10 plus the number of piles within 5 feet of the creature. The grapple ends if fewer than three piles are within 5 feet of the creature.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the pile takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the pile takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Vine Lash (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 piercing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The manticore makes two Claw attacks and one Stinger attack

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Slashing damage. If the manticore flies 30+ feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition and the manticore can make a Bite attack against it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

action.name: Stinger
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 20 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Piercing damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} 24 ({@damage 7d6}) Necrotic damage. Failure by 5 or More: The target also gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Wing Shards {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the manticore (flying creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}). {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Piercing damage, and if the target is flying, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

name: Sharkjaw Skeleton
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The sharkjaw skeleton doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). The skeleton can grapple up to two targets at a time.

action.name: Devouring Embrace
entries: The sharkjaw skeleton devours a Medium or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by it. The grapple ends, the devoured target is {@condition restrained} in the skeleton's many jaws, and the target takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage at the start of each of the skeleton's turns. If the skeleton moves, the devoured target moves with it. The skeleton can devour only one target at a time. A creature, including the devoured target, can take its action to pry the devoured target out of the skeleton's many jaws by succeeding on a {@dc 13} Strength check.

name: Shatter Corpse
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Glass Spikes
entries: Each time a creature makes a melee attack against a shatter corpse, it takes 3 piercing damage. A creature can choose to make an attack with disadvantage to avoid this damage.

trait.name: Loud
entries: Creatures have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks made to hear the approach of a shatter corpse.

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The shatter corpse has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the shatter corpse to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the shatter corpse drops to 1 hit point instead.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage and 2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Volley of Glass {@recharge}
entries: The shatter corpse flicks a volley of glass shards in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Rush
entries: If the sheep dragon moves at least 20 feet in a straight line, during which it moves within 5 feet of a creature and flies past it, that creature must make a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pulled 10 feet in the direction the sheep dragon is moving and knocked {@condition prone}, and the sheep dragon doesn't provoke an opportunity attack from it. On a successful save, the creature isn't pulled or knocked {@condition prone}, and if it makes an opportunity attack against the sheep dragon, it does so with disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sheep dragon makes two attacks: one with its Bite and one with its Headbutt. Alternatively, it makes three Wind Pistol attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Headbutt
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Wind Pistol
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 100/200 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The shellycoat can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The shellycoat has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing.

trait.name: Hazesight
entries: The shellycoat can see through areas obscured by fog, smoke, and steam without penalty.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The shellycoat regains 3 hp at the start of its turn. If the shellycoat takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the shellycoat's next turn. The shellycoat dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Water Camouflage
entries: The shellycoat has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide while at least partially submerged in water.

trait.name: Sunlight Petrification
entries: If the shellycoat remains in nonmagical sunlight for 1 minute, it becomes {@condition petrified} at the end of that minute.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shellycoat makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) slashing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the creature is {@condition restrained}. The shellycoat has two claws, each of which can grapple only one creature.

action.name: Shellycoat's Fog (1/Day)
entries: While in contact with water, the shellycoat can create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point it can see within 60 feet of it for 1 minute. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. A creature that enters the fog for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} and unable to breathe, unless it can breathe water, for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shield-maiden makes three attacks, using Longsword or Javelin in any combination. The shield maiden can replace one attack with Shield Bash.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Javelin
