entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 12} One creature within 5 feet that the shield-maiden can see. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: Call to Arms {@recharge 6}
entries: Up to three creatures of the shield-maiden's choice that are within 30 feet of her and can hear her gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls until the start of the shield-maiden's next turn.

reaction.name: Interpose Shield
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature within 5 feet of the shield-maiden is hit by a melee attack roll. {@actResponse} The target adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss. If the attack misses, the shield-maiden can make one weapon attack against the attacker.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the shieldhead moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Ram
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The drangolin can burrow through solid rock at half their burrow speed and leaves behind a 3-foot-diameter tunnel when they burrow. Tiny and Small creatures can move through it normally, and Medium and Large creatures can squeeze through it. This tunnel collapses after 10 minutes.

action.name: Fiery Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Erupt (1/Day)
entries: If the drangolin is burrowing within 10 feet of the surface, they can erupt from the ground (without spending movement) into a space that contains one or more creatures. When they do, each creature within 10 feet of the drangolin must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw. A creature directly above the drangolin when they emerge has disadvantage on this saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage and is knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, a creature takes only half as much damage and is pushed 5 feet to an unoccupied space of their choice instead of being knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Wrecking Ball (1/Day)
entries: The drangolin moves up to twice their walking speed in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks. While doing so, they can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. If the drangolin enters another creature's space during this move, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage. If the drangolin enters the space of a structure or object that isn't being worn or carried, it takes twice as much damage.

reaction.name: Ash Shot
entries: When a creature the drangolin can sense moves within 5 feet of them, the drangolin sprays them with a cloud of ash. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the start of their next turn.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The Caustic Slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The Caustic Slime can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Psuedopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) acid damage. The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and the shifting slime can't make a pseudopod attack against another target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The shifting slime makes one pseudopod attack against a target it is grappling that is at least one size smaller than itself. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is {@condition restrained}, it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside the shifting slime, and it must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw at the start of each of its turns taking 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage on a failure. If the shifting slime used its adaptive ability to become immune to a damage type, the damage dealt to the target on a failed save becomes that type instead. The shifting slime can have only one target swallowed at a time.
If the shifting slime dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it, and may move freely as the body of the slime quivers and neutralizes into an inert puddle of goo.

reaction.name: Split
entries: When a slime that is Medium or larger and has 10 or more hit points is hit with slashing damage, it splits into two new slimes. Each new slime has hit points equal to half the original slime's, rounded down. New slimes are one size smaller than the previous size. New shifting slimes each have the same damage type immunity as their parent slime and retain the Adaptive ability.

reaction.name: Adaptive
entries: Each time the slime is hit by a spell that deals damage, it can become immune to that damage type for 1 hour. When the slime changes the damage type it's immune to, its color changes based on the table on the below. The slime can only be immune to one damage type at a time. Normally, shifting slimes are iridescent, shimmering with all the colors of the rainbow.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The ancient shoggoth casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The shoggoth can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot without expending extra movement to do so.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The shoggoth can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The shoggoth has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shoggoth makes four attacks, using Horrid Tendril or Hurled Mucous in any combination. It can't attack the same target more than once.

action.name: Horrid Tendril
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 15}, Reach 20 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 2d10 + 10}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 20}), and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends. It can Grapple up to four Large or smaller creatures at a time.

action.name: Hurled Mucous
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 15}, range 200 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 2d10 + 10}) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Slime Wave {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 20}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 44 ({@damage 8d10}) Acid damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. For 1 minute, the area within the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} is drenched with slimy acid. When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, it takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Acid damage. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

bonus.name: Horrid Digestion
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 23}, one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the shoggoth. {@actSaveFail} The target takes 32 ({@damage 4d10 + 10}) Acid damage.

legendary.name: Thrash of Shifting Forms
entries: The shoggoth makes a Horrid Tendril or Hurled Mucous attack.

legendary.name: Bear Down Upon
entries: The shoggoth moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The shoggoth can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot without expending extra movement to do so.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The shoggoth can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The shoggoth has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shoggoth makes four attacks, using Horrid Tendril or Hurled Mucous in any combination. It can't attack the same target more than once.

action.name: Horrid Tendril
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 15}, Reach 20 ft. {@h}21 ({@dice 2d10 + 10}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 20}), and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends. It can Grapple up to four Large or smaller creatures at a time.

action.name: Hurled Mucous
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 15}, range 200 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 2d10 + 10}) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Slime Wave {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 20}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 44 ({@damage 8d10}) Acid damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. For 1 minute, the area within the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} is drenched with slimy acid. When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, it takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Acid damage. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

bonus.name: Horrid Digestion
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 23}, one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the shoggoth. {@actSaveFail} The target takes 32 ({@damage 4d10 + 10}) Acid damage.

legendary.name: Thrash of Shifting Forms
entries: The shoggoth makes a Horrid Tendril or Hurled Mucous attack.

legendary.name: Bear Down Upon
entries: The shoggoth moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

trait.name: Anaerobic Nature
entries: The shoggoth doesn't require air.

trait.name: Absorb Flesh
entries: When the shoggoth kills a creature while within 15 feet of it, the creature's body is absorbed into the shoggoth's. The creature can be restored to life only by means of a true resurrection or a {@spell wish} spell.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The shoggoth can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Hideous Cacophony
entries: The shoggoth's many mouths constantly emit whistles, fluting, and other high-pitched noises. It has disadvantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to be unheard. Each creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the shoggoth and that can hear it must make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or be disoriented until the start of its next turn. A disoriented creature is {@condition incapacitated}, and when it moves, it moves in a random direction.

Unless surprised, a creature can cover its ears to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't hear until the start of its next turn, when it can cover its ears again. If the creature uncovers its ears in the meantime while within 60 feet of the shoggoth, it must immediately make the save. A creature that is covering its ears and that has access to cloth, wax, or similar material can stuff its ears with the material as a bonus action to free up its hands, deafening itself while the material remains stuffed in its ears.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The shoggoth has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Limited Mutability
entries: Any spell or effect that would alter the shoggoth's form alters it for only 1 round. Afterward, the shoggoth returns to its amorphous blob form.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shoggoth makes four Slam attacks. It can replace two Slam attacks with a use of Crush.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 4d10 + 8}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}) if it is a Large or smaller creature.

action.name: Crush
entries: The shoggoth crushes up to two creatures it is grappling by rolling them beneath its bulk. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or take 30 ({@damage 4d10 + 8}) bludgeoning damage, be unable to breathe, and be {@condition restrained} until the grapple ends. If the shoggoth moves, a creature beneath it is no longer {@condition restrained} and is able to breathe, but it remains {@condition grappled}.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The shroud can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Shadow Evolution
entries: If the shroud deals at least 12 necrotic damage to a creature that isn't a Construct or Undead in 1 minute or less, the shroud transforms into a shadow at the start of the turn after it last dealt damage. It uses the statistics of the shadow, except it reduces the shadow's hp by an amount equal to the damage the shroud took before it transformed.

trait.name: Sunlight Weakness
entries: While in sunlight, the shroud has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The shroud doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Strength Drain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) necrotic damage, and the target has disadvantage on weapon attacks that use Strength until the end of its next turn. If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a new shroud rises from the corpse {@dice 1d4} hours later.

bonus.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the shroud takes the Hide action.

trait.name: Mist Form
entries: The shrouded can enter another creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without spending extra movement to do so.

trait.name: Corrupting Mist
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, a creature that starts its turn in the shrouded's space. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The soul of a Humanoid that dies from this damage becomes a new shrouded at the start of the shrouded's next turn and takes its turn on that {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}.
The Humanoid can't be returned to life until the new shrouded is destroyed.

trait.name: Graveyard Warding
entries: The shrouded can't move through a space with a barrier or line of iron, such as a wrought iron fence or a line of iron filings. This impassible barrier rises to a height of 1 mile above the iron.

trait.name: Variation
entries: The shrouded has one of three variants, which determines a unique action option: Devourer, Reaper, or Whisperer.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shrouded makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Corrupting Touch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Consuming Bite (Devourer Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 10 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 13}). At the start of a {@condition Grappled|XPHB} target's turn, it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage, and the shrouded regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to that amount.

action.name: Scythe (Reaper Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} until the start of the shrouded's next turn.

action.name: Toxic Thoughts (Whisperer Only)
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 13}, each creature that isn't a Construct or Undead in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the shrouded. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of the shrouded's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

name: Shtriga Nonna

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Shtriga Nonna can cast the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Feline Resilience (3/Day)
entries: When Shtriga Nonna fails a saving throw, she can immediately turn into a cat of her size (Medium in her normal form, Large while under the effect of Grow) and succeed instead. While in cat form, Shtriga Nonna retains her game statistics and ability to speak, except she can't cast spells or use Soul Steal. She reverts to her previous form at the end of her next turn.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: Shtriga Nonna has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Shtriga Nonna makes two Corrosive Claw attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Soul Steal, if available.

action.name: Corrosive Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. (10 ft. with Grow), one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage, or 14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) slashing damage while under the effect of Grow. If the target is wearing mundane metal armor, they must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity throw or their armor takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. If the armor is reduced to an AC of 10, it is destroyed.

action.name: Soul Steal {@recharge 5}
entries: Shtriga Nonna inhales deeply in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 16 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Shtriga Nonna regains 10 hit points for each creature who fails this saving throw.

bonus.name: Grow (2/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
entries: For 1 minute, Shtriga Nonna magically increases in size, along with anything she is wearing or carrying. While enlarged, she is Large, her reach becomes 10 feet, she deals an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage on Strength-based weapon attacks (included in the attacks), and she makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage. If Shtriga Nonna lacks the room to become Large, she attains the maximum size possible in the space available.

bonus.name: Gobble You Up
entries: Shtriga Nonna feeds on the body of an {@condition unconscious} creature within 5 feet of her. The target takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage, and Shtriga Nonna recharges her Soul Steal action.

reaction.name: Turned Upside Down
entries: When a creature hits Shtriga Nonna with a melee attack, she magically reverses gravity around her. Each creature within 5 feet of her must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or rise vertically 10 feet into the air. A creature levitating in this way remains suspended until the end of their next turn, then falls unless they have an ability that keeps them aloft.

legendaryHeader: Shtriga Nonna has three villain actions. She can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. She can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Snackies for Sweeties
entries: The air within 30 feet of Shtriga Nonna magically fills with the scent of rotten food. Each other creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). Creatures are affected even if they hold their breath or don't need to breathe.

legendary.name: Action 2: Feline Felicity
entries: Shtriga Nonna grows four cat legs in a burst of magical energy. Each creature within 5 feet of her must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10 ({@damage 4d4}) force damage and is pushed 10 feet away from her. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed. Shtriga Nonna can then move up to twice her speed, after which the extra cat legs disappear.

legendary.name: Action 3: Open the Oven
entries: Shtriga Nonna opens a portal to her massive oven in the palms of her hands, creating a blast of heat and noise in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 13 ({@damage 3d8}) fire damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Boundless Horror
entries: When Shub-Niggurath drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or would be killed outright, it instead transforms into a swarm of insects that fill its space. At the start of each of Shub-Niggurath's turns, it gains one recovery point but otherwise cannot use actions or legendary actions other than Relentless Horror. When it gains its fourth recovery point, its maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} return to normal if they have been reduced and it regains all lost {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. It reforms its physical body in a space of its choice within 10 miles of its location. It then loses all recovery points.
If Shub-Niggurath's space is filled with magical fire it is banished from the world and prevented from returning for {@dice 4d10} years.

trait.name: Horrid Garden
entries: Horrid vines, slick acidic dew and covering in flesh, gnawing mouths erupt from the ground in a 120-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from Shub-Niggurath. The effect of this trait depends on its level. When Shub-Niggurath rolls initiative, set this trait's level to 0. The trait's level increase by 1 after each of Shub-Niggurath's turns to a maximum of 3. Use the highest AC bonus granted by this trait. Shub-Niggurath gains the benefits of this trait's current level and all lower ones. These benefits end when Shub-Niggurath is no longer threatened by hostile creatures.

entries.name: Level 0
entries: No effect.

entries.name: Level 1
entries: The ground in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} for non-Plants. At the end of Shub-Niggurath's turns, including the turn in which this trait reached level 1, two awakened trees appear in open spots in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of Shub-Niggurath's choice. They immediately roll initiative and aid their Dark Mother.

entries.name: Level 2
entries: A non-plant takes 15 Acid damage, or 30 Acid damage if it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, when it ends its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}.

entries.name: Level 3
entries: Plants have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all attack rolls made against non-Plants in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. A creature hit by a Plant's melee attack gains the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If Shub-Niggurath fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Shub-Niggurath makes four total Grasping Tendril and Stomping Hoff attacks.

action.name: Grasping Tendril
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 17}, Reach 30 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 2d10 + 10}) Bludgeoning damage and the target is moved to the open space closest to Shub-Niggurath.

action.name: Stomping Hoof
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 17}, Reach 10 ft. {@h}32 ({@damage 4d10 + 10}) Bludgeoning damage and the target gains the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: The Earth Hungers {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 25}, creatures of Shub-Niggurath's choice within 200 ft. of Shub-Niggurath and the ground. {@actSaveFail} The target takes 110 ({@damage 20d10}) Bludgeoning damage, is pulled to the ground beneath it if it is flying, and gains the {@condition Prone|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions as fibrous plant tendrils erupt from the ground. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage, and the target is pulled to the ground beneath it if it is flying.

bonus.name: Tree Walk
entries: Shub-Niggurath may teleport to any open space, provided she ends that teleportation within 10 feet of a friendly Plant creature she can see.

legendary.name: Hungry Tendril
entries: Shub-Niggurath makes a Grasping Tendril Attack

legendary.name: Rapid Maneuver
entries: Shub-Niggurath uses its Tree Walk {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. It can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Relentless Horror {@recharge 5}
entries: Shub-Niggurath chooses one of the following options:

items: It teleports up to 200 ft. to an unoccupied space.
It immediately ends one spell or condition affecting it.
It ends one spell or magical effect of its choice within 120 ft. of it.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Shyla is a 5th level spellcaster, her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 13}, +5 to hit with spell attacks). Shyla has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Evasive
entries: Shyla includes her Intelligence modifier as a bonus on all Dexterity saving throws.

trait.name: Divine Eminence
entries: As a bonus action, Shyla can expend a spell slot to cause her melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If Shyla expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by {@damage 1d6} for each level above 1st.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage.

name: Sightless Agony
languages: all languages known before the curse

trait.name: Shared Agony
entries: When a Sightless Agony takes damage, it emits a wave of energy, causing each creature within 5 feet of it to take an amount of Psychic damage equal to half the triggering damage (rounding down).

trait.name: Stunted Flight
entries: When a Sightless Agony chooses to fly, it must land by the end of its turn or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Sightless Agony makes one Bite attack, two Claw attacks, and one Tail attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Psychic damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Psychic damage. If both Claw attacks hit the same creature, the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 17}). Checks made to escape the grapple have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Piercing damage plus 18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) Psychic damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave str} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

reaction.name: Wave of Agony (1/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} The Sightless Agony becomes {@status Bloodied|XPHB}. {@actResponse} {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, each creature within a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. {@actSaveFail} 45 ({@damage 10d8}) Psychic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

trait.name: Holy Weapons
entries: When the cavalier hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Radiant damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Skilled Rider
entries: While mounted, the cavalier can force an attack that targets its mount to target the cavalier instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cavalier makes two attacks.

action.name: Lance
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} (with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} against a target within 5 feet), reach 10 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) Force damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Radiant damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Force damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Radiant damage.

bonus.name: Summon Steed (1/Day)
entries: The cavalier magically summons a Griffon, which appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of the cavalier and obeys its commands. The steed takes its turn immediately before or after the cavalier. It remains until it or the cavalier dies, or the cavalier dismisses it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

trait.name: Holy Weapons
entries: When the paladin hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Radiant damage (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The paladin makes two attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Force damage, or 9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Force damage if wielded with two hands, plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Radiant damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Force damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Radiant damage.

bonus.name: Lay on Hands (3/Day)
entries: The paladin touches another creature. The target regains 11 ({@dice 2d8 + 2}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and is cured of one disease or the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.

reaction.name: Deny the Witch (3/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the paladin can see within 60 feet casts a spell. {@actResponse} If the spell is level 3 or lower, the spell fails, but no resources are wasted.

trait.name: For the Flame! (3/Day)
entries: The recruit can take an additional Multiattack action on its turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The recruit makes two attacks using its Longsword or Shortbow in any combination.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Slashing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) Slashing damage if wielded with two hands.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 80/320 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}The target is pushed 5 feet away from the recruit and has the {@condition Staggered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

reaction.name: Parry
entries: {@actTrigger} The recruit is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. {@actResponse} The recruit adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

trait.name: For the Flame! (1/Day)
entries: The squire can take an additional Multiattack action on its turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The squire makes two attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 80/320 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Helping Hand
entries: The squire grants a creature within 5 feet of them {@condition Valor|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} ({@dice 1d4}) until the end of that creature's next turn.

reaction.name: Look Out!
entries: {@actTrigger} An ally within 5 feet of the squire is hit by an attack. {@actResponse} The squire takes the attack's damage instead.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The Sitri cat has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Seven Shades of Sitri
entries: A humanoid who touches a Sitri cat must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or become infected with the Seven Shades of Sitri. If a humanoid succeeds on the saving throw, they're immune to the disease for 24 hours. Carnal urges overwhelm an infected humanoid. When the infected interacts with another non-hostile humanoid, the infected becomes {@condition charmed} by that humanoid until the subject of the infatuation or their friends harm the infected. The infected can repeat the saving throw once every 24 hours. Current infatuations end when one of these saves succeeds. The disease ends for the infected when they have succeeded on five saving throws.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 slashing damage and Seven Shades of Sitri.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The skald casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skald makes two Shortword or two Shortbow attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6} to hit, range 80/320 feet., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Heroic Oration {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature of the skald's choice within 30 feet of it that can hear it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of the skald's next turn.

trait.name: Fate's Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the skein witch fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The skein witch has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skein witch makes three Inexorable Thread attacks.

action.name: Inexorable Thread
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. {@h}27 ({@damage 5d8 + 5}) Radiant damage. If the skein witch hits with this attack, it can teleport, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

action.name: Destiny Distortion Wave {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 17} Each creature of its choice in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 55 Force damage, and the creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} for 1 minute. A creature can make a save at the end of each of its turns to end this effect. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Bind Fates (1/Day)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 17} One creature the skein witch can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target's fate is bound to that of one of its allies of the witch's choice. Any damage or condition the target suffers is inflicted on the ally to which it is bound instead, and vice versa. A creature can be bound to only one other creature at a time. This binding lasts until lifted by a {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB}, {@spell Heal|XPHB}, or {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} spell or similar magic.

bonus.name: Cutting the Thread
entries: The skein witch chooses a creature within 30 feet of it that it can see and that is at 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. If the creature was {@variantrule Stable|XPHB}, it is no longer {@variantrule Stable|XPHB}. In addition, it must make an immediate {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB}.

reaction.name: Parry Spell
entries: {@actTrigger} The skein witch succeeds on a saving throw against a spell of 4th level or lower that targets only the skein witch. {@actResponse} The spell has no effect. If the skein witch succeeds on the saving throw by 5 or more, the spell is reflected back at the spellcaster, using the slot level, spell save DC, attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the caster.

trait.name: Fate's Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the skein witch fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The skein witch has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skein witch makes three Inexorable Thread attacks. If two Inexorable Thread attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage on the next death saving throw it makes before it finishes a short rest. If a creature fails this saving throw multiple times, these effects are cumulative, affecting up to three of the creature's next death saving throws before it finishes a short rest.

action.name: Inexorable Thread
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. {@h}27 ({@damage 5d8 + 5}) radiant damage.

action.name: Destiny Distortion Wave {@recharge 5}
entries: The skein witch frays the strands of fate in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw, taking 55 ({@damage 10d10}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If any creature that failed the saving throw is affected by a condition, such as {@condition incapacitated} or {@condition poisoned}, those conditions are randomly redistributed among all the creatures that failed the saving throw.

action.name: Bind Fates (1/Day)
entries: One creature within 60 feet of the skein witch must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or the target's fate is bound to one of its ally's (chosen at random). Any damage or condition the target suffers is inflicted on the individual to which they are bound instead, and vice versa. A creature can be bound to only one other creature at a time. This binding lasts until lifted by a heal or {@spell heroes' feast} spell or similar magic.

bonus.name: Fate's Step
entries: The skein witch teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. A tiny hourglass shatters into a swirl of sand at the origin and destination when it uses this bonus action.

reaction.name: Parry Spell
entries: If the skein witch succeeds on a saving throw against a spell of 4th level or lower that targets only the skein witch, the spell has no effect. If the skein witch succeeds on the saving throw by 5 or more, the spell is reflected back at the spellcaster, using the slot level, spell save DC, attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the caster.

trait.name: Shrapnel
entries: If a creature within 5 feet of the swarm hits it with a melee attack while the swarm isn't underwater, the creature must make a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw as bits of tiny bones pelt it. On a failed save, the creature flinches, giving it disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes this turn.

trait.name: Skeletonized
entries: The swarm doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny fish. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. {@h}16 ({@damage 4d6 + 2}) piercing damage, or 9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

name: Skeleton
languages: the languages they knew in life

trait.name: Bone Weapons
entries: The skeleton's weapon attacks are magical. They use their bones as ammunition for their bone bow, regrowing used bones every dusk.

trait.name: Hail of Bones
entries: If the skeleton is reduced to 0 hit points by bludgeoning, force, or thunder damage, the skeleton is destroyed in an explosion of bone. Each creature within 5 feet of them takes 4 piercing damage.

action.name: Bone Bow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing, and if the target regains hit points before the start of the skeleton's next turn, the number of hit points the target regains is halved.

action.name: Bone Knife
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, they have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of this turn.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Chillsteel Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Cold damage. Critical {@h}The target has the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dc 10}).

bonus.name: Steady Aim
entries: The skeleton archer grants itself {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on its next ranged attack roll this turn. It can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} only if it hasn't moved during this turn, and after it uses this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 0 and can't increase until the end of this turn.

name: Skeleton Cannoneer
languages: understands languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Dead Firearms
entries: The cannon and pistol a skeleton cannoneer uses are nonfunctional as ranged weapons for a creature other than a skeleton cannoneer. For the skeleton cannoneer, the pistol never needs to be reloaded.

action.name: Load
entries: The skeleton cannoneer loads the dead cannon.

action.name: Dead Cannon
entries: The skeleton cannoneer fires its loaded cannon at a point it can see within 500 feet of it, but no closer than 50 feet from it. Each creature within 15 feet of that point must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Alternatively, the cannoneer can choose the cannon as the point of fire. Doing so means the shot goes off inside the cannon, destroying it and increasing each type of damage by 3 ({@dice 1d6}).

action.name: Pistol Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Dead Pistol
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage.

name: Skeleton Commander
languages: understands languages it knew in life but can't speak

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skeleton commander makes two pike attacks.

action.name: Pike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage and 5 ({@damage 2d4}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Warlord Strike {@recharge 5}
entries: The skeleton commander makes one pike attack. The commander can use a bonus action to direct another undead who can see or hear the commander to attack the target the commander attacked this turn. That undead can use a reaction to make the attack, adding the commander's proficiency bonus to the damage roll.

reaction.name: Brandish Standard
entries: If an undead the skeleton commander can see within 30 feet of the commander makes an attack roll or saving throw, the commander can brandish the tattered banner on its pike. If the commander does so, the target can add a {@dice d4} to its roll, provided it can see the commander and isn't receiving this benefit from another commander.

action.name: Fire Lance
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d10 + 3}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 1d10} Fire).

action.name: Shocking Arc
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) Lightning damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 13}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

action.name: Thunder Blast {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} originating from the skeleton mage. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the skeleton mage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Teleport
entries: The skeleton mage teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

name: Skeleton Rifler
languages: understands languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Dead Rifle
entries: The rifle a skeleton rifler carries is nonfunctional as a ranged weapon for a creature other than a skeleton rifler. For the skeleton rifler, the rifle never needs to be reloaded.

action.name: Bayonet
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Dead Rifle
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d12 + 2}) piercing damage and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Poison-Tipped Spear
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Poison damage.

bonus.name: Shield Slam
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 13}, one creature within 5 feet of the skeleton soldier. {@actSaveFail} The target is pushed 5 feet away from the skeleton soldier and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The skeljaskra deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skeljaskra makes two attacks, using Rend, Burning Spit, or Tail in any combination.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Burning Spit
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} conditions until the start of the skeljaskra's next turn.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) Piercing damage, and the target is pushed 5 feet.

reaction.name: Armored Ball
entries: {@actTrigger} The skeljaskra takes 10 or more Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage from a single source. {@actResponse} The skeljaskra curls into a ball until the start of its next turn. While this effect lasts, the creature has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage and has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Echolocation
entries: The skin bat can't use its blindsight while {@condition deafened}.

trait.name: Hungry Dead Nature
entries: The skin bat doesn't require air or sleep.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the end of its next turn. On a success, the target can't be {@condition paralyzed} in this way by the skin bat again for 24 hours.

In addition, the skin bat attaches to the target. While attached, the skin bat can't attack, and at the start of each of the bat's turns, the target takes 5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage. The attached bat moves with the target whenever the target moves, requiring none of the bat's movement. It can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement on its turn. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the skin bat by succeeding on a {@dc 11} Strength check.

reaction.name: Attract Bats (1/Day)
entries: When the skin bat is reduced to below half its hp maximum while underground or outside at night, it releases a high-frequency cry similar to that of an injured bat, attracting other bats to it. On initiative count 20 of the next round, {@dice 1d6} bats arrive and aid the skin bat. These bats aren't under the skin bat's control, but they protect it to the best of their abilities, attacking those that harm the skin bat.

trait.name: Amorphous Form
entries: The skin crawler can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skin crawler makes two Claw attacks and one Bind attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Bind
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d8 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 12}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and the skin crawler can't Bind another target.

bonus.name: Crush and Consume
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 12}, one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the skin crawler. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the skin crawler regains an equal number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. If this damage kills the target, the skin crawler assumes its form. The skin crawler's game statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Supernaturally Sharp
entries: Skinweaver's tanning knives overcome slashing damage resistance (though not immunity).

trait.name: Shocking Visage
entries: Any humanoid that starts its turn within 30 feet of the skinweaver and can see it must make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition frightened} until the end of the creature's next turn). Whether a creature succeeds or fails, it cannot be affected by this ability again until it loses sight of the skinweaver (as when the skinweaver moves behind {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} or successfully hides).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skinweaver makes two tanning knife attacks or one tanning knife and one web whip attack.

action.name: Tanning Knife
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Web Whip
entries: {@atk rw} Attack: {@hit 4} to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target is pulled up to 20 feet toward the skinweaver.

action.name: Web Net {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. {@h}The target is {@condition restrained} by leathery webbing. As an action, the {@condition restrained} target can attempt a {@dc 13} Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; hp 10; vulnerability to slashing damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The skinwing has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the skinwing's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Disturbing Bleating
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the skinwing is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave wis} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Staggered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to the Disturbing Bleating of all skinwings for 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skinwing makes one Bite attack and one Talons attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Slashing damage.

trait.name: Broken Shell
entries: A creature that hits the skitterhaunt with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage.

trait.name: Ooze Nature
entries: The skitterhaunt doesn't require sleep.

trait.name: Vermin Encasement
entries: The creature within the vermin's shell is a shapeless ooze protected by the vermin's exoskeleton. When the skitterhaunt is reduced to 0 hp, the exoskeleton breaks, and the skitterhaunt ooze exits it. Once out of its exoskeleton, the ooze is Small, has an AC of 10, 10 hp, and a speed of 15 feet, and it can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. In addition, its only attack is a Slam that uses the same statistics as its Sting, except it deals bludgeoning damage instead of piercing damage. The skitterhaunt dies if it remains outside of a host for more than 24 hours. It can exit or enter a dead host's exoskeleton as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skitterhaunt makes one Mandibles attack and one Sting attack, or it makes two Sting attacks.

action.name: Mandibles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the creature is {@condition restrained}, and the skitterhaunt can't use its Mandibles on another target.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage.

action.name: Infest Vermin
entries: The skitterhaunt infests a Large or smaller Beast with an exoskeleton within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} until the skitterhaunt no longer infests it. Every 24 hours that elapse, the target must repeat the saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage, and its hp maximum is reduced by that amount. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest after the skitterhaunt no longer infests it. The target dies if this reduces its hp maximum to 0. The skitterhaunt then takes control of the body, dissolving the flesh and hiding within the exoskeleton. A target that succeeds on two consecutive saving throws forces the skitterhaunt out of its body and is immune to the skitterhaunt's Infest Vermin for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Acid Spray {@recharge}
entries: The skitterhaunt spits acid in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The skitterling doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they fly out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the start of their next turn. Creatures who are immune to poison damage or the {@condition poisoned} condition succeed on this saving throw automatically.

hp.special: 6 + six times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Claws)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} slashing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Destabilizing Attack (2 Ferocity)
entries: The skitterling makes a signature attack. On a hit, the target also has disadvantage on the next attack roll they make before the start of the skitterling's next turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Ankle Biter (5 Ferocity)
entries: The skitterling moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks and makes a signature attack. On a hit, if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are also knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition grappled} by the skitterling (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}).

action.name: 5th Level: In All Your Faces! (8 Ferocity)
entries: The skitterling chaotically bounces around, smearing toxin on each enemy within 5 feet of them.

Each target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 1d6 plus PB} poison damage and be {@condition blinded} until the end of the skitterling's next turn. A creature within 5 feet of a target {@condition blinded} in this way can use their action to wipe the toxin off them, ending the condition for that target.

bonus.name: Crafty Distraction (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: The skitterling flutters and screeches distractingly, allowing their caregiver an opportunity to reposition. The caregiver can use a reaction to move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Skitterswarm
languages: understands Common and Sylvan but can't speak

trait.name: Body Burrowing
entries: If the swarm can see the corpse of a Humanoid at the start of its turn, it must move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} toward the corpse. Once it enters the corpse's space, it must remain there for 1 hour, after which time the corpse's flesh putrefies.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny centipede. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Vile Vermin
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 12}, any creature that starts its turn in the swarm's space. {@actSaveFail} The target contracts a magical contagion. While afflicted, the target can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and it repeats the save when it finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} or when targeted by an effect that ends the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition, recovering from the contagion on a success. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to the Vile Vermin trait of all skitterswarms for 24 hours.

action.name: Infesting Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) Piercing damage, or 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Piercing damage if the swarm is {@status Bloodied|XPHB}. If the target is a creature, a centipede infests its body. While infested, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The infestation ends when the target regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or is targeted by an effect that ends the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The skogsra casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skogsra makes three Claw attacks. In place of one Claw attack, it can use Grasping Vines or Spellcasting.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Grasping Vines
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 15} One Medium or smaller creature the skogsra can see within 15 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target is pulled up to 10 feet toward the skogsra and has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}).

bonus.name: Hollow Trap
entries: The skogsra pulls a creature with the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition into its hollow body. While held in this way, the target isn't {@condition Grappled|XPHB} but has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, and it takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Slashing damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage at the start of each of its turns. If this damage reduces a Humanoid creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, that creature is considered {@variantrule Stable|XPHB} and has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition. This condition lasts for 12 hours or until the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} creature regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

The held creature has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects outside the skogsra. While holding a creature within its body, the skogsra can't pull another creature into its hollow.

If the skogsra takes 15 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate that creature, which falls in a space within 5 feet of the skogsra and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

If the skogsra dies, a held creature no longer has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} or {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

name: Skopps the Beast-Breaker
languages: understands Auran but doesn't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Skopps can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. Skopps lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement and takes no falling damage. Skopps cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

trait.name: Talons
entries: Skopps has advantage on ability checks made to climb any surface his talons could reasonably grip.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Skopps makes two attacks. He can then use his Beast Command action.

action.name: Barbed Whip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 3d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage. After a hit, Skopps may spend a bonus action to grapple the target (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Beast Command
entries: Skopps commands a beast or monstrosity within 80 feet of him that can hear him. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of Skopps until the end of his next turn. While the target is {@condition frightened} and Skopps is conscious, Skopps has a telepathic link with it, and can use this link to mentally control the creature. At the start of the controlled creature's turn, Skopps can decide what actions and movement the creature takes on its turn. The target takes only the actions Skopps commands, and doesn't do anything that Skopps doesn't allow it to do. Skopps can cause the creature to use a reaction at any time, but this requires Skopps to use his reaction as well. Each time the controlled creature takes damage, it makes a Wisdom saving throw against being {@condition frightened}. If the saving throw succeeds, this effect ends. Beast Command is a magical effect.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skretch makes two attacks.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Spittle
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 120/300 ft., one target directly underneath the skretch. {@h}15 ({@damage 6d4}) Acid damage.

action.name: Expel Waste {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 10-foot radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} directly beneath the skretch. {@actSaveFail} 20 ({@damage 8d4}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d4} Acid). Each time the target takes damage from this condition, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or gain one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The sky drake doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The sky drake has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sky drake makes one bite attack and one attack with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage and 5 ({@damage 2d4}) lightning damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage.

name: Sky King
languages: understands Common and Torum but can't speak

trait.name: Cloud Trail
entries: Wherever the Sky King flies, it creates a trail of giant fluffy white clouds in its wake.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the Sky King fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: Unless it wishes to be affected, the Sky King is immune to spells of 6th level or lower. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The Sky King's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: New Life
entries: When the Sky King dies, a new great beast is born into the world.

trait.name: Spirit of Obojima (1/Day)
entries: If the Sky King drops below 150 hit points, a giant storm begins to brew above and the oceans begin to become uneasy. For the next minute, creatures that touch the Sky King or hit it with a melee attack take 9 ({@damage 2d10}) lightning damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Sky King makes three attacks: two with its Chomp and one with its Tail.

action.name: Chomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d6 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Inspiring Presence
entries: Each creature of the Sky King's choice that is within 300 feet of the Sky King and aware of it gains inspiration and a flying speed of 30 feet for the next minute. Once a creature benefits from the Sky King's Inspiring Presence, it can't do so again until 7 days have passed.

legendary.name: Chomp
entries: The Sky King makes a Chomp attack.

legendary.name: Turbulent Shift (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The air or water surrounding the Sky King begins to spin violently.

Each creature, other than the Sky King, within 60 feet of the Sky King must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 28 ({@dice 8d6}) bludgeoning and is disoriented until the end of its next turn. A disoriented creature makes all ability checks and saving throws with disadvantage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't disoriented. Objects and structures in the area automatically take maximum damage from this effect.

legendary.name: Nullify (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The effects of all spells of 3rd level or lower within 120 feet of the Sky King are suspended (as if by the {@spell Antimagic Field} spell) until the start of the Sky King's next turn, at which point their magic returns.

trait.name: Divine Vitality
entries: Skymir's ability scores and HP maximum can't be reduced except by means of a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell.

trait.name: Icy Weapons
entries: Skymir's weapon attacks are magical. When he hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Cold damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Skymir has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Skymir fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Skymir casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 19}):

spellcasting.name: Frightful Presence
headerEntries: Skymir uses Spellcasting to cast {@spell Command|XPHB} or {@spell Fear|XPHB}. Skymir can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Skymir makes two attacks using Runesword or Arcane Sphere in any combination. He can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Runesword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Cold damage; the target is Marked with a glowing spectral rune until the end of Skymir's next turn.

action.name: Arcane Sphere
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 12} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 3d12 + 6}) Force damage, and the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls until the end of Skymir's next turn.

action.name: Icy Sweep {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16} Each creature in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on Skymir. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Slashing damage, 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Cold damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet away from Skymir and gains the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage and not pushed or knocked {@condition Prone|XPHB}.

bonus.name: Translocative Word
entries: Skymir speaks a word of power, and up to two creatures Marked by Skymir's Runesword are teleported to unoccupied spaces on the ground within 60 feet that he can see. The Mark on those targets then fades.

reaction.name: Protective Word
entries: {@actTrigger} Skymir is hit by an attack roll. {@actResponse} Skymir utters a word of power, adding 6 to his AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: Skymir makes a Runesword or Arcane Sphere attack. He can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

legendary.name: Life-Draining Word
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16} Skymir utters a word of power, targeting up to three creatures of his choice within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage, and Skymir regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the damage taken from each target. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Skymir can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The whale makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the whale. A swallowed creature has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the whale, and it takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) lightning damage at the start of each of the whale's turns.

If the whale takes 25 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the whale must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of the whale. If the whale dies, a swallowed creature can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) thunder damage.

trait.name: Heat Wave
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the Slagger takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) fire damage. If the creature is wearing metal armor or wielding metal weapons, the damage is doubled.

trait.name: Scorch
entries: Flammable objects ignite if they come within 15 feet of the Slagger.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Slagger uses its Cough. It then makes one Slam attack.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 6d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Spew Magma {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 30/90 ft., three targets. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d12 + 5}) fire damage. Regardless of whether the attacks hit or miss, the area within 5 feet of each target is covered in lava. The lava is considered {@quickref difficult terrain||3}, and a creature that starts its turn in the lava takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) fire damage. The lava cools and hardens after 1 minute, at which point it becomes harmless and is no longer {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.

action.name: Cough
entries: The Slagger coughs a sulfurous cloud in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 13 ({@damage 2d12}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Heated Weapons
entries: When the slaghund hits with a weapon attack, it deals an extra 2 ({@damage 1d4}) fire damage (included in attacks).

trait.name: Heatable Body
entries: As a bonus action, the slaghund can cause its body to heat up, or return to a normal warm temperature. While its body is heated in this way, a creature that touches the slaghund or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) fire damage.

trait.name: Reactionary Flame
entries: When the slaghund is surprised, it ignites everything flammable within 1 foot of it that isn't being carried or worn.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) fire damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) fire damage.

trait.name: Lethe
entries: When the demon's soul count is 0, they have advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and their Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, the demon must use their movement on each of their turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature they can sense with their soulsight, and then if they are able, they must use their action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. The demon can't act with any other purpose until they add 1 to their soul count.

trait.name: Soul Devourer
entries: When the demon reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the demon consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to the demon's soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The demon makes four attacks using Pincer, Sword, Javelin, or a combination of them. They can replace one of these attacks with a Tail Spike attack. The demon can burn 1 soul to make a fifth attack using Pincer, Sword, or Javelin.

action.name: Pincer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). While {@condition grappled}, the target is {@condition restrained}. The demon has six pincers, each of which can grapple a target or wield a weapon.

action.name: Sword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail Spike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

bonus.name: Dive Deep (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: The demon takes the Disengage action and gains a burrowing speed equal to their walking speed until the end of their next turn.

trait.name: Puppet
entries: While in a dreamholder's lair, the sleepwalker sees what the dreamholder wants it to. A creature can use its action to make a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|PHB}) check contested by the dreamholder's Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|PHB}) to help the sleepwalker see through the illusion. On a success, the sleepwalker sees through the dreamholder's illusions and can't be beguiled by the dreamholder for the next 24 hours. On a failure, the sleepwalker believes the creature to be a trick, and any further attempts made to persuade it by that creature automatically fail for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sleepwalker makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Phantom Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) psychic damage.

trait.name: Preternatural Balance
entries: Sleipnirspringr automatically succeed on saving throws against the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, and they cannot be Pushed or Pulled through nonmagical means.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The horse makes 3 Hoof attacks.

action.name: Hoof
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Trickster Spawn
entries: The horse can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to take the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Dodge|XPHB} action.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The slicar has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour.

spellcasting.name: Cute
headerEntries: The slime is adorable. It can cast {@spell charm person} once per day without material components.

trait.name: Adorable Monstrosity
entries: The slime has advantage on Charisma ({@skill Performance}) and Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) checks.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Mucus
entries: When the slime is hit by a melee attack, the attacker must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or their weapon becomes stuck in the slime. The weapon can be wrenched out by using an action to make a {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, freeing the weapon on a success. All weapons stuck in the slime can be retrieved once the slime is slain.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Slime King's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 16}). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The Slime King has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks and on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition stunned}, and knocked {@condition unconscious}.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: While the Slime King sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

trait.name: Wallow in Waste
entries: The Slime King is immune to the effects of noxious gasses, such as those caused by the {@spell stinking cloud} and {@spell cloudkill} spells.

trait.name: Watchful Skulls
entries: The Slime King has two extra reactions that can be used only for {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Slime King makes three Bite attacks. It can replace one of its Bite attacks with a Slimeforged Blade attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Slimeforged Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) slashing damage. If the Slime King attacks a creature and rolls a 20 on its attack roll, the target is {@condition paralyzed} until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Bite
entries: The Slime King makes a Bite attack.

legendary.name: Slimecasting
entries: The Slime King casts {@spell acid splash} or {@spell web}.

legendary.name: Spread the Curse (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The Slime King sends out a spray of bone and slime. All enemies in a 10-foot radius centered on the Slime King must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The slime king can then cast {@spell bestow curse} on any creature that failed its saving throw.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
