entries: The slimesworn cultist is {@condition incapacitated} while in the area of an {@spell antimagic field}. If targeted by {@spell dispel magic}, the slimesworn cultist must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute.

trait.name: Dead Accurate
entries: If the slimesworn cultist is motionless, it looks merely like a dead mage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The slimesworn cultist makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Fabric Tendrils
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. {@h}The creature is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). Until this grapple ends, the target is also {@condition restrained} and must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw at the start of each its turns or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

name: Slip Tideswell
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Slip can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. Slip can't glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

trait.name: Drop Attack
entries: Slip can make an attack during his glide. If he does so, he deals an extra {@dice 1d8} points of damage.

trait.name: Patient
entries: When Slip takes a {@action Ready||readied action}, he has advantage on the first attack roll, skill check, or ability check he makes as a part of that action.

trait.name: Talons
entries: Slip has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks to climb any surface his talons could reasonably grip.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Riposte
entries: Slip reduces the damage dealt by one melee attack that would hit him by {@dice 1d8}, and deals that much piercing damage to his attacker. Slip must see the attacker and be wielding a rapier.

trait.name: Speed Burst
entries: Provided it isn't moving over difficult terrain, the sloth galloper can use a bonus action to take the Dash action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sloth galloper makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Elemental Nature
entries: The slow storm doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Eye of the Storm
entries: The slow storm is surrounded by a 15-foot-radius wind storm. The storm imposes disadvantage on ranged weapon attack rolls and Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks based on sight or hearing within the area. The winds extinguish open flames and disperse fog. A flying creature in the storm must land at the end of its turn or fall. Each creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage. The storm's area is difficult terrain for any creature other than the slow storm.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The slow storm makes three Slam attacks or four Lightning Bolt attacks. If two Slam attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be wracked with pain for 1 minute. While the target is wracked with pain, minute bits of electricity dance within its body, and the target takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) lightning damage for every 5 feet it moves. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage.

action.name: Lightning Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) lightning damage.

action.name: Static Shock {@recharge 5}
entries: The slow storm releases built-up electricity in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 54 ({@damage 12d8}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is also {@condition stunned} for 1 minute. A {@condition stunned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Enervating Aura
entries: Any creature other than an undead that starts its turn within 30 feet of the phantom must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target falls {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute. Whenever an {@condition unconscious} target takes damage or another creature uses an action to try to shake it awake, the target can make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Ethereal Form
entries: While on the Material Plane, attack rolls against the phantom are made with disadvantage unless the phantom is {@condition incapacitated}. In addition, the phantom can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the phantom fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The phantom has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Spectral Enthrallment
entries: Whenever the phantom reduces a humanoid to 0 hit points, the target dies and a specter rises from its corpse. The specter acts immediately after the phantom's initiative count and is under the phantom's control for 1 hour, after which time it vanishes.

trait.name: Turn Immunity
entries: The phantom is immune to effects that turn undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The phantom makes two Life Drain attacks. It can use its Dream Eater in place of one attack.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}36 ({@damage 8d8}) necrotic damage, and the target must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken, and on a successful save, its hit point maximum is reduced by half that amount. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The creature dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

action.name: Dream Eater
entries: The phantom taps into the nightmares of one creature it touches. The target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or be subjected to the effects of the {@spell phantasmal killer} spell for 1 minute (this effect doesn't require the phantom's {@status concentration}). The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. An {@condition unconscious} creature makes its saving throws against this effect with disadvantage, and whenever it takes damage from this effect, the phantom regains hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

bonus.name: Ethereal Jaunt
entries: As a bonus action, the phantom can magically shift from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane, or vice versa.

legendary.name: Ghostly Swipe
entries: The phantom makes a Life Drain attack. Before or after the attack, it can move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Ethereal Banishment (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The phantom casts {@spell banishment} (save {@dc 20}), requiring only somatic components and targeting a creature it can see within 5 feet of it. If the target is native to and currently on the Material Plane, it is banished to its corresponding location on the Ethereal Plane, instead of a harmless demiplane. If the target takes any damage while there, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the spell on a success. If the phantom concentrates on the spell for its full duration and the target is in the phantom's Enervating Aura when the spell ends, the target doesn't return.

legendary.name: Devour Dreams (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The phantom causes a wave of dread to erupt from a point it chooses within 120 feet of it. Each creature within 30 feet of that point is subjected to the phantom's Dream Eater effect.

name: Smaragdine Golem

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The golem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Enchanted Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical. When the golem hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 5d8} force damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Vessel
entries: When the smaragdine golem counters or ends a spell with Absorb Spell, it holds the spell's magical energy within its body and becomes Charged for 1 minute. While Charged, the golem sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The smaragdine golem makes two Slam attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Release Spell.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage plus 22 ({@damage 5d8}) force damage.

action.name: Release Spell (Recharge Special)
entries: The smaragdine golem releases an absorbed spell's energy in a green burst centered on a point the golem can see within 60 feet of it. Each creature, other than the smaragdine golem, within 5 feet of that point per level of the absorbed spell must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) force damage per level of the absorbed spell and is {@condition incapacitated} until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition incapacitated}. The golem can use this action only if it is Charged (see the Magic Vessel trait).

reaction.name: Absorb Spell
entries: When a creature the smaragdine golem can see within 30 feet of it casts a spell, the golem can absorb the spell's energy, countering it. This works like the {@spell counterspell} spell, except the golem must always make a spellcasting ability check, no matter the spell's level. Alternatively, when a creature the golem can see within 30 feet of the golem starts its turn while under the effects of a spell, such as bless or heroes' feast, the golem can absorb the spell's magic, ending the effect. In either case, the golem's ability check for this is +10. If it successfully counters or ends the spell, it becomes Charged (see the Magic Vessel trait). The golem can't use Absorb Spell while it is Charged.

trait.name: Aversion to Wind
entries: If the elemental starts its turn within a strong wind (such as one created by the {@spell Gust of Wind|XPHB} spell), it makes a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the elemental has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the end of its turn.

trait.name: Smoke Form
entries: The elemental can enter a creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two Smoky Tendril attacks.

action.name: Smoky Tendril
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 15 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Asphyxiate {@recharge 4}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 12}, one creature in the elemental's space. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Fire damage, and the target gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level. All {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} levels gained from this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} are removed after 1 minute.

trait.name: Evasive
entries: Snap adds her Intelligence modifier as a bonus to his Dexterity saving throws (already included in stat block).

trait.name: Hunter's Eye (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, Snap can add {@dice 1d8} to her next attack or damage roll made with a ranged weapon.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Snap makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Snap adds 2 to her AC against one melee attack that would hit her. To do so, Snap must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: Snapjaw can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Snapjaw makes three attacks: two with its bite and one with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}31 ({@damage 3d10 + 15}) piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and Snapjaw can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target not {@condition grappled} by Snapjaw. {@h}24 ({@damage 2d8 + 15}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Cunning Action
entries: Snapshadow can take the {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, or {@action Hide} action as a bonus action.

trait.name: Lone Duelist
entries: When fighting a single creature, so long as there are no creatures within 5 feet of her or her opponent, Snapshadow has advantage on her attack rolls.

trait.name: Sneak Attack
entries: Once per turn, Snapshadow deals an extra 10 {@damage 3d6} damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Snapshadow that isn't {@condition incapacitated} and Snapshadow doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: Snapshadow's long jump is 40 feet, and her base high jump is 20 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Snapshadow makes three attacks: two with her cane rapier and one with her dagger.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Riposte
entries: Snapshadow reduces the damage dealt by one melee attack that would hit her by {@dice 1d8}, and deals that much piercing damage to her attacker. Snapshadow must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks not made with cold iron weapons

trait.name: Ice Climb
entries: When climbing on ice, the Snow Queen has a climbing speed of 20 feet, and she can climb difficult surfaces made of ice and snow, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Icy Weapons
entries: The Snow Queen's weapon attacks are magical. When she hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 2d6} cold damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Snow Queen fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Snowsight
entries: The Snow Queen can see through areas obscured by snowfall, sleet, rain, and other wintry precipitation without penalty.

trait.name: Snow Walk
entries: The Snow Queen can move across icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost her extra movement.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Snow Queen makes two Claw or Ice Bolt attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Ice Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage. The target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Cold Snap {@recharge 5}
entries: The Snow Queen causes the temperature around her to drop dramatically. Each creature without 30 feet of the Snow Queen must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 42 ({@damage 12d6}) cold damage and suffers one level of {@condition exhaustion}. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and doesn't suffer {@condition exhaustion}. A creature that is immune to cold damage doesn't suffer {@condition exhaustion}, even if it fails the saving throw. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more is {@condition petrified} in ice for 1 minute. A {@condition petrified} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A {@condition petrified} creature that takes fire damage has advantage on the saving throw to end the effect.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The Snow Queen makes a Claw or Ice Bolt attack.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The Snow Queen moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Snowblind
entries: One creature the Snow Queen can see within 120 feet of her must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded} by swirling snow until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Wintry Swirl (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the Snow Queen must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or have vulnerability to cold damage until the end of its next turn. A creature with immunity to cold damage that fails this saving throw instead loses its immunity to cold damage but isn't vulnerable to it.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

trait.name: Inscrutable
entries: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sphinx makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft, {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Slashing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Cold damage.

bonus.name: Freezing Glare {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail 1} The target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, ending the effect on itself on a success. {@actSaveFail 2} The target has the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition instead of the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition, and is turned into an ice statue.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The snowball spirits make two pelt attacks.

action.name: Pelt
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 20/40 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is at least one size smaller than the snowball spirits, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be whelmed by the snowball spirits. A whelmed creature is considered {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}) and is carried with the snowball spirits when they move. A creature within 5 feet of the spirits can pull a whelmed creature out of them by taking an action to make a {@dc 14} Strength check, freeing the creature on a success.
The snowball spirit can have no more than one creature whelmed at a time, unless it reaches the Huge size, at which point it can whelm up to three creatures at a time.

action.name: Snowball
entries: Whenever the snowball spirits take the {@action Dash} action, they can make a slam attack as part of that action. Alternatively, if they are in snowy terrain, they can choose to absorb the snow during the movement, growing by one size and regaining 10 hit points.

trait.name: Natural Camouflage
entries: The snowfox has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made in snowy terrain or cloudy skies.

trait.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The snowfox doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they leave an enemy's reach.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 piercing damage, and the snowfox attaches to the target. While attached, the snowfox's Claw attacks against that target are made with advantage, and the snowfox can't attack another target. The target or a creature who can reach them can detach the snowfox as an action with a successful {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. The snowfox can detach by spending 5 feet of their movement.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 slashing damage.

bonus.name: Burrow
entries: The snowfox burrows up to 5 feet in snow.

bonus.name: Listen
entries: The snowfox makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: If the soda slime is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the soda slime move or act, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to discern that the soda slime isn't an ordinary soda can.

trait.name: Soda Pop
entries: When a soda slime is reduced to 0 hit points, each creature within 10 feet of the soda slime must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or take 6 ({@damage 1d10 + 1}) force damage as it explodes in a fizzy pop.

trait.name: Sticky Nature
entries: The soda slime can occupy the same space as another creature. While in the same space as the soda slime, a creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity checks. When a creature leaves the soda slime's space, it must first make a {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, carrying the slime with it on a failure.

action.name: Smack
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage.

reaction.name: Sticky Tendril
entries: When a hostile creature's movement provokes an opportunity attack from the soda slime, it forces the provoking creature to make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, causing it to fall {@condition prone} on a failed save.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The son of Fenris has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Divine Weapons
entries: The son of Fenris's weapon attacks are magical. When the son hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 3d6} necrotic damage or {@damage 3d6} radiant damage (included in the attack), the son's choice.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The son of Fenris makes one Bite attack and two Slam attacks, or it makes four Divine Bolt attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage or ({@damage 3d6}) radiant damage (the son's choice). If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the son of Fenris. A swallowed creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside the son, and it takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the son's turns. The son can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If the son takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the son must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the swallowed creature, which falls {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of the son. If the son dies, the swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 1d10 + 8}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage or ({@damage 3d6}) radiant damage (the son's choice).

action.name: Divine Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 8} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) necrotic damage or ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) radiant damage (the son's choice).

action.name: Snake Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The two snake tongues of the son of Fenris each exhale poison in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide, resulting in two lines. Each creature in a line must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 45 ({@damage 10d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the lines overlap, each creature in the overlapping lines must make one saving throw with disadvantage against only one of the lines rather than one saving throw for each line.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The sorcerer is a 7th-level spellcaster and can cast the following spells, using Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Metamagic
entries: The sorcerer has 7 sorcery points and regains all expended sorcery points when it finishes a long rest. It can spend these points in the following ways:

items.name: Quickened Spell
items.entry: When the sorcerer casts a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, it can spend 2 sorcery points to change the casting time to 1 bonus action for this casting.

items.name: Twinned Spell
items.entry: When the sorcerer casts a spell that targets only one creature and doesn't have a range of self, it can spend a number of sorcery points equal to the spell's level to target a second creature in range with the same spell (1 sorcery point if the spell is a cantrip).

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Magnetobolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: {@hit 5} to hit, range 90 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) force damage and the creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. A creature made of ferrous metal or wearing ferrous armour has disadvantage on this saving throw.

action.name: Shocking Grasp
entries: Melee Spell Attack: {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage and the creature can't take reactions until the start of its next turn. The sorcerer has advantage on the attack roll if the target is wearing armour made of metal.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The soul eater has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Soul Sense
entries: The soul eater can pinpoint the location of creatures that have souls within 60 feet of it and can sense the general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The soul eater makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Hasten Consumption {@recharge 5}
entries: The soul eater emits a wave of psychic energy to hasten the demise of nearby creatures, bringing them one step closer to having their souls consumed. Each creature within 20 feet of the soul eater must make a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw, taking 31 ({@damage 9d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature reduced to below half its hp maximum by this effect has disadvantage on the saving throw against the soul eater's Soul Drain for 1 minute.

reaction.name: Soul Drain
entries: When the soul eater reduces a target to 0 hp, the soul eater consumes that creature's soul. The victim must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or immediately die as the soul eater consumes its soul. A creature killed in this way can be restored to life only by means of a true resurrection or a {@spell wish} spell. If the soul eater is killed within 120 feet of the body of a soul it consumed and the victim has been dead for no longer than 1 minute, the victim's soul returns to the body and returns to life, {@condition unconscious} and stable with 0 hp.

trait.name: Fiendish Adacity
entries: The handler's AC includes its Charisma modifier.

trait.name: Fiendish Fury
entries: The handler deals an extra 5 ({@damage 1d10}) damage when it hits with a melee weapon attack (included in the attacks).

trait.name: Fiendish Vigour
entries: The handler gains 5 temporary hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the handler takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the handler's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The handler makes two attacks with its Morningstar or Tommybow.

action.name: Morningstar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Brittlebone Splinterspray Tommybow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30/120 ft., ., two creatures within 5 feet of each other. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) piercing damage. Reload (3).

reaction.name: Guardian
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the handler is the target of an attack, the handler can choose to become the target of the attack instead of the original target.

trait.name: Corpse Fuel
entries: If the stoker can see a corpse at the start of its turn, it must move as far as possible to enter the corpse's space and use its action to incinerate the corpse. Medium or smaller corpses are reduced to ash, and larger corpses are partially incinerated and decrease one size.

trait.name: Fire Form
entries: The stoker can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so, and it can enter a creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Fire damage.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The stoker sheds {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} in a 30-foot radius.

trait.name: Soul Burn
entries: At the end of each of the stoker's turns, each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the stoker takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stoker makes two Sear attacks.

action.name: Sear
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Fire damage, and the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll it makes before the start of the elemental's next turn.

bonus.name: Spectral Steam {@recharge 5}
entries: The stoker unleashes a blast of glowing spectral steam. {@actSave dex} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} For 1 minute, the target sheds {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Reckless Hate
entries: At the start of its turn, the Southerner Champion can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Southerner Champion makes two melee attacks, or one melee attack and one ranged attack.

action.name: Battle Axe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage, or 7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

trait.name: Reckless Hate
entries: At the start of its turn, the Southerner Raider can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Axe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage, or 6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) slashing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage, or 6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ooze has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Merge
entries: The ooze and one other Sovereign Ooze Lord within 5 feet of it merge over the course of a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}. When both oozes finish the {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, they merge into a Sovereign Ooze Monarch.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze makes three Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 10 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Force damage.

action.name: Arcane Glob {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point the ooze can see within 90 feet. {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Force damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The ooze shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or smaller Humanoid or Beast while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

bonus.name: Transformation (1/Day)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15}, one creature the ooze can see within 5 feet that has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. {@actSaveFail} The target dies. After one minute, the target transforms into a Sovereign Ooze Vassal, unless it is restored to life or the ooze is destroyed before a minute passes. Only a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell can reverse this transformation.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ooze has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze makes three Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 13}, reach 10 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Force damage.

action.name: Arcane Glob {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 20}, each creature in a 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point the ooze can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 45 ({@damage 10d8}) Force damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The ooze shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or smaller Humanoid or Beast while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

bonus.name: Transformation (1/Day)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 20}, one creature the ooze can see within 5 feet that has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. {@actSaveFail} The target dies. After one minute, the target transforms into a Sovereign Ooze Vassal unless it is restored to life or the ooze is destroyed before a minute passes. Only a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell can reverse this transformation.

legendary.name: Arcane Spray
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 20}, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the ooze. {@actSaveFail} 16 ({@damage 3d10}) Force damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The ooze can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Manipulate
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 20}, one creature the ooze can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 26 ({@damage 4d12}) Psychic damage, and if able, the target takes a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} in a horizontal direction of the ooze's choice, following the safest route. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The ooze can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Strike
entries: The ooze moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and makes one Slam attack.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

trait.name: Merge
entries: The ooze and one other Sovereign Ooze Vassal within 5 feet of it merge over the course of a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}. When both oozes finish the {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, they merge into a Sovereign Ooze Lord.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Arcane Glob {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point the ooze can see within 90 feet. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Force damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Damage Dispersal
entries: {@actTrigger} The ooze takes damage from a spell or magical effect. {@actResponse} The sovereign ooze halves the damage it takes (round down), and each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the ooze takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Force damage.

trait.name: Elemental Nature
entries: The spark doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spark makes three Electric Touch attacks.

action.name: Electric Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d8 + 3}) lightning damage.

action.name: Inhabit
entries: One Humanoid that the spark can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or be inhabited by the spark. The spark then disappears, fusing with the target's nervous system, and the target is {@condition incapacitated} and loses control of its body. The spark now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The spark can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, immunity to being {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition petrified}, or {@condition unconscious}, and its Electric Touch attack. It otherwise uses the inhabited target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.

Every 24 hours that elapse, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage, and its hp maximum is reduced by that amount. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest after the spark no longer inhabits it. The target dies if this reduces its hp maximum to 0. Each time the spark makes an Electric Touch attack and at the end of each long rest, the target can make a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw, expelling the spark on a success. Alternatively, the spark can exit the target's body as a bonus action or can be forced out by an effect like the {@spell protection from energy} spell. The target is immune to this spark's Inhabit for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the spark is expelled.

A willing target retains full function of its body, doesn't need to make a Constitution saving throw every 24 hours, has immunity to lightning damage, and can communicate with the spark telepathically. If the spark inhabits a willing target, it takes its turn at the same time as the target, but the spark can attack only as a reaction to a creature moving within 5 feet of the target or as a reaction to the target attacking a creature within 5 feet of it.

trait.name: Command Vermin
entries: The spawn of Akyishigal can command any Beast with an Intelligence of 2 or lower within 30 feet of it that isn't under the magical control of another creature, provided the Beast is insectoid and doesn't have a Challenge Rating higher than the spawn's. The Beast obeys the spawn's commands to the best of its ability, heedless of its own safety.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The spawn of Akyishigal has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spawn makes one Bite attack and two Sting attacks. It can replace its Bite attack with a use of Swarming Cough, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Swarming Cough (3/Day)
entries: The spawn belches forth a swarm of insects. The swarm is an ally of the spawn, obeys its spoken commands, and takes its turn immediately after the spawn's. The swarm remains for 1 minute, until the spawn dies, or until the spawn dismisses it as a bonus action. The spawn can have no more than two swarms under its control at a time.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the spawn's darkvision.

trait.name: Hive Bond
entries: While the spawn is within 60 feet of at least one member of its hive, it has advantage on initiative rolls and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks. The spawn can't be surprised if at least one other member is aware of the danger and within 300 feet of it.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The spawn has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Speak with Insects
entries: The spawn can communicate with insects as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spawn of Arbeyach makes one Bite attack and one Stinger attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) poison damage.

action.name: Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. A {@condition poisoned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Children of Arbeyach (1/Day)
entries: The spawn of Arbeyach magically calls {@dice 1d4} swarms of insects. The called creatures arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of the spawn and obeying its spoken commands. The insects remain for 1 hour, until the spawn dies, or until the spawn dismisses them as a bonus action.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the skull remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary humanoid skull.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Disparaging Remarks
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 12}, one creature the skull can see within 10 feet. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Psychic damage, and the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Guiding Words
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the skull can see within 10 feet makes an ability check. {@actResponse} The target can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the result to that check.

name: Specter
languages: the languages they knew in life

trait.name: Corrupting Phasing
entries: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The specter takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if they end their turn inside an object. A creature takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) necrotic damage the first time a specter passes through them on a turn.

action.name: Decaying Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or spend 1 Hit Die without any benefit. If the target has no Hit Dice to spend, they drop to 0 hit points instead.
If a Humanoid dies within 1 minute of being hit by this attack, their spirit rises as a specter under the GM's control in an unoccupied space nearest to where that Humanoid died.

bonus.name: Hidden Movement {@recharge 5}
entries: The specter turns {@condition invisible} and then moves up to their speed. At the end of this movement, the invisibility ends.

name: Spectral Guardian
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Disgrace Bound
entries: The spectral guardian is bound to a tomb, castle ruins, or other place related to the disgrace in life that caused it to rise as a spectral guardian in death. If the guardian starts its turn more than 1 mile from its bound location, it loses its Spectral Blade action until it returns to the region. If it remains outside the region, it automatically teleports back to its bound location after 24 hours, regardless of distance.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The spectral guardian can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The spectral guardian doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spectral guardian makes two Spectral Blade attacks. If both attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have its hp maximum reduced by the total necrotic damage dealt by both attacks.

action.name: Spectral Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spiritual Sight
entries: The spirit can see 60 feet into the Spirit Realm (Ethereal Plane) when it is on the Physical Realm, and vice versa.

action.name: Spectral Pass
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) necrotic damage. Etherealness. The spirit enters the Spirit Realm (Ethereal Plane) from the Physical Realm, or vice versa. It is visible on the Physical Realm while it is in the Spirit Realm, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The spirit enters the Spirit Realm (Ethereal Plane) from the Physical Realm, or vice versa. It is visible on the Physical Realm while it is in the Spirit Realm, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

action.name: Incorporeal Transfer
entries: While holding an item, the spirit can cause it to become incorporeal, allowing it to pass through other objects and creatures. If the spirit lets go of the item while inside of an object or creature, the item is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space outside of the object or creature.

trait.name: Aquatic Camouflage
entries: The leech has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks made to hide in aquatic terrain.

trait.name: Spell Glands
entries: The leech has a spell gland, which can store up to ten levels of spells. When encountered, roll {@dice 1d10} to determine how many spell levels it has stored.

action.name: Attach
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 0 ft. {@h}The leech attaches to the target. While attached, the leech doesn't attack, and moves with the target, using none of the leech's movement. The leech can detach itself using 5 feet of movement, and detaches immediately if its blood bags are filled or if the target dies.

A creature within 5 feet can take an action to detach the leech with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) check. {@actSaveFail} The leech is still detached, but the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 2d4}). Failure by 5 or More: The leech isn't detached and the target takes 8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Spell Drain
entries: The leech can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} only when it is attached to a creature. The attached creature is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave int} {@dc 13}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Bewildered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of the leech's next turn. If the target has spell slots, the leech drains one randomly determined spell slot which can be no higher than level 3. It then fills its spell glands with the same number of spell levels.

bonus.name: Arcane Transfusion
entries: The leech can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} only when it is attached to a creature and has at least one level worth of spells in its Spell Glands. The leech empties any number of spell levels from its Spell Glands, and the creature it is attached to regains an equal number of spell levels worth of spell slots.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The spider of Leng casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Eldritch Understanding
entries: The spider of Leng can read and use any spell scroll or magic item, ignoring all class, race, and level requirements.

trait.name: Poisonous Blood
entries: A creature that hits the spider of Leng with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) poison damage.

trait.name: Poisonous Death
entries: When the spider of Leng dies, the poisonous blood in its body vaporizes, forming a cloud in the spider's space until initiative count 20 on the next round. Each creature within 5 feet of the spider and each creature that enters the cloud for the first time on a turn must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spider of Leng makes two Claw attacks and one Staff of Leng attack, or it makes three Spit Venom attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) poison damage.

action.name: Staff of Leng
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of is next turn.

action.name: Spit Venom
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d8 + 3}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} and {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Poisonous Riposte
entries: The spider of Leng adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the spider must see the attacker. If this effect causes the attack to miss, the attacker takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) poison damage.

name: Spider Thief
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The spider thief doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The spider thief is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The spider thief has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spider thief makes one Hooked Wire attack and one Sickle Claw attack, or it makes two Sickle Claw attacks.

action.name: Sickle Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d8 + 1}) slashing damage.

action.name: Hooked Wire
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 15/30 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 2d4 + 1}) piercing damage, and the spider thief pulls itself in a straight line up to 25 feet toward the target, stopping in the nearest unoccupied space to the target. When the spider thief moves in this way, opportunity attacks against it have disadvantage.

bonus.name: Wire Jump
entries: The spider thief throws a hooked wire at a point on a surface, such as the ground or wall, it can see within 30 feet of it, attaching one end of the wire to that point. It then reels in the wire, pulling itself to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of that point. It can bring along objects and willing creatures as long as their total weight doesn't exceed 100 pounds. When the spider moves in this way, opportunity attacks against it have disadvantage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The dreg climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Spiny Body
entries: Any creature grappling the dreg or {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by it takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Piercing damage at the end of that creature's turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dreg makes three Spike attacks.

action.name: Spike
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft., or range 20/60 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage. Critical {@h}{@actSave con} {@dc 10}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The spinosaurus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Reptilian Affinity
entries: The spinosaurus never willingly attacks a reptilian Humanoid, such as a lizardfolk or dragonborn, unless attacked first. If magically forced to attack such a creature, the spinosaurus has disadvantage on attack rolls against it. This trait doesn't function if the spinosaurus's rider or tamer directs it to attack.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The spinosaurus deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spinosaurus makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 4d12 + 7}) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the spinosaurus can't Bite another target.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the spinosaurus' choice that is within 120 feet of the spinosaurus and aware of it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the spinosaurus's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The spinosaurus moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Roar
entries: The spinosaurus uses Frightful Presence.

legendary.name: Tail Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The spinosaurus makes one Tail attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The scholar is an 8th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following wizard spells prepared:

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The student is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following wizard spells prepared:

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft ., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Energized Body
entries: A creature wearing metal or wielding a metal weapon that touches the spire walker or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) lightning damage.

action.name: Lightning Burst
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) lightning damage, and each creature, other than the target, within 10 feet of the target must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The spire walker magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the spire walker wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

bonus.name: Steeple Step
entries: The spire walker teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. The destination must be on the steeple of a building, mast of a ship, corner of a rooftop, or similar narrow point or feature.

walk.condition: (0 ft., Flying 30 ft. in flying form)

action.name: Smack
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) bludgeoning damage.

variant.name: Here is a list of abilities a Spirit can have
entries: Some of these abilities may have an impact on the Spirit's Challenge Rating.

items.name: Commune with Animals
entries: The Spirit can communicate with beasts as if they shared a language.

items.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The Spirit can see 60 feet into the Spirit Realm (Ethereal Plane) when it is on the Physical Realm, and vice versa.

items.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The Spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

items.name: Invisible
entries: The Spirit is always {@condition Invisible}.

items.name: Magical
entries: The Spirit knows two cantrips and one 1st-level spell, which it can cast at will.

items.name: Ocular Prowess
entries: The Spirit has {@sense Truesight} out to a range of 30 feet.

items.name: Shift
entries: The Spirit can enter the Spirit Realm (Ethereal Plane) from the Physical Realm, or vice versa.

items.name: Action: Spectral Pass
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 ({@damage 4d8}) force or necrotic damage.

name: Spirit of Dendallen
languages: Common plus three other languages; telepathy 120 ft.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The spirit casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 21}):

spellcasting.name: Protective Magic
headerEntries: The spirit casts {@spell Counterspell|XPHB} or {@spell Shield|XPHB} in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

trait.name: Attuned Thrall
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 21}, the creature that attuned to three Remnants of Dendallen (if the creature has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition or can't be possessed, it can still be affected, but it makes its saves against this effect with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}). {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition, becoming the host to the Spirit of Dendallen. On the spirit's turn, it can issue verbal or telepathic commands to the target (no action required). The target does its best to obey on its turn. If it completes an order and doesn't receive further direction from the spirit, it acts and moves as it likes, seemingly unaware of or unbothered by the presence of the spirit. The spirit can also command the target to take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} but must take its own {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to do so.

The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect and dismissing the spirit on a success. The DC for this save decreases when the spirit drops to certain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} thresholds, reducing by 1 at 150 HP ({@dc 20}), 100 HP ({@dc 19}), and 50 HP ({@dc 18}).

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The spirit can't shape-shift.

trait.name: Incorporeal Tether
entries: The spirit can't move on its own. Instead, as the spirit's host moves, the spirit is moved with it (remaining centered on the host), even through other creatures and objects. The spirit can occupy another creature's space and vice versa.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the spirit fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The spirit has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Persistent Tendrils
entries: If the spirit doesn't have any tendrils at the end of its turn, one Tendril of Dendallen is created, as if by the Create Tendrils action.

trait.name: Unstable Conduit
entries: If the spirit's host dies, the spirit is destroyed in an explosion of necromantic energy, and the host is disintegrated into gray dust, leaving behind any Remnants of Dendallen it was wearing or carrying. The host can be revived only by a {@spell True Resurrection|XPHB} or a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell. {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the host. {@actSaveFail} 33 ({@damage 6d10}) Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spirit makes two attacks, using Slam or Decaying Ray in any combination. It can (A) replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast {@spell Magic Missile|XPHB} (level 2 version) or (B) replace two attacks with a use of Spellcasting to cast {@spell Blight|XPHB} (level 9 version).

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 13}, reach 10 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Force damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Acid damage.

action.name: Decaying Ray
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 13}, range 120 ft. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 21}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, taking 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Necrotic damage on a failure or losing all {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} levels caused by this effect on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

action.name: Create Tendrils {@recharge 5}
entries: The spirit creates {@dice 1d4 + 2} Tendrils of Dendallen, each appearing in unoccupied spaces the spirit can see on solid surfaces within 150 feet of itself. The spirit can have no more than six tendrils at a time. The tendrils take their turns immediately after the spirit on the same {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, and they obey the spirit. A tendril remains for 1 minute or until it's reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

legendary.name: Accursed Magic
entries: The spirit uses Spellcasting to cast {@spell Bestow Curse|XPHB}, {@spell False Life|XPHB} (level 3 version), or {@spell Hold Person|XPHB} (level 3 version). The spirit can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Command Tendrils
entries: Up to two Tendrils of Dendallen the spirit can see each either make a Grasp attack or use {@spell Teleport|XPHB}. The spirit can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Sweep
entries: The spirit sweeps out with its massive arm. {@actSave dex} {@dc 19}, each creature in a 20-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 23 ({@damage 3d12 + 4}) Force damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet away from the spirit and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Cunning Action
entries: On each of his turns, Spleck can use a bonus action to take the {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, or {@action Hide} action.

trait.name: Forest Cunning
entries: Speck has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made in forests and jungle environments.

trait.name: Purifying Skin
entries: Speck has advantage on saving throws made to resist being {@condition poisoned} or infected with a disease.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: Spleck deals an extra 7 {@damage 2d6} damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Spleck that isn't incapacitated and Spleck doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Sticky Grip
entries: Spleck can climb upside down or on difficult surfaces without making ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Spleck makes two melee attacks with his dagger.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) poison damage.

action.name: Sticky Tongue
entries: Spleck extends his long sticky tongue toward an object he can see within 20 feet of him. His sticky tongue grabs the object and pulls it to him in a straight line. If Spleck has free hands, he can immediately wield the object; otherwise, it drops at his feet. If the object is being held or carried by a creature, Spleck and that creature make opposed Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks. If the creature wins, it maintains its hold on the object. Alternatively, if Spleck targets an object that is heavier than himself, he is instead pulled toward the object, provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks} as normal.

reaction.name: Poison Skin (Recharges on a Short or Long Rest)
entries: When a creature touches Spleck, hits him with a melee weapon attack using natural weapons, or {@action grapple||grapples} him, Spleck can cause that creature to make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage and becomes {@condition poisoned} until the end of Spleck's next turn. On a success, the target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: The spythronar sac appears to be a tangled ball of string, twigs, and dirt. Someone who can see the sac can identify it with a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana} or {@skill Nature}) check.

trait.name: Fragile
entries: A creature who enters the spythronar sac's space must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw, or the sac is destroyed.

trait.name: Lightning Release
entries: When the spythronar sac is destroyed, it releases lightning in a 10-foot radius. A creature who destroyed the sac by entering its space receives no saving throw. Other creatures in that area must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or take 4 ({@damage 1d8}) lightning damage. Each spythronar swarm and web in this area instead gains advantage on its next attack roll.

trait.name: Shocking Birth
entries: When a spythronar sac takes lightning damage from a source other than another spythronar, it hatches, transforming into a spythronar swarm with half the normal hit points. This swarm rolls initiative and enters the combat.

trait.name: Furtive
entries: The spythronar swarm can use a bonus action to take the Hide action.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spythronar swarm can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The spythronar swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny arachnid. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

trait.name: Web Sense
entries: While in contact with a web, the spythronar swarm knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The spythronar swarm ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Bites
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. {@h}10 ({@damage 4d4}) piercing damage and 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage, or 5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage and 4 ({@damage 1d8}) lightning damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

action.name: Weave (4/Day)
entries: The spythronar swarm weaves webbing, covering a 5-foot square. The swarm can then give up 1 hit point to create a spythronar sac in that space. If the swarm's webbing covers a 10-foot square, it can give up 23 hit points as part of the same action, creating a spythronar web with the same number of hit points. The swarm can't drop to 0 hit points to create a sac or web.

If the swarm weaves an incomplete web, that web is a normal web rather than a sentient, monstrous one. A creature that enters this normal web's space must succeed on a {@dc 10} Strength saving throw or become {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10}) and {@condition restrained} while {@condition grappled} in this way. Each 5-foot square of this web has AC 10; the damage vulnerabilities, immunities, and resistances of a spythronar web; and 5 hit points.

trait.name: Adhesive
entries: The spythronar web adheres to anything that touches it. To avoid adhering when touching the web, a creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw, but a creature hit by the web's crush attack doesn't receive a saving throw. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the web is also {@condition grappled} by it (escape {@dc 13}). If adhered to a target larger than it can grapple, the web can release the adhesive or remain adhered and be dragged along as the target moves. Neither choice requires an action from the web. Removing an object adhered to the web or the web from anything it's adhered to requires a successful {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check as an action.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The spythronar web can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the spythronar web remains motionless and takes no action, it is indistinguishable from a large, thick spider web.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: A spythronar web can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Sense
entries: While in contact with a web, the spythronar web knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The spythronar web ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Crush
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and Adhesive. The target is also {@condition restrained} while {@condition grappled} in this way, and the spythronar web can't crush another target.

action.name: Lightning Surge
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage. If the spythronar web has a creature {@condition grappled} and attacks another target, the {@condition grappled} creature also takes this damage.

name: Squabswarm
languages: understands Common and Sylvan but can't speak

trait.name: Compelled Delivery
entries: As an {@action Influence|XPHB} action, a creature can direct the swarm to deliver a letter or parcel (which the creature must provide) to a recipient the creature knows. The swarm has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until it delivers the item to the specified recipient or until it takes damage. While {@condition Charmed|XPHB} in this way, the swarm must deliver the item to the specified recipient if it knows where the recipient is.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny pigeon. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Unerring Delivery
entries: If the swarm is tasked to deliver an item to a creature, the swarm knows the distance and direction to the creature while they are on the same plane.

action.name: Peck
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 2d4}) Piercing damage, or 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Piercing damage if the swarm is {@status Bloodied|XPHB}. If the swarm isn't {@status Bloodied|XPHB} and the target is a creature, the target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the start of the swarm's next turn.

reaction.name: Many Eyes, One Voice (1/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature who tasked the swarm to deliver an item and is on the same plane as the swarm takes an action to see through the swarm. {@actResponse} The swarm becomes a scrying sensor as if the creature cast {@spell Scrying|XPHB}. For the duration, the creature can speak through the swarm.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The drake has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Nimbus of Swirling Stars
entries: At the start of each of the drake's turns, each creature within 10 feet of it and that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition incapacitated} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Planar Weapons
entries: The drake's weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 4d8} force damage (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drake makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks, or it makes four Searing Star attacks. If two Searing Star attacks hit one creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) piercing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) force damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) force damage.

action.name: Searing Star
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 12} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) radiant damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) force damage.

action.name: Planar Traveler
entries: The star drake can transport itself to a different plane of existence. This works like the {@spell plane shift} spell, except the drake can affect only itself and can't use this action to banish an unwilling creature to another plane.

action.name: Plane-Altered Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The drake exhales raw magic in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 ({@damage 10d10}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The star warden is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The star warden may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the star warden can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the star warden has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Alien Intellect
entries: The sentient planetoid is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the sentient planetoid's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Cosmic Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the star warden is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave cha} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} The target is hurled through time and space, witnessing every moment of existence in a single second. It takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) Psychic damage and is teleported to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

trait.name: Lords of Time and Space
entries: When the star warden is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 1 or 20, the star warden regains all of its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and another creature of its choice within 30 feet is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The star warden makes two attacks.

action.name: Staff of Stars
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. or range 60/120 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 5d6 + 4}) Radiant damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Force damage.

action.name: Nebulae Grasp
