entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}27 ({@damage 5d8 + 4}) Piercing damage, and the star warden can teleport the target to an unoccupied space the star warden can see within 120 feet.

action.name: Stardust
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) Radiant damage and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d6} Radiant).

bonus.name: The Cold Void of Space
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, one creature within 120 feet of the star warden that teleported this turn. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Cold damage.

reaction.name: Outside Time and Space
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature hits the star warden with an attack. {@actResponse} The star warden switches places with another creature within 30 feet, and the attack hits that creature instead.

trait.name: Psychic Absorption
entries: Whenever the star spawn is subjected to psychic damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hp equal to the psychic damage dealt.

trait.name: Void Traveler
entries: The star spawn of Cthulhu doesn't require air, food, drink, sleep, or ambient pressure.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The star spawn of Cthulhu makes two Crushing Claws attacks and one Dimensional Stomp attack, or it makes three Void Bolt attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Disintegrating Gaze, if available.

action.name: Crushing Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 2d12 + 7}) bludgeoning damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Dimensional Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d20 + 7}) bludgeoning damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw or be teleported to an unoccupied space the star spawn can see within 30 feet of it.

action.name: Void Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 15} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}32 ({@damage 5d8 + 10}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Disintegrating Gaze {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature the star spawn can see within 60 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) necrotic damage and be transformed into a misty cloud for 1 minute. The transformed creature's only method of movement is a flying speed of 10 feet, and it can enter and occupy the space of another creature. In addition, the transformed target can't talk, attack, cast spells, or manipulate objects, and any objects it was carrying or holding can't be dropped, used, or otherwise interacted with. The transformed target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or ending the effect on itself on a successful one. A creature killed by this effect can be restored to life only by means of a true resurrection or a {@spell wish} spell.

bonus.name: Interdimensional Step
entries: The star spawn of Cthulhu teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Small tears in reality appear at the origin and destination when it uses this bonus action.

name: Starved Dreamholder

trait.name: Phantasmal Cone
entries: The dreamholder's central eye creates an area of phantasmagoric horrors—illusory manifestations unique to each creature—within a 90-foot cone. At the start of each of its turns, the dreamholder decides which way the cone faces and whether the cone is active. Each creature within the cone at the end of the dreamholder's turn must succeed on a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage and become frightened of the dreamholder and the illusions within the area until the end of the dreamholder's next turn.
As an affected creature is surrounded by these illusions, the source of its fear is in every direction, rendering it unable to move in any direction while it can see these sources of its fear.

trait.name: Inconsistent Incoporeality
entries: When the dreamholder takes 5 or more psychic or thunder damage in a single instance, it becomes corporeal until the start of its next turn. While corporeal, it loses its Incorporeal Movement trait; its immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage; and its immunity to the grappled and restrained conditions.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The dreamholder can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dreamholder fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Dreameater
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) psychic damage.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The dreamholder shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one to three creatures it can see within 120 feet of it:

items.name: 1. Charm Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the dreamholder for 1 hour, or until the dreamholder harms the target.

items.name: 2. Confusion Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be afflicted by the confusion spell until the end of its next turn.

items.name: 3. Static Ray
entries: The target must make a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, a target has muddled thoughts for 1 minute. During that time, it rolls a d6 and subtracts the number rolled from all its attack rolls and ability checks, as well as its Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 4. Rot Ray
entries: The target must make a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, its grey matter deteriorates, it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage, and it has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls it makes until the end of its next turn. On a success it takes half as much damage and suffers no additional effects.

items.name: 5. Incorporeal Shunt Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or become momentarily incorporeal, be pushed up to 15 feet directly away from the dreamholder, and then rematerialise. The creature takes 13 ({@damage 3d8}) force damage if it rematerialises inside an object. If the creature rematerialises in another creature's space, both creatures take this damage. The target is then pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

items.name: 6. Nightmare Ray
entries: The target is assailed by illusory manifestations of its fears. It must make a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw, taking 16 ({@damage 3d10}) psychic damage on a failure or half as much damage on a success.

legendaryHeader: The dreamholder can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The dreamholder regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Eye Ray
entries: The dreamholder uses one random eye ray.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: The dreamholder teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of it. If it is within its lair it doesn't need to see this space to teleport to it.

legendary.name: Mirror (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Two illusory dreamholders appear within 30 feet of the dreamholder, and the dreamholder can then immediately teleport, switching places with one of the illusory duplicates. Physical interaction with the illusory dreamholder, such as hitting it with an attack, reveals it to be an illusion. A creature can use its action to make a {@dc 14} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|PHB}) check to inspect one dreamholder within 30 feet of it, determining if it's an illusion on a success. When the dreamholder uses an eye ray, all the illusions fire the same eye rays at the same target, and when it teleports, so too do the illusions. All the illusions disappear at the end of the dreamholder's next turn.

trait.name: Chorus of Death
entries: If the starving harpy hears a harpy's Alluring Song, they can start harmonizing (no action required). The starving harpy continues harmonizing until the song ends, until they choose to stop harmonizing, or until they become {@condition deafened} or {@condition incapacitated}. For each starving harpy harmonizing, the range of the song increases by 50 feet, and the save DCs for the singing harpy's Alluring Song action and Beckon bonus action both increase by 1 (maximum DC increase of 5).

trait.name: Echolocation
entries: The harpy can't use their blindsight while {@condition deafened}.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the harpy takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the harpy takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Grasping Talons (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, the harpies can move them 5 feet in any direction. If the attack was made by three or more harpies, they can move the target 10 feet instead of 5.

name: Steam Golem

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Boiler Weakness
entries: If the steam golem starts its turn immersed in water, or if it was soaked with at least 20 gallons of water on its previous turn, it risks losing steam pressure in its boiler. The steam golem must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or its internal fire is extinguished. Until its internal fire is relit, the golem's speed is halved, its AC is reduced by 2, and it must repeat the saving throw at the start of each of its turns. On a failure, it stops repeating this saving throw and becomes dormant, effectively dead until the fire is relit. A Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of the golem can take an action to relight the golem's internal fire, making it active again.

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The golem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Heated Weapons
entries: The steam golem's weapon attacks are magical. When the golem hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 4d8} fire damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The steam golem makes one Axe Arm attack and one Long Axe attack.

action.name: Axe Arm
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d6 + 8}) slashing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) fire damage.

action.name: Long Axe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d8 + 8}) slashing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) fire damage.

action.name: Steam Blast {@recharge 5}
entries: The steam golem releases a blast of steam in a 30-foot cone or in a 10-foot-radius cloud that extends from it, spreading around corners. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 ({@damage 12d8}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Whistle {@recharge 4}
entries: When a creature the steam golem can see within 30 feet of it casts a spell, the steam golem emits a shriek from its twin steam whistles. The spellcaster must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or the spell fails and has no effect.

trait.name: Bird Caller
entries: The captain can cast the {@spell animal messenger} spell, but only as a ritual and only targeting a beast that has an innate flying speed.

trait.name: Indomitable (2/Day)
entries: The captain rerolls a failed saving throw.

trait.name: Launch (5/Day)
entries: As a bonus action while on the ground, the captain jumps up to 30 feet. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, and the captain takes no falling damage when it lands. The captain can't use this trait if its speed is 0.

If the captain hits a target with an attack immediately after it lands or during the leap's movement, the target takes an extra 5 ({@damage 1d10}) damage, and it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Steel Jump (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: When the captain uses its Launch trait, it can choose to jump 90 feet, instead of 30.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The captain makes three attacks.

action.name: Silver Eagle Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage. Scoring a critical hit with this weapon doesn't double the weapon's damage dice. Whenever the same number is rolled on both of the weapon's damage dice, the target takes an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Bird Caller
entries: The soldier can cast the {@spell animal messenger} spell, but only as a ritual and only targeting a beast that has an innate flying speed.

trait.name: Launch (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action while on the ground, the soldier jumps up to 15 feet. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, and the soldier takes no falling damage when it lands. The soldier can't use this trait if its speed is 0.
If the soldier hits a target with an attack immediately after it lands or during the leap's movement, the target takes an extra 5 ({@damage 1d10}) damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The soldier makes two attacks.

action.name: Glaive
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage.

name: Steel Horse
languages: understands one language of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Repairable
entries: As long as it has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} remaining, the steel horse regains 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} whenever a {@spell Mending|XPHB} spell is cast on it.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The Caustic Slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Slime Trail
entries: The slime leaves a trail of ooze behind it that remains tacky for up to 15 minutes. A creature that steps in the ooze must succeed a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or become {@condition restrained}. A creature may attempt the saving throw again at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Mucus
entries: When the slime is hit by a melee attack, the attacker must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or their weapon becomes stuck in the slime. The weapon can be wrenched out by using an action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check against the same DC, freeing the weapon on a success. All weapons stuck in the slime can be retrieved once the slime is slain.

action.name: Psuedopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Tiny Target
entries: If the stirge is reduced to 0 hit points by any damage other than psychic while attached to another creature, that creature takes damage equal to half that dealt to the stirge.

action.name: Proboscis
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}3 piercing damage, and the stirge can attach to the target and enter their space. While attached, the stirge moves with the target and can't make Proboscis attacks. A creature who can reach the stirge can use an action to detach the stirge, shunting them into the nearest unoccupied space of the stirge's choice. The stirge also detaches if they become {@condition grappled}, {@condition incapacitated}, {@condition prone}, or {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Drain Essence
entries: The stirge sips the life essence of a creature they are attached to who isn't a Construct or an Undead. The creature loses 3 hit points and must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of the stirge's next turn. If the creature is already {@condition poisoned}, they also become {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the end of the stirge's next turn.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the broodling takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the broodling takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Tiny Target
entries: If the broodling is reduced to 0 hit points by any damage other than psychic while attached to another creature, that creature takes 1 damage of the same type.

action.name: Proboscis (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}1 piercing damage, and each broodling who joined the attack can attach to the target and enter their space. While attached, a broodling moves with the target and can't make Proboscis attacks. The target or a creature who can reach them can use an action or bonus action to detach all broodlings, shunting them into the nearest unoccupied space of each broodling's choice. The broodling also detaches if they become {@condition grappled}, {@condition incapacitated}, {@condition prone}, or {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Drain Essence
entries: The broodling sips the life essence of a creature they're attached to who isn't a Construct or an Undead. The creature loses 1 hit point.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Proboscis)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Destabilizing Attack (2 Ferocity)
entries: The stirge makes a signature attack. On a hit, the target also has disadvantage on the next attack they make before the end of their next turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Quick Drink (5 Ferocity)
entries: The stirge makes a signature attack. On a hit, the target takes an extra {@damage PBd4} piercing damage and is {@condition poisoned} until the end of their next turn.

action.name: 5th Level: Attach (8 Ferocity)
entries: The stirge makes a signature attack against a creature. On a hit, the target takes an extra {@damage PBd6} piercing damage and the stirge attaches to the target and enters their space. While attached, the stirge moves with the target and can't attack any creature other than the target. If the stirge hits the target with an attack while attached, the target takes an extra {@damage PBd6} piercing damage. The stirge can use an action or bonus action to detach and move 5 feet into an unoccupied space without provoking opportunity attacks. The stirge also detaches if they become {@condition grappled}, {@condition incapacitated}, {@condition prone}, or {@condition restrained}, or if they take more than PB × 5 damage in a turn.

bonus.name: Essence Shared (2/Long Rest)
entries: If the stirge's caregiver is within 5 feet of them and the stirge isn't attached to another creature, the stirge pumps life essence into the caregiver's veins. The caregiver regains {@damage 1d6 plus PB} hit points.

name: Stitcher
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Hold Still, Please
entries: The stitcher has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against a {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, or {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stitcher makes two Scissorhand attacks and one Sewing Needle attack. It can replace any of these attacks with Attach Limb.

action.name: Scissorhand
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 10 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) Slashing damage, and the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d4}).

action.name: Sewing Needle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 10 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Piercing damage. {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} The target has a body part bound and sewn up (stitcher's choice):

action.name: Eyes
entries: The target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Mouth
entries: The target cannot speak and cannot cast spells with a verbal component.

action.name: Limbs
entries: The target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

A creature within 5 feet can take an action to remove the threads with a successful {@dc 17} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) check, ending the effect. {@actSaveFail} The threads are removed but the target takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Slashing damage. Failure by 5 or More: The target takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Slashing damage and the threads aren't removed.

action.name: Attach Limb
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 17}, one creature the stitcher can see within 10 feet ({@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, and {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}). {@actSaveFail} The target makes a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw at the start of each of its turns. On a success, it controls the limb until the start of its next turn. Otherwise, the limb is uncontrolled for the same duration. The target suffers one of the following effects depending on the attached limb:

items.name: Head
entries: While controlled, the target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma-based {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests}. While uncontrolled, the target can control its action or its movement on its turn, but the head controls the other. On a failure by 5 or more, the head chooses which to control instead of the target.

items.name: Arm
entries: While controlled, the target can take an extra action on its turn, choosing from the Attack (one weapon attack only) or Utilize actions. While uncontrolled, the extra arm makes one melee weapon attack against the target at the start of its turn. The arm has a +9 attack bonus and deals 14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage on a hit.

items.name: Leg
entries: While controlled, the target can take an extra action on its turn, choosing from the {@action Dash|XPHB} or {@action Disengage|XPHB} actions. While uncontrolled, the leg forces the target to move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} in a random direction at the start of its turn. If this movement forces the target toward a hazard or precipice, the host can repeat the saving throw. On a successful save, it stops its movement and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition before entering the hazard.

An attached limb can be attacked (AC 20, 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage). A creature within 5 feet can take an action to remove the limb with a successful {@dc 17} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) check or {@dc 15} Strength check. When removed by any means other than a successful Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) check, the target takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage and has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d4}).

name: Stoa Mossbow
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Stoa can spend a reaction to fly up to their speed in one direction as they descend. They land in an unoccupied space at the end of their movement and take no falling damage. They cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though they can drop any held items as part of their reaction).

trait.name: Patterned Feathers
entries: Stoa has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks when they attempt to hide in a forest.

trait.name: Talons
entries: Stoa has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface their talons could reasonably grip.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 slashing damage.

trait.name: Dense Flesh
entries: When a stone listener isn't wearing any armor, their base {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} equals 10 plus their Dexterity and Constitution modifiers. They can use a {@spell Shield|XPHB} and still gain this benefit.

trait.name: Revel in Stone Words
entries: Whenever a creature the stone listener can see gains the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} or {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition as the result of a spell or magical effect, the stone listener gains 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

action.name: Warhammer
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage, or 10 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

reaction.name: Stonehide Growth
entries: {@actTrigger} The stone listener takes damage. {@actResponse} The stone listener gains resistance to that instance of damage.

name: Stone Speaker
languages: Any two language (usually Common and Deep Speech)

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The stone speaker casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Dense Flesh
entries: When a stone speaker isn't wearing any armor, their base {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} equals 10 plus their Dexterity and Constitution modifiers. They can use a {@spell Shield|XPHB} and still gain this benefit.

trait.name: Revel in Stone Words
entries: Whenever a creature the stone speaker can see gains the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} or {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition as the result of a spell or magical effect, the stone speaker gains 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stone speaker makes 3 Eldritch Bolt attacks. Up to three of these attacks can be replaced by Stone to Flesh. They also make one Sculptor's Knife attack.

action.name: Sculptor's Knife
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a successful save. If the target fails a saving throw against this ability while it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition, it instead has the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition. It can continue to make saving throws at the end of each of its turns, ending the petrification on a successful save.

action.name: Eldritch Bolt
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 120 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Force damage.

action.name: Remold
entries: The stone speaker shape-shifts to resemble a Medium humanoid it has seen, or it returns to its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except for its size. Any equipment it's wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

action.name: Stone to Flesh
entries: The stone speaker ends the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition on one creature it touches. The stone speaker regains 16 ({@dice 3d10}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and the newly un-Petrified creature has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for 10 minutes.

trait.name: Earth Aquatic
entries: The stone whale can move through stone and earth as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.

trait.name: Echolocation
entries: The stone whale can't use its blindsight while {@condition deafened}.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The stone whale can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The stone whale has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 5d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Hideous Toughness (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the Stone-troll Chief takes 14 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

trait.name: Sunlight Curse
entries: The Stone-troll Chief becomes {@condition petrified} if it ends its turn in sunlight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Stone-troll Chief makes two melee attacks. It cannot use its great club if it is grappling a creature.

action.name: Great Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d4 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). If the target is Small or smaller, it is also {@condition restrained} until this {@action grapple} ends. While grappling the target, the Stone-troll Chief has advantage on attack rolls against it and cannot use this attack against other targets.

action.name: Yell of Triumph (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: Each creature of the Stone-troll Chief's choice that is within 30 feet of it and can hear it gains advantage on attack rolls and Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks until the start of the Stone-troll Chief's next turn. The Stone-troll Chief can then make one attack as a bonus action.

trait.name: Hideous Toughness (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the Stone-troll Robber takes 7 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

trait.name: Sunlight Curse
entries: The Stone-troll Robber becomes {@condition petrified} if it ends its turn in sunlight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Stone-troll Robber makes two melee attacks. It cannot use its great club if it is grappling a creature.

action.name: Great Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). If the target is Small or smaller, it is also {@condition restrained} until this {@action grapple} ends. While grappling the target, the Stone-troll Robber has advantage on attack rolls against it and cannot use this attack against other targets.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The isopod can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The isopod has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks to hide in rocky terrain.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Seize
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). Until this grapple ends, the isopod can't make a Seize attack against another target.

reaction.name: Curl
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the isopod hits them with an attack, the isopod defensively rolls up inside their rocky carapace. The isopod gains a +2 bonus to AC against the triggering attack, and the attacker must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or take 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 5 feet into an unoccupied space of the isopod's choice.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The isopod can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The isopod has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

action.name: Signature Attack (Bite)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Mangling Attack (2 Ferocity)
entries: The isopod makes a signature attack. On a hit, the target's speed is also reduced by 10 feet until the end of the isopod's next turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Push Through (5 Ferocity)
entries: The isopod moves up to their walking speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

While doing so, they can move through the spaces of Large or smaller creatures as if they were difficult terrain. If the isopod enters another creature's space during this move, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: 5th Level: Tackle (8 Ferocity)
entries: The isopod moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks and makes a signature attack. On a hit, the target is also {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, the target is {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} and {@condition restrained}.

reaction.name: Emergency Hug (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: When the isopod's caregiver is hit with an attack while within 5 feet of the isopod, the isopod curls around the caregiver, giving the caregiver a +PB bonus to their AC against the attack.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the stoneborn hobgoblin remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate statue.

trait.name: Martial Advantage
entries: Once per turn, the stoneborn hobgoblin can deal an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 feet of an ally of the stoneborn hobgoblin that doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) Slashing damage, or 6 ({@damage 1d10 + 1}) Slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 3}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) Piercing damage.

trait.name: Air Form
entries: The storm spirit can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The storm spirit doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The storm spirit has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The storm spirit makes two Spirit Surge attacks.

action.name: Spirit Surge
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 8} to hit, reach o ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) lightning damage.

action.name: Storm Burst {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of the storm spirit must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) lightning damage and 22 ({@damage 4d10}) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The troll regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Special Immunities
entries: The troll is immune to the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes two Claw attacks and one Bite attack. It can replace its Bite attack with Hurl Lightning if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Thunder damage, and the target has the {@condition Staggered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the troll's next turn.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Lightning damage, and lightning leaps from the target to a different creature of the troll's choice that it can see within 10 feet of the target. The second creature takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Lightning damage.

action.name: Hurl Lightning {@recharge 5}
entries: The troll hurls a magical lightning bolt at a point it can see within 300 feet of it. {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on that point. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Lightning damage and has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the troll's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The stormborn ithjar has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Slippery Serpent
entries: The stormborn ithjar has advantage on ability checks or saving throws made to escape a grapple and saving throws to avoid being {@condition paralyzed} or {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stormborn ithjar attacks once with its bite and once with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) slashing damage and 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) thunder damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the stormborn ithjar can't use its tail on another target.

action.name: Storm Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The stormborn ithjar exhales a 30-foot cone of lightning and thunder. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 31 ({@damage 7d8}) lightning damage and 31 ({@damage 7d8}) thunder damage and falls {@condition prone}. If the save succeeds, the creature takes half the lightning and thunder damage and doesn't fall {@condition prone}. The discharge of this breath weapon is audible for 1 mile outside and 300 feet inside.

action.name: Fisticuffs
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Brace Up
entries: The streetfighter gains 9 ({@dice 2d8}) {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

bonus.name: Combo
entries: The streetfighter makes one Fisticuffs attack.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The strife can mimic Humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 17} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

trait.name: Delight
entries: When a creature within 30 feet of the strife takes psychic damage, the strife gains 5 temporary hp or gains advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn (the strife's choice).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The strife can use its Sow Discord. It then makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Sow Discord
entries: The strife attempts to sow discord in up to two creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage and distrusts its allies until the start of the strife's next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and doesn't distrust its allies. A creature that distrusts its allies can't give or receive aid from its allies, including spells, class features like Sneak Attack, and the Help action.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The strife magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the strife wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

reaction.name: Induce Doubt
entries: If a creature misses the strife with an attack, the strife can cause the attacker to doubt itself. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or each time it makes an attack roll or saving throw before the end of its next turn, it must roll a {@dice d4} and subtract the number rolled from the attack roll or saving throw.

name: Strig Berserker
languages: understands Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, the berserker can spend a reaction to fly up to their speed in one direction as they descend. They land in an unoccupied space at the end of their movement, and take no falling damage. The berserker can't glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though they can drop any held items as part of their reaction).

trait.name: Talons
entries: The berserker has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface their talons could reasonably grip.

trait.name: Patterned Feathers
entries: The berserker has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks when they attempt to hide in a forest.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the berserker can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

name: Strig Knight
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, the knight can spend a reaction to fly up to their speed in one direction as they descend. They land in an unoccupied space at the end of their movement, and take no falling damage. They cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though they can drop any held items as part of their reaction).

trait.name: Talons
entries: The knight rolls advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface their talons could reasonably grip.

trait.name: Maneuver (2/Day)
entries: When the knight hits with an attack, they can choose to maneuver the enemy out of position, granting an ally within 5 feet of the target the opportunity to use their reaction to move away from this enemy at half their movement speed without provoking an {@action opportunity attack|phb|attack of opportunity}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The knight makes two short sword attacks.

action.name: Short Sword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage. The knight can choose to grapple a target hit by this attack as a bonus action.

action.name: Wing Crest Shield (1/Day)
entries: The knight casts the {@spell gust of wind} spell (save {@dc 15}).

name: Strig Tracker
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The tracker is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 12}, +4 to hit with spell attacks). The strig tracker has the following ranger spells prepared:

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, the tracker can spend a reaction to fly up to their speed in one direction as they descend. They land in an unoccupied space at the end of their movement, and take no falling damage. They cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though they can drop any held items as part of their reaction).

trait.name: Talons
entries: The tracker rolls advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to climb any surface their talons could reasonably grip.

trait.name: Patterned Feathers
entries: The tracker has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks when they attempt to hide in a forest.

trait.name: Reya's Keen Eye
entries: The tracker can make Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks as a bonus action to try and find hidden creatures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tracker makes two melee attacks, one with their longsword and one with their hand axe. Or they make two ranged attacks with their hand axe.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage if wielding with both hands.

action.name: Hand Axe
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

hp.special: 57 (6d10 + 24) plus 57 (6d10 + 24) per player character

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The striga has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on melee attack rolls against a creature with the {@status Bloodied|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The striga is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. It may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Necrotic Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the Striga takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The striga regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the striga takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The striga can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: The striga has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

action.name: The striga always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the striga can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the striga takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

action.name: Necrotic Bite (1/Round)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) Necrotic damage. The target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} Maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the striga regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to that amount.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 15 ft. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Delerium Healing
entries: The striga touches a delerium shard and regains 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the striga has used a delerium shard in this way, it can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

action.name: Blood Howl (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 18}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the striga that can hear it. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Jinxed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} ({@dice 1d6}) and {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} conditions (save ends both). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage, and the target is immune to the striga's Blood Howl for 24 hours.

action.name: Charge
entries: The striga moves up to 40 feet in a straight line, moving through the spaces of other creatures. Each creature whose space the striga passes through is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} The target is pushed 10 feet away from the striga and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The striga chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The striga can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

reaction.name: Retaliation
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature within 15 feet of the striga deals Radiant damage to it. {@actResponse} The striga makes a Claws attack against that creature.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (3/Day)
headerEntries: The stryx casts the {@spell comprehend languages} spell, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the stryx keeps its beak closed and doesn't speak, it is indistinguishable from a normal owl.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The stryx doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: The stryx has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Mountain Walk
entries: The stuhac can move across and climb rocky surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of rocks or rocky debris doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The stuhac's long jump is up to 30 feet and tis high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stuhac can use Hobble. It then makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 5d8 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Hobble
entries: The stuhac telekinetically tears the tendons and ligaments of one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) force damage and its speed is reduced by 10 feet. The stuhac can't reduce a creature's speed below 0 feet with this action. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest or until removed by the {@spell greater restoration} spell or similar magic.

action.name: Illusory Appearance
entries: The stuhac covers itself and anything it is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes it look like another creature of its general size and Humanoid shape. The illusion ends if the stuhac takes a bonus action to end it or if the stuhac dies.

The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the stuhac could appear to have gnarled hands, but someone touching the stuhac's hands would feel its jagged claws. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to discern that the stuhac is disguised.

trait.name: Hallucinatory Chatter
entries: If a creature starts its turn within 30 feet of the Stul and can hear it, the Stul can force the creature to make a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw if the Stul isn't {@condition incapacitated}. On a failed save, the creature becomes {@condition charmed} for 1 minute.

An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The effect ends early for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) poison damage.

action.name: Beckon
entries: The Stul commands any number of creatures {@condition charmed} by its Hallucinatory Chatter to approach it. Each creature must spend its action on its next turn to move as close to the Stul as it can.

action.name: Mental Invasion
entries: One creature the Stul chooses that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be forced to use its reaction to move its full speed in the opposite direction of the Stul.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Stygian fat-tailed scorpion makes two Claw attacks and one Sting attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until it finishes a short or long rest. Each time the {@condition poisoned} creature takes poison damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of {@condition exhaustion}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The giant can hold their breath for 10 minutes.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The giant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Mindful Wader
entries: The giant is immune to the effects of dark water (see Chapter 5 of Book of Ebon Tides for more on dark water).

trait.name: Netted Strike
entries: Twice per turn, the giant can deal an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage to a {@condition restrained} creature the giant hits with a weapon attack.

trait.name: Confusing Memories
entries: A creature trapped in the giant's Mooncatcher's Net makes a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw at the start of its turn. On a failed save, the creature is bamboozled as the memory fragments in the net mingle with its own memories. Roll a {@dice d6} and consult the table below to determine what it does during its current turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes a Mooncatcher's Net attack and then two Staff attacks.

action.name: Staff
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Mooncatcher's Net
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, ranged 20/60 ft., one Small, Medium, or Large creature. {@h}The target is {@condition restrained} until it escapes the net. A creature can use its action to make a {@dc 16} Strength check to free itself or another creature in the net, ending the effect on a success. Dealing 15 slashing damage to the net (AC 14) frees the target.

bonus.name: Shadow Traveler (3/Day)
entries: While in shadows, dim light, or darkness, the giant disappears into the darkness and reappears in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. A tendril of inky smoke appears at the origin and destination when it uses this trait.

reaction.name: Shadow Cloak (3/Day)
entries: When the giant is targeted by an attack, it can cloak itself in shadows. Attacks against the giant are made at disadvantage, and it has resistance to radiant damage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Flood Fever
entries: During flood season, the subek is overcome with bloodthirsty malice, becoming more aggressive and losing its proficiency in Intelligence ({@skill History}) and Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) checks. If it hasn't fed within the past 8 hours, it enters a frenzy, spending each turn attacking the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the subek attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. During the frenzy, it has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hp. It continues the frenzy until it has fed and enters the frenzy again every time it goes without eating for 8 hours for the duration of the flood season.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The subek can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The subek makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. If both Claw attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) slashing damage as the subek tears into the target.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. it: 13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Corona
entries: The nexus sheds bright sunlight in a 120-foot radius and dim light for another 120 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nexus makes three Solar Arc attacks. They can replace one attack with a use of Heavenly Collapse or Rejuvenating Flare, if available.

action.name: Solar Arc
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d12 + 5}) radiant damage.

action.name: Heavenly Collapse (2/Day)
entries: The nexus shines harsh light on an enemy they can see within 60 feet of them. Each ally of the nexus within 5 feet of the target regains 20 hit points, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or lose any damage resistances they have and be {@condition blinded} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Rejuvenating Flare (1/Day)
entries: One ally the nexus can see within 30 feet of them is bathed in rejuvenating light. The ally regains 27 ({@damage 5d10}) hit points, and if they are {@condition charmed}, {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, {@condition frightened}, or {@condition poisoned}, those conditions end for them.

bonus.name: Convocation of Sunlight (2/Day)
entries: The nexus imbues the power of sunlight in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Healing Radiance.} The Elemental regains 30 hit points. Until the end of the nexus's next turn, the Elemental refracts shimmering light, and creatures within 10 feet of them who aren't Elementals are {@condition blinded}.

{@b Protective Light.} Four brilliant motes orbit the Elemental for 1 minute. When the Elemental deals damage to a creature with an attack, the Elemental can extinguish one mote (no action required) to deal an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) radiant damage to that creature.

trait.name: Hungry
entries: Whenever the sunsnacker first detects the presence of sweet food that isn't being worn or carried, it must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or get distracted. While distracted, it spends its movement and actions trying to get close to the food and eat it. A distracted sunsnacker repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success and becoming immune to the allure of that source of food for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The sunsnacker has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Light
entries: The sunsnacker creates a glowing orb that hovers in the air within 5 feet of it for the next minute, moving with it. The orb sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

trait.name: Bright
entries: When the sunsprite isn't invisible, it sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the sunsprite dies, it explodes in a burst of light. Each creature within 5 feet of the sunsprite must make a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: When the sunsprite is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage.

action.name: Sunbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 40/160 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The sunsprite magically turns invisible until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the sunsprite wears or carries is invisible with it.

name: Susan of the Swamp
languages: can also speak with beasts of any size which represent spiders, insects, worms, or other bugs

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Susan is a 2nd-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 13}, +5 to hit with spell attacks). Susan has the following warlock spells prepared:

trait.name: Dark One's Blessing
entries: When Susan reduces a hostile creature to 0 hit points, she gains 5 temporary hit points.

trait.name: Repelling Blast
entries: When Susan hits a creature with eldritch blast, she can push the creature up to 10 feet away in a straight line.

action.name: Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 1} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d6 - 1}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Fiendish Vigor
entries: Susan can cast {@spell false life} at will as a 1st-level spell.

action.name: Curl Up
entries: Susan curls up into a spiny ball. While curled up in this way she cannot move, attack, or cast spells with somatic components, and her base armor class becomes 19. Any creature that misses Susan with a melee attack while she is curled up takes {@damage 2d4} points of piercing damage from her sharp quills. If a creature hits Susan while she is curled up, however, Susan is knocked {@condition prone} in her space at the end of the turn. Susan may uncurl herself at any point during her turn.

trait.name: Detect Lies
entries: The suturefly knows if it hears a lie and can pinpoint the location of a creature within 60 feet of it that lied within the last minute.

trait.name: Forest Camouflage
entries: The suturefly has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in forested terrain.

action.name: Sew
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or the suturefly sews the target's mouth, nose, or one of its eyes closed (the suturefly's choice). With supernatural speed, the suturefly repeatedly pierces the target's face, each time threading a loop of the target's own skin through the previous hole. These skin loops rapidly blacken, shrink, and draw the orifice tightly closed. If a target's mouth is sewn shut, it can't speak. If its mouth and nose are sewn shut, it can't breathe, and if both eyes are sewn shut, it is {@condition blinded}. A creature, including the target, can take its action to cut open one of the sewn orifices by succeeding on a {@dc 12} Dexterity check with an edged weapon or tool.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The swallybog can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Gullible
entries: The swallybog has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|PHB}) checks.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The swallybog's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Swamp Camouflage
entries: The swallybog has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|PHB}) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The swallybog makes two attacks, either with its Blowgun or its Trident.

action.name: Blowgun
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 25/100 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage.

action.name: Trident
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage, or 5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The swallybog is a 10th level spellcaster and can cast the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The swallybog can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Gullible
entries: The swallybog has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|PHB}) checks.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The swallybog's long jump is up to 20 feet and her high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Swamp Camouflage
entries: The swallybog has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|PHB}) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage, or 5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The swallybog can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Gullible
entries: The swallybog has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|PHB}) checks.

trait.name: Net Master
entries: Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on the swallybog's ranged attack rolls. Making an attack with a net doesn't limit the number of non-net attacks the swallybog can make (included in actions).

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The swallybog's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Swamp Camouflage
entries: The swallybog has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|PHB}) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The swallybog makes three attacks: one with its Net and two with its Trident.

action.name: Trident
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage, or 7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage.

action.name: Net
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 5/10 ft., one target. {@h}the target is restrained if it is Large or smaller. A creature can use its action to make a {@dc 10} Strength check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) also frees the creature without harming it, ending the effect and destroying the net.

trait.name: Swamp Camouflage
entries: The swamp adder has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage and is {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. On a success, a target takes half the damage and isn't {@condition paralyzed}. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Swamp Dryad
languages: any languages the dryad spoke before their binding

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: The dryad has advantage on saving throws against supernatural effects.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
entries: The dryad can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Tree Stride (1/Turn)
entries: The dryad can use 10 feet of movement to step into one living tree within their reach and emerge from a second living tree within 60 feet of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large or larger.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dryad makes two Slam attacks and uses Entangling Roots, if available.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}.

action.name: Entangling Roots {@recharge 5}
entries: The dryad chooses a point they can see within 60 feet of them, causing tree roots to pull free of the ground and attack in a 15-foot radius centered on that point. If the dryad is within 5 feet of their tree, the radius of this effect doubles to 30 feet. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).
While {@condition grappled} in this way, a creature is {@condition restrained} and their flesh begins to harden and turn to wood.

At the end of a creature's third consecutive turn being {@condition grappled} in this way, they become {@condition petrified} and turn into a hardwood statue. The {@condition petrified} condition ends for that creature if the dryad uses an action to end it, or if the dryad dies.

action.name: Fey Intimidation
entries: The dryad targets up to five creatures they can see within 30 feet of them. Each target who can see the dryad must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the dryad (save ends at end of turn). If a target succeeds on their saving throw or the effect ends for them, the target is immune to the swamp dryad's Fey Intimidation for the next 24 hours.

bonus.name: Swamp Medicine (3/Day)
entries: The dryad touches a creature, who regains 18 ({@dice 3d8 + 5}) hit points. Alternatively, the creature removes one disease or neutralizes one poison afflicting them.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The swamp naga is an 8th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks), and it needs only verbal components to cast its spells. It knows the following sorcerer spells:

trait.name: Cloud of Insects
entries: A cloud of biting and stinging insects surrounds the swamp naga. A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the naga must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. On a success, it takes half the damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. A {@condition poisoned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses the insect cloud for 1 minute. As a bonus action, the naga can disperse the cloud for 1 minute.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If it dies, the swamp naga returns to life in {@dice 1d6} days and regains all its hp. Only a {@spell wish} spell or removing the naga from its swamp for 1 year can prevent this trait from functioning.

trait.name: Insect and Serpent Passivism
entries: No insects or serpents can willingly attack the swamp naga. They can be forced to do so through magical means.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) poison damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the naga can't constrict another target.

trait.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
entries: The swarm adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the swarm is also grappled by it (escape {@dc 13}). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

trait.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
entries: If the swarm is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the swarm move or act, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|PHB}) check to discern that the swarm is animate.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The swarm has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The swarm can use its action to polymorph into a pile of Tiny objects or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny mimic. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Bites
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) acid damage, or 3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) acid damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

trait.name: Smoke Weakness
entries: If a swarm starts its turn in a space that is either partially or entirely covered by smoke, its attacks have disadvantage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. {@h}5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage, or 2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer. The target must make a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 4d4}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable, but remains {@condition unconscious}, even after regaining hit points. An {@condition unconscious} creature can be woken by taking an action to shake it awake, otherwise the creature will awaken in 8 hours.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

action.name: Contaminated Bites
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 0 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage, or 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage if the swarm has the {@status Bloodied|XPHB} condition. {@actSave con} {@dc 10}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: The swarm has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

trait.name: Resilience
entries: The swarm has advantage on saving throws made to resist being {@condition poisoned}.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny squirrel. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage, or 3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

trait.name: Echolocation
entries: The swarm can't use its blindsight while {@condition deafened}.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The swarm has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing.

trait.name: Flame Essence
entries: Any creature that starts their turn within 5 feet of the emberbat swarm must make a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw, taking 2 ({@damage 1d4}) points of fire damage on a failure.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The Swarm of Emberbats can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny bat. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Bites
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. {@h}5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage, or 2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: As long as it has more than half of its hit points, the swarm can cast the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm of fiendcats can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny cat. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Bite (Cockatrice)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +6} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm' space. {@h}21 ({@damage 6d6}) piercing damage or 10 ({@damage 6d6}) piercing damage if the swarm has half its hit points or fewer. In addition, the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage and becoming {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute on a failure, or taking half as much damage and not becoming {@condition poisoned} on a success.

trait.name: Elemental Nature
entries: The swarm of fire dancers doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Fire Form
entries: A creature that touches the swarm or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage. In addition, the first time the swarm enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage and catches fire. Until a creature, which can include the target, uses an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The swarm sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light to an additional 30 feet.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny Elemental. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

trait.name: Water Susceptibility
entries: For every 5 feet the swarm moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.

action.name: Multiattack
