entries: The swarm of fire dancers can use its Frightening Visage, if available. It then makes two Singe attacks.

action.name: Singe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d10}) fire damage, or 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage if the swarm has half its hp or fewer.

action.name: Frightening Visage {@recharge 5}
entries: The swarm rearranges itself into the shape of a giant, blue, flaming Humanoid skull. Each Humanoid within 30 feet of the swarm that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A {@condition frightened} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Bloodmire Adaptation
entries: The mosquito is immune to the diseases described in the {@table Bloodmire Diseases|GriffonsSaddlebag2} table.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Small mosquito. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Bites
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage, or 7 ({@damage 2d6}) if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

trait.name: Woodbore
entries: The swarm can burrow up to its speed through solid wood and tree bark, and its attacks ignore the damage threshold of objects made of wood.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. {@h}5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage and 5 ({@damage 2d4}) acid damage, or 2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage and 2 ({@damage 1d4}) acid damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

variant.name: Gimlet Larvae
entries: Swarms of gimlet larvae are just as damaging to the tree as the beetle themselves. They use the same statistics listed for a swarm of gimlets, but with the characteristics described here.

entries.name: Swarm of Gimlet Larvae
entries: A swarm of gimlet larvae has the following traits:

items.name: Speed
items.entry: The swarm of Gimlet larvae has a movement speed of 10 feet and a climb speed of 10 feet. It cannot fly.

items: The swarm of gimlet larvae loses the bite attack listed in the swarm of gimlet's stat block and instead gains the following attack:

items.name: Acidic Mucus
items.entry: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 0 ft., all targets in the swarm's space. {@h}5 ({@damage 2d4}) acid damage, or 2 ({@damage 1d4}) acid damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

action.name: Acidic Mucus
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 0 ft., all targets in the swarm's space. {@h}5 ({@damage 2d4}) acid damage, or 2 ({@damage 1d4}) acid damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

trait.name: Multitudinous
entries: The swarm has advantage on opportunity attacks, and creatures provoke opportunity attacks from the swarm even if they take the Disengage action before leaving the swarm's reach.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. {@h}10 ({@damage 4d4}) piercing damage, or 5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage if the swarm has half their hit points or fewer.

action.name: Distracting Buzz
entries: If the swarm has at least half their hit points remaining, they emit an annoying drone, buzz, or skittering sound. Until the start of the swarm's next turn, creatures within 15 feet of the swarm who can hear them have disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than the swarm.

trait.name: Arcanomagnetic Repulsion
entries: Attacks against the swarm made with ferrous weapons or ammunition are made at disadvantage.

trait.name: Superconductor
entries: If the swarm takes 10 or more fire damage in a single instance, it falls {@condition prone} and, until the end of its next turn, it is {@condition incapacitated} and its flying speed is reduced to 0 feet.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny utensil. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Jabs
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target the swarm's space. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage or 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The swarm of manabane scarabs can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Sense Magic
entries: The swarm of manabane scarabs senses magic within 120 feet of it at will. This trait otherwise works like the {@spell detect magic} spell but isn't itself magical.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

action.name: Bites
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. {@h}28 ({@damage 8d6}) piercing damage, or 14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer, and the swarm can attempt to end one random magical effect of 2nd level or lower on the target. This effect works like the {@spell dispel magic} spell, except the swarm must always make an ability check. Its ability check for this is +5.

bonus.name: Drain Magic Item
entries: The swarm drains the magic from one magic item in its space that isn't being worn or carried. A magic item with charges loses {@dice 1d4} charges, an item with limited uses per day loses one daily use, and a single-use item, such as a potion or spell scroll is destroyed. All other magic items have their effects suppressed for 1 minute. A drained item regains its magic after 1 hour.

trait.name: Glittering Carapace
entries: When a creature that can see the swarm starts its turn within 30 feet of the swarm and the swarm is in bright or dim light, the swarm can force the creature to make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw if the swarm isn't {@condition incapacitated} and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature falls {@condition unconscious}. Otherwise, a creature that fails the save is {@condition incapacitated} and its speed is reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn, as it remains transfixed in place by the glitter of the swarm. A creature has advantage on the saving throw if the swarm is in dim light. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the swarm until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the swarm in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

action.name: Bites
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage, or 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hp or fewer. The target must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 10 ({@damage 4d4}) poison damage and is euphoric for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't euphoric. A euphoric creature has disadvantage on saving throws. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the swarm remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary patch of fungus.

trait.name: Sporeburst
entries: When the swarm takes bludgeoning, force, piercing, slashing, or thunder damage, it releases puffs of necrotic spores. Each creature within 5 feet of it must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny mushroom. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Detonate
entries: The swarm takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) slashing damage that can't be reduced in any way and releases a plume of spores. Each creature within 5 feet of it must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Downpour
entries: If the swarm moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with an attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Freezing Rain
entries: If the swarm takes cold damage, whenever it hits a creature with an attack before the end of its next turn, the attack deals cold damage instead of its normal damage type.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny hornet. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Stings
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach Oft., one target in the swarm's space. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage, or 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Small ratling. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Chittering Mass
entries: The swarm has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against any creature in its space.

trait.name: Scampering Survivors
entries: When the swarm is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it leaves behind {@dice 1d4} {@creature Ratling Warrior|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Ratling Warriors} in its space.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The swarm makes one Bite attack against each creature in its space.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 0 ft. {@h}28 ({@damage 8d6}) Piercing damage, or 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Piercing damage if the swarm has the {@status Bloodied|XPHB} condition. If the target is a creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}).

bonus.name: Scurrying Horde
entries: The swarm takes the {@action Dash|XPHB} action.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The swarm can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects. In addition, if the swarm is subjected to a spell or other magical effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw.

trait.name: Scornful Reinforcement
entries: When the swarm kills a creature that has a familiar, the familiar joins the swarm, causing the swarm's hit point maximum and current hit points to increase by 10.

trait.name: Spell Detection
entries: The swarm immediately knows when a spell of 3rd-level or higher has been cast within 1000 feet of it, and it can sense the direction to the spellcaster's location.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny familiar.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The swarm makes two attacks.

action.name: Spiteful Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) force damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage, or 7 ({@damage 2d6}) force damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

action.name: Drain Magic
entries: The swarm attempts to siphon some magical power from a creature it can see within 10 feet of it. If the target has any remaining spell slots, it must make a {@dc 16} saving throw using its spellcasting ability. The target makes this saving throw with disadvantage if it has less than half of its spell slots remaining. On a failed save, the target loses one spell slot. Roll a {@dice d6} to determine the level of the spell slot lost. If the target has no remaining spell slots of that level, it instead loses its highest remaining spell slot below that level. The swarm then regains ({@dice 1d8}) hit points per level of the spell slot lost.

reaction.name: Arcane Barrier
entries: The swarm adds 3 to its AC against one attack that would hit it, as it creates an instantaneous shield of force around itself.

trait.name: In Your Face
entries: While the swarm occupies an enemy's space, that creature has disadvantage on attack rolls made against any target other than the swarm and takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) slashing damage if they attack a creature other than the swarm.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny skitterling. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) slashing damage, or 7 ({@damage 2d6}) slashing damage if the swarm has half of their hit points or fewer. The target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the start of their next turn. Creatures who are immune to poison damage or the {@condition poisoned} condition succeed on this saving throw automatically.

trait.name: Sunlight Weakness
entries: While in sunlight, the swarm of sluaghs has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny fey. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

action.name: Chilling Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. {@h}28 ({@damage 8d6}) cold damage, or 14 ({@damage 4d6}) cold damage if the swarm has half of its hp or fewer. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be unable to regain hp for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the swarm of sluaghs takes the Hide action.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The swarm can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny spider. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The swarm ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. {@h}5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) poison damage, or 2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage if the swarm has half their hit points or fewer.

action.name: Too Many Legs
entries: The swarm mobs a creature in their space and attaches to them. When the swarm takes damage other than psychic damage, the attached creature also takes half as much damage. The attached creature has disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than the swarm, and attacks against the attached creature have advantage.

While attached, the swarm can't attack another target. The attached creature or another creature who can reach them can shake off the swarm and detach them as an action. The swarm can detach by spending 5 feet of their movement.

hp.special: 5 + 10 per spell level (the swarm has a number of Hit Dice [d8s] equal to the spell's level)

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The swarm has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the swarm's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can enter and occupy the space of another creature and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny Beast.

action.name: Bites
entries: {@atkr m} {@hitYourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier}, reach 0 ft. {@h}{@damage 2d6 + 1 + summonSpellLevel} Piercing damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The swarm of wharflings can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Snapping Jaws
entries: A creature that attempts to move out of or through the swarm of wharflings must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny wharfling. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

action.name: Pilfering Bites
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. {@h}28 ({@damage 8d6}) piercing damage, or 14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hp or fewer, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or lose one item it is wearing or carrying to the swarm, provided the item weighs no more than 10 pounds, isn't a weapon, and isn't wrapped around or firmly attached to the target, such as a shirt or armor.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The swarm of wolf spirits can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The swarm of wolf spirits doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The swarm of wolf spirits makes two Spectral Bites attacks.

action.name: Spectral Bites
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) cold damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage, or 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) necrotic damage if the swarm has half of its hp or fewer.

action.name: Chilling Howl {@recharge 5}
entries: The swarm of wolf spirits howls, causing cold fear to course through those that hear it. Each creature within 15 feet that can hear the howl must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) cold damage and is {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition frightened}. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more also suffers one level of {@condition exhaustion}. A {@condition frightened} creature can make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Spawn Swarm (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The fungus spawns a swarm of pufflings in the nearest unoccupied space.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 15 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) Slashing damage. If the swordbeak moved 30+ feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Slashing damage.

trait.name: Fey Countenance (1/Turn)
entries: When a creature who can see Sylphise targets her with an attack, power, or spell, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the start of their next turn (no action required).

trait.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
entries: Sylphise can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: Sylphise has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Sylphise makes three Claw attacks or uses Sibilant Whispers twice.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Sibilant Whispers
entries: One creature Sylphise can see within 60 feet of her must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: Sylphise magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Mundane World, or vice versa.

reaction.name: Too Slow!
entries: If a creature misses Sylphise with an attack, she can move up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks from that creature.

name: Tanker
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Chemical Stench
entries: A creature other than a Construct or Undead that starts its turn within 10 feet of the tanker is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Sickened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to the Chemical Stench of all tankers for 1 hour.

trait.name: Special Immunities
entries: The tanker is immune to the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (Acid only).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tanker makes two Slam or Chemical Glob attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Chemical Glob
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 60/120 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) Acid, Cold, or Poison damage (tanker's choice).

action.name: Chemical Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} is subjected to one of the following effects of the tanker's choice:

items.name: Sulfuric Acid
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} 25 ({@damage 10d4}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d4} Acid). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: Liquid Nitrogen
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Cold damage, and the target has the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dc 14}). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: Chlorine Gas
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition (save ends). While {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Flammable
entries: If the elemental takes fire damage, it ignites. It takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns and its weapon attacks deal an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage. If the elemental is subject to heavy rain or takes 5 or more cold damage in a single instance, the flames are extinguished and the effects end.

trait.name: Oil Form
entries: When the elemental moves through water, it uses its swimming speed to skim along the water's surface; it can't submerge below the surface of water without a powerful detergent.

trait.name: Water Form
entries: The elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until it or another creature within reach of the target uses its action to clean the target. This speed reduction can stack; if the target's walking speed is reduced to 0 feet by this effect, it is restrained.

action.name: Arcane Activation
entries: The elemental attempts to possess one Huge or smaller corporeal creature in close proximity to an arcane power source, such as a magitech firearm. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be under the elemental's control until the elemental releases it as a bonus action, or the arcane power source is destroyed or is more than 5 feet from the possessed creature. While the elemental controls a creature in this way, the possessed creature gains the features in the Arcane Possession sidebar.

name: Tar-rasque

trait.name: Concealed Arcane Power Source
entries: After the tar-rasque's Primordial Awakening trait activates, the crystal in the tar-rasque's head can be targeted separately from the tar-rasque (AC 19, 180 hit points, vulnerability to thunder damage, and immunity to all other damage types except bludgeoning, force, piercing, and slashing). It can only be targeted by a creature grappled by the tar-rasque's Necrotar Tongue, or by creatures that Ready an action for when the tar-rasque makes a Necrotar Tongue attack. If the crystal is destroyed, the tar-rasque's current hit points are reduced to 0.

trait.name: Flammable
entries: If the tar-rasque takes fire damage, it ignites. It and any creature it is grappling takes 26 ({@damage 4d12}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns and its melee attacks and Necrotaruption deal an additional 26 ({@damage 4d12}) fire damage. If the tar-rasque is subject to heavy rain or takes 20 or more cold damage in a single instance, the flames are extinguished and the effects end.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the tar-rasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The tar-rasque has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Primordial Awakening (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the tar-rasque would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 390 hit points and it recharges its Necrotaruption. Additionally, the tar-rasque can use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 90,000 XP (180,000 XP total) for defeating the tar-rasque after its Primordial Awakening activates.

trait.name: Refractive Exterior
entries: Any time the tar-rasque is targeted by a magic missile spell, a line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, some of the energy is refracted into a random elemental type and a bolt of energy fires back at the caster as a ranged spell attack using the caster's spell attack modifier, and dealing 13 ({@damage 3d8}) damage on a hit. Roll a d4 to determine the damage type: 1-acid, 2-cold, 3-fire, 4-lightning.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tar-rasque makes five attacks: one with its Necrotar Tongue, two with its Claws, one with its Horns, and one with its Tail. It can use its Necrotaruption instead of its Necrotar Tongue.

action.name: Necrotar Tongue
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 4d4 + 9}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 24} Strength saving throw or be grappled (escape {@dc 24}) and pulled into the tar-rasque's maw. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, takes 19 ({@damage 4d4 + 9}) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns, and the tar-rasque can't use its tongue on another target.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d8 + 8}) slashing damage.

action.name: Horns
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 4d10 + 8}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d6 + 8}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 24} Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Necrotaruption (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The tar-rasque exhales a torrent of thick tar-phlegm in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 42 ({@damage 12d6}) necrotic damage and is restrained until the end of the tar-rasque's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't restrained. In addition, until the end of the tar-rasque's next turn, the area is difficult terrain for other creatures and a creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on its turn takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Arcane Power Source
entries: The crystal in the tarannosaurus' ribcagecan be targeted separately from the tarannosaurus (AC 19, 64 hit points, vulnerability to thunder damage, and immunity to all other damage types except bludgeoning, force, piercing, and slashing). If the tarannosaurus fails a saving throw against an area of effect, the crystal also fails the saving throw.

If the crystal is destroyed the tar elemental possessing the tarannosaurus moves into the nearest unoccupied space without provoking opportunity attacks and the tarannosaurus crumbles into a pile of inanimate bones.

trait.name: Flammable
entries: If the tarannosaurus takes fire damage, it ignites. It takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns and its melee attacks and Taruption deal an additional 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage. If the tarannosaurus is subject to heavy rain or takes 10 or more cold damage in a single instance, the flames are extinguished and the effects end.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tarannosaurus makes two attacks: one with its Bite and one with its Tail. It can't make both attacks against the same target. It can use Taruption in place of the Bite attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}34 ({@damage 4d12 + 8}) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape {@dc 20}). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the tarannosaurus can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d8 + 8}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Taruption (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The tarannosaurus launches a torrent of tar in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the cone that isn't tar- or water-based must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or become restrained for 1 minute. A creature can use its action to make a {@dc 17} Strength check, ending the effect on itself on a success. This area is difficult terrain for 1 minute, or until it is cleaned.

trait.name: Arcane Power Source
entries: The crystal in the tarchaeologist's magitech pistol can be targeted separately from the tarchaeologist (AC 19, 20 hit points, vulnerability to thunder damage, and immunity to all other damage types except bludgeoning, force, piercing, and slashing). If the tarchaeologist fails a saving throw against an area of effect, the crystal also fails the saving throw.

If the crystal is destroyed, or if the tarchaeologist is disarmed of its pistol (it has a +7 modifier on ability checks and saving throws to avoid being disarmed), the mini tar elemental possessing the tarchaeologist moves into the nearest unoccupied space without provoking opportunity attacks and the tarchaeologist falls unconscious and stable.

trait.name: Flammable
entries: If the tarchaeologist takes fire damage, it ignites. It takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns and its melee attacks deal an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage. If the tarchaeologist is subject to heavy rain or takes 5 or more cold damage in a single instance, the flames are extinguished and the effects end.

trait.name: Necromantic Reinvigoration (1/Ever)
entries: If the tarchaeologist is reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 52 hit points, its creature type changes to undead, and it gains immunity to poison damage and the poisoned condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tarchaeologist makes three attacks: one with its Pseudopod, one with its Wrench, and one with its Magitech Pistol.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Wrench
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Magitech Pistol
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target, loud (500 ft.), reload (2). {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Flammable
entries: If the tarling takes fire damage, it ignites. It and any creature it is grappling take 2 ({@damage 1d4}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns and its weapon attacks deal an additional 2 ({@damage 1d4}) fire damage on a hit. If the tarling is subject to heavy rainfall or it takes 5 or more cold damage in a single instance, the flames are extinguished.

trait.name: Oil Form
entries: When the tarling tries to move through water, it instead uses its swimming speed to skim along the water's surface; it can't submerge below the surface of water without a powerful detergent.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Tary is a 15th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks). He has the following spells prepared:

trait.name: Alchemical Defense
entries: Tary's experimental concoctions have granted him resistance to acid and poison damage, and immunity to the {@condition poisoned} condition.

trait.name: Doty
entries: {@creature Doty X|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Doty} moves and acts on Tary's turn, and Tary can use a bonus action to command him to use the {@action Dash}, {@action Dodge}, {@action Disengage}, or {@action Attack} action. He can also command him to {@action Attack} as part of his Multitask action (see below). Doty can take only one action on each of Tary's turns.

trait.name: Focused
entries: Tary has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on Constitution {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1} made to maintain {@status concentration} on spells.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Tary wears a {@item helm of brilliance}, a {@item robe of useful items}, and a {@item ring of the ram}. He carries a {@item rod of mercurial form|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn}, as well as a {@item bag of holding}, {@dice 1d4 + 4} {@item bead of force||beads of force}, a {@item broom of flying}, and a {@item chime of opening}.

trait.name: Toughness
entries: Tary has an additional 30 hit points.

action.name: Multitask
entries: Tary makes two weapon attacks or casts a spell with a casting time of 1 action, and can also command {@creature Doty X|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Doty} to use his Empowered Fist or Repair action.

action.name: Mercurial Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d10 + 1}) slashing damage.

action.name: {@item Bead of Force}
entries: Tary throws a {@item bead of force} up to 60 feet. Each creature within a 10-foot radius of where the bead landed must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or take 12 ({@damage 5d4}) force damage. A sphere of transparent force then encloses the area for 1 minute. A creature that fails the save and is completely within the area is trapped inside the sphere.

reaction.name: Brilliant Intellect
entries: When Tary or another creature he can see within 30 feet of him makes an ability check or a {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}, he can use his reaction to add +4 to the roll.

trait.name: Disaster Prone
entries: When the tatzling makes an ability check or attack roll and rolls a 1 on the d20, the results are often disastrous. The GM has great latitude when deciding the consequences of this trait triggering.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Protect (3/Day)
entries: When a creature the tatzling can see attacks a target that is within 5 feet of the tatzling, it can impose disadvantage on the attack roll provided the attack is against a creature other than the tatzling.

name: Tavern Mimic Brain

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The brain is a 9th-level spellcaster and can cast the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Central Nervous System
entries: The mimic's brain is the central nervous system of the tavern mimic. The first time the brain takes damage on a turn, it takes an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage. As a reaction to taking this damage, the brain can relocate itself to any location within the tavern.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The brain has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the brain fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Sensitive Gut
entries: The brain's blindsight extends throughout its interior structure.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The brain can use its action to polymorph into a different building or back into its true, tavern form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment or creatures it is wearing or carrying aren't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Warded
entries: The brain can't be harmed or affected by attacks or effects that originate from outside of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The brain makes two attacks, one with its Pseudopod and one with its Squirt.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Squirt
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) acid damage.

legendaryHeader: The brain can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The brain regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The brain makes one attack.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The brain casts a spell.

legendary.name: Immune Response (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: A torrent of pus gushes from a 15-foot-radius area of the brain's ceiling. Each creature directly under that area must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

trait.name: Aerial Ace
entries: As long as she's flying, attacks against Tempa are made with disadvantage.

trait.name: Borrowed Flight (Recharges on a Long Rest)
entries: Tempa has a fly speed of 60 feet and can hover. This lasts for 1 hour. Once the effect ends, she gently floats to earth. Tempa must finish a long rest within 5 feet of the {@creature infant amphithere|HumblewoodTales} to recharge this feature. This is a magical effect.

trait.name: Daring Action
entries: Tempa can use a bonus action to take the {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, or {@action Help} action.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: Tempa's long jump is 30 feet, and her base high jump is 15 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Slingshot
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Uncanny Luck (3/Day)
entries: Tempa takes no damage from an attack.

name: Temple Dog
languages: understands Celestial and Common but can't speak

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The temple dog has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Protector's Instincts
entries: The temple dog has advantage on initiative rolls while in its temple or within 30 feet of a priest of its deity.

trait.name: Radiant Jaws
entries: The temple dog's Bite attacks are magical. When it hits with a Bite attack, the Bite deals an extra {@damage 2d6} radiant damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Rushing Bite
entries: If the temple dog moves at least 15 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Bite attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the temple dog. If the target is pushed, the temple dog can move up to 10 feet straight toward the target without provoking opportunity attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The temple dog makes two Bite attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the temple dog sinks in its teeth, shaking its head violently, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) slashing damage and be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and temple dog can't Bite another target.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage.

action.name: Immovable
entries: The tendril can't move or be moved except via teleportation or interplanar travel.

action.name: Immutable Form
entries: The tendril can't shape-shift.

action.name: Necromantic Demise
entries: The tendril disappears if the Spirit of Dendallen is destroyed or dismissed.

action.name: Will of Dendallen
entries: The tendril has a telepathic link with the spirit and the spirit's host while it's on the same plane of existence as them. The tendril doesn't provide cover to enemies against attacks and effects that pass through its space.

action.name: Grasp
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) Force damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Acid damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}) and is pulled up to 5 feet toward the tendril. The tendril can have only one target {@condition Grappled|XPHB} in this way at a time.

action.name: Fling
entries: The tendril throws a Medium or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by it to a space it can see within 60 feet of itself that isn't in the air. {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}, the creature thrown and each creature in the destination space. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Teleport
entries: The tendril teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see on a solid surface.

name: Tendril Puppet
languages: understands the languages of its vine lord but can't speak

trait.name: Green Regeneration
entries: While in a forest, the tendril puppet regains 5 hp at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hp.

trait.name: Root Mind
entries: The vine lord and the tendril puppets it has created are connected via a hive mind. The vine lord and its puppets can telepathically communicate with each other, provided the communicating creatures are within 1 mile of each other. In addition, while in a forest, the tendril puppet can't be surprised.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The tendril puppet has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Woodland Walk
entries: Difficult terrain composed of nonmagical plants doesn't cost the tendril puppet extra movement, and it can pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.

action.name: Thorned Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Ball of Thorns
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 4d4 + 2}) piercing damage, and the ball bursts, scattering sharp thorns around the target. Each creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Malleable
entries: The dreg can move through a space as narrow as 6 inches wide without expending extra movement to do so.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dreg makes two Tentacle Slap attacks.

action.name: Tentacle Slap
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 15 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Constricting Tentacle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 15 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 13}). Until this grapple ends, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition, takes 10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns, and the dreg can't make Constricting Tentacle attacks.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The terror bird has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the bird's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Passing Bite
entries: Terror birds who move at least 20 feet straight toward a target have advantage on the next attack roll against that target.

action.name: Serrated Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) slashing damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) slashing damage at the beginning of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Tetra casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

spellcasting.name: Misty Step (3/Day)
headerEntries: Tetra casts {@spell Misty Step|XPHB}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

spellcasting.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
headerEntries: Tetra casts {@spell Counterspell|XPHB} or {@spell Shield|XPHB} in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

trait.name: Reactive Mutations
entries: Immediately after the ooze takes damage, it gains resistance to that damage type. The ooze can have up to two resistances from this trait. If the ooze has its maximum number of resistances, the oldest resistance is lost when a new one is gained.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The ooze moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Tiny creatures' spaces. Whenever the ooze enters a creature's space, the creature must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the ooze. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

On a failed save, the ooze enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is {@condition restrained}, and takes 10 ({@damage 4d4}) acid damage at the start of each of the ooze's turns. When the ooze moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a {@dc 12} Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) acid damage and the target suffers one of the following random effects (roll a {@dice d4}):
1. The target takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) force damage.
2. The target takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) bludgeoning damage.
3. The target takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage.
4. The target takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) slashing damage

name: Tevor of the Spring Path
languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

trait.name: Glide
entries: When falling at least 10 feet, Tevor can spend a reaction to fly up to his speed in one direction as he descends. He lands in an unoccupied space at the end of his movement, and takes no falling damage. He cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though he can drop any held items as part of his reaction).

trait.name: Wing Flap
entries: As a bonus action, Tevor can use his powerful feathered arms to propel himself upward up to half his movement speed. He can use it in conjunction with a regular jump, but not while gliding.

trait.name: Fated (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: Tevor can choose to reroll any attack roll, skill check, or saving throw.

trait.name: Resilience
entries: Tevor rolls with advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned}.

trait.name: Drop Attack
entries: Tevor can make an attack during his glide. If he does, he deals an extra 4 ({@damage 1d8}) points of damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage or 6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage if used with both hands.

action.name: Tender Healing (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: Tevor casts the {@spell cure wounds} spell at 1st level. Wisdom is his spellcasting ability for this spell.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Tharahsk hunter casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Tharashk hunter makes two Spear Thrust attacks and uses Set a Trap.

action.name: Spear Thrust
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage, and the Tharashk hunter pushes the target 5 feet back.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 80/320 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Set a Trap
entries: The Tharashk hunter creates a magical trap in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. A trap persists for 10 minutes or until it is triggered. The Tharashk hunter can use an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} on a subsequent turn to hide a trap it has set. A creature must succeed on a {@dc 12} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) or Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) check to find a hidden trap. The Tharashk hunter can have no more than five traps active at any given time. If it places a sixth trap, the Tharashk hunter can choose one currently active trap to deactivate. {@actSave dex} {@dc 12}, a creature that moved into the space. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 2d12}) Piercing damage and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. A {@condition Restrained|XPHB} creature can use an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} to make a {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) check, ending the effect on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Tharian casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks):

spellcasting.name: Hellish Rebuke
headerEntries: Tharian casts {@spell Hellish Rebuke|XPHB} in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

trait.name: Fiendish Infusion
entries: Attacks and spells that deal Fire damage instead deal Necrotic or Poison damage (his choice).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Tharian makes three Pact Axe attacks.

action.name: Pact Axe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 13 ({@dice 3d8}) Necroticor Poisondamage.

name: Thaumaturge Archmage
languages: one regional language plus five other languages

trait.name: Collaborative Rift Control
entries: When multiple Thaumaturge Archmages capable of creating and controlling Arcane Rifts are present, they can interact with each other's rifts, and for every additional Thaumaturge Archmage, the maximum possible level of each rift increases by 2, up to a maximum of 15.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the archmage fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The archmage has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Personalized Arcane Burst
entries: Each archmage is specialized in one pair of damage types from the following list:

items: Acid and Poison
Bludgeoning and Necrotic
Cold and Fire

entries: When the archmage uses the Arcane Burst action, it can choose to change the attack's damage type from Force to one of the two selected damage types.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The archmage makes four Arcane Burst attacks or makes two Arcane Burst attacks and uses the Spellcasting action.

action.name: Arcane Burst
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 150 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) Force damage and the creature is pushed back 10 feet.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The archmage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}):

bonus.name: Misty Step
entries: The archmage casts {@spell Misty Step|XPHB}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

reaction.name: Arcane Contingency
entries: {@actTrigger} The archmage is reduced to 40 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or less. {@actResponse} The archmage can cast {@spell Dimension Door|XPHB}. This does not consume a use of the spell.

reaction.name: Arcane Countermeasure
entries: {@actTrigger} The archmage is targeted by a spell, or the archmage is in the area of effect of a spell being cast. {@actResponse} The archmage casts {@spell Shield|XPHB} or {@spell Counterspell|XPHB}, or casts {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} targeting a spell in response to seeing that spell take effect. The archmage uses the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The archmage uses the Spellcasting action.

legendary.name: Create Arcane Rift (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The archmage creates a level 5 Arcane Rift in an unoccupied space the archmage can see within 120 feet. The Arcane Rift is a Large magical object, which hovers, has 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} per Arcane Rift level, and has an {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB|AC} of 17. In addition to standard object properties, the Arcane Rift is Resistant to damage from spells and spell effects and is  {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immune} to all conditions.
Creatures within 30 feet of the Arcane Rift treat all movement away from the Arcane Rift as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}.

The Arcane Rift can be dispelled with a {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} spell, treating the Arcane Rift's level as its spell level. It can also be destroyed if targeted by a {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB} spell.

items.name: Infuse Arcane Rift
entries: The archmage increases the level of one Arcane Rift it can see within 120 feet by 2, up to a maximum level of 9.

items.name: Ignite Arcane Rift
entries: The archmage causes one Arcane Rift it can see within 120 feet to expand to Huge or Gargantuan size before exploding, destroying the Arcane Rift. All creatures within 30 feet are subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Force damage per Arcane Rift level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

items.name: Arcane Rift Summoning
entries: The archmage targets one Arcane Rift it can see within 120 feet, funneling its magic to cast {@spell Summon Dragon|XPHB} using the Arcane Rift level as the Spell Slot level, destroying the Arcane Rift in the process. Upon summoning, the archmage can change the summoned creature's creature type to any of the following: Aberration, Beast, Elemental, Fiend, or Monstrosity. This casting requires no somatic or material components.

name: Thaumaturge Initiated
languages: one regional language plus three other languages

trait.name: Disguise Other
entries: When the initiated casts {@spell Disguise Self|XPHB}, it can choose to have it affect up to 3 additional creatures (including {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostiles}) that it can see within 60 feet. It can choose the same or different disguises for each affected creature. When cast in this manner, the effect lasts for 1 minute or until the initiated chooses to dismiss it from that creature.

trait.name: Personalized Arcane Burst
entries: Each initiated is specialized in one pair of damage types from the following list:

items: Acid and Poison
Bludgeoning and Necrotic
Cold and Fire

entries: When the initiated uses the Arcane Burst action, it can choose to change the attack's damage type from Force to one of the two selected damage types.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The initiated makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

action.name: Arcane Burst
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) Force damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The initiated casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

bonus.name: Malignant Transposition (3/Day)
entries: The initiated creates clouds in a 5-ft radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} in its space and in up to three additional spaces it can see within 60 feet. The Spheres are {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB} except to the initiated. The Spheres last until the start of the initiate's next turn, or they can be dispersed by a strong wind.

When the clouds appear, the initiated can target one creature in one cloud with the following effect. {@actSave cha} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The creature swaps places with the initiated. The initiated can also teleport themselves to an unoccupied space within one of the other clouds.

reaction.name: Arcane Reflection (3/Day)
entries: The initiated casts {@spell Shield|XPHB} in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. If the triggering attack misses and it is a spell or {@variantrule Magical Effect|XPHB}, the initiated can immediately end the {@spell Shield|XPHB} spell to have the triggering attack target another creature within range of the spell's originator.

hp.special: 305 (15d20 + 150) plus 300 (15d20 + 150) per player character

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (1/Round)
headerEntries: The Algorithm casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 27}):

trait.name: Electronic Data Network
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the Algorithm takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Lightning damage.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The Algorithm is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Predictive Analytics
entries: At the end of each of the Algorithm's turns, it rolls {@dice 1d20} for each player character fighting it. The Algorithm can replace any {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} made by it or a creature it can see with one of these predictive rolls. It must choose to do so before the roll, and it can replace a roll in this way only once per turn.
Each predictive roll can be used only once. Any unused predictive rolls are lost at the start of the Algorithm's next turn.

action.name: The Algorithm always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the Algorithm can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Algorithm takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Wire
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 26}, one creature the Algorithm can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 2d10 + 10}) Force damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 20}). The Algorithm can grapple up to six creatures at a time.

items.name: Algorithmic Manipulation
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 26}, one Huge or smaller creature or object the Algorithm can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} The Algorithm moves the target up to 30 feet in any direction, and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. If the Algorithm lifts the target into the air, it is suspended there. The target remains held until the Algorithm releases it (no action required), uses this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} again, or has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Deatomization
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 26}, one creature or object the Algorithm can see within 300 feet. {@actSaveFail} 65 ({@damage 10d12}) Necrotic damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it dies and its body is reduced to atoms. {@actSaveFail} Half damage.

action.name: Reprogram (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 26}, one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the algorithm. {@actSaveFail} 55 ({@damage 10d10}) Piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it dies and its brain is replaced with mechanical components. The target reanimates at the start of its next turn as a Construct under the Algorithm's control. It resembles the original creature, but its eyes glow with synthetic green light, and its body is covered in protruding wires, metal scraps, and glowing tubes.

action.name: Assuming Direct Control (1/Round)
entries: The Algorithm targets a Construct within 120 feet and immediately enters and takes control of it. The Algorithm can still use its {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} as normal and replaces the Construct's game statistics with its own, except the Construct's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. When the Construct is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the Algorithm reemerges in an unoccupied space within 15 feet of it.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The Algorithm chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Algorithm can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

spellcasting.name: Undying Mount {@recharge 5}
headerEntries: The king casts {@spell Phantom Steed|XPHB}, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability. The conjured steed takes no damage from areas of effect. The spell ends early if the king casts it again.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
entries: If the king fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The king has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Marshall Undead
entries: Undead creatures of the king's choice (excluding himself) in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from him have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and saving throws. He can't use this trait if he has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Name of Rest
entries: The king has AC 10 against attack rolls made with a weapon inscribed with the runic form of his original name, and the king has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls made against a creature holding such a weapon.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The king makes three Soul Blade attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of Life Drain.

action.name: Soul Blade
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 14}, reach 5 ft. or range 40/80 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d6 + 7}) Slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Necrotic damage. {@hom}The blade magically returns to the king's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 22}, one creature within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} 16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) Necrotic damage, and the target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.
A Humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a {@creature Wight|XMM} under the king's control, unless the Humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed.

action.name: Blade Storm {@recharge 5}
entries: The king's blade flies in a deadly arc around him. {@actSave dex} {@dc 22}, each creature of the king's choice in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from him. {@actSaveFail} A creature takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Force damage and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: {@actTrigger} The king is hit by an attack roll while holding a weapon or shield. {@actResponse} The king adds 7 to his AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

legendary.name: Death Grasp
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 22}, one creature the king can see within 100 feet. {@actSaveFail} A ghostly, skeletal arm pulls the target up to 40 feet closer to the king, and the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Grim Charge
entries: The king moves up to his {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} (or commands his mount to move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}) and makes one Soul Blade attack.

legendary.name: Lord's Call
entries: The king magically summons two {@creature Wight|XMM|Wights} into unoccupied spaces he can see within 30 feet of himself.

The wights obey the king and take their turn immediately after him on the same {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count. A wight vanishes after 1 hour, when it or the king dies, or when the king uses this action again. A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of a wight must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn. The king can't use this action again until the start of his next turn.

spellcasting.name: Project Image
headerEntries: The beast casts the {@spell Project Image|XPHB} spell, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability. During the spell's duration, the beast can use its Spew Blight action and Rot Stride {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} as if it were in the image's space.

trait.name: Blighted Overgrowth
entries: While the beast is {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls, its Spew Blight action recharges at the start of its turn, and if it has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} at the start of its turn, it regains 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.
If it takes Fire damage, it doesn't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Fungal Step
entries: The beast ignores {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} caused by plants or fungi.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the beast fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Unraveled Longing
entries: If the beast can see the likeness of its long-lost love at the start of its turn, the beast takes 10 Psychic damage and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The beast makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 17}) from one of two claws. If the beast moved at least 20 feet immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Spew Blight {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it automatically succeeds. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Rot Stride
entries: The beast teleports to an unoccupied space within 60 feet. Either its starting or destination space must contain fungus or rotting organic matter.

legendary.name: Hallucinate
entries: The beast exhales hallucinatory spores. {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, one creature within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target is affected by the {@spell Confusion|XPHB} spell until the start of the beast's next turn. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The beast can't use this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Impale
entries: The beast impales a creature it is grappling on one of its exposed ribs (it can have two creatures impaled at a time). {@actSave str} {@dc 19}, one creature the beast is grappling. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Piercing damage, and the target now has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 17}) from an impaling rib, and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The beast can't use this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Trample
entries: The beast moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}. A Large or smaller creature in a space the beast enters must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

spellcasting.name: Cataclysmic Spellcasting (1/Day)
headerEntries: The Brimstone Behemoth casts {@spell Earthquake|XPHB} and {@spell Meteor Swarm|XPHB}, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 24}).

trait.name: Burning Sacrifice
entries: If a creature willingly sacrifices its life in fire or lava for the purpose of defeating the behemoth, the creature can't be returned to life by any means. For the next 24 hours, the behemoth has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests}, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved, it has {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Radiant damage, and it loses its Legendary {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} trait.

trait.name: Consuming Flame
entries: When the behemoth deals Fire damage, it can choose to deal Necrotic damage instead.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
entries: If the behemoth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The behemoth has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The behemoth deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The behemoth can burrow through solid rock at half its {@variantrule Burrow Speed|XPHB} and leaves a 20-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The behemoth makes one Bite attack, and it makes two Claw or Blazing Boulder attacks in any combination.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 18}, reach 15 ft. {@h}26 ({@damage 3d10 + 10}) Slashing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 20}). Until the grapple ends, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 18}, reach 15 ft. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d8 + 10}) Slashing damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Fire damage.

action.name: Blazing Boulder
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 18}, range 150 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 1d10 + 10}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

reaction.name: Hellish Rebuke
entries: The behemoth casts {@spell Hellish Rebuke|XPHB} in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Cataclysmic Spellcasting.

legendary.name: Fire Rain
entries: The behemoth makes one Blazing Boulder attack.

legendary.name: Lava Well
entries: The behemoth causes lava to cover the ground in its space and in any unoccupied spaces in any tunnels it left by burrowing within 100 feet. A creature that touches the lava for the first time on a turn or starts its turn in the lava takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) Fire damage. A creature takes this damage only once per round.
The lava cools and hardens after 1 hour or when the behemoth uses this action again. The behemoth can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Trample
entries: The behemoth moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, and it makes one Claw attack. On a hit, if the target is a creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

spellcasting.name: Etherealness
headerEntries: The reaper casts the {@spell Etherealness|XPHB} spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability. The reaper is visible on the Material Plane while on the Border Ethereal and vice versa, but it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

trait.name: Ancestral Shame
entries: If a creature that can speak Orc within 30 feet of the reaper takes an action to read aloud the names carved in the stone on the reaper's back, the reaper takes 20 Radiant damage.

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The reaper can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The reaper can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the reaper fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The reaper makes one Balefire Scythe attack and one Chain attack, and it uses either Chain Slam or Fling.

action.name: Balefire Scythe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 15 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Necrotic damage, and the target begins burning. It takes Necrotic damage instead of Fire damage while burning in this way.

action.name: Chain
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 20 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}) from one of four chains.

action.name: Chain Slam
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, each creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the reaper. {@actSaveFail} 9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the start of the reaper's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Fling
entries: The reaper throws a Large or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by it to a space it can see within 30 feet of itself that isn't in the air. {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, the creature thrown and each creature in the destination space. {@actSaveFail} 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

legendary.name: Balefire Scythe
entries: The reaper makes one Balefire Scythe attack. The reaper can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Drift
entries: The reaper moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

legendary.name: Lantern Flare
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 17}, each creature of the reaper's choice in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from it. {@actSaveFail} The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks and attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The abbot casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):
will: {@spell Disguise Self|XPHB} (can appear as a Medium Humanoid, 24-hour duration)

trait.name: Honor Lost
entries: If a creature takes a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to present a memento or recite a reminder of the abbot's past and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) check, the abbot has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} he makes before the start of the creature's next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the abbot fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The abbot can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: The abbot takes 20 Radiant damage if he starts his turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, he has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The abbot makes two Sanguine Blade attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of Blood Call.

action.name: Sanguine Blade
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Blood Call
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15}, one creature other than a Construct or Undead within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum is reduced by the damage taken. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The abbot regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the damage taken. A Humanoid reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by this damage and then buried rises the following sunset as a {@creature Crimson Clergy|CrookedMoon24} under the abbot's control.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: {@actTrigger} The abbot is hit by an attack roll while holding a weapon. {@actResponse} The abbot adds 3 to his AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

legendary.name: Bloody Strike
entries: The abbot moves up to half his {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and makes one Sanguine Blade attack.

legendary.name: Castigate
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, one creature within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition and repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
