On a failed save, a target becomes {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target is also {@condition stunned} while {@condition frightened} in this way. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the Wight-king's Strike Fear for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Wight Song
entries: The Wight-king chants a low, chilling song to subdue a creature other than an Elf or a Wizard within 30 feet of him who can hear him with the dark enchantment of his voice. The target gains 3 Shadow points from Sorcery, resisted by a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target succumbs to a magical slumber, falling {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute or until it takes damage, or someone uses an action to shake it awake. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target is {@condition unconscious} for 1 hour instead and cannot be shaken awake. A creature that successfully saves against the effect is {@condition stunned} until the end of the Wight-king's next turn unless it succeeds by 5 or more, and is immune to the Wight-king's song for the next 24 hours.

bonus.name: Darker than Darkness {@recharge}
entries: As a bonus action, the Wight-king can summon a magical darkness spreading from a point of the Wight-king's choice to fill a 30-foot-radius sphere for 1 minute. The darkness spreads around corners. Non-magical light cannot illuminate this darkness.

name: The Wild Hunt

trait.name: Hunter's Prowess
entries: The Wild Hunt have advantage on attack rolls against a target if they are occupying the same space as the target and there are not other hostile creatures in The Wild Hunt's space.

trait.name: Incorporeal Swarm
entries: The Wild Hunt can occupy another creature's space and vice versa. The Wild Hunt can also move through any opening large enough for a Medium creature, and they can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. The Wild Hunt take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if they end their turn inside an object.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Wild Hunt have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Wild Hunt make two mauling rend attacks. They can use their Volley in place of one attack.

action.name: Mauling Rend
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage, plus 9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage, or 7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) slashing damage if The Wild Hunt have half their hit points or fewer.

action.name: Volley
entries: The Wild Hunt releases a flurry of arrows, targeting a point they can see within 120 feet of them. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder centered on that point must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If The Wild Hunt have half their hit points or fewer, a target instead takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage on a failed save, or no damage on a successful one.

legendaryHeader: The Wild Hunt can take 2 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Wild Hunt regain spent legendary actions at the start of their turn.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The Wild Hunt moves up to its speed.

legendary.name: Rallying Horn (Below Half Hit Points Only)
entries: The Wild Hunt gain 13 ({@dice 2d12}) temporary hit points.

legendary.name: War Horn (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Whenever a target takes damage from The Wild Hunt before the end of their next turn, the target takes an extra 4 ({@damage 1d8}) force damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day or 5/Day in Lair)
entries: If the titan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The titan has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Runic Sever
entries: If the titan starts its turn within 50 feet of a stone at least 10 feet high and 10 feet wide that is carved with the glyph representing its forgotten creator, the titan takes 50 Necrotic damage and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The titan deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The titan makes two Massive Fist attacks. It can replace one or both attacks with a use of Thrown Boulder.

action.name: Massive Fist
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 17}, reach 20 ft. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d8 + 10}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 20}) from one of two fists, and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends.

action.name: Thrown Boulder
entries: The titan hurls a boulder at a point it can see within 150 feet. {@actSave dex} {@dc 25}, each creature in a 10-foot radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on that point. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Wild Roar {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 19}, each of the titan's enemies in a 100-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the titan. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the start of the titan's next turn. While {@condition Charmed|XPHB} in this way, the creature must use its action to make its most powerful melee or ranged attacks against the nearest creature it can see.

legendary.name: Arm Sweep
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 25}, each creature in a 20-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The titan can't use this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Crushing Hurl
entries: The titan hurls an object it is holding, a creature it is grappling, or a Large clod of earth to a space within 100 feet. {@actSave dex} {@dc 25}, each creature in the projectile's space, including a hurled creature. {@actSaveFail} 19 ({@damage 2d8 + 10}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The titan can't use this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Stomping Stride
entries: The titan moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}. It can enter a Huge or smaller creature's space, and the creature is pushed to nearest unoccupied space.

hp.special: 205 (10d20 + 100) plus 205 (10d20 + 100) per player character

trait.name: Delerium Storm Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the World Ender takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Lightning damage and is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 24}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The World Ender is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Mutations Abound
entries: A creature that gains a {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level from the World Ender's Delerium Storm Aura must roll {@dice 2d6} and take the lower result to determine if they mutate. Whenever a creature within the aura gains a mutation, that creature must roll twice on the {@table Mutations|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} table and gains both mutations.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If the World Ender is destroyed, it regains all of its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} in 1 hour unless a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell is used to prevent it from rejuvenating. This is a stressful use of the {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The World Ender deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Unbound Arcana
entries: Whenever the World Ender is the target of a spell, an {@table Arcane Anomalies|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} is triggered on the caster.

action.name: The World Ender always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the World Ender can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the World Ender takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

action.name: Necrotic Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 19}, reach 15 ft. {@h}37 ({@damage 5d10 + 10}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Bite (1/Round)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 19}, reach 15 ft. {@h}26 ({@damage 3d10 + 10}) Piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 27}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and the World Ender can't Bite another target.

action.name: Charge Eradication Beam {@recharge 5}
entries: Octarine energy ripples through the body of the World Ender from its tail up to its head. The World Ender's Eradication Beam recharges, and it chooses the direction it will face to unleash its Eradication Beam.

The World Ender can only use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} if it's the first {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} it has taken this round. After using this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, The World Ender can't use Bite, Bellowing Roar, or Devour until the start of the next round.

action.name: Eradication Beam (Special Recharge)
entries: The World Ender can only use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} if it's the last {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} it takes this round. {@actSave con} {@dc 27}, each creature and object in a 1000-foot long, 20-foot wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 110 ({@damage 20d10}) Force damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} A creature is disintegrated along with anything it is wearing or carrying if this damage leaves it with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and can't be revived except by a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell.

The Eradication Beam destroys any {@spell Wall of Force|XPHB}, {@spell Forcecage|XPHB}, or {@spell Prismatic Wall|XPHB} spell within its area. It also damages unattended magic items in its area, including artifacts.

action.name: Octarine Lightning Strike
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 27}, each creature in a 10-foot radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within 500 feet. {@actSaveFail} 54 ({@damage 12d8}) Lightning damage, and the target has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Bellowing Roar (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 27}, each creature in a 120-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the World Ender that can hear it. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition (save ends). While {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Ground Slam (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 27}, each creature on the ground in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 26 ({@damage 4d12}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the World Ender and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} becomes {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} until the start of the World Ender's next turn.

action.name: Devour
entries: The World Ender can't take this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} if it has used its Bite {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} this round. The World ender makes a Bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it has {@condition Grappled|XPHB}. If the attack hits, the target takes the Bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, it has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against effects originating from outside the World Ender, and it takes 56 ({@damage 16d6}) Acid damage and gains a {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level at the start of each of the World Ender's turns.

If the World Ender takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the World Ender must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land in unoccupied spaces within 10 feet of the World Ender with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. If the World Ender dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and can escape from the corpse by using 30 feet of movement, exiting with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The World Ender chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The World Ender can use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

hp.special: 125 (7d20 + 49) plus 125 (7d20 + 49) per player character

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics; 1/Round)
headerEntries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 26}):

trait.name: Avoidance
entries: If the Thing with the Writhing Tail is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Inscrutable
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the being's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Purring Aura
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail projects a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of madness and dread. A creature that ends its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 hour. A creature can take an action to attempt to overcome its fear, making a {@dc 25} Wisdom saving throw. {@actSaveFail} The target takes 27 ({@damage 5d10}) Psychic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} The {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition ends for that creature, and it becomes immune to the Purring Aura of the Thing with the Writhing Tail for 24 hours.

trait.name: Quantum Displacement
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail shifts between realities and timelines. Attack rolls against it have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}, and it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws. If it is hit by an attack or fails a saving throw, this trait is disrupted until it uses Phase Displacement. This trait is also disrupted while the Thing with the Writhing Tail has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition or a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 0.

action.name: The Thing with the Writhing Tail always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, The Thing with the Writhing Tail can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, The Thing with the Writhing Tail takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

action.name: Cosmic Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 15}, reach 10 ft. {@h}29 ({@damage 4d10 + 8}) Force damage.

action.name: Tail Whip
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 26}, one creature the Thing with the Writhing Tail can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends). Failure by 5 or More: 70 ({@damage 20d6}) Psychic damage, and the target instead has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Manifest Duplicate (1/Round)
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail creates a perfect visual illusion of itself in an unoccupied space it can see within 300 feet. The illusion is intangible and doesn't occupy its space. The duplicate lasts for 1 minute, but it ends early if the Thing with the Writhing Tail dismisses it (no action required) or has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. The Thing with the Writhing Tail can have a up to eight illusory duplicates at a time. While it has one or more duplicates, it has the following benefits:

action.name: Attacks and Spells
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail can cast spells, use Tail Whip, and make Claw attacks as if was in an illusory duplicate's space.

action.name: Aura Expansion
entries: Each illusory duplicate emanates a Purring Aura. The effects of multiple overlapping auras do not stack; a creature is only affected once by the Purring Aura even if it is within range of multiple Emanations.

action.name: Move
entries: Each time the Thing with the Writhing Tail takes this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, it can move any number of illusions up to 60 feet to unoccupied spaces within 300 feet of itself.

action.name: Distract
entries: When both the Thing with the Writhing Tail and one of its illusory duplicates are within 10 feet of a creature that can see them, the Thing with the Writhing Tail has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against that creature.

action.name: Sense
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail can see and hear through each of its illusory duplicates.

action.name: Phase Displacement
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail teleports, swapping places with one of its illusory duplicates. If its Quantum Displacement trait was disrupted, it is no longer disrupted.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting it and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Thing with the Writhing Tail can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

hp.special: 100 (8d10 + 56) plus 100 (8d10 + 56) per palyer character

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The Think Tank is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The Think Tank may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Life Support System
entries: The Think Tank is protected by three machine nodes that make up its Life Support System. The nodes are positioned in a triangle, each no further than 30 feet apart from the rest. Each node is a Large object with AC 20, 25 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} per player character, and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage. The Think Tank can't move or be moved more than 60 feet away from any two of its Life Support System nodes.

trait.name: Nightmare Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the Think Tank takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage.

trait.name: Shield Generator
entries: As long as at least one machine node in the Life Support System remains, the Think Tank's {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immunities} can't be ignored except by effects caused by level 9 spells or artifacts. If all nodes are destroyed, the Think Tank loses its {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immunities}.

trait.name: Telepathic Eavesdropping
entries: The Think Tank can project its consciousness to see and hear any creature or location within 5 miles as if it had cast {@spell Scrying|XPHB} (no action required). It can read the thoughts of creatures in this area, communicate with them telepathically, and listen in on telepathic communications which occur between other creatures in the region. It remains aware of its own surroundings while doing so. It cannot observe the area within a Private Sanctum spell or locations and creatures protected by magic which blocks divination or scrying sensors.

action.name: The Think Tank always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the Think Tank can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Think Tank takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Contaminated Blast
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 12}, reach 10 ft., or range 120 ft. {@h}32 ({@damage 4d12 + 6}) Necrotic damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 20}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains a {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

items.name: Telekinetic Grip
entries: The Think Tank reaches out with its mind to hold one creature or object it can see within 120 feet of it in its psychic grasp. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave str} {@dc 20}. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Force damage, and the target is moved up to 30 feet in any direction and has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until it escapes or the Think Tank has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. The Think Tank can hold up to two creatures or objects in its grip at one time. On its turn, a held creature can take an action to repeat the save, escaping the grip on a success.

If the target is an object weighing 1,000 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is telekinetically moved up to 30 feet in any direction. The Think Tank can also exert fine control on objects with its telekinesis, such as manipulating surgical tools or opening a door or a container.

items.name: Pluck the Puppet Strings
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 20}, one creature within 120 feet of the Think Tank. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage, and the target must use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} directly toward a creature of the Think Tank's choice. If the target ends this movement within reach of the chosen creature, it must make a melee weapon attack against that creature with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Mind Cage (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 20}, one creature the Think Tank can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveSuccess} 33 ({@damage 6d10}) Psychic damage. {@actSaveFail} 33 ({@damage 6d10}) Psychic damage, and the target perceives itself to be trapped within a nightmare conjured forth from the depths of its own psyche until it escapes. While trapped, the target has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, and {@condition Deafened|XPHB} conditions. On its turn, the target can take an action to repeat the save. Each time it does, it takes 33 ({@damage 6d10}) psychic damage. On a success, the effect ends for it.

action.name: Unbind Gravity (1/Round)
entries: The Think Tank controls gravity in a 200-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} centered on itself until the end of the next round. Each time the Think Tank uses this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, it decides which direction gravity pulls within the area. All creatures and objects that aren't somehow anchored to the ground in the area fall in the chosen direction until they reach the edge of the area. A creature can make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw to grab onto a fixed object it can reach, avoiding the fall on a success.

If some solid object (such as a ceiling) is encountered in this fall, falling objects and creatures strike it just as they would during a normal downward fall. If an object or creature reaches the edge of the area without striking anything, it remains there, oscillating slightly, for the duration.

Alternatively, the Think Tank can decide to prevent gravity from acting within the area. When it does, creatures within the area without a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} levitate in midair, and must move by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows them to move as if they were climbing. Unattended objects float around randomly.
If the Think Tank doesn't use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} during the next round, the effect ends and affected objects and creatures fall back down.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The Think Tank chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Think Tank can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

trait.name: Corpse Retreat (1/Day)
entries: The thornblood is a mass of thick, thorny vines that grow from a Medium humanoid corpse. When the thornblood is reduced to 0 hit points, they are reduced to 1 hit point instead and retreat into the corpse that grew them.

The thornblood becomes immune to all damage until the end of their next turn. Additionally, until the thornblood finishes a long rest, their size becomes Medium, their walking and climbing speeds become 60 feet, and they can't make Throttle attacks or benefit from the Overgrowth trait.

trait.name: Overgrowth
entries: The thornblood can move their vines through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. The thornblood can occupy another creature's space and vice versa.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: The thornblood has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thornblood makes four attacks using Vinerip, Throttle, or both.

action.name: Vinerip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) piercing damage, and the target is pulled up to 30 feet toward the thornblood.

action.name: Throttle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the thornblood's space. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) piercing damage, and the target is entangled in thorny vines. While entangled, the target is {@condition restrained} and moves with the thornblood, can't see outside their space, and takes 20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) piercing damage at the start of each of their turns. The target or another creature within 5 feet of them can use their action to take 20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) slashing damage and make a {@dc 20} Strength check, freeing the target on a success.

action.name: From Life, Lightning (2/Day)
entries: The thornblood must have at least one creature entangled to use this action. Each creature entangled by the thornblood must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw, taking 55 ({@damage 10d10}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Then the thornblood shoots a bolt of lightning at each enemy within 60 feet of them who isn't entangled by them. Each target must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 ({@damage 10d10}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: You're Mine
entries: The thornblood moves an entangled creature to a space occupied by the thornblood that isn't also occupied by another creature or object.

reaction.name: Hostile Roots
entries: When an enemy ends their turn in the thornblood's space, the thornblood attempts to pull them down. The target must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Needles
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Ever Vigilant
entries: At least two of the thrudgelmir's heads are awake at all times. The creature has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The thrudgelmir has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Runic Tattoos
entries: The thrudgelmir giant's body is covered in magical, runic tattoos. A successful {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} cast on the tattoos (against {@dc 15}) causes them to vanish for 1 minute. During that time, the thrudgelmir loses its Magic Resistance and the energy damage from its Elemental Hammer attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thrudgelmir makes three Elemental Hammer attacks.

action.name: Elemental Hammer
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d8 + 8}) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) damage (roll {@dice 1d6} to determine damage type: 1. Acid, 2. Cold, 3. Fire, 4. Lightning, 5. Poison, 6. Thunder).

action.name: Faces of Evil {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} All creatures within 30 feet of the thrudgelmir that can see it are subjected to one of the following conditions or effects until the end of the giant's next turn.

rows: {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on all {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests}
The creature sees allies as enemies and the thrudgelmir as an ally

trait.name: Chilling Presence
entries: At the start of each of the thuellai's turns, each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage. For each minute a creature spends within 15 feet of the thuellai, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of {@condition exhaustion} from cold exposure. Unprotected, nonmagical flames within 15 feet of the thuellai are extinguished. Any spells of 3rd level or lower that provide resistance to cold damage and that are within 15 feet of the thuellai immediately end. Water freezes if it remains within 15 feet of the thuellai for at least 1 minute.

trait.name: Elemental Nature
entries: The thuellai doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Snowsight
entries: The thuellai can see through areas obscured by snowfall, sleet, rain, and other wintry precipitation without penalty.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thuellai makes three Icy Claw attacks.

action.name: Icy Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Freezing Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The thuellai exhales an icy blast in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking 49 ({@damage 14d6}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The thunderbird's innate spellcasting ability is Constitution (spell save {@dc 17}). The thunderbird can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The thunderbird has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The thunderbird deals double damage to objects and structures (included in {@spell Thunderclap|XGE}).

action.name: Nultiattack
entries: The thunderbird makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d8 + 9}) piercing damage plus 13 ({@damage 2d12}) lightning damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d6 + 9}) slashing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the thunderbird can't use its talons on another target.

action.name: Thunderclap {@recharge 5}
entries: The thunderbird flaps its wings, unleashing a powerful, concussive burst upon the surrounding area. The burst deals 100 thunder damage to all structures within 60 feet of the thunderbird, and each creature in the area must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 39 ({@damage 6d12}) thunder damage and is pushed 30 feet away from the thunderbird and knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed or knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Cast Iron Stomach
entries: The thursir has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned}.

trait.name: Alignment
entries: The alignment of an thursir is neutral evil (50%) or lawful evil (50%).

action.name: Warhammer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, or 15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Runic Blood (3/Day)
entries: The thursir touches a weapon, painting the thurs rune on the weapon in the thursir's blood. When the thursir hits with the weapon while the rune is active, the weapon deals an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage, and the target can't take reactions until the start of its next turn. The rune lasts for 1 minute.

trait.name: Cast Iron Stomach
entries: Thursir have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Thurs Rune Warhammer
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Lightning damage, and the target can't take {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|Reactions} until the start of the giant's next turn.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Thyrin has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Thyrin casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Thyrin makes three attacks, using Crushing Mace or Eye of Fimbulwinter in any combination. He can replace two of these attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Crushing Mace
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Force damage.

action.name: Eye of Fimbulwinter
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 9} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 6d6}) Cold damage and the target is frozen in place ({@condition Restrained|XPHB}) by ice until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Curse of Ragnarok
entries: Thyrin pronounces a curse against an enemy he can see within 30 feet of him. {@actSave wis} {@dc 19}. {@actSaveFail} The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on all attack rolls and saving throws until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is unaffected.

reaction.name: Healing Reprisal (3/day)
entries: {@actTrigger} When Thyrin takes damage from a melee or ranged attack or becomes affected by a condition. {@actResponse} Thyrin heals 23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and ends a single condition affecting him.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the archon takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the archon takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Psychic Scar
entries: The archon is immune to any effect that would sense their emotions, read their thoughts, reveal they are lying, or reveal their alignment or location.

action.name: Brutal Flail (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 bludgeoning damage. If two or more archons joined the attack, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the end of their next turn. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 plus the number of archons who joined the attack.

action.name: Blaster (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. {@h}3 radiant damage.

trait.name: Psychic Scar
entries: The armiger is immune to any effect that would sense their emotions, read their thoughts, reveal they are lying, or reveal their alignment or location.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The armiger makes two attacks using Blaster, Serrated Saber, or both.

action.name: Serrated Saber
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage, and the target has disadvantage on their next attack roll made before the start of the armiger's next turn.

action.name: Blaster
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) radiant damage.

action.name: Concussive Slam (1st-Order Power)
entries: The armiger rains down telekinetic force on a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 3d4}) force damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Sickening Sympathy (2nd-Order Power)
entries: When another creature the armiger can see within 30 feet of them is hit with an attack, the armiger floods the attacker's mind with the nauseous pain of their target. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of their next turn.

hp.special: Seven times their level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Cutlass)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d10 plus PB} slashing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the freebooter can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 7th Level: Wraithstep (1/Day)
entries: As an action, the freebooter becomes {@condition invisible} for 1 minute. While {@condition invisible}, the freebooter has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks, and the freebooter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The freebooter takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if they end their turn inside an object.

bonus.name: 3rd Level: Blip Strike (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the freebooter teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see. If this space is within 5 feet of an enemy the freebooter can see, the freebooter can make a signature attack against them with advantage as part of this bonus action.

bonus.name: 5th Level: Kinetic Clamp (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the freebooter tries to telekinetically grip one creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage PBd6} force damage and is {@condition restrained} until the start of the freebooter's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and is not {@condition restrained}.

trait.name: Precog Reflexes
entries: The nemesis adds their Intelligence modifier (+4) to initiative rolls and to their AC (included in Armor Class).

trait.name: Psychic Scar
entries: The nemesis is immune to any effect that would sense their emotions, read their thoughts, reveal they are lying, or reveal their alignment or location.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nemesis makes two Golden Scythe attacks. They can replace one attack with a use of Kinetic Crush or Phase, if available.

action.name: Golden Scythe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage. If this attack reduces a creature who is in an astral body (as with the {@spell astral projection} spell) to 0 hit points, that creature's soul returns to their material body, and then their material body is also reduced to 0 hit points.

action.name: Kinetic Crush (4th-Order Power)
entries: The nemesis attempts to telekinetically grip one creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) force damage, and their speed becomes 0 until the start of the nemesis's next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and their speed isn't reduced.

action.name: Phase (1/Day; 4th-Order Power; Concentration)
entries: For 1 minute, the nemesis can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The nemesis takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if they end their turn inside an object. If this power ends while the nemesis is inside an object, they are shunted out of the object into the nearest unoccupied space of their choice.

bonus.name: Jaunt (3/Day; 3rd-Order Power)
entries: The nemesis teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see.

trait.name: Psychic Scar
entries: The vertex is immune to any effect that would sense their emotions, read their thoughts, reveal they are lying, or reveal their alignment or location.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vertex makes two Psionic Slam attacks.

action.name: Psionic Slam
entries: {@atk mp} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage, and the next attack roll against the target made before the start of the vertex's next turn has advantage.

action.name: Split Space (2/Day)
entries: The vertex chooses a point in a precise location they have seen (in person or otherwise) on any plane of existence. A shimmering 10-foot-diameter portal leading to that location appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the vertex. Each creature who touches the portal is instantly teleported to the nearest unoccupied space at the chosen location. The portal lasts until the vertex dies, uses this action again, dismisses the portal as an action, or is transported by the portal.

bonus.name: Invigorated March (3rd-Order Power)
entries: The vertex emits invigorating psionic energy. Each time raider within 60 feet of the vertex can use their reaction to move up to half their speed.

reaction.name: Kinetic Defense Field
entries: When another Medium or smaller creature the vertex can see within 120 feet of them takes damage, that damage is reduced by 15.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The pixie's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 13}). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Drunken Confessions
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the tipsy that has two or more levels of {@condition drunkenness|GriffonsSaddlebag2} (as per the Drunkenness rules from page 274 of this book) is under the effect of a {@spell zone of truth} spell. Whenever an affected creature tells the truth as a result of this effect, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or also be compelled to share a true feeling it has about one or more of the creatures to whom it's speaking.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The tipsy has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Charm
entries: One humanoid the tipsy can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition charmed}. If the {@condition charmed} creature is under the effect of a {@spell zone of truth} spell, it isn't aware of the spell and thus won't intentionally avoid answering questions to which it would normally respond with a lie.

Each time the tipsy or its allies ask the target a question, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts for 1 hour or until the tipsy dies, is on a different plane of existence from the target, or ends the effect as a bonus action. If the target successfully saves against the effect, or if the effect on it ends, the target is immune to this tipsy's Charm for the next 24 hours. The tipsy can have no more than three creatures {@condition charmed} at a time.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The tipsy magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the tipsy wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it. Creatures with two or more levels of {@condition drunkenness|GriffonsSaddlebag2} are unaffected by this effect and can see the tipsy as if it wasn't {@condition invisible}.

trait.name: Slither
entries: If the titanoboa hasn't eaten a Huge creature in the last 24 hours, it can easily move through any open large enough for a Large creature, and it can squeeze through any opening large enough for a Medium creature. The titanoboa's destination must still have suitable room to accommodate its volume.

trait.name: Sparkling Scales
entries: When a creature that can see the titanoboa starts its turn within 30 feet of the titanoboa and the titanoboa is in bright light, isn't {@condition incapacitated}, and can see the creature, the titanoboa can force the creature to make a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition stunned} until the start of its next turn.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the titanoboa until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the titanoboa in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The titanoboa makes two Bite attacks or one Bite attack and one Constrict attack. It can replace one Bite attack with a use of Swallow.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 5d8 + 8}) piercing damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 4d10 + 8}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}) if it is a Huge or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the titanoboa can't Constrict another target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The titanoboa makes one Bite attack against a Huge or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside the titanoboa, and it takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the titanoboa's turns. If the titanoboa takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a swallowed creature, the titanoboa must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of the titanoboa. If the titanoboa dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Tol Kharash casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 25}):

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Tol Kharash fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Tol Kharash has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: None Above Me
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 25}, each creature that starts their turn within 100 feet of Tol Kharash and who is positioned above his eye level. {@actSaveFail} A target must use as much of its movement as possible to move to a space below Tol Kharash's eye level.

trait.name: Revel in Tyranny
entries: Tol Khalesh's attacks deal an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage against creatures that have either the {@condition Prone|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Tol Kharash makes four attacks, using Battleaxe's Blade, Battleaxe's Blast, or Gore in any combination. He can replace one of these attacks with a use of Spellcasting (at will spells only).

action.name: Battleaxe's Blade
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 16}, reach 10 ft. {@h}27 ({@damage 3d12 + 8}) Slashing damage, and the target is pushed 15 feet away from Tol Kharash.

action.name: Battleaxe's Blast
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 17}, range 120 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d12 + 9}) Necrotic damage, and the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on its next saving throw before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 16}, reach 10 ft. {@h}34 ({@damage 4d12 + 8}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Overlord's Presence
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 25}, each creature of Tol Kharash's choice that is within 120 feet of him and aware of him. {@actSaveFail} 33 ({@damage 6d10}) Psychic damage and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Tol Kharash's Overlord's Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Shape-Shift
entries: Tol Kharash shape-shifts into a Beast, Humanoid, or Giant that has a {@variantrule Challenge Rating|XPHB} no higher than his own, or back into his true form. He reverts to his true form if he dies. Tol Kharash retains his {@variantrule Alignment|XPHB}, {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Dice}, ability to speak, Proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, his Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, and this {@variantrule Action|XPHB}. His statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except for any features or Legendary Actions of that form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (his choice).

reaction.name: Demonglass Prison
entries: {@actTrigger} When a creature Tol Kharash can see within 60 feet is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. {@actResponse} Tol Kharash can trap its soul within a Small conjured demonglass shard, which appears adjacent to the target. The demonglass shard has AC 15 and 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. While its soul is trapped, a target continues to make death saving throws but it cannot regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by any means, until the demonglass shard is destroyed. If a creature dies while its soul is trapped, it cannot be resurrected until the demonglass shard is destroyed. When a demonglass shard is destroyed, Tol Kharash regains 26 ({@dice 4d12}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and the newly released creature has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 hour. The {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition persists even if the creature is {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} or dead.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: Tol Kharash makes one Battleaxe's Blade, Battleaxe's Blast, or Gore attack.

legendary.name: Oppress
entries: Tol Kharash casts {@spell Command|XPHB}.

legendary.name: Incite (2 Legendary Actions)
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 25}, two creatures of Tol Kharash's choice within 60 feet of him. {@actSaveFail} Targets must use their {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} (if available) to make a melee attack with a weapon against each other. If the other target is not within reach, a target instead makes a ranged attack with a weapon against the other target, throwing its weapon if necessary. These attacks are made with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} and gain a +4 bonus to the damage roll.

trait.name: Occupation
entries: The Master

trait.name: Distinctive Features
entries: Absent-minded, Merry

name: Tophet
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Burning Heart
entries: The tophet sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Each creature in the bright light has resistance to cold damage. At the start of each of its turns, the tophet chooses whether this light is active.

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The tophet doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that touches the tophet or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tophet makes two Slam attacks. It can replace one Slam attack with a use of Burning Belly.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}) if it is a Large or smaller creature.

action.name: Burning Belly
entries: The tophet makes one Slam attack against a target it is grappling as it shoves the creature into its open, flame-filled belly. If the attack hits, the target is forced into the tophet's burning belly, and the grapple ends. While inside the belly, the target is {@condition restrained}, has {@quickref Cover||3||three-quarters cover} against attacks and other effects outside the belly, and it takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature, including the target, can take its action to pull the target free from the belly by succeeding on a {@dc 16} Strength check. The creature making the attempt takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Gout of Flame {@recharge 5}
entries: Flames erupt on a point the tophet can see within 100 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 ({@damage 10d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Eat Fire
entries: If the torcheater flies through fire, it reduces the fire's area by a 1-foot cube. A fire goes out if its area is reduced to nothing.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft.one target. {@h}1 fire damage.

trait.name: Lethe
entries: When the tormenauk's soul count is 0, they have advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and their Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, the tormenauk must use their movement on each of their turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature they can sense with their soulsight, and then if they are able, they must use their action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. The tormenauk can't act with any other purpose until they add 1 to their soul count.

trait.name: Soul Devourer
entries: When the tormenauk reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the tormenauk consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to the tormenauk's soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tormenauk makes two Slam attacks and one Many Maws attack.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}), and they are {@condition restrained} until the grapple ends. The tormenauk can grapple up to two targets at a time.

action.name: Many Maws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target {@condition grappled} by the tormenauk. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Agony Wail (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: The tormenauk screeches, broadcasting a consumed soul's lifelong pain. Each creature within 30 feet of the tormenauk who can hear them must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw, taking 35 ({@damage 10d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures who knew the owner of the burned soul have disadvantage on the saving throw.

reaction.name: Share Agony (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: When the tormenauk takes damage, they choose a creature they can see within 30 feet of them to share the pain. The target must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw, taking psychic damage equal to the triggering damage taken by the tormenauk on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Crowd Tactics
entries: The tosculi can share its space with up to one other tosculi. While sharing its space with one other tosculi, it has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if the other tosculi in its space isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Glide
entries: The tosculi can extend its vestigial wings while falling to slow its rate of descent to 60 feet per round, landing on its feet and taking no falling damage. It can move up to 5 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it falls. The tosculi can't gain height with its wings alone. If subjected to a strong wind or lift of any kind, it can use the updraft to glide farther.

trait.name: Hive Sense
entries: The tosculi can pinpoint the location of its hive queen when she is within 300 feet of it, and it can sense the general direction and distance to the hive where its queen makes her home.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Archer
entries: A ranged weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the tosculi hits with it (included in the attack).

trait.name: Hive Sense
entries: The tosculi can pinpoint the location of its hive queen when she is within 300 feet of it, and it can sense the general direction and distance to the hive where its queen makes her home.

trait.name: Point Blank Hunter
entries: When the tosculi makes a ranged attack with a bow, it doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll from being within 5 feet of a hostile creature, though it may still have disadvantage from other sources.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tosculi elite bow raider makes two Claw or Longbow attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d4 + 7}) slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Skirmisher
entries: The tosculi takes the Dash or Disengage action.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the hive queen fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Hive's Heart
entries: The hive queen knows the direction and distance to all members of her hive and the range of her telepathy extends to 20 miles when communicating with a member of her hive.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tosculi hive queen makes four Scimitar attacks.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) slashing damage.

action.name: Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}22 ({@damage 6d4 + 7}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the target is also {@condition paralyzed}. A {@condition poisoned} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The hive queen's potent poison can be removed only by the {@spell greater restoration} spell or similar magic.

action.name: Implant Egg
entries: The hive queen implants an egg into an {@condition incapacitated} creature within 5 feet of her that isn't a Construct or Undead. Until the egg hatches or is removed, the creature is {@condition poisoned}, {@condition paralyzed}, and doesn't need to eat or drink. The egg hatches after 30 days, and the larval tosculi bursts out of the host, killing the host in the process. A creature can take its action to remove the egg by succeeding on a {@dc 20} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check. Alternatively, a spell or effect that cures disease disintegrates the unhatched tosculi.

legendary.name: Flight
entries: The hive queen flies up to half her flying speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Stinger (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The hive queen makes one Stinger attack.

legendary.name: Glitter Dust (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The hive queen beats her wings and creates a cloud of glittering, golden particles. Each non-tosculi creature within 20 feet of her must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Crowd Tactics
entries: The tosculi can share its space with up to one other tosculi. While sharing its space with one other tosculi, it has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if the other tosculi in its space isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Hive Sense
entries: The tosculi can pinpoint the location of its hive queen when she is within 300 feet of it, and it can sense the general direction and distance to the hive where its queen makes her home.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tosculi warrior makes one Claw attack and one Stinger attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d4 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d4 + 5}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the target is also {@condition paralyzed}. A {@condition poisoned} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Prepare Host
entries: The tosculi extends the paralysis on a creature within 5 feet of it that was {@condition paralyzed} by a tosculi's Stinger attack. The {@condition paralyzed} target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 8 hours and no longer makes saving throws to end the paralysis. The paralysis ends if the target takes damage while below half its hp maximum. Otherwise, a spell or effect that cures disease ends this paralysis.

items.name: Constructed Nature
entries: The dragon doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

items.name: False Appearance
entries: While the dragon remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate bronze statue.

items.name: Faultless Tracker
entries: The creature(s) that caused the dragon to animate becomes its quarry. The dragon knows the direction and distance to its quarry as long the quarry remains within Drakkenheim or until the dragon is destroyed.

items.name: Immutable Form
entries: The dragon is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

items.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The dragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The dragon's weapon attacks are magical.

items.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If the tower dragon is destroyed, it regains all its hit points in 1 hour unless a {@spell disintegrate} spell is cast on its remains.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the dragon remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate bronze statue.

trait.name: Faultless Tracker
entries: The creatures that caused the dragon to animate become its quarries. The dragon knows the direction and distance to its quarries as long the quarries remain within Drakkenheim or until the dragon is destroyed.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The dragon is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The dragon has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If the dragon is destroyed, it reforms with all of its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} in 1 hour unless a {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB} spell is cast on its remains.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three Rend attacks.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} + 9, reach 10 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Force damage.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Lightning Breath
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 55 ({@damage 10d10}) Lightning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Repulsion Breath
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} The target is pushed up to 40 feet away from the dragon.

trait.name: Silver Tongue
entries: The Trade Factor has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@skill Deception|XPHB}, {@skill Insight|XPHB}, and {@skill Persuasion|XPHB} checks when discussing trade deals or contracts.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Trade Factor makes two attacks using its Rapier.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Piercing damage, plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage.

bonus.name: Gold Talks
entries: The Trade Factor throws 10 GP to creature within 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or gain the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the end of the factor's next turn.

reaction.name: Paper Shield (1/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature that the Trade Factor can see makes an attack roll against the factor. {@actResponse} The Trade Factor produces a legal document sealed with a magical ward and imposes {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the attacker's roll.

trait.name: Traps (3/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} The first time an enemy with a {@variantrule Passive Perception|XPHB} of 12 or lower comes within 30 feet of the trapper or the trapper shoves the creature 5 feet. {@actSave dex} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} The target takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Piercing damage and has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. A creature can use its action to make a {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. Each failed check deals {@damage 1d4} Piercing damage to the trapped creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The trapper makes two attacks, using Greataxe or Short Bow in any combination.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d12 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 80/320 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Shove
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 13}, one Large or smaller creature within 5 feet of the trapper. {@actSaveFail} The creature is pushed 5 feet directly away from the trapper.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The treacle can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The treacle can mimic animal sounds. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

action.name: Blood Drain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}The treacle attaches to the target. While attached, the treacle can't attack, and at the start of each of the treacle's turns, the target loses 5 {@dice 2d4} hp due to blood loss. Each time the target loses hp in this way, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to notice the treacle is attached and harming it, otherwise it is unaware the hp loss is from the treacle. A creature that loses hp in this way while below half its hp maximum automatically succeeds on this check.

The attached treacle moves with the target whenever the target moves, requiring none of the treacle's movement. It can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement on its turn. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the treacle.

reaction.name: Mimic Innocence
entries: When a creature the treacle can see moves within 120 feet of it, the treacle squishes, stretches, and molds its body into the shape of a Tiny Beast or object the creature finds least threatening, such as an injured rabbit or a long-lost toy. The treacle's body takes on most of the coloration of the desired shape, but some part of it is always white, pale, or pearlescent. Regardless of the shape, the treacle's flesh doesn't change and is soft and plush to the touch. The treacle can maintain this shape for up to 8 hours or until another creature it can see moves within 120 feet of it.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, the treant can cast the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the treant remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from a normal tree.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The treant makes two Thorned Tendril attacks.

action.name: Thorned Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, a target is {@condition restrained} and takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage at the start of each of their turns.

action.name: Swinging Tendrils {@recharge}
entries: The treant swings the creatures they are grappling in violent circles. Each creature {@condition grappled} by the treant takes 26 ({@damage 4d12}) bludgeoning damage, and the treant can move them into an unoccupied space the treant can see within 15 feet of the treant.

All other creatures within 15 feet of the treant must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 26 ({@damage 4d12}) bludgeoning damage per creature {@condition grappled} by the treant. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

bonus.name: Healing Growth (1/Day)
entries: Each creature of the treant's choice within 30 feet of them regains 17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) hit points.

bonus.name: Reel and Wrap
entries: The treant wraps one creature they have {@condition grappled} in thick vines, pulling the target up to 10 feet toward them. The target can't speak until the grapple ends.

hp.special: Nine times their level (number of d12 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Claw)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 2d6 plus PB} slashing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the immobilizer can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Lash Out (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the immobilizer whips a vine toward a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 10 feet toward the immobilizer and {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}). Until this grapple ends, the immobilizer's attacks against the target deal an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} bludgeoning damage.

action.name: 5th Level: Ground Stomp (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the im - mobilizer stomps the ground. Each creature within 10 feet of the immobilizer must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. Then the immobilizer can make a signature attack with a reach of 10 feet against one {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: 7th Level: Entomb (1/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the immobilizer calls spiky vines to surround a creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage PBd10} piercing damage and is {@condition restrained}. While {@condition restrained} in this way, the target is {@condition blinded}. On a successful save, the target takes only half damage and isn't {@condition restrained}.
A creature can use their action to make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check, freeing themself or another creature within reach on a success.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the sapling remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from a normal tree.

trait.name: Grove Strength
entries: When a non-minion ally hits a target with an attack, the target takes an extra 2 slashing damage for each sapling within 5 feet of the target.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the sapling takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the sapling takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Claws (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 slashing damage.

trait.name: Charm Resistant
entries: Treyvan has advantage on saving throws he makes to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} condition on himself.

trait.name: Mind Link
entries: Treyvan can communicate telepathically with any Amethyst Knife boss regardless of distance, provided they are on the same plane of existence.

trait.name: Telekinetic Bastion
entries: Each ally within 20 feet of Treyvan has a +2 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws. Enemies treat the area within 20 feet of Treyvan as difficult terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Treyvan makes two Maul attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of Telekinetic Throw or Choke, if available.

action.name: Maul
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, Treyvan can choose to either knock them {@condition prone} or push them up to 10 feet away from him.

action.name: Telekinetic Throw
entries: Treyvan throws his maul with telekinetic force, making a Maul attack with a range of 30 feet. After making this attack, the maul immediately returns to Treyvan's hands.

action.name: Choke (2/Day; 5th-Order Power; Concentration)
entries: Treyvan telekinetically crushes one Large or smaller creature he can see within 30 feet of him. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While {@condition restrained} in this way, the target takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) force damage at the start of each of their turns. If the target is ever more than 30 feet away from Treyvan or has total cover from him, the power ends early.

reaction.name: Shared Condition
entries: When Treyvan is {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, or {@condition stunned}, he chooses a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 feet of him who doesn't already have the condition or is immune to it. The chosen creature then gains the condition for the duration, and Treyvan loses the condition. He can use this reaction even while {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Beast of Burden
entries: The tribex is considered to be a Huge animal for the purposes of determining its carrying capacity.

trait.name: Herding
entries: Attacks against the tribex have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} if at least one of the tribex's allies is within 5 feet of it and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Ram
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage. If the tribex moved at least 20 feet straight toward a target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Bludgeoning damage and, if it is Huge or smaller, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Enduring Mount
entries: The tribex has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws it makes as part of a forced march.

trait.name: Sure-Footed Runner
entries: If the tribex uses the {@action Dash|XPHB} action, its speed is not reduced by {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} until the end of its turn.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage. If the tribex moved at least 20 feet straight toward a target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Piercing damage and, if it is Huge or smaller, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Enduring Mount
entries: The tribex has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws it makes as part of a forced march.

trait.name: Unstoppable
entries: The tribex has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against effects that would cause it to have the {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, or {@condition Prone|XPHB} conditions.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Piercing damage. If the tribex moved at least 20 feet straight toward a target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Piercing damage and, if it is Huge or smaller, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Trample
entries: {@actTrigger} The target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actResponse} The tribex can make a Hooves attack.

name: Trinket
languages: understands Common but can't speak it
