trait.name: Chosen Companion
entries: Trinket has an additional 10 hit points, and has a +6 bonus to attack and damage rolls and to Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks.

trait.name: Empowered Attacks
entries: Trinket's attacks are treated as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to damage from nonmagical attacks.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: Trinket has {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Raven's Slumber
entries: If Trinket is reduced to 0 hit points and is within 100 feet of Vex, he is immediately drawn into the demiplane within {@creature Vex'ahlia|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Vex's} {@item raven's slumber|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn} and stabilized.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Trinket makes two attacks: one with his bite and one with his claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 1d8 + 10}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d6 + 10}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Relentless Hunger
entries: When the troll is reduced to 0 hit points by any damage other than acid or fire damage, they don't die or fall {@condition unconscious}, and can continue moving and taking actions as usual. The troll only dies if they end their turn with 0 hit points, if acid or fire damage reduces them to 0 hit points, or if they take acid or fire damage while they have 0 hit points.

trait.name: Sluggish
entries: For 1 hour after sleep or another period of unconsciousness, the troll's speed is halved and they can't use Multiattack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is not a Construct, an Elemental, or a Plant, the troll regains hit points equal to the damage dealt. If this attack reduces the target to 0 hit points, the troll regains twice as many hit points as they otherwise would with this attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Crash Through
entries: The troll moves up to their speed in a straight line, smashing through mundane obstacles in their path. The troll can enter the spaces of Large or smaller creatures during this movement, forcing those creatures to make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage and falls {@condition prone}. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and doesn't fall {@condition prone}.

During this move, mundane objects that aren't worn or carried by a creature take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) damage when the troll enters their space. If the troll moves into the space of a Large or larger object and this damage doesn't destroy it, the troll's movement stops and they are {@condition stunned} until the end of their next turn.

reaction.name: Spiteful Retort
entries: When the troll is reduced to 0 hit points and doesn't die, they can make a Bite attack against a creature within 5 feet of them.

spellcasting.name: Coven Magic
headerEntries: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell's normal casting time, and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks).

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The troll hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

1: {@spell Scrying} The hag may replace either its Fungal Staff or Slimeball attack with the following:

trait.name: Fungal Aura
entries: The ground in a 10-foot radius of any of the three hags is difficult terrain and grants the hags half cover as it is covered in constant fungal growths and clouds of spores unless the hag has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, any creature who ends its turn within the area. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Staggered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and {@condition Bewildered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} conditions (save ends)

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The troll hag regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the troll hag takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the hag's next turn. The troll hag dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll hag makes one Fungal Staff attack and one Slimeball attack. It can replace either attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Fungal Staff
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 14}, one creature within 5ft. {@actSaveFail} 16 ({@damage 3d8 + 3}) Psychic damage and the target has the {@condition Addled|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

action.name: Slimeball
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, range 30/120 ft. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d10 + 3}) Acid damage and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 3d10} Acid).

action.name: Garden of Fungal Delights {@recharge}
entries: The coven pours their strange brew upon the mushroom patches around them, immediately spawning 7 ({@dice 2d6}) Fungal Trollings.

action.name: Rapid Growth (1/Day)
entries: If all three hags use their action to target the same fungal trolling within 60 feet of them with this ability, that trolling erupts in size and becomes a Humongous Fungus Troll. While the hags are using this ability, they must maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}. If any of the hags lose {@status Concentration|XPHB} before the third hag takes its action, the ability is not wasted but they must start over. While being targeted by Rapid Growth, the targeted fungal trolling has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Vexing Curse
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} 19 ({@damage 3d10 + 3}) Psychic damage and the target has the {@condition Jinxed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} ({@dice 1d6}) condition (save ends).

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The troll hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The troll hag regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the troll hag takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the hag's next turn. The troll hag dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll hag makes one Fungal Staff attack and one Slimeball attack. It can replace either attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Fungal Staff
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 14}, one creature within 5ft. {@actSaveFail} 16 ({@damage 3d8 + 3}) Psychic damage and the target has the {@condition Addled|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

action.name: Slimeball
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, range 30/120 ft. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d10 + 3}) Acid damage and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 3d10} Acid).

bonus.name: Spore Step
entries: The troll hag magically teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of it.

reaction.name: Spawn Troll
entries: {@actTrigger} The troll hag takes damage. {@actResponse} Create one Fungal Trolling in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the troll hag. The fungal trolling acts immediately after the triggering creature's turn, then after the troll hag's turn on subsequent rounds.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the limbjumble takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the limbjumble takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Arm and a Leg (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller and if three or more limbjumbles joined the attack, the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the whelp takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the whelp takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Relentless Hunger
entries: When the whelp is reduced to 0 hit points by any damage other than acid or fire damage, they don't die or fall {@condition unconscious}, and can continue moving and taking actions as usual. The whelp only dies if they end their turn with 0 hit points, if acid or fire damage reduces them to 0 hit points, or if they take acid or fire damage while they have 0 hit points.

trait.name: Ripping Claws
entries: Spaces within reach of one or more whelps are difficult terrain for Medium or smaller enemies. When an enemy leaves the reach of one or more whelps who can see them, the enemy takes 2 slashing damage.

action.name: Bite (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 4} piercing damage, and if the target is not a Construct, an Elemental, or a Plant, each whelp who joined this attack regains all lost hit points.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The trollkin regains 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|hp} at the start of its turn. If the trollkin takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the trollkin's next turn. The trollkin dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|hp} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The trollkin makes two attacks, using Spear and Longbow in any combination.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 3} to hit, range 150/600 feet., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Aim
entries: The raider has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the next ranged attack roll it makes during the current turn.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The trollkin regains 1 hp at the start of its turn. If the trollkin takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the trollkin's next turn. The trollkin dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Thick Hide
entries: The trollkin's skin is thick and tough, granting it a +1 bonus to Armor Class. This bonus is included in the trollkin's AC.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The trollkin makes two spear attacks or one bite attack and two claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) slashing damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage, or 5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The trollkin reaver regains 5 hp at the start of its turn. If the trollkin takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the trollkin's next turn. The trollkin dies if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Thick Hide
entries: The trollkin reaver's skin is thick and tough, granting it a +1 bonus to Armor Class. This bonus is already factored into the trollkin's AC.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The trollkin raider makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks, or it makes three Handaxe attacks. It can replace one Claw attack with a Battleaxe attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage, or 9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Handaxe
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Howl of Battle {@recharge}
entries: The trollkin reaver howls a battle cry at up to three friendly creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target can make one weapon attack as a reaction and has advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Arctic Camouflage
entries: The tundra gnoll has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks in snowy or icy conditions.

action.name: Bone Axe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Bone Bow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Freezing Glare
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 12} One creature within 20 feet of the tundra gnoll. {@actSaveFail} The creature's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced to 0 feet until the end of its next turn by a supernatural chill.

bonus.name: Rampage (2/Day)
entries: Immediately after dealing damage to a {@status Bloodied|XPHB} creature, the tundra gnoll moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and makes one Bone Axe attack.

name: Tuned Koboldzilla

trait.name: Apotheosis (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the koboldzilla would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 462 hit points, it recharges its Dragon Breath, its Dexterity increases to 27 (+8), and its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma increase to 20 (+5). Additionally, all kobold pilots are incinerated in the process, it can't use its Koboldapult legendary action until it finishes a short or long rest, and the koboldzilla can use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 105,000 XP (210,000 XP total) for defeating the koboldzilla after its Apotheosis activates.

trait.name: Constructed Weakness
entries: The koboldzilla has the following flaws:

items.name: Arcanothermic Engine
items.entry: If the koboldzilla takes 30 or more cold damage in a single turn, it can't recharge its Dragon Breath action until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Rustable
items.entry: If the koboldzilla takes 30 or more acid damage in a single turn, it becomes restrained until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The koboldzilla is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the koboldzilla fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Loose Plating
entries: When the koboldzilla is reduce to 231 hit points or fewer for the first time since it last finished a long rest, it loses some of its armour plating. Its AC is reduced to 20, its walking speed is doubled, and its Dexterity increases to 20 (+5). These effects last until it finishes a long rest.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The koboldzilla deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The koboldzilla makes three attacks: one with its Dragon Bite, one with its Gazebo Smash, and one with its Tail. It can use Dragon Breath in place of its Dragon Bite.

action.name: Dragon Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 4d10 + 8}) piercing damage.

action.name: Gazebo Smash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 10 ft., each target within a 5-foot-radius circle. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d8 + 8}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 4d10 + 8}) slashing damage.

action.name: Dragon Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The koboldzilla exhales fire in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 ({@damage 18d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendaryHeader: The koboldzilla can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The koboldzilla regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: The koboldzilla makes one Tail attack.

legendary.name: Koboldapult (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The koboldzilla fires a cluster of kobolds at a point within 120 feet of the koboldzilla. Each creature within 20 feet of that point must make a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) piercing damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success. Additionally, 4 ({@dice 1d4 + 2}) kobolds survive this ordeal, and land prone in unoccupied spaces within the area. These kobolds act on initiative count 1.

mythicHeader: If the koboldzilla's Apotheosis trait has activated in the last hour, it can use the options below as legendary actions.

mythic.name: Takeoff
entries: The koboldzilla upregulates its arcanothermic engine. Each creature within 15 feet of the koboldzilla must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) fire damage and be knocked prone. The koboldzilla can then fly up to 60 feet and begin to hover.

At the end of the next turn, the koboldzilla lands. Each creature in the space where the koboldzilla lands must make a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone and restrained until the koboldzilla moves out of the creature's space. Alternatively, the creature can use an action to make a {@dc 22} Strength ({@skill Athletics|PHB}) check, exiting prone in the nearest unoccupied space on a success. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage, is not knocked prone, and moves to the nearest unoccupied space.

mythic.name: Arcanothermic Overcharge (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The koboldzilla recharges and uses its Dragon Breath.

trait.name: Electrified Tendrils
entries: A creature that touches the skyfish or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) lightning damage. In addition, a creature that starts its turn beneath the skyfish while the skyfish is hovering takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) lightning damage, provided the creature is within 15 feet of the skyfish.

trait.name: Mobile Grappler
entries: While grappling a creature, the tusked skyfish can move at its full speed, carrying the {@condition grappled} creature along with it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tusked skyfish makes one Gore attack and one Electrified Tentacles attack.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Electrified Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) lightning damage at the start of each of its turns, and the skyfish can't use its Electrified Tentacles on another target.

action.name: Stench Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: The tusked skyfish sprays foul‑smelling liquid in a 20-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature falls {@condition unconscious} while {@condition poisoned} in this way. The {@condition unconscious} creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake. A {@condition poisoned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Lethe
entries: When the demon's soul count is 0, they have advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and their Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, the demon must use their movement on each of their turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature they can sense with their soulsight, and then if they are able, they must use their action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. The demon can't act with any other purpose until they add 1 to their soul count.

trait.name: Soul Devourer
entries: When the demon reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the demon consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to the demon's soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

trait.name: Trample
entries: The demon can move through the spaces of Large or smaller creatures as if they were difficult terrain. When the demon enters a creature's space for the first time on the demon's turn, the demon can make a Stomp attack against that creature (no action required). Additionally, the demon can end their turn in the space of a {@condition prone} creature who is Medium or smaller, and that creature can't stand up while in the demon's space.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) piercing damage. The demon can burn 1 soul to push the target up to 40 feet directly away from the demon.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Tongue
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) slashing damage, and if the target is a creature, they must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 10 feet toward the demon.

reaction.name: Vengeful Charge (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: When an enemy within 40 feet of the demon deals damage to the demon, the demon can move up to their speed straight toward them. If the demon ends this movement within 10 feet of the enemy, the demon can make a Gore attack against them.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Tuval-Uthriar can cast the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Elf Glamour (1/Day)
entries: When a creature targets Tuval-Uthriar with an attack, power, or spell, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by him until the end of his next turn (no action required).

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: Tuval-Uthriar has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

trait.name: Wheel of Ire
entries: Each enemy within 30 feet of Tuval-Uthriar has disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than him.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Tuval-Uthriar makes three Longsword attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) slashing damage, or 10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Call Lightning (3/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
entries: A magical bolt of lightning flashes down from the sky to a point Tuval-Uthriar can see within 120 feet of him. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 ({@damage 3d10}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Eye of Sunrise (1/Day)
entries: Tuval-Uthriar's gauntlet emits a fiery explosion in a 30-foot cone. The explosion can be heard 300 feet away. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 ({@damage 5d6}) fire damage plus 17 ({@damage 5d6}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Each structure and mundane object in the area that isn't being worn or carried takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) fire damage plus 35 ({@damage 10d6}) force damage.

bonus.name: Healing Word (2nd-Level Spell)
entries: Tuval-Uthriar targets one creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead who he can see within 60 feet of him. The target regains 8 ({@dice 2d4 + 3}) hit points.

hp.special: Eight times their level (number of d10 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Longsword)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d8 plus PB} slashing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the tyrant can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Shift Ranks (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the tyrant makes a signature attack and allows up to three allies within 30 feet of them who can hear them to move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks (no action required).

action.name: 7th Level: Choke (1/Day)
entries: As an action, the tyrant makes a signature attack; if the attack hits, the tyrant chokes the target with infernal magic. The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}) and {@condition restrained} until the grapple ends.

reaction.name: 5th Level: Devastation (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the tyrant makes a signature attack, and up to three allies within 30 feet of them who can hear them can use their reaction to make one weapon attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The umbral tailor casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

1e: {@spell greater restoration} (casting time requires target to take a long rest)

trait.name: Shadow Patch
entries: The umbral tailor can conduct a ritual to undo the effects of shadow corruption. This ritual takes 1 hour to complete, uses 200 gp worth of components, and must be performed on a willing subject.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the umbral tailor has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Unseelie Blessing
entries: The umbral tailor has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put them to sleep.

action.name: Bone Needle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Soul Read
entries: The umbral tailor can focus their mind on any one creature they can see within 30 feet. The umbral tailor learns the creature's current emotional state and whether the creature is diseased, corrupted, cursed, or under the effects of a spell. If the creature does not have a soul, it is unaffected.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The umbral vampire can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the umbral vampire has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The umbral vampire doesn't require air.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The umbral vampire can use its Umbral Grasp. It then makes two Shadow Touch attacks.

action.name: Shadow Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by {@dice 1d4}. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. A non-evil Humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a shadow under the vampire's control, unless the Humanoid is restored to life. The vampire can have no more than five shadows under its control at one time.

action.name: Umbral Grasp
entries: The umbral vampire sends a giant hand of shadow to grab one creature it can see that is in dim light or darkness within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} by wisps of magical shadow for 1 minute. While {@condition restrained}, the target takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The umbral vampire can have no more than two creatures {@condition restrained} by its Umbral Grasp at a time.

bonus.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the umbral vampire takes the Hide action.

trait.name: Absorbing Flesh
entries: A creature reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by the growth is absorbed into its body and dies. When it absorbs a creature, the growth's size increases by one category. If the growth finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} and hasn't absorbed a body since its last {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, its size decreases by one category.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The growth makes a number of attacks based on its size: two (Medium), three (Large), four (Huge) or five (Gargantuan).

action.name: Assimilating Pseudopod
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 10 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Necrotic damage, and if the target is smaller than the growth, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target is swallowed by the growth. A swallowed creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} from attacks and effects outside the growth, and takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage and the start of each of the growth's turns. The growth regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the amount of Necrotic damage dealt, and excess healing increases its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} Maximum.

If the growth takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the growth must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition in unoccupied spaces within 10 feet of the growth. If the growth dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

reaction.name: Adaptable Flesh
entries: {@actTrigger} The growth takes damage from a spell or attack. {@actResponse} The growth halves the damage it takes from the triggering spell or attack.

trait.name: Displacement
entries: The polyp's form is constantly shifting and moving through reality in unnatural ways. Attack rolls against the polyp have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}. If the polyp takes damage, this trait ceases to function until the start of its next turn. This trait is suppressed while the polyp has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} or {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions or is otherwise unable to move.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The polyp makes two Mucus attacks.

action.name: Mucus
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Acid damage, and a 5-foot radius centered on the target is covered in acidic slime for 1 minute. A creature other than the polyp that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 3d6} Acid).

action.name: Slip Space
entries: The polyp teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 20 feet. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the polyp when it reappears. {@actSaveFail} 16 ({@damage 3d10}) Force damage. Failure by 5 or More: The target triggers an {@table Arcane Anomalies|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} centered on itself. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Shift Step
entries: The polyp teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

reaction.name: Confused Realities
entries: {@actTrigger} The polyp takes damage from a creature it can see within 30 feet. {@actResponse} The triggering creature is teleported to an unoccupied space the polyp can see within 30 feet of its original space. The destination must be on a surface or liquid that can support the target without the target having to squeeze.

name: Uraeus
languages: understands Celestial and Common but can't speak

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The uraeus doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The uraeus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. While {@condition poisoned}, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. A {@condition poisoned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Spit Fire
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 4d6 + 2}) fire damage.

action.name: Searing Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The uraeus exhales a 15-foot cone of fire. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Ward Bond
entries: The uraeus forms a magical bond with a willing creature within 5 feet of it. While bonded, the uraeus and its ward know the distance and direction to each other and the general state of each other's health, even if the two are on different planes of existence. The bond lasts until the uraeus or its ward dies, until the uraeus ends it as a bonus action, or until the uraeus uses this bonus action to create a bond with another creature.

reaction.name: Bonded Savior
entries: When the uraeus's bonded ward takes damage, the uraeus prevents the ward from taking the damage and loses hp equal to that amount instead, regardless of the type of damage dealt.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The urban ranger is an 8th-level spellcaster that uses Wisdom as its spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}; {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). It knows the following spells from the ranger spell list:

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The urban ranger makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, ranged 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

name: Urochar

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

languages: understands Darakhul and Void Speech but can't speak

trait.name: Mind-Rending Death
entries: When the urochar dies, it releases all the fear it consumed in its lifetime in a single, mind-rending wave. Each creature within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A {@condition frightened} creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns. A {@condition frightened} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Rubbery Body
entries: The urochar's body is rubbery with few bones, allowing it to easily move through any opening large enough for a Medium creature. It can squeeze through any opening large enough for a Small creature. The urochar's destination must still have suitable room to accommodate its volume.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The urochar can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The urochar can use its Paralyzing Gaze. It then makes four Tentacle attacks.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}. The urochar has four tentacles, each can grapple only one target.

action.name: Paralyzing Gaze
entries: The urochar turns its eerie gaze upon one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the urochar's Paralyzing Gaze for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Strangling Grasp
entries: Each creature {@condition grappled} by the urochar must make a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 36 ({@damage 8d8}) bludgeoning damage and can't breathe until the grapple ends. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and can still breathe.

reaction.name: Hidden Step
entries: The urochar magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see and takes the Hide action. Grappled creatures are no longer {@condition grappled} and don't teleport with it.

trait.name: Severed Body
entries: Urugama has four spectral bodies, each of which Urugama can take actions from. These different bodies can't move more than 100 feet away from each other, and Urugama divides its movement among its four bodies as it chooses.

trait.name: Shifting Form
entries: At the start of Urugama's turn, one of its bodies is randomly selected as the true Urugama.
Only the true body can take damage or suffer effects that round. The other bodies can still be targeted with attacks and effects, but they are unaffected and pass through the bodies without harm.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Two of Urugama's forms make a spectral pass attack.

action.name: Spectral Pass
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Haunting Chuckle
entries: If at least three of Urugama's bodies are within 20 feet of each other, they can release a haunting chuckle. All creatures within 30 feet of an Urugama body that can hear them must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or suffer one level of {@condition exhaustion}. On a failed save, the creature is immune to Urugama's Haunting Chuckle for the next 24 hours.

name: Ushabti
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The ushabti doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the ushabti is motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal funerary statue.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The ushabti is immune to spells and effects that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ushabti has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Necrotic Weapons
entries: The ushabti's weapon attacks are magical. When the ushabti hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ushabti makes two Nabboot attacks.

action.name: Nabboot
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be cursed with tomb taint. The cursed target's speed is halved, and its hp maximum decreases by 3 ({@dice 1d6}) for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hp maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to dust. The curse lasts until removed by the {@spell remove curse} spell or comparable magic.

action.name: Serpentine Armlets (1/Day)
entries: The ushabti commands its armlets to drop to the floor and transform into two giant, poisonous snakes. The snakes act as allies of the ushabti and obey its spoken commands. The snakes remain for 1 hour, until the ushabti dies, or until the ushabti dismisses one or both of them as a bonus action. When the snakes disappear, they become wisps of smoke and reform as armlets around the ushabti's arms.

reaction.name: Telekinesis
entries: One creature the ushabti can see within 60 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or the ushabti moves the creature up to 30 feet in any direction (including upward). The target is {@condition restrained} until the start of the ushabti's next turn.

name: Ushabti Royal Guard
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The ushabti doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the ushabti is motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal funerary statue.

trait.name: Healing Leech
entries: If a creature within 30 feet of the ushabti regains hp from a spell or magical effect, the creature regains only half the amount and the ushabti regains the other half.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The ushabti is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the ushabti fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ushabti has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Necrotic Weapons
entries: The ushabti's weapon attacks are magical. When the ushabti hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ushabti can use its Breath-Stealing Presence. It then makes two Khopesh attacks and one Medjai's Scepter attack.

action.name: Khopesh
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Medjai's Scepter
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Breath-Stealing Presence
entries: Each creature of the ushabti's choice within 30 feet of the ushabti and aware of it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage and be unable to speak or breathe for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the ushabti's Breath‑Stealing Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Enervating Surge {@recharge 5}
entries: The ushabti emits waves of necrotic energy. Each creature within 30 feet of the ushabti must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 49 ({@damage 11d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that can't breathe because of the ushabti's Breath‑Stealing Presence has disadvantage on the saving throw. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature also suffers one level of {@condition exhaustion}. A Humanoid slain by this effect rises {@dice 1d4} hours later as a mummy under the ushabti's control, unless the Humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The ushabti can have no more than five mummies under its control at one time.

reaction.name: Sudden Strike
entries: When a creature more than 5 feet away from the ushabti moves to a space within 5 feet of the ushabti, the ushabti can make one Khopesh attack against it.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The ushabti moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Medjai's Scepter (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The ushabti makes one Medjai's Scepter attack.

legendary.name: Telekinesis (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Up to two creatures the ushabti can see within 60 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or the ushabti moves the creature up to 30 feet in any direction (including upward). A moved target is then {@condition restrained} until the start of the ushabti's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Vaanor's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 22}, {@hit 14} to hit with spell attacks). Vaanor can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Vaanor fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Vaanor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Soul Sentry
entries: Vaanor's weapon attacks are magical. When Vaanor hits an undead with a weapon attack, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) force damage.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: Vaanor has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Three Heads
entries: Vaanor has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks, as well as Constitution saving throws made to maintain {@status concentration} on spells.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: When one of Vaanor's heads is asleep, its other heads are awake. In addition, magic can't put it to sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Vaanor can use its Inescapable Presence. It then makes three bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage. If this is the first attack Vaanor has made as part of its Multiattack, the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If this is the second attack, the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the start of Vaanor's next turn. If this is the third attack, the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the start of Vaanor's next turn.

action.name: Inescapable Presence
entries: Vaanor magically restricts one creature it can see within 120 feet of it from fleeing. The target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or become unable to willingly move or teleport away from Vaanor for 1 minute. Creatures that can't be {@condition frightened} are immune to this effect. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Vaanor's Inescapable Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Hellfire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Vaanor exhales debilitating fire in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 ({@damage 10d6}) fire damage and 35 ({@damage 10d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Summon Hounds (1/Day)
entries: Vaanor magically summons ({@dice 4d4}) hell hounds. A summoned hell hound appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Vaanor and acts as Vaanor's ally. It remains for 1 minute, until it or Vaanor dies, or until Vaanor dismisses it as an action.

legendary.name: Bite
entries: Vaanor makes one bite attack.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Vaanor moves up to its speed.

legendary.name: Trailblaze (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Vaanor moves up to twice its speed, leaving a trail of fire in its wake. During this movement, Vaanor doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, and it can move through the space of any creature that is Huge or smaller. Each creature in its path must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and 22 ({@damage 5d8}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Until the end of Vaanor's next turn, each space it moved through is filled with an opaque, 20-foot-high wall of fire. Whenever a creature enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, it takes 22 ({@damage 5d8}) fire damage.

legendary.name: Release the Hounds (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Vaanor uses its Summon Hounds.

name: Vættir
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Grave Goods Sense
entries: The vættir can pinpoint the location of creatures wearing or carrying one of the vættir's personal items or grave goods within 60 feet of it, and the vættir can sense the general direction of its personal items and grave goods within 1 mile of it.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: A destroyed vættir gains a new body in 24 hours, regaining all its hp and becoming active again. The new body forms in a random unoccupied space within 100 feet of where it fell. This trait doesn't function if the vættir is put to rest (typically by returning its remains to its burial mound).

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the vættir has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The vættir doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vættir can use its Disorienting Gaze. It then makes two Vættir's Greataxe or Necrotic Bolt attacks.

action.name: Vættir's Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d12 + 5}) slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Necrotic Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 4} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d8 + 2}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Disorienting Gaze
entries: The vættir locks eyes with one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition incapacitated} for 1 minute. While {@condition incapacitated}, the creature moves in a random direction when it moves. An {@condition incapacitated} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the vættir's Disorienting Gaze for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Corpse Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The vættir spews forth a 15‑foot cone of putrid gas. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. A {@condition poisoned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Alien Mind
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 22}, any creature that tries to read Valaar's thoughts or deals Psychic damage to it. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
entries: If Valaara fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Valaara has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Valaara regains 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If Valaara takes Radiant damage, this trait doesn't function on Valaara's next turn. Valaara dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Valaara makes two attacks, using Chitinous Claw or Chitinous Spine in any combination. It also uses Summon Swarms.

action.name: Chitinous Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 5 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Chitinous Spine
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 14}, range 60/180 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d6 + 7}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Summon Swarms
entries: Valaara summons a swarm of insects or arachnids that fills a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point Valaara can see within 120 feet, afflicting all creatures in the area with one of the following effects (roll a {@dice 1d6} or choose one), to which Valaara is immune:

items.name: Stinging Wasps
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 22}. {@actSaveFail} 32 ({@damage 5d12}) Piercing damage, and the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage and the target doesn't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls.

items.name: Spinning Spiders
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 22}. {@actSaveFail} 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Fire damage; {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage).

items.name: Venomous Centipedes
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 22}. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Poison damage and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

items.name: Infesting Grubs
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 22}. {@actSaveFail} The target is infested by 4 ({@dice 1d4 + 2}) rot grubs, taking 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Piercing damage per rot grub at the start of each of its turns. If a target infested with rot grubs ends its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the rot grubs burrow into its heart, killing it. Any effect that cures disease kills all rot grubs infesting the target, ending the effect. Applying fire to the bite wound before the end of the creature's next turn deals 1 Fire damage to the creature and kills the rot grubs, ending the effect. After this time, the rot grubs are too far under the skin to be burned.

items.name: Discordant Cicadas
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 22}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. While {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} The target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on future saves against this swarm for 24 hours.

action.name: Psychoactive Beetles
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 22}. {@actSaveFail} 33 ({@damage 6d10}) Psychic damage.

bonus.name: Teleport
entries: Valaara teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary.name: Throw Spine
entries: Valaara makes one Chitinous Spine attack.

legendary.name: Imaginary Crawlers
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 22}, one creature Valaara can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Psychic damage, and the target immediately loses {@status Concentration|XPHB} on any spell it is {@status Concentration|XPHB|Concentrating} on.

legendary.name: Synthesize Worm
entries: Valaara magically fuses the swarms under its command, forming a Carrion Crawler in an unoccupied space they can see within 90 feet of themself. The Carrion Crawler takes its turn immediately after Valaara on the same {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, and it obeys Valaara.

trait.name: Cloak and Dagger
entries: While Vali is hidden, he doesn't give away his location if he makes a weapon attack and misses.

trait.name: Deft-Footed
entries: Vali leaves no tracks or other traces of his presence unless he wants to.

trait.name: Elf Glamour (1/Day)
entries: When a creature targets Vali with an attack, power, or spell, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by him until the end of his next turn (no action required).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Vali makes two Shortsword attacks, or he makes two Waning Moon attacks and uses Waning Moon Fade, if available.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Waning Moon
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature who can't see Vali, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) force damage.

action.name: Waning Moon Fade (1/Day)
entries: Vali becomes {@condition invisible} for 1 minute and takes the Hide action. This invisibility ends if Vali makes an attack, casts a spell, or manifests a power.

bonus.name: Nimble Escape
entries: Vali takes the Disengage or Hide action.

trait.name: Aura of Valor
entries: Friendly creatures wielding weapons within 30 feet of the valkyrie have advantage on weapon attack rolls and ability checks. At the start of each of its turns, the valkyrie can choose to exclude any number of friendly creatures from this aura (no action required).

trait.name: Immortal Nature
entries: The valkyrie doesn't require food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The valkyrie has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Radiant Weapons
entries: The valkyrie's weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 16 ({@damage 3d10}) radiant damage (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The valkyrie can use its Gaze of Doom. It then makes two Longsword attacks and one Spear attack, or it makes three Radiant Bolt attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage, or 9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 16 ({@damage 3d10}) radiant damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 16 ({@damage 3d10}) radiant damage.

action.name: Radiant Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 8} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d10 + 4}) radiant damage.

action.name: Gaze of Doom
entries: The valkyrie's gaze foretells a doomed fate for one creature the valkyrie can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Healing Touch (4/Day)
entries: The valkyrie touches another creature. The target magically regains 21 {@dice 6d6} hp and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

reaction.name: Ascension
entries: When a friendly creature the valkyrie can see and within its Aura of Valor is reduced to 0 hp while engaged in melee combat, the valkyrie can reincarnate the creature as a gladiator. If the gladiator reduces at least three creatures to 0 hp within 1 minute of its reincarnation, it transforms into an einherjar. The valkyrie can provide ascension to up to two creatures each hour with this reaction.

trait.name: Acid Absorption
entries: Whenever the valochera is subjected to acid damage, they take no damage and instead regain a number of hit points equal to the acid damage dealt.

trait.name: Unbearable Stench
entries: Any creature who starts their turn within 5 feet of the valochera must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The valochera makes two Mycelium attacks.

action.name: Mycelium
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).
Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Chow Time
entries: The valochera douses a creature they have {@condition grappled} with acid and then takes a bite. The target must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) acid damage plus 14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Poison Glob {@recharge 5}
entries: The valochera spits a glob of noxious sludge at a point they can see within 30 feet of them.

Each creature in a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw, taking 33 ({@damage 6d10}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Vampire
languages: the languages they knew in life

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, the vampire can cast the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}):

trait.name: Radiant Aversion
entries: Each time the vampire takes radiant damage, they take an extra 10 radiant damage.

trait.name: Resting Place
entries: When the vampire drops to 0 hit points and is not in sunlight, running water, or their resting place, the vampire teleports to their resting place. While in their resting place, the vampire is stable. After spending 1 hour in their resting place with 0 hit points, they regain 1 hit point.

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The vampire has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes two Claw attacks and, if possible, a Bite attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. If the target is Large or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, the target is {@condition restrained}. Moving while grappling a Medium or smaller creature doesn't halve the vampire's speed. A vampire can have only one target {@condition grappled} in this way at a time.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature who is {@condition grappled} by the vampire, {@condition incapacitated}, or {@condition restrained}. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by a number equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains hit points equal to that number. The reduction lasts until reversed by a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power of 4th order or higher, a {@spell greater restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect. The target dies if this attack reduces their hit point maximum to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way rises the following midnight as a vampire spawn under the vampire's control.

action.name: Exsanguinating Mist {@recharge}
entries: The vampire, along with anything they are wearing or carrying, turns into a cloud of blood-sucking mist. When they do, they release any creature they were grappling, and if the vampire was {@condition grappled} or {@condition restrained}, that effect ends for them. Then the vampire flies up to twice their speed to an unoccupied space. During this move, the vampire ignores difficult terrain, doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, and can move through creatures and objects. Each creature the vampire passes through must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 35 ({@damage 10d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. At the end of this movement, the vampire transforms back into their previous form.

bonus.name: Beguile
entries: The vampire targets one creature they can see within 30 feet of them and who can see them. The target must make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target uses their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed to a location chosen by the vampire, then either makes a melee attack against a target of the vampire's choice or falls {@condition prone} (vampire's choice).

Creatures who can't be {@condition charmed} automatically succeed on this saving throw, and creatures who have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} make this saving throw with advantage.

bonus.name: Inhuman Agility
entries: The vampire moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

reaction.name: Run, My Child
entries: When an ally the vampire can see takes damage, the vampire can command the ally to move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Vampire Neophyte

hp.special: Eight times their level (number of d10 Hit Dice equal to their level)

languages: any two languages they knew in life

action.name: Signature Attack (Claws)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d8 plus PB} slashing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the neophyte can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Take Away (3/Day)
entries: When the neophyte hits a creature with a signature attack, the neophyte grabs the target. The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}), and the neophyte moves up to their speed without provoking attacks of opportunity (no action required). If the {@condition grappled} creature is Medium or smaller, they don't cost the neophyte extra movement.

action.name: 5th Level: Blood Seeker (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the neophyte moves up to their speed toward a creature they can see within 60 feet of them. If the neophyte ends their movement within 5 feet of the creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}) and take {@damage 1d4} piercing damage plus {@damage PBd8} necrotic damage. The neophyte regains hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt.

action.name: 7th Level: Child of the Night (3/Day)
entries: As a reaction to taking damage, the neophyte disappears in a cloud of bats and insects. Every enemy within 10 feet of the neophyte must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage PBd4} piercing damage plus {@damage PBd4} slashing damage. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. At the end of the turn, the neophyte reforms in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of where they disappeared.

name: Vampire Spawn
languages: the languages they knew in life

trait.name: Radiant Aversion
entries: Each time the spawn takes radiant damage, they take an extra 10 radiant damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spawn makes two Claw attacks. They can replace one attack with a Bite attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Moving while grappling a Medium or smaller creature doesn't halve the spawn's speed. The spawn can have only one target {@condition grappled} in this way at a time.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature who is {@condition grappled} by the spawn, {@condition incapacitated}, or {@condition restrained}. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by a number equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the spawn regains hit points equal to that number. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest or is targeted by a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power of 4th order or higher, a {@spell greater restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect. The target dies if this attack reduces their hit point maximum to 0.

bonus.name: Inhuman Speed
entries: The spawn moves up to their speed.

trait.name: Fog Flow
entries: While in fog or mist, the vapor lynx can move through a space as narrow at 1 inch wide without squeezing, provided the fog or mist is flowing through the space.

trait.name: Hazesight
entries: The vapor lynx can see through areas obscured by fog, mist, and steam without penalty.

trait.name: Swamp Walk
entries: Difficult terrain composed of mud, shallow water, and water plants doesn't cost the vapor lynx extra movement.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vapor lynx makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Poison Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The vapor lynx exhales poisonous fog in a 20-foot radius centered on itself. The fog spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. The fog lasts for 1 minute. A creature that starts its turn in the fog or enters the fog for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Fog Step
entries: The vapor lynx teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. The origin and destination spaces must contain fog.

name: Vedaja
languages: Understands the language of its creator plus one other language but can't speak

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: A vedaja's form can't be altered.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The vedaja has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vedaja makes two Hand attacks.

action.name: Hand
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Bludgeoning or Piercing damage (the vedaja's choice).

action.name: Terrifying Glare
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 11} One creature the vedaja can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of the vedaja's next turn. While {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition.

name: Veiled Lady

trait.name: Communication Spores
entries: The Veiled Lady's telepathy extends throughout its lair. It communicates using images and emotion.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Veiled Lady fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Mycelial Form
entries: The Veiled Lady can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Sun Sickness
entries: While in sunlight, or if it takes 15 or more radiant damage in a single turn, the Veiled Lady has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of its next turn. The Veiled Lady dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

trait.name: Symbiotic Vigour (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the Veiled Lady would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 138 hit points, it gains 138 temporary hit points as beetles, hyphae, and grubs swarm over it, and it recharges its Infectious Spores and Shackles of Pain actions. Additionally, the Veiled Lady can use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 18,000 XP (29,500 XP total) for defeating the Veiled Lady after its Symbiotic Vigour activates.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Veiled Lady uses either its Infectious Spores or Shackles of Pain, if available, then makes two Halluciwhip attacks.

action.name: Halluciwhip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 3d4 + 4}) slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Infectious Spores (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The Veiled Lady exhales a cloud of spores at a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or become afflicted as by the fungal infection* spell cast at 6th level for 1 minute. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Shackles of Pain (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The Veiled Lady exhales a cloud of spores at a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or become afflicted by the shackles of pain* spell. The Veiled Lady can have only one creature afflicted by Shackles of Pain at a time.

bonus.name: Detritivore
entries: As a bonus action, the Veiled Lady can target one Small or larger corpse not under the effects of the gentle repose spell within 15 feet of it, draining it of its essence and regaining 21 ({@damage 6d6}) hit points. Once a corpse has been targeted by this feature, it becomes desiccated and can't be targeted again.

legendaryHeader: The Veiled Lady can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Veiled Lady regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Hyphal Tether
entries: Tendrils of grasping hyphae burst from the ground, grabbing at one creature the Veiled Lady can see within 30 feet of it. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or become grappled (escape {@dc 18}). Until this grapple ends, that creature is restrained.

legendary.name: Mycelial Reconstitution
entries: The Veiled Lady dissolves into mycelia, ending any grapples or restraining effects to which it is currently subjected, and reappears in an unoccupied space on the ground it can see within 30 feet of it. This does not end grapples created by the Veiled Lady's Hyphal Tether.

legendary.name: Whip
entries: The Veiled Lady makes a Halluciwhip attack.

mythicHeader: If the Veiled Lady's Symbiotic Vigour has activated in the last hour, it can use the options below as legendary actions.

mythic.name: Spore Bloom
entries: The Veiled Lady recharges and uses its Infectious Spores or Shackles of Pain. The Veiled Lady must use a different legendary action before it uses this one again.

mythic.name: Whirlwhip (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Veiled Lady flicks its whip in a wide circle. Each creature within 10 feet of the Veiled Lady must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) slashing and 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Velma is a 1st-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). Velma has the following spells prepared:

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: Velma's long jump is 30 feet, and her base high jump is 15 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Team Tactics
entries: Velma can take the {@action Help} action as a bonus action.

action.name: Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage, or 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

trait.name: Rampage
entries: When the venomous gnoll reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the gnoll can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The venomous gnoll makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage and 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage and 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage.

action.name: Spine Spike
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage and 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage.

name: Venomous Mummy
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Toxic Smoke
entries: If the venomous mummy takes fire damage, each creature within 10 feet of it must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw as its venom-soaked wraps emit a poisonous smoke. On a failure, a creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. The smoke fills a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on the mummy. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is lightly obscured. It lasts until the end of the mummy's next turn. A creature that enters the cloud for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there is {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Venom-Soaked Wraps
entries: A creature that touches the mummy or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The venomous mummy doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Venomous Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be cursed. Every 24 hours that elapse, the cursed target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage, and its hp maximum is reduced by that amount.
