A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the wampus cat's Sweet Song for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Terrifying Yowl {@recharge 5}
entries: The wampus cat emits an ear‑piercing yowl. Each creature within 15 feet of the wampus cat that can hear the yowl must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) thunder damage and is {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition frightened}.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The wampus cat magically polymorphs into a Medium female Humanoid, or back into her true form. Her statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying transforms with her. She reverts to her true form if she dies.

name: Wandering Door
languages: understands all languages but can't speak

trait.name: Dispel Susceptibility
entries: The Wandering Door becomes a mundane pile of rubble if it's targeted by a {@spell Dispel Magic} spell of 7th level or higher.

trait.name: Doorway
entries: A creature that enters the Wandering Door can teleport to any doorway on any plane as if the doorway was planted directly in front of the location.
If a creature is not aware of how the door's magic works, it is instead teleported to a random doorway.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The Wandering Door is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (7/Day)
entries: If the Wandering Door fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Like the Wind
entries: The Wandering Door's movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Wandering Door has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Special Feet
entries: The Wandering Door can walk on all surfaces, including vertically up walls and on top of water.

action.name: Leap!
entries: The Wandering Door leaps 60 feet vertically into the air.

action.name: Shake!
entries: The Wandering Door shakes violently. All creatures on top of the Wandering Door must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be thrown away from the door, landing {@condition prone} in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of it.

reaction.name: Flee
entries: If a creature moves within 30 feet of the Wandering Door, it moves up to 100 feet.

reaction.name: Shake!
entries: When a creature lands on top of the Wandering Door, the door shakes violently. All creatures on top of the Wandering Door must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be thrown away from the door, landing {@condition prone} in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of it.

trait.name: Primal Strike
entries: Once on each of its turns, when the druid hits a creature with an attack, it deals an extra {@damage 1d8} Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage (chosen on a successful hit).

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Humanoid Form Only)
headerEntries: The druid casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The druid makes three attacks, or it casts a spell.

action.name: Fang and Claw (Wild Shape Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) Radiant damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Hand Axe (Humanoid Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d6 + 1}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Short Bow (Humanoid Form Only)
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Verdant Bolt
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7} to hit, range 90 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) Radiant damage.

bonus.name: Wild Shape
entries: The druid shapeshifts into a beast form or back to humanoid form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except where listed. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed into its body when it shifts into beast form. When the druid shifts into a beast form, it gains 18 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Dowsing Sense
entries: The wandering pond instinctively knows the direction, size, and location of all bodies of water containing at least 30 gallons of liquid within 1 mile of its location.

trait.name: Faerie Glamour
entries: While the wandering pond remains motionless, it is covered in an illusory glamour that makes it appear like a charming pond. The pond seems completely real, including sounds and smells appropriate to the depicted pond. Physical interaction with the pond reveals its nature, and the creatures who can see through illusion perceive the ooze for what it really is.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wandering pond makes two Pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Vortex
entries: The wandering pond engulfs a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. An engulfed creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the pond, and it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the wandering pond's turns. A creature reduced to 0 hit points in this way becomes stable and is instantly teleported to a random body of water within 1 mile of the wandering pond.

The wandering pond can only have one creature swallowed at a time. While the pond isn't {@condition incapacitated}, it can regurgitate the creature at any time (no action required) in a space within 5 feet of it. The creature exits {@condition prone}. If the wandering pond dies, it likewise regurgitates a swallowed creature.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The wandslinger casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}):

trait.name: Quickdraw
entries: During its first turn, the wandslinger has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn, and any hit the wandslinger scores against such a creature is a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Arcane Blast
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 120 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d10 + 2}) Force damage.

bonus.name: Taunt (2/Day)
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 12}, one creature within 30 feet that can hear the wandslinger. {@actSaveFail} The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the start of the wandslinger's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chosen makes two attacks, using Longsword or Radiant Bolt in any combination.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Radiant damage.

action.name: Radiant Bolt
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4} to hit, range 90 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d10 + 2}) Radiant damage.

action.name: War God's Healing {@recharge 5}
entries: One ally within 30 feet of the chaplain regains 10 ({@damage 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

bonus.name: Divine Orders
entries: The war chaplain commands an ally within 30 feet. The target can use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make one attack against a creature the chaplain attacked this round.

trait.name: Leaping Pounce
entries: If the war ostrich jumps at least 15 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the ostrich can make one Beak attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The war ostrich's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Intimidating Screech
entries: The war ostrich screeches at a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn, as the screech rattles it.

bonus.name: Skittish
entries: The war ostrich takes the Dash or Disengage action.

trait.name: Baby Burst
entries: When the spider dies, a {@creature swarm of spiders|FleeMortals} bursts forth from their remains and acts on the same initiative count as the spider did.

trait.name: Rider Launcher
entries: An allied rider who jumps off the spider has a long jump of 30 feet and a high jump of 15 feet, with or without a running start. If an allied rider jumps off the spider, the first melee weapon attack the ally makes on the same turn has advantage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

trait.name: Wide Back
entries: Two Small or Tiny creatures can share a space while riding the spider, allowing up to eighteen Small or seventy-two Tiny creatures to ride the spider at once.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Bladed Leg
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Web Spray
entries: The spider sprays webbing from their abdomen in a 15-foot cube. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} by the webbing. A creature can use their action to make a {@dc 14} Strength or Dexterity check, freeing themself or another creature they can reach on a success.

action.name: Trample {@recharge}
entries: The spider can move up to their speed and move through the spaces of other creatures as if they were difficult terrain. The spider can make one Bladed Leg attack against each creature whose space they move into during the move. A creature hit by this attack can't take reactions until the start of their next turn.

action.name: Legs
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}1 Piercing damage.

action.name: Detect Ward
entries: The ward sweeper clicks loudly one time for each {@spell Glyph of Warding|XPHB} within 10 feet.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The warlock's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks), requiring no material components:

trait.name: Skulker
entries: The ratling can take the Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The ratling has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The ratling casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The ratling has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Balefire
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 2d8} Necrotic).

action.name: Conjure Swarms (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The ratling conjures two Swarms of Rats, which appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet. The swarms act immediately after the ratling in {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}. The swarms remain for 1 minute or until destroyed.

bonus.name: Teleport
entries: The ratling teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The warlord makes three attacks, using Battleaxe or Longbow in any combination.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Command
entries: The warlord orders one ally within 60 feet that can see and hear the warlord. The ally can immediately use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make a melee or ranged weapon attack against a target the warlord chooses.

bonus.name: Intimidate
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 14} One creature the warlord can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls until the start of the warlord's next turn.

reaction.name: Reflexive Strike
entries: {@actTrigger} The warlord is hit by an attack roll. {@actResponse} The warlord can make one Battle Axe attack against the attacker. On a hit, the attacker must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The warp marauder is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The warp marauder may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the warp marauder can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the warp marauder has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Alien Intellect
entries: The warp marauder is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the warp marauder's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Extraplanar Gullet
entries: The warp marauder's back opens into a large mouth that leads to an extradimensional gullet. Anything it swallows is transported into this extraplanar space, which manifests as a rhizomatic network of slurping tunnels and fleshy passages. This space can hold any number of creatures of any size, and nothing inside the space can harm the warp marauder.

A creature within the gullet can take an action to attempt to escape, making a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw. On a success, it reappears in the nearest unoccupied space within 5 feet of the warp marauder. On a failure, it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage. If the warp marauder dies, everything inside the extraplanar gullet appears in the nearest unoccupied spaces to its corpse.

trait.name: Grasping Tentacles
entries: The warp marauder can have up to four tentacles at a time. Each tentacle has AC 20, 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage. Destroying a tentacle deals no damage to the warp marauder, which can extrude a replacement tentacle on its next turn. A creature within 5 feet can take an action to break a tentacle with a successful {@dc 15} Strength check.

trait.name: Swirling Color Field
entries: A field of shimmering color reverberates around the warp marauder, distorting reality. A creature that hits the warp marauder with an attack suffers one of the following effects, determined randomly (roll {@dice 1d6}). A creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} and adjacent to the warp marauder isn't affected by the Swirling Color Field.

trait.name: 1-2: Blue
entries: The attacker is teleported to an unoccupied space the warp marauder can see within 20 feet. The chosen space must be on a surface or in a liquid that can support the target. The attacker is then subjected to the following effect. {@actSave cha} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

trait.name: 3-4: Yellow
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Lightning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

trait.name: 5-6: Red
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Staggered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The warp marauder makes four Tentacle attacks, uses Reel, and makes one Bite attack.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 60 ft. {@h}The target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and saving throws, and the warp marauder can't use this tentacle against another target.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft, one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the warp marauder. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) Piercing damage, and the warp marauder swallows the target. The target, along with everything it is wearing and carrying, appears in the warp marauder's Extraplanar Gullet.

action.name: Reel
entries: The warp marauder pulls each creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by it up to 30 feet straight toward it.

bonus.name: Dimensional Jump
entries: The warp marauder teleports to an unoccupied space within 120 feet. Alternatively, it travels from the Material Plane to the Space Between Worlds or vice versa.

reaction.name: Reality Hunter
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the warp marauder attempts to teleport. {@actResponse d}{@actSave int} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Force damage, and the teleport fails. {@actSaveSuccess} The teleport fails, but no resources are wasted.

items.name: Psychic Wail {@recharge 5}
entries: Every creature within 30 feet of the warp witch must succeed on a {@dc 13} Intelligence saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage and become {@condition incapacitated} until the end of the warp witches next turn.

items.name: Mutate Host
entries: The warp witch can use a bonus action while it is possessing a creature to force mutations upon its host. The possessed creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}. Rather than rolling to determine if a mutation occurs, the warp witch automatically causes a random mutation.

name: Warp Witch
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The warp witch can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Balefire Lantern
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) Cold damage, and the target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the warp witch's next turn.

action.name: Psychic Scream
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition (save ends).

action.name: Possession
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 13}, one Humanoid the warp witch can see within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target is possessed by the Warp Witch. The witch disappears, and the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and loses control of its body. The witch controls the target's body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The witch can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead. The witch retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions. It otherwise uses the possessed target's game statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the witch ends it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, or the witch is turned or forced out by an effect like the {@spell Dispel Evil and Good|XPHB} spell. When the possession ends, the witch reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. If the target succeeds on its save or the effect ends for it, it is immune to this warp witch's {@variantrule Possession|XPHB} for 24 hours.

bonus.name: Mutate Host
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 13}, one creature the warp witch is possessing. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level and a mutation.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The warpriest casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

spellcasting.name: Divine Aid (3/Day)
headerEntries: The warpriest casts {@spell Bless|XPHB}, {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB}, {@spell Healing Word|XPHB}, or {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The warpriest makes three attacks, using Blessed Warhammer or Divine Flame in any combination.

action.name: Blessed Warhammer
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Radiant or Necrotic damage (warpriest's choice).

action.name: Divine Flame
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) Radiant or Necrotic damage (warpriest's choice)

reaction.name: War Blessing
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the warpriest can see within 30 feet hits with a melee weapon attack. {@actResponse} The triggering weapon deals an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Radiant or Necrotic damage (warpriest's choice).

name: Watchful Priest
languages: one regional language plus one other language

trait.name: Enraging Sacrifice
entries: When the priest dies, each ally within 20 feet who can see the priest gains 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} and a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls for 1 minute.

trait.name: Zealous Aura
entries: The priest radiates an aura of zeal in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from it. Each ally in the area has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} checks, and their successful attacks deal an extra {@damage 1d4} Radiant damage. This aura becomes inactive if the priest has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The priest makes two Castigating Word attacks.

action.name: Castigating Word
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) Radiant damage, and one ally of the priest within 20 feet of the target can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make a melee attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

bonus.name: Righteous Morale (1/Day)
entries: The priest chooses up to three other creatures it can see within 20 feet of it. Each target regains 4 ({@damage 1d8}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and has  {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions until the start of the priest's next turn.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: If the Watchwood Tree is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the Watchwood Tree move or act, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to discern that the Watchwood Tree isn't an ordinary tree.

trait.name: Unruly Earth
entries: The ground within a 15-foot radius centered on the Watchwood Tree is considered {@quickref difficult terrain||3} for all creatures besides the Watchwood Tree.

action.name: Root Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Watching Eye {@recharge}
entries: The terrifying gaze of a Watchwood Tree can leave a creature frozen in its tracks. Each creature of the Watchwood Tree's choice within a 15-foot cone must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition restrained}; a creature that can't be {@condition frightened} automatically succeeds on its saving throw. The Watchwood Tree can then immediately make a Root Slam attack against each creature that failed its saving throw.
A creature {@condition restrained} in this way can use its action to make a {@dc 12} Wisdom check, freeing itself on a success.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The water leaper can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Underwater Camouflage
entries: The water leaper has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made while underwater.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The water leaper makes one Bite attack and one Stinger attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the water leaper can't Bite another target.

action.name: Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the creature takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. A {@condition poisoned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The water leaper makes a Bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside the water leaper, and it takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the water leaper's turns. The water leaper can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If the water leaper takes 15 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the leaper must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls {@condition prone} in a space within 5 feet of the leaper. If the leaper dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the spark takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the spark takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Whirlpool Suction
entries: If an enemy starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more water sparks, the enemy must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have their speed reduced to 0. The DC for this saving throw equals 14 plus the number of water sparks within 5 feet of the enemy.

action.name: Whelming Wave (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. {@h}10 bludgeoning damage, and if the attack was made by more than one spark, the target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and be unable to stand up until the end of the sparks' next turn. The DC for this saving throw equals 14 plus the number of sparks who joined the attack.

trait.name: Bottle Trap
entries: A haint that enters the space of an upright, empty bottle must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or be drawn into the bottle, and a cork or stopper appears to close the bottle. The trapped haint can see and hear through the bottle out to 10 feet, and any creature in that range can hear the haint. The haint is released if the bottle breaks or another creature opens it.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The haint can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside a solid object.

action.name: Draining Regret
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the target gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level. This can't raise the target's {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level above 5, and all {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} levels gained from this action end when the target finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, or if it receives a {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB} spell or similar magic.

spellcasting.name: Coven Magic
headerEntries: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell's normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability: {@spell Augury|XPHB}, {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB}, {@spell Identify|XPHB}, {@spell Locate Object|XPHB}, {@spell Lucky Charm|CrookedMoon24} (lasts until the hag casts it again, or chooses to end it with no action required), or {@spell Unseen Servant|XPHB}. The hag must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before using this trait to cast that spell again.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

trait.name: Biting Gift
entries: If a creature willingly offers one of its teeth to the hag, the hag must accept it and has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for 24 hours, or until the creature or its allies deal damage to the hag or force it to make a saving throw.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes one Bite attack and uses Spellcasting (at will spells only).

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage.

action.name: Waking Terrors {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 13}, one creature the hag can see within 30 feet. If the hag has one of the target's teeth, the target has Disadvantage on the save. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

While {@condition Frightened|XPHB} in this way, the target perceives its allies as enemies born from its nightmares, but it isn't compelled to act against or harm them. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The hag shape-shifts to resemble a Tiny {@creature weasel|XMM} ({@variantrule Speed|XPHB} 30 ft., Climb 30 ft.) or a Small or Medium Humanoid, or back into her true form. Her game statistics, other than her {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} as a weasel and her size, are the same in each form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

trait.name: Alien Mind
entries: A creature who attempts to communicate with the weeper must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The weeper has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The weeper makes three attacks, only one of which can be a Stinger attack.

action.name: Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Lashing Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. The weeper has two lashing tendrils, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Grasping Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. {@h}The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}), and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be pulled to up to 15 feet toward the weeper. It has two grasping tendrils, each of which can grapple only one target. If it is grappling at least one creature with its grasping tendril, the weeper can use this action to pull all creatures {@condition grappled} in this way up to 30 feet closer to it.

bonus.name: Maddening Song {@recharge 4}
entries: The weeper sings its maddening melody. The song doesn't typically affect sentient creatures but being subjected to it at close range can have deleterious effects. Each creature within 15 feet of the weeper that can hear its song must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn, as the alien song muddles the mind and confuses the senses.

action.name: Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 1} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The weeping treant deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Speak with Plants
entries: The weeping treant can communicate with plants as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Weep Acid
entries: Thick tears of dark, acidic sap stream continuously down the treant's face and trunk. A creature that touches the weeping treant or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The weeping treant makes two Slam or Rock attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., single target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage, and the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage at the end of its next turn unless it or another creature takes an action to wipe off the acid.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the willow remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from a normal willow tree.

trait.name: Flammable
entries: If the willow takes fire damage, they catch fire and take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage at the start of each of their turns for 1 minute. The effect ends early if the willow takes cold damage or a creature uses an action to extinguish the flames.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The willow makes two Frenzied Branch attacks.

action.name: Frenzied Branch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the willow is on fire, this attack deals an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Tugging Roots
entries: Roots erupt from a point on the ground the willow can see within 60 feet of them. Each creature in a 10-foot sphere centered on that point must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and moved up to 30 feet toward the willow, taking 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet moved.

action.name: Willow's Tears
entries: The willow showers salty droplets on their bower. Each creature within 15 feet of the willow must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the willow (save ends at end of turn). While {@condition charmed} in this way, a creature can't willingly move more than 15 feet away from the willow. If a creature {@condition charmed} in this way takes damage, the effect ends for them.

reaction.name: Tree Transformation
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the willow deals slashing damage to the willow, the willow attempts to turn the creature into a tree. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or their feet begin to transform into tree roots and they are {@condition restrained}. A creature {@condition restrained} in this way must repeat the saving throw at the end of their next turn. On a successful save, the effect ends. On a failed save, they are transformed into a wooden tree and are {@condition petrified}. A creature {@condition petrified} in this way resembles a normal tree of the same size as that creature, except the creature's face appears carved into the trunk. If the willow dies, the petrification ends and the creature reverts to their true form. A {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power or {@spell lesser restoration} spell also ends this effect.

trait.name: Alluring Cry
entries: The cry of the Weeping Willow attracts creatures in a 120-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} from the willow. At the start of each of its turns, a creature within the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma save or have the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for 1 hour. On a success, the target is immune to this Weeping Willow's Alluring Cry for 24 hours.

While {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, the target also has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. On each of its turns, a {@condition Charmed|XPHB} creature must use its movement to approach the Weeping Willow by the most direct route, stopping when it is within 5 feet of the Weeping Willow. It doesn't avoid {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}, but if this movement would obviously cause damage (such as by walking through fire), the creature repeats the save before entering that space.

trait.name: Deep Rooted
entries: The Weeping Willow is immune to effects that would move it.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Weeping Willow has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Weeping Willow makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d10 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Lignify
entries: {@actSave con}, one creature within 5 feet: {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, ending the effect on itself on a success. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition instead of the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition, becoming a tree permanently. {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB} or similar magic returns an affected creature to their original form.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Weeping Willow casts one of the following spells without the need for components, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The wellwyrm can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Hunting Terror
entries: If the wellwyrm hears a creature play a horn or similar Musical Instrument, it has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wellwyrm makes one Bite attack and uses Constrict.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 10 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 16}, one Medium or smaller creature the wellwyrm can see within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}), and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends. The wellwyrm needn't spend extra movement to move during this grapple.

walk.condition: (50 ft. and 30 ft. climb in hybrid and kindred form)

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The werebear is a 13th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). It can cast spells in any form, regardless of verbal, somatic, or material components provided they have no gold cost. It has the following druid spells prepared:

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The werebear ascetic can use its action to polymorph into a bear-humanoid hybrid or into its kindred bear form, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, unless noted, are the same in each form. Any armor it is wearing merges into its alternate forms. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Kindred Form
entries: The werebear's kindred form takes the shape of a Large bear. While in this form, it can speak to and understand bears, cannot take any actions requiring hands, adds its Constitution modifier to the result of any saving throw, and gains 25 temporary hit points the first time it takes this form each day.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The werebear makes three melee attacks, only one of which can be a bite.

action.name: Bite (Hybrid or Kindred Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d8 + 3}) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be cursed with werebear lycanthropy.

action.name: Claw (Hybrid or Kindred Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Adapted
entries: The weremammoth can tolerate temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower without being subjected to the effects of extreme cold.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The weremammoth makes three attacks, using Spear or Trample in any combination. It can replace one attack with a Gore attack.

action.name: Gore (Mammoth or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it instead becomes a Weremammoth under the GM's control and has 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this weremammoth's curse for 24 hours.

action.name: Spear (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d6 + 7}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Trample (Mammoth or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the weremammoth moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The werewolf shape-shifts into a Large mammoth-humanoid hybrid or a Huge mammoth, or it returns to its true humanoid form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

vulnerable.note: from nonmagical attacks that are silvered

trait.name: Grappler
entries: While a creature is {@condition grappled} by the werewolf ravager, the werewolf has advantage on attack rolls against {@condition grappled} targets, and the target takes an additional 3 {@damage 1d6} damage whenever it is hit with the werewolf's bite or claw attack.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The werewolf can use its action to polymorph into a wolf-humanoid hybrid or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Any armor it is wearing merges into its hybrid form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The werewolf ravager makes two melee attacks. It can only make one bite attack per turn.

action.name: Bite (Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled}.
Additionally, if the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be cursed with werewolf lycanthropy.

action.name: Claw (Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Short Sword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Patriotic Outrider
entries: If the westwind rider has neither the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition, friendly creatures within 30 feet that can see it gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The westwind rider makes two Lance or Longsword attacks, in any combination.

action.name: Lance
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) Piercing damage. If the westwind rider is mounted and directed its mount to move at least 10 feet straight toward a target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Piercing damage and, if it is Huge or smaller, it is pushed up to 10 feet away and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Slashing damage or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) Slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Arcane Blast
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 120 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d10 + 2}) Force damage.

reaction.name: Take Heart!
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature that the westwind rider can see, and who can see or hear the westwind rider, is hit by a melee attack. {@actResponse} The target adds 2 to its AC against the attack.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The wharfling can breathe air and water.

action.name: Pilfering Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the wharfling can steal one item the target is wearing or carrying, provided the item weighs no more than 10 pounds, isn't a weapon, and isn't wrapped around or firmly attached to the target, such as a shirt or armor.

trait.name: Spellcasting Animosity
entries: If the white ape sees a creature cast a spell, the ape has advantage on attack rolls against that creature on the ape's next turn.

trait.name: Arcane Wasting
entries: Characterized by the slow mental deterioration it causes, arcane wasting is a disease that infects Humanoids and spreads through spellcasting. A creature infected with this disease manifests symptoms {@dice 1d4} days after infection, which include brain fog and difficulty recalling memories. Until the disease is cured, at the end of each long rest, the infected creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or its Intelligence and Wisdom scores are each reduced by {@dice 1d2}. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest after the disease is cured. If the disease reduces a creature's Intelligence or Wisdom to 0, the creature dies. If the infected creature casts a spell on a Humanoid before the disease is cured, and the Humanoid is hit by the spell or fails the saving throw, that Humanoid must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or also become infected with the arcane wasting disease.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The white ape has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The white ape makes one Bite attack and two Fist attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or contract the arcane wasting disease (see the Arcane Wasting trait).

action.name: Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Frenzy {@recharge 5}
entries: The white ape lashes out wildly at nearby creatures, flailing and biting. Each creature within 10 feet of the white ape must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away from the ape. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't pushed. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw also has advantage on attack rolls against the white ape until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Blizzard Stalker
entries: Inclement weather (such as fog, snow or wind) doesn't impede the wraith's vision, and it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks it makes in such conditions.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} (with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} during the first round of each combat), reach 5 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d8 + 3}) Necrotic damage plus 16 ({@damage 3d10}) Cold damage. If the target is a creature, its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken.

action.name: Freezing Gale {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Cold damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Create Walker (2/Day)
entries: The wraith targets a Humanoid corpse within 10 feet of itself that died from either Cold damage or exposure to extreme cold. The target's remains animate as either a Skeleton or a Zombie (depending on the state of the corpse, as determined by the GM) that has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Cold and Necrotic damage and shares the wraith's Blizzard Stalker trait. The animated creature is under the wraith's control. The wraith can have no more than ten animated creatures under its control at a time.

name: Wight
languages: the languages they knew in life

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wight makes one Longsword attack and one Vitality Theft attack, or they make two Heavy Crossbow attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d10 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Vitality Theft
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage, and the wight regains a number of hit points equal to half the damage dealt. Until the start of the wight's next turn, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls made against creatures other than the wight.

reaction.name: Decaying Guard
entries: When an ally the wight can see within 5 feet of them is hit by an attack, the wight forces the attacker to reroll the attack and to instead target the wight or a willing ally within 5 feet of the original target.

name: Wight Deathguard

hp.special: Eight times their level (number of d10 Hit Dice equal to their level)

languages: the languages they knew in life

action.name: Signature Attack (Longsword)
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d8 plus PB} slashing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the deathguard can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Blood for Blood (3/Day)
entries: As a reaction to an ally the deathguard can see within 5 feet of them being hit with an attack, the deathguard redirects the attack to themself, potentially causing the attack to miss. If the attacker is within 5 feet of the deathguard, the deathguard can make a signature attack against the attacker.

action.name: 5th Level: Soul Thief (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the deathguard shrouds themself in dark energy. The deathguard regains {@damage PBd6} hit points, and each enemy within 5 feet of the deathguard must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes {@damage PBd6} necrotic damage. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage.

action.name: 7th Level: This Way! (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the deathguard moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Each ally the deathguard passes within 5 feet of during the move can use a reaction to move up to their speed in the same direction as the deathguard without provoking opportunity attacks. Until the start of the deathguard's next turn, attacks against these allies have disadvantage.

name: Wight Siphoner
languages: the languages they knew in life

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the siphoner takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the siphoner takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Grasping Resurrection (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 necrotic damage. If three or more siphoners joined the attack, they can restore the remains of a destroyed Undead minion within 15 feet of the target. That Undead minion returns to life with all their hit points. If five or more siphoners joined the group attack, they can either choose to increase the range of this effect from 15 to 30 feet or to restore two Undead minions instead of one.

name: Wild Wolf
passive: 15 (20 when relying on hearing or smell)

trait.name: Fear of Fire
entries: If a Wild Wolf takes fire or radiant damage, it must succeed on a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check ({@dc 10} + damage taken) or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The Wild Wolf has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The Wild Wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Wild Wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must make a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Hunter's Pounce
entries: If the wildcat hits a Large or smaller target and had advantage on the attack roll, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). While grappling the target in this way, the wildcat can't attack another creature.

trait.name: Natural Camouflage
entries: The wildcat has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made in their native terrain.

trait.name: Sprint (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: When the wildcat moves on their turn in combat, they can triple their speed until the end of their turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage, plus an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage if the target is {@condition grappled} or {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage, plus an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) slashing damage if the wildcat had advantage on the attack roll.

bonus.name: Sneak
entries: The wildcat takes the Hide action.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

trait.name: Familiar Territory
entries: The wildcat has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) and Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks made in their native terrain (as determined by you and the GM).

trait.name: Predator's Grab (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: When the wildcat hits a creature with an opportunity attack, the creature is also {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}).

trait.name: Sprint (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: When the wildcat moves on their turn in combat, they can triple their speed until the end of their turn.

action.name: Signature Attack (Bite or Claw)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage (Bite) or slashing damage (Claw).

action.name: 1st Level: Crushing Jaws (2 Ferocity)
entries: The wildcat makes a signature Bite attack, dealing an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} bludgeoning damage on a hit, or an extra 2 × PB bludgeoning damage to a target they are grappling.

action.name: 3rd Level: Pounce (5 Ferocity)
entries: The wildcat moves up to their speed and makes a signature attack against one target, dealing an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} damage on a hit. If the target is Large or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}), and the wildcat can't attack another creature until the grapple ends.

action.name: 5th Level: Shredding Claws (8 Ferocity)
entries: The wildcat makes three signature Claw attacks against the same target. The target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the wildcat for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The wildpyre can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Quenching Water
entries: Any water affects the wildpyre as if it were Holy Water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wildpyre makes two Blazing Rend attacks and uses Flame Bind if available.

action.name: Blazing Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Necrotic damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Fire damage, and the target begins burning. If the target is a creature no larger than the wildpyre, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Flame Bind {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}, one creature the wildpyre can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. At the end of each of the target's turns, it repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. During the target's turn, it can choose to end the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition by taking 6 ({@damage 1d12}) Fire damage plus 6 ({@damage 1d12}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Elusive
entries: The dragon has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid or escape an effect that would reduce its speed or grapple or restrain it.

trait.name: Storm Sight
entries: The dragon can see through areas obscured by fog, mist, clouds, or precipitation.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tempest Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales a blast of stormy wind in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 5 feet away from the dragon. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't pushed. Unprotected flames, such as torches, in the area are extinguished, and protected flames, such as those in lanterns, have a 50 percent chance of being extinguished.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The wind troll regains 15 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Storm Absorption
entries: Whenever the wind troll is subjected to Lightning or Thunder damage, it regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Lightning and Thunder damage dealt.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The wind troll casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wind troll makes three attacks, using Rend or Storm Strike in any combination.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Storm Strike
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7} to hit, range 60 feet, one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Lightning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Thunder damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Windstorm {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 15} Each creature in a 20-foot radius around the troll. {@actSaveFail} 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away from the troll. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Flying Charge
entries: The wind troll flies up to half its {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The winged wretch makes two Rend attacks.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) Slashing damage.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The troll regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Special Immunities
entries: The troll is {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immune} to the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition(s).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes two Slam attacks and one Bite attack. It can replace its Bite attack with Freezing Breath, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Cold damage, and the target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the troll's next turn. Critical {@h}The target has the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (escape {@dc 16}).

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Cold damage.

action.name: Freezing Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Cold damage and has the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (escape {@dc 16}). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The pup has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the pup's {@variantrule Ally|XPHB|Allies} is within 5 feet of the creature and the {@variantrule Ally|XPHB} doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) Piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Cold damage.

trait.name: Natural Appearance
entries: While the wirbeln remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary fungus.

action.name: Poison Needle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Poison Dart
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. {@hit 5} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Spore Cloud {@recharge 5}
entries: The wirbeln ejects spores in a 15- foot cone. All creatures that are not wirbeln fungi must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) poison damage and be subject to one of the following effects for 1 minute, depending on the wirbeln's color: green is {@condition poisoned}; red is {@condition blinded}; yellow is {@condition incapacitated}; blue is {@condition paralyzed}; purple is {@condition frightened}; and black is 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage each round. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The witch casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The witch casts {@spell Misty Step|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The witch makes three attacks, using Dagger or Eldritch Burst in any combination.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Eldritch Burst
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., or range 120 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) Force damage.

reaction.name: Retributive Vines
entries: {@actTrigger} The witch takes 5 or more damage from an attacker it can see. {@actResponse} Vines grow out of the ground to wrap around the attacker. The target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn.

reaction.name: Reflexive Hex
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the witch can see within 60 feet succeeds on a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}. {@actResponse} The target must roll a {@dice d6} and subtract the number rolled from the triggering roll.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The witch is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). The witch has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Coven Member
entries: The witch has advantage on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) checks involving a witch coven.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}1 bludgeoning damage.

name: Witchlight
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: The witchlight is incapacitated while in the area of an {@spell antimagic field}. If targeted by {@spell dispel magic}, the witchlight must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The witchlight doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Variable Illumination
entries: The witchlight sheds bright light in a 5- to 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius. The witchlight can alter the radius as a bonus action.

action.name: Light Blast
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) radiant damage.

action.name: Flash (3/Day)
entries: The witchlight emits a bright burst of light. Each creature within 20 feet of the witchlight must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded} for 1 minute. A creature can make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Cursed Scratch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls until the start of the witchwoven's next turn.

reaction.name: Protective Bond
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the witchwoven can see within 60 feet takes damage. {@actResponse} The creature gains {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the triggering damage, and the witchwoven takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Force damage.

trait.name: Lethe
entries: When the wobalas's soul count is 0, they have advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and their Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, the wobalas must use their movement on each of their turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature they can sense with their soulsight, and then if they are able, they must use their action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. The wobalas can't act with any other purpose until they add 1 to their soul count.

trait.name: Soul Devourer
entries: When the wobalas reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the wobalas consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to the wobalas's soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wobalas makes three Despair Bolt attacks.

action.name: Despair Bolt
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one creature. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage. The wobalas can burn 1 soul to make the target {@condition frightened} of them for 1 minute. If the target is immune to being {@condition frightened}, the wobalas regains the burned soul.

action.name: Banishing Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage, and the target is teleported up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the wobalas can see.

bonus.name: Flee, Mortal (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: The wobalas chooses a creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to move their speed away from the wobalas by the most direct route possible, with no regard for their own safety. Creatures who can't be {@condition frightened} succeed on this saving throw automatically.

trait.name: Danger Sense
entries: While conscious, the wolf reaver dwarf has advantage on Dexterity saving throws.

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: The wolf reaver dwarf has advantage on saving throws against poison.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The wolf reaver dwarf has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the dwarf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the wolf reaver dwarf can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wolf reaver dwarf makes one Battleaxe attack and two Spear attacks, or it makes three Handaxe attacks.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage, or 9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Handaxe
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

name: Wolf-chieftain
passive: 15 (20 when relying on hearing or smell)

trait.name: Fear of Fire
entries: If a Wolf-chieftain takes fire or radiant damage, it must succeed on a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check ({@dc 10} + damage taken) or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The Wolf-chieftain has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The Wolf-chieftain has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Wolf-chieftain's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must make a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Aversion to Axes
entries: At the start of the woodwarped's turn, if it can see a creature holding a Battleaxe, a Greataxe, or a Handaxe, it has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Thorns
entries: At the start of each of its turns, the woodwarped deals 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Piercing damage to any creature it is grappling or any creature grappling it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The woodwarped makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Poison damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}) from one of two claws.

action.name: Thorn Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the woodwarped, with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} if {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by it. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Splintered Propagation (1/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} The woodwarped takes Slashing damage that isn't from a Battleaxe, Greataxe, or Handaxe. {@actResponse} A fragment of the woodwarped breaks off and rapidly grows into a new Woodwarped in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the original. The new woodwarped is Small, has 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, only has the Claw action, lacks this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, and takes its turn on the original woodwarped's {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

trait.name: Move as One
entries: While the worg's caregiver is mounted on the worg, opportunity attacks against the worg or their caregiver are made with disadvantage. The worg's caregiver can mount or dismount the worg by spending 5 feet of movement.

action.name: Signature Attack (Bite)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Overwhelming Attack (2 Ferocity)
entries: The worg makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} damage, and the target can't take reactions until the start of the worg's next turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Brutal Charge (5 Ferocity)
entries: The worg moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. During or at the end of this move, they can make a signature attack against one target.

action.name: 5th Level: Bite Rampage (8 Ferocity)
entries: The worg makes signature attacks against PB creatures of their choice within 5 feet of them. On a hit, a target is knocked {@condition prone}.

name: Wormhearted Suffragan
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The wormhearted suffragan has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Master of Undeath
entries: A Humanoid killed by the wormhearted suffragan's disease rises {@dice 1d4} hours later as a skeleton or zombie (the suffragan's choice), unless the Humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. Between its disease and its Animating Worms, the suffragan can have no more than fifteen total skeletons and zombies under its control at one time.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The wormhearted suffragan doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wormhearted suffragan makes two Worm-Coated Fist or Paralyzing Bolt attacks.

action.name: Worm-Coated Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or contract a disease. Until the disease is cured, the target can't regain hp, and its hp maximum decreases by 7 ({@dice 2d6}) every 24 hours. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest after the disease is cured. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

action.name: Paralyzing Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Animating Worms (3/Day)
entries: The wormhearted suffragan touches the body of a dead Humanoid, passing on some of the suffragan's worms. The worms fill the target, animating it as a skeleton or zombie (the suffragan's choice) under the suffragan's control.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The surgeon regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If it takes Poison damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The surgeon dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Veiled Ignorance
entries: A creature whose mind can't be read, or that is under the effect of a {@spell Mind Blank|XPHB} or {@spell Nondetection|XPHB} spell, has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition toward the surgeon (this ignores the surgeon's Blindsight).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The surgeon makes two Bone Saw attacks.

action.name: Bone Saw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Psychic damage.
